### `app/api/trails/route/route.ts`

```typescript
import { parseRouteResponse, type LatLng } from "@/lib/trail-routing";
import { validShapingWaypoints } from "@/lib/route-shaping";
import { orsCoordinateKey } from "@/lib/ors-request-control";
import { queryORS, trailRoutingRequest, TrailRoutingError, orsResultCache } from "@/lib/trail-routing-server";

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    // Keep access and endpoint validation centralized. The original request is
    // consumed there; clone it to also read optional intermediate coordinates.
    const extra = await request.clone().json().catch(() => null) as unknown;
    const body = await trailRoutingRequest(request, "route");
    const rawVia = extra && typeof extra === "object" ? (extra as Record<string, unknown>).via : undefined;
    if (rawVia !== undefined && !validShapingWaypoints(rawVia)) {
      throw new TrailRoutingError("Invalid route-shaping waypoint coordinates.", 400);
    }
    const via: LatLng[] = (rawVia as LatLng[] | undefined) ?? [];
    const coordinates = [body.from!, ...via, body.to!];
    const result = await orsResultCache.getOrLoad(
      orsCoordinateKey("route", coordinates),
      async () => {
        try { return parseRouteResponse(await queryORS("route", coordinates), body.from!, body.to!); }
        catch (error) {
          // ORS 422 (including provider 404/code 2010) is a missing trail; avoid asking again for the
          // exact same coordinates during the short negative-cache lifetime.
          if (error instanceof TrailRoutingError && error.status === 422) return null;
          throw error;
        }
      },
    );
    if (!result) return Response.json({ error: "No connected hiking trail found for these stops. Use a manual segment instead." }, { status: 422 });
    return Response.json(result, { headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
  } catch (error) {
    const status = error instanceof TrailRoutingError ? error.status : 500;
    return Response.json({ error: error instanceof TrailRoutingError ? error.message : "Could not follow trails." },
      { status, headers: error instanceof TrailRoutingError && error.retryAfterSeconds
        ? { "Retry-After": String(error.retryAfterSeconds), "Cache-Control": "no-store" }
        : { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
  }
}




```

### `app/api/trails/snap/route.ts`

```typescript
import { parseSnapResponse } from "@/lib/trail-routing";
import { orsCoordinateKey } from "@/lib/ors-request-control";
import { queryORS, trailRoutingRequest, TrailRoutingError, orsResultCache } from "@/lib/trail-routing-server";

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await trailRoutingRequest(request, "snap");
    const coordinates = [body.point!];
    const result = await orsResultCache.getOrLoad(
      orsCoordinateKey("snap", coordinates),
      async () => {
        try { return parseSnapResponse(await queryORS("snap", coordinates)); }
        catch (error) {
          if (error instanceof TrailRoutingError && error.status === 422) return null;
          throw error;
        }
      },
    );
    if (!result) return Response.json({ error: "No hiking trail within 75 m. The waypoint was left in place." }, { status: 422 });
    return Response.json(result, { headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
  } catch (error) {
    const status = error instanceof TrailRoutingError ? error.status : 500;
    return Response.json({ error: error instanceof TrailRoutingError ? error.message : "Could not snap to a trail." },
      { status, headers: error instanceof TrailRoutingError && error.retryAfterSeconds
        ? { "Retry-After": String(error.retryAfterSeconds), "Cache-Control": "no-store" }
        : { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
  }
}
```

### `app/api/trip-resources/route.ts`

```typescript
import { requireBuildAccess } from "@/lib/build-access";
import { parseOsmResources } from "@/lib/trip-resources";

/** Explicit opt-in discovery. OSM locations are leads, not verified access or potable water. */
export const runtime = "nodejs";
const cache = new Map<string, { expires: number; value: ReturnType<typeof parseOsmResources> }>();
const lastSearch = new Map<string, number>();
export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const params = new URL(request.url).searchParams;
  const buildId = params.get("buildId") ?? "";
  try { await requireBuildAccess(buildId); }
  catch { return Response.json({ error: "You do not have access to this trip." }, { status: 403 }); }
  const lat = Number(params.get("lat")), lng = Number(params.get("lng")), radius = Number(params.get("radius") ?? "3000");
  if (!Number.isFinite(lat) || !Number.isFinite(lng) || !Number.isInteger(radius) || radius < 300 || radius > 5000 || lat < 48 || lat > 60.5 || lng < -140 || lng > -113) {
    return Response.json({ error: "Choose a valid BC map position and a radius of 300–5000 m." }, { status: 400 });
  }
  const key = `${lat.toFixed(3)},${lng.toFixed(3)},${radius}`;
  const stored = cache.get(key);
  if (stored && stored.expires > Date.now()) return Response.json({ results: stored.value, source: "OpenStreetMap", cached: true });
  const previous = lastSearch.get(buildId) ?? 0;
  if (Date.now() - previous < 30000) return Response.json({ error: "Try the resource search again in about 30 seconds." }, { status: 429 });
  lastSearch.set(buildId, Date.now());
  const api = process.env.OVERPASS_API_URL ?? "https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter";
  if (api !== "https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter" && !/^https:\/\/[-a-z0-9.]+(?:\/[\w/-]+)?$/i.test(api)) return Response.json({ error: "Invalid configured map data endpoint." }, { status: 503 });
  const around = `(around:${radius},${lat.toFixed(5)},${lng.toFixed(5)})`;
  const query = `[out:json][timeout:15];(nwr["tourism"~"^(camp_site|camp_pitch)$"]${around};nwr["amenity"="drinking_water"]${around};nwr["natural"="spring"]${around};);out center 80;`;
  try {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 17500);
    let response: Response;
    try { response = await fetch(api, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded", "User-Agent": "TrailPicker/0.4 (trail logistics resource discovery)" }, body: new URLSearchParams({ data: query }).toString(), signal: controller.signal, cache: "no-store" }); }
    finally { clearTimeout(timeout); }
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Map data service unavailable (${response.status}).`);
    const data: unknown = await response.json();
    const results = parseOsmResources(data);
    if (cache.size > 100) cache.delete(cache.keys().next().value!);
    cache.set(key, { expires: Date.now() + 12 * 60 * 60 * 1000, value: results });
    return Response.json({ results, source: "OpenStreetMap", cached: false }, { headers: { "Cache-Control": "private, max-age=600" } });
  } catch {
    return Response.json({ error: "Map data is temporarily unavailable. You can still add campsite and water stops manually." }, { status: 503 });
  }
}
```

### `app/api/weather/route.ts`

```typescript
import {
  getWeather,
  mountain,
  validateQuery,
  WeatherInputError,
} from "@/lib/weather/service";
export const runtime = "nodejs";
// GeoMet cold-cache sampling involves multiple bounded WMS requests.
export const maxDuration = 60;
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const started = Date.now();
  const headers = { "Cache-Control": "no-store", "Server-Timing": "" };
  try {
    const params = new URL(request.url).searchParams,
      query = validateQuery(params);
    const data =
      params.get("model") === "1"
        ? await mountain(query.lat, query.lng, query.date, query.zone)
        : await getWeather(query, { summary: params.get("view") === "summary" });
    headers["Server-Timing"] = `weather;dur=${Date.now() - started}`;
    return Response.json(data, { headers });
  } catch (error) {
    headers["Server-Timing"] = `weather;dur=${Date.now() - started}`;
    return Response.json(
      {
        error:
          error instanceof WeatherInputError
            ? error.message
            : "Weather is temporarily unavailable. Please retry.",
      },
      { status: error instanceof WeatherInputError ? 400 : 503, headers },
    );
  }
}
```

### `app/build/[id]/page.tsx`

```typescript
import { getBuildViewAccess } from "@/lib/build-visibility";
import PrivateBuildNotice from "@/components/builder/PrivateBuildNotice";
import PublicBuildView from "@/components/builder/PublicBuildView";
import { claimCurrentBuild } from "@/app/build/actions";
import { currentBuildUserId } from "@/lib/build-access";

import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { calculateWeightBreakdown, calculateTotalCost } from "@/lib/calculations";
import { type BuildForCompat, type CompatItem } from "@/lib/compatibility";
import WeightSummary from "@/components/builder/WeightSummary";
import { readFoodPlan } from "@/lib/food-plan";
import BuildRow from "@/components/builder/BuildRow";
import BuildHeader from "@/components/builder/BuildHeader";
import CostSummary from "@/components/builder/CostSummary";
import ShareBar from "@/components/builder/ShareBar";
import CompatibilityBar from "@/components/builder/CompatibilityBar";
import CompatibilityDetails from "@/components/builder/CompatibilityDetails";
import {
  evaluateCompatibility,
} from "@/lib/compatibility";
import TripPlanner from "@/components/builder/TripPlanner/TripPlanner";
import { evaluatePackIntelligence, type IntelligenceItem } from "@/lib/pack-intelligence";

export default async function BuildPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<{ tab?: string }>;
}) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const view = await getBuildViewAccess(id);
  if (view.status === "missing") notFound();
  if (view.status === "private") return <PrivateBuildNotice buildId={id} />;
  const access = view.access;
  const canClaim = view.canEdit && access?.userId === null && !!(await currentBuildUserId());
  const { tab } = await searchParams;

  const activeTab = tab === "trip" ? "trip" : "gear";

  const build = await prisma.build.findUnique({
    where: view.canEdit && access ? { id, userId: access.userId } : { id, isPublic: true },
    include: {
      items: {
        include: {
          gear: {
            include: {
              brand: true,
              category: true,
              subcategory: true,
              images: true,
              specifications: true, // For explicitly labelled shelter sleeping capacity.
            },
          },
        },
      },
      days: { orderBy: { date: "asc" } },
    },
  });

  if (!build) notFound();

  const { base, consumable, worn, total } = calculateWeightBreakdown(build.items);
  const totalCost = calculateTotalCost(build.items);
  const plannedFood = readFoodPlan(build.tripLogistics);
  const plannedConsumables = plannedFood.foods.filter(item=>item.countInPack).reduce((sum,item)=>sum+(item.gramsPerUnit??0)*item.startingUnits,0)
    + (plannedFood.settings.countFuelInPack?plannedFood.settings.startingFuelGrams:0);
  const plannedUnknown = plannedFood.foods.some(item=>item.countInPack && item.gramsPerUnit===null && item.startingUnits>0);
  // Ownership belongs to the signed-in build owner, not the public viewer.
  const ownedGearIds = view.canEdit && access?.userId
    ? new Set((await prisma.ownedGear.findMany({
      where: { userId: access.userId, gearId: { in: build.items.flatMap(item => item.gearId ? [item.gearId] : []) } },
      select: { gearId: true },
    })).map(item => item.gearId))
    : new Set<string>();
  const costToBuy = calculateTotalCost(build.items.filter(item => !item.gearId || !ownedGearIds.has(item.gearId)));

  const compatBuild: BuildForCompat = {
    people: build.people,
    minTemperature: build.minTemperature,
    conditions: build.conditions,
    startDate: build.startDate,
    endDate: build.endDate,
  };

  const compatItems: CompatItem[] = build.items.map((item) => ({
    id: item.id,
    quantity: item.quantity,
    isConsumable: item.isConsumable,
    isWorn: item.isWorn,
    customCategory: item.customCategory,
    gearNameSnapshot: item.gearNameSnapshot,
    weightSnapshot: item.weightSnapshot,
    priceSnapshot: item.priceSnapshot,
    gear: item.gear
      ? {
        id: item.gear.id,
        name: item.gear.name,
        weight_g: item.gear.weight_g,
        price_cad: item.gear.price_cad,
        capacity_l: item.gear.capacity_l,
        specifications: item.gear.specifications.map(spec => ({ key: spec.key, value: spec.value, unit: spec.unit })),
        frame_type: item.gear.frame_type,
        waterproof: item.gear.waterproof,
        temperature_rating: item.gear.temperature_rating,
        season: item.gear.season,
        category: { name: item.gear.category.name },
        subcategory: item.gear.subcategory
          ? { name: item.gear.subcategory.name, slug: item.gear.subcategory.slug }
          : null,
      }
      : null,
  }));
  const issues = evaluateCompatibility(compatBuild, compatItems, build.days);
  const intelligenceFindings = evaluatePackIntelligence(build, compatItems as IntelligenceItem[], build.days).findings;
  const analysisReviewCount = intelligenceFindings.filter(f => f.level === "critical" || f.level === "review").length;

  if (!view.canEdit) {
    const publicBuild = {
      id: build.id, name: build.name,
      location: build.location, locationLat: build.locationLat, locationLng: build.locationLng,
      startDate: build.startDate, endDate: build.endDate,
      people: build.people, minTemperature: build.minTemperature, conditions: build.conditions,
      // Hide new free-text resource annotations on public build pages.
      // Booking references stay in private tripLogistics and never enter routeWaypoints.
      routeWaypoints: Array.isArray(build.routeWaypoints) ? build.routeWaypoints.map(point => {
        if (!point || typeof point !== "object" || Array.isArray(point)) return point;
        const { resource: _privateResource, ...publicPoint } = point as Record<string, unknown>;
        void _privateResource;
        return publicPoint;
      }) : build.routeWaypoints,
      days: build.days.map(day => ({
        id: day.id, date: day.date, minTemperature: day.minTemperature,
        conditions: day.conditions, notes: null,
        startLocation: day.startLocation, endLocation: day.endLocation,
        distanceKm: day.distanceKm, elevationGainM: day.elevationGainM,
        elevationLossM: day.elevationLossM, durationMinutes: day.durationMinutes,
        campsite: day.campsite, reservation: null, waterSource: day.waterSource,
        waterCarryL: day.waterCarryL, trailConditions: day.trailConditions,
        activities: day.activities,
      })),
      items: build.items.map(item => ({
        id: item.id, quantity: item.quantity, isWorn: item.isWorn,
        isConsumable: item.isConsumable, customCategory: item.customCategory,
        gearNameSnapshot: item.gearNameSnapshot, weightSnapshot: item.weightSnapshot,
        priceSnapshot: item.priceSnapshot,
        gear: item.gear ? {
          id: item.gear.id, name: item.gear.name, weight_g: item.gear.weight_g,
          price_cad: item.gear.price_cad, category: { name: item.gear.category.name },
        } : null,
      })),
    };
    return <PublicBuildView build={publicBuild} activeTab={activeTab}
      compatBuild={compatBuild} compatItems={compatItems}
      issueCount={analysisReviewCount} />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      {canClaim && (
        <form action={claimCurrentBuild} className="mx-5 mt-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 max-md:flex-wrap rounded-md border border-green-200 bg-green-50 p-3 text-sm">
          <input type="hidden" name="buildId" value={build.id} />
          <span>This guest build is saved in this browser for 30 days.</span>
          <button type="submit" className="rounded-md bg-green-800 px-3 py-2 font-medium text-white">Save to my account</button>
        </form>
      )}
      <BuildHeader
        buildId={build.id}
        name={build.name}
        active={activeTab}
        issueCount={analysisReviewCount}
      />

      <div className="mx-auto mt-4 max-w-screen-2xl px-4">
        <div className="relative overflow-visible rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-sm">

          <CompatibilityBar
            buildId={build.id}
            trip={build}
            items={compatItems}
            totalWeight={total}
          />

          <div className="border-t border-gray-100">
            <ShareBar
              buildId={build.id}
              buildName={build.name}
              isPublic={build.isPublic}
              createdAt={build.createdAt}
              updatedAt={build.updatedAt}
              activeTab={activeTab}
              gpxDays={build.days.map(day => ({ id: day.id, date: day.date }))}
            />
          </div>

        </div>
      </div>
      <main className="max-w-screen-2xl mx-auto p-2">

        {activeTab === "trip" ? (

          <TripPlanner
            build={{
              id: build.id,
              location: build.location,
              locationLat: build.locationLat,
              locationLng: build.locationLng,
              startDate: build.startDate,
              endDate: build.endDate,
              people: build.people,
              minTemperature: build.minTemperature,
              conditions: build.conditions,
              days: build.days,
              routeWaypoints: build.routeWaypoints,
              tripLogistics: build.tripLogistics,
            }}
            issues={issues}
            items={compatItems}
          />

        ) : (

          <>
            <div className="mt-10 overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-white">
              <div className="grid max-md:hidden grid-cols-[180px_minmax(0,1fr)_100px_100px_100px] p-3 text-xs bg-gray-50 font-light text-gray-600">
                <div>Component</div>
                <div>Selection</div>
                <div className="text-center pr-5">Weight</div>
                <div className="text-center pr-5">Price</div>
                <div></div>
              </div>

              <BuildRow name="Backpack" gearLink="/gear/packs" selectCategory="packs" categoryName="Packs" buildId={build.id} ownedGearIds={ownedGearIds}
                items={build.items.filter((i) => i.gear?.category.name === "Packs" || i.customCategory === "Packs")} />
              <BuildRow name="Shelter" gearLink="/gear/shelter" selectCategory="shelter" categoryName="Shelter" buildId={build.id} ownedGearIds={ownedGearIds}
                items={build.items.filter((i) => i.gear?.category.name === "Shelter" || i.customCategory === "Shelter")} />
              <BuildRow name="Sleep System" gearLink="/gear/sleep" selectCategory="sleep" categoryName="Sleep" buildId={build.id} ownedGearIds={ownedGearIds}
                items={build.items.filter((i) => i.gear?.category.name === "Sleep" || i.customCategory === "Sleep")} />
              <BuildRow name="Cooking" gearLink="/gear/cooking" selectCategory="cooking" categoryName="Cooking" buildId={build.id} ownedGearIds={ownedGearIds}
                items={build.items.filter((i) => i.gear?.category.name === "Cooking" || i.customCategory === "Cooking")} />
              <BuildRow name="Water" gearLink="/gear/water" selectCategory="water" categoryName="Water" buildId={build.id} ownedGearIds={ownedGearIds}
                items={build.items.filter((i) => i.gear?.category.name === "Water" || i.customCategory === "Water")} />
              <BuildRow name="Clothing" gearLink="/gear/clothing" selectCategory="clothing" categoryName="Clothing" buildId={build.id} ownedGearIds={ownedGearIds}
                items={build.items.filter((i) => i.gear?.category.name === "Clothing" || i.customCategory === "Clothing")} />
              <BuildRow name="Electronics" gearLink="/gear/electronics" selectCategory="electronics" categoryName="Electronics" buildId={build.id} ownedGearIds={ownedGearIds}
                items={build.items.filter((i) => i.gear?.category.name === "Electronics" || i.customCategory === "Electronics")} />
              <BuildRow name="Miscellaneous" gearLink="/gear/misc" selectCategory="misc" categoryName="Misc" buildId={build.id} ownedGearIds={ownedGearIds}
                items={build.items.filter((i) => i.gear?.category.name === "Misc" || i.customCategory === "Misc")} />

              <CostSummary totalCost={totalCost} costToBuy={costToBuy} />
            </div>

            <WeightSummary
              base={base}
              consumable={consumable}
              worn={worn}
              total={total}
              plannedConsumables={plannedConsumables}
              plannedUnknown={plannedUnknown}
            />

            <CompatibilityDetails
              buildId={build.id}
              trip={build}
              items={compatItems}
            />
          </>

        )}

      </main>

    </div>
  );
}
```

### `app/build/actions.ts`

```typescript
"use server";

import { saveTripDetails, saveTripDay } from "@/lib/trip-planner-actions";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { getDateRange } from "@/lib/trip";
import { currentBuildUserId, hasGuestBuildAccess, requireBuildAccess, requireBuildItemAccess, setCurrentBuild } from "@/lib/build-access";
import { guestBuildCookieName } from "@/lib/guest-build-token";
import { getDestination } from "@/lib/destinations";
import { createDiscoverDaySeed, createDiscoverLogistics } from "@/lib/discover-trip";
import { Prisma } from "@/app/generated/prisma/client";
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { remapRouteDays, validatedRoute } from "@/lib/itinerary-links";
import { getBuildSnapshot, lockBuild, mutateBuildWithRevision, recordBuildRevision } from "@/lib/build-history";
import { combinedQuantity, formNumber, formText, parseBuildDetails, parseLogistics, MAX_GEAR_QUANTITY } from "@/lib/build-validation";

function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) throw new Error("Invalid TrailPicker import file.");
  return value as Record<string, unknown>;
}

function optionalText(value: unknown, max: number) {
  if (value == null || value === "") return null;
  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length > max) throw new Error("Invalid TrailPicker import file.");
  return value;
}

function optionalNumber(value: unknown, min: number, max: number, integer = false) {
  if (value == null || value === "") return null;
  if (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(value) || value < min || value > max || (integer && !Number.isInteger(value))) {
    throw new Error("Invalid TrailPicker import file.");
  }
  return value;
}

function importDate(value: unknown) {
  if (value == null || value === "") return null;
  if (typeof value !== "string") throw new Error("Invalid TrailPicker import file.");
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) throw new Error("Invalid TrailPicker import date.");
  return date;
}

function importItem(value: unknown) {
  const item = asRecord(value);
  const quantity = optionalNumber(item.quantity, 1, 999, true) ?? 1;
  const gearId = optionalText(item.gearId, 200);
  const gearName = optionalText(item.gearName, 200);
  const gearNameSnapshot = optionalText(item.gearNameSnapshot, 200);
  return {
    gearId,
    gearName,
    quantity,
    isConsumable: item.isConsumable === true,
    isWorn: item.isWorn === true,
    customCategory: optionalText(item.customCategory, 100),
    gearNameSnapshot,
    weightSnapshot: optionalNumber(item.weightSnapshot, 0, 1_000_000, true),
    priceSnapshot: optionalNumber(item.priceSnapshot, 0, 1_000_000),
  };
}

function importDay(value: unknown) {
  const day = asRecord(value);
  const sourceId = optionalText(day.id, 200);
  const date = importDate(day.date);
  if (!date) throw new Error("Imported itinerary day is missing a date.");
  const text = (key: string, max = 5000) => optionalText(day[key], max);
  return {
    sourceId,
    date,
    minTemperature: optionalNumber(day.minTemperature, -100, 60, true),
    conditions: text("conditions", 20),
    notes: text("notes"),
    startLocation: text("startLocation", 500),
    endLocation: text("endLocation", 500),
    distanceKm: optionalNumber(day.distanceKm, 0, 1000),
    elevationGainM: optionalNumber(day.elevationGainM, 0, 20000, true),
    elevationLossM: optionalNumber(day.elevationLossM, 0, 20000, true),
    durationMinutes: optionalNumber(day.durationMinutes, 0, 1440, true),
    campsite: text("campsite"),
    reservation: text("reservation"),
    waterSource: text("waterSource"),
    waterCarryL: optionalNumber(day.waterCarryL, 0, 100),
    trailConditions: text("trailConditions"),
    activities: text("activities"),
  };
}

export async function getBuildExport(buildId: string) {
  const access = await requireBuildAccess(buildId);
  const snapshot = await getBuildSnapshot(access.id, access.userId);

  return {
    format: "trailpicker-build",
    version: 3,
    exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    ...snapshot,
  };
}

export async function importBuildItems(formData: FormData) {
  const buildId = formData.get("buildId")?.toString() ?? "";
  const access = await requireBuildAccess(buildId);
  const raw = formData.get("payload");
  const mode = formData.get("mode") === "replace" ? "replace" : "merge";

  if (typeof raw !== "string" || raw.length > 2_000_000) throw new Error("Import file is missing or too large.");

  let parsed: unknown;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    throw new Error("That file is not valid JSON.");
  }
  const payload = asRecord(parsed);
  if (payload.format != null && payload.format !== "trailpicker-build") throw new Error("That JSON file is not a TrailPicker build export.");
  if (!Array.isArray(payload.items) || payload.items.length > 1000) throw new Error("Import must contain no more than 1,000 gear items.");
  if (payload.days != null && (!Array.isArray(payload.days) || payload.days.length > 366)) throw new Error("Import must contain no more than 366 itinerary days.");

  const items = payload.items.map(importItem);
  const days = Array.isArray(payload.days) ? payload.days.map(importDay) : null;
  if (days && new Set(days.map(day => day.date.toISOString().slice(0, 10))).size !== days.length) {
    throw new Error("Imported itinerary contains duplicate dates.");
  }
  if (mode === "replace") {
    const ids = items.map(item => item.gearId).filter((id): id is string => Boolean(id));
    if (new Set(ids).size !== ids.length) throw new Error("Replacement import contains the same gear item more than once.");
  }
  // Reject invalid route objects before the database transaction rather than
  // storing values that readWaypoints later silently removes from the UI.
  const importRoute = mode === "replace" ? validatedRoute(payload.routeWaypoints) : null;
  const importLogistics = mode === "replace" ? parseLogistics(payload.tripLogistics,
    days?.flatMap(day => day.sourceId ? [day.sourceId] : []) ?? [],
    importRoute?.filter(p => p.kind === "camp").map(p => p.id) ?? [],
    importRoute?.filter(p => p.kind === "resupply").map(p => p.id) ?? []) : null;
  const requestedGearIds = [...new Set(items.map((item) => item.gearId).filter((id): id is string => Boolean(id)))];
  const existingGear = requestedGearIds.length
    ? await prisma.gear.findMany({ where: { id: { in: requestedGearIds } }, select: { id: true } })
    : [];
  const existingGearIds = new Set(existingGear.map((gear) => gear.id));
  let unassignedStops = 0;

  await mutateBuildWithRevision(access.id, access.userId, "import",
    mode === "replace" ? `Imported and replaced build with ${items.length} gear items` : `Imported ${items.length} gear items`,
    async (tx) => {
    if (mode === "replace") {
      const startDate = importDate(payload.startDate);
      const endDate = importDate(payload.endDate);
      if ((startDate == null) !== (endDate == null) ||
          (startDate && endDate && (endDate < startDate || endDate.getTime() - startDate.getTime() > 365 * 86_400_000))) {
        throw new Error("Imported trip dates are invalid or exceed 366 days.");
      }

      const name = optionalText(payload.name, 100) ?? "Imported build";
      const people = optionalNumber(payload.people, 1, 100, true) ?? 1;
      const location = optionalText(payload.location, 500);
      const locationLat = optionalNumber(payload.locationLat, -90, 90);
      const locationLng = optionalNumber(payload.locationLng, -180, 180);
      if ((locationLat == null) !== (locationLng == null)) throw new Error("Imported coordinates must include latitude and longitude.");

      const importedRows = days
        ? days.map(({ sourceId, ...day }) => ({ ...day, id: randomUUID(), buildId: access.id, sourceId }))
        : startDate && endDate
          ? getDateRange(startDate, endDate).map((date) => ({ id: randomUUID(), buildId: access.id, date, sourceId: null }))
          : [];
      const linked = remapRouteDays(importRoute,
        days?.map((day) => ({ id: day.sourceId, date: day.date })) ?? [],
        importedRows,
      );
      unassignedStops = linked.unassignedCount;

      await tx.build.update({
        where: { id: access.id, userId: access.userId },
        data: {
          name,
          destinationId: optionalText(payload.destinationId, 200),
          location,
          locationLat,
          locationLng,
          startDate,
          endDate,
          people,
          minTemperature: optionalNumber(payload.minTemperature, -100, 60, true),
          conditions: optionalText(payload.conditions, 50),
          routeWaypoints: linked.points == null ? Prisma.DbNull : JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(linked.points)),
          tripLogistics: importLogistics == null ? Prisma.DbNull : (() => {
            const sourceToNewDay = new Map(importedRows.flatMap(row => row.sourceId ? [[row.sourceId, row.id] as const] : []));
            const phase6 = importLogistics.phase6;
            const phase7 = importLogistics.phase7;
            const arrangements = importLogistics.arrangements;
            return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({ ...importLogistics,
              ...(phase6 ? { phase6: { ...phase6, bookings: phase6.bookings.map(booking => ({
                ...booking, dayId: booking.dayId ? sourceToNewDay.get(booking.dayId) || "" : "",
              })) } } : {}),
              ...(arrangements ? { arrangements: arrangements.map(entry => ({ ...entry, dayId: entry.dayId ? sourceToNewDay.get(entry.dayId) || "" : "" })) } : {}),
              ...(phase7 ? { phase7: { ...phase7, meals: phase7.meals.map(meal => ({
                ...meal, dayId: sourceToNewDay.get(meal.dayId) || meal.dayId,
              })) } } : {}),
            }));
          })(),
        },
      });

      await tx.buildItem.deleteMany({ where: { buildId: access.id } });
      await tx.tripDay.deleteMany({ where: { buildId: access.id } });

      if (importedRows.length) {
        await tx.tripDay.createMany({ data: importedRows.map(({ sourceId, ...row }) => {
          void sourceId;
          return row;
        }) });
      }
    }

    for (const item of items) {
      const gearId = item.gearId && existingGearIds.has(item.gearId) ? item.gearId : null;
      if (mode === "merge" && gearId) {
        const existing = await tx.buildItem.findUnique({
          where: { buildId_gearId: { buildId: access.id, gearId } },
          select: { quantity: true },
        });
        combinedQuantity(existing?.quantity ?? 0, item.quantity);
        await tx.buildItem.upsert({
          where: { buildId_gearId: { buildId: access.id, gearId } },
          update: {
            quantity: { increment: item.quantity },
            isConsumable: item.isConsumable,
            isWorn: item.isWorn,
          },
          create: {
            buildId: access.id,
            gearId,
            quantity: item.quantity,
            isConsumable: item.isConsumable,
            isWorn: item.isWorn,
          },
        });
      } else {
        await tx.buildItem.create({
          data: {
            buildId: access.id,
            gearId,
            quantity: item.quantity,
            isConsumable: item.isConsumable,
            isWorn: item.isWorn,
            customCategory: item.customCategory,
            gearNameSnapshot: gearId ? item.gearNameSnapshot : item.gearNameSnapshot ?? item.gearName ?? "Imported item",
            weightSnapshot: item.weightSnapshot,
            priceSnapshot: item.priceSnapshot,
          },
        });
      }
    }
  });
  revalidatePath(`/build/${access.id}`);
  revalidatePath("/profile/builds");

  return { mode, itemCount: items.length, dayCount: days?.length ?? 0, unassignedStops };
}

export async function duplicateBuild(formData: FormData) {
  const buildId = formData.get("buildId") as string;

  const access = await requireBuildAccess(buildId);
  const ownerId = await currentBuildUserId();
  const original = await prisma.build.findUnique({
    where: { id: buildId, userId: access.userId },
    include: { items: true, days: true },
  });

  if (!original) throw new Error("Build not found.");

  if (original.items.some(item => !Number.isInteger(item.quantity) || item.quantity < 1 || item.quantity > MAX_GEAR_QUANTITY)) {
    throw new Error("This build contains an invalid gear quantity. Correct it before duplicating.");
  }
  const copiedDays = original.days.map((day) => ({ ...day, newId: randomUUID() }));
  const mappedRoute = remapRouteDays(
    validatedRoute(original.routeWaypoints),
    original.days,
    copiedDays.map((day) => ({ id: day.newId, date: day.date })),
  );
  const copy = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const created = await tx.build.create({
    data: {
      name: `${original.name} (copy)`,
      userId: ownerId,
      locationLat: original.locationLat,
      locationLng: original.locationLng,
      location: original.location,
      destinationId: original.destinationId,
      startDate: original.startDate,
      endDate: original.endDate,
      people: original.people,
      minTemperature: original.minTemperature,
      conditions: original.conditions,
      routeWaypoints: mappedRoute.points == null ? undefined : JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(mappedRoute.points)),
      tripLogistics: original.tripLogistics ?? undefined,
      days: { create: copiedDays.map(({ id, newId, buildId, createdAt, updatedAt, ...day }) => {
          // These fields belong to the original day, not the duplicated day.
          void id;
          void buildId;
          void createdAt;
          void updatedAt;
          return { ...day, id: newId };
        }) },
      items: {
        create: original.items.map((item) => ({
          gearId: item.gearId,
          quantity: item.quantity,
          isConsumable: item.isConsumable,
          isWorn: item.isWorn,
          customCategory: item.customCategory,
          gearNameSnapshot: item.gearNameSnapshot,
          weightSnapshot: item.weightSnapshot,
          priceSnapshot: item.priceSnapshot,
        })),
      },
    },
    });
    await recordBuildRevision(created.id, ownerId, "copy", `Created from ${original.name}`, tx);
    return created;
  });
  await setCurrentBuild(copy.id, !ownerId);
  redirect(`/build/${copy.id}`);
}
export async function setItemCategory(formData: FormData) {
  const buildId = formText(formData, "buildId", 200, true)!;
  const itemId = formText(formData, "itemId", 200, true)!;
  const category = formText(formData, "category", 20, true);
  if (!category || !["base", "worn", "consumable"].includes(category)) throw new Error("Invalid gear category.");
  const item = await requireBuildItemAccess(buildId, itemId);
  await mutateBuildWithRevision(buildId, item.accessUserId, "gear", "Changed gear category", async tx => {
    await tx.buildItem.update({
      where: { id: itemId, buildId, build: { userId: item.accessUserId } },
      data: { isWorn: category === "worn", isConsumable: category === "consumable" },
    });
  });
  revalidatePath(`/build/${buildId}`);
}

export async function addCustomItem(formData: FormData) {
  const buildId = formText(formData, "buildId", 200, true)!;
  const access = await requireBuildAccess(buildId);
  const category = formText(formData, "category", 100);
  const name = formText(formData, "name", 200, true)!;
  const weight = formNumber(formData, "weight_g", 0, 1_000_000, true);
  const price = formNumber(formData, "price_cad", 0, 1_000_000);
  await mutateBuildWithRevision(buildId, access.userId, "gear", `Added custom item: ${name}`, async tx => {
    await tx.buildItem.create({
      data: { buildId, customCategory: category, gearNameSnapshot: name, weightSnapshot: weight, priceSnapshot: price },
    });
  });
  redirect(`/build/${buildId}`);
}

export async function updateQuantity(formData: FormData) {
  const itemId = formText(formData, "itemId", 200, true)!;
  const buildId = formText(formData, "buildId", 200, true)!;
  const rawDelta = formText(formData, "delta", 2, true);
  if (rawDelta !== "1" && rawDelta !== "-1") throw new Error("Invalid quantity change.");
  const item = await requireBuildItemAccess(buildId, itemId);
  const delta = Number(rawDelta);
  await mutateBuildWithRevision(buildId, item.accessUserId, "gear", "Changed gear quantity", async tx => {
    // Conditional atomic update: concurrent requests cannot overwrite each other.
    const result = await tx.buildItem.updateMany({
      where: { id: itemId, buildId, build: { userId: item.accessUserId },
        quantity: delta === 1 ? { lt: MAX_GEAR_QUANTITY } : { gt: 1 } },
      data: { quantity: delta === 1 ? { increment: 1 } : { decrement: 1 } },
    });
    if (result.count !== 1 && delta === 1) throw new Error(`Maximum quantity is ${MAX_GEAR_QUANTITY}.`);
  });
  revalidatePath(`/build/${buildId}`);
}
export async function claimCurrentBuild(formData?: FormData) {
  const userId = await currentBuildUserId();
  if (!userId) return;
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const submittedId = formData?.get("buildId");
  const buildId = typeof submittedId === "string" ? submittedId : cookieStore.get("currentBuild")?.value;
  if (!buildId || !(await hasGuestBuildAccess(buildId))) return;
  const result = await prisma.$transaction(async tx => {
    await lockBuild(tx, buildId);
    return tx.build.updateMany({ where: { id: buildId, userId: null }, data: { userId } });
  });
  if (result.count) {
    cookieStore.delete(guestBuildCookieName(buildId));
    revalidatePath(`/build/${buildId}`);
    revalidatePath("/profile/builds");
  }
}
export async function createBuild(formData: FormData) {
  const ownerId = await currentBuildUserId();
  // Logged-in users may choose a default; guests always start private.
  const newBuildPublic = ownerId
    ? (await prisma.userSettings.findUnique({
        where: { userId: ownerId }, select: { defaultBuildPublic: true },
      }))?.defaultBuildPublic === true
    : false;
  const parsed = parseBuildDetails(formData);
  const selected = getDestination(parsed.destinationId);
  const discoverPlan = formData.get("discoverPlan") === "1" && selected !== null;
  const seedItinerary = formData.get("seedItinerary") === "1";
  const tripLogistics = discoverPlan && selected ? createDiscoverLogistics(selected) : undefined;
  const location = selected ? `${selected.name}, ${selected.park}` : parsed.location;
  const locationLat = selected?.latitude ?? parsed.latitude;
  const locationLng = selected?.longitude ?? parsed.longitude;
  const build = await prisma.$transaction(async tx => {
    const created = await tx.build.create({
      data: {
        name: parsed.name,
        destinationId: selected?.id ?? null,
        location, locationLat, locationLng, ...parsed.dates,
        people: parsed.people, minTemperature: parsed.minTemperature,
        conditions: parsed.conditions, userId: ownerId, isPublic: discoverPlan ? false : newBuildPublic,
        ...(tripLogistics ? { tripLogistics } : {}),
      },
    });
    if (created.startDate && created.endDate) {
      await tx.tripDay.createMany({
        data: getDateRange(created.startDate, created.endDate).map((date, index, dates) => ({
          buildId: created.id, date,
          ...(discoverPlan && seedItinerary && selected ? createDiscoverDaySeed(selected, index, dates.length) : {}),
        })),
        skipDuplicates: true,
      });
    }
    await recordBuildRevision(created.id, ownerId, "create", "Created build", tx);
    return created;
  });
  await setCurrentBuild(build.id, !ownerId);
  redirect(`/build/${build.id}${discoverPlan ? "?tab=trip" : ""}`);
}
export async function addGear(formData: FormData) {
  const buildId = formText(formData, "buildId", 200, true)!;
  const gearId = formText(formData, "gearId", 200, true)!;
  const access = await requireBuildAccess(buildId);
  await mutateBuildWithRevision(buildId, access.userId, "gear", "Added gear", async tx => {
    const existing = await tx.buildItem.findUnique({
      where: { buildId_gearId: { buildId, gearId } }, select: { quantity: true },
    });
    combinedQuantity(existing?.quantity ?? 0, 1);
    await tx.buildItem.upsert({
      where: { buildId_gearId: { buildId, gearId } },
      update: { quantity: { increment: 1 } },
      create: { buildId, gearId },
    });
  });
  redirect(`/build/${buildId}`);
}

export async function removeGear(formData: FormData) {
  const buildId = formText(formData, "buildId", 200, true)!;
  const itemId = formText(formData, "itemId", 200, true)!;
  const item = await requireBuildItemAccess(buildId, itemId);
  await mutateBuildWithRevision(buildId, item.accessUserId, "gear", "Removed gear", async tx => {
    await tx.buildItem.delete({ where: { id: itemId, buildId, build: { userId: item.accessUserId } } });
  });
  redirect(`/build/${buildId}`);
}

export async function updateTripDetails(formData: FormData) { return saveTripDetails(formData); }
export async function updateTripDay(formData: FormData) { return saveTripDay(formData); }
```

```typescript
export default function BuildPage() {

          <div className="bg-green-900 px-8 py-5 flex items-center justify-between">

        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

### `app/discover/actions.ts`

```typescript
"use server";

import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import { currentBuildUserId, setCurrentBuild } from "@/lib/build-access";
import { recordBuildRevision } from "@/lib/build-history";
import { remapRouteDays, validatedRoute } from "@/lib/itinerary-links";
import { getDestination } from "@/lib/destinations";
import { createBuild } from "@/app/build/actions";

function submittedId(formData: FormData): string {
  const id = formData.get("buildId");
  if (typeof id !== "string" || !id || id.length > 200) throw new Error("Invalid build.");
  return id;
}

function requestLogin(): never {
  redirect("/api/auth/signin?callbackUrl=%2Fdiscover");
}

export async function changeSavedBuild(formData: FormData): Promise<void> {
  const id = submittedId(formData);
  const intent = formData.get("intent");
  if (intent !== "save" && intent !== "unsave") throw new Error("Invalid bookmark action.");
  const userId = await currentBuildUserId();
  if (!userId) requestLogin();

  if (intent === "unsave") {
    await prisma.savedBuild.deleteMany({ where: { userId, buildId: id } });
  } else {
    const publicBuild = await prisma.build.findFirst({ where: { id, isPublic: true }, select: { id: true } });
    if (!publicBuild) throw new Error("This build is no longer public.");
    await prisma.savedBuild.upsert({
      where: { userId_buildId: { userId, buildId: id } },
      create: { userId, buildId: id },
      update: {},
    });
  }
  revalidatePath("/discover");
  revalidatePath("/discover/community");
  revalidatePath("/discover/saved");
  revalidatePath(`/discover/trips/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
  revalidatePath(`/discover/packs/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
}

/** Bookmark a catalog destination for the signed-in account. Idempotent on retries. */
export async function changeSavedDestination(formData: FormData): Promise<void> {
  const rawId = formData.get("destinationId");
  const intent = formData.get("intent");
  if (typeof rawId !== "string" || !rawId || rawId.length > 200) throw new Error("Invalid destination.");
  if (intent !== "save" && intent !== "unsave") throw new Error("Invalid bookmark action.");
  const userId = await currentBuildUserId();
  if (!userId) requestLogin();

  if (intent === "save") {
    // A stale or forged ID must never create a meaningless bookmark.
    if (!getDestination(rawId)) throw new Error("Destination not found.");
    await prisma.savedDestination.upsert({
      where: { userId_destinationId: { userId, destinationId: rawId } },
      create: { userId, destinationId: rawId },
      update: {},
    });
  } else {
    // Removal is still possible if a destination was removed from the catalog.
    await prisma.savedDestination.deleteMany({ where: { userId, destinationId: rawId } });
  }
  revalidatePath("/discover");
  revalidatePath("/discover/search");
  revalidatePath("/discover/saved");
  revalidatePath(`/discover/destinations/${encodeURIComponent(rawId)}`);
}

/** Create a PRIVATE, independent copy of a PUBLIC build. */
export async function copyPublicBuild(formData: FormData): Promise<void> {
  const id = submittedId(formData);
  const userId = await currentBuildUserId();
  if (!userId) requestLogin();

  const source = await prisma.build.findFirst({
    where: { id, isPublic: true },
    include: { items: true, days: { orderBy: { date: "asc" } } },
  });
  if (!source) throw new Error("This build is no longer public.");
  if (source.items.length > 1000 || source.days.length > 366 || source.items.some(
    (item) => !Number.isInteger(item.quantity) || item.quantity < 1 || item.quantity > 999,
  )) throw new Error("The source build is too large or contains invalid gear quantities.");

  const copiedDays = source.days.map((day) => ({ original: day, id: randomUUID() }));
  // Remap waypoint references to the copied day IDs, never the owner's IDs.
  const mapped = remapRouteDays(
    validatedRoute(source.routeWaypoints),
    source.days,
    copiedDays.map((day) => ({ id: day.id, date: day.original.date })),
  );

  const copy = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const created = await tx.build.create({
      data: {
        name: `${source.name.slice(0, 91)} (copy)`,
        userId,
        isPublic: false,
        destinationId: source.destinationId,
        location: source.location,
        locationLat: source.locationLat,
        locationLng: source.locationLng,
        startDate: source.startDate,
        endDate: source.endDate,
        people: source.people,
        minTemperature: source.minTemperature,
        conditions: source.conditions,
        // Never duplicate private logistics or booking information.
        routeWaypoints: mapped.points == null ? undefined : JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(
          mapped.points.map(({ note: _note, ...point }) => point),
        )),
        days: {
          create: copiedDays.map(({ original: day, id: newId }) => ({
            id: newId,
            date: day.date,
            minTemperature: day.minTemperature,
            conditions: day.conditions,
            startLocation: day.startLocation,
            endLocation: day.endLocation,
            distanceKm: day.distanceKm,
            elevationGainM: day.elevationGainM,
            elevationLossM: day.elevationLossM,
            durationMinutes: day.durationMinutes,
            campsite: day.campsite,
            waterSource: day.waterSource,
            waterCarryL: day.waterCarryL,
            trailConditions: day.trailConditions,
            activities: day.activities,
            // Excluded on purpose: notes, reservation.
          })),
        },
        items: {
          create: source.items.map((item) => ({
            gearId: item.gearId,
            quantity: item.quantity,
            customCategory: item.customCategory,
            gearNameSnapshot: item.gearNameSnapshot,
            weightSnapshot: item.weightSnapshot,
            priceSnapshot: item.priceSnapshot,
            isConsumable: item.isConsumable,
            isWorn: item.isWorn,
            customWeight: item.customWeight,
          })),
        },
      },
    });
    await recordBuildRevision(created.id, userId, "copy", `Created from a public build`, tx);
    return created;
  });

  await setCurrentBuild(copy.id);
  redirect(`/build/${copy.id}${source.days.length ? "?tab=trip" : ""}`);
}

/** Start a real trip using an existing destination record, including guest ownership. */
export async function startDestinationPlan(formData: FormData): Promise<void> {
  const raw = formData.get("destinationId");
  if (typeof raw !== "string" || raw.length > 200) throw new Error("Invalid destination.");
  const destination = getDestination(raw);
  if (!destination) throw new Error("Destination not found.");

  // Only forward supported fields. createBuild validates dates, traveller count,
  // creates the private build, seeds editable days, and redirects to Trip Planner.
  const requestedName = formData.get("name");
  if (requestedName !== null &&
      (typeof requestedName !== "string" || requestedName.length > 100)) {
    throw new Error("Invalid trip name.");
  }
  const values = new FormData();
  values.set("name", typeof requestedName === "string" && requestedName.trim()
    ? requestedName.trim() : `${destination.name.slice(0, 92)} trip`);
  values.set("destinationId", destination.id);
  for (const key of ["startDate", "endDate", "people"] as const) {
    const item = formData.get(key);
    if (item === null) continue;
    if (typeof item !== "string" || item.length > 40) throw new Error(`Invalid ${key}.`);
    values.set(key, item);
  }
  // This flag is set by the server action, not trusted from the browser form.
  values.set("discoverPlan", "1");
  if (formData.get("seedItinerary") === "1") values.set("seedItinerary", "1");
  await createBuild(values);
}
```

```typescript
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import DestinationDetail from "@/components/discover/DestinationDetail";
import { DESTINATIONS, getDestination } from "@/lib/destinations";
import { relatedCampgrounds, relatedPlaces } from "@/lib/destination-detail";
import { currentBuildUserId } from "@/lib/build-access";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import { findRelatedPublicContent } from "@/lib/discover-related-query";

export function generateStaticParams() {
  return DESTINATIONS.map(destination => ({ id: destination.id }));
}

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { id } = await params;
  const destination = getDestination(id);
  if (!destination) return { title: "Destination not found | TrailPicker" };
  return {
    title: `${destination.name} | Discover BC | TrailPicker`,
    description: `${destination.summary} Explore ${destination.park}, ${destination.region} with trip planning and official park information.`.slice(0, 200),
  };
}

export default async function DestinationPage({ params }: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const destination = getDestination(id);
  if (!destination) notFound();
  const userId = await currentBuildUserId();
  const saved = userId ? Boolean(await prisma.savedDestination.findUnique({
    where: { userId_destinationId: { userId, destinationId: id } }, select: { destinationId: true },
  })) : false;

  const related = await findRelatedPublicContent(destination.id, { limit: 4 });

  return <DestinationDetail
    destination={destination}
    saved={saved}
    signedIn={Boolean(userId)}
    related={related}
    campgrounds={relatedCampgrounds(destination, DESTINATIONS)}
    places={relatedPlaces(destination, DESTINATIONS)}
  />;
}
```

### `app/discover/packs/[id]/page.tsx`

```typescript
import {notFound} from "next/navigation";
import {prisma} from "@/lib/prisma";
import {currentBuildUserId} from "@/lib/build-access";
import {evaluateCompatibility, type CompatItem} from "@/lib/compatibility";
import PublicPackDetail from "@/components/discover/PublicPackDetail";
import {getDestination} from "@/lib/destinations";
import {findRelatedPublicContent} from "@/lib/discover-related-query";

export default async function PublicPackPage({params}:{params:Promise<{id:string}>}) {
  const {id}=await params;
  if (!id || id.length>200) notFound();
  const pack=await prisma.build.findFirst({
    where:{id,isPublic:true,items:{some:{}}},
    select:{
      id:true,name:true,location:true,destinationId:true,people:true,createdAt:true,updatedAt:true,
      minTemperature:true,conditions:true,startDate:true,endDate:true,
      user:{select:{name:true,username:true,isProfilePublic:true}},
      _count:{select:{savedBy:true}},
      items:{select:{id:true,quantity:true,isWorn:true,isConsumable:true,customCategory:true,gearNameSnapshot:true,weightSnapshot:true,priceSnapshot:true,
        gear:{select:{id:true,name:true,description:true,weight_g:true,price_cad:true,capacity_l:true,frame_type:true,waterproof:true,temperature_rating:true,season:true,
          brand:{select:{name:true}},category:{select:{name:true}},subcategory:{select:{name:true,slug:true}},
          specifications:{select:{key:true,value:true,unit:true}},
        }},
      }},
      days:{select:{minTemperature:true,conditions:true,campsite:true,waterCarryL:true,waterSource:true}},
    },
  });
  if (!pack) notFound();
  const related=await findRelatedPublicContent(pack.destinationId,{excludeBuildId:pack.id,limit:3});
  const userId=await currentBuildUserId();
  const saved=userId?Boolean(await prisma.savedBuild.findUnique({where:{userId_buildId:{userId,buildId:pack.id}},select:{buildId:true}})):false;
  const items:CompatItem[]=pack.items.map(item=>({
    id:item.id,quantity:item.quantity,isWorn:item.isWorn,isConsumable:item.isConsumable,
    customCategory:item.customCategory,gearNameSnapshot:item.gearNameSnapshot,
    weightSnapshot:item.weightSnapshot,priceSnapshot:item.priceSnapshot,
    gear:item.gear?{
      id:item.gear.id,name:item.gear.name,weight_g:item.gear.weight_g,price_cad:item.gear.price_cad,
      capacity_l:item.gear.capacity_l,frame_type:item.gear.frame_type,waterproof:item.gear.waterproof,
      temperature_rating:item.gear.temperature_rating,season:item.gear.season,
      category:item.gear.category,subcategory:item.gear.subcategory,specifications:item.gear.specifications,
    }:null,
  }));
  const issues=evaluateCompatibility({people:pack.people,minTemperature:pack.minTemperature,
    conditions:pack.conditions,startDate:pack.startDate,endDate:pack.endDate},items,pack.days);
  return <PublicPackDetail pack={{id:pack.id,name:pack.name,location:pack.location,people:pack.people,
    createdAt:pack.createdAt,updatedAt:pack.updatedAt,
    author:pack.user?.isProfilePublic?(pack.user.username||pack.user.name||"Community member"):"Community member",
    items:pack.items,saves:pack._count.savedBy,
  }} issues={issues} saved={saved} signedIn={Boolean(userId)} destination={getDestination(pack.destinationId)}
    hasTrip={pack.days.length>0} related={related}/>;
}
```

### `app/gear/[id]/page.tsx`

```typescript
import GearPicker, { type GearBrowseSearch } from "@/components/builder/GearPicker";
import ProductDetails from "@/components/gear/ProductDetails";
import GearCompareSelection from "@/components/gear/GearCompareSelection";
import { currentBuildUserId, findAccessibleBuild } from "@/lib/build-access";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";

export default async function GearDetailPage({params,searchParams}:{params:Promise<{id:string}>;searchParams:Promise<GearBrowseSearch>}) {
  const {id}=await params;
  const category=await prisma.category.findUnique({where:{slug:id.toLowerCase()},select:{id:true}});
  if(category)return <GearPicker categorySlug={id} filters={await searchParams}/>;
  const gear=await prisma.gear.findUnique({where:{id},include:{brand:true,category:true,subcategory:true,images:{orderBy:[{isPrimary:"desc"},{id:"asc"}]},prices:{include:{retailer:true}},specifications:true,reviews:{orderBy:{createdAt:"desc"},include:{user:{select:{name:true,username:true}}}}}});
  if(!gear)notFound();
  const userId=await currentBuildUserId();
  const candidate=(await cookies()).get("currentBuild")?.value;
  const access=candidate?await findAccessibleBuild(candidate):null;
  const [owned,favorite,build]=await Promise.all([
    userId?prisma.ownedGear.findUnique({where:{userId_gearId:{userId,gearId:id}},select:{id:true}}):null,
    userId?prisma.favorite.findUnique({where:{userId_gearId:{userId,gearId:id}},select:{id:true}}):null,
    access?prisma.build.findUnique({where:{id:access.id,userId:access.userId},select:{id:true,name:true}}):null,
  ]);
  return <GearCompareSelection buildId={build?.id}><ProductDetails gear={gear} userId={userId} owned={Boolean(owned)} favorite={Boolean(favorite)} build={build}/></GearCompareSelection>;
}
```

### `app/gear/compare/actions.ts`

```typescript
"use server";

import { requireBuildAccess } from "@/lib/build-access";
import { mutateBuildWithRevision } from "@/lib/build-history";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

const required = (form: FormData, key: string) => {
  const value = form.get(key);
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !value || value.length > 200) throw new Error("Invalid comparison request.");
  return value;
};

/** Only replaces a linked product in an owned/authorized build, never another user's item. */
export async function replaceComparedGear(form: FormData): Promise<{ message: string }> {
  const buildId = required(form, "buildId");
  const itemId = required(form, "itemId");
  const newGearId = required(form, "newGearId");
  const access = await requireBuildAccess(buildId);
  const newGear = await prisma.gear.findUnique({ where: { id: newGearId }, select: { id: true, categoryId: true, name: true } });
  if (!newGear) throw new Error("The replacement product is no longer available.");

  await mutateBuildWithRevision(buildId, access.userId, "gear", `Replaced gear with ${newGear.name}`, async tx => {
    // Check everything again under the build's transaction lock; the list may have changed.
    const previous = await tx.buildItem.findFirst({
      where: { id: itemId, buildId, build: { userId: access.userId } },
      include: { gear: { select: { categoryId: true } } },
    });
    if (!previous?.gear) throw new Error("The original product was removed. Refresh and try again.");
    if (previous.gear.categoryId !== newGear.categoryId) throw new Error("Choose a replacement in the same gear category.");
    if (previous.gearId === newGear.id) throw new Error("That product is already selected in the build.");
    const duplicate = await tx.buildItem.findUnique({
      where: { buildId_gearId: { buildId, gearId: newGear.id } }, select: { id: true },
    });
    if (duplicate) throw new Error("The replacement is already in this build. Remove the duplicate first.");
    await tx.buildItem.update({
      where: { id: previous.id },
      data: {
        gearId: newGear.id,
        // Old manual price/weight details must not survive a different product.
        gearNameSnapshot: null, weightSnapshot: null, priceSnapshot: null,
        customWeight: null, customCategory: null,
      },
    });
  });
  revalidatePath(`/build/${buildId}`);
  revalidatePath("/profile/builds");
  return { message: `Replaced with ${newGear.name}. Your build history has been updated.` };
}

```

```typescript
import Link from "next/link";
import Image from "next/image";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { ArrowLeft, Scale, ShieldAlert, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import { findAccessibleBuild } from "@/lib/build-access";
import { evaluateCompatibility, type BuildForCompat, type CompatItem } from "@/lib/compatibility";
import { comparisonPrice, getComparisonRows, parseCompareIds, type CompareProduct } from "@/lib/gear-comparison";
import { gearMoney, safeGearUrl } from "@/lib/gear-display";
import { RemoveFromComparison, ReplaceComparedGear } from "@/components/gear/ComparisonActions";
import type { SelectedGear } from "@/components/gear/GearCompareSelection";
import ComparisonTable from "@/components/gear/ComparisonTable";
import ProductBuildButton from "@/components/gear/ProductBuildButton";

export const metadata = { title: "Compare Gear | TrailPicker", description: "Compare backpacking equipment side by side." };

type PageParams = { ids?: string | string[]; build?: string | string[] };

export default async function CompareGearPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<PageParams> }) {
  const search = await searchParams;
  const ids = parseCompareIds(search.ids);
  const explicit = Array.isArray(search.build) ? search.build[0] : search.build;
  const cookieId = (await cookies()).get("currentBuild")?.value;
  const access = await findAccessibleBuild(explicit || cookieId || "");
  const [found, build] = await Promise.all([
    ids.length ? prisma.gear.findMany({ where: { id: { in: ids } }, include: {
      brand: true, category: true, subcategory: true,
      images: { orderBy: [{ isPrimary: "desc" }, { id: "asc" }] },
      specifications: true,
      prices: { select: { price: true, currency: true, inStock: true } },
      reviews: { select: { rating: true } },
    } }) : Promise.resolve([]),
    access ? prisma.build.findUnique({ where: { id: access.id, userId: access.userId },
      include: { days: true, items: { include: { gear: { include: { category: true, subcategory: true, specifications: true } } } } },
    }) : Promise.resolve(null),
  ]);
  const products = ids.flatMap(id => found.filter(p => p.id === id));
  const comparisonProducts: CompareProduct[] = products;
  const selected: SelectedGear[] = products.map(p => ({ id: p.id, name: p.name, categoryId: p.categoryId, categoryName: p.category.name }));
  const rows = getComparisonRows(comparisonProducts);
  const category = products[0]?.category;
  const back = category ? `/gear/${encodeURIComponent(category.slug)}${build ? `?build=${encodeURIComponent(build.id)}` : ""}` : "/gear";

  const compatibilityInput: BuildForCompat | null = build ? {
    people: build.people, minTemperature: build.minTemperature, conditions: build.conditions,
    startDate: build.startDate, endDate: build.endDate,
  } : null;
  const items: CompatItem[] = build?.items.map(item => ({
    id: item.id, quantity: item.quantity, isConsumable: item.isConsumable, isWorn: item.isWorn,
    customCategory: item.customCategory, gearNameSnapshot: item.gearNameSnapshot,
    weightSnapshot: item.weightSnapshot, priceSnapshot: item.priceSnapshot,
    gear: item.gear ? {
      id: item.gear.id, name: item.gear.name, weight_g: item.gear.weight_g,
      price_cad: item.gear.price_cad, capacity_l: item.gear.capacity_l,
      frame_type: item.gear.frame_type, waterproof: item.gear.waterproof,
      temperature_rating: item.gear.temperature_rating, season: item.gear.season,
      category: { name: item.gear.category.name },
      subcategory: item.gear.subcategory ? { name: item.gear.subcategory.name, slug: item.gear.subcategory.slug } : null,
      specifications: item.gear.specifications,
    } : null,
  })) ?? [];
  const baseline = compatibilityInput ? evaluateCompatibility(compatibilityInput, items, build?.days ?? []) : [];
  const beforeIds = new Set(baseline.filter(i => i.severity !== "info").map(i => `${i.id}:${i.severity}`));

  return <main className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 px-4 py-8 sm:px-8">
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl">
      <Link href={back} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-green-800 hover:underline"><ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />Back to gear</Link>
      <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div><h1 className="mt-2 text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-gray-950 sm:text-4xl">Compare equipment</h1><p className="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-600">Up to four products, with recorded specifications and real differences.</p></div>
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700"><Scale className="h-4 w-4 text-green-800" />{products.length} of 4 selected</span>
      </div>

      {products.length < 2 ? <section className="mt-8 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-gray-300 bg-white px-6 py-14 text-center"><Scale className="mx-auto h-10 w-10 text-gray-400" /><h2 className="mt-4 text-xl font-bold">Choose at least two products</h2><p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-md text-sm text-gray-500">Open a gear category or product page and press Compare on the equipment you want to see side by side.</p><Link href={back} className="mt-6 inline-flex rounded-lg bg-green-900 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-green-800">Browse gear</Link></section> : <>
        {build && <p className="mt-6 rounded-xl border border-green-200 bg-green-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-green-900">Comparing for <Link href={`/build/${build.id}`} className="font-bold underline">{build.name}</Link>. You can add equipment or replace an existing item from this page.</p>}
        <section aria-label="Compared products" className="mt-7 overflow-x-auto pb-2">
          <div className="grid gap-4" style={{ minWidth: `${Math.max(730, products.length * 255)}px`, gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${products.length}, minmax(0, 1fr))` }}>
            {products.map(product => {
              const url = safeGearUrl(product.images[0]?.url);
              const image = url && (url.startsWith("https://") || url.startsWith("/")) ? url : null;
              const replaceable = build?.items.filter(item => item.gear?.categoryId === product.categoryId && item.gearId !== product.id).map(item => ({ id: item.id, name: item.gear?.name ?? item.gearNameSnapshot ?? "Gear item" })) ?? [];
              const oneExisting = build?.items.filter(item => item.gear?.categoryId === product.categoryId);
              const oldItem = oneExisting?.length === 1 ? oneExisting[0] : null;
              const simulatedGear = {
                id: product.id, name: product.name, weight_g: product.weight_g,
                price_cad: product.price_cad, capacity_l: product.capacity_l,
                frame_type: product.frame_type, waterproof: product.waterproof,
                temperature_rating: product.temperature_rating, season: product.season,
                category: { name: product.category.name },
                subcategory: product.subcategory ? { name: product.subcategory.name, slug: product.subcategory.slug } : null,
                specifications: product.specifications,
              };
              const alreadyInBuild = build?.items.some(item => item.gearId === product.id);
              const proposed: CompatItem[] = alreadyInBuild
                ? items
                : oldItem
                  ? items.map(item => item.id === oldItem.id ? { ...item, gear: simulatedGear } : item)
                  : [...items, { id: `preview:${product.id}`, quantity: 1, isWorn: false, isConsumable: false, customCategory: null, gearNameSnapshot: null, weightSnapshot: null, priceSnapshot: null, gear: simulatedGear }];
              const additionalIssues = compatibilityInput ? evaluateCompatibility(compatibilityInput, proposed, build?.days ?? [])
                .filter(issue => issue.severity !== "info" && !beforeIds.has(`${issue.id}:${issue.severity}`)) : [];
              return <article key={product.id} className="flex min-w-0 flex-col rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm sm:p-5">
                <div className="flex justify-end"><RemoveFromComparison productId={product.id} selected={selected} buildId={build?.id} /></div>
                <Link href={`/gear/${encodeURIComponent(product.id)}`} className="group block"><div className="relative aspect-[5/4] overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-gray-50">{image ? <Image src={image} alt={product.name} fill sizes="(max-width: 767px) 250px, 350px" className="object-contain p-4 transition group-hover:scale-105" /> : <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center text-xs text-gray-400">Photo unavailable</div>}</div><p className="mt-5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-green-800">{product.brand.name}</p><h2 className="mt-1 min-h-12 break-words text-lg font-bold leading-tight text-gray-950 group-hover:text-green-800">{product.name}</h2></Link>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">{product.subcategory?.name ?? product.category.name}</p>
                <p className="mt-3 text-xl font-bold text-gray-900">{gearMoney(comparisonPrice(product))}</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">{product.prices.some(price => price.currency === "CAD" && price.inStock) ? "Lowest recorded in-stock CAD offer" : "Catalog price when available"}</p>
                {build && <div className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 p-3 text-xs text-gray-700">
                  {alreadyInBuild ? <p className="font-semibold text-green-800">Already in your build</p> : <p className="font-semibold">Pack check preview</p>}
                  {additionalIssues.length ? <p className="mt-1 flex items-start gap-1.5 text-amber-800"><ShieldAlert className="mt-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />{additionalIssues.length} additional warning{additionalIssues.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""} in this simulation</p> : <p className="mt-1 flex items-start gap-1.5 text-green-800"><ShieldCheck className="mt-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />No new warnings detected</p>}
                  <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-gray-500">{alreadyInBuild ? "Evaluated using your current build." : oldItem ? "Simulated as a replacement for your sole item in this category." : "Simulated as an additional item."}</p>
                  {additionalIssues[0] && <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-gray-700">{additionalIssues[0].message}</p>}
                </div>}
                <div className="mt-auto pt-4">{build ? <>{!alreadyInBuild && <ProductBuildButton buildId={build.id} gearId={product.id} />}{!alreadyInBuild && replaceable.length > 0 && <ReplaceComparedGear buildId={build.id} newGearId={product.id} items={replaceable} />}</> : <Link href="/build" className="block rounded-lg bg-green-900 px-3 py-3 text-center text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-green-800">Create a build</Link>}</div>
              </article>;
            })}
          </div>
        </section>
        <ComparisonTable products={products.map(p => ({ id: p.id, name: p.name }))} rows={rows} />
      </>}
    </div>
  </main>;
}
```

### `app/gear/review-actions.ts`

```typescript
"use server";

import { currentBuildUserId } from "@/lib/build-access";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

async function userId() {
  const id = await currentBuildUserId();
  if (!id) throw new Error("Sign in to manage your reviews.");
  return id;
}
function text(form: FormData, key: string, max: number) {
  const value = form.get(key);
  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.trim().length > max) throw new Error(`Invalid ${key}.`);
  return value.trim();
}
function refresh(gearId: string) {
  revalidatePath(`/gear/${gearId}`);
  revalidatePath("/gear", "layout");
  revalidatePath("/profile/reviews");
}

export async function saveGearReview(form: FormData) {
  const owner = await userId();
  const gearId = text(form, "gearId", 200);
  if (!gearId) throw new Error("Choose a product.");
  const rating = Number(form.get("rating"));
  if (!Number.isInteger(rating) || rating < 1 || rating > 5) throw new Error("Choose a rating from 1 to 5.");
  const title = text(form, "title", 120);
  const body = text(form, "body", 4000);
  if (body.length < 10) throw new Error("Write at least 10 characters about your experience.");
  if (!await prisma.gear.findUnique({ where: { id: gearId }, select: { id: true } })) throw new Error("This product is no longer available.");
  await prisma.$transaction(async tx => {
    // The existing schema has no review unique key. Serialize writes for this
    // member/product pair without needing a database migration.
    await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT 1 AS locked FROM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(${owner}), hashtext(${gearId}))`;
    const existing = await tx.review.findFirst({ where: { userId: owner, gearId }, orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }, select: { id: true } });
    if (existing) await tx.review.updateMany({ where: { id: existing.id, userId: owner, gearId }, data: { rating, title: title || null, body } });
    else await tx.review.create({ data: { userId: owner, gearId, rating, title: title || null, body } });
  });
  refresh(gearId);
}

export async function deleteGearReview(form: FormData) {
  const owner = await userId();
  const reviewId = text(form, "reviewId", 200);
  if (!reviewId) throw new Error("Choose a review.");
  const review = await prisma.review.findFirst({ where: { id: reviewId, userId: owner }, select: { gearId: true } });
  if (!review) throw new Error("Review not found.");
  await prisma.review.deleteMany({ where: { id: reviewId, userId: owner } });
  refresh(review.gearId);
}
```

```css
/* Make native and accessible button controls feel clickable site-wide. */
@layer base {
  button:not(:disabled):not([aria-disabled="true"]),
  input:is([type="button"], [type="submit"], [type="reset"]):not(:disabled):not([aria-disabled="true"]),
```

### `app/profile/actions.ts`

```typescript
"use server";

import { auth } from "@/auth";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { mutateBuildWithRevision } from "@/lib/build-history";
import { duplicateBuild } from "@/app/build/actions";

async function currentUser() {
  const session = await auth();
  if (!session?.user?.email) throw new Error("You must be signed in.");
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: session.user.email }, select: { id: true } });
  if (!user) throw new Error("User not found.");
  return user;
}

export async function deleteBuild(formData: FormData) {
  const user = await currentUser();
  const buildId = String(formData.get("buildId") || "");
  await prisma.build.deleteMany({ where: { id: buildId, userId: user.id } });
  revalidatePath("/profile");
  revalidatePath("/profile/builds");
}

export async function renameBuild(formData: FormData) {
  const user = await currentUser();
  const buildId = String(formData.get("buildId") || "");
  const name = String(formData.get("name") || "").trim();
  if (!name) throw new Error("Build name is required.");
  await mutateBuildWithRevision(buildId, user.id, "settings", "Renamed build", async tx => {
    const result = await tx.build.updateMany({ where: { id: buildId, userId: user.id }, data: { name: name.slice(0, 80) } });
    if (result.count !== 1) throw new Error("Build not found.");
  });
  revalidatePath("/profile");
  revalidatePath("/profile/builds");
}

export async function duplicateProfileBuild(formData: FormData) {
  const user = await currentUser();
  const buildId = String(formData.get("buildId") || "");
  // Reuse the canonical copy implementation, preserving routes, all day fields,
  // logistics and remapped day IDs. Never maintain a second partial copy path.
  const owned = await prisma.build.findFirst({ where: { id: buildId, userId: user.id }, select: { id: true } });
  if (!owned) throw new Error("Build not found.");
  return duplicateBuild(formData);
}

export async function updateProfile(formData: FormData) {
  const user = await currentUser();
  const name = String(formData.get("name") || "").trim();
  const username = String(formData.get("username") || "").trim().toLowerCase();
  const bio = String(formData.get("bio") || "").trim();
  const location = String(formData.get("location") || "").trim();
  if (!name) throw new Error("Display name is required.");
  if (username && !/^[a-z0-9_]{3,24}$/.test(username)) throw new Error("Username must be 3–24 letters, numbers, or underscores.");
  await prisma.user.update({ where: { id: user.id }, data: { name, username: username || null, bio: bio || null, location: location || null, isProfilePublic: formData.get("isProfilePublic") === "on" } });
  revalidatePath("/profile", "layout");
  redirect("/profile");
}
```
