### `components/builder/ConsumablesTimeline.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useId, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  ChevronUp,
  Info,
  Package,
  Pencil,
  RotateCcw,
  SlidersHorizontal,
} from "lucide-react";

import type { PackAnalysis } from "@/lib/pack-analysis";
import type { PlannerBuild } from "@/lib/trip-planner";
import { projectConsumableLoad } from "@/lib/consumables-model";
import { useDisplayPreferences } from "@/components/settings/DisplayPreferencesProvider";
import { weightText } from "@/lib/user-preferences";

type Props = {
  pack: PackAnalysis;
  trip: PlannerBuild;
};

const INITIAL_VISIBLE_DAYS = 10;

function numberOfDays(trip: PlannerBuild): number {
  if (trip.days.length) {
    return Math.min(31, Math.max(1, trip.days.length));
  }

  if (!trip.startDate || !trip.endDate) return 1;

  const from = new Date(trip.startDate).valueOf();
  const to = new Date(trip.endDate).valueOf();

  if (!Number.isFinite(from) || !Number.isFinite(to) || to < from) {
    return 1;
  }

  return Math.min(31, Math.max(1, Math.round((to - from) / 86_400_000) + 1));
}

export default function ConsumablesTimeline({ pack, trip }: Props) {
  const { weightUnit } = useDisplayPreferences();
  const formatWeight = (grams: number) => weightText(grams, weightUnit);
  const days = numberOfDays(trip);
  const settingsId = useId();
  const [settingsOpen, setSettingsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [showAllDays, setShowAllDays] = useState(false);

  // String inputs let someone clear a field while editing, without making
  // the mass model receive NaN or an out-of-range value.
  const [dailyInput, setDailyInput] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [resupplyDay, setResupplyDay] = useState(0);
  const [resupplyInput, setResupplyInput] = useState("0");

  const defaultDaily = Math.min(
    100_000,
    Math.round(pack.consumableGrams / days)
  );
  const dailyUse = dailyInput === null ? defaultDaily : Number(dailyInput || 0);
  const activeResupplyDay =
    resupplyDay >= 2 && resupplyDay <= days ? resupplyDay : 0;
  const resupplyGrams = Number(resupplyInput || 0);
  const effectiveResupply = activeResupplyDay ? resupplyGrams : 0;

  const timeline = useMemo(
    () =>
      projectConsumableLoad(
        pack.consumableGrams,
        days,
        dailyUse,
        activeResupplyDay || null,
        effectiveResupply
      ),
    [pack.consumableGrams, days, dailyUse, activeResupplyDay, effectiveResupply]
  );

  const unknownConsumables = pack.lines
    .filter((line) => line.weightClass === "consumable" && line.grams === null)
    .reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.quantity, 0);

  const firstShortfall = timeline.find((day) => day.unmetGrams > 0);
  const startingLoad = pack.baseGrams + pack.consumableGrams;
  const endingLoad =
    pack.baseGrams + (timeline.at(-1)?.remainingGrams ?? pack.consumableGrams);

  // Bars show base weight (blue) plus the consumables present at the START
  // of that day (green), including any resupply before that day.
  const dailyLoads = timeline.map((day) => ({
    ...day,
    supplies: day.startingGrams + day.addedGrams,
    carried: pack.baseGrams + day.startingGrams + day.addedGrams,
  }));
  const maxCarried = Math.max(1, ...dailyLoads.map((day) => day.carried));
  const visibleLoads = showAllDays
    ? dailyLoads
    : dailyLoads.slice(0, INITIAL_VISIBLE_DAYS);

  function resetAssumptions() {
    setDailyInput(null);
    setResupplyDay(0);
    setResupplyInput("0");
  }

  return (
    <section
      aria-labelledby="consumables-heading"
      className="min-w-0 border-b border-gray-200 pb-8 text-gray-800"
    >
      {/* Same section typography and understated metadata as Trip Planner. */}
      <header className="mb-5 flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h2 id="consumables-heading" className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-950">
            Consumables
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-1 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-gray-500">
            See how your estimated carried weight changes as supplies are used
            and replenished during the trip.
          </p>
        </div>
        <span className="shrink-0 rounded-lg bg-gray-100 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-gray-600">
          {days} {days === 1 ? "day" : "days"} modeled
        </span>
      </header>

      {pack.consumableGrams === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 sm:p-5">
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center rounded-lg bg-white px-6 py-12 text-center">
            <span className="mb-5 flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white text-gray-500">
              <Package aria-hidden="true" className="h-9 w-9" />
            </span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-gray-950">
              No consumables recorded yet
            </h3>
            <p className="mt-3 max-w-lg text-base leading-7 text-gray-500">
              Add food, water, fuel, or other consumable supplies to see how
              your pack weight changes each day.
            </p>
            <Link
              href={`/build/${trip.id}?tab=gear`}
              className="mt-6 inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-green-800 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-green-900 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-green-700"
            >
              Add consumables
            </Link>
            {unknownConsumables > 0 && (
              <p className="mt-4 max-w-md text-xs leading-5 text-amber-800" role="status">
                {unknownConsumables} consumable {unknownConsumables === 1 ? "unit has" : "units have"} unknown weight. Add recorded weights to include them in the estimate.
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
      {/* One connected panel, matching Trip Planner's divided sections. */}
      <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-5 gap-y-5 border-b border-gray-200 px-4 py-5 sm:grid-cols-3 sm:gap-x-8 sm:px-5">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">Starting pack</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight tabular-nums text-gray-950">
              {formatWeight(startingLoad)}
            </p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">Base + recorded supplies</p>
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">End of trip</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight tabular-nums text-green-800">
              {formatWeight(endingLoad)}
            </p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">After day {days}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="col-span-2 min-w-0 border-t border-gray-100 pt-4 sm:col-span-1 sm:border-l sm:border-t-0 sm:py-0 sm:pl-7">
            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">Recorded consumables</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight tabular-nums text-gray-950">
              {formatWeight(pack.consumableGrams)}
            </p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">At the trailhead</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* An editable row styled like the collapsible Trip Logistics rows. */}
        <div className="border-b border-gray-200">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-4 sm:px-5">
            <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-3">
              <span className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-gray-100 text-gray-600">
                <SlidersHorizontal aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4" />
              </span>
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-gray-950">
                  Consumption &amp; resupply
                </h3>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-gray-500">
                  {formatWeight(dailyUse)} per day
                  {activeResupplyDay
                    ? ` · ${formatWeight(effectiveResupply)} added before day ${activeResupplyDay}`
                    : " · No resupply"}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-expanded={settingsOpen}
              aria-controls={settingsId}
              onClick={() => setSettingsOpen((open) => !open)}
              className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3.5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-800 transition-colors hover:border-green-300 hover:bg-green-50 hover:text-green-900 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-green-700"
            >
              {settingsOpen ? (
                <>
                  <ChevronUp aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4" />
                  Close
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Pencil aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4" />
                  Edit assumptions
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>

          <div
            id={settingsId}
            hidden={!settingsOpen}
            className="border-t border-gray-100 bg-gray-50/60 px-4 pb-5 pt-4 sm:px-5"
          >
            <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
              <label className="block min-w-0">
                <span className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700">
                  Daily consumption (g)
                </span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  inputMode="numeric"
                  min={0}
                  max={100_000}
                  step={10}
                  value={dailyInput ?? String(defaultDaily)}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    const value = event.currentTarget.value;
                    if (
                      value === "" ||
                      (Number.isFinite(Number(value)) &&
                        Number(value) >= 0 &&
                        Number(value) <= 100_000)
                    ) {
                      setDailyInput(value);
                    }
                  }}
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm text-gray-900 outline-none transition-colors hover:border-gray-300 focus:border-green-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-700/10"
                />
              </label>
              <label className="block min-w-0">
                <span className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700">
                  Resupply before
                </span>
                <select
                  value={activeResupplyDay}
                  disabled={days === 1}
                  onChange={(event) => setResupplyDay(Number(event.currentTarget.value))}
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm text-gray-900 outline-none transition-colors hover:border-gray-300 focus:border-green-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-700/10 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-gray-100 disabled:text-gray-400"
                >
                  <option value={0}>No resupply</option>
                  {Array.from({ length: days - 1 }, (_, index) => index + 2).map(
                    (day) => (
                      <option key={day} value={day}>
                        Day {day}
                      </option>
                    )
                  )}
                </select>
              </label>
              <label className="block min-w-0">
                <span className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700">
                  Resupply amount (g)
                </span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  inputMode="numeric"
                  min={0}
                  max={1_000_000}
                  step={10}
                  disabled={!activeResupplyDay}
                  value={resupplyInput}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    const value = event.currentTarget.value;
                    if (
                      value === "" ||
                      (Number.isFinite(Number(value)) &&
                        Number(value) >= 0 &&
                        Number(value) <= 1_000_000)
                    ) {
                      setResupplyInput(value);
                    }
                  }}
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm text-gray-900 outline-none transition-colors hover:border-gray-300 focus:border-green-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-700/10 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-gray-100 disabled:text-gray-400"
                />
              </label>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <p className="max-w-xl text-xs leading-5 text-gray-500">
                Daily use starts as an even division of recorded supplies, not
                a recommended amount. Edits update this estimate only.
              </p>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={resetAssumptions}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 transition-colors hover:text-green-800 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-green-700"
              >
                <RotateCcw aria-hidden="true" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Reset assumptions
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Readable, proportional bars distinguish fixed gear from supplies. */}
        <div className="px-4 py-5 sm:px-5 sm:py-6">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-x-5 gap-y-3">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-gray-950">
                Estimated weight by day
              </h3>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-gray-500">
                Pack weight at the start of each day, before daily use.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-2 text-xs text-gray-600" aria-label="Chart legend">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span aria-hidden="true" className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-sm bg-blue-500" />
                Base weight
              </span>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span aria-hidden="true" className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-sm bg-green-700" />
                Consumables
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {startingLoad === 0 && effectiveResupply === 0 ? (
            <div className="mt-5 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-4 py-7 text-center text-sm text-gray-500">
              Add items with recorded weights to see a meaningful weight projection.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div
              role="list"
              aria-label="Estimated starting pack weight for each displayed trip day"
              className="mt-6 space-y-3"
            >
              {visibleLoads.map((day) => {
                const basePercent = (pack.baseGrams / maxCarried) * 100;
                const suppliesPercent = (day.supplies / maxCarried) * 100;

                return (
                  <div
                    key={day.day}
                    role="listitem"
                    aria-label={`Day ${day.day}: ${formatWeight(day.carried)} carried${
                      day.addedGrams > 0
                        ? `, including ${formatWeight(day.addedGrams)} resupply`
                        : ""
                    }`}
                    className="grid grid-cols-[3.3rem_minmax(0,1fr)_5.7rem] items-center gap-2.5 sm:grid-cols-[4rem_minmax(0,1fr)_7rem] sm:gap-4"
                  >
                    <span className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-600">
                      Day {day.day}
                    </span>
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <div aria-hidden="true" className="flex h-3 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-gray-100">
                        <div
                          className="h-full shrink-0 bg-blue-500 transition-[width] duration-300"
                          style={{ width: `${basePercent}%` }}
                        />
                        <div
                          className="h-full shrink-0 bg-green-700 transition-[width] duration-300"
                          style={{ width: `${suppliesPercent}%` }}
                        />
                      </div>
                      {day.addedGrams > 0 && (
                        <span className="mt-1 block text-[11px] font-medium text-green-800">
                          + {formatWeight(day.addedGrams)} resupply
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-right text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums text-gray-900">
                      {formatWeight(day.carried)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}

          {dailyLoads.length > INITIAL_VISIBLE_DAYS &&
            !(startingLoad === 0 && effectiveResupply === 0) && (
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-expanded={showAllDays}
                onClick={() => setShowAllDays((shown) => !shown)}
                className="mt-5 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 transition-colors hover:border-green-300 hover:bg-green-50 hover:text-green-900 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-green-700"
              >
                {showAllDays
                  ? "Show fewer days"
                  : `Show all ${dailyLoads.length} days`}
              </button>
            )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Keep warnings and model limitations distinct from trip-day results. */}
      {unknownConsumables > 0 && (
        <div
          role="status"
          className="mt-4 flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-amber-900"
        >
          <AlertTriangle aria-hidden="true" className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
          <p>
            {unknownConsumables} consumable {unknownConsumables === 1 ? "unit has" : "units have"} unknown weight.
            Your starting load may be incomplete.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {firstShortfall && (
        <div
          role="status"
          className="mt-4 flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-amber-900"
        >
          <AlertTriangle aria-hidden="true" className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
          <p>
            Recorded consumable mass runs short by day <strong>{firstShortfall.day}</strong> with
            these assumptions. This is a weight projection, not a check of food,
            water, or fuel sufficiency.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      </>
      )}

      <p className="mt-5 flex items-start gap-2 border-t border-gray-100 pt-4 text-xs leading-5 text-gray-500">
        <Info aria-hidden="true" className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
        <span>
          Estimates use recorded consumable mass and your assumptions. Worn
          weight is excluded; the model does not calculate nutritional,
          hydration, or fuel requirements or verify resupply availability.
          Trips are modeled for up to 31 days.
        </span>
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

### `components/builder/CostSummary.tsx`

```typescript
type Props = {
  totalCost: number;
  costToBuy: number;
};

const money = (value: number) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-CA", { style: "currency", currency: "CAD" }).format(value);

export default function CostSummary({ totalCost, costToBuy }: Props) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-end gap-x-8 gap-y-2 border-t border-gray-400 bg-gray-50 px-4 py-4">
      <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2 text-sm text-gray-500">
        <span>Total gear value</span>
        <span className="font-semibold tabular-nums text-gray-800">{money(totalCost)}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2 text-sm text-gray-700">
        <span>To buy</span>
        <strong className="text-xl font-bold tabular-nums text-gray-900">{money(costToBuy)}</strong>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `components/builder/FoodConsumablesPlanner.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { AlertTriangle, CookingPot, Plus, Save, Trash2, Package, Truck, TrendingDown } from "lucide-react";
import { saveTripFoodPlan } from "@/lib/tracked-build-actions";
import { readWaypoints, type PlannerBuild } from "@/lib/trip-planner";
import { type PackAnalysis } from "@/lib/pack-analysis";
import WaterPlanningSection from "@/components/builder/WaterPlanningSection";
import { useDisplayPreferences } from "@/components/settings/DisplayPreferencesProvider";
import { weightText } from "@/lib/user-preferences";
import { DEFAULT_FOOD_SETTINGS, MEAL_SLOTS, projectFoodPlan, readFoodPlan, type FoodItem, type FoodPlan, type FoodResupply, type FoodSettings, type MealSlot, type PlannedMeal } from "@/lib/food-plan";

const input = "w-full min-w-0 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-900 focus:border-green-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-green-700";
const label = "block space-y-1 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700";
const button = "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40";
const card = "rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 sm:p-5";
const newId = () => crypto.randomUUID();
function numeric(raw: string, lo: number, hi: number, fallback = 0) { const n = Number(raw); return raw.trim() === "" ? fallback : Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, n)) : fallback; }
function dayLabel(date: Date, i: number) {
  const parsed = new Date(date);
  return `Day ${i + 1}${Number.isFinite(+parsed) ? ` · ${parsed.toLocaleDateString("en-CA", { month: "short", day: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" })}` : ""}`;
}
export default function FoodConsumablesPlanner({ pack, trip }: { pack: PackAnalysis; trip: PlannerBuild }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { weightUnit } = useDisplayPreferences();
  const format = (n:number) => weightText(Math.max(0,n), weightUnit);
  const serverSignature = JSON.stringify(trip.tripLogistics ?? null);
  const [plan, setPlanState] = useState<FoodPlan>(() => readFoodPlan(trip.tripLogistics));
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("");
  const [activeDay, setActiveDay] = useState(0);
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState({ inventory: true, fuel: false, resupply: false });
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!dirty) setPlanState(readFoodPlan(trip.tripLogistics));
    // When server props change, don't overwrite an unsaved draft.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [serverSignature]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const onReplace = (event: Event) => {
      if ((event as CustomEvent<string>).detail !== trip.id) return;
      setDirty(false); setStatus("");
    };
    window.addEventListener("trailpicker:build-replaced", onReplace);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("trailpicker:build-replaced", onReplace);
  }, [trip.id]);
  const days = useMemo(() => [...trip.days].sort((a,b) => +new Date(a.date) - +new Date(b.date)), [trip.days]);
  const dayIds = useMemo(() => days.map(d=>d.id), [days]);
  const route = useMemo(() => readWaypoints(trip.routeWaypoints), [trip.routeWaypoints]);
  const resupplyStops = route.filter(p=>p.kind === "resupply");
  const forecast = useMemo(() => projectFoodPlan(plan,dayIds,route,pack.baseGrams,pack.consumableGrams), [plan, dayIds, route, pack.baseGrams, pack.consumableGrams]);
  const active = days[Math.min(activeDay, Math.max(0,days.length-1))];
  const selectedMeals = active ? plan.meals.filter(m=>m.dayId===active.id) : [];
  const maxCarried = Math.max(1,...forecast.days.map(day=>day.packStartKnownGrams));
  const hasOtherUnknown = pack.lines.some(line=>line.weightClass === "consumable" && line.grams === null);
  const unknownMass = forecast.missingFoodWeights || hasOtherUnknown;
  const hasFood = plan.foods.length > 0;
  const setPlan = (next:FoodPlan) => {setPlanState(next);setDirty(true);setStatus("");};
  const patchSettings = (patch:Partial<FoodSettings>) => setPlan({...plan,settings:{...plan.settings,...patch}});
  const patchFood = (id:string,patch:Partial<FoodItem>) => setPlan({...plan,foods:plan.foods.map(f=>f.id===id?{...f,...patch}:f)});
  const removeFood = (id:string) => setPlan({...plan,foods:plan.foods.filter(f=>f.id!==id),meals:plan.meals.filter(m=>m.foodId!==id),resupplies:plan.resupplies.flatMap(r=>r.foodId!==id?[r]:r.fuelGrams>0?[{...r,foodId:"",units:0}]:[])});
  const patchMeal = (id:string,patch:Partial<PlannedMeal>) => setPlan({...plan,meals:plan.meals.map(m=>m.id===id?{...m,...patch}:m)});
  const patchResupply = (id:string,patch:Partial<FoodResupply>) => setPlan({...plan,resupplies:plan.resupplies.map(r=>r.id===id?{...r,...patch}:r)});
  function addMeal(slot:MealSlot) {
    if (!active || !hasFood || plan.meals.length>=3000) return;
    setPlan({...plan,meals:[...plan.meals,{id:newId(),dayId:active.id,slot,foodId:plan.foods[0].id,units:1,heated:false}]});
  }
  function addResupply() {
    if (!resupplyStops.length || plan.resupplies.length >= 200) return;
    setPlan({...plan,resupplies:[...plan.resupplies,{id:newId(),waypointId:resupplyStops[0].id,foodId:plan.foods[0]?.id||"",units:plan.foods.length?1:0,fuelGrams:plan.foods.length?0:100}]});
    setExpanded(s=>({...s,resupply:true}));
  }
  async function save() {
    if (saving || !dirty) return;
    setSaving(true);setStatus("");
    try {
      const form = new FormData();
      form.set("buildId",trip.id);form.set("foodPlan",JSON.stringify(plan));
      await saveTripFoodPlan(form);
      setDirty(false);setStatus("Food and consumables plan saved.");
      router.refresh();
    } catch (error) {setStatus(error instanceof Error?error.message:"Could not save food plan. Your changes remain here.");}
    finally {setSaving(false);}
  }
  const panelButton = (key:keyof typeof expanded,title:string) => <button type="button" aria-expanded={expanded[key]} className="flex w-full items-center justify-between text-left" onClick={()=>setExpanded(s=>({...s,[key]:!s[key]}))}>
    <strong className="text-base text-gray-950">{title}</strong><span className="text-xs font-semibold text-green-800">{expanded[key]?"Collapse":"Expand"}</span>
  </button>;
  return <section aria-labelledby="food-consumables-heading" className="scroll-mt-20 space-y-5 border-b border-gray-200 pb-8 text-gray-800">
    <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
      <div><h2 id="food-consumables-heading" className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-950">Food & consumables</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-gray-500">Plan meals by day, track food and fuel you carry, and see how resupply changes estimated pack weight.</p></div>
      <button type="button" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-green-900 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-40" disabled={saving||!dirty} onClick={save}>
        <Save className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden/>{saving?"Saving…":dirty?"Save food plan":"Saved"}</button>
    </header>
    {status && <p role="status" className="rounded-lg bg-gray-100 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700">{status}</p>}
    <p className="rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-5 text-gray-600">Planning-only weight estimates, not dietary or cooking guidance. Food and fuel tracked here are <strong>additional</strong> to Builder consumables unless you turn off their pack-weight switches. Don't record the same supplies twice.</p>
    <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
      {[
        ["Builder consumables",format(pack.consumableGrams)],
        ["Additional food at trailhead",format(forecast.startingFoodKnownGrams)+(forecast.missingFoodWeights?"+ unknown":"")],
        ["Fuel at trailhead",format(plan.settings.startingFuelGrams)],
        ["Starting known carry",format(forecast.initialCarriedKnownGrams)+(unknownMass?"+ unknown":"")],
      ].map(([title,value])=><div key={title} className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-3"><p className="text-xs text-gray-500">{title}</p><p className="mt-1 text-lg font-bold text-gray-950 tabular-nums">{value}</p></div>)}
    </div>
    <WaterPlanningSection buildId={trip.id} routePoints={route} logistics={trip.tripLogistics} />
    <div className={card}>
      {panelButton("inventory","Food inventory")}
      {expanded.inventory && <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
        <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-gray-500">Use a unit consistently, such as one packet or one serving. Enter mass for <strong>one unit</strong>, including packaging if you carry it. Unknown mass stays unknown.</p>
        {plan.foods.map(food=><div key={food.id} className="grid items-end gap-3 rounded-lg border border-gray-100 bg-gray-50 p-3 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(0,2fr)_repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))_auto]">
          <label className={label}>Food name<input className={input} value={food.name} maxLength={120} onChange={e=>patchFood(food.id,{name:e.target.value})}/></label>
          <label className={label}>Unit weight (g)<input className={input} type="number" min="0" max="100000" step="0.1" placeholder="Unknown" value={food.gramsPerUnit??""} onChange={e=>patchFood(food.id,{gramsPerUnit:e.target.value===""?null:numeric(e.target.value,0,100000)})}/></label>
          <label className={label}>Start quantity<input className={input} type="number" min="0" max="10000" step="0.25" value={food.startingUnits} onChange={e=>patchFood(food.id,{startingUnits:numeric(e.target.value,0,10000)})}/></label>
          <button type="button" className="rounded-lg p-2 text-red-700 hover:bg-red-50" aria-label={`Remove ${food.name}`} onClick={()=>removeFood(food.id)}><Trash2 className="h-4 w-4"/></button>
          <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-600 sm:col-span-4"><input type="checkbox" checked={food.countInPack} onChange={e=>patchFood(food.id,{countInPack:e.target.checked})}/>Add this inventory to carried-weight forecast (uncheck if already counted in Builder)</label>
        </div>)}
        <button className={button} type="button" disabled={plan.foods.length>=150} onClick={()=>setPlan({...plan,foods:[...plan.foods,{id:newId(),name:`Food ${plan.foods.length+1}`,gramsPerUnit:null,startingUnits:1,countInPack:true}]})}><Plus className="h-4 w-4"/>Add food</button>
        {!hasFood && <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">No food yet. Add an inventory item to start scheduling meals.</p>}
      </div>}
    </div>
    <div className={card}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3"><h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-bold text-gray-950"><CookingPot className="h-4 w-4"/>Daily meal plan</h3>
        {days.length>0 && <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700">Trip day
          <select className={input} value={Math.min(activeDay,days.length-1)} onChange={e=>setActiveDay(Number(e.target.value))}>{days.map((d,i)=><option key={d.id} value={i}>{dayLabel(d.date,i)}</option>)}</select>
        </label>}</div>
      {!days.length?<p className="mt-3 text-sm text-amber-800">Set your trip dates to create itinerary days before scheduling meals.</p>:<div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        {MEAL_SLOTS.map(slot=><section key={slot} className="rounded-lg border border-gray-200 p-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2"><h4 className="text-sm font-semibold capitalize text-gray-900">{slot}</h4>
            <button type="button" className={button} disabled={!hasFood||plan.meals.length>=3000} onClick={()=>addMeal(slot)}><Plus className="h-3 w-3"/>Add</button></div>
          <div className="mt-2 space-y-2">{selectedMeals.filter(m=>m.slot===slot).map(meal=><div key={meal.id} className="space-y-2 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 p-2">
            <div className="flex gap-2"><select className={input} aria-label={`${slot} food`} value={meal.foodId} onChange={e=>patchMeal(meal.id,{foodId:e.target.value})}>{plan.foods.map(f=><option value={f.id} key={f.id}>{f.name}</option>)}</select>
              <button className="p-2 text-red-700" type="button" aria-label="Remove meal" onClick={()=>setPlan({...plan,meals:plan.meals.filter(m=>m.id!==meal.id)})}><Trash2 className="h-4 w-4"/></button></div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3"><label className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs">Units<input type="number" min="0.01" max="10000" step="0.25" className={`${input} w-20`} value={meal.units} onChange={e=>patchMeal(meal.id,{units:numeric(e.target.value,0.01,10000,0.01)})}/></label>
              <label className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs"><input type="checkbox" checked={meal.heated} onChange={e=>patchMeal(meal.id,{heated:e.target.checked})}/>Count a heating session</label></div>
          </div>)}{!selectedMeals.some(m=>m.slot===slot)&&<p className="text-xs text-gray-400">No meals planned</p>}</div>
        </section>)}
      </div>}
      <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-gray-500">Meal entries reduce inventory on the assigned day. If supplies run short, the forecast flags missing quantities instead of pretending they were packed.</p>
    </div>
    <div className={card}>
      {panelButton("fuel","Fuel planning assumptions")}
      {expanded.fuel && <div className="mt-4 space-y-3"><p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Fuel mass is a configurable planning estimate, not a stove-specific consumption prediction. Heating sessions come from the meal checkboxes.</p>
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {([
          ["startingFuelGrams","Fuel packed initially (g)",0,50000,1],
          ["fuelGramsPerHeating","Assumed g per heating session",0,1000,1],
          ["fuelAdjustment","Adjustment factor",0.25,4,0.05],
          ["fuelReservePercent","Extra planning reserve (%)",0,100,1],
          ["otherDailyUseGrams","Other Builder consumables used daily (g)",0,100000,1],
        ] as const).map(([key,title,min,max,step])=><label key={key} className={label}>{title}<input type="number" min={min} max={max} step={step} className={input} value={plan.settings[key]} onChange={e=>patchSettings({[key]:numeric(e.target.value,min,max)} as Partial<FoodSettings>)}/></label>)}
        </div><label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-700"><input type="checkbox" checked={plan.settings.countFuelInPack} onChange={e=>patchSettings({countFuelInPack:e.target.checked})}/>Add separately planned fuel to carried pack weight (uncheck if already in Builder)</label>
        <button className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 underline" type="button" onClick={()=>patchSettings(DEFAULT_FOOD_SETTINGS)}>Restore default assumptions</button>
      </div>}
      <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-4 border-t border-gray-100 pt-3 text-sm"><span>Heating sessions: <strong>{plan.meals.filter(m=>m.heated).length}</strong></span><span>Estimated consumption: <strong>{format(forecast.fuelNeededGrams)}</strong></span><span>With reserve: <strong>{format(forecast.fuelTargetWithReserveGrams)}</strong></span><span>Available from start + mapped resupplies: <strong>{format(forecast.totalFuelSuppliedGrams)}</strong></span></div>
      {forecast.totalFuelSuppliedGrams < forecast.fuelTargetWithReserveGrams && <p role="status" className="mt-2 text-xs text-amber-800">Planned fuel is below the selected consumption-plus-reserve estimate. This does not verify fuel needs or availability.</p>}
    </div>
    <div className={card}>
      {panelButton("resupply","Food & fuel resupply stops")}
      {expanded.resupply && <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
        <p className="text-xs text-gray-600">Attach supplies to a Phase 6 resupply waypoint with a trip day. Supplies are added at the <strong>start</strong> of that day. Changes to route day assignment take effect after saving the route and refreshing the plan.</p>
        {plan.resupplies.map(r=><div key={r.id} className="grid gap-3 rounded-lg border border-gray-100 bg-gray-50 p-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5">
          <label className={`${label} lg:col-span-2`}>Mapped resupply stop<select className={input} value={r.waypointId} onChange={e=>patchResupply(r.id,{waypointId:e.target.value})}>
            {!resupplyStops.some(p=>p.id===r.waypointId)&&<option value={r.waypointId}>Removed stop (reassign)</option>}
            {resupplyStops.map(p=><option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.name}{p.dayId?` · ${days.findIndex(d=>d.id===p.dayId)+1>0?`Day ${days.findIndex(d=>d.id===p.dayId)+1}`:"Unassigned"}`:" · Unassigned"}</option>)}
          </select></label>
          <label className={label}>Food<select className={input} value={r.foodId} onChange={e=>patchResupply(r.id,{foodId:e.target.value,units:e.target.value?r.units||1:0})}><option value="">Fuel only</option>{plan.foods.map(f=><option key={f.id} value={f.id}>{f.name}</option>)}</select></label>
          <label className={label}>Food units<input type="number" min="0" max="10000" step="0.25" className={input} disabled={!r.foodId} value={r.units} onChange={e=>patchResupply(r.id,{units:numeric(e.target.value,0,10000)})}/></label>
          <label className={label}>Fuel added (g)<div className="flex gap-2"><input type="number" min="0" max="50000" className={input} value={r.fuelGrams} onChange={e=>patchResupply(r.id,{fuelGrams:numeric(e.target.value,0,50000)})}/><button type="button" aria-label="Remove resupply" onClick={()=>setPlan({...plan,resupplies:plan.resupplies.filter(x=>x.id!==r.id)})} className="text-red-700"><Trash2 className="h-4 w-4"/></button></div></label>
        </div>)}
        <button type="button" className={button} disabled={!resupplyStops.length||plan.resupplies.length>=200} onClick={addResupply}><Truck className="h-4 w-4"/>Add resupply</button>
        {!resupplyStops.length&&<p className="text-sm text-amber-800">Add a Resupply stop under Route & itinerary, assign it to a day, and save the route first.</p>}
      </div>}
    </div>
    <div className={card}>
      <h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-bold text-gray-950"><TrendingDown className="h-4 w-4"/>Daily carried-weight forecast</h3>
      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">Weight at the start of each day after resupply, before that day's meals and other usage. Base gear stays constant. Results include only known masses.</p>
      {forecast.days.length ? <div className="mt-4 space-y-3" role="list" aria-label="Daily estimated pack weight">
        {forecast.days.map(d=><div role="listitem" key={d.dayId} className="grid grid-cols-[3.5rem_minmax(0,1fr)_6.2rem] items-center gap-2 sm:grid-cols-[5rem_minmax(0,1fr)_8rem]">
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700">Day {d.day}</span><div className="min-w-0">
            <div className="h-3 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-gray-100"><div className="h-full rounded-full bg-green-700" style={{width:`${Math.min(100,d.packStartKnownGrams/maxCarried*100)}%`}}/></div>
            {(d.foodAddedGrams>0||d.fuelAddedGrams>0)&&<span className="text-[11px] text-green-800">+ {format(d.foodAddedGrams+d.fuelAddedGrams)} resupplied</span>}
            {(d.shortfalls.length>0||d.fuelShortfallGrams>0)&&<span className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-800">Supply shortfall · {d.shortfalls.length} food line(s){d.fuelShortfallGrams>0?` · ${format(d.fuelShortfallGrams)} fuel`:""}</span>}
          </div><span className="text-right text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 tabular-nums">{format(d.packStartKnownGrams)}{unknownMass?" +?":""}</span>
        </div>)}
        </div>:<div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 px-3 py-6 text-sm text-gray-500"><Package className="h-5 w-5"/>Set trip dates to see daily weight changes.</div>}
      <div className="mt-4 grid gap-2 border-t border-gray-100 pt-3 text-xs text-gray-600 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <p>Food and fuel consumption are taken from scheduled meals and editable assumptions. Unplanned food stays in your pack.</p>
        <p>Builder consumables stay constant unless you set daily usage. Water planning appears above; water mass is not automatically added to the carried-weight forecast.</p>
      </div>
      {(forecast.orphanedResupplies>0||forecast.orphanedMeals>0||unknownMass||forecast.days.some(d=>d.shortfalls.length||d.fuelShortfallGrams))&&<div role="status" className="mt-3 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3 text-xs leading-5 text-amber-900"><AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0"/>
        <span>{forecast.orphanedResupplies>0?`${forecast.orphanedResupplies} resupply entry/entries have no mapped day. `:""}{forecast.orphanedMeals>0?`${forecast.orphanedMeals} meal(s) refer to removed days. `:""}{unknownMass?"Some weights are unknown; totals show known mass only. ":""}{forecast.days.some(d=>d.shortfalls.length||d.fuelShortfallGrams)?"Scheduled supplies exceed recorded inventory on at least one day.":""}</span>
      </div>}
    </div>
    {dirty&&<p role="status" className="text-xs font-semibold text-amber-800">Unsaved changes to your food and consumables plan.</p>}
  </section>;
}
```

```typescript
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import { findAccessibleBuild, requireBuildPageAccess } from "@/lib/build-access";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import Link from "next/link";
import Image from "next/image";
import AddGearButton from "@/components/builder/AddGearButton";
import BrandFilter from "@/components/filters/BrandFilter";
import FilterSection from "@/components/filters/FilterSection";
import RangeFilter from "@/components/filters/RangeFilter";
import SortHeader from "@/components/filters/SortHeader";
import GearCompareSelection, { GearCompareButton } from "@/components/gear/GearCompareSelection";

export type GearBrowseSearch = Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>;
const first = (value: string | string[] | undefined) => (Array.isArray(value) ? value[0] : value) ?? "";
function limit(value: string | string[] | undefined, integer = false) {
  const text = first(value).trim();
  const number = Number(text);
  if (!text || !Number.isFinite(number) || number < 0) return undefined;
  return integer ? Math.min(Math.floor(number), 2147483647) : number;
}

export default async function OriginalGearPicker({ categorySlug, subcategorySlug, filters }: {
  categorySlug: string; subcategorySlug?: string; filters: GearBrowseSearch;
}) {
  const explicitBuild = first(filters.build);
  const cookieBuild = (await cookies()).get("currentBuild")?.value;
  // Navigation state chooses a candidate; ownership proof authorizes it.
  const access = explicitBuild
    ? await requireBuildPageAccess(explicitBuild)
    : cookieBuild ? await findAccessibleBuild(cookieBuild) : null;
  const build = access ? await prisma.build.findUnique({
    where: { id: access.id, userId: access.userId }, select: { id: true, name: true },
  }) : null;
  const categoryData = await prisma.category.findUnique({
    where: { slug: categorySlug.toLowerCase() },
    include: { subcategories: {
      orderBy: { name: "asc" },
      include: { gear: {
        where: { images: { some: {} } }, take: 1, orderBy: { name: "asc" },
        select: { name: true, images: { take: 1, orderBy: [{ isPrimary: "desc" }, { id: "asc" }] } },
      } },
    } },
  });
  if (!categoryData) notFound();
  const selected = subcategorySlug ? categoryData.subcategories.find(item => item.slug === subcategorySlug) : undefined;
  if (subcategorySlug && !selected) notFound();
  const scope = { categoryId: categoryData.id, ...(selected ? { subcategoryId: selected.id } : {}) };
  const sort = first(filters.sort);
  const direction = first(filters.direction) === "desc" ? "desc" as const : "asc" as const;
  const brands = (Array.isArray(filters.brand) ? filters.brand : [filters.brand ?? ""]).flatMap(item => item.split(",")).filter(Boolean);
  const maxWeight = limit(filters.maxWeight, true);
  const maxPrice = limit(filters.maxPrice);
  const [availableBrands, gear] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.brand.findMany({ where: { gear: { some: scope } }, orderBy: { name: "asc" } }),
    prisma.gear.findMany({
      where: {
        ...scope,
        ...(brands.length ? { brand: { name: { in: brands } } } : {}),
        ...(maxWeight !== undefined ? { weight_g: { lte: maxWeight } } : {}),
        ...(maxPrice !== undefined ? { price_cad: { lte: maxPrice } } : {}),
      },
      orderBy: sort === "weight" ? { weight_g: direction } : sort === "price" ? { price_cad: direction } : undefined,
      include: { brand: true, reviews: true, images: true },
    }),
  ]);
  const base = `/gear/${encodeURIComponent(categoryData.slug)}`;
  function typeHref(slug: string) {
    const query = new URLSearchParams();
    for (const key of ["brand", "maxWeight", "maxPrice", "sort", "direction", "build"]) {
      const value = filters[key];
      if (value) query.set(key, Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(",") : value);
    }
    return `${base}${slug ? "/" + encodeURIComponent(slug) : ""}${query.size ? "?" + query : ""}`;
  }
  const tiles = !selected && categoryData.subcategories.length > 0 ? <nav aria-label="Subcategories" className="mb-6">
    <h2 className="mb-3 text-center text-lg font-semibold">Shop by category</h2>
    <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-3">
{categoryData.subcategories.map(type => <Link
  key={type.id}
  href={typeHref(type.slug)}
  className="w-28 shrink-0 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white p-2 text-center">
      <div className="relative mx-auto h-20 w-20">
        {type.gear[0]?.images[0] ? <Image src={type.gear[0].images[0].url} alt={type.gear[0].name} fill sizes="80px" className="object-contain p-1" />
          : <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center text-xs text-gray-400">No photo</div>}
      </div><span className="text-xs font-semibold">{type.name}</span>
    </Link>)}
    </div>
  </nav> : null;
    return (
        <GearCompareSelection buildId={build?.id}>
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
            <main className="max-w-[110rem] mx-auto px-8 py-8">

                <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8">
                    Choose {selected?.name ?? categoryData.name}
                </h1>

                {build && <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-gray-500">Adding to {build.name} · <Link href={`/build/${build.id}`} className="text-blue-600 hover:underline">Back to build</Link></p>}
                {tiles}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-[250px_1fr] gap-8">

                    {/* Filters */}
                    <aside className="border-r pr-6">

                        <h2 className="font-bold text-xl mb-4">
                            Filters
                        </h2>


                        <div className="space-y">
                            <FilterSection title="BRAND">
                                <BrandFilter
                                    brands={availableBrands}
                                />
                            </FilterSection>


                            <FilterSection title="WEIGHT">
                                <RangeFilter
                                    min={0}
                                    max={3000}
                                    unit="g"
                                    param="maxWeight"
                                />
                            </FilterSection>

                            <FilterSection title="PRICE">
                                <RangeFilter
                                    min={0}
                                    max={1000}
                                    unit="CAD"
                                    param="maxPrice"
                                />
                            </FilterSection>
                        </div>
                    </aside>

                    {/* Gear */}
                    <div role="region" aria-label="Products" className="min-w-0 overflow-x-auto rounded-lg">
                        <p className="mb-8 text-lg font-bold text-black">
                            {gear.length} Products
                        </p>
                        <div className="grid min-w-[1020px] grid-cols-[minmax(220px,2.3fr)_90px_90px_100px_90px_90px_90px_185px] px-5 py-3 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide text-gray-500 border-b border-gray-400">
                            <div>Product</div>
                            <SortHeader
                                label="Weight"
                                value="weight"
                            />
                            <div className="text-center">Capacity</div>
                            <div className="text-center">Frame</div>
                            <div className="text-center">Waterproof</div>
                            <div className="text-center">Rating</div>
                            <SortHeader
                                label="Price"
                                value="price"
                            />
                            <div></div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                            {gear.map((item) => {
                                const averageRating =
                                    item.reviews.length > 0
                                        ? (
                                            item.reviews.reduce(
                                                (sum, review) => sum + review.rating,
                                                0
                                            ) / item.reviews.length
                                        ).toFixed(1)
                                        : null;

                                return (
                                    <div
                                        key={item.id}
                                        className="grid min-w-[1020px] grid-cols-[minmax(220px,2.3fr)_90px_90px_100px_90px_90px_90px_185px] items-center px-5 py-2 hover:bg-gray-50"
                                    >
                                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

                                            <Link href={`/gear/${item.id}`} aria-label={`View ${item.name}`} className="
                                                    relative
                                                    w-12
                                                    aspect-square
                                                    rounded-lg
                                                    overflow-hidden
                                                    bg-white
                                                    border
                                                    border-gray-200
                                                    shrink-0
                                                ">
                                                {item.images[0] && (
                                                    <Image
                                                        src={item.images[0].url}
                                                        alt={item.name}
                                                        fill
                                                        className="object-contain"
                                                    />
                                                )}
                                            </Link>


                                            <div>
                                                <h2 className="font-semibold hover:text-blue-600">
                                                    <Link href={`/gear/${item.id}`}>{item.name}</Link>
                                                </h2>

                                                <p className="text-[13px] text-gray-500">
                                                    {item.brand.name}
                                                </p>
                                            </div>

                                        </div>

                                        <div className="text-center">
                                            {item.weight_g === null ? "—" : `${item.weight_g} g`}
                                        </div>

                                        <div className="text-center">
                                            {item.capacity_l === null ? "—" : `${item.capacity_l} L`}
                                        </div>

                                        <div className="text-center">
                                            {item.frame_type ?? "—"}
                                        </div>

                                        <div className="text-center">
                                            {item.waterproof === null || item.waterproof === undefined
                                                ? "—"
                                                : item.waterproof
                                                    ? "Yes"
                                                    : "No"}
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="text-center">
                                            {averageRating
                                                ? `★ ${averageRating}`
                                                : "—"}
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="text-center">
                                            ${item.price_cad ?? "—"}
                                        </div>

                                        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                                            <GearCompareButton product={{ id: item.id, name: item.name, categoryId: item.categoryId, categoryName: categoryData.name }} />
                                            {build ? <AddGearButton buildId={build.id} gearId={item.id} /> : null}
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                );
                            })}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </main>
        </div>
        </GearCompareSelection>
    );
}
```

### `components/builder/ItemCategoryToggle.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useOptimistic, useTransition } from "react";
import { setItemCategory } from "@/lib/tracked-build-actions";

type Category = "base" | "worn" | "consumable";

type Props = {
    itemId: string;
    buildId: string;
    isConsumable: boolean;
    isWorn: boolean;
};

export default function ItemCategoryToggle({
    itemId,
    buildId,
    isConsumable,
    isWorn,
}: Props) {
    const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();

    const initial: Category = isWorn
        ? "worn"
        : isConsumable
            ? "consumable"
            : "base";

    const [optimisticCategory, setOptimisticCategory] = useOptimistic(
        initial,
        (_state: Category, next: Category) => next
    );

    function select(category: Category) {
        const next = optimisticCategory === category ? "base" : category;

        startTransition(async () => {
            setOptimisticCategory(next);

            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append("itemId", itemId);
            formData.append("buildId", buildId);
            formData.append("category", next);

            await setItemCategory(formData);
        });
    }

    return (
        <div
            className={`
                inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 p-0.5
                transition ${isPending ? "opacity-60" : ""}
            `}
        >
            <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => select("worn")}
                aria-pressed={optimisticCategory === "worn"}
                className={`
                    rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 max-md:min-h-9 max-md:px-3 text-[10px] font-semibold
                    cursor-pointer transition whitespace-nowrap
                    ${optimisticCategory === "worn"
                        ? "bg-amber-400 text-amber-950"
                        : "text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600"
                    }
                `}
            >
                Worn
            </button>

            <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => select("consumable")}
                aria-pressed={optimisticCategory === "consumable"}
                className={`
                    rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 max-md:min-h-9 max-md:px-3 text-[10px] font-semibold
                    cursor-pointer transition whitespace-nowrap
                    ${optimisticCategory === "consumable"
                        ? "bg-emerald-400 text-emerald-950"
                        : "text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600"
                    }
                `}
            >
                Consumable
            </button>
        </div>
    );
}
```

### `components/builder/PublicBuildView.tsx`

```typescript

import Link from "next/link";
import {publicRouteWaypoints} from "@/lib/discover-public-route";
import TripPlanner from "./TripPlanner/TripPlanner";
import type { PlannerBuild } from "@/lib/trip-planner";
import { evaluateCompatibility } from "@/lib/compatibility";
import BuildHeader from "@/components/builder/BuildHeader";
import CompatibilityDetails from "@/components/builder/CompatibilityDetails";
import WeightSummary from "@/components/builder/WeightSummary";
import { calculateWeightBreakdown, calculateTotalCost } from "@/lib/calculations";
import type { BuildForCompat, CompatItem } from "@/lib/compatibility";

type Item = {
  id: string;
  quantity: number;
  isWorn: boolean;
  isConsumable: boolean;
  customCategory: string | null;
  gearNameSnapshot: string | null;
  weightSnapshot: number | null;
  priceSnapshot: number | null;
  gear: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    weight_g: number | null;
    price_cad: number | null;
    category: { name: string };
  } | null;
};

type Build = PlannerBuild & {
  name: string;
  items: Item[];
};

// Server-rendered display only: no mutation forms or editing components.
export default function PublicBuildView({
  build,
  activeTab,
  compatBuild,
  compatItems,
  issueCount,
}: {
  build: Build;
  activeTab: "gear" | "trip";
  compatBuild: BuildForCompat;
  compatItems: CompatItem[];
  issueCount: number;
}) {
  const weight = calculateWeightBreakdown(build.items);
  const totalCost = calculateTotalCost(build.items);

  const categories = [
    ...new Set(
      build.items.map(
        (item) => item.gear?.category.name ?? item.customCategory ?? "Other"
      )
    ),
  ];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      <BuildHeader
        buildId={build.id}
        name={build.name}
        active={activeTab}
        issueCount={issueCount}
      />

      <main className="mx-auto max-w-6xl space-y-6 px-4 py-6">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-green-200 bg-green-50 p-4 text-sm text-green-900">
          <p>Public build · Read-only · Only the owner can edit.</p>
          <Link href="/build" className="font-semibold underline">
            Create your own build
          </Link>
        </div>

        {activeTab === "gear" ? (
          <>
            {categories.length === 0 && (
              <p className="rounded-xl bg-white p-6 text-gray-500">
                No gear added yet.
              </p>
            )}

            {categories.map((category) => (
              <section
                key={category}
                className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-5"
              >
                <h2 className="mb-3 text-lg font-semibold">{category}</h2>

                <ul className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                  {build.items
                    .filter(
                      (item) =>
                        (item.gear?.category.name ??
                          item.customCategory ??
                          "Other") === category
                    )
                    .map((item) => {
                      const name =
                        item.gear?.name ??
                        item.gearNameSnapshot ??
                        "Custom item";

                      const grams =
                        item.gear?.weight_g ?? item.weightSnapshot;

                      const price =
                        item.gear?.price_cad ?? item.priceSnapshot;

                      return (
                        <li
                          key={item.id}
                          className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 py-3"
                        >
                          <div>
                            {item.gear ? (
                              <Link
                                href={`/gear/${item.gear.id}`}
                                className="font-semibold hover:underline"
                              >
                                {name}
                              </Link>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="font-semibold">{name}</span>
                            )}

                            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">
                              Quantity: {item.quantity}
                              {item.isWorn ? " · Worn" : ""}
                              {item.isConsumable ? " · Consumable" : ""}
                            </p>
                          </div>

                          <div className="text-sm text-gray-600">
                            {grams == null
                              ? "Weight unknown"
                              : `${grams * item.quantity} g`}
                            {" · "}
                            {price == null
                              ? "Price unknown"
                              : `CAD $${(price * item.quantity).toFixed(2)}`}
                          </div>
                        </li>
                      );
                    })}
                </ul>
              </section>
            ))}

            <p className="text-lg font-semibold">
              Total cost: CAD ${totalCost.toFixed(2)}
            </p>

            <WeightSummary {...weight} />

            <CompatibilityDetails
              trip={build}
              items={compatItems}
              readOnly
            />
          </>
        ) : (
          <TripPlanner
            build={{
              ...build,
              routeWaypoints: publicRouteWaypoints(build.routeWaypoints,build.days.map(day=>day.id)),
              tripLogistics: undefined,
              days: build.days.map((day) => ({
                ...day,
                reservation: null,
              })),
            }}
            issues={evaluateCompatibility(
              compatBuild,
              compatItems,
              build.days
            )}
            items={compatItems}
            readOnly
          />
        )}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `components/builder/QuantityStepper.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useOptimistic, useTransition } from "react";
import { updateQuantity } from "@/lib/tracked-build-actions";

type Props = {
    itemId: string;
    buildId: string;
    quantity: number;
};

export default function QuantityStepper({
    itemId,
    buildId,
    quantity,
}: Props) {
    const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();

    const [optimisticQuantity, setOptimisticQuantity] = useOptimistic(
        quantity,
        (_state: number, newValue: number) => newValue
    );

    function change(delta: number) {
        const next = Math.max(1, optimisticQuantity + delta);

        startTransition(async () => {
            setOptimisticQuantity(next);

            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append("itemId", itemId);
            formData.append("buildId", buildId);
            formData.append("delta", delta.toString());

            await updateQuantity(formData);
        });
    }

    return (
        <div
            className={`
            flex items-center rounded-full border border-gray-300 bg-white shrink-0
            transition
            ${isPending ? "opacity-60" : ""}
            `}
        >
            <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => change(-1)}
                disabled={optimisticQuantity <= 1}
                aria-label="Decrease quantity"
                className="
                w-6 h-6 max-md:w-9 max-md:h-9
                flex items-center justify-center
                text-gray-500
                hover:text-red-600
                disabled:opacity-30
                disabled:hover:text-gray-500
                transition
                cursor-pointer
                "
            >
                −
            </button>

            <span className="w-6 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 select-none">
                {optimisticQuantity}
            </span>

            <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => change(1)}
                aria-label="Increase quantity"
                className="
                w-6 h-6 max-md:w-9 max-md:h-9
                flex items-center justify-center
                text-gray-500
                hover:text-green-700
                transition
                cursor-pointer
                "
            >
                +
            </button>
        </div>
    );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { Copy, CopyCheck, Plus, Save } from "lucide-react";
import BuildSettings from "@/components/builder/BuildSettings";
import BuildDataTools from "@/components/builder/BuildDataTools";
import { duplicateBuild } from "@/lib/tracked-build-actions";

type Props = {
  buildId: string;
  buildName: string;
  isPublic: boolean;
  createdAt: Date;
  updatedAt: Date;
  activeTab: "gear" | "trip";
  gpxDays: { id: string; date: Date | string }[];
};

const btnClass =
  "flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 shadow-sm transition hover:border-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50";

export default function ShareBar({ buildId, buildName, isPublic, createdAt, updatedAt, activeTab, gpxDays }: Props) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const shareUrl = typeof window !== "undefined" ? `${window.location.origin}/build/${buildId}` : `/build/${buildId}`;

  async function copyLink() {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(shareUrl);
      setCopied(true);
      window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500);
    } catch {
      // The URL remains selectable if clipboard permission is blocked.
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5 px-5 py-4">
      <div className="flex min-w-[280px] max-md:min-w-0 max-md:basis-full flex-1 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2 shadow-inner shadow-gray-100/70">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={copyLink}
          title={isPublic ? "Copy public link" : "Copy private link"}
          className="shrink-0 rounded-md p-1 text-gray-400 transition hover:bg-white hover:text-green-800"
        >
          {copied ? <CopyCheck className="h-4 w-4 text-green-700" /> : <Copy className="h-4 w-4" />}
        </button>
        <input
          readOnly
          value={shareUrl}
          onFocus={(event) => event.currentTarget.select()}
          className="w-full max-md:min-w-0 truncate bg-transparent text-sm text-gray-700 outline-none"
        />
        <span className={`shrink-0 rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide ${isPublic ? "bg-green-100 text-green-800" : "bg-gray-200 text-gray-600"}`}>
          {isPublic ? "Public" : "Private"}
        </span>
      </div>

      <BuildDataTools
        buildId={buildId}
        buildName={buildName}
        createdAt={createdAt}
        updatedAt={updatedAt}
        activeTab={activeTab}
        gpxDays={gpxDays}
        buttonClassName={btnClass}
      />

      <BuildSettings buildId={buildId} buildName={buildName} isPublic={isPublic} buttonClassName={btnClass} />

      <form action={duplicateBuild}>
        <input type="hidden" name="buildId" value={buildId} />
        <button type="submit" className={btnClass}>
          <Save className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          Save As
        </button>
      </form>

      <Link href="/build" className={btnClass}>
        <Plus className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        New Build
      </Link>
    </div>
  );
}
```
