### `components/builder/TripPlanner/RouteElevationPanel.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useMemo, useState, type Dispatch, type SetStateAction } from "react";
import {
  AlertTriangle, ChevronDown, MapPin, SlidersHorizontal, X,
  Route as RouteIcon,
} from "lucide-react";
import { computeRouteMetrics } from "@/lib/route-metrics";
import { classicNaismithMinutes, sacReferenceMinutes } from "@/lib/hiking-time";
import { routeAnalysisScope } from "@/lib/route-analysis-scope";
import {
  analyzeTerrain,
  type BreakSettings, type SustainedSlope,
} from "@/lib/route-analysis-insights";
import type { PlannerDay, Waypoint } from "@/lib/trip-planner";
import { notableTerrainFindings, summarizeGradient } from "@/lib/terrain-gradient-summary";

const PACE_OPTIONS = [
  { label: "Relaxed", pace: 3 },
  { label: "Steady", pace: 4 },
  { label: "Brisk", pace: 5 },
] as const;
const km = (meters: number) => (meters / 1000).toFixed(2);
const wholeMeters = (meters: number) => Math.round(meters).toLocaleString("en-CA");
const duration = (minutes: number) => {
  const rounded = Math.round(minutes);
  const hours = Math.floor(rounded / 60);
  const remaining = rounded % 60;
  return hours ? `${hours}h ${remaining ? `${remaining}m` : ""}`.trim() : `${remaining}m`;
};
const pct = (part: number, total: number) => total > 0 ? Math.round(part / total * 100) : 0;
const formatSlope = (value: number) => `${value > 0 ? "+" : ""}${value.toFixed(1)}%`;
function TerrainFindingRow({ title, slope, dayLabels, onInspect }: {
  title: string; slope: SustainedSlope; dayLabels: Map<string, string>;
  onInspect?: (section: SustainedSlope) => void;
}) {
  const day = slope.dayId ? dayLabels.get(slope.dayId) ?? "Unknown day" : "Cross-day / unassigned";
  return <div className="min-w-0 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-3 sm:px-4">
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-5 gap-y-3">
      <div className="min-w-[180px] flex-1">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{title}</p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] tabular-nums text-gray-500">{day} · km {km(slope.startM)}–{km(slope.endM)}</p>
      </div>
      <div className="grid min-w-0 flex-[2] grid-cols-3 gap-x-3 gap-y-2 sm:max-w-[520px]">
        <div className="min-w-0"><p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">Avg. gradient</p><p className="mt-0.5 text-sm font-bold tabular-nums text-gray-950">{formatSlope(slope.gradePct)}</p></div>
        <div className="min-w-0"><p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">Distance</p><p className="mt-0.5 text-sm font-bold tabular-nums text-gray-950">{km(slope.endM - slope.startM)} km</p></div>
        <div className="min-w-0"><p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">{slope.direction === "climb" ? "Elevation gain" : "Elevation loss"}</p><p className="mt-0.5 text-sm font-bold tabular-nums text-gray-950">{slope.direction === "climb" ? "+" : "−"}{wholeMeters(slope.gainM)} m</p></div>
      </div>
      {onInspect && <button type="button" onClick={() => onInspect(slope)}
        className="inline-flex min-h-9 shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-green-200 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-green-900 hover:bg-green-50 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-green-700">
        <MapPin className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />Locate on map
      </button>}
    </div>
  </div>;
}

export default function RouteElevationPanel({ points, days, working, paceKmh, onPaceChange, breaks, onBreaksChange, activeDayId, onInspectTerrain }: {
  points: Waypoint[]; days: PlannerDay[]; working: boolean; paceKmh: number; onPaceChange: (value: number) => void;
  breaks: BreakSettings; onBreaksChange: Dispatch<SetStateAction<BreakSettings>>;
  activeDayId: string | null;
  onInspectTerrain?: (section: SustainedSlope) => void;
}) {
  const metrics = useMemo(() => computeRouteMetrics(points, days, paceKmh), [points, days, paceKmh]);
  const terrain = useMemo(() => analyzeTerrain(metrics.profileSections, metrics.profileDayIds), [metrics]);
  const [settingsOpen, setSettingsOpen] = useState(true);
  const [advancedOpen, setAdvancedOpen] = useState(false);
  const preset = PACE_OPTIONS.find(option => option.pace === paceKmh);
  const breakRate = breaks.style === "minimal" ? 5 : breaks.style === "normal" ? 10
    : breaks.style === "frequent" ? 15 : breaks.customMinutesPerHour;
  const breakLabel = breaks.style === "minimal" ? "Short" : breaks.style === "normal" ? "Normal"
    : breaks.style === "frequent" ? "Frequent" : "Custom";
  const scope = useMemo(() => routeAnalysisScope(metrics, activeDayId, breaks), [metrics, activeDayId, breaks]);
  const fullyElevated = scope.segments > 0 && scope.unroutedSegments === 0 && scope.climbedSegments === scope.segments;
  const dayLabels = useMemo(() => new Map(days.map((day, index) => [day.id, `Day ${index + 1}`])), [days]);
  const shownTerrain = useMemo(() => scope.dayId
    ? analyzeTerrain(
        metrics.profileSections.filter((_, index) => metrics.profileDayIds[index] === scope.dayId),
        metrics.profileDayIds.filter(id => id === scope.dayId),
      )
    : terrain, [metrics, scope.dayId, terrain]);
  const directionalTerrain = useMemo(() => summarizeGradient(shownTerrain.cells), [shownTerrain]);
  const terrainFindings = useMemo(() => notableTerrainFindings(shownTerrain.hardestClimb, directionalTerrain.longestSteepClimb, shownTerrain.hardestDescent), [shownTerrain, directionalTerrain]);
  // All figures, including advanced reference models, now follow the single
  // route-wide day selector. Pace and breaks remain trip preferences.
  const { movingMinutes, breakMinutes: breakEstimate } = scope;
  const routeTimeComplete = scope.complete;
  const totalMinutes = movingMinutes !== null && breakEstimate !== null ? movingMinutes + breakEstimate : null;
  const totalBreakText = movingMinutes !== null && breakEstimate !== null ? duration(breakEstimate) : "Unavailable";
  const timeBarTotal = totalMinutes !== null && totalMinutes > 0 ? totalMinutes : 0;
  const movingShare = timeBarTotal > 0 ? Math.max(0, movingMinutes ?? 0) / timeBarTotal * 100 : 0;
  const breakShare = timeBarTotal > 0 ? Math.max(0, breakEstimate ?? 0) / timeBarTotal * 100 : 0;
  const sampleCoverage = pct(scope.terrainTimeDistanceM, scope.routedDistanceM);
  const referenceModels = fullyElevated ? {
    naismith: classicNaismithMinutes(scope.distanceM, scope.knownAscentM),
    sac: sacReferenceMinutes(scope.distanceM, scope.knownAscentM, scope.knownDescentM),
  } : null;
  // Compare each day using the same timing model and break preferences as the
  // main hiking-time card. The comparison always includes all itinerary days,
  // regardless of the selected analysis scope.
  const dayComparison = useMemo(() => days.map((day, index) => {
    const dayMetrics = metrics.dayMetrics.find(entry => entry.dayId === day.id);
    if (!dayMetrics || dayMetrics.segments === 0) {
      return { id: day.id, label: `Day ${index + 1}`, segments: 0,
        complete: false, total: null };
    }
    const dayScope = routeAnalysisScope(metrics, day.id, breaks);
    const total = dayScope.movingMinutes !== null && dayScope.breakMinutes !== null
      ? dayScope.movingMinutes + dayScope.breakMinutes : null;
    return { id: day.id, label: `Day ${index + 1}`, segments: dayScope.segments,
      complete: dayScope.complete, total };
  }), [days, metrics, breaks]);
  const maxDayMinutes = Math.max(0, ...dayComparison.map(day => day.total ?? 0));
  const routeIssues = scope.issues;
  if (!metrics.segments) return <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-300 bg-gray-50/70 px-5 py-8 text-center">
    <RouteIcon className="mx-auto h-7 w-7 text-gray-400" aria-hidden="true" />
    <h3 className="mt-2 text-base font-semibold text-gray-900">Start by mapping a route</h3>
    <p className="mx-auto mt-1 max-w-md text-sm text-gray-600">Add stops in Route & itinerary to analyze hiking days, slopes and timing.</p>
    <a href="#route" className="mt-3 inline-flex rounded-lg bg-green-900 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white">Open route map</a>
  </div>;

  return <section className="space-y-5 pb-3 sm:space-y-6" aria-label="Route terrain and daily hiking analysis">
    <section aria-label="Hiking time and breaks" className="space-y-4">
      {routeIssues.length > 0 && <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-5 text-amber-950" role="status">
        <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
        <div><strong>Some route estimates are incomplete.</strong> {routeIssues.join(" · ")}.</div>
      </div>}

      <div className={`grid gap-4 xl:gap-5 ${settingsOpen ? "lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,0.95fr)]" : "lg:grid-cols-1"} ${settingsOpen && advancedOpen ? "lg:items-start" : "lg:items-stretch"}`} aria-label="Hiking time and settings">
        <section aria-labelledby="route-hiking-time-heading" className="flex min-w-0 flex-col rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 sm:p-5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <h3 id="route-hiking-time-heading" className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-950">Hiking time</h3>
            {!settingsOpen && <button type="button" onClick={() => setSettingsOpen(true)} aria-expanded={false}
              className="inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-green-900 transition-colors hover:border-green-200 hover:bg-green-50 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-green-700">
              <SlidersHorizontal className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
              Show settings

            <p className="text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight tabular-nums text-gray-950">{totalMinutes !== null ? `~${duration(totalMinutes)}` : "Unavailable"}</p>
            {timeBarTotal === 0 && <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-gray-600">
              {movingMinutes !== null ? `${duration(movingMinutes)} moving` : "Moving time unavailable"}
              {totalBreakText !== "Unavailable" ? ` · ${totalBreakText} breaks` : ""}
            </p>}
            {!routeTimeComplete && <p className="mt-2 text-xs font-medium text-amber-800">Partial estimate · Only estimable route sections</p>}
          </div>

          {timeBarTotal > 0 && <div className="mt-4 space-y-2" aria-label="Hiking time breakdown">
            <div className="flex h-3 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-gray-100" role="img"
              aria-label={`${duration(movingMinutes!)} moving, ${duration(breakEstimate!)} breaks`}>
              <span className="h-full bg-green-800 transition-[width] duration-200" style={{ width: `${movingShare}%` }} />
              {breakShare > 0 && <span className="h-full bg-amber-500 transition-[width] duration-200" style={{ width: `${breakShare}%` }} />}
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-2 text-xs">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-600">
                <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-green-800" aria-hidden="true" />
                Moving <strong className="font-semibold tabular-nums text-gray-950">{duration(movingMinutes!)}</strong>
              </span>

                Breaks <strong className="font-semibold tabular-nums text-gray-950">{duration(breakEstimate!)}</strong>
              </span>
            </div>

          <div className="mt-5 flex flex-1 flex-col justify-end">

                  className={`min-h-[44px] min-w-0 rounded-lg border px-2 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-green-700 ${option.pace === paceKmh ? "border-green-700 bg-green-50 text-green-900" : "border-gray-200 bg-white text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50"}`}>

              </label>
              <details className="border-t border-gray-100 pt-3">
                <summary className="cursor-pointer font-semibold text-green-900">How time is calculated & compared</summary>
                <p className="mt-3 leading-5">Primary estimate: Tobler walking-speed curve over sampled 200 m elevation windows, scaled to the selected level-trail pace. Climbing is already included. Sparse sections use a conservative Naismith-style fallback. <strong>{sampleCoverage}%</strong> of mapped distance uses the sampled slope model.</p>
                {referenceModels && <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  <div><p className="font-semibold">Classic Naismith</p><p className="mt-1 text-lg font-bold tabular-nums">{duration(referenceModels.naismith)}</p><p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">5 km/h + 600 m ascent/hour</p></div>
                  <div><p className="font-semibold">Swiss Alpine Club</p><p className="mt-1 text-lg font-bold tabular-nums">{duration(referenceModels.sac)}</p><p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">4 km/h + ascent/400 m/h + descent/800 m/h</p></div>
                </div>}
                <p className="mt-3 text-[11px] leading-5 text-gray-500">Reference methods exclude breaks and are not confidence bounds. Scheduled itinerary stops are not added to hiking time.</p>

          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">Find the most demanding sustained slopes, then locate them on your map.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      {terrainFindings.length > 0 ? <div className="mt-4 space-y-2.5">
        {terrainFindings.map(({title,slope}) => <TerrainFindingRow

          title={title} slope={slope} dayLabels={dayLabels} onInspect={onInspectTerrain} />)}
      </div> : <p className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 px-3 py-3 text-xs leading-5 text-gray-600">
        {shownTerrain.analyzedDistanceM > 0
          ? "No sustained climbs or descents meet the 8% gradient over 500 m threshold for this selection."
          : "Not enough reliable elevation samples for sustained-slope analysis. Unmapped and sparse sections are excluded."}
      </p>}
      <details id="route-terrain-method" className="group mt-4 text-xs text-gray-600">
        <summary className="flex cursor-pointer list-none items-center justify-between gap-2 font-semibold text-green-900 marker:content-none"><span>How terrain sections are identified</span><ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 transition-transform group-open:rotate-180" aria-hidden="true" /></summary>
        <p className="mt-2 leading-5">Sustained sections require at least 500 m at an estimated gradient of 8% or more, calculated from 200 m elevation windows. “Hardest” means the greatest elevation gain among qualifying climbs, not technical trail difficulty. Missing or sparsely sampled sections are excluded. {working ? "Includes your unsaved route draft." : "Based on the saved route."} Inspect the gradient-colored elevation profile beneath the map to see where steep sections occur.</p>
      </details>
    </section>

    {dayComparison.length > 1 && <section id="route-compare-days" className="space-y-3 pt-1" aria-labelledby="route-compare-days-heading">
      <div>
        <h3 id="route-compare-days-heading" className="text-base font-semibold text-gray-950">Compare hiking days</h3>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">Estimated hiking time, including breaks, for each day.</p>
      </div>
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-4 sm:px-5">
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {dayComparison.map(day => <div key={day.id} className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
              <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{day.label}</span>
              <span className={`tabular-nums ${day.complete ? "font-semibold text-gray-900" : "text-gray-500"}`}>
                {day.segments === 0 ? "No mapped route" : day.total === null ? "Unavailable" : `${day.complete ? "~" : "≥"}${duration(day.total)}${day.complete ? "" : " · partial"}`}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="h-2.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-gray-100" role="img"
              aria-label={`${day.label}: ${day.segments === 0 ? "no mapped route" : day.total === null ? "time unavailable" : `${duration(day.total)}${day.complete ? " estimated" : " partial estimate"}`}`}>
              {day.total !== null && day.segments > 0 && maxDayMinutes > 0 && <div
                className={`h-full rounded-full ${day.complete ? "bg-green-800" : "bg-amber-500"}`}
                style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, day.total / maxDayMinutes * 100)}%` }} />}
            </div>
          </div>)}
        </div>
        {dayComparison.some(day => day.segments > 0 && !day.complete) && <p className="mt-3 text-[11px] leading-4 text-gray-500">
          Partial days have incomplete trail or elevation data; their bars are not directly comparable with complete days.
        </p>}
      </div>
    </section>}
  </section>;
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { Fragment, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { MapContainer, TileLayer, Marker, Popup, Polyline, CircleMarker, Tooltip, ZoomControl, useMap, useMapEvents } from "react-leaflet";
import { divIcon, DomEvent, type Marker as LeafletMarker } from "leaflet";
import { LocateFixed } from "lucide-react";
import type { Waypoint } from "@/lib/trip-planner";
import { waypointMarkerHtml, waypointType } from "@/lib/waypoint-map";
import { metersBetween, usableTrailSegment, type LatLng } from "@/lib/trail-routing";
import { MAX_ROUTE_SHAPING_WAYPOINTS, shapingInsertIndex, shapingInsertPositions } from "@/lib/route-shaping";
import { coveredMapBottomPx, routeFitPadding } from "@/lib/route-visible-fit";
import { routeLegStyle } from "@/lib/route-leg-style";
import { isSharedOvernightStop } from "@/lib/shared-overnight-stop";
import { clusterProjectedStops, displayStops, spiderfyOffset, type DisplayStop } from "@/lib/route-marker-clustering";
import "leaflet/dist/leaflet.css";

// Separate visuals: saved stops have numbered pins; route-shaping waypoints
// have small blue diamonds that render ONLY when editing.
const insertWaypointIcon = divIcon({
  className: "trailpicker-insert-waypoint-marker",
  html: '<span class="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 border-green-800 bg-white text-xl font-bold leading-none text-green-800 shadow-md hover:bg-green-50">+</span>',
  iconSize: [32, 32],
  iconAnchor: [16, 16],
});

const shapingWaypointIcon = divIcon({
  className: "trailpicker-shaping-waypoint-marker",
  html: '<span style="display:block;width:18px;height:18px;background:#2563eb;border:3px solid white;border-radius:3px;transform:rotate(45deg);box-shadow:0 1px 5px #0008"></span>',
  iconSize: [24, 24], iconAnchor: [12, 12], popupAnchor: [0, -16],
});

export type MapFocus = { lat: number; lng: number; request: number };
type Props = {
  points: Waypoint[];
  fallback: [number, number] | null;
  onPick?: (lat: number, lng: number) => void;
  onSelect?: (id: string) => void;
  onMove?: (id: string, lat: number, lng: number) => void;
  onInsert?: (afterIndex: number, viaIndex: number, lat: number, lng: number) => void;
  onMoveVia?: (stopId: string, viaIndex: number, lat: number, lng: number) => void;
  onRemoveVia?: (stopId: string, viaIndex: number) => void;
  selectedId?: string | null;
  activeDayId?: string | null;
  expandedDayIds?: readonly string[];
  editing?: boolean;
  compact?: boolean;
  profileDocked?: boolean;
  hoverLocation?: [number, number] | null;
  focus?: MapFocus | null;
};

function Controls({ points, onPick, focus }: Pick<Props, "points" | "onPick" | "focus">) {
  const map = useMap();
  const initialized = useRef(false);
  useMapEvents({ click(event) { onPick?.(event.latlng.lat, event.latlng.lng); } });
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialized.current) return;
    initialized.current = true;
    if (points.length > 1) map.fitBounds(points.map(p => [p.lat, p.lng]), { padding: [44, 44], maxZoom: 14 });
    else if (points.length === 1) map.setView([points[0].lat, points[0].lng], 13);
  }, [map, points]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (focus) map.setView([focus.lat, focus.lng], Math.max(map.getZoom(), 14));
  }, [map, focus]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const container = map.getContainer();
    const previous = container.style.cursor;
    container.style.cursor = onPick ? "crosshair" : "";
    return () => { container.style.cursor = previous; };
  }, [map, onPick]);
  return null;
}

/** Day selection emphasizes the corresponding mapped legs without scrolling the map on hover. */
function FocusSelectedDay({ points, activeDayId }: Pick<Props, "points" | "activeDayId">) {
  const map = useMap();
  const previous = useRef<string | null | undefined>(undefined);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (previous.current === undefined) { previous.current = activeDayId ?? null; return; }
    if (previous.current === (activeDayId ?? null)) return;
    previous.current = activeDayId ?? null;
    if (!activeDayId) {
      if (points.length > 1) map.fitBounds(points.map(p => [p.lat, p.lng]), { padding: [38, 38], maxZoom: 14 });
      return;
    }
    const coords: LatLng[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i++) {
      if (points[i].dayId === activeDayId) coords.push([points[i].lat, points[i].lng]);
      const next = points[i + 1];
      if (next && points[i].dayId === activeDayId && next.dayId === activeDayId) {
        const trail = usableTrailSegment(points[i], next);
        if (trail) coords.push(...trail.geometry);
      }
    }
    if (coords.length > 1) map.fitBounds(coords, { padding: [48, 48], maxZoom: 14 });
    else if (coords.length === 1) map.setView(coords[0], Math.max(map.getZoom(), 12));
  }, [map, points, activeDayId]);
  return null;
}

/**
 * Wheel input scrolls the page normally. Holding Ctrl zooms the map at the
 * pointer instead, without triggering the browser's Ctrl+wheel page zoom.
 * Uses a non-passive native listener because preventDefault is required.
 */
function CtrlWheelZoom() {
  const map = useMap();
  const accumulated = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const container = map.getContainer();
    const onWheel = (event: WheelEvent) => {
      if (!event.ctrlKey) {
        accumulated.current = 0;
        return; // leave ordinary scrolling completely untouched
      }

      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      const delta = event.deltaY * (
        event.deltaMode === 1 ? 16 : event.deltaMode === 2 ? container.clientHeight : 1
      );
      accumulated.current += delta;
      if (Math.abs(accumulated.current) < 60) return;

      // One zoom notch per normal mouse-wheel detent; also supports trackpads.
      const steps = Math.trunc(accumulated.current / 100) || Math.sign(accumulated.current);
      accumulated.current -= steps * 100;
      const zoom = Math.max(map.getMinZoom(), Math.min(map.getMaxZoom(), map.getZoom() - steps));
      if (zoom !== map.getZoom()) {
        map.setZoomAround(map.mouseEventToContainerPoint(event), zoom, { animate: false });
      }
    };
    container.addEventListener("wheel", onWheel, { capture: true, passive: false });
    return () => container.removeEventListener("wheel", onWheel, true);
  }, [map]);

  return <div className="trailpicker-ctrl-wheel-hint pointer-events-none absolute bottom-5 left-14 z-[800] rounded-md bg-white/90 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-gray-700 shadow-sm">
    Ctrl + scroll to zoom
  </div>;
}

/** Leaflet needs an explicit size refresh when the resizable panel changes width. */
function RefreshMapOnResize() {
  const map = useMap();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") return;
    let frame = 0;
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      window.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      frame = window.requestAnimationFrame(() => map.invalidateSize({ pan: false }));
    });
    observer.observe(map.getContainer());
    return () => {
      observer.disconnect();
      window.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    };
  }, [map]);
  return null;
}

function FitRoute({ points, fallback }: Pick<Props, "points" | "fallback">) {
  const map = useMap();
  const toolbar = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (toolbar.current) { DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(toolbar.current); DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(toolbar.current); }
  }, []);
  function fit() {
    // The elevation profile overlays (rather than resizes) the map. Leaflet's
    // default fitBounds otherwise centers part of the route behind the drawer.
    // Reading its rendered bounds also handles resizing and CSS height clamps.
    const mapElement = map.getContainer();
    const dock = mapElement.parentElement?.querySelector<HTMLElement>("[data-route-elevation-dock]");
    const coveredBottom = coveredMapBottomPx(
      mapElement.getBoundingClientRect(), dock?.getBoundingClientRect() ?? null,
    );
    if (points.length > 1) {
      map.fitBounds(points.map(p => [p.lat, p.lng]), {
        ...routeFitPadding(coveredBottom), maxZoom: 14,
      });
    } else if (points.length === 1 || fallback) {
      const center: [number, number] = points.length === 1
        ? [points[0].lat, points[0].lng] : fallback!;
      const zoom = points.length === 1 ? 14 : 12;
      if (coveredBottom > 0) {
        map.setView(center, zoom, { animate: false });
        // Move the location up by half of the occluded area, to the middle of
        // the map that the user can actually see.
        map.panBy([0, coveredBottom / 2], { animate: false });
      } else {
        // Preserve the existing behavior exactly when the profile is closed.
        map.setView(center, zoom);
      }
    }
  }
  return <div ref={toolbar} className="absolute right-3 top-3 z-[1000]">
    <button type="button" onClick={fit} disabled={!points.length && !fallback}
      aria-label="Fit route" title="Fit route"
      className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white text-gray-700 shadow-sm hover:bg-gray-50 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-green-700 disabled:opacity-50">
      <LocateFixed className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
    </button>
  </div>;
}

function StopMarker({ stop, position, selectedId, activeDayId, expandedDayIds, onSelect, onMove, spiderfied = false, autoOpen = false }: {
  stop: DisplayStop;
  position?: [number, number];
  selectedId?: string | null;
  activeDayId?: string | null;
  expandedDayIds?: readonly string[];
  onSelect?: (id: string) => void;
  onMove?: (id: string, lat: number, lng: number) => void;
  spiderfied?: boolean;
  autoOpen?: boolean;
}) {
  const selectedMember = stop.members.find(({ point }) => point.id === selectedId);
  const { point, order } = selectedMember ?? stop.members[0];
  const selected = !!selectedMember;
  const active = stop.members.some(({ point: item }) => expandedDayIds !== undefined
    ? expandedDayIds.includes(item.dayId ?? "")
    : (!!activeDayId && item.dayId === activeDayId));
  const size = selected ? 38 : ["camp", "water", "resupply"].includes(point.kind) ? 34 : 32;
  const icon = useMemo(() => divIcon({
    html: waypointMarkerHtml(point.kind, order, selected, size),
    className: "trailpicker-stop-icon",
    iconSize: [size, size], iconAnchor: [size / 2, size / 2], popupAnchor: [0, -size / 2],
  }), [point.kind, order, selected, size]);
  const marker = useRef<LeafletMarker | null>(null);
  const label = stop.members.length > 1 ? `${point.name} · ${stop.members.length} linked day stops` : `${order}. ${point.name}`;
  useEffect(() => {
    const element = marker.current?.getElement();
    if (element) {
      element.title = label;
      element.setAttribute("aria-label", `${waypointType(point.kind).label}: ${label}`);
    }
  }, [label, point.kind, icon]);
  useEffect(() => { if (autoOpen) marker.current?.openPopup(); }, [autoOpen]);
  // An overnight handoff remains one marker. To move either underlying stop,
  // select its entry first (on the map or in the itinerary).
  const canDrag = !!onMove && (stop.members.length === 1 || selected);
  return <Marker ref={marker} position={position ?? [stop.lat, stop.lng]}
    icon={icon} title={label} alt={`${waypointType(point.kind).label}: ${label}`} keyboard bubblingMouseEvents={false}
    draggable={canDrag} zIndexOffset={selected ? 1500 : spiderfied ? 800 : active ? 150 : 0}
    eventHandlers={{
      click: () => { if (stop.members.length === 1 || selected) onSelect?.(point.id); },
      dragend: event => {
        const location = (event.target as LeafletMarker).getLatLng();
        onMove?.(point.id, location.lat, location.lng);
      },
    }}>
    <Popup>
      <strong>{point.name}</strong><br />{waypointType(point.kind).label}
      {point.elevationM != null && <> · {point.elevationM} m</>}
      {stop.members.length > 1 && <div className="mt-2 space-y-1">
        <p className="text-xs text-gray-600">Shared overnight location. Choose the itinerary stop to edit:</p>
        {stop.members.map(member => <button key={member.point.id} type="button"
          className={`block w-full rounded px-2 py-1 text-left text-xs ${selectedId === member.point.id ? "bg-green-100 text-green-900" : "hover:bg-gray-100"}`}
          onClick={() => onSelect?.(member.point.id)}>
          Stop {member.order}{member.point.dayId ? " · Trip day stop" : " · Unassigned"}
        </button>)}
      </div>}
      {canDrag && <><br /><span className="text-xs">Drag the pin to adjust its location.</span></>}
    </Popup>
  </Marker>;
}

function markerClusterIcon(count: number) {
  const size = 36;
  return divIcon({
    className: "trailpicker-marker-cluster",
    html: `<div style="box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:${size}px;height:${size}px;border:3px solid white;border-radius:50%;background:#14532d;color:white;box-shadow:0 2px 7px #0005;font:700 13px system-ui">${count}</div>`,
    iconSize: [size, size], iconAnchor: [size / 2, size / 2], popupAnchor: [0, -size / 2],
  });
}

/** Clustering applies ONLY to the saved-stop display layer, never route geometry. */
function StopMarkerLayer({ points, selectedId, activeDayId, expandedDayIds, onSelect, onMove }: Pick<Props, "points" | "selectedId" | "activeDayId" | "expandedDayIds" | "onSelect" | "onMove">) {
  const map = useMap();
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(() => map.getZoom());
  const [spiderfied, setSpiderfied] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [openAfterSelection, setOpenAfterSelection] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useMapEvents({
    zoomend() { setZoom(map.getZoom()); setSpiderfied(null); },
    movestart() { setSpiderfied(null); },
  });
  const visibleStops = useMemo(() => displayStops(points), [points]);
  const byKey = useMemo(() => new Map(visibleStops.map(stop => [stop.key, stop])), [visibleStops]);
  // A selected stop always remains visible and on top of any nearby cluster.
  const selectedStop = visibleStops.find(stop => stop.members.some(({ point }) => point.id === selectedId));
  const clusters = useMemo(() => clusterProjectedStops(visibleStops
    .filter(stop => stop.key !== selectedStop?.key)
    .map(stop => {
      const projected = map.project([stop.lat, stop.lng], zoom);
      return { key: stop.key, x: projected.x, y: projected.y };
    }), 39), [visibleStops, selectedStop?.key, zoom, map]);
  const expanded = clusters.find(cluster => cluster.key === spiderfied && cluster.keys.length > 1);

  const selectStop = (id: string) => {
    setSpiderfied(null);
    setOpenAfterSelection(id);
    onSelect?.(id);
  };

  return <>
    {clusters.map(cluster => {
      if (cluster.keys.length === 1) {
        const stop = byKey.get(cluster.keys[0]);
        return stop && <StopMarker key={stop.key} stop={stop} selectedId={selectedId}
          activeDayId={activeDayId} expandedDayIds={expandedDayIds} onSelect={selectStop} onMove={onMove} />;
      }
      const center = map.unproject([cluster.x, cluster.y], zoom);
      if (expanded?.key === cluster.key) {
        return <Fragment key={cluster.key}>
          {cluster.keys.map((key, index) => {
            const stop = byKey.get(key);
            if (!stop) return null;
            const [offsetX, offsetY] = spiderfyOffset(index);
            const separated = map.unproject([cluster.x + offsetX, cluster.y + offsetY], zoom);
            const position: [number, number] = [separated.lat, separated.lng];
            return <Fragment key={key}>
              <Polyline interactive={false} positions={[[stop.lat, stop.lng], position]}
                pathOptions={{ color: "#64748b", weight: 1.5, opacity: 0.7, dashArray: "3 4" }} />
              <StopMarker stop={stop} position={position} spiderfied selectedId={selectedId}
                activeDayId={activeDayId} expandedDayIds={expandedDayIds} onSelect={selectStop}
                onMove={undefined} />
            </Fragment>;
          })}
        </Fragment>;
      }
      const count = cluster.keys.length;
      return <Marker key={cluster.key} position={[center.lat, center.lng]}
        icon={markerClusterIcon(count)} title={`${count} nearby stops. Click to ${zoom >= 16 ? "expand" : "zoom in"}.`}
        alt={`${count} nearby map stops`} keyboard bubblingMouseEvents={false}
        eventHandlers={{ click: () => {
          if (zoom >= 16 || zoom >= map.getMaxZoom()) {
            setSpiderfied(cluster.key);
          } else {
            map.flyTo([center.lat, center.lng], Math.min(zoom + 2, 16, map.getMaxZoom()), { duration: 0.3 });
          }
        } }} />;
    })}
    {selectedStop && <StopMarker key={`selected-${selectedStop.key}`} stop={selectedStop}
      selectedId={selectedId} activeDayId={activeDayId} expandedDayIds={expandedDayIds}
      onSelect={selectStop} onMove={onMove} autoOpen={openAfterSelection !== null && selectedStop.members.some(member => member.point.id === openAfterSelection)} />}
  </>;
}

export default function RouteMapInner({ points, fallback, onPick, onSelect, onMove, onInsert, onMoveVia, onRemoveVia, selectedId, activeDayId, expandedDayIds, editing = false, compact = false, profileDocked = false, hoverLocation, focus }: Props) {
  const [mapBlocked,setMapBlocked] = useState(false);
  const first = points[0] ? [points[0].lat,points[0].lng] : fallback;
  const external = first ? `https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=${first[0]}&mlon=${first[1]}#map=12/${first[0]}/${first[1]}` : "https://www.openstreetmap.org/";
  return <MapContainer center={fallback ?? [49.7, -123.1]} zoom={fallback ? 12 : 9} zoomControl={false} scrollWheelZoom={false} className={profileDocked ? "trailpicker-route-map relative z-0 h-[500px] w-full sm:h-[600px] xl:h-full" : compact ? "relative z-0 h-[480px] w-full sm:h-[580px] xl:h-[min(75vh,760px)]" : "relative z-0 h-[420px] w-full sm:h-[480px]"}>
    <TileLayer referrerPolicy="origin" eventHandlers={{tileerror:()=>setMapBlocked(true)}} url="https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png" attribution='&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors' />
    {mapBlocked && <div role="status" className="absolute inset-x-3 top-16 z-[1000] rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-white/95 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-700 shadow-md">Map tiles unavailable. Route stops are still listed in the itinerary. <a href={external} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="font-semibold text-green-900 underline">Open map externally</a></div>}
    <FocusSelectedDay points={points} activeDayId={activeDayId} />
    <Controls points={points} onPick={onPick} focus={focus} />
    <RefreshMapOnResize />
    <CtrlWheelZoom />
    <ZoomControl position="bottomleft" />
    <FitRoute points={points} fallback={fallback} />
    {points.slice(0, -1).map((point, i) => {
      const next = points[i + 1];
      if (isSharedOvernightStop(point, next)) return null;
      const via = point.viaToNext ?? [];
      const trail = usableTrailSegment(point, next);
      // Straight-line fallback still passes through the shaping waypoints.
      const path: LatLng[] = trail?.geometry ?? [[point.lat, point.lng], ...via, [next.lat, next.lng]];
      const insertions = onInsert && via.length < MAX_ROUTE_SHAPING_WAYPOINTS
        ? shapingInsertPositions(path, via) : [];
      return <Fragment key={`${point.id}-${next.id}`}>
      <Polyline key={trail ? "mapped" : "direct"} interactive={!!onInsert && via.length < MAX_ROUTE_SHAPING_WAYPOINTS}
        eventHandlers={onInsert && via.length < MAX_ROUTE_SHAPING_WAYPOINTS ? {
          click: event => {
            const clicked: LatLng = [event.latlng.lat, event.latlng.lng];
            onInsert(i, shapingInsertIndex(path, via, clicked), clicked[0], clicked[1]);
          },
        } : undefined}
        bubblingMouseEvents={false}
        positions={path}
        pathOptions={routeLegStyle({
          mapped: !!trail,
          editing,
          activeDayId,
          expandedDayIds,
          startDayId: point.kind === "camp" && next.kind !== "trailhead" && point.dayId !== next.dayId ? next.dayId : point.dayId,
          endDayId: next.dayId,
        })} />
      {insertions.map((position, viaIndex) => (
        <Marker
          key={`insert-${point.id}-${viaIndex}`}
          position={position}
          icon={insertWaypointIcon}
          title={`Add route-shaping waypoint ${viaIndex + 1} between ${point.name} and ${next.name}`}
          alt="Add route-shaping waypoint"
          keyboard
          bubblingMouseEvents={false}
          eventHandlers={{ click: () => onInsert?.(i, viaIndex, position[0], position[1]) }}
        >
          <Tooltip direction="top" offset={[0, -16]}>Add route-shaping waypoint</Tooltip>
        </Marker>
      ))}
      {onMoveVia && via.map((position, viaIndex) => (
        <Marker
          key={`via-${point.id}-${viaIndex}`}
          position={position}
          icon={shapingWaypointIcon}
          title={`Route shaping waypoint ${viaIndex + 1}`}
          alt="Route-shaping waypoint; drag to change route"
          keyboard
          draggable
          bubblingMouseEvents={false}
          eventHandlers={{
            dragend: event => {
              const location = (event.target as LeafletMarker).getLatLng();
              onMoveVia(point.id, viaIndex, location.lat, location.lng);
            },
          }}
        >
          <Popup>
            <strong>Route-shaping waypoint {viaIndex + 1}</strong>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs">Drag the blue diamond to guide the hiking route. Not a saved stop.</p>
            {onRemoveVia && <button type="button" className="mt-2 rounded bg-red-50 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-red-800" onClick={() => onRemoveVia(point.id, viaIndex)}>Remove waypoint</button>}
          </Popup>
        </Marker>
      ))}
      {trail && metersBetween([point.lat, point.lng], trail.geometry[0]) > 3 &&
        <Polyline interactive={false} positions={[[point.lat, point.lng], trail.geometry[0]]}
          pathOptions={{ color: "#d97706", weight: 2, dashArray: "3 5", opacity: 0.9 }} />}
      {trail && metersBetween([next.lat, next.lng], trail.geometry[trail.geometry.length - 1]) > 3 &&
        <Polyline interactive={false} positions={[trail.geometry[trail.geometry.length - 1], [next.lat, next.lng]]}
          pathOptions={{ color: "#d97706", weight: 2, dashArray: "3 5", opacity: 0.9 }} />}
      </Fragment>;
    })}
    {hoverLocation && <CircleMarker center={hoverLocation} radius={6} interactive={false}
      pathOptions={{ color: "#ffffff", weight: 2.5, fillColor: "#14532d", fillOpacity: 1, opacity: 1 }} />}
    <StopMarkerLayer points={points} selectedId={selectedId} activeDayId={activeDayId} expandedDayIds={expandedDayIds} onSelect={onSelect} onMove={onMove} />
    {!points.length && fallback && <Marker position={fallback} icon={divIcon({ html: waypointMarkerHtml("waypoint", 1, false, 32), className: "trailpicker-stop-icon", iconSize: [32, 32], iconAnchor: [16, 16] })} title="Trip location"><Popup>Trip location · add your first route stop here or explore the map.</Popup></Marker>}
  </MapContainer>;
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useId, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type PointerEvent } from "react";
import type { PlannerDay, Waypoint } from "@/lib/trip-planner";
import { gradeAtDistance, locationAtDistance, type ExplorerRoute, type ExplorerSample } from "@/lib/route-explorer";
import { buildTerrainStrokes, preserveProfileExtrema, terrainStrokeColor } from "@/lib/route-profile-visual";
import { analyzeTerrain } from "@/lib/route-analysis-insights";

const LEFT = 55;
const RIGHT = 9;
const TOP = 11;
const BOTTOM = 8;

const fmtDistance = (meters: number) => `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(2)} km`;

function profilePath(samples: readonly ExplorerSample[], x: (d: number) => number, y: (h: number) => number): string {
  return samples.map((p, i) => `${i ? "L" : "M"}${x(p.distanceM).toFixed(1)} ${y(p.elevationM).toFixed(1)}`).join(" ");
}

export default function RouteProfileDock({
  route, days, points, activeDayId, selectedId, hover, onHover, onDayChange, profileMode, onProfileModeChange, focusedRange,
}: {
  route: ExplorerRoute;
  days: readonly PlannerDay[];
  points: readonly Waypoint[];
  activeDayId: string | null;
  selectedId: string | null;
  hover: ExplorerSample | null;
  onHover: (value: ExplorerSample | null) => void;
  onDayChange: (dayId: string | null) => void;
  profileMode: "elevation" | "gradient";
  onProfileModeChange: (mode: "elevation" | "gradient") => void;
  focusedRange?: { startM: number; endM: number } | null;
}) {
  const gradientId = useId().replace(/:/g, "");
  // Reuse the same 200 m sampled terrain classification as Route Analysis.
  // Sparse sections are left unclassified rather than invented or interpolated.
  const terrain = useMemo(() => analyzeTerrain(
    route.sections.map(section => section.samples),
    route.sections.map(section => section.dayId),
  ), [route]);
  const terrainStrokes = useMemo(() => buildTerrainStrokes(
    route.sections.map(section => section.samples), terrain.cells,
  ), [route, terrain]);
  const visibleTerrainCells = useMemo(() => activeDayId
    ? terrain.cells.filter(cell => cell.dayId === activeDayId)
    : terrain.cells, [terrain, activeDayId]);
  const steepDistanceM = visibleTerrainCells.reduce((meters, cell) =>
    meters + (cell.band === "steep" ? cell.endM - cell.startM : 0), 0);
  const plot = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  // No guessed 680px SVG on first paint. Measure the actual chart before
  // drawing it, so hydration and drawer resizing never cause a stretched flash.
  const [dimensions, setDimensions] = useState<{ width: number; height: number } | null>(null);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const element = plot.current;
    if (!element) return;
    const measure = (width: number, height: number) => {
      const next = { width: Math.max(80, Math.round(width)), height: Math.max(65, Math.round(height)) };
      setDimensions(previous => previous?.width === next.width && previous?.height === next.height ? previous : next);
    };
    // Synchronous layout measurement occurs before the browser paints the graph.
    const box = element.getBoundingClientRect();
    measure(box.width, box.height);
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") return;
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => measure(entry.contentRect.width, entry.contentRect.height));
    observer.observe(element);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [route.sections.length]);
  const width = dimensions?.width ?? 0;
  const height = dimensions?.height ?? 0;
  const graphWidth = Math.max(1, width - LEFT - RIGHT);
  const graphHeight = Math.max(1, height - TOP - BOTTOM);
  const { min, max, hasHeights } = useMemo(() => {
    let min = Infinity, max = -Infinity;
    for (const section of route.sections) for (const sample of section.samples) {
      min = Math.min(min, sample.elevationM);
      max = Math.max(max, sample.elevationM);
    }
    return { min: Number.isFinite(min) ? min : 0, max: Number.isFinite(max) ? max : 0, hasHeights: Number.isFinite(min) };
  }, [route]);
  // Label actual altitude in metres, with sensible round intervals in between.
  // The extra chart inset keeps labels inside the SVG when the profile is resized.
  const elevationTicks = useMemo(() => {
    if (!hasHeights) return [];
    if (max - min < 2) return [Math.round(min)];
    const range = max - min;
    const targetStep = range / 3;
    const scale = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(targetStep));
    const step = ([1, 2, 5, 10].find(n => n * scale >= targetStep) ?? 10) * scale;
    const ticks = [Math.round(min)];
    for (let altitude = Math.ceil(min / step) * step; altitude < max; altitude += step) {
      if (altitude > min + step * 0.08 && altitude < max - step * 0.08) ticks.push(altitude);
    }
    ticks.push(Math.round(max));
    return Array.from(new Set(ticks));
  }, [min, max, hasHeights]);
  const padding = Math.max(25, (max - min) * 0.08);
  const low = min - padding;
  const high = max + padding;
  const x = (distanceM: number) => LEFT + distanceM / Math.max(route.distanceM, 1) * graphWidth;
  const y = (heightM: number) => TOP + (high - heightM) / Math.max(high - low, 1) * graphHeight;
  const selectedStop = points.find(point => point.id === selectedId);
  const selectedDistance = selectedStop ? route.stopDistances[selectedStop.id] : undefined;
  const selectedPosition = selectedDistance === undefined ? null : locationAtDistance(route, selectedDistance);
  const inspection = hover ?? selectedPosition;
  const gradeCell = inspection && profileMode === "gradient"
    ? terrain.cells.find(cell => inspection.distanceM >= cell.startM && inspection.distanceM < cell.endM)
    : null;
  const grade = profileMode === "gradient" ? gradeCell?.gradePct ?? null : inspection ? gradeAtDistance(route, inspection.distanceM) : null;
  const stopMarkers = points.filter(point => point.kind === "camp" || point.kind === "water").slice(0, 36);

  function inspectDistance(distanceM: number) {
    const position = locationAtDistance(route, Math.max(0, Math.min(route.distanceM, distanceM)));
    onHover(position);
  }

  function move(event: PointerEvent<SVGSVGElement>) {
    const bounds = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const fractionalX = (event.clientX - bounds.left) / bounds.width * width;
    inspectDistance((fractionalX - LEFT) / graphWidth * route.distanceM);
  }

  function keyDown(event: KeyboardEvent<SVGSVGElement>) {
    if (!(["ArrowRight", "ArrowLeft", "Home", "End"] as string[]).includes(event.key)) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const current = hover?.distanceM ?? selectedDistance ?? 0;
    const next = event.key === "Home" ? 0 : event.key === "End" ? route.distanceM :
      current + (event.key === "ArrowRight" ? 100 : -100);
    inspectDistance(next);
  }

  return <div id="route-elevation-profile" className="flex h-full min-h-0 min-w-0 flex-col border-t border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 pb-1 pt-2.5 sm:px-4" aria-label="Map-linked elevation profile">
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-2">
      <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-900">Elevation profile</span>
        {hasHeights && <span className="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-gray-500">{Math.round(min).toLocaleString()}–{Math.round(max).toLocaleString()} m</span>}
      </div>
      <div className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 p-0.5" role="group" aria-label="Elevation profile display mode">
        {(["elevation", "gradient"] as const).map(mode => <button key={mode} type="button"
          aria-pressed={profileMode === mode} onClick={() => onProfileModeChange(mode)}
          className={`rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-green-700 ${profileMode === mode ? "bg-white text-green-900 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-gray-200" : "text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-900"}`}>
          {mode === "elevation" ? "Elevation" : "Gradient"}
        </button>)}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-1.5">
      <div className="flex max-w-full min-w-0 items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto" role="group" aria-label="Highlight a hiking day">
        <button type="button" aria-pressed={!activeDayId} onClick={() => onDayChange(null)} className={`whitespace-nowrap rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold ${!activeDayId ? "bg-green-900 text-white" : "bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-200"}`}>Full route</button>
        {days.map((day, index) => <button type="button" key={day.id} aria-pressed={activeDayId === day.id} onClick={() => onDayChange(activeDayId === day.id ? null : day.id)} className={`whitespace-nowrap rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold ${activeDayId === day.id ? "bg-green-900 text-white" : "bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-200"}`}>Day {index + 1}</button>)}
      </div>
      {inspection ? <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 text-[11px] tabular-nums text-gray-700" role="status" aria-live="off">
        <span><strong className="font-semibold text-gray-950">{fmtDistance(inspection.distanceM)}</strong> from start</span>
        <span><strong className="font-semibold text-gray-950">{Math.round(inspection.elevationM).toLocaleString()} m</strong> altitude</span>
        {grade !== null && <span><strong className="font-semibold text-gray-950">{grade > 0 ? "+" : ""}{grade.toFixed(1)}%</strong> {profileMode === "gradient" && gradeCell ? "200 m grade" : "grade"}</span>}
      </div> : <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">Hover to inspect the mapped trail</span>}
    </div>
    {profileMode === "gradient" && <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[10px] text-gray-600" aria-label="Gradient legend">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
        {([ ["gentle", "Gentle <5%"], ["moderate", "Moderate 5–12%"], ["steep", "Steep ≥12%"] ] as const).map(([band, label]) => <span key={band} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: terrainStrokeColor(band) }} aria-hidden="true" />{label}</span>)}
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="h-0.5 w-3 bg-slate-400" aria-hidden="true" />Unclassified</span>
      </div>
      <span className="tabular-nums">{visibleTerrainCells.length ? `${fmtDistance(steepDistanceM)} steep · 200 m estimates` : "No reliable slope windows"}</span>
    </div>}
    {route.sections.length ? <>
      <div ref={plot} className="mx-auto mt-1 min-h-[70px] w-full max-w-[900px] flex-1 overflow-hidden">
      {/* A data plot has independently scaled distance/elevation axes. "meet"
          letterboxes the plot whenever ResizeObserver sees a transient panel size,
          making a narrow graph flash before the final dimensions arrive. */}
      {dimensions && <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`} preserveAspectRatio="none" className="block h-full w-full cursor-crosshair" role="slider" tabIndex={0}
        aria-label={`${profileMode === "gradient" ? "Gradient-colored elevation" : "Elevation"} along mapped route. Use left and right arrows to inspect in 100-metre steps.`}
        aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={Math.round(route.distanceM)} aria-valuenow={Math.round(inspection?.distanceM ?? 0)}
        aria-valuetext={inspection ? `${fmtDistance(inspection.distanceM)}, altitude ${Math.round(inspection.elevationM)} metres${grade !== null ? `, ${grade.toFixed(1)} percent grade` : ""}${profileMode === "gradient" ? `, ${gradeCell?.band ?? "unclassified"} terrain` : ""}` : "No location selected"}
        onPointerMove={move} onPointerLeave={() => onHover(null)} onBlur={() => onHover(null)} onKeyDown={keyDown}>
        <defs><linearGradient id={gradientId} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stopColor="#15803d" stopOpacity="0.19"/><stop offset="1" stopColor="#15803d" stopOpacity="0.01"/></linearGradient></defs>
        {elevationTicks.map((tick) => <g key={`elevation-${tick}`} aria-hidden="true">
          <line x1={LEFT} x2={width - RIGHT} y1={y(tick)} y2={y(tick)} stroke="#cbd5e1" strokeOpacity="0.56" strokeWidth="0.8" strokeDasharray="3 6" />
          <text x={LEFT - 9} y={y(tick) + 3.5} textAnchor="end" fontSize="10.5" fill="#64748b">{tick.toLocaleString()} m</text>
        </g>)}
        {focusedRange && focusedRange.endM > focusedRange.startM && <g aria-hidden="true">
          <rect x={x(focusedRange.startM)} y={TOP} width={Math.max(0, x(focusedRange.endM) - x(focusedRange.startM))} height={graphHeight} fill="#f59e0b" fillOpacity="0.09" />
          {[focusedRange.startM, focusedRange.endM].map(distanceM => <line key={distanceM} x1={x(distanceM)} x2={x(distanceM)} y1={TOP} y2={TOP + graphHeight} stroke="#b45309" strokeWidth="1" strokeDasharray="3 4" opacity="0.75" />)}
        </g>}
        {route.sections.map((section, i) => {
          const compact = preserveProfileExtrema(section.samples, Math.max(90, Math.floor(550 / route.sections.length)));
          const line = profilePath(compact as ExplorerSample[], x, y);
          const baseline = TOP + graphHeight;
          const included = !activeDayId || activeDayId === section.dayId;
          return <g key={i} opacity={included ? 1 : 0.16}>
            <path d={`${line} L${x(compact[compact.length - 1].distanceM).toFixed(1)} ${baseline} L${x(compact[0].distanceM).toFixed(1)} ${baseline} Z`} fill={`url(#${gradientId})`} />
            <path d={line} fill="none" stroke={profileMode === "gradient" ? "#94a3b8" : "#166534"} strokeWidth={included ? 2.35 : 1.6} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" />
          </g>;
        })}
        {profileMode === "gradient" && terrainStrokes.map((stroke, index) => <path key={`grade-${index}`}
          d={profilePath(stroke.points, x, y)} fill="none" stroke={terrainStrokeColor(stroke.band)}
          strokeWidth="3" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke"
          opacity={!activeDayId || activeDayId === stroke.dayId ? 1 : 0.16} />)}
        {stopMarkers.map((stop) => {
          const distance = route.stopDistances[stop.id];
          if (!Number.isFinite(distance)) return null;
          const position = locationAtDistance(route, distance);
          if (!position) return null;
          return <circle key={stop.id} cx={x(distance)} cy={y(position.elevationM)} r={stop.id === selectedId ? 4.5 : 2.6} fill={stop.kind === "camp" ? "#a16207" : "#0369a1"} stroke="white" strokeWidth="1.5"><title>{stop.name}</title></circle>;
        })}
        {inspection && <g aria-hidden="true">
          <line x1={x(inspection.distanceM)} y1={TOP} x2={x(inspection.distanceM)} y2={TOP + graphHeight} stroke="#64748b" strokeWidth="1" strokeDasharray="3 4" opacity="0.65" />
          <circle cx={x(inspection.distanceM)} cy={y(inspection.elevationM)} r="4.5" fill="white" stroke={profileMode === "gradient" && gradeCell ? terrainStrokeColor(gradeCell.band) : "#166534"} strokeWidth="2.4" />
        </g>}
        <line x1={LEFT} x2={width-RIGHT} y1={TOP+graphHeight} y2={TOP+graphHeight} stroke="#d1d5db" strokeWidth="0.8" />
      </svg>}
      </div>
      <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[900px] shrink-0 items-center justify-between text-[11px] tabular-nums text-gray-500" style={{ paddingLeft: LEFT, paddingRight: RIGHT }}>
        <span>0 km</span><span>{fmtDistance(route.distanceM)}</span>
      </div>
    </> : <div className="flex min-h-20 items-center justify-between gap-3 py-2 text-xs text-gray-500">
      <span>{route.distanceM > 0 ? "Elevation unavailable for the mapped route. The map and itinerary still work." : "Add a mapped route with elevation data to inspect the profile."}</span>
    </div>}
  </div>;
}
```

### `components/builder/TripPlanner/StopSelectPicker.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useId, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { Check, ChevronDown } from "lucide-react";

type StopOption = { value: string; label: string; detail?: string; icon?: ReactNode };
type Position = { top: number; left: number; width: number; maxHeight: number };

type Props = {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  options: readonly StopOption[];
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  hideLabel?: boolean;
  placeholder?: string;
  variant?: "default" | "action" | "analysis";
};

const FOCUS_RING = "focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-green-700 focus-visible:ring-offset-2";

/** Shared popover selector for stop fields and forecast locations. */
export default function StopSelectPicker({ label, value, options, onChange, disabled = false, hideLabel = false, placeholder = "Select…", variant = "default" }: Props) {
  const id = useId();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [position, setPosition] = useState<Position>({ top: 0, left: 0, width: 220, maxHeight: 320 });
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const optionRefs = useRef<Array<HTMLButtonElement | null>>([]);
  const selected = options.find(option => option.value === value);
  const selectedIndex = Math.max(0, options.findIndex(option => option.value === value));
  const triggerStyle = variant === "action"
    ? "border-green-200 bg-green-50 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-green-900 hover:border-green-400 hover:bg-green-100"
    : variant === "analysis"
      ? "min-h-10 border-green-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-green-950 hover:border-green-400 hover:bg-green-50"
      : "border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-900 hover:border-gray-300";

  function getPosition(height = 300): Position {
    const rect = triggerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const margin = 12;
    const width = Math.min(Math.max(rect?.width ?? 220, 180), window.innerWidth - 2 * margin);
    if (!rect) return { top: margin, left: margin, width, maxHeight: height };
    const below = window.innerHeight - rect.bottom - margin;
    const above = rect.top - margin;
    const flip = below < height + 8 && above > below;
    const available = flip ? above - 8 : below - 8;
    const maxHeight = Math.min(height, Math.max(120, available));
    const top = flip ? Math.max(margin, rect.top - maxHeight - 6)
      : Math.max(margin, Math.min(rect.bottom + 6, window.innerHeight - margin - maxHeight));
    const left = Math.max(margin, Math.min(rect.left, window.innerWidth - margin - width));
    return { top, left, width, maxHeight };
  }

  function close(restoreFocus = true) {
    setOpen(false);
    if (restoreFocus) triggerRef.current?.focus();
  }

  function show() {
    if (disabled || options.length === 0) return;
    setPosition(getPosition(Math.min(320, options.length * 60 + 16)));
    setOpen(true);
  }

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    optionRefs.current[selectedIndex]?.focus();
    const update = () => {
      const height = Math.min(320, options.length * 60 + 16);
      const next = getPosition(height);
      setPosition(old => old.top === next.top && old.left === next.left && old.width === next.width && old.maxHeight === next.maxHeight ? old : next);
    };
    function outside(event: PointerEvent) {
      const target = event.target;
      if (target instanceof Node && !panelRef.current?.contains(target) && !triggerRef.current?.contains(target)) close(false);
    }
    window.addEventListener("scroll", update, true);
    window.addEventListener("resize", update);
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", outside);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", update, true);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", update);
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", outside);
    };
  }, [open, options.length, selectedIndex]);

  function choose(next: string) {
    if (next !== value) onChange(next);
    close();
  }

  function onOptionKey(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, index: number) {
    let target: number;
    if (event.key === "ArrowDown") target = (index + 1) % options.length;
    else if (event.key === "ArrowUp") target = (index - 1 + options.length) % options.length;
    else if (event.key === "Home") target = 0;
    else if (event.key === "End") target = options.length - 1;
    else if (event.key === "Escape") { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); close(); return; }
    else if (event.key === "Tab") { close(false); return; }
    else return;
    event.preventDefault();
    optionRefs.current[target]?.focus();
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-w-0">
      <span className={hideLabel ? "sr-only" : "block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600"}>{label}</span>
      <button
        ref={triggerRef}
        type="button"
        disabled={disabled}
        aria-label={label}
        aria-haspopup="listbox"
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={open ? id : undefined}
        onClick={() => open ? close() : show()}
        onKeyDown={event => {
          if (!open && ["ArrowDown", "ArrowUp", "Enter", " "].includes(event.key)) {
            event.preventDefault();
            show();
          }
        }}
        className={`${hideLabel ? "" : "mt-1 "}flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg border text-left disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 ${triggerStyle} ${FOCUS_RING}`}
      >
        <span className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
          {selected?.icon && <span className="shrink-0" aria-hidden="true">{selected.icon}</span>}
          <span className="min-w-0"><span className="block truncate">{selected?.label ?? placeholder}</span>{selected?.detail && <span className="block truncate text-[11px] font-normal text-gray-500">{selected.detail}</span>}</span>
        </span>
        <ChevronDown className={`h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-gray-500 transition-transform ${open ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} aria-hidden="true" />
      </button>
      {open && typeof document !== "undefined" && createPortal(
        <div
          ref={panelRef}
          id={id}
          role="listbox"
          aria-label={label}
          style={{ position: "fixed", ...position, overflowY: "auto" }}
          className="z-[999] rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-1 shadow-[0_16px_48px_-12px_rgba(15,23,42,0.25)]"
          onKeyDown={event => {
            if (event.key === "Escape") { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); close(); }
          }}
        >
          {options.map((option, index) => (
            <button
              key={option.value}
              ref={element => { optionRefs.current[index] = element; }}
              type="button"
              role="option"
              aria-selected={option.value === value}
              onKeyDown={event => onOptionKey(event, index)}
              onClick={() => choose(option.value)}
              className={`flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-left text-sm ${FOCUS_RING} ${option.value === value ? "bg-green-50 font-semibold text-green-900" : "text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50"}`}
            >
              {option.icon && <span className="shrink-0" aria-hidden="true">{option.icon}</span>}
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1"><span className="block truncate">{option.label}</span>{option.detail && <span className="block truncate text-[11px] font-normal text-gray-500">{option.detail}</span>}</span>
              {option.value === value && <Check className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-green-700" aria-hidden="true" />}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>, document.body
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `components/builder/TripPlanner/StopTimePicker.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useId, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { Clock3, X } from "lucide-react";

type Period = "AM" | "PM";
type Selection = { hour: number; minute: number; period: Period };
type Position = { top: number; left: number; width: number; maxHeight: number };

type Props = {
  label: string;
  value?: string | null; // Saved itinerary format: local HH:mm (24-hour)
  onChange: (value: string | null) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
};

const HOURS = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, index) => index + 1);
const MINUTES = Array.from({ length: 60 }, (_, index) => index);
const PERIODS: Period[] = ["AM", "PM"];
const FOCUS_RING = "focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-green-700 focus-visible:ring-offset-2";

function parseTime(value?: string | null): Selection | null {
  const match = /^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/.exec(value ?? "");
  if (!match) return null;
  const hours = Number(match[1]);
  const minute = Number(match[2]);
  if (hours > 23 || minute > 59) return null;
  return { hour: hours % 12 || 12, minute, period: hours >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM" };
}

function timeLabel(selection: Selection) {
  return `${selection.hour}:${String(selection.minute).padStart(2, "0")} ${selection.period}`;
}

function timeValue(selection: Selection) {
  const hours = (selection.hour % 12) + (selection.period === "PM" ? 12 : 0);
  return `${String(hours).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(selection.minute).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

export default function StopTimePicker({ label, value, onChange, disabled = false }: Props) {
  const id = useId();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Selection>({ hour: 8, minute: 0, period: "AM" });
  const [position, setPosition] = useState<Position>({ top: 0, left: 0, width: 320, maxHeight: 340 });
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const hoursRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const minutesRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const periodRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const chosen = parseTime(value);
  const title = label.replace(/\s*\(optional\)$/i, "");

  function getPosition(panelHeight = 336): Position {
    const rect = triggerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const margin = 12;
    const width = Math.min(320, Math.max(0, window.innerWidth - margin * 2));
    if (!rect) return { top: margin, left: margin, width, maxHeight: panelHeight };
    const below = window.innerHeight - rect.bottom - margin;
    const above = rect.top - margin;
    const flip = below < panelHeight + 8 && above > below;
    const available = flip ? above - 8 : below - 8;
    const maxHeight = Math.min(panelHeight, Math.max(150, available));
    const top = flip ? Math.max(margin, rect.top - maxHeight - 8)
      : Math.max(margin, Math.min(rect.bottom + 8, window.innerHeight - margin - maxHeight));
    const left = Math.max(margin, Math.min(rect.left, window.innerWidth - margin - width));
    return { top, left, width, maxHeight };
  }

  function close() {
    setOpen(false);
    triggerRef.current?.focus();
  }

  function show() {
    if (disabled) return;
    setDraft(chosen ?? { hour: 8, minute: 0, period: "AM" });
    setPosition(getPosition());
    setOpen(true);
  }

  // Unlike an in-flow dropdown, this stays in view inside the scrollable itinerary sidebar.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const panel = panelRef.current;
    panel?.focus();
    const scrollToSelected = (container: HTMLDivElement | null) => {
      if (!container) return;
      const selected = container.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('[aria-pressed="true"]');
      if (selected) container.scrollTop = selected.offsetTop - container.offsetTop - container.clientHeight / 2 + selected.offsetHeight / 2;
    };
    scrollToSelected(hoursRef.current);
    scrollToSelected(minutesRef.current);
    scrollToSelected(periodRef.current);
    const update = () => {
      const height = panelRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect().height ?? 336;
      setPosition((old) => {
        const next = getPosition(height);
        return old.top === next.top && old.left === next.left && old.width === next.width && old.maxHeight === next.maxHeight ? old : next;
      });
    };
    const frame = requestAnimationFrame(update);
    function outside(event: PointerEvent) {
      const node = event.target;
      if (node instanceof Node && !panelRef.current?.contains(node) && !triggerRef.current?.contains(node)) setOpen(false);
    }
    window.addEventListener("resize", update);
    window.addEventListener("scroll", update, true);
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", outside);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", update);
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", update, true);
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", outside);
    };
  }, [open]);

  function moveOption(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>, values: readonly number[] | readonly Period[], current: number, select: (index: number) => void) {
    const key = event.key;
    if (!["ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", "Home", "End"].includes(key)) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const next = key === "Home" ? 0 : key === "End" ? values.length - 1
      : (current + (key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : -1) + values.length) % values.length;
    select(next);
    const options = event.currentTarget.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>("button[data-time-option]");
    options[next]?.focus();
  }

  function commit() {
    onChange(timeValue(draft));
    close();
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-w-0">
      <span className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600">{label}</span>
      <button
        ref={triggerRef}
        type="button"
        disabled={disabled}
        aria-label={label}
        aria-haspopup="dialog"
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={open ? id : undefined}
        onClick={() => open ? close() : show()}
        className={`mt-1 flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm text-gray-900 hover:border-gray-300 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 ${FOCUS_RING}`}
      >
        <span className={chosen ? "tabular-nums" : "text-gray-400"}>{chosen ? timeLabel(chosen) : "Add time"}</span>
        <Clock3 className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-gray-500" aria-hidden="true" />
      </button>
      {open && typeof document !== "undefined" && createPortal(
        <div
          ref={panelRef}
          id={id}
          role="dialog"
          aria-label={`Set ${title.toLowerCase()}`}
          tabIndex={-1}
          style={{ position: "fixed", ...position, overflowY: "auto" }}
          className="z-[999] rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 text-slate-900 shadow-[0_16px_48px_-12px_rgba(15,23,42,0.25)]"
          onKeyDown={(event) => {
            if (event.key === "Escape") { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); close(); }
            if (event.key === "Tab") {
              const buttons = Array.from(panelRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('button:not([tabindex="-1"]):not(:disabled)') ?? []);
              const first = buttons[0];
              const last = buttons[buttons.length - 1];
              if (event.shiftKey && (document.activeElement === first || document.activeElement === panelRef.current)) { event.preventDefault(); last?.focus(); }
              else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { event.preventDefault(); first?.focus(); }
            }
          }}
        >
          <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">Set {title.toLowerCase()}</h3>
            <button type="button" onClick={close} aria-label="Close time picker" className={`rounded-full p-1.5 text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-100 ${FOCUS_RING}`}><X className="h-4 w-4" /></button>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_72px] gap-2">
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <div className="mb-1 text-center text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">Hour</div>
              <div ref={hoursRef} aria-label="Hour" className="h-44 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/40 p-1" onKeyDown={(event) => moveOption(event, HOURS, draft.hour - 1, (index) => setDraft((old) => ({ ...old, hour: HOURS[index] })))}>
                {HOURS.map((hour) => <button key={hour} data-time-option type="button" tabIndex={draft.hour === hour ? 0 : -1} aria-pressed={draft.hour === hour}
                  onClick={() => setDraft((old) => ({ ...old, hour }))}
                  className={`block w-full rounded-md py-2 text-center text-sm tabular-nums ${FOCUS_RING} ${draft.hour === hour ? "bg-green-800 font-semibold text-white" : "text-slate-700 hover:bg-green-50"}`}>
                  {String(hour).padStart(2, "0")}
                </button>)}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <div className="mb-1 text-center text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">Minute</div>
              <div ref={minutesRef} aria-label="Minute" className="h-44 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/40 p-1" onKeyDown={(event) => moveOption(event, MINUTES, draft.minute, (index) => setDraft((old) => ({ ...old, minute: MINUTES[index] })))}>
                {MINUTES.map((minute) => <button key={minute} data-time-option type="button" tabIndex={draft.minute === minute ? 0 : -1} aria-pressed={draft.minute === minute}
                  onClick={() => setDraft((old) => ({ ...old, minute }))}
                  className={`block w-full rounded-md py-2 text-center text-sm tabular-nums ${FOCUS_RING} ${draft.minute === minute ? "bg-green-800 font-semibold text-white" : "text-slate-700 hover:bg-green-50"}`}>
                  {String(minute).padStart(2, "0")}
                </button>)}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="mb-1 text-center text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">Period</div>
              <div ref={periodRef} aria-label="AM or PM" className="flex flex-col gap-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/40 p-1" onKeyDown={(event) => moveOption(event, PERIODS, PERIODS.indexOf(draft.period), (index) => setDraft((old) => ({ ...old, period: PERIODS[index] })))}>
                {PERIODS.map((period) => <button key={period} data-time-option type="button" tabIndex={draft.period === period ? 0 : -1} aria-pressed={draft.period === period}
                  onClick={() => setDraft((old) => ({ ...old, period }))}
                  className={`rounded-md py-2 text-center text-sm ${FOCUS_RING} ${draft.period === period ? "bg-green-800 font-semibold text-white" : "text-slate-700 hover:bg-green-50"}`}>
                  {period}
                </button>)}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-slate-100 pt-3">
            {chosen ? <button type="button" onClick={() => { onChange(null); close(); }} className={`rounded-md px-2 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900 ${FOCUS_RING}`}>Clear time</button> : <span />}
            <button type="button" onClick={commit} className={`rounded-lg bg-green-800 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-green-900 ${FOCUS_RING}`}>Done</button>
          </div>
        </div>, document.body
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
