### `components/builder/TripPlanner/TripEditForm.tsx`

```typescript

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { ArrowLeft, Check, MapPin, Pencil, X } from "lucide-react";
import DestinationPicker from "@/components/build/DestinationPicker";
import DateRangePicker from "@/components/build/DateRangePicker";
import { updateTripDetails } from "@/lib/tracked-build-actions";
import { useBuildAutosave } from "@/lib/use-build-autosave";

type DestinationSelection = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  lat: string;
  lng: string;
};

type Props = {
  build: {
    id: string;
    destinationId?: string | null;
    location: string | null;
    locationLat: number | null;
    locationLng: number | null;
    startDate: Date | null;
    endDate: Date | null;
    people: number;
    minTemperature: number | null;
    conditions: string | null;
    days?: { date: Date }[];
  };
  onSaved: () => void;
  onCancel?: () => void;
};

const inputClass =
  "w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-gray-900 outline-none transition focus:border-green-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-700/10";

const labelClass =
  "mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700";

const secondaryButton =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3.5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-800 transition hover:border-green-300 hover:bg-green-50 hover:text-green-900 disabled:opacity-50";

const primaryButton =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-green-900 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-green-800 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50";

function iso(date: Date | null | undefined) {
  return date ? new Date(date).toISOString().slice(0, 10) : "";
}

export default function TripEditForm({
  build,
  onSaved,
  onCancel,
}: Props) {
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [pickerError, setPickerError] = useState("");
  const [choosingDestination, setChoosingDestination] =
    useState(false);
  const [pickerSession, setPickerSession] = useState(0);
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const pickerRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);

  const [destination, setDestination] =
    useState<DestinationSelection>(() => ({
      id: build.destinationId ?? "",
      name: build.location ?? "",
      lat:
        build.locationLat == null
          ? ""
          : String(build.locationLat),
      lng:
        build.locationLng == null
          ? ""
          : String(build.locationLng),
    }));

  const [willRemoveDays, setWillRemoveDays] = useState(false);

  const originalStart = iso(build.startDate);
  const originalEnd = iso(build.endDate);

  const autosave = useBuildAutosave({
    buildId: build.id,
    resource: "trip-details",
    save: updateTripDetails,
    onError: setError,
    canAutosave: (data) =>
      String(data.get("startDate") ?? "") === originalStart &&
      String(data.get("endDate") ?? "") === originalEnd,
  });
  const { formRef } = autosave;

  // Watch the hidden date inputs from DateRangePicker.
  // Show confirmation only if existing itinerary days
  // would actually be removed.
  useEffect(() => {
    const form = formRef.current;
    if (!form) return;

    function checkDateRange() {
      if (!form) return;

      const data = new FormData(form);
      const start = String(data.get("startDate") ?? "");
      const end = String(data.get("endDate") ?? "");

      const datesChanged =
        start !== originalStart || end !== originalEnd;

      const removesDays =
        datesChanged &&
        (build.days ?? []).some((day) => {
          const date = iso(day.date);
          return !start || !end || date < start || date > end;
        });

      setWillRemoveDays((previous) =>
        previous === removesDays ? previous : removesDays
      );
    }

    const observer = new MutationObserver(checkDateRange);

    observer.observe(form, {
      subtree: true,
      attributes: true,
      attributeFilter: ["value"],
    });

    form.addEventListener("input", checkDateRange);
    form.addEventListener("change", checkDateRange);

    checkDateRange();

    return () => {
      observer.disconnect();
      form.removeEventListener("input", checkDateRange);
      form.removeEventListener("change", checkDateRange);
    };
  }, [formRef, build.days, originalStart, originalEnd]);

  function openDestinationPicker() {
    setPickerError("");
    setPickerSession((current) => current + 1);
    setChoosingDestination(true);
  }

  function confirmDestination() {
    if (!pickerRef.current) return;

    const values = new FormData(pickerRef.current);

    const next: DestinationSelection = {
      id: String(
        values.get("candidateDestinationId") ?? ""
      ).trim(),
      name: String(
        values.get("candidateLocation") ?? ""
      ).trim(),
      lat: String(values.get("candidateLat") ?? "").trim(),
      lng: String(values.get("candidateLng") ?? "").trim(),
    };

    if (!next.name) {
      setPickerError(
        "Choose a destination or select a custom location first."
      );
      return;
    }

    if (
      (next.lat === "") !== (next.lng === "") ||
      (next.lat !== "" &&
        (!Number.isFinite(Number(next.lat)) ||
          !Number.isFinite(Number(next.lng)) ||
          Math.abs(Number(next.lat)) > 90 ||
          Math.abs(Number(next.lng)) > 180))
    ) {
      setPickerError(
        "Choose a location with valid coordinates."
      );
      return;
    }

    autosave.markUserEdit();
    // Only confirming updates the actual trip form.
    // Browsing and cancelling do not change its location.
    setDestination(next);
    setChoosingDestination(false);
    setPickerError("");
    setError("");
  }

  function handleSubmit(formData: FormData) {
    if (choosingDestination) return;

    startTransition(async () => {
      setError("");

      try {
        await autosave.saveNow(formData);
        onSaved();
      } catch (cause) {
        setError(
          cause instanceof Error
            ? cause.message
            : "Could not save trip."
        );
      }
    });
  }

  return (
    <section
      aria-label="Edit trip details"
      className={`mx-auto w-full rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm sm:p-6 ${
        choosingDestination
          ? "max-w-screen-2xl"
          : "max-w-5xl"
      }`}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="mb-5 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900">
            {choosingDestination
              ? "Choose destination"
              : "Trip Details"}
          </h2>

          {choosingDestination && (
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">
              Search the catalogue or select a custom
              wilderness location.
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        {choosingDestination ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setChoosingDestination(false)}
            className={secondaryButton}
          >
            <ArrowLeft
              className="h-4 w-4"
              aria-hidden="true"
            />
            Back to details
          </button>
        ) : (
          onCancel && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onCancel}
              className={secondaryButton}
            >
              <X className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              Close
            </button>
          )
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Main trip details form */}
      {/* Keep mounted while browsing so unsaved field
          values are not lost. */}

      <form
        ref={formRef}
        action={handleSubmit}
        className={
          choosingDestination ? "hidden" : "space-y-5"
        }
      >
        <fieldset
          disabled={isPending}
          className="space-y-5"
        >
          <input
            type="hidden"
            name="buildId"
            value={build.id}
          />
          <input
            type="hidden"
            name="destinationId"
            value={destination.id}
          />
          <input
            type="hidden"
            name="location"
            value={destination.name}
          />
          <input
            type="hidden"
            name="locationLat"
            value={destination.lat}
          />
          <input
            type="hidden"
            name="locationLng"
            value={destination.lng}
          />

          {/* Destination summary */}
          <div>
            <label className={labelClass}>
              Destination
            </label>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50/60 p-3 sm:flex-nowrap">
              <MapPin
                className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-green-800"
                aria-hidden="true"
              />

              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="break-words text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">
                  {destination.name ||
                    "No destination selected"}
                </p>

                <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-gray-500">
                  {destination.id
                    ? "Popular destination"
                    : "Custom wilderness location"}
                </p>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={openDestinationPicker}
                disabled={isPending}
                className={`${secondaryButton} shrink-0`}
              >
                <Pencil
                  className="h-4 w-4"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                />
                Change
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Dates, travelers and weather */}
          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <div>
              <label className={labelClass}>
                Trip dates
              </label>

              <div className="rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-2">
                <DateRangePicker
                  startName="startDate"
                  endName="endDate"
                  initialStart={originalStart}
                  initialEnd={originalEnd}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label
                htmlFor="trip-people"
                className={labelClass}
              >
                Travelers
              </label>

              <input
                id="trip-people"
                name="people"
                type="number"
                min={1}
                max={100}
                required
                defaultValue={build.people}
                className={inputClass}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Conditional date warning */}
          {willRemoveDays && (
            <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3 text-xs leading-5 text-amber-900">
              <input
                name="confirmDateChange"
                type="checkbox"
                value="yes"
                className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 accent-green-800"
              />

              <span>
                I understand that itinerary days outside
                the new date range will be removed.
                Stops assigned to those days will be kept but become unassigned.
                Days within the range will be kept.
              </span>
            </label>
          )}

          {error && (
            <p
              role="alert"
              className="text-sm text-red-700"
            >
              {error}
            </p>
          )}

          {/* Actions */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-gray-100 pt-4">
            {onCancel && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onCancel}
                className={secondaryButton}
              >
                Close
              </button>
            )}

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isPending}
              className={primaryButton}
            >
              <Check
                className="h-4 w-4"
                aria-hidden="true"
              />
              {isPending
                ? "Saving…"
                : "Save changes"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </fieldset>
      </form>

      {/* Separate destination selection view */}
      {choosingDestination && (
        <div>
          <form
            key={pickerSession}
            ref={pickerRef}
            onSubmit={(event) => {
              event.preventDefault();
              confirmDestination();
            }}
            className="space-y-4"
          >
            <DestinationPicker
              destinationField="candidateDestinationId"
              nameField="candidateLocation"
              latField="candidateLat"
              lngField="candidateLng"
              initialDestinationId={
                destination.id || undefined
              }
              initialName={destination.name}
              initialLat={
                destination.lat === ""
                  ? null
                  : Number(destination.lat)
              }
              initialLng={
                destination.lng === ""
                  ? null
                  : Number(destination.lng)
              }
            />

            {pickerError && (
              <p
                role="alert"
                className="text-sm text-red-700"
              >
                {pickerError}
              </p>
            )}

            <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2 border-t border-gray-100 pt-4">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() =>
                  setChoosingDestination(false)
                }
                className={secondaryButton}
              >
                Cancel
              </button>

              <button
                type="submit"
                className={primaryButton}
              >
                <Check
                  className="h-4 w-4"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                />
                Use this destination
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

### `components/builder/TripPlanner/TripLogistics.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  CarFront,
  Check,
  ChevronDown,
  LockKeyhole,
  NotebookPen,
  Shield,
  Ticket,
  type LucideIcon,
} from "lucide-react";
import { saveTripLogistics } from "@/lib/tracked-build-actions";
import { readLogistics, type Logistics, type PlannerDay } from "@/lib/trip-planner";
import PermitReservationManager from "./PermitReservationManager";
import { readArrangements } from "@/lib/trip-arrangements";
import { readPrivateResources } from "@/lib/trip-resources";
import { useBuildAutosave } from "@/lib/use-build-autosave";

type FieldSpec = {
  key: keyof Logistics;
  label: string;
  placeholder: string;
};

type LogisticsSection = {
  id: "bookings" | "access" | "safety" | "other";
  title: string;
  description: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  fields: readonly FieldSpec[];
};

// The form still submits all seven original field names. No schema or
// server-action changes are needed to use this layout with existing trips.
const SECTIONS: readonly LogisticsSection[] = [
  {
    id: "bookings",
    title: "Permits & reservations",
    description: "Access permits, campsite bookings and confirmation details",
    icon: Ticket,
    fields: [],
  },
  {
    id: "access",
    title: "Getting there",
    description: "Transportation, parking and trailhead access",
    icon: CarFront,
    fields: [
      {
        key: "transportation",
        label: "Transportation",
        placeholder: "Driving, shuttle arrangements, pickups or drop-offs…",
      },
      {
        key: "parking",
        label: "Parking & trailhead access",
        placeholder: "Parking area, fees, road conditions or access notes…",
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: "safety",
    title: "Emergency information",
    description: "Your contact details and backup or exit plans",
    icon: Shield,
    fields: [
      {
        key: "emergencyContact",
        label: "Emergency contact",
        placeholder: "Name, contact number and relevant details…",
      },
      {
        key: "emergencyPlan",
        label: "Emergency plan & exit routes",
        placeholder: "Exit points, alternate routes, communication or check-in plan…",
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: "other",
    title: "Other notes",
    description: "Anything else you'll want handy on the trip",
    icon: NotebookPen,
    fields: [
      {
        key: "notes",
        label: "Trip notes",
        placeholder: "Additional logistics or reminders…",
      },
    ],
  },
];

type SectionId = LogisticsSection["id"];

function compactText(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

function sectionPreview(section: LogisticsSection, values: Logistics): string {
  const filled = section.fields
    .map(({ key, label }) => {
      const content = compactText(values[key]);
      return content ? `${label}: ${content}` : null;
    })
    .filter((preview): preview is string => preview !== null);

  return filled.length ? filled.join("  ·  ") : section.description;
}

function TripLogisticsEditor({
  buildId,
  value,
  days,
  waypoints,
}: {
  buildId: string;
  value: unknown;
  days: PlannerDay[];
  waypoints: unknown;
}) {
  const cleanLegacyNotes = (logistics: Logistics): Logistics => ({ ...logistics, permits:"", reservations:"" });
  const [values, setValues] = useState<Logistics>(() => cleanLegacyNotes(readLogistics(value)));
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<SectionId | null>(() =>
    Object.entries(readLogistics(value)).some(([key,entry]) => !["permits","reservations"].includes(key) && entry.trim())
      ? null
      : "bookings"
  );
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const committed = useRef(cleanLegacyNotes(readLogistics(value)));
  const externalReset = useRef(false);
  const serverSignature = JSON.stringify(value ?? null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const onReplace = (event: Event) => {
      if ((event as CustomEvent<string>).detail === buildId) externalReset.current = true;
    };
    window.addEventListener("trailpicker:build-replaced", onReplace);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("trailpicker:build-replaced", onReplace);
  }, [buildId]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const next = cleanLegacyNotes(readLogistics(value));
    if (externalReset.current || JSON.stringify(values) === JSON.stringify(committed.current)) {
      committed.current = next;
      setValues(next);
      setSaving(false);
      setError("");
      externalReset.current = false;
    }
    // Apply new server data without clobbering edits that haven't saved yet.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [serverSignature]);

  const autosave = useBuildAutosave({
    buildId,
    resource: "logistics",
    save: saveTripLogistics,
    onError: (message) => {
      setError(message);
      if (message) setSaving(false);
    },
    onSaved: () => setSaving(false),
  });
  const { formRef } = autosave;

  function changeField(key: keyof Logistics, next: string) {
    setValues((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: next }));
    setSaving(true);
    setError("");
  }

  return (
    <section
      id="logistics"
      aria-labelledby="logistics-heading"
      className="min-w-0 scroll-mt-20 border-b border-gray-200 pb-6 text-gray-800"
    >
      <header className="mb-5 flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h2 id="logistics-heading" className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-950">
            Logistics
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">
            Permits, access details and other practical trip information.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">
          <span role="status" aria-live="polite" className={error ? "text-red-700" : "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"}>
            {error ? (
              <span role="alert">Couldn’t save. Edit to retry.</span>
            ) : saving ? (
              "Saving…"
            ) : (
              <><Check aria-hidden="true" className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-green-700" /> Saved</>
            )}
          </span>
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <LockKeyhole aria-hidden="true" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Private when sharing
          </span>
        </div>
      </header>

      <form ref={formRef}>
        <input type="hidden" name="buildId" value={buildId} />

        {/* A single divided list, rather than a collection of separate cards. */}
        <div className="border-y border-gray-200">
          {SECTIONS.map((section) => {
            const open = expanded === section.id;
            const Icon = section.icon;
            const hasContent = section.fields.some(({ key }) =>
              Boolean(values[key].trim())
            );
            const editorId = `logistics-${section.id}`;
            const arrangementRows = section.id === "bookings" ? [...readArrangements(value).map(a => a.status), ...readPrivateResources(value).bookings.map(b => b.status)] : [];
            const bookingPreview = arrangementRows.length ? `${arrangementRows.length} entries · ${arrangementRows.filter(s => s === "confirmed").length} confirmed` : section.description;

            const legacyFields = (
                  <div
                    className={`grid gap-4 ${
                      section.fields.length > 1 ? "md:grid-cols-2" : ""
                    }`} 
                  >
                    {section.fields.map((field) => (
                      <label key={field.key} className="block min-w-0">
                        <span className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700">
                          {field.label}
                        </span>
                        <textarea
                          name={field.key}
                          value={values[field.key]}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            changeField(field.key, event.target.value)
                          }
                          rows={3}
                          maxLength={5000}
                          placeholder={field.placeholder}
                          className="w-full resize-y rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3.5 py-3 text-sm leading-6 text-gray-900 outline-none transition-colors placeholder:text-gray-400 hover:border-gray-300 focus:border-green-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-700/10"
                        />
                      </label>
                    ))}
                  </div>
            );
            return (
              <div
                key={section.id}
                className="border-b border-gray-200 last:border-b-0"
              >
                <h3>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-expanded={open}
                    aria-controls={editorId}
                    onClick={() => setExpanded(open ? null : section.id)}
                    className="group flex w-full items-start gap-3 py-4 text-left outline-none transition-colors hover:bg-gray-50/50 focus-visible:bg-green-50/50 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-green-700 sm:gap-4 sm:px-2"
                  >
                    <span className="mt-0.5 flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 group-hover:text-green-900">
                      <Icon aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </span>
                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-950">
                        {section.title}
                      </span>
                      <span
                        className={`mt-1 block break-words text-xs leading-5 ${
                          hasContent ? "text-gray-600" : "text-gray-500"
                        } ${open ? "" : "line-clamp-2"}`}
                      >
                        {open ? section.description : section.id === "bookings" ? bookingPreview : sectionPreview(section, values)}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                    <ChevronDown
                      aria-hidden="true"
                      className={`mt-2 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-gray-400 transition-transform ${
                        open ? "rotate-180" : ""
                      }`}
                    />
                  </button>
                </h3>

                {/* Keep every input mounted even when its row is collapsed.
                    saveTripLogistics replaces all seven values on each save. */}
                <div
                  id={editorId}
                  hidden={!open}
                  className="pb-5 pl-0 sm:pl-[3.75rem] sm:pr-7"
                >
                  {section.id === "bookings" && <div className="mb-4"><PermitReservationManager buildId={buildId} value={value} days={days} waypoints={waypoints}/></div>}
                  {section.id !== "bookings" && legacyFields}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </form>
    </section>
  );
}

export default function TripLogistics(props: {
  buildId: string;
  value: unknown;
  days: PlannerDay[];
  waypoints: unknown;
}) {
  // If the client navigates between builds without remounting the page,
  // reset the editor and autosave baseline for the new build.
  return <TripLogisticsEditor key={props.buildId} {...props} />;
}
```

### `components/builder/TripPlanner/TripPlanner.tsx`

```typescript

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import ConsumablesTimeline from "@/components/builder/ConsumablesTimeline";
import FoodConsumablesPlanner from "@/components/builder/FoodConsumablesPlanner";
import { analyzePack, type PackInputItem } from "@/lib/pack-analysis";
import WeatherPanel from "./WeatherPanel";
import { weatherPoints } from "@/lib/weather/locations";
import TripSummaryCard from "./TripSummaryCard";
import TripEditForm from "./TripEditForm";
import TripPlanningWorkspace from "./TripPlanningWorkspace";
import TripLogistics from "./TripLogistics";
import { type PlannerBuild } from "@/lib/trip-planner";
import type { CompatibilityIssue } from "@/lib/compatibility";

export default function TripPlanner({
  build,
  issues,
  items,
  readOnly = false,
}: {
  build: PlannerBuild;
  issues: CompatibilityIssue[];
  items: PackInputItem[];
  readOnly?: boolean;
}) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(!readOnly && !build.startDate);
  // A full replace/restore invalidates editor defaults, including the
  // destination picker. Close that editor before the refreshed server props arrive.
  useEffect(() => {
    const onReplaced = (event: Event) => {
      if ((event as CustomEvent<string>).detail !== build.id) return;
      setEditing(false);
    };
    window.addEventListener("trailpicker:build-replaced", onReplaced);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("trailpicker:build-replaced", onReplaced);
  }, [build.id]);

  const points = weatherPoints(build);
  const pack = useMemo(() => analyzePack(items), [items]);
  const temperatures = [
    build.minTemperature,
    ...build.days.map((d) => d.minTemperature),
  ].filter((x): x is number => x != null);

  const displayBuild = {
    ...build,
    minTemperature: temperatures.length
      ? Math.min(...temperatures)
      : null,
  };

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto mt-4 max-w-screen-2xl space-y-8 px-4 pb-20">
      {/* Section navigation */}
      <nav
        aria-label="Trip sections"
        className="border-b border-gray-200"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-8 overflow-x-auto whitespace-nowrap [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden">
          {[
            "overview",
            "route",
            "analysis",
            "weather",
            "consumables",
            ...(!readOnly ? ["logistics"] : []),
          ].map((section) => (
            <a
              key={section}
              href={`#${section}`}
              className="shrink-0 border-b-2 border-transparent px-1 py-3 text-sm font-medium capitalize text-gray-600 transition-colors hover:border-green-700 hover:text-green-900"
            >
              {section === "route" ? "Route & itinerary" : section === "analysis" ? "Route analysis" : section}
            </a>
          ))}
        </div>
      </nav>

      {/* Overview */}
      <div id="overview" className="scroll-mt-20">
        {editing ? (
          <TripEditForm
            build={build}
            onSaved={() => setEditing(false)}
            onCancel={
              build.startDate
                ? () => setEditing(false)
                : undefined
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <TripSummaryCard
            build={displayBuild}
            issues={issues}
            onEdit={
              readOnly ? undefined : () => setEditing(true)
            }
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* One connected route and day-planning workspace */}
      <TripPlanningWorkspace
        buildId={build.id}
        waypoints={build.routeWaypoints}
        lat={build.locationLat}
        lng={build.locationLng}
        days={build.days}
        weatherPoints={points}
        readOnly={readOnly}
        buildName={build.name || build.location || "Trip"}
        people={build.people}
        tripLogistics={build.tripLogistics}
        packLines={pack.lines}
      />

      {/* Weather */}
      <WeatherPanel
        points={points}
        tripStart={
          build.startDate
            ? new Date(build.startDate).toISOString().slice(0, 10)
            : undefined
        }
        tripEnd={
          build.endDate
            ? new Date(build.endDate).toISOString().slice(0, 10)
            : undefined
        }
      />

      {/* Consumables */}
      <div id="consumables" className="scroll-mt-20">
        {readOnly ? <ConsumablesTimeline pack={pack} trip={build} /> : <FoodConsumablesPlanner pack={pack} trip={build} />}
      </div>

      {/* Logistics */}
      {!readOnly && (
        <TripLogistics
          buildId={build.id}
          value={build.tripLogistics}
          days={build.days}
          waypoints={build.routeWaypoints}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import type { PlannerDay } from "@/lib/trip-planner";
import type { PackLine } from "@/lib/pack-analysis";
import type { WeatherPoint } from "@/lib/weather/locations";
import DayStopsItinerary from "./DayStopsItinerary";
import TripRoute from "./TripRoute";

type Props = {
  buildId: string;
  days: PlannerDay[];
  waypoints: unknown;
  lat: number | null;
  lng: number | null;
  weatherPoints: WeatherPoint[];
  readOnly?: boolean;
  buildName: string;
  people: number;
  tripLogistics: unknown;
  packLines: PackLine[];
};

export default function TripPlanningWorkspace({
  buildId, days, waypoints, lat, lng,
  weatherPoints, readOnly = false, buildName, people, tripLogistics, packLines,
}: Props) {
  const sortedDays = [...days].sort((a, b) => +new Date(a.date) - +new Date(b.date));

  return (
    <TripRoute
        header={<div className="mb-5">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-950">Route & itinerary</h2>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">Plan each day, add its stops, and see everything on the map.</p>
        </div>}
        buildId={buildId}
        value={waypoints}
        lat={lat}
        lng={lng}
        readOnly={readOnly}
        buildName={buildName}
        people={people}
        tripLogistics={tripLogistics}
        packLines={packLines}
        days={sortedDays}
        renderItinerary={(route) => (
          <DayStopsItinerary
            route={route}
            buildId={buildId}
            days={sortedDays}
            weatherPoints={weatherPoints}
          />
        )}
      />
  );
}
```

### `components/builder/TripPlanner/TripResourcesSection.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Droplets, MapPinned, Save, Tent, Plus, Trash2, Search } from "lucide-react";
import type { PlannerDay, Waypoint } from "@/lib/trip-planner";
import { readLogistics } from "@/lib/trip-planner";
import type { PackLine } from "@/lib/pack-analysis";
import {
  BOOKING_STATUSES, calculateWaterLegs, readPrivateResources, type CampBooking,
  type DiscoveredResource, type PrivateTripResources, type ResourceAnnotation,
  type WaterReliability,
} from "@/lib/trip-resources";
import type { TripExport } from "@/lib/trip-resources-export";
import { TRIP_EXPORT_REQUEST, type TripExportRequest } from "@/lib/trip-export-events";
import { saveTripResources } from "@/lib/tracked-build-actions";
import { readFoodPlan } from "@/lib/food-plan";
import { readArrangements } from "@/lib/trip-arrangements";

const inputStyle = "w-full min-w-0 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-900 focus:border-green-700 focus:outline-none";
const buttonStyle = "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-50 disabled:opacity-40";
const fieldLabel = "block space-y-1 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700";
const reliabilityLabels: Record<WaterReliability,string> = {
  unknown: "Unknown / not checked", reported: "Personally checked recently", seasonal: "Seasonal / uncertain", unavailable: "Reported dry / unavailable",
};
function newBooking(point?: Waypoint): CampBooking {
  return { id: crypto.randomUUID(), waypointId: point?.id || "", dayId: point?.dayId || "", campground: point?.name || "", status: "to_book", arrival: "", departure: "", provider: "", confirmation: "", notes: "" };
}

export default function TripResourcesSection({
  buildId, buildName, people, days, points, logistics, packLines, draft, canEditRoute, busy,
  onUpdatePoint, onAddPoint,
}: {
  buildId: string; buildName: string; people: number;
  days: PlannerDay[]; points: Waypoint[]; logistics: unknown; packLines: PackLine[];
  draft: boolean; canEditRoute: boolean; busy: boolean;
  onUpdatePoint: (id: string, patch: Partial<Waypoint>) => void;
  onAddPoint: (place: DiscoveredResource) => void;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const saved = useMemo(() => readPrivateResources(logistics), [logistics]);
  const [privatePlan, setPrivatePlan] = useState<PrivateTripResources>(saved);
  const [changed, setChanged] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [searching, setSearching] = useState(false);
  const [results, setResults] = useState<DiscoveredResource[]>([]);
  const [searchError, setSearchError] = useState("");
  const [centerId, setCenterId] = useState("");
  const [radius, setRadius] = useState(3000);
  const serverSig = JSON.stringify(logistics ?? null);
  // External restore/import refreshes only overwrite saved data, never local edits.
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  useEffect(() => { if (!changed) setPrivatePlan(readPrivateResources(logistics)); }, [serverSig]);
  useEffect(() => { setResults([]); setSearchError(""); }, [buildId]);
  const trip = useMemo(() => readLogistics(logistics), [logistics]);
  const camps = points.filter(point => point.kind === "camp");
  const annotated = points.filter(point => ["camp","water","resupply"].includes(point.kind));
  const waterLegs = calculateWaterLegs(points, privatePlan.settings);
  const payload: TripExport = { name: buildName, people, days, points, logistics: trip, bookings: privatePlan.bookings, arrangements: readArrangements(logistics), packLines, foodPlan: readFoodPlan(logistics) };
  // The toolbar owns all export actions. Keep the current Trip Planner state
  // available to it without moving the route/resource draft into global state.
  const exportRef = useRef(payload);
  exportRef.current = payload;
  useEffect(() => {
    const onRequest = (event: Event) => {
      const detail = (event as CustomEvent<TripExportRequest>).detail;
      if (detail?.buildId === buildId) detail.respond(exportRef.current);
    };
    window.addEventListener(TRIP_EXPORT_REQUEST, onRequest);
    return () => window.removeEventListener(TRIP_EXPORT_REQUEST, onRequest);
  }, [buildId]);
  const setPlan = (next: PrivateTripResources) => { setPrivatePlan(next); setChanged(true); setMessage(""); };
  const updateBooking = (id: string, patch: Partial<CampBooking>) => setPlan({ ...privatePlan, bookings: privatePlan.bookings.map(item => item.id === id ? { ...item, ...patch } : item) });
  const changeResource = (point: Waypoint, patch: Partial<ResourceAnnotation>) => {
    if (!canEditRoute || busy) return;
    onUpdatePoint(point.id, { resource: { ...point.resource, ...patch } });
  };
  async function save() {
    if (saving || busy || !changed) return;
    setMessage(""); setSaving(true);
    try {
      const form = new FormData();
      form.set("buildId", buildId);
      form.set("resources", JSON.stringify(privatePlan));
      await saveTripResources(form);
      setChanged(false);
      setMessage("Water preferences and campsite bookings saved.");
      router.refresh();
    } catch (reason) { setMessage(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Save failed. Edits remain here."); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  }
  async function search() {
    const point = points.find(item => item.id === centerId) || points[0];
    if (!point || searching) return;
    setSearching(true); setSearchError(""); setResults([]);
    try {
      const qs = new URLSearchParams({ buildId, lat: String(point.lat), lng: String(point.lng), radius: String(radius) });
      const response = await fetch(`/api/trip-resources?${qs}`, { cache: "no-store" });
      const data = await response.json() as { results?: DiscoveredResource[]; error?: string };
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || "Could not search map data.");
      setResults(Array.isArray(data.results) ? data.results : []);
    } catch (reason) { setSearchError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Discovery unavailable."); }
    finally { setSearching(false); }
  }
  return (
    <section id="resources" aria-labelledby="trip-resources-heading" className="min-w-0 scroll-mt-20 space-y-6 border-b border-gray-200 pb-8">
      <header>
        <h2 id="trip-resources-heading" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xl font-bold text-gray-950"><Tent className="h-5 w-5 text-green-800"/>Campsites & water</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">Track overnight stops, water-source reliability, resupply, bookings and field notes. Route changes update water-leg estimates immediately.</p>
      </header>
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4" aria-label="Route resource stops">
        <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900">Route resources</h3>
        <p className="my-2 text-xs leading-5 text-gray-600">Add campsites, water points and resupply stops from Route & itinerary. To change annotations here, choose <strong>Edit route</strong> on the map, then save the route.</p>
        {!annotated.length && <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">No campsite, water or resupply stops yet.</p>}
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {annotated.map(point => (
            <div key={point.id} className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 p-3">
              <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div><strong className="text-sm text-gray-950">{point.name}</strong><span className="ml-2 text-xs text-gray-500">{point.kind}</span></div>
                {point.resource?.sourceUrl && <a href={point.resource.sourceUrl} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="text-xs text-green-800 underline">Source · {point.resource.sourceName || "map listing"}</a>}
              </div>
              <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
                <label className={fieldLabel}>Facilities / observations
                  <textarea value={point.resource?.detail || ""} maxLength={750} rows={2} disabled={!canEditRoute || busy} onChange={event => changeResource(point, { detail: event.target.value })} className={inputStyle} placeholder={point.kind === "camp" ? "Platforms, toilets, food storage, site rules…" : point.kind === "resupply" ? "Pickup location, opening hours, supplies…" : "Water type, conditions, observations…"}/>
                </label>
                <label className={fieldLabel}>Access / restrictions
                  <textarea value={point.resource?.access || ""} maxLength={350} rows={2} disabled={!canEditRoute || busy} onChange={event => changeResource(point, { access: event.target.value })} className={inputStyle} placeholder="Permit, seasonal access, restrictions (verify officially)…"/>
                </label>
                {point.kind === "water" && <>
                  <label className={fieldLabel}>Reliability status
                    <select value={point.resource?.waterReliability || "unknown"} disabled={!canEditRoute || busy} onChange={event => changeResource(point, { waterReliability: event.target.value as WaterReliability, refillConfirmed: false })} className={inputStyle}>
                      {Object.entries(reliabilityLabels).map(([value, label]) => <option value={value} key={value}>{label}</option>)}
                    </select>
                  </label>
                  <label className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end pb-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700">
                    <input type="checkbox" checked={Boolean(point.resource?.refillConfirmed)} disabled={!canEditRoute || busy || point.resource?.waterReliability === "unavailable"} onChange={event => changeResource(point, { refillConfirmed: event.target.checked })} /> Include as a planned refill (you must personally verify availability)
                  </label>
                </>}
                <label className={fieldLabel}>Date last checked
                  <input type="date" disabled={!canEditRoute || busy} value={point.resource?.checkedOn || ""} onChange={event => changeResource(point, { checkedOn: event.target.value })} className={inputStyle}/>
                </label>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        {draft && <p className="mt-3 text-xs font-semibold text-amber-800">Resource stop changes are in your unsaved route draft. Use Save route above to keep them.</p>}
      </section>
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4" aria-label="Water segment estimates">
        <h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-bold text-gray-900"><Droplets className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-700"/>Water carry estimates</h3>
        <p className="my-2 text-xs leading-5 text-gray-600">Adjustable planning assumptions, not a medical hydration recommendation. Estimates use verified routed distances and climbs, plus a reserve. Unknown trail geometry or climb means the leg is <strong>unestimated</strong>. Starts with an assumed full carry; no mapped water point is guaranteed potable or flowing.</p>
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
          {([ ["rateLph", "Usage assumption (L/hour)",0.1,2,0.1],["reserveL","Reserve (L)",0,5,0.25],["capacityL","Carry capacity (L)",0.25,20,0.25] ] as const).map(([key,label,min,max,step]) => <label className={fieldLabel} key={key}>{label}
            <input type="number" min={min} max={max} step={step} value={privatePlan.settings[key]} onChange={event => setPlan({ ...privatePlan, settings: { ...privatePlan.settings,[key]: Number(event.target.value) } })} className={inputStyle}/>
          </label>)}
        </div>
        {!waterLegs.length ? <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-gray-500">Add a route with at least two stops to estimate water between mapped stops.</p> :
          <div className="mt-4 overflow-x-auto"><table className="w-full text-left text-xs"><thead><tr className="border-b border-gray-200 text-gray-600"><th className="py-2 pr-3">From → to</th><th className="py-2 pr-3">Trail distance</th><th className="py-2 pr-3">Moving hours</th><th className="py-2">Suggested plan</th></tr></thead><tbody>{waterLegs.map((leg,i)=><tr key={i} className="border-b border-gray-100"><td className="py-2 pr-3 font-medium">{leg.from} → {leg.to}</td><td className="py-2 pr-3">{leg.distanceKm === null ? "Unknown" : `${leg.distanceKm} km`}</td><td className="py-2 pr-3">{leg.movingHours === null ? "Unknown" : `${leg.movingHours} h`}</td><td className="py-2">{leg.requiredL === null ? "Incomplete route data" : <span className={leg.exceedsCapacity ? "font-semibold text-red-700" : "text-gray-700"}>{leg.requiredL} L including reserve{leg.exceedsCapacity ? " · Above your carry capacity" : ""}</span>}<div className="text-gray-500">{leg.note}</div></td></tr>)}</tbody></table></div>}
        <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-5 text-amber-900">Treat or otherwise verify water safety and check seasonal availability from an authoritative source. Change the plan if refill locations are unavailable. Water requirements vary widely by person, weather and exertion.</p>
      </section>
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4" aria-label="Find nearby campsites and water">
        <h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-bold text-gray-900"><MapPinned className="h-4 w-4"/>Discover nearby mapped resources</h3>
        <p className="my-2 text-xs leading-5 text-gray-600">Search voluntarily sends the selected stop’s coordinates to an OpenStreetMap Overpass server. Listings are community-mapped, may be old or inaccessible, and do not verify campsite legality, reservations or water quality.</p>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3">
          <label className={`${fieldLabel} grow`}>Search near
            <select className={inputStyle} disabled={!points.length} value={centerId} onChange={event=>setCenterId(event.target.value)}>
              {points.map((point,i)=><option key={point.id} value={point.id}>{i+1}. {point.name}</option>)}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label className={fieldLabel}>Radius
            <select className={inputStyle} value={radius} onChange={event=>setRadius(Number(event.target.value))}><option value={1000}>1 km</option><option value={3000}>3 km</option><option value={5000}>5 km</option></select>
          </label>
          <button type="button" onClick={search} disabled={searching || !points.length} className={buttonStyle}><Search className="h-4 w-4"/>{searching ? "Searching…" : "Search mapped sites"}</button>
        </div>
        {searchError && <p role="alert" className="mt-2 text-xs text-red-700">{searchError}</p>}
        {!!results.length && <div className="mt-3 max-h-80 space-y-2 overflow-y-auto">{results.map(item=><div key={item.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-100 py-2">
          <div className="min-w-0"><p className="text-sm font-semibold">{item.name} <span className="font-normal text-gray-500">· {item.kind}</span></p><p className="text-xs text-gray-500">{item.access}{item.kind === "water" ? ` · ${item.waterReliability} water reliability` : ""}</p><a className="text-xs text-green-800 underline" href={item.sourceUrl} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">View OpenStreetMap feature</a></div>
          <button type="button" disabled={busy || points.length >= 200 || points.some(p=>p.resource?.sourceUrl===item.sourceUrl)} onClick={()=>{ if(window.confirm(`Add ${item.name} at the end of the current route? The connection will be a straight-line placeholder until you adjust and save the route.`)) onAddPoint(item); }} className={buttonStyle}><Plus className="h-3 w-3"/>Add stop</button>
        </div>)}</div>}
        {!searching && !searchError && !results.length && <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-gray-500">No results loaded. Search near an existing stop to begin.</p>}
        <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-gray-500">Data © <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="underline">OpenStreetMap contributors · ODbL</a>. Reservations: <a href="https://bcparks.ca/reservations/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="underline">BC Parks official information</a>.</p>
      </section>
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4" aria-label="Campsite reservation tracker">

        <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-5 text-gray-600">Record reservation status, dates, operator and private confirmation details. This is a personal tracker, <strong>not</strong> a real-time booking system. Official availability and booking rules must be checked separately.</p>
        <div className="mt-3 space-y-3">
          {privatePlan.bookings.map((booking,i)=><div className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 p-3" key={booking.id}>
            <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2"><strong className="text-sm">Reservation {i+1}</strong><button type="button" className="text-red-700" aria-label={`Remove reservation ${i+1}`} onClick={()=>setPlan({ ...privatePlan, bookings: privatePlan.bookings.filter(item=>item.id!==booking.id) })}><Trash2 className="h-4 w-4"/></button></div>
            <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
              <label className={fieldLabel}>Campsite stop
                <select value={booking.waypointId} className={inputStyle} onChange={event=>{const stop=camps.find(p=>p.id===event.target.value); updateBooking(booking.id,{ waypointId:event.target.value, campground: stop?.name || booking.campground, dayId: stop?.dayId || booking.dayId });}}><option value="">Manual / not mapped</option>{camps.map(p=><option value={p.id} key={p.id}>{p.name}</option>)}</select>
              </label>
              <label className={fieldLabel}>Campground name
                <input className={inputStyle} value={booking.campground} maxLength={200} onChange={event=>updateBooking(booking.id,{campground:event.target.value})}/>
              </label>
              <label className={fieldLabel}>Trip day
                <select className={inputStyle} value={booking.dayId} onChange={event=>updateBooking(booking.id,{dayId:event.target.value})}><option value="">Unassigned</option>{days.map((d,index)=><option key={d.id} value={d.id}>Day {index+1}</option>)}</select>
              </label>
              <label className={fieldLabel}>Status
                <select className={inputStyle} value={booking.status} onChange={event=>updateBooking(booking.id,{status:event.target.value as CampBooking["status"]})}>{BOOKING_STATUSES.map(status=><option key={status} value={status}>{status.replaceAll("_"," ")}</option>)}</select>
              </label>
              <label className={fieldLabel}>Arrival
                <input type="date" className={inputStyle} value={booking.arrival} onChange={event=>updateBooking(booking.id,{arrival:event.target.value})}/>
              </label>
              <label className={fieldLabel}>Departure
                <input type="date" className={inputStyle} value={booking.departure} onChange={event=>updateBooking(booking.id,{departure:event.target.value})}/>
              </label>
              <label className={fieldLabel}>Booking provider
                <input className={inputStyle} value={booking.provider} maxLength={150} placeholder="BC Parks, hut operator…" onChange={event=>updateBooking(booking.id,{provider:event.target.value})}/>
              </label>
              <label className={fieldLabel}>Confirmation (private)
                <input className={inputStyle} value={booking.confirmation} maxLength={120} onChange={event=>updateBooking(booking.id,{confirmation:event.target.value})}/>
              </label>
              <label className={fieldLabel}>Booking notes (private)
                <input className={inputStyle} value={booking.notes} maxLength={750} onChange={event=>updateBooking(booking.id,{notes:event.target.value})}/>
              </label>
            </div>
          </div>)}
          {!privatePlan.bookings.length && <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">No bookings tracked yet. Add a reservation or connect it to an existing campsite stop.</p>}
        </div>
        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3"><button type="button" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-green-900 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-40" disabled={saving || busy || !changed} onClick={save}><Save className="h-4 w-4"/>{saving ? "Saving…" : "Save water & bookings"}</button><span role="status" className="text-xs text-gray-600">{message || (changed ? "Unsaved water settings or booking changes" : "Saved settings")}</span></div>
      </section>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```typescript
  function rateLimitRemaining() {

  // Snap an edited marker without exposing the routing-provider key to the browser.

  async function snapStop(id: string, raw: LatLng, version: number) {
    if (!followTrails) return;
    const remaining = rateLimitRemaining();
    if (remaining) { setRoutingMessage(`Trail routing paused. Try again in about ${remaining}s.`); return; }
    const controller = new AbortController();
    snapControllers.current.add(controller);
    setSnappingCount(n => n + 1);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/trails/snap", {
        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ buildId, point: raw }),

      if (response.status === 429) rememberRateLimit(response);
      const payload: unknown = await response.json();
      if (version !== snapVersion.current) return;
      if (!response.ok) {
        setRoutingMessage((payload as { error?: string }).error ?? "No nearby routable hiking trail found. Kept the original stop position.");

      const value = payload as { point?: LatLng };
      if (!Array.isArray(value.point) || !validCoordinates(value.point[0], value.point[1])) return;
      setPoints(current => current.map((point, index) => {
        if (point.id === id && metersBetween([point.lat, point.lng], raw) < 0.2) {
          return { ...point, lat: value.point![0], lng: value.point![1], trailToNext: undefined };

  // Shaping waypoints are coordinates on a route segment, NOT saved stops.
  // They snap to nearby hiking trails, but never enter the itinerary list.
  async function snapShapingWaypoint(stopId: string, viaIndex: number, raw: LatLng, version: number) {
    if (!followTrails) return;
    const remaining = rateLimitRemaining();
    if (remaining) { setRoutingMessage(`Trail routing paused. Try again in about ${remaining}s.`); return; }
    const controller = new AbortController();
    snapControllers.current.add(controller);
    setSnappingCount(n => n + 1);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/trails/snap", {
        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ buildId, point: raw }),
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (response.status === 429) rememberRateLimit(response);
      const payload: unknown = await response.json();
      if (version !== snapVersion.current) return;
      if (!response.ok) {
        setRoutingMessage((payload as { error?: string }).error ?? "No nearby hiking trail found. Kept the shaping waypoint in place.");
        return;
```
