### `components/builder/TripPlanner/WaypointSearch.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Search, LoaderCircle, MapPin } from "lucide-react";
import { parsePlaceResults, type PlaceResult } from "@/lib/waypoint-map";

type Props = { near: [number, number] | null; onChoose: (place: PlaceResult) => void; disabled?: boolean };

export default function WaypointSearch({ near, onChoose, disabled = false }: Props) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [results, setResults] = useState<PlaceResult[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const request = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const cache = useRef(new Map<string, PlaceResult[]>());
  const lastSearch = useRef(0);
  useEffect(() => () => { request.current?.abort(); request.current = null; }, []);

  async function search() {
    const text = query.trim();
    if (disabled || busy || text.length < 2) return;
    request.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    request.current = controller;
    const key = `${text.toLocaleLowerCase()}:${near?.map(n => n.toFixed(2)).join(",") ?? ""}`;
    const cached = cache.current.get(key);
    if (cached) { setResults(cached); setMessage(cached.length ? "" : "No places found. Try a nearby town or place the stop on the map."); return; }
    if (Date.now() - lastSearch.current < 1000) { setMessage("Wait a moment before searching again."); return; }
    lastSearch.current = Date.now();
    setBusy(true);
    setResults([]);
    setMessage("");
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 12000);
    try {
      const endpoint = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_WAYPOINT_SEARCH_URL || "https://photon.komoot.io/api/";
      const url = new URL(endpoint, window.location.origin);
      url.searchParams.set("q", text);
      url.searchParams.set("limit", "6");
      if (near) { url.searchParams.set("lat", String(near[0])); url.searchParams.set("lon", String(near[1])); }
      const response = await fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Search failed.");
      const found = parsePlaceResults(await response.json());
      if (request.current !== controller || controller.signal.aborted) return;
      if (cache.current.size >= 20) cache.current.delete(cache.current.keys().next().value!);
      cache.current.set(key, found);
      setResults(found);
      setMessage(found.length ? "" : "No places found. Try a nearby town or place the stop on the map.");
    } catch {
      if (request.current === controller) setMessage("Place search is unavailable. You can still add stops by clicking the map.");
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      if (request.current === controller) setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return <div className="space-y-2">
    <div role="search" className="flex gap-2">
      <label className="relative min-w-0 flex-1">
        <span className="sr-only">Search for a place</span>
        <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-3 h-4 w-4 text-gray-400" aria-hidden="true" />
        <input type="search" value={query} maxLength={200} onChange={e => {
          setQuery(e.target.value); setResults([]); setMessage("");
          request.current?.abort(); request.current = null; setBusy(false);
        }} disabled={disabled} onKeyDown={event => { if (event.key === "Enter") { event.preventDefault(); void search(); } }} placeholder="Lake, campground, trailhead…" className="w-full rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white py-2.5 pl-9 pr-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-green-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-700/10" />
      </label>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => void search()} disabled={disabled || busy || query.trim().length < 2} aria-label="Search places" className="rounded-xl bg-green-900 px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-40">
        {busy ? <LoaderCircle className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : "Search"}
      </button>
    </div>
    <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="text-xs text-gray-500">{busy ? "Searching…" : message}</p>
    {results.length > 0 && <ul aria-label="Place search results" className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
      {results.map(place => <li key={place.id}><button type="button" disabled={disabled} onClick={() => { onChoose(place); setResults([]); }} className="flex w-full items-start gap-2 px-3 py-3 text-left hover:bg-green-50 disabled:opacity-40">
        <MapPin className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-green-700" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span className="min-w-0"><span className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">{place.name}</span><span className="mt-0.5 block text-xs text-gray-500">{place.detail}</span></span>
      </button></li>)}
    </ul>}
    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">Place search: <a href="https://photon.komoot.io/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="underline">Photon</a> / <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="underline">OpenStreetMap</a></p>
  </div>;
}


```

### `components/builder/TripPlanner/WeatherPanel.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { AlertTriangle, ChevronDown, CircleHelp, Cloud, CloudRain, CloudSnow, CloudSun, ExternalLink, MapPin, RefreshCw, Sun, Sunrise, Sunset, Wind } from "lucide-react";
import type { WeatherResult } from "@/lib/weather/service";
import type { WeatherPoint } from "@/lib/weather/locations";
import { loadWaypointWeather } from "@/lib/weather/client-cache";
import { comparePlan, forecastHints, tripDayForecast, localHour, type PlanningInputs } from "@/lib/weather/presentation";
import { dateKey } from "@/lib/weather/core";
import { useDisplayPreferences } from "@/components/settings/DisplayPreferencesProvider";
import { temperatureNumber, windText } from "@/lib/user-preferences";
import { clockLabel, type DaylightResult } from "@/lib/route-analysis-insights";
import StopSelectPicker from "./StopSelectPicker";
import WaypointIcon from "./WaypointIcon";
import { waypointType } from "@/lib/waypoint-map";

type Snapshot = { key: string; data?: WeatherResult; error?: string };

const number = (value: number | null | undefined, unit = "") =>
  value == null ? "—" : `${Math.round(value)}${unit}`;
const shortDate = (date: string) =>
  new Date(`${date}T12:00:00Z`).toLocaleDateString("en-CA", {
    timeZone: "UTC", weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric",
  });
const timeLabel = (iso: string | null | undefined, zone: string) =>
  iso ? new Date(iso).toLocaleString("en-CA", {
    timeZone: zone, month: "short", day: "numeric", hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit",
  }) : "Unavailable";

// Model-based icons: never present unknown cloud cover as "sunny".
// The PoP layer cannot establish precipitation type; temperature is only a rough hint.
type ModelSample = WeatherResult["hourly"][number];
type SkyKind = "sun" | "partly" | "cloud" | "rain" | "snow" | "mixed" | "precip" | "unknown";
type SkyCondition = { kind: SkyKind; label: string; detail: string };

function skyCondition(samples: readonly ModelSample[]): SkyCondition {
  const wet = samples.filter(s => s.pop != null && s.pop >= 60)
    .sort((a, b) => (b.pop ?? 0) - (a.pop ?? 0));
  if (wet.length) {
    const temperature = wet[0].temperature;
    if (temperature == null) return { kind: "precip", label: "Precipitation possible", detail: "Based on model precipitation probability" };
    if (temperature <= -1) return { kind: "snow", label: "Snow possible", detail: "Precipitation chance + air temperature estimate" };
    if (temperature >= 3) return { kind: "rain", label: "Rain possible", detail: "Precipitation chance + air temperature estimate" };
    return { kind: "mixed", label: "Rain or snow possible", detail: "Precipitation chance + near-freezing air temperature" };
  }
  const cloud = samples.map(s => s.cloudCover)
    .filter((v): v is number => typeof v === "number" && v >= 0 && v <= 100);
  if (cloud.length) {
    const average = cloud.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / cloud.length;
    if (average < 20) return { kind: "sun", label: "Mostly clear", detail: "Estimated from model cloud cover" };
    if (average < 70) return { kind: "partly", label: "Partly cloudy", detail: "Estimated from model cloud cover" };
    return { kind: "cloud", label: "Cloudy", detail: "Estimated from model cloud cover" };
  }
  return { kind: "unknown", label: "Sky conditions unavailable", detail: "Cloud and precipitation data not available for this sample" };
}

function SkyIcon({ kind, className = "h-8 w-8" }: { kind: SkyKind; className?: string }) {
  const props = { className, "aria-hidden": true as const };
  switch (kind) {
    case "sun": return <Sun {...props} className={`${className} text-amber-600`} />;
    case "partly": return <CloudSun {...props} className={`${className} text-amber-600`} />;
    case "cloud": return <Cloud {...props} className={`${className} text-slate-500`} />;
    case "rain": return <CloudRain {...props} className={`${className} text-blue-600`} />;
    case "snow": return <CloudSnow {...props} className={`${className} text-sky-600`} />;
    case "mixed": return <CloudSnow {...props} className={`${className} text-sky-600`} />;
    case "precip": return <CloudRain {...props} className={`${className} text-blue-600`} />;
    default: return <CircleHelp {...props} className={`${className} text-gray-400`} />;
  }
}

export default function WeatherPanel({ points, date, defaultPointId, tripStart, tripEnd, planning, daylight, gearIssueCount = 0, onLocationChange }: {
  points: WeatherPoint[];
  date?: string;
  defaultPointId?: string;
  tripStart?: string;
  tripEnd?: string;
  planning?: PlanningInputs;
  daylight?: DaylightResult | null;
  gearIssueCount?: number;
  onLocationChange?: (point: WeatherPoint) => void;
}) {
  const { temperatureUnit, distanceUnit } = useDisplayPreferences();
  const temp = (value: number | null | undefined, withUnit = false) => {
    const converted = temperatureNumber(value, temperatureUnit);
    return converted == null ? "—" : `${Math.round(converted)}°${withUnit ? (temperatureUnit === "f" ? "F" : "C") : ""}`;
  };
  const wind = (value: number | null | undefined) => windText(value, distanceUnit);
  const controlId = useId();
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(defaultPointId || points[0]?.id || "");
  const [revision, setRevision] = useState(0);
  const forceNext = useRef(false);
  const [snapshot, setSnapshot] = useState<Snapshot>({ key: "" });
  const [updating, setUpdating] = useState(false);
  const [showDetails, setShowDetails] = useState(false);
  const [detailsLoading, setDetailsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [detailsError, setDetailsError] = useState("");

  const point = points.find(p => p.id === selected) ||
    points.find(p => p.id === defaultPointId) || points[0];
  const coordinates = point ? new URLSearchParams({
    lat: String(point.lat), lng: String(point.lng), ...(date ? { date } : {}),
  }).toString() : "";
  const summaryUrl = coordinates ? `/api/weather?${coordinates}&view=summary` : "";
  const detailUrl = coordinates ? `/api/weather?${coordinates}` : "";

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!summaryUrl) return;
    let active = true;
    const force = forceNext.current;
    forceNext.current = false;
    void loadWaypointWeather(summaryUrl, force)
      .then(data => {
        if (!active) return;
        setSnapshot({ key: coordinates, data });
      })
      .catch(error => {
        if (!active) return;
        setSnapshot(previous => ({
          key: coordinates,
          // Keep a previous forecast only for a failed refresh of this point.
          data: previous.key === coordinates ? previous.data : undefined,
          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Forecast unavailable.",
        }));
      })
      .finally(() => { if (active) setUpdating(false); });
    const interval = window.setInterval(() => {
      if (document.visibilityState === "visible") {
        setUpdating(true);
        forceNext.current = true;
        setRevision(n => n + 1);
      }
    }, 10 * 60_000);
    return () => { active = false; window.clearInterval(interval); };
  }, [summaryUrl, coordinates, revision]);

  const isLoading = updating || (Boolean(summaryUrl) && snapshot.key !== coordinates);
  const data = snapshot.key === coordinates ? snapshot.data : undefined;
  const error = snapshot.key === coordinates ? snapshot.error : undefined;

  async function loadDetails() {
    if (!detailUrl || detailsLoading) return;
    if (data?.sampleDensity === "detail") { setShowDetails(value => !value); return; }
    setDetailsLoading(true);
    setDetailsError("");
    try {
      const detailed = await loadWaypointWeather(detailUrl);
      // A request may finish after a waypoint change. Never display it for another point.
      if (currentCoordinates.current !== coordinates) return;
      setSnapshot({ key: coordinates, data: detailed });
      setShowDetails(true);
    } catch (cause) {
      if (currentCoordinates.current === coordinates)
        setDetailsError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Detailed samples unavailable.");
    } finally {
      setDetailsLoading(false);
    }
  }
  const currentCoordinates = useRef(coordinates);
  useEffect(() => { currentCoordinates.current = coordinates; }, [coordinates]);

  const zone = data?.query.zone || "UTC";
  const days = useMemo(() => data?.daily || [], [data?.daily]);
  const day = date ? days.find(item => item.date === date) : undefined;
  const tripDays = tripStart ? days.filter(item => item.date >= tripStart && item.date <= (tripEnd || tripStart)) : [];
  const visibleDays = date ? [] : tripDays.length ? tripDays : days.slice(0, 10);
  const hours = data?.hourly.filter(hour => !date || dateKey(hour.time, zone) === date) || [];
  const nearest = hours[0] || data?.hourly[0];
  const relevant = date ? tripDayForecast(data, date)
    : tripDays.length ? tripDayForecast(data, tripDays[0].date)
    : days[0] ? tripDayForecast(data, days[0].date) : null;
  const hints = relevant ? forecastHints(relevant) : [];
  const changes = planning && relevant ? comparePlan(relevant, planning) : [];
  const risks = data?.assessment;
  const warningCount = data?.alerts.items.length || 0;
  const featuredSky = skyCondition(date ? hours : nearest ? [nearest] : []);
  const daySky = (dayDate: string) => skyCondition(
    data?.hourly.filter(hour => dateKey(hour.time, zone) === dayDate) ?? [],
  );

  // The itinerary only needs a quick glance. Keep the detailed model dashboard
  // below for the main Weather section (where `date` is not provided).
  if (date) {
    const forecastAvailable = !!data && !data.forecastStale && !!day;
    const hasNumbers = forecastAvailable && [day.high, day.low, day.pop, day.wind].some(value => value != null);
    const condition = forecastAvailable && hours.length ? featuredSky : {
      kind: "unknown" as const,
      label: "Conditions unavailable",
      detail: "No sky-condition samples for this date",
    };
    const actualAlerts = data?.alerts.items ?? [];
    const alertsUnknown = data?.alerts.status === "unavailable";

    return (
      <section aria-label={`Day forecast for ${shortDate(date)}`} className="min-w-0 text-sm text-gray-800">
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50/50 px-3 py-3 shadow-sm sm:px-4">
          {/* The itinerary owns the only Day forecast heading. Keep the card focused on weather. */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-end text-xs text-gray-500">
          </div>

          {!point ? (
            <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-600">
              <CircleHelp aria-hidden="true" className="h-6 w-6 shrink-0 text-gray-400" />
              <span>Add a trip stop to see weather for this day.</span>
            </div>
          ) : !data ? (
            <div role={error ? "alert" : "status"} className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-600">
              {error && <CircleHelp aria-hidden="true" className="h-6 w-6 shrink-0 text-gray-400" />}
              <span>{error ? "Forecast couldn't be loaded. Try reopening this day forecast." : "Loading forecast…"}</span>
            </div>
          ) : !forecastAvailable || !hasNumbers ? (
            <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-3 py-1 text-gray-600">
              <CircleHelp aria-hidden="true" className="h-9 w-9 shrink-0 text-gray-400" />
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-800">Forecast unavailable</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">No forecast available for this day.</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-5 gap-y-3">
              <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
                <SkyIcon kind={condition.kind} className="h-9 w-9 shrink-0" />
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xl font-semibold tabular-nums tracking-tight text-gray-950">
                    {temp(day.high)} <span className="font-normal text-gray-400">/</span> {temp(day.low)}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">{condition.label}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              {/* Keep precipitation and wind on the right, wrapping on small screens. */}
              <div className="ml-auto flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-x-4 gap-y-1.5 text-xs text-gray-700">
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap">
                  <CloudRain aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4 text-gray-500" />
                  Precip. {number(day.pop, "%")}
                </span>
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap">
                  <Wind aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4 text-gray-500" />
                  Wind {wind(day.wind)}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* The location selector stays full-width and visible, below the forecast like before. */}
          {point && (
            <div className="mt-4 flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
              <MapPin aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-gray-500" />
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <StopSelectPicker
                  label="Day forecast location"
                  hideLabel
                  value={point.id}
                  options={points.map(item => ({
                    value: item.id,
                    label: item.name,
                    icon: item.kind ? (
                      <span style={{ color: waypointType(item.kind).color }}>
                        <WaypointIcon kind={item.kind} className="h-4 w-4" />
                      </span>
                    ) : <MapPin className="h-4 w-4 text-gray-500" />,
                  }))}
                  onChange={nextId => {
                    setSelected(nextId);
                    const nextPoint = points.find(entry => entry.id === nextId);
                    if (nextPoint) onLocationChange?.(nextPoint);
                    setShowDetails(false);
                    setDetailsError("");
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {daylight && (
            <div className="mt-4 border-t border-gray-200/80 pt-3">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-7 gap-y-2 text-sm">
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Sunrise className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-green-800" aria-hidden="true" />
                  <span className="text-gray-600">Sunrise</span>
                  <strong className="font-semibold tabular-nums text-gray-900">
                    {daylight.sunriseMinutes != null ? clockLabel(daylight.sunriseMinutes) : "Unavailable"}
                  </strong>
                </span>
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Sunset className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-green-800" aria-hidden="true" />
                  <span className="text-gray-600">Sunset</span>
                  <strong className="font-semibold tabular-nums text-gray-900">
                    {daylight.sunsetMinutes != null ? clockLabel(daylight.sunsetMinutes) : "Unavailable"}
                  </strong>
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] text-gray-500">Times from {daylight.zone}</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {error && data && <p role="status" className="mt-2 text-xs text-amber-800">Could not refresh; showing previously loaded data.</p>}
          {alertsUnknown && (
            <p role="status" className="mt-2 text-xs text-amber-900">Official weather alert status couldn&apos;t be checked.</p>
          )}
          {actualAlerts.length > 0 && (
            <details className="group mt-4 rounded-lg border border-gray-200/80 bg-white px-3 py-3 text-xs text-gray-800">
              <summary className="flex cursor-pointer list-none items-center gap-2 focus-visible:rounded-sm focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-green-700 [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden">
                <AlertTriangle aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-amber-600" />
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="block font-semibold text-gray-900">
                    {actualAlerts.length} active ECCC {actualAlerts.length === 1 ? "alert" : "alerts"}
                  </span>
                  <span className="mt-0.5 block truncate text-gray-500">
                    {actualAlerts.length === 1 ? actualAlerts[0].area : "Current weather alerts for this location"}
                  </span>
                </span>
                <ChevronDown aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-gray-500 transition-transform group-open:rotate-180" />
              </summary>
              <div className="mt-3 space-y-3 pl-6 text-gray-700">
                <p className="text-gray-500">These are current alerts, not necessarily alerts for your trip date.</p>
                {actualAlerts.map(alert => (
                  <div key={alert.id}>
                    <p className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{alert.title} · {alert.area}</p>
                    <p className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed">{alert.text}</p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </details>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }

  return (
    <section
      id={!date ? "weather" : undefined}
      aria-label={date ? `Weather for ${shortDate(date)}` : "Trip forecast"}
      className={`scroll-mt-20 min-w-0 text-sm text-gray-800 ${!date ? "border-b border-gray-200 pb-6" : ""}`}
    >
      {/* Match Route's flat section heading; only forecast content uses cards. */}
      <header className="mb-5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-950">
              {date ? `Weather · ${shortDate(date)}` : "Weather"}
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">
              Model forecasts for your route waypoints.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {gearIssueCount > 0 && (
              <a
                href="#compatibility-details"
                className="inline-flex min-h-9 items-center rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-green-900 hover:bg-gray-50"
              >
                Gear checks ({gearIssueCount})
              </a>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={!point || isLoading}
              onClick={() => {
                setUpdating(true);
                forceNext.current = true;
                setShowDetails(false);
                setRevision(n => n + 1);
              }}
              className="inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-800 transition-colors hover:bg-gray-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <RefreshCw aria-hidden="true" className={`h-4 w-4 ${isLoading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
              {isLoading ? "Updating…" : "Refresh"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-5 gap-y-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50/70 px-4 py-3">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <MapPin aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-green-800" />
            <label htmlFor={controlId} className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700">
              Forecast location
            </label>
            {point ? (
              <select
                id={controlId}
                value={point.id}
                onChange={event => {
                  setSelected(event.target.value);
                  const nextPoint=points.find(entry=>entry.id===event.target.value);
                  if(nextPoint)onLocationChange?.(nextPoint);
                  setShowDetails(false);
                  setDetailsError("");
                }}
                className="min-w-0 max-w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-green-700"
              >
                {points.map(item => (
                  <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>
                    {item.name}{item.elevationM == null ? "" : ` · ${item.elevationM} m`}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            ) : (
              <span className="text-sm text-gray-500">No route waypoints available</span>
            )}
          </div>
          {point && (
            <span className="text-xs tabular-nums text-gray-500">
              {point.lat.toFixed(4)}, {point.lng.toFixed(4)}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        {data && (
          <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-gray-500" aria-live="polite">
            {isLoading ? "Checking for updated model data…" : `Checked ${timeLabel(data.generated, zone)}`}
            {data.sampleDensity === "summary" ? " · Quick overview" : " · Detailed samples"}
          </p>
        )}
      </header>

      {!point ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-300 bg-gray-50 p-6 text-gray-600">
          Add a Canadian route waypoint to see the forecast.
        </div>
      ) : !data ? (
        <div role={error ? "alert" : "status"} className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-6 text-gray-700">
          {error ? (
            <p>{error} Use Refresh to try again.</p>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="h-3 w-32 animate-pulse rounded bg-gray-200" />
              <div className="mt-4 h-10 w-40 animate-pulse rounded bg-gray-100" />
              <p className="mt-4 text-xs text-gray-500">Loading model samples for {point.name}…</p>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="min-w-0">
          {error && (
            <p role="alert" className="mb-4 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-3 text-xs text-amber-950">
              Unable to update: {error}. Showing the previous forecast.
            </p>
          )}

          {/* Official alerts remain visible, never hidden behind disclosure controls. */}
          {data.alerts.status !== "ok" ? (
            <p role="alert" className="mb-5 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-amber-950">
              Official alert status could not be checked. Do not assume there are no warnings.
            </p>
          ) : warningCount > 0 ? (
            <div className="mb-5 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-4 text-amber-950">
              <p className="flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold">
                <AlertTriangle aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                {warningCount} active ECCC {warningCount === 1 ? "alert" : "alerts"}
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs">Alerts apply to current conditions at this point, not a future trip date.</p>
              {data.alerts.items.map(alert => (
                <details key={alert.id} className="mt-3 border-t border-amber-200 pt-3">
                  <summary className="cursor-pointer font-medium">{alert.title} · {alert.area}</summary>
                  <p className="mt-2 whitespace-pre-wrap text-xs leading-relaxed">{alert.text}</p>
                </details>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : null}

          {/* Primary overview: one important reading, three supporting measurements. */}
          <div className="grid min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.4fr)_minmax(260px,1fr)]">
            <div className="p-5 sm:p-6">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-500">
                    {date ? `Sampled forecast · ${shortDate(date)}` : "Next sampled forecast"}
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">
                    {date ? "High and low from available model samples" : timeLabel(nearest?.time, zone)}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex min-w-0 max-w-[160px] flex-col items-end gap-1 text-right" title={featuredSky.detail}>
                  <SkyIcon kind={featuredSky.kind} className="h-12 w-12" />
                  <span className="text-xs font-medium leading-snug text-gray-600">{featuredSky.label}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p className="mt-6 text-5xl font-semibold tabular-nums tracking-tight text-gray-950 sm:text-6xl">
                {date ? temp(day?.high) : temp(nearest?.temperature, true)}
                {date && (
                  <span className="ml-2 text-2xl font-medium text-gray-400 sm:text-3xl">
                    / {temp(day?.low)}
                  </span>
                )}
              </p>
              <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-600">
                {date ? "Sampled high / low" : "Temperature at the next available model time"}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 border-t border-gray-200 bg-gray-50/60 lg:grid-cols-1 lg:border-l lg:border-t-0">
              <div className="min-w-0 px-3 py-5 sm:px-5 lg:py-4">
                <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">
                  <Wind aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4" /> Wind
                </p>
                <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums text-gray-950 sm:text-xl">
                  {wind(date ? day?.wind : nearest?.wind)}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 border-l border-gray-200 px-3 py-5 sm:px-5 lg:border-l-0 lg:border-t lg:py-4">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">Gusts</p>
                <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums text-gray-950 sm:text-xl">
                  {wind(date ? day?.gust : nearest?.gust)}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 border-l border-gray-200 px-3 py-5 sm:px-5 lg:border-l-0 lg:border-t lg:py-4">
                <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">
                  <CloudRain aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4" /> Precip. chance
                </p>
                <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums text-gray-950 sm:text-xl">
                  {number(date ? day?.pop : nearest?.pop, "%")}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-gray-500">
            TrailPicker provides model-based weather estimates, not live observations or official safety advice. Actual conditions may differ. Terrain and avalanche hazards are not assessed. Cloud cover and precipitation icons are model estimates, not confirmed conditions. “—” means unavailable data.
          </p>

          {/* Days use easy-to-scan tiles instead of a dense data table. */}
          {!date && (
            <section className="mt-8" aria-label="Forecast by day">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-2">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-950">
                    {tripDays.length ? "Forecast for your trip" : "Upcoming forecast"}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">Daily values sampled from available forecast models.</p>
                </div>
                <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">{visibleDays.length} {visibleDays.length === 1 ? "day" : "days"}</span>
              </div>
              {visibleDays.length ? (
                <div className="mt-4 flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2">
                  {visibleDays.map(item => (
                    <div key={item.date} className="min-w-[155px] flex-1 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-4">
                      <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-950">{shortDate(item.date)}</p>
                      <div className="mt-3 flex min-h-[65px] flex-col items-start gap-1" title={daySky(item.date).detail}>
                        <SkyIcon kind={daySky(item.date).kind} className="h-8 w-8" />
                        <span className="text-xs leading-tight text-gray-600">{daySky(item.date).label}</span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="mt-3 text-xl font-bold tabular-nums tracking-tight text-gray-950">
                        {temp(item.high)}
                        <span className="ml-1 text-base font-medium text-gray-400">/ {temp(item.low)}</span>
                      </p>
                      <div className="mt-4 space-y-2 border-t border-gray-100 pt-3 text-xs text-gray-600">
                        <p className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                          <span>Wind</span><span className="font-medium tabular-nums text-gray-800">{wind(item.wind)}</span>
                        </p>
                        <p className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                          <span>Precip.</span><span className="font-medium tabular-nums text-gray-800">{number(item.pop, "%")}</span>
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p className="mt-4 text-gray-600">No forecast samples available.</p>
              )}
              {tripStart && !tripDays.length && (
                <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-amber-900">
                  Your trip dates are outside the available forecast. The upcoming days shown are not predictions for your trip.
                </p>
              )}
            </section>
          )}

          {/* Risk screening is supportive information, not a safety clearance. */}
          <section className="mt-8 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50/70 p-5 sm:p-6" aria-label="Weather considerations">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <AlertTriangle aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4 text-gray-600" />
                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-950">Weather considerations</h3>
              </div>
              <span className="rounded-full border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700">
                {risks?.level || "Unknown"}
              </span>
            </div>
            {risks?.reasons.length ? (
              <ul className="mt-4 list-disc space-y-2 pl-5 leading-relaxed text-gray-700">
                {risks.reasons.slice(0, 5).map((reason, index) => (
                  <li key={`${reason}-${index}`}>{reason}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            ) : (
              <p className="mt-3 text-gray-600">
                No issues flagged in the available temperature and wind samples. This is not a safety assessment.
              </p>
            )}
            {hints.length > 0 && <p className="mt-3 text-gray-700">{hints.join(" ")}</p>}
          </section>

          {date && planning && (
            <section className="mt-6 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-5" aria-label="Plan comparison">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-950">Compared with your trip plan</h3>
              <p className="mt-2 text-gray-600">
                Planned minimum: {temp(planning.minTemperature, true)} · Sampled minimum: {temp(day?.low, true)}
              </p>
              {changes.length > 0 && (
                <ul className="mt-3 list-disc space-y-2 pl-5 text-amber-900">
                  {changes.map(change => <li key={change}>{change}</li>)}
                </ul>
              )}
              <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-gray-500">Forecasts never overwrite saved trip conditions.</p>
            </section>
          )}

          {/* Full model time steps are only fetched when the user requests them. */}
          <section className="mt-8 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-200" aria-label="Model time steps">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-4 sm:px-5">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-950">Model time steps</h3>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">
                  {data.sampleDensity === "summary"
                    ? "Load detailed samples to explore forecast changes over time."
                    : `${hours.length} model samples available for this selection.`}
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={detailsLoading}
                onClick={() => { void loadDetails(); }}
                aria-expanded={showDetails}
                className="inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-50 disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                {detailsLoading ? "Loading details…" : data.sampleDensity === "detail" ? showDetails ? "Hide time steps" : "Show time steps" : "Load time steps"}
                <ChevronDown aria-hidden="true" className={`h-4 w-4 transition-transform ${showDetails ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} />
              </button>
            </div>
            {detailsError && <p role="alert" className="px-4 pb-3 text-xs text-amber-900">{detailsError}</p>}
            {showDetails && (
              <div className="overflow-x-auto border-t border-gray-200 px-4 py-2 sm:px-5">
                {hours.length > 0 ? (
                  <table className="w-full min-w-[580px] border-collapse text-left text-sm">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="border-b border-gray-200 text-xs text-gray-500">
                        <th scope="col" className="py-3 pr-3 font-semibold">Local time</th>
                        <th scope="col" className="px-3 py-3 font-semibold">Temp.</th>
                        <th scope="col" className="px-3 py-3 font-semibold">Wind</th>
                        <th scope="col" className="px-3 py-3 font-semibold">Gusts</th>
                        <th scope="col" className="px-3 py-3 font-semibold">Precip.</th>
                        <th scope="col" className="py-3 pl-3 font-semibold">Model</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {hours.map(hour => (
                        <tr key={hour.time} className="border-b border-gray-100 last:border-0">
                          <th scope="row" className="whitespace-nowrap py-3 pr-3 font-medium text-gray-900">
                            {shortDate(dateKey(hour.time, zone))} · {localHour(hour.time, zone)}
                          </th>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 tabular-nums">{temp(hour.temperature, true)}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 tabular-nums">{wind(hour.wind)}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 tabular-nums">{wind(hour.gust)}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 tabular-nums">{number(hour.pop, "%")}</td>
                          <td className="py-3 pl-3 text-xs text-gray-600">{hour.model}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                ) : (
                  <p className="py-3 text-gray-600">No time steps were returned for this date.</p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </section>

          <footer className="mt-6 border-t border-gray-100 pt-4 text-xs leading-relaxed text-gray-500">
            <p>
              Source: Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC) GeoMet · {data.modelsAvailable.join(" / ") || "Model unavailable"}.
            </p>
            <a
              href="https://eccc-msc.github.io/open-data/msc-geomet/readme_en/"
              target="_blank"
              rel="noreferrer"
              className="mt-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-green-800 underline underline-offset-2"
            >
              ECCC model documentation <ExternalLink aria-hidden="true" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </a>
          </footer>
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

### `components/builder/useIgnoredCompatibility.ts`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useCallback, useMemo, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import type { CompatibilityIssue } from "@/lib/compatibility";

const EVENT = "trailpicker:compatibility-ignored";
const storageKey = (buildId: string) => `trailpicker:compatibility-ignored:v1:${buildId}`;

/** A changed issue, item or trip context must be acknowledged again. */
export function issueFingerprint(issue: CompatibilityIssue, context: string) {
  return JSON.stringify([context, issue.id, issue.severity, issue.kind, issue.message, issue.basis, issue.action, issue.itemIds]);
}

export function useIgnoredCompatibility(buildId: string | undefined, issues: readonly CompatibilityIssue[], context: string) {
  const key = buildId ? storageKey(buildId) : null;
  const fingerprints = useMemo(() => new Map(issues.map(issue => [issue.id, issueFingerprint(issue, context)])), [issues, context]);

  const subscribe = useCallback((onChange: () => void) => {
    if (!key) return () => {};
    const onStorage = (event: StorageEvent) => { if (event.key === key) onChange(); };
    window.addEventListener("storage", onStorage);
    window.addEventListener(EVENT, onChange);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("storage", onStorage);
      window.removeEventListener(EVENT, onChange);
    };
  }, [key]);

  const getSnapshot = useCallback(() => {
    try { return key ? window.localStorage.getItem(key) ?? "[]" : "[]"; }
    catch { return "[]"; }
  }, [key]);
  const raw = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, () => "[]");
  const ignored = useMemo(() => {
    let saved: unknown;
    try { saved = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { saved = []; }
    const current = new Set(fingerprints.values());
    return new Set(Array.isArray(saved) ? saved.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === "string" && current.has(value)) : []);
  }, [raw, fingerprints]);

  const toggle = (issue: CompatibilityIssue) => {
    if (!key) return;
    const fingerprint = fingerprints.get(issue.id);
    if (!fingerprint) return;
    // Read the latest storage state to avoid overwriting another mounted panel.
    let saved: unknown;
    try { saved = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(key) ?? "[]"); } catch { saved = []; }
    const current = new Set(fingerprints.values());
    const next = new Set<string>(Array.isArray(saved) ? saved.filter((v): v is string => typeof v === "string" && current.has(v)) : []);
    if (next.has(fingerprint)) next.delete(fingerprint);
    else next.add(fingerprint);
    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify([...next]));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event(EVENT));
    } catch { /* Storage may be blocked; don't claim a dismissal was saved. */ }
  };

  return { ignored, toggle, fingerprints, canIgnore: Boolean(key), ready: true };
}
```

### `components/builder/useIgnoredFindings.ts`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useCallback, useMemo, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import type { Finding } from "@/lib/pack-intelligence";
import { findingAcknowledgementId, findingFingerprint, isFindingIgnored, parseIgnoredFindings } from "@/lib/finding-dismissals";

const CHANGE_EVENT = "trailpicker:ignored-findings-changed";
const storageKey = (buildId: string) => `trailpicker:ignored-findings:v1:${buildId}`;

/** Private-to-this-browser acknowledgement. Public/read-only builds cannot be dismissed. */
export function useIgnoredFindings(buildId: string, findings: readonly Finding[], canIgnore: boolean) {
  const key = canIgnore ? storageKey(buildId) : null;
  const [storageError, setStorageError] = useState(false);
  const subscribe = useCallback((onChange: () => void) => {
    if (!key) return () => {};
    const fromOtherTab = (event: StorageEvent) => { if (event.key === key) onChange(); };
    const fromThisTab = () => onChange();
    window.addEventListener("storage", fromOtherTab);
    window.addEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, fromThisTab);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("storage", fromOtherTab);
      window.removeEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, fromThisTab);
    };
  }, [key]);
  const getSnapshot = useCallback(() => {
    try { return key ? window.localStorage.getItem(key) ?? "{}" : "{}"; }
    catch { return "{}"; }
  }, [key]);
  const raw = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, () => "{}");
  const records = useMemo(() => parseIgnoredFindings(raw), [raw]);
  const ignoredIds = useMemo(() => new Set(findings.filter(f => isFindingIgnored(f, records)).map(f => f.id)), [findings, records]);

  const toggleIgnore = useCallback((finding: Finding) => {
    if (!key) return;
    try {
      // Read at interaction time so two mounted panels cannot overwrite each other.
      const latest = parseIgnoredFindings(window.localStorage.getItem(key));
      const fingerprint = findingFingerprint(finding);
      const acknowledgementId = findingAcknowledgementId(finding);
      if (latest[acknowledgementId] === fingerprint) delete latest[acknowledgementId];
      else latest[acknowledgementId] = fingerprint;
      window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(latest));
      setStorageError(false);
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CHANGE_EVENT));
    } catch {
      setStorageError(true); // Never claim a warning was ignored when storage failed.
    }
  }, [key]);
  return { ignoredIds, toggleIgnore, storageError };
}
```

### `components/builder/WaterPlanningSection.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Droplets, Save, ChevronDown } from "lucide-react";
import type { Waypoint } from "@/lib/trip-planner";
import { calculateWaterLegs, readPrivateResources, type ResourceSettings } from "@/lib/trip-resources";
import { saveTripWaterSettings } from "@/lib/tracked-build-actions";
import {
  ROUTE_WATER_POINTS_CHANGED, ROUTE_WATER_POINTS_REQUEST,
  type RouteWaterPointsChanged, type RouteWaterPointsRequest,
} from "@/lib/route-water-events";

const input = "w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-900 focus:border-green-700 focus:outline-none";

export default function WaterPlanningSection({ buildId, routePoints, logistics }: {
  buildId: string; routePoints: Waypoint[]; logistics: unknown;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const saved = readPrivateResources(logistics).settings;
  const serverKey = JSON.stringify(saved);
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<ResourceSettings>(() => saved);
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [source, setSource] = useState<RouteWaterPointsChanged | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!dirty) setSettings(readPrivateResources(logistics).settings);
    // Server props are authoritative only when local settings aren't dirty.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [serverKey]);
  useEffect(() => {
    setSource(null);
    const update = (event: Event) => {
      const detail = (event as CustomEvent<RouteWaterPointsChanged>).detail;
      if (detail?.buildId === buildId) setSource(detail);
    };
    window.addEventListener(ROUTE_WATER_POINTS_CHANGED, update);
    const request: RouteWaterPointsRequest = { buildId, respond: setSource };
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(ROUTE_WATER_POINTS_REQUEST, { detail: request }));
    return () => window.removeEventListener(ROUTE_WATER_POINTS_CHANGED, update);
  }, [buildId]);
  const points = source?.buildId === buildId ? source.points : routePoints;
  const legs = useMemo(() => calculateWaterLegs(points, settings), [points, settings]);
  const refills = points.filter(p => p.kind === "water" && p.resource?.refillConfirmed && p.resource?.waterReliability !== "unavailable").length;
  const update = (key: keyof ResourceSettings, value: string, min: number, max: number) => {
    const n = Number(value);
    if (value.trim() === "" || !Number.isFinite(n)) return;
    setSettings(current => ({ ...current, [key]: Math.max(min, Math.min(max, n)) }));
    setDirty(true); setMessage("");
  };
  async function save() {
    if (!dirty || saving) return;
    setSaving(true); setMessage("");
    try {
      const form = new FormData();
      form.set("buildId", buildId);
      form.set("waterSettings", JSON.stringify(settings));
      await saveTripWaterSettings(form);
      setDirty(false); setMessage("Water settings saved.");
      router.refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not save water settings.");
    } finally { setSaving(false); }
  }
  return <section aria-label="Water planning" className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 sm:p-5">
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
      <div><h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-bold text-gray-950"><Droplets className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-700"/>Water planning</h3>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">Carry estimates based on your mapped route and selected refill stops.</p></div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        {dirty && <><span className="text-xs font-medium text-amber-800">Unsaved settings</span>
          <button type="button" onClick={save} disabled={saving}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-green-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-40"><Save className="h-3.5 w-3.5"/>{saving ? "Saving…" : "Save water"}</button></>}
        <button type="button" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50"
          onClick={() => setOpen(value => !value)} aria-expanded={open}><ChevronDown className={`h-4 w-4 transition-transform ${open ? "rotate-180" : ""}`}/>Water settings</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-x-5 gap-y-1 text-xs text-gray-700">
      <span>Capacity: <strong>{settings.capacityL} L</strong></span>
      <span>Reserve: <strong>{settings.reserveL} L</strong></span>
      <span>Planned refill stops: <strong>{refills}</strong></span>
    </div>
    {open && <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 border-t border-gray-100 pt-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
      {([ ["rateLph", "Usage assumption (L/hour)", 0.1, 2, 0.1],
          ["reserveL", "Reserve (L)", 0, 5, 0.25],
          ["capacityL", "Carry capacity (L)", 0.25, 20, 0.25] ] as const).map(([key, label, min, max, step]) =>
        <label className="block space-y-1 text-xs font-medium text-gray-700" key={key}>{label}
          <input type="number" inputMode="decimal" min={min} max={max} step={step} className={input}
            value={settings[key]} onChange={e => update(key, e.target.value, min, max)}/>
        </label>)}
      <p role="status" className="text-xs text-gray-600 sm:col-span-3">{message || (dirty ? "Save your new water settings before leaving the page." : "Saved water settings")}</p>
    </div>}
    {!legs.length ? <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-gray-500">Add at least two itinerary stops to estimate water between them.</p> :
      <div className="mt-4 overflow-x-auto"><table className="w-full text-left text-xs"><thead><tr className="border-b border-gray-200 text-gray-600"><th className="py-2 pr-3">From → to</th><th className="py-2 pr-3">Trail distance</th><th className="py-2 pr-3">Moving hours</th><th className="py-2">Estimated need</th></tr></thead><tbody>
        {legs.map((leg, i) => <tr key={i} className="border-b border-gray-100"><td className="py-2 pr-3 font-medium">{leg.from} → {leg.to}</td><td className="py-2 pr-3">{leg.distanceKm === null ? "Unknown" : `${leg.distanceKm} km`}</td><td className="py-2 pr-3">{leg.movingHours === null ? "Unknown" : `${leg.movingHours} h`}</td><td className="py-2">
          {leg.requiredL === null ? <span className="text-gray-500">Incomplete route data</span> : <span className={leg.exceedsCapacity ? "font-semibold text-amber-800" : "font-semibold text-gray-900"}>{leg.requiredL} L including reserve{leg.exceedsCapacity ? " · Above capacity" : ""}</span>}
          <span className="block text-gray-500">{leg.note}</span>
        </td></tr>)}
      </tbody></table></div>}
    {source?.draft && <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-amber-800">Estimates use unsaved route edits. Save route to keep the waypoint changes.</p>}
    <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-5 text-gray-500">Planning estimates only. Check water availability and safety independently; conditions and needs can vary. Unverified water sources are not guaranteed refills.</p>
  </section>;
}
```

### `components/builder/WeightSummary.tsx`

```typescript
type Props = {
    base: number;
    consumable: number;
    worn: number;
    total: number;
    plannedConsumables?: number;
    plannedUnknown?: boolean;
};

function toLb(grams: number) {
    return (grams / 453.592).toFixed(2);
}

export default function WeightSummary({
    base,
    consumable,
    worn,
    total,
    plannedConsumables = 0,
    plannedUnknown = false,
}: Props) {
    const adjustedTotal = total + plannedConsumables;
    const basePct = adjustedTotal > 0 ? (base / adjustedTotal) * 100 : 0;
    const wornPct = adjustedTotal > 0 ? (worn / adjustedTotal) * 100 : 0;
    const consumablePct = adjustedTotal > 0 ? (consumable / adjustedTotal) * 100 : 0;
    const plannedPct = adjustedTotal > 0 ? (plannedConsumables / adjustedTotal) * 100 : 0;

    return (
        <section className="mt-10 border-t border-gray-200 pt-6">
            <div className="flex items-end justify-between">
                <div>
                    <h2 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-400">
                        Weight Breakdown
                    </h2>

                    <p className="mt-1 text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">
                        {adjustedTotal}
                        <span className="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900">g</span>
                        <span className="ml-2 text-base font-medium text-gray-400">
                            ({toLb(adjustedTotal)} lb)
                        </span>
                    </p>
                </div>


            </div>

            {(plannedConsumables > 0 || plannedUnknown) && <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-5 text-gray-500">Includes additional food/fuel from your private trip plan, not added as Builder gear. {plannedUnknown ? "Some food has unknown weight; the total is known mass only." : ""}</p>}

            <div className="mt-4 flex h-2 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-gray-100">
                <div
                    className="h-full bg-blue-500 transition-all"
                    style={{ width: `${basePct}%` }}
                />
                <div
                    className="h-full bg-amber-400 transition-all"
                    style={{ width: `${wornPct}%` }}
                />
                <div
                    className="h-full bg-emerald-400 transition-all"
                    style={{ width: `${consumablePct}%` }}
                />
                {plannedConsumables > 0 && <div className="h-full bg-green-800" style={{width:`${plannedPct}%`}} />}
            </div>

            <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-8 gap-y-2 text-sm">
                <Stat dot="bg-blue-500" label="Base" grams={base} />
                <Stat dot="bg-amber-400" label="Worn" grams={worn} />
                <Stat dot="bg-emerald-400" label="Builder consumable" grams={consumable} />
                {(plannedConsumables > 0 || plannedUnknown) && <Stat dot="bg-green-800" label="Additional planned food/fuel (known)" grams={plannedConsumables} />}
            </div>
        </section>
    );
}

function Stat({
    dot,
    label,
    grams,
}: {
    dot: string;
    label: string;
    grams: number;
}) {
    return (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 max-md:flex-wrap">
            <span className={`h-2 w-2 rounded-full ${dot}`} />
            <span className="text-gray-500">{label}</span>
            <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{grams}g</span>
            <span className="text-gray-400">({toLb(grams)} lb)</span>
        </div>
    );
}
```

```typescript
          </div>

              <Field label="Maximum listed distance" hint="Catalog distance may be one-way, return, or unspecified."><select name="distance" defaultValue={preferences.distance??"any"} className={inputClass}><option value="any">No preference</option><option value="5">Up to 5 km</option><option value="10">Up to 10 km</option><option value="15">Up to 15 km</option><option value="25">Up to 25 km</option></select></Field>
              <Field label="Maximum recorded gain" hint="Gain is missing for many catalog entries."><select name="gain" defaultValue={preferences.gain??"any"} className={inputClass}><option value="any">No preference</option><option value="300">Up to 300 m</option><option value="600">Up to 600 m</option><option value="1000">Up to 1,000 m</option></select></Field>
              <Field label="Bringing a dog?" hint="Only explicitly allowed policies qualify."><select name="dogs" defaultValue={preferences.dogs??"any"} className={inputClass}><option value="any">No requirement</option><option value="yes">Confirmed dog access</option></select></Field>
              <Field label="Need toilets?"><select name="toilets" defaultValue={preferences.toilets??"any"} className={inputClass}><option value="any">No requirement</option><option value="yes">Confirmed toilets</option></select></Field>
              <Field label="Need food storage?"><select name="storage" defaultValue={preferences.storage??"any"} className={inputClass}><option value="any">No requirement</option><option value="yes">Confirmed food storage</option></select></Field>
            </div>
            <fieldset><legend className="mb-3 text-sm font-semibold">What matters most?</legend><div className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
              <RadioTile name="priority" value="balanced" title="Balanced matches" desc="A bit of everything" selected={preferences.priority==="balanced"}/>
              <RadioTile name="priority" value="facilities" title="Listed facilities" desc="Toilets and food storage" selected={preferences.priority==="facilities"}/>

              <RadioTile name="priority" value="featured" title="Catalog highlights" desc="Favor featured places" selected={preferences.priority==="featured"}/>
            </div></fieldset>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4"><p className="max-w-xl text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">Unknown distance and gain values may still appear, clearly marked. Verify current access and park rules before planning.</p><button type="submit" className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-green-900 px-5 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-green-800">Apply refinements <ArrowRight size={16}/></button></div>
          </div>

Broaden the region, activity, scenery, or confirmed facilities."}</p></div><Link href="/discover/search" className="inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-white"><Search size={15}/> Search everything</Link></div>
        <div className="grid gap-4">{matches.map((match,index)=><MatchCard key={match.destination.id} match={match} index={index}/>)}</div>
        {matches.length>0&&<p className="mt-5 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 p-4 text-xs leading-6 text-amber-900"><Info size={15} className="mr-1 inline"/> These suggestions are not verified hiking routes, campsite assignments, or forecasts. Confirm access, actual distance, park rules, and conditions before leaving.</p>}
      </section>}
    </div>
  </main>;
}
```

```typescript
  saved: boolean;
  signedIn: boolean;

};

  easy: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800",
  moderate: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-800",
  hard: "bg-rose-50 text-rose-800",
};
const labelKind = (kind: string | undefined) => (kind ?? "campground").replaceAll("-", " ").replace(/\b\w/g, letter => letter.toUpperCase());
const labelActivity = (activity: string) => activity.replaceAll("-", " ").replace(/\b\w/g, letter => letter.toUpperCase());

function Stat({ icon: Icon, label, value }: { icon: typeof Compass; label: string; value: string }) {
  return <div className="flex min-h-24 flex-col justify-center rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4">
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500"><Icon size={15} className="text-emerald-700" aria-hidden="true" />{label}</span>
    <strong className="mt-2 break-words text-lg font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900">{value}</strong>
  </div>;
}

function Fact({ icon: Icon, label, value, caution }: { icon: typeof Compass; label: string; value: string; caution?: boolean }) {
  return <div className="flex items-start gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 py-3.5 last:border-b-0">

    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1"><dt className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">{label}</dt><dd className={`mt-0.5 text-sm font-semibold ${caution ? "text-amber-800" : "text-slate-900"}`}>{value}</dd></div>
  </div>;
}

function RelatedCard({ item }: { item: RelatedDestination }) {

      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{relation === "same-park" ? `In ${destination.park}` : destination.park}{straightLineKm !== null ? ` · about ${straightLineKm.toFixed(1)} km away` : ""}</p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">{destination.summary}</p>
    </div><ArrowRight size={16} className="mt-1 shrink-0 text-slate-400 group-hover:text-emerald-700" aria-hidden="true" />
  </Link>;
}

            <dl className="mt-2">
              <Fact icon={PawPrint} label="Dogs" value={dogsLabel(destination.dogs)} caution={destination.dogs === "check-current-rules"} />
              <Fact icon={CalendarClock} label="Camping or park permits" value={permitLabel(destination.reservations)} caution={destination.reservations === "check-current-rules"} />
              {campground && <Fact icon={Tent} label="Listed tent sites" value={destination.tentSites === null ? "Not provided" : String(destination.tentSites)} />}
            </dl>
            <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">Rules vary by activity and season. A camping reservation is not the same as a day-use permit.</p>
          </section>

          {hasFacilityData && <section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5">
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold">Facilities</h2>
            <dl className="mt-2">
              {destination.toilet != null && <Fact icon={Toilet} label="Toilets" value={facilityLabel(destination.toilet)} caution={destination.toilet === "unknown" || destination.toilet === "seasonal"} />}
              {destination.foodStorage != null && <Fact icon={Warehouse} label="Provided food storage" value={facilityLabel(destination.foodStorage)} caution={destination.foodStorage === "unknown" || destination.foodStorage === "seasonal"} />}
              {destination.toilet == null && destination.foodStorage == null && <p className="py-2 text-sm text-slate-500">Facilities have not been assessed.</p>}
            </dl>
            {!campground && <p className="mt-2 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 p-3 text-xs leading-5 text-amber-950">These facilities may be at a nearby designated campground rather than along the hike. Read the location notes and official source.</p>}
            <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">“Not confirmed” means the catalog cannot establish availability, not that a facility is absent. “Seasonal” is not a year-round guarantee.</p>
          </section>}

          <section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5">
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold">Official information &amp; booking</h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">Confirm access, advisories, permitted activities and current regulations with the park or operator.</p>
            <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
              {source ? <a href={source} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="inline-flex min-h-11 w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-green-900 hover:bg-emerald-50">Destination source <ExternalLink size={16} aria-hidden="true" /></a> : <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">No destination source linked.</p>}
              {booking && <a href={booking} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="inline-flex min-h-11 w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-green-900 hover:bg-emerald-50">Reservation information <ExternalLink size={16} aria-hidden="true" /></a>}
            </div>
          </section>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-12 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-200 pt-5 text-sm text-slate-500">
        <Link href="/discover/search" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold text-green-900 hover:underline"><ArrowLeft size={16} aria-hidden="true" />Back to Discover</Link>
        <p>Destination information is a planning reference, not live trail conditions.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </main>;
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { ImageOff, Mountain } from "lucide-react";
import { discoverPhotoUrl, discoverPhotoSource, getDiscoverPhoto } from "@/lib/discover-photos";
import type { Destination } from "@/lib/destinations";

export default function DestinationDetailHero({ destination }: { destination: Destination }) {
  const [error, setError] = useState(false);
  const photo = getDiscoverPhoto(destination);
  return <div className="relative isolate aspect-[1.38/1] w-full overflow-hidden rounded-[22px] bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-200 via-emerald-100 to-emerald-900 sm:aspect-[2.3/1] lg:aspect-[2.9/1]">
    {photo && !error ? <>
      {/* Wikimedia Commons photo with a visible, clickable licence credit. */}
      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
      <img
        src={discoverPhotoUrl(photo)}
        alt={photo.representative ? `Representative park scenery: ${photo.description}` : photo.description}
        className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover"
        loading="eager"
        referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
        onError={() => setError(true)}
      />
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-24 bg-gradient-to-t from-slate-950/65 to-transparent" />
      <a href={discoverPhotoSource(photo)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="absolute bottom-3 right-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-950/70 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-white backdrop-blur-sm hover:bg-slate-950/90">
        {photo.representative ? "Area photo" : "Photo"} · {photo.author} · {photo.license}
      </a>
    </> : <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 text-emerald-950/55">
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="absolute -bottom-40 left-[-20%] h-96 w-[70%] rotate-[-25deg] rounded-[50%] bg-green-950/15" />
      <Mountain size={56} className="relative" strokeWidth={1.2} aria-hidden="true" />
      <span className="relative inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium"><ImageOff size={15} aria-hidden="true" /> Photo not available</span>
      <span className="relative text-xs">No unrelated photo substituted</span>
    </div>}
  </div>;
}
```

### `components/discover/DestinationSaveButton.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useFormStatus } from "react-dom";
import { Bookmark, BookmarkCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { changeSavedDestination } from "@/app/discover/actions";

function SaveSubmit({ saved, compact }: { saved: boolean; compact: boolean }) {
  const { pending } = useFormStatus();
  const Icon = saved ? BookmarkCheck : Bookmark;
  return <button type="submit" disabled={pending} aria-label={saved ? "Remove saved destination" : "Save destination"}
    aria-pressed={saved}
    className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-xl border font-semibold transition disabled:opacity-60 ${compact ? "min-h-10 px-3 py-2 text-xs" : "h-11 px-4 text-sm"} ${saved ? "border-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 text-green-900 hover:bg-emerald-100" : "border-slate-200 bg-white text-green-900 hover:bg-emerald-50"}`}>
    <Icon size={16} aria-hidden="true"/>{!compact && (pending ? "Working…" : saved ? "Saved" : "Save destination")}
  </button>;
}

export default function DestinationSaveButton({ destinationId, saved, signedIn, compact = false }:
  { destinationId: string; saved: boolean; signedIn: boolean; compact?: boolean }) {
  if (!signedIn) return <Link href="/api/auth/signin?callbackUrl=%2Fdiscover%3Fview%3Dsaved"
    aria-label="Sign in to save destination"
    className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white font-semibold text-green-900 hover:bg-emerald-50 ${compact ? "min-h-10 px-3 py-2 text-xs" : "h-11 px-4 text-sm"}`}>
    <Bookmark size={16} aria-hidden="true" />{!compact && "Sign in to save"}</Link>;
  return <form action={changeSavedDestination} className="flex items-stretch">
    <input type="hidden" name="destinationId" value={destinationId}/>
    <input type="hidden" name="intent" value={saved ? "unsave" : "save"}/>
    <SaveSubmit saved={saved} compact={compact}/>
  </form>;
}
```
