### `components/discover/DestinationTripForm.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useFormStatus } from "react-dom";
import { ArrowRight, CalendarDays, ClipboardList, LockKeyhole, Users } from "lucide-react";
import { startDestinationPlan } from "@/app/discover/actions";
import { discoverTripPreview } from "@/lib/discover-trip";
import type { Destination } from "@/lib/destinations";

function SubmitPlanButton({disabled}: {disabled: boolean}) {
  const { pending } = useFormStatus();
  return <button type="submit" disabled={disabled || pending} className="inline-flex min-h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-green-900 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-green-800 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50">
    {pending ? "Creating your trip..." : "Create trip & open planner"}
    {!pending && <ArrowRight size={17} aria-hidden="true" />}
  </button>;
}

const inputClass = "min-h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 outline-none transition focus:border-emerald-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-600/10";
const dateFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", { month: "short", day: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" });

export default function DestinationTripForm({destination}: {destination: Destination}) {
  const [name, setName] = useState(`${destination.name.slice(0, 92)} trip`);
  const [start, setStart] = useState("");
  const [end, setEnd] = useState("");
  const [people, setPeople] = useState("1");
  const [seed, setSeed] = useState(true);
  const preview = useMemo(() => discoverTripPreview(destination.name, start, end), [destination.name, start, end]);
  const peopleNumber = Number(people);
  const invalid = Boolean(preview.error) || !name.trim() || name.length > 100 ||
    !Number.isInteger(peopleNumber) || peopleNumber < 1 || peopleNumber > 100;

  return <section aria-labelledby="plan-trip-heading" className="scroll-mt-24 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-emerald-900/15 bg-white shadow-sm">
    <div className="bg-green-900 px-5 py-5 text-white">
      <h2 id="plan-trip-heading" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-lg font-bold"><CalendarDays size={20} aria-hidden="true" />Plan your trip</h2>
      <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-white/80">Start a trip with {destination.name} already selected.</p>
    </div>
    <form action={startDestinationPlan} className="space-y-4 p-5">
      <input type="hidden" name="destinationId" value={destination.id} />
      <input type="hidden" name="discoverPlan" value="1" />
      <div>
        <label htmlFor={`trip-name-${destination.id}`} className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Trip name</label>
        <input id={`trip-name-${destination.id}`} name="name" value={name} maxLength={100} required onChange={event => setName(event.target.value)} className={inputClass} />
      </div>
      <div>
        <div className="mb-1.5 flex items-center justify-between"><span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Trip dates</span><span className="text-xs text-slate-500">Optional</span></div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          <div><label htmlFor={`trip-start-${destination.id}`} className="mb-1 block text-xs text-slate-500">Start</label>
            <input id={`trip-start-${destination.id}`} type="date" name="startDate" value={start} onChange={event => setStart(event.target.value)} className={inputClass} /></div>
          <div><label htmlFor={`trip-end-${destination.id}`} className="mb-1 block text-xs text-slate-500">End</label>
            <input id={`trip-end-${destination.id}`} type="date" name="endDate" min={start || undefined} value={end} onChange={event => setEnd(event.target.value)} className={inputClass} /></div>
        </div>
        {preview.error && <p role="alert" className="mt-2 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-700">{preview.error}</p>}
      </div>
      <div>
        <label htmlFor={`trip-people-${destination.id}`} className="mb-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700"><Users size={14} aria-hidden="true" />Travellers</label>
        <input id={`trip-people-${destination.id}`} type="number" inputMode="numeric" name="people" min="1" max="100" step="1" required value={people} onChange={event => setPeople(event.target.value)} className={inputClass} />
      </div>
      <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-3">
        <input type="checkbox" name="seedItinerary" value="1" checked={seed} onChange={event => setSeed(event.target.checked)} className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 accent-green-800" />
        <span className="min-w-0"><span className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">Add starter itinerary</span>
          <span className="mt-0.5 block text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">Editable day descriptions, not a verified hiking route.</span></span>
      </label>
      {preview.count > 0 && <section aria-label="Itinerary preview" className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50/60 p-3">
        <h3 className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-green-900"><ClipboardList size={14} aria-hidden="true" />{preview.count} {preview.count === 1 ? "day" : "days"} in your planner</h3>
        {seed ? <ol className="mt-2 space-y-2">{preview.days.map(item => <li key={item.day} className="flex gap-2 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-700">
          <span className="shrink-0 font-bold text-green-900">Day {item.day}</span>
          <span className="text-slate-400">{dateFormat.format(new Date(`${item.date}T00:00:00Z`))}</span>
          <span className="min-w-0">{item.activities}</span>
        </li>)}</ol> : <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-600">Blank editable day records will be created.</p>}
        {preview.count > preview.days.length && <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-slate-500">Showing the first two and last day. All {preview.count} dates will be added.</p>}
      </section>}
      <SubmitPlanButton disabled={invalid} />
      <p className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500"><LockKeyhole size={14} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />New Discover plans start private. Dates and day notes can be edited in Trip Planner.</p>
      <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">Official park information and access cautions are copied to Trip Logistics. No route, campsite or booking is assumed.</p>
    </form>
  </section>;
}


```

### `components/discover/DiscoverDestinationMapView.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowRight, Footprints, MapPin, Mountain, Navigation, Route } from "lucide-react";
import type { Destination } from "@/lib/destinations";
import { destinationHref } from "@/lib/destination-detail";
import { getDiscoverPhoto, discoverPhotoUrl } from "@/lib/discover-photos";
import DiscoverSearchMap from "./DiscoverSearchMap";

type Unmapped = Pick<Destination, "id" | "name" | "park" | "region" | "difficulty">;

function Photo({destination}: {destination: Destination}) {
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const photo = getDiscoverPhoto(destination);
  return <div className="relative h-28 w-full shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-100 via-emerald-100 to-emerald-700 sm:h-32">
    {photo && !failed ? (
      // Remote Commons images are served directly, as with the existing Discover cards.
      // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
      <img src={discoverPhotoUrl(photo)} alt={photo.description} loading="lazy" onError={() => setFailed(true)} referrerPolicy="no-referrer" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
    ) : <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center text-emerald-900/50"><Mountain size={34} strokeWidth={1.4} aria-hidden="true" /></div>}
  </div>;
}

const difficultyStyle: Record<Destination["difficulty"], string> = {
  easy: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800",
  moderate: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-800",
  hard: "bg-rose-50 text-rose-800",
};

export default function DiscoverDestinationMapView({
  mapped, unmapped,
}: {
  mapped: Destination[];
  unmapped: Unmapped[];
}) {
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  // In case the user changes server-side filters while staying in map mode.
  const resultKey = mapped.map(destination => destination.id).join("|");
  useEffect(() => { setSelectedId(null); }, [resultKey]);
  const selected = mapped.find(destination => destination.id === selectedId) ?? null;

  return <section aria-label="Destination map results" className="mt-4">
    <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-sm">
      <p className="flex items-center gap-2 font-medium text-slate-700">
        <MapPin size={16} className="text-emerald-700" aria-hidden="true" />
        {mapped.length} of {mapped.length + unmapped.length} matching destinations have mapped locations
      </p>
      <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">Only confirmed catalog coordinates are pinned.</span>
    </div>
    {mapped.length ? <div className="grid overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm lg:grid-cols-[minmax(270px,340px)_minmax(0,1fr)] xl:grid-cols-[minmax(290px,380px)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
      <div className="order-2 flex min-h-0 flex-col border-t border-slate-200 lg:order-1 lg:h-[560px] lg:border-r lg:border-t-0">
        {selected && <div className="border-b border-slate-200 p-3 sm:p-4" aria-live="polite">
          <Photo destination={selected} />
          <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1"><h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">{selected.name}</h3><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{selected.park} · {selected.region}</p></div>
            <span className={`shrink-0 rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold capitalize ${difficultyStyle[selected.difficulty]}`}>{selected.difficulty}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
            {selected.distanceKm != null && <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><Footprints size={13} />{selected.distanceKm} km listed</span>}
            {selected.elevationGainM != null && <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><Mountain size={13} />{selected.elevationGainM} m gain</span>}
          </div>
          <Link href={destinationHref(selected.id)} className="mt-3 inline-flex min-h-10 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-green-900 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-green-800">
            Explore destination <ArrowRight size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
          </Link>
        </div>}
        <div className="max-h-[330px] overflow-y-auto p-2 sm:p-3 lg:max-h-none lg:min-h-0 lg:flex-1" aria-label="Mapped destination list">
          <p className="px-2 py-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">Mapped places</p>
          <div className="space-y-1">
            {mapped.map(destination => <div key={destination.id} className={`flex items-stretch gap-2 rounded-xl border transition ${selectedId === destination.id ? "border-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50" : "border-transparent hover:border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50"}`}>
              <button type="button" aria-pressed={selectedId === destination.id} onClick={() => setSelectedId(destination.id)} className="min-w-0 flex-1 px-3 py-3 text-left focus-visible:rounded-xl focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-green-900">
                <span className="block truncate text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">{destination.name}</span>
                <span className="mt-1 block truncate text-xs text-slate-500">{destination.region} · {destination.park}</span>
              </button>
              <Link href={destinationHref(destination.id)} aria-label={`Open ${destination.name}`} className="flex w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-r-xl text-green-900 hover:bg-emerald-100 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-green-900"><ArrowRight size={16} /></Link>
            </div>)}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="order-1 min-w-0 lg:order-2">
        <DiscoverSearchMap destinations={mapped} selectedId={selectedId} onSelect={setSelectedId} />
      </div>
    </div> : <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white px-5 py-10 text-center">
      <Navigation size={30} className="mx-auto text-slate-400" aria-hidden="true" />
      <h3 className="mt-3 font-bold text-slate-900">No mapped locations for this search</h3>
      <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-md text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">These destinations don't have verified coordinates in the catalog yet. You can still open any destination below or switch back to Grid.</p>
    </div>}
    {unmapped.length > 0 && <details className="mt-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm">
      <summary className="cursor-pointer px-4 py-4 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-50 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-green-900">
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><Route size={16} className="text-slate-500" aria-hidden="true" /> {unmapped.length} additional {unmapped.length === 1 ? "destination" : "destinations"} without map coordinates</span>
      </summary>
      <p className="border-t border-slate-100 px-4 pt-3 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-600">These are real search results, not missing from Discover. Their locations haven't been verified for map pins.</p>
      <ul className="grid max-h-72 grid-cols-1 gap-x-2 overflow-y-auto px-2 pb-3 pt-2 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
        {unmapped.map(destination => <li key={destination.id}>
          <Link href={destinationHref(destination.id)} className="flex min-h-12 items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm hover:bg-slate-50 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-green-900">
            <span className="min-w-0"><span className="block truncate font-semibold text-slate-800">{destination.name}</span><span className="block truncate text-xs text-slate-500">{destination.region} · {destination.park}</span></span>
            <ArrowRight size={14} className="shrink-0 text-green-800" aria-hidden="true" />
          </Link>
        </li>)}
      </ul>
    </details>}
  </section>;
}

```

### `components/discover/DiscoverHeader.tsx`

```typescript
import Link from "next/link";
import {ArrowLeft, Bookmark, Compass, Search, UsersRound, WandSparkles} from "lucide-react";

type Section="home" | "search" | "find" | "community" | "saved";
const names: Record<Section,string> = {
  home:"Discover",search:"Destination search",find:"Find adventure",community:"Community",saved:"Saved",
};
/** Breadcrumb and contextual actions, not another nested tab system. */
export default function DiscoverHeader({active="home",back=false}: {active?: Section;back?:boolean}) {
  const action = active === "find" || active === "search"
    ? {href:active==="find"?"/discover/search":"/discover/find",label:active==="find"?"Search catalog":"Find adventure",Icon:active==="find"?Search:WandSparkles}
    : {href:active==="community"?"/discover/search":"/discover/community",label:active==="community"?"Explore places":"Community",Icon:active==="community"?Search:UsersRound};
  return <div className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-800">
    <nav aria-label="Discover breadcrumb and actions" className="mx-auto flex max-w-screen-2xl items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
      <Link href="/discover" className="inline-flex min-h-10 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-1 text-sm font-semibold text-green-800 hover:underline">{back?<ArrowLeft size={17}/>:<Compass size={18}/>} Discover</Link>
      {active!=="home"&&<><span className="text-slate-300" aria-hidden="true">/</span><span className="hidden truncate text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500 sm:inline">{names[active]}</span></>}
      <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-1 sm:gap-2">
        {active!=="saved"&&<Link href={action.href} className="inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-emerald-50 hover:text-green-800 sm:text-sm"><action.Icon size={16}/><span className="hidden min-[480px]:inline">{action.label}</span></Link>}
        <Link href="/discover/saved" aria-current={active==="saved"?"page":undefined} aria-label="Saved items" className={`inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-3 text-xs font-semibold transition sm:text-sm ${active==="saved"?"bg-emerald-50 text-green-800":"text-slate-600 hover:bg-emerald-50 hover:text-green-800"}`}><Bookmark size={16}/> <span className="hidden sm:inline">Saved</span></Link>
      </div>
    </nav>
  </div>;
}

```

```typescript
import Link from "next/link";
import {
  ArrowRight, Backpack, Bookmark, MapPin, Mountain,
  Search, Sparkles, Tent, UsersRound,
} from "lucide-react";
import { DESTINATIONS, getDestination, type Destination } from "@/lib/destinations";
import { destinationHref } from "@/lib/destination-detail";
import { getDiscoverPhoto, discoverPhotoUrl, discoverPhotoSource } from "@/lib/discover-photos";

// These are editorial picks, not a ranking of current trail safety or availability.
const editorialIds = [
  "elfin-lakes",
  "garibaldi-lake-destination",
  "berg-lake-trail",
  "nels-bight-cape-scott",
];

function getSpotlights(): Destination[] {
  const chosen = editorialIds
    .map(id => getDestination(id))
    .filter((destination): destination is Destination => Boolean(destination));
  // The catalog can change. Fall back to existing featured records, not invented entries.
  for (const destination of DESTINATIONS) {
    if (chosen.length >= 4) break;
    if (destination.featured && !chosen.some(item => item.id === destination.id)) chosen.push(destination);
  }
  return chosen.slice(0, 4);
}

function DestinationCard({ destination }: { destination: Destination }) {
  const photo = getDiscoverPhoto(destination);
  const href = destinationHref(destination.id);
  return (
    <article className="group min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm transition duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-green-200 hover:shadow-md">
      <div className="relative aspect-[1.65/1] overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-100 via-emerald-100 to-green-700">
        {photo ? (
          <>
            <Link href={href} aria-label={`View ${destination.name}`} className="absolute inset-0 z-0">
              {/* Existing photo URLs and attribution come from TrailPicker's catalog. */}
              {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
              <img
                src={discoverPhotoUrl(photo)}
                alt={photo.representative ? `Representative scenery in ${destination.park}` : photo.description}
                loading="lazy"
                referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                className="h-full w-full object-cover transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-[1.035]"
              />
            </Link>
            <a href={discoverPhotoSource(photo)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="absolute bottom-2 right-2 z-10 max-w-[92%] truncate rounded-md bg-black/65 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] text-white hover:bg-black/80">
              {photo.representative ? "Area photo" : "Photo"} · {photo.author} · {photo.license}
            </a>
          </>
        ) : (
          <Link href={href} className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-center text-green-900/45" aria-label={`View ${destination.name}`}>
            <Mountain size={46} strokeWidth={1.25} aria-hidden="true" />
          </Link>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="flex min-h-[145px] flex-col p-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
          <MapPin size={13} className="text-green-700" aria-hidden="true" />
          <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{destination.region}</span>
          <span className="ml-auto shrink-0 rounded-md bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 font-medium capitalize text-slate-600">{destination.difficulty}</span>
        </div>
        <h3 className="mt-2 line-clamp-2 text-base font-bold leading-snug text-slate-900">
          <Link href={href} className="transition hover:text-green-800 focus-visible:underline">{destination.name}</Link>
        </h3>
        <p className="mt-1 line-clamp-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{destination.park}</p>
        <p className="mt-auto pt-3 text-xs text-slate-500">{destination.distanceKm === null ? "Distance not listed" : `${Number(destination.distanceKm.toFixed(1))} km listed`}</p>
        <Link href={`${href}#plan-trip-heading`} className="mt-3 inline-flex min-h-10 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-green-900 px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-green-800 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-green-700">Plan this destination <ArrowRight size={15} aria-hidden="true" /></Link>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

const quickSearches = [
  { label: "Alpine lakes", href: "/discover/search?q=lake" },
  { label: "Garibaldi", href: "/discover/search?q=Garibaldi" },
  { label: "Coastal trails", href: "/discover/search?q=coast" },
];

export default function DiscoverHome() {
  const spotlights = getSpotlights();
  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 pb-16 text-slate-900">
      <div className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-white">

          <div>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-slate-900">Discover</h1>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">Find places, explore ideas, and start planning.</p>
          </div>
          <nav aria-label="Discover shortcuts" className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
```

```typescript
      <p className="mt-3 line-clamp-2 min-h-10 text-sm leading-5 text-slate-600">{destination.summary}</p>
      <div className="mt-3"><DestinationMeta destination={destination}/></div>
      <div className="mt-auto flex items-center gap-2 pt-5">
        <Link href={`${destinationHref(destination.id)}#plan-trip-heading`} className="inline-flex min-h-10 min-w-0 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-green-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-green-800 sm:text-sm">Plan this destination <ArrowRight size={15} aria-hidden="true" /></Link>
        <DestinationSaveButton destinationId={destination.id} saved={saved} signedIn={signedIn} compact/>
        {isHttpUrl(destination.sourceUrl) && <a href={destination.sourceUrl} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label={`Official information for ${destination.name}`} className="inline-flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-slate-50 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-green-800"><ExternalLink size={16} aria-hidden="true" /></a>}
      </div>
    </div>
  </article>;
}

function SpotlightCard({destination, saved, signedIn}: {destination: Destination; saved: boolean; signedIn: boolean}) {
  return <article className="group relative isolate flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-[22px] border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm transition duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-lg">
    <DestinationVisual destination={destination} large />
    <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col px-4 pb-4 pt-4 sm:px-5">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-green-50 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-green-800"><Sparkles size={12} /> Featured</span>
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">{formatKind(destination.kind)}</span>
      </div>
      <h3 className="mt-2 text-xl font-bold text-slate-950"><Link href={destinationHref(destination.id)} className="hover:text-green-800 focus-visible:underline">{destination.name}</Link></h3>
      <p className="mt-1 flex items-start gap-1 text-xs text-slate-500"><MapPin size={13} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />{destination.region} · {destination.park}</p>
      <div className="mt-3"><DestinationMeta destination={destination}/></div>
      <div className="mt-auto flex gap-2 pt-4">
        <Link href={`${destinationHref(destination.id)}#plan-trip-heading`} className="inline-flex min-h-10 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-green-900 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-green-800">Plan this destination <ArrowRight size={14} aria-hidden="true" /></Link>
        <DestinationSaveButton destinationId={destination.id} saved={saved} signedIn={signedIn} compact/>
      </div>
    </div>
  </article>;
}

const activities: {value: DiscoverActivity; label: string; Icon: typeof Compass}[] = [
  {value: "all", label: "Everything", Icon: Compass},
  {value: "hiking", label: "Hiking", Icon: Footprints},
  {value: "backpacking", label: "Backpacking", Icon: Backpack},
  {value: "camping", label: "Camping", Icon: Tent},
  {value: "paddling", label: "Paddling", Icon: Waves},
];
const categories: {value: DiscoverCategory; label: string}[] = [
  {value: "all", label: "All places"}, {value: "trail", label: "Trails"}, {value: "lake", label: "Lakes"},
  {value: "summit", label: "Summits"}, {value: "waterfall", label: "Waterfalls"},
  {value: "campground", label: "Campgrounds"}, {value: "coastal", label: "Coastal"},
  {value: "viewpoint", label: "Viewpoints"}, {value: "other", label: "Other places"},
];
const popularRegions = ["Lower Mainland", "Sea to Sky", "Vancouver Island", "Canadian Rockies"] as const;

export default function DiscoverLanding({entries, destinations, mapDestinations = [], unmappedDestinations = [], featuredDestinations, regions, filters, total, totalPages, signedIn, savedDestinationIds = []}: Props) {
  const savedDestinations = new Set(savedDestinationIds);
  const [q, setQ] = useState(filters.q);
  const [location, setLocation] = useState(filters.location);
  const [sort, setSort] = useState(filters.sort);
  const [region, setRegion] = useState(filters.region);
  const [difficulty, setDifficulty] = useState(filters.difficulty);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState(filters.category);
  const searchRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [copiedLink, setCopiedLink] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    setQ(filters.q); setLocation(filters.location); setSort(filters.sort); setRegion(filters.region);
    setDifficulty(filters.difficulty); setCategory(filters.category);
  }, [filters.q, filters.location, filters.sort, filters.region, filters.difficulty, filters.category]);
  const isDestinationView = filters.view === "destinations";
  const isMapView = isDestinationView && filters.display === "map";
  const defaultSort = isDestinationView ? "popular" : "recent";
  const clear = discoverUrl(filters, {q: "", location: "", region: "", difficulty: "all", activity: "all", category: "all", sort: defaultSort, page: 1});
  const hasFilters = Boolean(filters.q || filters.location || filters.region || filters.difficulty !== "all" || filters.activity !== "all" || filters.category !== "all" || filters.sort !== defaultSort);
  const searchTitle = isDestinationView ? "Explore BC destinations" : filters.view === "saved" ? "Your saved plans" : filters.view === "packs" ? "Public gear builds" : "Public trips";

  return <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#f6f8f7] pb-20 text-slate-900">
    <DiscoverHeader active="search" back/>
    <div className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-white">
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-screen-2xl flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-6 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div><h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 sm:text-3xl">Search destinations</h1><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">Filter the complete BC catalog by region, activity, and recorded trail details.</p></div>
        <Link href="/discover/find" className="inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-green-200 bg-green-50 px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-green-900 transition hover:bg-green-100"><Sparkles size={16}/> Help me choose <ArrowRight size={15}/></Link>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-screen-2xl px-4 pt-7 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
      {isDestinationView && featuredDestinations.length > 0 && <section aria-labelledby="featured-heading" className="mb-9">
        <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3">
          <div><p className="text-xs font-medium text-green-800">British Columbia</p><h2 id="featured-heading" className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold sm:text-[28px]">Featured destinations</h2><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">A few places to start exploring.</p></div>
          <span className="rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-green-900">{total} BC destinations</span>
        </div>
        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">{featuredDestinations.map(destination => <SpotlightCard key={destination.id} destination={destination} saved={savedDestinations.has(destination.id)} signedIn={signedIn}/>)}</div>
      </section>}

      {isDestinationView && <section aria-label="Browse by activity" className="mb-6">
        <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 sm:text-base">What do you want to explore?</h2><span className="hidden text-xs text-slate-500 sm:inline">Choose an activity</span></div>
        <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1">{activities.map(({value, label, Icon}) => <Link key={value} href={discoverUrl(filters, {activity: value, page: 1})} aria-current={filters.activity === value ? "true" : undefined} className={`inline-flex min-h-11 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-4 text-sm font-semibold transition focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-green-800 ${filters.activity === value ? "border-green-900 bg-green-900 text-white shadow-sm" : "border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:border-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-50"}`}><Icon size={16} aria-hidden="true"/>{label}</Link>)}</div>
      </section>}

      <section aria-label="Search and filters">
        <form method="GET" action="/discover/search" role="search" className={`grid gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3 shadow-sm sm:p-4 ${isDestinationView ? "lg:grid-cols-[minmax(220px,1fr)_repeat(4,minmax(125px,auto))_auto]" : "md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,0.65fr)_auto_auto]"}`}>
          {isDestinationView && <input type="hidden" name="activity" value={filters.activity}/>}
          {isMapView && <input type="hidden" name="display" value="map"/>} 
          <label className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 focus-within:border-green-700 focus-within:ring-1 focus-within:ring-green-700"><Search size={17} className="shrink-0 text-slate-500" aria-hidden="true"/><span className="sr-only">Search names and locations</span><input ref={searchRef} name="q" value={q} onChange={e=>setQ(e.target.value)} maxLength={100} type="search" placeholder={isDestinationView ? "Search parks, trails, lakes…" : "Search trips, builds, places…"} className="h-11 w-full min-w-0 bg-transparent text-sm outline-none" /></label>
          {isDestinationView ? <>
            <label className="flex min-w-0 items-center rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3"><span className="sr-only">Destination category</span><select name="category" value={category} onChange={e=>setCategory(e.target.value as DiscoverCategory)} className="h-11 w-full min-w-0 bg-white text-sm outline-none">{categories.map(item=><option key={item.value} value={item.value}>{item.label}</option>)}</select></label>
            <label className="flex min-w-0 items-center rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3"><span className="sr-only">Region</span><select name="region" value={region} onChange={e=>setRegion(e.target.value)} className="h-11 w-full min-w-0 bg-white text-sm outline-none"><option value="">All regions</option>{regions.map(value=><option key={value} value={value}>{value}</option>)}</select></label>
            <label className="flex min-w-0 items-center rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3"><span className="sr-only">Difficulty</span><select name="difficulty" value={difficulty} onChange={e=>setDifficulty(e.target.value as DiscoverSearch["difficulty"])} className="h-11 w-full min-w-0 bg-white text-sm outline-none"><option value="all">Any difficulty</option><option value="easy">Easy</option><option value="moderate">Moderate</option><option value="hard">Hard</option></select></label>
          </> : <label className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 focus-within:border-green-700"><MapPin size={17} className="shrink-0 text-slate-500" aria-hidden="true"/><span className="sr-only">Filter by location</span><input name="location" value={location} onChange={e=>setLocation(e.target.value)} maxLength={100} placeholder="Location contains…" className="h-11 min-w-0 w-full bg-transparent text-sm outline-none" /></label>}
          <label className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3"><SlidersHorizontal size={16} className="shrink-0 text-slate-500" aria-hidden="true"/><span className="sr-only">Sort results</span><select name="sort" value={sort} onChange={e=>setSort(e.target.value as DiscoverSearch["sort"])} className="h-11 w-full min-w-0 bg-white text-sm outline-none">{isDestinationView ? <><option value="popular">Featured first</option><option value="name">Name A–Z</option><option value="distance">Shortest distance</option></> : <><option value="recent">Newest</option><option value="updated">Recently updated</option><option value="popular">Most saved</option><option value="name">Name A–Z</option></>}</select></label>
          <button type="submit" className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-green-900 px-5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-green-800 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-green-800">Search</button>
        </form>
      </section>

      {isDestinationView && <nav aria-label="Quick region filters" className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs">
        <span className="mr-1 font-semibold text-slate-500">Popular regions</span>
        {popularRegions.filter(value => regions.includes(value)).map(value=><Link key={value} href={discoverUrl(filters, {region: filters.region === value ? "" : value, page: 1})} className={`rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 font-semibold transition ${filters.region === value ? "border-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-900" : "border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-600 hover:border-emerald-300 hover:text-green-900"}`}>{value}<ChevronRight className="ml-1 inline h-3 w-3" aria-hidden="true"/></Link>)}
      </nav>}

      <div className="mt-8 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3">
        <div><h2 className="text-xl font-bold">{isDestinationView ? (hasFilters ? "Matching destinations" : "All destinations") : searchTitle}</h2><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">{total} {total === 1 ? "result" : "results"}{!isMapView && total > 0 && ` · Page ${filters.page} of ${totalPages}`}</p></div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          {hasFilters && <Link href={clear} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-800 hover:bg-emerald-50"><FilterX size={16} aria-hidden="true"/>Clear filters</Link>}
          {isDestinationView && <nav aria-label="Search result view" className="inline-flex items-center rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-1 shadow-sm">
            <Link href={discoverUrl(filters, {display: "grid", page: 1})} aria-current={!isMapView ? "page" : undefined} className={`inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 text-sm font-semibold transition focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-green-900 ${!isMapView ? "bg-green-900 text-white shadow-sm" : "text-slate-600 hover:bg-emerald-50"}`}><LayoutGrid size={16} aria-hidden="true"/>Grid</Link>
            <Link href={discoverUrl(filters, {display: "map", page: 1})} aria-current={isMapView ? "page" : undefined} className={`inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 text-sm font-semibold transition focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-green-900 ${isMapView ? "bg-green-900 text-white shadow-sm" : "text-slate-600 hover:bg-emerald-50"}`}><MapIcon size={16} aria-hidden="true"/>Map</Link>
          </nav>}
        </div>
      </div>

      {isMapView && total > 0 ? <DiscoverDestinationMapView mapped={mapDestinations} unmapped={unmappedDestinations} /> : (isDestinationView ? destinations.length : entries.length) > 0 ? <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">{isDestinationView ? destinations.map(destination=><DestinationCard key={destination.id} destination={destination} saved={savedDestinations.has(destination.id)} signedIn={signedIn}/>) : entries.map(entry=><EntryCard key={entry.id} entry={entry} view={filters.view} signedIn={signedIn}/>)}</div> : <section className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white px-6 py-14 text-center">
        <Compass size={30} className="mx-auto text-slate-400" aria-hidden="true"/>
        <h3 className="mt-3 text-lg font-bold">{filters.view === "saved" && !signedIn ? "Sign in to see saved plans" : hasFilters ? "No results match those filters" : filters.view === "saved" ? "Nothing saved yet" : isDestinationView ? "No destinations available" : "No public plans yet"}</h3>
        <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-md text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500">{filters.view === "saved" && !signedIn ? "Your saved trips and gear lists appear here once you sign in." : hasFilters ? "Try another activity, region, or a broader search." : filters.view === "saved" ? "Bookmark a public trip or build and it will appear here." : isDestinationView ? "The destination catalog is empty." : "Only builds explicitly shared publicly appear here. Create a trip or pack list to get started."}</p>
        <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-3">
          {hasFilters && <Link href={clear} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-slate-50">Clear filters</Link>}
          {filters.view === "saved" && !signedIn ? <Link href="/api/auth/signin?callbackUrl=%2Fdiscover%2Fsaved" className="rounded-xl bg-green-900 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-green-800">Sign in</Link> : <Link href="/discover/find" className="rounded-xl bg-green-900 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-green-800">Find a destination</Link>}
        </div>
      </section>}

      {!isMapView && totalPages > 1 && <nav aria-label="Discover pages" className="mt-7 flex items-center justify-center gap-3">
        {filters.page > 1 && <Link href={discoverUrl(filters, {page: filters.page - 1})} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-slate-50">Previous</Link>}
        <span className="text-sm text-slate-500">{filters.page} / {totalPages}</span>
        {filters.page < totalPages && <Link href={discoverUrl(filters, {page: filters.page + 1})} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-slate-50">Next</Link>}
      </nav>}
      <div className="mt-8 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-200 pt-5 text-xs text-slate-500">
        <p>Check current access, weather, and permits before heading out. Photos may represent the wider park, not a specific campsite.</p>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3"><Link href="/profile/builds" className="font-semibold text-green-900 hover:underline">My builds</Link><button type="button" onClick={async()=>{
          try {await navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href);setCopiedLink(true);window.setTimeout(()=>setCopiedLink(false),1800);}catch {searchRef.current?.focus();}
        }} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-green-900 hover:underline">{copiedLink?<Check size={13}/>:<Copy size={13}/>} {copiedLink?"Link copied":"Share this search"}</button></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </main>;
}
```

### `components/discover/DiscoverLocationMapInner.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import {useEffect,useMemo,useRef,useState} from "react";
import {MapContainer,TileLayer,CircleMarker,Popup,Polyline,useMap} from "react-leaflet";
import type {Waypoint} from "@/lib/trip-planner";
import {openStreetMapLink,type Coordinates} from "@/lib/destination-detail";
import "leaflet/dist/leaflet.css";

function FitPublishedRoute({points}:{points:Waypoint[]}){
  const map=useMap();
  const key=useMemo(()=>points.map(point=>`${point.lat},${point.lng}`).join(";"),[points]);
  useEffect(()=>{if(points.length>1)map.fitBounds(points.map(point=>[point.lat,point.lng] as [number,number]),{padding:[35,35],maxZoom:13});},[map,key,points]);
  return null;
}
/** Keep normal page scrolling; only Ctrl + wheel zooms the map under the pointer. */
function CtrlWheelZoom(){
  const map=useMap();
  const accumulated=useRef(0);
  useEffect(()=>{
    const container=map.getContainer();
    const onWheel=(event:WheelEvent)=>{
      if(!event.ctrlKey){accumulated.current=0;return;}
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      const delta=event.deltaY*(event.deltaMode===1?16:event.deltaMode===2?container.clientHeight:1);
      accumulated.current+=delta;
      if(Math.abs(accumulated.current)<60)return;
      const steps=Math.trunc(accumulated.current/100)||Math.sign(accumulated.current);
      accumulated.current-=steps*100;
      const zoom=Math.max(map.getMinZoom(),Math.min(map.getMaxZoom(),map.getZoom()-steps));
      if(zoom!==map.getZoom())map.setZoomAround(map.mouseEventToContainerPoint(event),zoom,{animate:false});
    };
    container.addEventListener("wheel",onWheel,{capture:true,passive:false});
    return ()=>container.removeEventListener("wheel",onWheel,true);
  },[map]);
  return <div className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-4 left-3 z-[800] rounded-md bg-white/90 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-700 shadow-sm">Ctrl + scroll to zoom</div>;
}
export default function DiscoverLocationMapInner({coords,points,title,height}:{coords:Coordinates|null;points:Waypoint[];title:string;height:"destination"|"trip"}) {
  const [failed,setFailed]=useState(false);
  const initial=points[0]?[points[0].lat,points[0].lng] as [number,number]:coords?[coords.latitude,coords.longitude] as [number,number]:[49.28,-123.12] as [number,number];
  const external=coords?openStreetMapLink(coords):points[0]?openStreetMapLink({latitude:points[0].lat,longitude:points[0].lng}):"https://www.openstreetmap.org/";
  return <div className="relative">
    <MapContainer center={initial} zoom={points.length>1?10:12} scrollWheelZoom={false} className={height==="trip"?"relative z-0 h-[310px] w-full sm:h-[385px]":"relative z-0 h-[310px] w-full sm:h-[375px]"} aria-label={title}>
      <TileLayer
        url="https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"
        attribution='&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors'
        referrerPolicy="origin"
        eventHandlers={{tileerror:()=>setFailed(true)}}
      />
      <CtrlWheelZoom/>
      <FitPublishedRoute points={points}/>
      {points.length>1&&<Polyline interactive={false} positions={points.map(point=>[point.lat,point.lng])} pathOptions={{color:"#166534",weight:3,dashArray:"6 8"}}/>}
      {points.map((point,index)=><CircleMarker key={point.id} center={[point.lat,point.lng]} radius={8} pathOptions={{color:"#fff",weight:2,fillColor:"#166534",fillOpacity:1}}><Popup><strong>{index+1}. {point.name}</strong><br/>{point.kind.replace("waypoint","Stop")}{point.time?` · ${point.time}`:""}</Popup></CircleMarker>)}
      {!points.length&&coords&&<CircleMarker center={[coords.latitude,coords.longitude]} radius={9} pathOptions={{color:"#fff",weight:2,fillColor:"#166534",fillOpacity:1}}><Popup>Catalog destination location</Popup></CircleMarker>}
    </MapContainer>
    {failed&&<div role="status" className="absolute inset-x-3 top-3 z-[700] rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-white/95 p-3 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-700 shadow-md">Map tiles could not load. Your destination or route information is still available below. <a href={external} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="font-bold text-green-900 underline">Open in OpenStreetMap</a>.</div>}
  </div>;
}

```

### `components/discover/DiscoverResultsServer.tsx`

```typescript
import SavedLibrary from "@/components/discover/SavedLibrary";
import { parseSavedSearch, type SavedEntry } from "@/lib/discover-saved";
import PackExplore, {type PublicPackCard} from "@/components/discover/PackExplore";
import {parsePackFilters, summarizePack} from "@/lib/discover-packs";
import {queryPublicPackIds} from "@/lib/discover-packs-query";
import TripExplore, { type PublicTripCard } from "@/components/discover/TripExplore";
import {parseTripFeature, publicTripAuthor, type TripDayPublic} from "@/lib/discover-trips";
import {getDestination} from "@/lib/destinations";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import { currentBuildUserId } from "@/lib/build-access";
import type { Prisma } from "@/app/generated/prisma/client";
import DiscoverLanding from "@/components/discover/DiscoverLanding";
import { parseDiscoverSearch, filterDiscoverDestinations } from "@/lib/discover";
import { DESTINATIONS, getDestinationRegions } from "@/lib/destinations";
import { splitMappedDestinations } from "@/lib/discover-search-map";

const PAGE_SIZE = 12;

export default async function DiscoverResultsServer({searchParams, section}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
  section: "destinations" | "trips" | "packs" | "saved";
}) {
  const params = await searchParams;
  const filters = parseDiscoverSearch({...params, view: section});
  const regions = getDestinationRegions();
  if (filters.view === "packs") {
    const packFilters = parsePackFilters(params);
    const {ids,total,totalPages,page} = await queryPublicPackIds(packFilters);
    const userId = await currentBuildUserId();
    const builds = ids.length ? await prisma.build.findMany({
      where: {id:{in:ids},isPublic:true,items:{some:{}}},
      select: {
        id:true,name:true,location:true,people:true,updatedAt:true,
        user:{select:{name:true,username:true,isProfilePublic:true}},
        _count:{select:{savedBy:true}},
        items:{select:{quantity:true,isWorn:true,isConsumable:true,weightSnapshot:true,priceSnapshot:true,customCategory:true,
          gear:{select:{weight_g:true,price_cad:true,category:{select:{name:true}}}},
        }},
      },
    }):[];
    const byId = new Map(builds.map(build=>[build.id,build]));
    const savedIds=userId&&ids.length?new Set((await prisma.savedBuild.findMany({
      where:{userId,buildId:{in:ids}},select:{buildId:true},
    })).map(saved=>saved.buildId)):new Set<string>();
    const cards: PublicPackCard[] = ids.flatMap(id=>{
      const build=byId.get(id);
      if (!build) return [];
      return [{id:build.id,name:build.name,location:build.location,
        author:build.user?.isProfilePublic?(build.user.username||build.user.name||"Community member"):"Community member",
        people:build.people,updatedAt:build.updatedAt.toISOString(),saves:build._count.savedBy,
        saved:savedIds.has(build.id),summary:summarizePack(build.items),
      }];
    });
    return <PackExplore packs={cards} filters={{...packFilters,page}} total={total} totalPages={totalPages} signedIn={Boolean(userId)}/>;
  }
  if (filters.view === "trips") {
    const feature = parseTripFeature(params.feature);
    const userId = await currentBuildUserId();
    const regionIds = filters.region
      ? DESTINATIONS.filter(destination => destination.region === filters.region).map(destination => destination.id)
      : [];
    const tripWhere: Prisma.BuildWhereInput = {
      isPublic: true, days: {some: {}},
      ...(filters.q ? {OR: [
        {name: {contains:filters.q,mode:"insensitive"}},
        {location: {contains:filters.q,mode:"insensitive"}},
      ]} : {}),
      ...(filters.location ? {location: {contains:filters.location,mode:"insensitive"}} : {}),
      ...(filters.region ? {AND: [{OR: [
        {destinationId: {in:regionIds}},
        {location: {contains:filters.region,mode:"insensitive"}},
      ]}]} : {}),
      ...(feature === "campsite" ? {days:{some:{campsite:{not:null}}}} : {}),
      ...(feature === "route" ? {days:{some:{OR:[
        {distanceKm:{not:null}},{startLocation:{not:null}},{endLocation:{not:null}},
      ]}}} : {}),
      ...(feature === "gear" ? {items:{some:{}}} : {}),
    };
    const tripOrder: Prisma.BuildOrderByWithRelationInput[] =
      filters.sort === "name" ? [{name:"asc"},{id:"asc"}] :
      filters.sort === "popular" ? [{savedBy:{_count:"desc"}},{createdAt:"desc"},{id:"asc"}] :
      filters.sort === "updated" ? [{updatedAt:"desc"},{id:"asc"}] :
      [{createdAt:"desc"},{id:"asc"}];
    const count = await prisma.build.count({where:tripWhere});
    const totalPages = Math.max(1,Math.ceil(count/PAGE_SIZE));
    const page=Math.min(filters.page,totalPages);
    const trips = count===0?[]:await prisma.build.findMany({
      where:tripWhere, orderBy:tripOrder, skip:(page-1)*PAGE_SIZE,take:PAGE_SIZE,
      select:{
        id:true,name:true,location:true,destinationId:true,startDate:true,endDate:true,updatedAt:true,people:true,
        user:{select:{name:true,username:true,isProfilePublic:true}},
        _count:{select:{savedBy:true,items:true}},
        days:{select:{date:true,startLocation:true,endLocation:true,distanceKm:true,elevationGainM:true,campsite:true,activities:true},orderBy:{date:"asc"}},
      },
    });
    const savedIds=userId&&trips.length?new Set((await prisma.savedBuild.findMany({
      where:{userId,buildId:{in:trips.map(trip=>trip.id)}},select:{buildId:true},
    })).map(item=>item.buildId)):new Set<string>();
    const cards: PublicTripCard[]=trips.map(trip=>({
      id:trip.id,name:trip.name,location:trip.location,author:publicTripAuthor(trip.user),
      destination:getDestination(trip.destinationId),startDate:trip.startDate?.toISOString()??null,
      endDate:trip.endDate?.toISOString()??null,updatedAt:trip.updatedAt.toISOString(),people:trip.people,
      days:trip.days as TripDayPublic[],saves:trip._count.savedBy,saved:savedIds.has(trip.id),gearCount:trip._count.items,
    }));
    return <TripExplore trips={cards} filters={{...filters,page}} feature={feature} regions={regions}
      total={count} totalPages={totalPages} signedIn={Boolean(userId)} />;
  }
  if (filters.view === "saved") {
    const search = parseSavedSearch(params);
    const userId = await currentBuildUserId();
    if (!userId) return <SavedLibrary entries={[]} search={search} signedIn={false}/>;
    // Both sections are private to the signed-in user. A single Build bookmark
    // can appear in Trip and Builds filters when it has both days and equipment.
    const [destinations, builds] = await Promise.all([
      prisma.savedDestination.findMany({where:{userId},select:{destinationId:true,createdAt:true}}),
      prisma.savedBuild.findMany({where:{userId},select:{createdAt:true,build:{select:{
        id:true,name:true,location:true,isPublic:true,
        days:{select:{id:true},take:1},items:{select:{id:true},take:1},
      }}}}),
    ]);
    const entries: SavedEntry[] = [
      ...destinations.map(row => {
        const item = getDestination(row.destinationId);
        return {id:row.destinationId,kind:"destination" as const,name:item?.name ?? "Unavailable destination",
          subtitle:item ? `${item.park} · ${item.region}` : "Removed from the catalog",
          savedAt:row.createdAt.toISOString(),available:!!item};
      }),
      ...builds.map(row => {
        // Unpublished builds must not leak their previous private metadata.
        const available = row.build.isPublic;
        const hasDays = available && row.build.days.length > 0;
        const hasItems = available && row.build.items.length > 0;
        return {id:row.build.id,kind:hasDays?"trip" as const:"pack" as const,
          name:available?row.build.name:"Unavailable public plan",
          subtitle:available?(row.build.location||"Location not specified"):"No longer public",
          savedAt:row.createdAt.toISOString(),available,hasDays,hasItems};
      }),
    ];
    return <SavedLibrary entries={entries} search={search} signedIn/>;
  }
  if (filters.view === "destinations") {
    const matching = filterDiscoverDestinations(DESTINATIONS, filters);
    // Search is the full database, not a curated feed. Every matching entry is listed and paginated.
    const listings = matching;
    const { mapped, unmapped } = splitMappedDestinations(matching);
    const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(listings.length / PAGE_SIZE));
    const page = Math.min(filters.page, totalPages);
    const userId = await currentBuildUserId();
    const visibleIds = listings.slice((page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE, page * PAGE_SIZE).map(d=>d.id);
    const savedDestinationIds = userId && visibleIds.length ? (await prisma.savedDestination.findMany({
      where:{userId,destinationId:{in:visibleIds}},select:{destinationId:true},
    })).map(x=>x.destinationId) : [];
    return <DiscoverLanding
      savedDestinationIds={savedDestinationIds}
      destinations={listings.slice((page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE, page * PAGE_SIZE)}
      mapDestinations={filters.display === "map" ? mapped : []}
      unmappedDestinations={filters.display === "map" ? unmapped : []}
      featuredDestinations={[]}
      entries={[]}
      filters={{ ...filters, page }}
      total={matching.length}
      totalPages={totalPages}
      regions={regions}
      signedIn={Boolean(userId)}
    />;
  }

}
```

### `components/discover/DiscoverSearchMapInner.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { CircleMarker, MapContainer, TileLayer, Tooltip, useMap } from "react-leaflet";
import type { Destination } from "@/lib/destinations";
import { validCoordinates } from "@/lib/destination-detail";
import { LocateFixed } from "lucide-react";
import "leaflet/dist/leaflet.css";

type MapPoint = { id: string; name: string; latitude: number; longitude: number; difficulty: Destination["difficulty"] };

function fitPoints(map: ReturnType<typeof useMap>, points: MapPoint[]) {
  if (!points.length) return;
  if (points.length === 1) map.setView([points[0].latitude, points[0].longitude], 12, { animate: false });
  else map.fitBounds(points.map(p => [p.latitude, p.longitude] as [number, number]), {
    padding: [35, 35], maxZoom: 11, animate: false,
  });
}

function MapBehavior({ points, selectedId }: { points: MapPoint[]; selectedId: string | null }) {
  const map = useMap();
  const key = useMemo(() => points.map(p => p.id).join("|"), [points]);
  const initialized = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    // Fit the FILTERED markers on mount and whenever the results change.
    fitPoints(map, points);
    initialized.current = true;
  }, [map, key, points]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialized.current || !selectedId) return;
    const selected = points.find(p => p.id === selectedId);
    if (selected) map.panTo([selected.latitude, selected.longitude], { animate: true });
  }, [map, points, selectedId]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") return;
    let frame = 0;
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => map.invalidateSize({ pan: false }));
    });
    observer.observe(map.getContainer());
    return () => { observer.disconnect(); cancelAnimationFrame(frame); };
  }, [map]);
  return null;
}

/** Page scrolls normally. Ctrl+wheel zooms under the pointer. */
function CtrlWheelZoom() {
  const map = useMap();
  const accumulated = useRef(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const container = map.getContainer();
    const onWheel = (event: WheelEvent) => {
      if (!event.ctrlKey) { accumulated.current = 0; return; }
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      const delta = event.deltaY * (event.deltaMode === 1 ? 16 : event.deltaMode === 2 ? container.clientHeight : 1);
      accumulated.current += delta;
      if (Math.abs(accumulated.current) < 60) return;
      const steps = Math.trunc(accumulated.current / 100) || Math.sign(accumulated.current);
      accumulated.current -= steps * 100;
      const zoom = Math.max(map.getMinZoom(), Math.min(map.getMaxZoom(), map.getZoom() - steps));
      if (zoom !== map.getZoom()) map.setZoomAround(map.mouseEventToContainerPoint(event), zoom, { animate: false });
    };
    container.addEventListener("wheel", onWheel, { capture: true, passive: false });
    return () => container.removeEventListener("wheel", onWheel, true);
  }, [map]);
  return <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-4 left-3 z-[800] rounded-lg bg-white/95 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-600 shadow-sm">Ctrl + scroll to zoom</span>;
}

function FitControl({points}: {points: MapPoint[]}) {
  const map = useMap();
  return <div className="absolute right-3 top-3 z-[800]">
    <button type="button" onClick={() => fitPoints(map, points)} className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 shadow-sm transition hover:bg-slate-50 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-green-900">
      <LocateFixed size={15} aria-hidden="true" /> Fit all
    </button>
  </div>;
}

export default function DiscoverSearchMapInner({
  destinations, selectedId, onSelect,
}: {
  destinations: Destination[];
  selectedId: string | null;
  onSelect: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const [tileFailure, setTileFailure] = useState(false);
  const points = useMemo<MapPoint[]>(() => destinations.flatMap(destination => {
    const coordinates = validCoordinates(destination);
    return coordinates ? [{
      id: destination.id, name: destination.name,
      latitude: coordinates.latitude, longitude: coordinates.longitude,
      difficulty: destination.difficulty,
    }] : [];
  }), [destinations]);
  const selected = points.find(point => point.id === selectedId) ?? null;
  const externalPoint = selected ?? points[0];
  const external = externalPoint
    ? `https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=${externalPoint.latitude}&mlon=${externalPoint.longitude}#map=12/${externalPoint.latitude}/${externalPoint.longitude}`
    : "https://www.openstreetmap.org/";

  if (!points.length) return <div className="flex h-[380px] items-center justify-center bg-slate-100 p-6 text-center text-sm text-slate-600">These filtered destinations have no verified map coordinates.</div>;

  return <div className="relative isolate">
    <MapContainer center={[points[0].latitude, points[0].longitude]} zoom={10} scrollWheelZoom={false}
      className="relative z-0 h-[380px] w-full sm:h-[500px] lg:h-[560px]" aria-label="Map of filtered BC destinations">
      <TileLayer
        url="https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"
        referrerPolicy="origin"
        attribution='&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors'
        eventHandlers={{ tileerror: () => setTileFailure(true) }}
      />
      <MapBehavior points={points} selectedId={selectedId} />
      <CtrlWheelZoom />
      <FitControl points={points} />
      {points.map(point => <CircleMarker
        key={point.id} center={[point.latitude, point.longitude]}
        radius={selectedId === point.id ? 13 : 10}
        pathOptions={{ color: "#ffffff", weight: selectedId === point.id ? 3 : 2, fillColor: selectedId === point.id ? "#047857" : "#14532d", fillOpacity: 1 }}
        eventHandlers={{ click: () => onSelect(point.id) }}
      >
        <Tooltip direction="top" offset={[0,-7]}>{point.name}</Tooltip>
      </CircleMarker>)}
    </MapContainer>
    <a href={external} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="absolute right-3 top-14 z-[800] rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white/95 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-green-900 shadow-sm hover:bg-white focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-green-900">Open in OSM ↗</a>
    {tileFailure && <div role="status" className="absolute inset-x-3 top-24 z-[900] rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-white/95 p-3 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-700 shadow-md">
      OpenStreetMap tiles could not load. Destination results remain available in the list. <a className="font-bold text-green-900 underline" href={external} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Open map externally</a>.
    </div>}
  </div>;
}
```

```typescript
import Link from "next/link";
import {ArrowRight, Backpack, Bookmark, FilterX, MapPin, Package, Scale, Search, SlidersHorizontal, Tent, Users, Wallet} from "lucide-react";
import {PACK_CATEGORIES, formattedCad, formattedKg, packBrowseHref, packHref, type PackFilters, summarizePack} from "@/lib/discover-packs";
import PackActions from "./PackActions";
import DiscoverHeader from "./DiscoverHeader";

export type PublicPackCard = {
  id:string; name:string; location:string|null; author:string; people:number;
  updatedAt:string; saves:number; saved:boolean;
  summary: ReturnType<typeof summarizePack>;
};
function PackCard({pack,signedIn}:{pack:PublicPackCard;signedIn:boolean}) {
  return <article className="flex min-w-0 flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm transition hover:border-emerald-200 hover:shadow-md">
    <div className="flex h-32 items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-100 via-emerald-50 to-teal-200 text-emerald-800"><Backpack size={50} strokeWidth={1.3} aria-hidden="true"/></div>
    <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col p-5">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2"><Link href={packHref(pack.id)} className="line-clamp-2 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 hover:text-green-800">{pack.name}</Link><span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-slate-500"><Bookmark size={13}/>{pack.saves}</span></div>
      <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">By {pack.author}</p>
      {pack.location&&<p className="mt-2 flex items-start gap-1 text-sm text-slate-600"><MapPin size={15} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0"/>{pack.location}</p>}
      <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
        <div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-3"><span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-slate-500"><Scale size={14}/>Base weight</span><strong className="mt-1 block text-sm">{pack.summary.baseWeightG===null?`${formattedKg(pack.summary.knownBaseG)}+*`:formattedKg(pack.summary.baseWeightG)}</strong></div>
        <div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-3"><span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-slate-500"><Wallet size={14}/>Cost (CAD)</span><strong className="mt-1 block text-sm">{pack.summary.costCad===null?`${formattedCad(pack.summary.knownCostCad)}+*`:formattedCad(pack.summary.costCad)}</strong></div>
      </div>
      <p className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-xs text-slate-600"><span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><Package size={14}/>{pack.summary.itemCount} gear items</span><span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><Users size={14}/>{pack.people} {pack.people===1?"person":"people"}</span></p>
      <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">{pack.summary.categories.slice(0,4).map(([category])=><span key={category} className="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-slate-600">{category}</span>)}{pack.summary.categories.length>4&&<span className="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-slate-600">+{pack.summary.categories.length-4}</span>}</div>
      <div className="mt-auto space-y-3 pt-4"><Link href={packHref(pack.id)} className="inline-flex min-h-11 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-green-900 px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-green-800">View gear list <ArrowRight size={16}/></Link><PackActions id={pack.id} saved={pack.saved} signedIn={signedIn}/></div>
    </div>
  </article>;
}
export default function PackExplore({packs,filters,total,totalPages,signedIn}:{packs:PublicPackCard[];filters:PackFilters;total:number;totalPages:number;signedIn:boolean}) {
  const active=Boolean(filters.q||filters.location||filters.people||filters.category||filters.minBaseKg!==null||filters.maxBaseKg!==null||filters.maxCostCad!==null||filters.sort!=="recent");
  return <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#f6f8f7] pb-20 text-slate-900">
    <DiscoverHeader active="community" back/>
    <div className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-white"><div className="mx-auto max-w-screen-2xl px-4 py-6 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 sm:text-3xl">Community</h1><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">Public itineraries and gear lists from other backpackers.</p>
      <nav aria-label="Community content type" className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2"><Link href="/discover/community" className="inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"><Tent size={16}/> Trips</Link><Link href="/discover/community?type=packs" aria-current="page" className="inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-green-800 px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white"><Backpack size={16}/> Gear lists</Link></nav>
    </div></div>
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-screen-2xl px-4 pt-7 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
      <div className="mb-6"><h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">Browse gear lists</h2><p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">Compare recorded weights and prices, or copy a public setup to your Builder.</p></div>
      <form method="get" action="/discover/community" className="grid gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
        <input type="hidden" name="type" value="packs"/>
        <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 sm:col-span-2"><span className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-1"><Search size={14}/>Search builds</span><input name="q" type="search" maxLength={100} defaultValue={filters.q} placeholder="Build name or location" className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 text-sm font-normal outline-emerald-700"/></label>
        <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600"><span className="mb-1 block">Location contains</span><input name="location" maxLength={100} defaultValue={filters.location} placeholder="e.g. Garibaldi" className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 text-sm font-normal outline-emerald-700"/></label>
        <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600"><span className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-1"><SlidersHorizontal size={14}/>Sort</span><select name="sort" defaultValue={filters.sort} className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 text-sm font-normal"><option value="recent">Newest</option><option value="updated">Recently updated</option><option value="popular">Most saved</option><option value="name">Name A–Z</option><option value="lightest">Lightest base weight</option><option value="cheapest">Lowest recorded cost</option></select></label>
        <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600"><span className="mb-1 block">Gear category</span><select name="packCategory" defaultValue={filters.category} className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 text-sm font-normal"><option value="">All categories</option>{PACK_CATEGORIES.map(category=><option key={category} value={category}>{category}</option>)}</select></label>
        <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600"><span className="mb-1 block">People</span><select name="packPeople" defaultValue={filters.people??""} className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 text-sm font-normal"><option value="">Any</option>{[1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8].map(n=><option key={n} value={n}>{n}</option>)}</select></label>
        <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600"><span className="mb-1 block">Min base weight (kg)</span><input name="minBaseKg" inputMode="decimal" type="number" min={0} max={50} step="0.01" defaultValue={filters.minBaseKg??""} placeholder="Any" className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 text-sm font-normal"/></label>
        <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600"><span className="mb-1 block">Max base weight (kg)</span><input name="maxBaseKg" inputMode="decimal" type="number" min={0} max={50} step="0.01" defaultValue={filters.maxBaseKg??""} placeholder="Any" className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 text-sm font-normal"/></label>
        <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600"><span className="mb-1 block">Max recorded cost (CAD)</span><input name="maxCostCad" inputMode="decimal" type="number" min={0} max={100000} step="0.01" defaultValue={filters.maxCostCad??""} placeholder="Any" className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 text-sm font-normal"/></label>
        <div className="flex items-end gap-2"><button type="submit" className="min-h-11 flex-1 rounded-xl bg-green-900 px-5 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-green-800">Apply filters</button>{active&&<Link href="/discover/community?type=packs" aria-label="Clear filters" className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 text-green-900 hover:bg-emerald-50"><FilterX size={18}/></Link>}</div>
      </form>
      <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-500">Weight filters use complete base-weight data; budget filters require all item prices. Unknown values are excluded from those filters and sorted last.</p>
      <div className="mt-7 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3"><div><h3 className="text-xl font-bold">{active?"Matching builds":"Public gear builds"}</h3><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">{total} {total===1?"build":"builds"}{total>0?` · Page ${filters.page} of ${totalPages}`:""}</p></div></div>
      {packs.length?<div className="mt-4 grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">{packs.map(pack=><PackCard key={pack.id} pack={pack} signedIn={signedIn}/>)}</div>:<div className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white px-6 py-14 text-center"><Backpack size={32} className="mx-auto text-slate-400"/><h3 className="mt-3 text-lg font-semibold">{active?"No builds match those filters":"No public gear builds yet"}</h3><p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">{active?"Try fewer restrictions or a different search.":"Builds appear when people choose to publish a gear list."}</p><Link href={active?"/discover/community?type=packs":"/build"} className="mt-5 inline-flex min-h-10 items-center rounded-xl bg-green-900 px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white">{active?"Clear filters":"Create a build"}</Link></div>}
      {totalPages>1&&<nav aria-label="Build pages" className="mt-8 flex items-center justify-center gap-3">{filters.page>1&&<Link className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold" href={packBrowseHref(filters,{page:filters.page-1})}>Previous</Link>}<span className="text-sm text-slate-500">{filters.page} / {totalPages}</span>{filters.page<totalPages&&<Link className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold" href={packBrowseHref(filters,{page:filters.page+1})}>Next</Link>}</nav>}
      <p className="mt-8 border-t border-slate-200 pt-5 text-xs text-slate-500">Community gear lists contain user-entered data. Gear specs, prices, compatibility findings and completeness should be independently checked before any trip. * A plus sign means one or more values are unknown; displayed totals are known amounts only.</p>
    </div>
  </main>;
}
```
