### `components/discover/PublicPackDetail.tsx`

```typescript
import Link from "next/link";
import {ArrowLeft, Backpack, CircleHelp, ClipboardCheck, Package, Scale, ShieldAlert, Users, Wallet} from "lucide-react";
import type {CompatibilityIssue} from "@/lib/compatibility";
import {categoryOf, formattedCad, formattedKg, summarizePack} from "@/lib/discover-packs";
import PackActions from "./PackActions";
import RelatedDiscover from "./RelatedDiscover";
import DiscoverSectionNav from "./DiscoverSectionNav";
import type {Destination} from "@/lib/destinations";
import {relatedDestinationHref,relatedTripHref,type RelatedPublicContent} from "@/lib/discover-related";

type GearItem = {
  id:string;quantity:number;isWorn:boolean;isConsumable:boolean;
  customCategory:string|null;gearNameSnapshot:string|null;weightSnapshot:number|null;priceSnapshot:number|null;
  gear:{id:string;name:string;description:string|null;weight_g:number|null;price_cad:number|null;
    brand:{name:string};category:{name:string}}|null;
};
export type PublicPackDetailData = {
  id:string;name:string;location:string|null;people:number;createdAt:Date;updatedAt:Date;
  author:string;items:GearItem[];saves:number;
};
function Metric({label,value,hint,Icon}:{label:string;value:string;hint?:string;Icon:typeof Backpack}) {
  return <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4"><div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500"><Icon size={15}/>{label}</div><p className="mt-2 text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">{value}</p>{hint&&<p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{hint}</p>}</div>;
}
export default function PublicPackDetail({pack,issues,saved,signedIn,destination,hasTrip,related}:{pack:PublicPackDetailData;issues:CompatibilityIssue[];saved:boolean;signedIn:boolean;destination:Destination|null;hasTrip:boolean;related:RelatedPublicContent}) {
  const summary=summarizePack(pack.items);
  const categories=[...new Set(pack.items.map(item=>categoryOf(item)))].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b));
  const noteworthy=issues.filter(issue=>issue.severity==="error"||issue.severity==="warning");
  return <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#f6f8f7] pb-20 text-slate-900">
    <header className="bg-[#00802f] text-white"><div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-8 sm:px-6"><Link href="/discover/community?type=packs" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white/90 hover:text-white"><ArrowLeft size={16}/>All community builds</Link><p className="mt-6 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-white/80">Public gear setup</p><h1 className="mt-2 text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">{pack.name}</h1><p className="mt-2 text-sm text-white/90">By {pack.author}{pack.location?` · ${pack.location}`:""} · {pack.people} {pack.people===1?"person":"people"}</p></div></header>
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl space-y-7 px-4 pt-6 sm:px-6">
      <DiscoverSectionNav active="packs" />
      <section aria-label="Build metrics" className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <Metric Icon={Scale} label="Base weight" value={formattedKg(summary.knownBaseG)+(summary.unknownBaseCount?"+*":"")} hint={summary.unknownBaseCount?`${summary.unknownBaseCount} base-weight value(s) missing`:"Excludes worn and consumable"}/>
        <Metric Icon={Wallet} label="Gear cost (CAD)" value={formattedCad(summary.knownCostCad)+(summary.unknownCostCount?"+*":"")} hint={summary.unknownCostCount?`${summary.unknownCostCount} price value(s) missing`:"Listed gear prices, not current quotes"}/>
        <Metric Icon={Backpack} label="Total recorded weight" value={formattedKg(summary.knownTotalG)+(summary.totalWeightG===null?"+*":"")} hint="Base + worn + consumables"/>
        <Metric Icon={Package} label="Gear inventory" value={`${summary.itemCount} items`} hint={`${summary.categoryCount} categories`}/>
      </section>
      <div className="grid gap-7 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_280px]">
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <section><div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><div><h2 className="text-xl font-bold">Gear list</h2><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">Items are grouped by category. Counts reflect quantity, not distinct product models.</p></div></div>
            <div className="mt-4 space-y-4">{categories.map(category=>{
              const items=pack.items.filter(item=>categoryOf(item)===category);
              const sub=summarizePack(items);
              return <section key={category} className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white"><div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-100 bg-slate-50 px-5 py-3"><h3 className="font-bold">{category}</h3><p className="text-xs text-slate-500">{sub.itemCount} items · {formattedKg(sub.knownTotalG)}{sub.totalWeightG===null?"+*":""}</p></div><ul className="divide-y divide-slate-100">{items.map(item=>{
                const weight=item.gear?.weight_g??item.weightSnapshot;
                const price=item.gear?.price_cad??item.priceSnapshot;
                const name=item.gear?.name??item.gearNameSnapshot??"Custom item";
                return <li key={item.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3 px-5 py-4"><div className="min-w-0 flex-1"><div className="font-semibold">{item.gear?<Link href={`/gear/${encodeURIComponent(item.gear.id)}`} className="text-green-900 hover:underline">{name}</Link>:name}</div>{item.gear?.brand.name&&<p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500">{item.gear.brand.name}</p>}{item.gear?.description&&<p className="mt-1 line-clamp-2 text-xs text-slate-500">{item.gear.description}</p>}<p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">Qty {item.quantity}{item.isWorn?" · Worn":""}{item.isConsumable?" · Consumable":""}</p></div><div className="text-right text-xs text-slate-600"><p>{weight===null?"Weight unknown":`${(weight*item.quantity).toLocaleString("en-CA")} g`}</p><p className="mt-1">{price===null?"Price unknown":formattedCad(price*item.quantity)}</p></div></li>;
              })}</ul></section>;
            })}</div>
          </section>
          <RelatedDiscover related={related} title="More from this destination" />
          <section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5"><div className="flex items-center gap-2"><ClipboardCheck size={19} className="text-green-900"/><h2 className="text-lg font-bold">Gear compatibility notes</h2></div><p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">These are automated checks using the published build’s recorded gear and trip context, not a safety certification.</p>
            {noteworthy.length?<ul className="mt-4 space-y-3">{noteworthy.slice(0,10).map(issue=><li key={issue.id} className="rounded-xl border border-amber-100 bg-amber-50 p-3"><div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-amber-900"><ShieldAlert size={16}/>{issue.category}</div><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-800">{issue.message}</p></li>)}</ul>:<p className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-600"><CircleHelp size={17}/>No flagged warnings from the available data. This is not a guarantee of readiness.</p>}
            {issues.length>noteworthy.length&&<p className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-500">{issues.length-noteworthy.length} additional informational/unknown-data checks are not shown here. Examine the copied setup in Builder for fuller analysis.</p>}
          </section>
        </div>
        <aside className="space-y-4"><section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5"><h2 className="font-bold">Make it yours</h2><p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">Save this setup or copy its gear into a private, editable build.</p><div className="mt-4"><PackActions id={pack.id} saved={saved} signedIn={signedIn}/></div><p className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-500">{pack.saves} {pack.saves===1?"save":"saves"} · Updated {pack.updatedAt.toLocaleDateString("en-CA",{timeZone:"UTC"})}</p></section>
          {(destination||hasTrip)&&<section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5"><h2 className="font-bold">Connected trip &amp; destination</h2><div className="mt-3 flex flex-col items-start gap-3 text-sm font-semibold text-green-900">{hasTrip&&<Link href={relatedTripHref(pack.id)} className="hover:underline">View this build’s itinerary →</Link>}{destination&&<Link href={relatedDestinationHref(destination.id)} className="hover:underline">Explore {destination.name} →</Link>}</div><p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">Links are available only when the public build has itinerary days or an exact catalog destination ID.</p></section>}
          <section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5"><h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold"><Users size={17}/>Build details</h2><dl className="mt-3 space-y-3 text-sm"><div className="flex justify-between gap-4"><dt className="text-slate-500">People</dt><dd className="font-semibold">{pack.people}</dd></div><div className="flex justify-between gap-4"><dt className="text-slate-500">Categories</dt><dd className="font-semibold">{summary.categoryCount}</dd></div><div className="flex justify-between gap-4"><dt className="text-slate-500">Worn</dt><dd className="font-semibold">{formattedKg(summary.knownWornG)}{summary.unknownWornCount?"+*":""}</dd></div><div className="flex justify-between gap-4"><dt className="text-slate-500">Consumables</dt><dd className="font-semibold">{formattedKg(summary.knownConsumableG)}{summary.unknownConsumableCount?"+*":""}</dd></div></dl></section>
          <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">* Plus means missing values; totals show only known amounts. Published gear lists may not match what someone actually carries, and product prices can change.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </div>
  </main>;
}
```

### `components/discover/PublicTripDetail.tsx`

```typescript
import Link from "next/link";
import {ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Backpack, CalendarDays, Compass, ExternalLink, Footprints, MapPin, Mountain, Route, Tent, Users} from "lucide-react";
import type {Destination} from "@/lib/destinations";
import {getDiscoverPhoto, discoverPhotoUrl, discoverPhotoSource} from "@/lib/discover-photos";
import {openStreetMapLink, validCoordinates} from "@/lib/destination-detail";
import {publicTripDay, summarizeTripDays, tripDate, tripDayTitle, type TripDayPublic} from "@/lib/discover-trips";
import TripActions from "./TripActions";
import DiscoverLocationMap from "./DiscoverLocationMap";
import {publicRouteWaypoints} from "@/lib/discover-public-route";
import RelatedDiscover from "./RelatedDiscover";
import DiscoverSectionNav from "./DiscoverSectionNav";
import {relatedPackHref,relatedDestinationHref,type RelatedPublicContent} from "@/lib/discover-related";

type Props={
  id:string; name:string;location:string|null;author:string;destination:Destination|null;
  startDate:Date|null;endDate:Date|null;people:number;
  days:TripDayPublic[];saves:number;saved:boolean;signedIn:boolean;
  gearCount:number;related:RelatedPublicContent;waypoints:unknown;
};
function Stat({title,value,icon:Icon}: {title:string;value:string;icon:typeof Compass}) {
 return <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4"><p className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium text-slate-500"><Icon size={14}/>{title}</p><p className="mt-1 text-lg font-bold text-slate-950">{value}</p></div>;
}
export default function PublicTripDetail({id,name,location,author,destination,startDate,endDate,people,days,saves,saved,signedIn,gearCount,related,waypoints}:Props) {
  const publicDays=days.map(publicTripDay);
  const route=publicRouteWaypoints(waypoints,days.flatMap(day=>day.id?[day.id]:[]));
  const unassigned=route.filter(point=>!point.dayId||!days.some(day=>day.id===point.dayId));
  const stats=summarizeTripDays(publicDays);
  const photo=destination?getDiscoverPhoto(destination):null;
  // Never expose an arbitrary user-entered precise location on a public browse page.
  const coords=destination?validCoordinates(destination):null;
  return <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#f6f8f7] pb-20 text-slate-900">
    <div className="bg-[#00802f] px-4 py-5 text-white"><div className="mx-auto max-w-screen-xl"><Link href="/discover/community" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold hover:underline"><ArrowLeft size={16}/>Back to Trips</Link></div></div>
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-screen-xl px-4 pt-6 sm:px-6">
      <div className="mb-5"><DiscoverSectionNav active="trips" /></div>
      <div className={`relative flex flex-col justify-end overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-800 via-teal-900 to-green-950 p-6 sm:p-8 ${photo ? "min-h-[210px] sm:min-h-[260px]" : ""}`}>
        {photo&&<>
          {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
          <img src={discoverPhotoUrl(photo)} alt={photo.representative?`Representative area photography in ${destination?.park}`:photo.description} className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/>
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/70 to-transparent" aria-hidden="true"/>
          <a href={discoverPhotoSource(photo)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="absolute right-3 top-3 rounded-md bg-black/70 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] text-white">{photo.representative?"Area photo · ":"Photo · "}{photo.author} · {photo.license}</a>
        </>}
        <div className="relative max-w-3xl text-white"><p className="mb-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Public community itinerary</p><h1 className="text-3xl font-bold sm:text-4xl">{name}</h1><p className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm"><MapPin size={16}/>{location||destination?.name||"Location not specified"}</p></div>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-6 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-5">
        <Stat title="Itinerary" value={`${stats.dayCount} ${stats.dayCount===1?"day":"days"}`} icon={CalendarDays}/>
        <Stat title="Distance entered" value={stats.distanceKm===null?"Not planned":`${Number(stats.distanceKm.toFixed(1))} km${stats.measuredDistanceDays<stats.dayCount?"*":""}`} icon={Footprints}/>
        <Stat title="Elevation entered" value={stats.elevationGainM===null?"Not planned":`${stats.elevationGainM.toLocaleString("en-CA")} m${stats.measuredGainDays<stats.dayCount?"*":""}`} icon={Mountain}/>
        <Stat title="Travellers" value={String(people)} icon={Users}/>
        <Stat title="Saved by" value={String(saves)} icon={Compass}/>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-6 grid gap-7 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_310px]">
        <div className="min-w-0 space-y-6">
          <section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 sm:p-6"><div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2"><div><h2 className="text-xl font-bold">Day-by-day itinerary</h2><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">Shared by {author} · {tripDate(startDate??days[0]?.date)}{endDate?` – ${tripDate(endDate)}`:""}</p></div><span className="rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-800">Read-only</span></div>
            <ol className="mt-5 space-y-3">{publicDays.map((day,index)=><li key={`${index}-${String(day.date)}`} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-4"><div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2"><div><p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-800">Day {index+1} · {tripDate(day.date)}</p><h3 className="mt-1 text-base font-bold text-slate-900">{tripDayTitle(day,index)}</h3></div><span className="text-xs text-slate-500">{day.distanceKm===null?"Distance not set":`${day.distanceKm} km`}</span></div>
              {day.activities&&<p className="mt-3 whitespace-pre-line text-sm leading-6 text-slate-700">{day.activities}</p>}
              {day.id&&route.some(point=>point.dayId===day.id)&&<div className="mt-3 border-t border-slate-200 pt-3"><p className="text-xs font-semibold text-green-900">Mapped stops</p><ol className="mt-2 space-y-1.5">{route.filter(point=>point.dayId===day.id).map((point,stopIndex)=><li key={point.id} className="text-xs text-slate-600">{stopIndex+1}. {point.name}{point.time?` · ${point.time}`:""}</li>)}</ol></div>}
              <dl className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-x-5 gap-y-2 text-xs text-slate-600">{day.campsite&&<div className="flex items-center gap-1"><Tent size={13}/><dt className="font-semibold">Camp:</dt><dd>{day.campsite}</dd></div>}{day.elevationGainM!==null&&<div><dt className="inline font-semibold">Gain: </dt><dd className="inline">{day.elevationGainM} m</dd></div>}{day.durationMinutes!=null&&<div><dt className="inline font-semibold">Planned time: </dt><dd className="inline">{Math.round(day.durationMinutes)} min</dd></div>}</dl>
            </li>)}</ol>
          </section>
          {(coords||route.length>0)&&<section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white"><div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 p-5"><div><h2 className="text-xl font-bold">Published route & location</h2><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{route.length?`${route.length} saved stops · dashed lines connect points directly, not along trails`:"Catalog destination pin, not a trailhead or mapped trail"}</p></div><a href={openStreetMapLink(coords??{latitude:route[0].lat,longitude:route[0].lng})} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-semibold text-green-900">Open map <ExternalLink size={14}/></a></div><DiscoverLocationMap coords={coords} points={route} title="Published itinerary route" height="trip"/>{unassigned.length>0&&<div className="border-t border-slate-100 p-4"><p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">Other mapped stops</p><ol className="mt-2 grid gap-1">{unassigned.map(point=><li key={point.id} className="text-xs text-slate-600">{point.name}{point.time?` · ${point.time}`:""}</li>)}</ol></div>}</section>}
          <RelatedDiscover related={related} title="More from this destination" />
          <section className="rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-5 text-sm text-amber-950"><h2 className="font-bold">Use this as a starting point</h2><p className="mt-2 leading-6">This is a community-contributed plan. Trip information and distances may be incomplete or outdated. Confirm current access, park restrictions, route suitability, permits, and weather before travelling.</p>{(stats.measuredDistanceDays!==stats.dayCount||stats.measuredGainDays!==stats.dayCount)&&<p className="mt-2 text-xs">* Total route statistics only include days with recorded values; they are not complete trip totals.</p>}</section>
        </div>
        <aside className="space-y-4 lg:sticky lg:top-6 lg:self-start"><section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5"><h2 className="text-lg font-bold">Make this trip yours</h2><p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">Copy this trip to create your own private, editable itinerary and gear list.</p><div className="mt-4"><TripActions id={id} saved={saved} signedIn={signedIn}/></div><div className="mt-4 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">{gearCount>0?<Link href={relatedPackHref(id)} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-green-900 hover:underline">View this trip’s gear list <ArrowRight size={15}/></Link>:<p className="text-xs text-slate-500">No public gear list attached to this trip.</p>}</div></section>
          <section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5"><h2 className="text-base font-bold">Trip details</h2><dl className="mt-3 space-y-3 text-sm"><div className="flex justify-between gap-3"><dt className="text-slate-500">Start</dt><dd className="text-right font-semibold">{tripDate(startDate)}</dd></div><div className="flex justify-between gap-3"><dt className="text-slate-500">End</dt><dd className="text-right font-semibold">{tripDate(endDate)}</dd></div><div className="flex justify-between gap-3"><dt className="text-slate-500">Gear entries</dt><dd className="font-semibold">{gearCount}</dd></div><div className="flex justify-between gap-3"><dt className="text-slate-500">Campsite entries</dt><dd className="font-semibold">{stats.campsites}</dd></div></dl>{destination&&<Link href={relatedDestinationHref(destination.id)} className="mt-5 inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-green-900 hover:underline">Explore the destination <ArrowRight size={15}/></Link>}</section>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </div>
  </main>;
}
```

```typescript
import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowRight, Backpack, CalendarDays, Compass } from "lucide-react";
import {
  relatedPackHref,
  relatedPublicSummary,
  relatedTripHref,
  type RelatedPublicContent,
  type RelatedPublicItem,
} from "@/lib/discover-related";

type Props = {
  related: RelatedPublicContent;
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  showEmpty?: boolean;
};

function RelatedGroup({
  kind,
  entries,
}: {
  kind: "trip" | "pack";
  entries: readonly RelatedPublicItem[];
}) {
  const trip = kind === "trip";
  const Icon = trip ? CalendarDays : Backpack;
  return <div className="min-w-0">
    <h3 className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700">
      <Icon size={17} className="text-emerald-700" aria-hidden="true" />
      {trip ? "Public trips" : "Gear builds"}
    </h3>
    <ul className="space-y-2">
      {entries.map(entry => <li key={entry.id}>
        <Link href={trip ? relatedTripHref(entry.id) : relatedPackHref(entry.id)}
          className="group flex min-h-20 items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-4 py-3 transition hover:border-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-50">
          <span className="min-w-0">
            <span className="block line-clamp-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-green-900">{entry.name}</span>
            <span className="mt-1 block text-xs text-slate-500">{relatedPublicSummary(entry, kind)}</span>
          </span>
          <ArrowRight size={17} className="shrink-0 text-emerald-700" aria-hidden="true" />
        </Link>
      </li>)}
    </ul>
  </div>;
}

export default function RelatedDiscover({
  related,
  title = "Connected community content",
  description = "Public trips and gear setups explicitly linked to this catalog destination.",
  showEmpty = false,
}: Props) {
  const hasTrips = related.trips.length > 0;
  const hasPacks = related.packs.length > 0;
  if (!hasTrips && !hasPacks && !showEmpty) return null;
  return <section aria-labelledby="related-discover-heading" className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 sm:p-6">
    <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
      <Compass size={20} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-emerald-700" aria-hidden="true" />
      <div>
        <h2 id="related-discover-heading" className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900">{title}</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">{description}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    {hasTrips || hasPacks ? <div className="mt-5 grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
      {hasTrips && <RelatedGroup kind="trip" entries={related.trips} />}
      {hasPacks && <RelatedGroup kind="pack" entries={related.packs} />}
    </div> : <p className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 px-4 py-4 text-sm text-slate-600">No public community trips or gear builds are linked to this destination yet.</p>}
    <nav aria-label="Explore more Discover sections" className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-x-5 gap-y-2 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4 text-sm font-semibold text-green-900">
      <Link href="/discover/community" className="hover:underline">Browse all trips</Link>
      <Link href="/discover/community?type=packs" className="hover:underline">Browse all builds</Link>
    </nav>
  </section>;
}

```

### `components/discover/SavedLibrary.tsx`

```typescript
import Link from "next/link";
import { Bookmark, Compass, MapPin, Backpack, CalendarDays, Search, ArrowRight, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { changeSavedBuild, changeSavedDestination } from "@/app/discover/actions";
import DiscoverHeader from "./DiscoverHeader";
import { filterSavedEntries, savedHref, savedUrl, type SavedEntry, type SavedSearch, type SavedType } from "@/lib/discover-saved";

const PAGE_SIZE = 12;
const tabs: { type: SavedType; name: string }[] = [
  {type:"all", name:"All saved"}, {type:"destinations",name:"Destinations"},
  {type:"trips",name:"Trips"}, {type:"packs",name:"Builds"},
];
const icons = {destination:MapPin,trip:CalendarDays,pack:Backpack};

export default function SavedLibrary({entries,search,signedIn}: {
  entries: SavedEntry[]; search:SavedSearch; signedIn:boolean;
}) {
  const filtered = filterSavedEntries(entries,search);
  const totalPages = Math.max(1,Math.ceil(filtered.length/PAGE_SIZE));
  const page = Math.min(search.page,totalPages);
  const shown = filtered.slice((page-1)*PAGE_SIZE,page*PAGE_SIZE);
  return <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#f6f8f7] pb-20 text-slate-900">
    <DiscoverHeader active="saved" back/>
    <div className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-white"><div className="mx-auto flex max-w-screen-xl items-center gap-3 px-4 py-6 sm:px-6"><span className="flex size-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-green-50 text-green-800"><Bookmark size={21}/></span><div><h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 sm:text-3xl">Saved</h1><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">Your bookmarked destinations, trips, and gear lists.</p></div></div></div>
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-screen-xl px-4 py-7 sm:px-6">
      {!signedIn ? <section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-6 py-14 text-center shadow-sm">
        <Bookmark className="mx-auto text-emerald-700" size={35} />
        <h2 className="mt-3 text-xl font-bold">Sign in to see your saved items</h2>
        <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-md text-sm text-slate-600">Bookmarks are kept with your account, so they remain available when you sign in again.</p>
        <Link href="/api/auth/signin?callbackUrl=%2Fdiscover%2Fsaved" className="mt-5 inline-flex rounded-xl bg-green-900 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-green-800">Sign in</Link>
      </section> : <>
        <nav aria-label="Saved categories" className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {tabs.map(tab => <Link key={tab.type} href={savedUrl(tab.type,search.q)}
            aria-current={search.type === tab.type ? "page" : undefined}
            className={`rounded-full border px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold transition ${search.type === tab.type ? "border-green-900 bg-green-900 text-white" : "border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:bg-emerald-50"}`}>
            {tab.name}{tab.type === "all" ? ` (${entries.length})` : ""}
          </Link>)}
        </nav>
        <form action="/discover/saved" method="get" className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <input type="hidden" name="savedType" value={search.type} />
          <label className="flex min-h-11 min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 sm:max-w-xl">
            <Search size={18} className="shrink-0 text-slate-400" aria-hidden="true" />
            <span className="sr-only">Search saved items</span>
            <input name="q" defaultValue={search.q} maxLength={100} placeholder="Search your saved items" className="h-11 min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent text-sm outline-none"/>
          </label>
          <button type="submit" className="rounded-xl bg-green-900 px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-green-800">Search</button>
          {search.q && <Link href={savedUrl(search.type)} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50">Clear</Link>}
        </form>
        <div className="mt-5 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-sm text-slate-600"><p>{filtered.length} {filtered.length === 1 ? "saved item" : "saved items"}</p><p>Newest saved first</p></div>
        {shown.length ? <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
          {shown.map(item => {
            const Icon = icons[item.kind]; const href = savedHref(item,search.type);
            const typeLabel = item.kind === "destination" ? "Destination" : item.hasDays && item.hasItems ? "Trip + gear" : item.hasDays ? "Trip" : "Gear build";
            return <article key={`${item.kind}:${item.id}`} className="flex min-w-0 flex-col rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-800"><Icon size={15} aria-hidden="true" />{typeLabel}</span>
              <h2 className="mt-3 break-words text-lg font-bold">{item.name}</h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">{item.subtitle}</p>
              <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-500">Saved {new Date(item.savedAt).toLocaleDateString("en-CA",{timeZone:"UTC",year:"numeric",month:"short",day:"numeric"})}</p>
              {!item.available && <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-amber-800">This listing is no longer available. You can remove the bookmark.</p>}
              <div className="mt-auto flex flex-wrap gap-2 pt-5">
                {href && <Link href={href} className="inline-flex min-h-10 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-green-900 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-green-800">Open <ArrowRight size={15}/></Link>}
                <form action={item.kind === "destination" ? changeSavedDestination : changeSavedBuild}>
                  <input type="hidden" name={item.kind === "destination" ? "destinationId" : "buildId"} value={item.id}/>
                  <input type="hidden" name="intent" value="unsave" />
                  <button type="submit" className="inline-flex min-h-10 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-rose-50" aria-label={`Remove ${item.name} from Saved`}><Trash2 size={15}/> Remove</button>
                </form>
              </div>
            </article>;
          })}
        </div> : <section className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-10 text-center">
          <Compass size={32} className="mx-auto text-emerald-700"/>
          <h2 className="mt-3 text-lg font-bold">{search.q ? "No matching saved items" : "Nothing saved here yet"}</h2>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">Explore destinations, public trips, and gear lists to add bookmarks.</p>
          <Link href="/discover/search" className="mt-4 inline-flex rounded-xl bg-green-900 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-green-800">Explore destinations</Link>
        </section>}
        {totalPages > 1 && <nav aria-label="Saved pages" className="mt-7 flex items-center justify-center gap-3">
          {page > 1 && <Link href={savedUrl(search.type,search.q,page-1)} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold">Previous</Link>}
          <span className="text-sm text-slate-600">{page} / {totalPages}</span>
          {page < totalPages && <Link href={savedUrl(search.type,search.q,page+1)} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold">Next</Link>}
        </nav>}
      </>}
    </div>
  </main>;
}

```

```typescript
import { Compass, Flower2, Mountain, Sailboat, Trees, Waves } from "lucide-react";
import type { Scenery } from "@/lib/discover-finder";

/** Share TrailPicker's existing Lucide icon style with the activity filters. */
const icons = {
  any: Compass,
  lakes: Waves,
  summits: Mountain,
  forest: Trees,
  coast: Sailboat,
  meadows: Flower2,
} satisfies Record<Scenery, typeof Compass>;

export default function SceneryIcon({ scene, className = "h-4 w-4" }: { scene: Scenery; className?: string }) {
  const Icon = icons[scene];
  return <Icon aria-hidden="true" className={className} strokeWidth={2} />;
}
```

### `components/discover/ShareDestinationButton.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Check, Copy } from "lucide-react";

export default function ShareDestinationButton() {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  async function copy() {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href);
      setCopied(true);
    } catch {
      // Copying is optional; no false confirmation if browser permission is denied.
      setCopied(false);
    }
  }
  return <button type="button" onClick={copy} className="inline-flex h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-slate-50" aria-live="polite">
    {copied ? <Check size={16} aria-hidden="true" /> : <Copy size={16} aria-hidden="true" />}
    {copied ? "Copied" : "Copy link"}
  </button>;
}


```

```typescript
"use client";

import {useFormStatus} from "react-dom";
import type {ReactNode} from "react";
import {Bookmark, Copy} from "lucide-react";
import {changeSavedBuild, copyPublicBuild} from "@/app/discover/actions";

function ActionButton({kind, children}: {kind: "save" | "copy"; children: ReactNode}) {
  const {pending} = useFormStatus();
  const Icon = kind === "save" ? Bookmark : Copy;
  return <button type="submit" disabled={pending} className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-green-900 transition hover:border-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-50 disabled:opacity-50"><Icon size={16} aria-hidden="true" />{pending ? "Working…" : children}</button>;
}

export default function TripActions({id, saved, signedIn}: {id: string; saved: boolean; signedIn: boolean}) {
  return <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
    <form action={changeSavedBuild}>
      <input type="hidden" name="buildId" value={id}/>
      <input type="hidden" name="intent" value={saved ? "unsave" : "save"}/>
      <ActionButton kind="save">{saved ? "Saved" : "Save trip"}</ActionButton>
    </form>
    <form action={copyPublicBuild}>
      <input type="hidden" name="buildId" value={id}/>
      <ActionButton kind="copy">Copy to my planner</ActionButton>
    </form>
    {!signedIn && <p className="w-full text-xs text-slate-500">Sign in to save or copy. Copies are private and editable.</p>}
  </div>;
}
```

```typescript
import Link from "next/link";
import {ArrowRight, Backpack, Bookmark, CalendarDays, Compass, Footprints, MapPin, Mountain, Route, Search, Tent, SlidersHorizontal, FilterX} from "lucide-react";
import type {DiscoverSearch} from "@/lib/discover";
import type {Destination} from "@/lib/destinations";
import type {TripDayPublic, TripFeature} from "@/lib/discover-trips";
import {tripBrowseHref, tripDate, tripDayTitle, tripHref, summarizeTripDays} from "@/lib/discover-trips";
import {getDiscoverPhoto, discoverPhotoUrl, discoverPhotoSource} from "@/lib/discover-photos";
import TripActions from "./TripActions";
import DiscoverHeader from "./DiscoverHeader";

export type PublicTripCard = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  location: string | null;
  author: string;
  destination: Destination | null;
  startDate: string | null;
  endDate: string | null;
  updatedAt: string;
  people: number;
  days: TripDayPublic[];
  saves: number;
  saved: boolean;
  gearCount: number;
};
type Props = { trips: PublicTripCard[]; filters: DiscoverSearch; feature: TripFeature; regions: string[]; total: number; totalPages: number; signedIn: boolean };
const features = [
  {value: "all", label: "All trips", Icon: Compass},
  {value: "route", label: "With route details", Icon: Route},
  {value: "campsite", label: "Campsite plans", Icon: Tent},
  {value: "gear", label: "With gear lists", Icon: Backpack},
] as const;
function TripCard({trip,signedIn}: {trip: PublicTripCard;signedIn:boolean}) {
  const stats=summarizeTripDays(trip.days);
  const photo=trip.destination ? getDiscoverPhoto(trip.destination) : null;
  const first=trip.days[0];
  return <article className="flex min-w-0 flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm transition hover:border-emerald-200 hover:shadow-md">
    <div className="relative flex h-40 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-br from-teal-100 via-emerald-100 to-green-800 text-green-900/40">
      {photo ? <>
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img src={discoverPhotoUrl(photo)} alt={photo.representative ? `Area photograph of ${trip.destination?.park}` : photo.description} loading="lazy" referrerPolicy="no-referrer" className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover"/>
        <a href={discoverPhotoSource(photo)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" title={`${photo.author} · ${photo.license}`} className="absolute bottom-2 right-2 z-10 rounded-md bg-slate-950/70 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-white">{photo.representative ? "Area photo" : "Photo"} · {photo.author} · {photo.license}</a>
      </> : <Mountain size={56} strokeWidth={1.3} aria-hidden="true"/>}
      <span className="absolute left-3 top-3 rounded-lg bg-white/95 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-green-900 shadow-sm">{stats.dayCount} {stats.dayCount === 1 ? "day" : "days"}</span>
    </div>
    <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col p-5">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3"><div className="min-w-0 flex-1"><Link href={tripHref(trip.id)} className="line-clamp-2 text-lg font-bold leading-snug text-slate-900 hover:text-green-800">{trip.name}</Link><p className="mt-2 flex items-start gap-1 text-sm text-slate-600"><MapPin size={15} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-emerald-800"/>{trip.location || trip.destination?.name || "Location not specified"}</p></div><span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-slate-500"><Bookmark size={13}/>{trip.saves}</span></div>
      <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-sm">
        <div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-3"><span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-slate-500"><Footprints size={13}/> Distance</span><strong className="mt-1 block">{stats.distanceKm === null ? "Not planned" : `${Number(stats.distanceKm.toFixed(1))} km${stats.measuredDistanceDays < stats.dayCount ? "*" : ""}`}</strong></div>
        <div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-3"><span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-slate-500"><Mountain size={13}/> Elevation gain</span><strong className="mt-1 block">{stats.elevationGainM === null ? "Not planned" : `${stats.elevationGainM.toLocaleString("en-CA")} m${stats.measuredGainDays < stats.dayCount ? "*" : ""}`}</strong></div>
      </div>
      {first && <p className="mt-4 line-clamp-2 text-sm text-slate-600"><span className="font-semibold text-slate-700">Day 1: </span>{tripDayTitle(first,0)}</p>}
      <p className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500"><CalendarDays size={13}/> {tripDate(trip.startDate ?? first?.date)}{trip.endDate && trip.endDate !== trip.startDate ? ` – ${tripDate(trip.endDate)}` : ""}</p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">By {trip.author} · {trip.gearCount} gear items · {stats.campsites} campsite entries</p>
      {stats.measuredDistanceDays > 0 && stats.measuredDistanceDays < stats.dayCount && <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">* Totals include only days with recorded values.</p>}
      <div className="mt-auto space-y-3 pt-4"><Link href={tripHref(trip.id)} className="flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-green-900 px-4 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-green-800">View itinerary <ArrowRight size={16}/></Link><TripActions id={trip.id} saved={trip.saved} signedIn={signedIn}/></div>
    </div>
  </article>;
}
export default function TripExplore({trips, filters, feature, regions, total, totalPages, signedIn}: Props) {

    </div></div>
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-screen-2xl px-4 pt-7 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
      <section className="mb-6"><h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">Browse itineraries</h2><p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">Explore public trips and make a private copy of any itinerary you want to adapt.</p></section>
      <nav aria-label="Trip quick filters" className="mb-5 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-2">{features.map(({value,label,Icon})=><Link key={value} href={tripBrowseHref(state,feature,{feature:value,page:1})} aria-current={feature===value?"true":undefined} className={`inline-flex min-h-11 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-4 text-sm font-semibold ${feature===value?"border-green-900 bg-green-900 text-white":"border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:bg-emerald-50"}`}><Icon size={16}/>{label}</Link>)}</nav>
      <form action="/discover/community" method="get" className="grid gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(200px,1fr)_repeat(3,minmax(120px,auto))_auto]">
```

### `components/filters/BrandFilter.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import {
    useRouter,
    useSearchParams,
} from "next/navigation";

type Props = {
    brands: {
        id: string;
        name: string;
    }[];
};

export default function BrandFilter({ brands }: Props) {
    const router = useRouter();
    const searchParams = useSearchParams();
    const selected =
        searchParams.get("brand")?.split(",") ?? [];
    const allSelected =
        selected.length === 0;

    function toggleBrand(brand: string) {
        const params =
            new URLSearchParams(searchParams);

        let updated =
            [...selected];

        if (updated.includes(brand)) {
            updated = updated.filter(
                (item) => item !== brand
            );
        } else {
            updated.push(brand);
        }

        if (updated.length === 0) {
            params.delete("brand");
        } else {
            params.set(
                "brand",
                updated.join(",")
            );
        }

        router.push(
            `?${params.toString()}`
        );
    }

    function selectAll() {
        const params =
            new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
        params.delete("brand");

        router.push(
            `?${params.toString()}`
        );
    }

    return (
        <div>
            <div className="space-">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-1 hover:bg-gray-100 cursor-pointer transition text-[14px]">

                    <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={allSelected}
                        onChange={selectAll}
                        className="h-4 w-4 rounded"
                    />

                    <span className="font-medium">
                        All
                    </span>
                </label>

                {brands.map((brand) => (
                    <label
                        key={brand.id}
                        className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-1 hover:bg-gray-100 cursor-pointer transition text-[15px]"
                    >
                        <input
                            type="checkbox"
                            checked={selected.includes(brand.name)}
                            onChange={() => toggleBrand(brand.name)}
                            className="h-4 w-4 rounded"
                        />

                        <span>
                            {brand.name}
                        </span>
                    </label>
                ))}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}
```

### `components/filters/RangeFilter.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import {
    useRouter,
    useSearchParams,
} from "next/navigation";


type Props = {
    min: number;
    max: number;
    unit: string;
    param: string;
};


export default function RangeFilter({
    min,
    max,
    unit,
    param,
}: Props) {

    const router = useRouter();
    const searchParams = useSearchParams();


    const urlValue =
        Number(searchParams.get(param))
        || max;


    const [value, setValue] =
        useState(urlValue);


    function updateValue(newValue: number) {

        setValue(newValue);


        const params =
            new URLSearchParams(searchParams);


        if (newValue >= max) {

            params.delete(param);

        } else {

            params.set(
                param,
                newValue.toString()
            );

        }


        router.push(
            `?${params.toString()}`
        );
    }


    return (
        <div className="space-y-3">

            <input
                type="range"
                min={min}
                max={max}
                value={value}
                onChange={(e) =>
                    updateValue(
                        Number(e.target.value)
                    )
                }
                className="range-slider"
                style={{
                    ["--progress" as string]: `${((value - min) / (max - min)) * 100}%`,
                }}
            />


            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                <input
                    type="number"
                    value={value}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                        updateValue(
                            Number(e.target.value)
                        )
                    }
                    className="w-full rounded bg-gray-100 px-2 py-1 text-sm border-0"
                />


                <span className="text-sm text-gray-500">
                    {unit}
                </span>

            </div>

        </div>
    );
}
```

### `components/filters/SortHeader.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import {
    useRouter,
    useSearchParams,
} from "next/navigation";

type Props = {
    label: string;
    value: string;
};

export default function SortHeader({
    label,
    value,
}: Props) {

    const router = useRouter();
    const searchParams = useSearchParams();

    const currentSort = searchParams.get("sort");

    const currentDirection =
        searchParams.get("direction");


    function sort() {
        const params =
            new URLSearchParams(searchParams);


        if (currentSort === value) {

            params.set(
                "direction",
                currentDirection === "asc"
                    ? "desc"
                    : "asc"
            );

        } else {

            params.set(
                "sort",
                value
            );

            params.set(
                "direction",
                "asc"
            );
        }


        router.push(
            `?${params.toString()}`
        );
    }


    return (
        <button
            onClick={sort}
            className="text-center hover:text-blue-600 cursor-pointer transition"
        >
            {label}

            {currentSort === value && (
                <span className="ml-1">
                    {currentDirection === "desc"
                        ? "↓"
                        : "↑"}
                </span>
            )}
        </button>
    );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { X, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import { COMPARE_STORAGE_KEY, type SelectedGear } from "@/components/gear/GearCompareSelection";
import { replaceComparedGear } from "@/app/gear/compare/actions";

export function RemoveFromComparison({ productId, selected, buildId }: { productId: string; selected: SelectedGear[]; buildId?: string | null }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  function remove() {
    const remaining = selected.filter(p => p.id !== productId);
    try { sessionStorage.setItem(COMPARE_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(remaining)); } catch { /* Storage is optional. */ }
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ ids: remaining.map(p => p.id).join(",") });
    if (buildId) params.set("build", buildId);
    router.push(`/gear/compare?${params}`);
  }
  return <button type="button" onClick={remove} aria-label="Remove from comparison" title="Remove from comparison" className="rounded-full border border-gray-200 bg-white p-2 text-gray-500 transition hover:border-red-200 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-700"><X className="h-4 w-4" /></button>;
}

export function ReplaceComparedGear({ buildId, newGearId, items }: { buildId: string; newGearId: string; items: Array<{ id: string; name: string }> }) {
  const [itemId, setItemId] = useState(items[0]?.id ?? "");
  const [pending, start] = useTransition();
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const router = useRouter();
  if (!items.length) return null;
  function replace() {
    if (!itemId) return;
    const form = new FormData();
    form.set("buildId", buildId);
    form.set("itemId", itemId);
    form.set("newGearId", newGearId);
    setError(""); setMessage("");
    start(async () => {
      try {
        const result = await replaceComparedGear(form);
        setMessage(result.message);
        router.refresh();
      } catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not replace this item."); }
    });
  }
  return <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 p-3">
    <label htmlFor={`replace-${newGearId}`} className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700">Replace in current build</label>
    <select id={`replace-${newGearId}`} value={itemId} onChange={event => setItemId(event.target.value)} disabled={pending} className="mt-2 w-full min-w-0 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 bg-white px-2 py-2 text-xs text-gray-900 focus:border-green-700 focus:outline-none">
      {items.map(item => <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>{item.name}</option>)}
    </select>
    <button type="button" onClick={replace} disabled={pending || !itemId} className="mt-2 inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-green-800 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-green-900 hover:bg-green-50 disabled:opacity-50"><RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />{pending ? "Replacing…" : "Replace selected item"}</button>
    {message && <p role="status" className="mt-2 text-xs text-green-800">{message}</p>}
    {error && <p role="alert" className="mt-2 text-xs text-red-700">{error}</p>}
  </div>;
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import type { ComparisonRow } from "@/lib/gear-comparison";

export default function ComparisonTable({ products, rows }: { products: Array<{ id: string; name: string }>; rows: ComparisonRow[] }) {
  const [differencesOnly, setDifferencesOnly] = useState(false);
  const visible = rows.filter(row => !differencesOnly || row.different);
  return <section aria-label="Product specification comparison" className="mt-8 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-sm">
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-gray-100 px-5 py-4 sm:px-6">
      <div><h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-950">Side-by-side specifications</h2><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">A dash means that information is not available, not that the product lacks the feature.</p></div>
      <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700"><input type="checkbox" checked={differencesOnly} onChange={event => setDifferencesOnly(event.target.checked)} className="h-4 w-4 accent-green-800" />Differences only</label>
    </div>
    <div className="overflow-x-auto"><table style={{ minWidth: `${200 + products.length * 210}px` }} className="w-full table-fixed border-separate border-spacing-0 text-left text-sm">
      <thead><tr><th scope="col" className="sticky left-0 z-10 w-40 border-b border-r border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-4 py-4 font-semibold text-gray-700 sm:w-48">Feature</th>{products.map(product => <th scope="col" key={product.id} className="border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-4 py-4 font-semibold text-gray-950">{product.name}</th>)}</tr></thead>
      <tbody>{(["Overview", "Specifications"] as const).map(section => {
        const sectionRows = visible.filter(row => row.section === section);
        if (!sectionRows.length) return null;
        return <FragmentSection key={section} section={section} rows={sectionRows} count={products.length} />;
      })}</tbody>
    </table></div>
    {!visible.length && <p className="px-6 py-7 text-sm text-gray-500">No differing specifications were recorded for these products.</p>}
    <p className="border-t border-gray-100 px-5 py-3 text-xs text-gray-500">Green highlights indicate a lower listed price, lower weight, or greater capacity among the selected products. Other differences are descriptive, not automatically better.</p>
  </section>;
}

function FragmentSection({ section, rows, count }: { section: string; rows: ComparisonRow[]; count: number }) {
  return <>
    <tr><th colSpan={count + 1} scope="colgroup" className="bg-green-50 px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-green-900">{section}</th></tr>
    {rows.map(row => <tr key={row.key} className="group">
      <th scope="row" className="sticky left-0 z-10 border-b border-r border-gray-100 bg-white px-4 py-3 font-medium text-gray-700 group-hover:bg-gray-50">{row.label}{row.different && <span className="ml-1.5 text-green-700" aria-label="Values differ">•</span>}</th>
      {row.values.map((value, index) => <td key={index} className={`border-b border-gray-100 px-4 py-3 align-top ${row.bestIndices.includes(index) ? "bg-green-50 font-semibold text-green-900" : row.different ? "bg-amber-50/30 text-gray-900" : "text-gray-600"}`}>
        {value ?? <span className="text-gray-400">—</span>}
        {row.bestIndices.includes(index) && row.bestLabel && <span className="ml-2 inline-block rounded bg-green-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-green-800">{row.bestLabel}</span>}
      </td>)}
    </tr>)}
  </>;
}
```

### `components/gear/GearCompareSelection.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { createContext, useContext, useMemo, useState, useSyncExternalStore, type ReactNode } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { Check, Scale, X } from "lucide-react";

export type SelectedGear = { id: string; name: string; categoryId: string; categoryName: string };
export const COMPARE_STORAGE_KEY = "trailpicker-gear-compare-v1";

function valid(value: unknown): value is SelectedGear {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object") return false;
  const data = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  return ["id", "name", "categoryId", "categoryName"].every(key => typeof data[key] === "string" && (data[key] as string).length > 0 && (data[key] as string).length <= 200);
}

const EMPTY: SelectedGear[] = [];
let cacheRaw: string | null | undefined;
let cache: SelectedGear[] = EMPTY;
let inMemory: SelectedGear[] = EMPTY;
let storageBlocked = false;
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

function sanitize(raw: string | null): SelectedGear[] {
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return EMPTY;
    const accepted = parsed.filter(valid).slice(0, 4);
    const category = accepted[0]?.categoryId;
    return accepted.filter(p => p.categoryId === category).filter((p, index, items) => items.findIndex(other => other.id === p.id) === index);
  } catch { return EMPTY; }
}

function snapshot() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return EMPTY;
  if (storageBlocked) return inMemory;
  try {
    const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(COMPARE_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (raw !== cacheRaw) { cacheRaw = raw; cache = sanitize(raw); }
    return cache;
  } catch { storageBlocked = true; return inMemory; }
}
function subscribe(listener: () => void) {
  listeners.add(listener);
  window.addEventListener("storage", listener);
  return () => { listeners.delete(listener); window.removeEventListener("storage", listener); };
}
function writeSelection(value: SelectedGear[]) {
  inMemory = value;
  try {
    sessionStorage.setItem(COMPARE_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(value));
    cacheRaw = JSON.stringify(value);
    cache = value;
  } catch { storageBlocked = true; }
  listeners.forEach(listener => listener());
}

type CompareContextType = {
  selected: SelectedGear[];
  toggle: (product: SelectedGear) => void;
  clear: () => void;
};
const CompareContext = createContext<CompareContextType | null>(null);

export default function GearCompareSelection({ children, buildId = null }: { children: ReactNode; buildId?: string | null }) {
  const selected = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, snapshot, () => EMPTY);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const value = useMemo<CompareContextType>(() => ({
    selected,
    toggle(product) {
      if (selected.some(item => item.id === product.id)) {
        writeSelection(selected.filter(item => item.id !== product.id));
        setNotice("");
        return;
      }
      if (selected.length && selected[0].categoryId !== product.categoryId) {
        setNotice(`Compare products in the same category. Clear your ${selected[0].categoryName} selection first.`);
        return;
      }
      if (selected.length === 4) {
        setNotice("Select up to four products.");
        return;
      }
      setNotice("");
      writeSelection([...selected, product]);
    },
    clear() { writeSelection([]); setNotice(""); },
  }), [selected]);
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ ids: selected.map(item => item.id).join(",") });
  if (buildId) params.set("build", buildId);

  return <CompareContext.Provider value={value}>
    <div className={selected.length ? "pb-28" : ""}>{children}</div>
    {selected.length > 0 && <aside aria-label="Gear comparison selection" className="fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-40 border-t border-green-200 bg-white/95 shadow-[0_-10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.15)] backdrop-blur">
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-7xl flex-wrap items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 sm:px-8">
        <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 font-semibold text-gray-900"><Scale className="h-5 w-5 text-green-800" /><span>Compare ({selected.length}/4)</span></div>
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-wrap gap-1.5">{selected.map(item => <button key={item.id} type="button" onClick={() => value.toggle(item)} title={`Remove ${item.name}`} className="inline-flex max-w-40 items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-green-200 bg-green-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-green-900 hover:bg-green-100"><span className="truncate">{item.name}</span><X aria-hidden="true" className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" /></button>)}</div>
        <button type="button" onClick={value.clear} className="rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-100">Clear</button>
        {selected.length >= 2 ? <Link href={`/gear/compare?${params}`} className="rounded-lg bg-green-900 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-green-800">Compare {selected.length} products</Link> : <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">Select one more</span>}
        {notice && <p role="status" className="w-full text-xs text-amber-800">{notice}</p>}
      </div>
    </aside>}
  </CompareContext.Provider>;
}

export function GearCompareButton({ product, className = "" }: { product: SelectedGear; className?: string }) {
  const context = useContext(CompareContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error("GearCompareButton must be inside GearCompareSelection.");
  const checked = context.selected.some(item => item.id === product.id);
  return <button type="button" aria-pressed={checked} onClick={() => context.toggle(product)} className={`inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold transition focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-green-800 ${checked ? "border-green-800 bg-green-50 text-green-900" : "border-gray-200 bg-white text-gray-700 hover:border-green-700 hover:text-green-900"} ${className}`}>
    {checked ? <Check aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Scale aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4" />}
    {checked ? "Selected" : "Compare"}
  </button>;
}

```

### `components/gear/GearLibraryActions.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Heart, PackageCheck, Check } from "lucide-react";
import { addFavorite, removeFavorite, addOwnedGear, removeOwnedGear } from "@/app/profile/gear/actions";

export default function GearLibraryActions({ gearId, signedIn, owned, favorite }: { gearId: string; signedIn: boolean; owned: boolean; favorite: boolean }) {
  const [pending, start] = useTransition();
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  if (!signedIn) return <Link href={`/api/auth/signin?callbackUrl=${encodeURIComponent(`/gear/${gearId}`)}`} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-gray-50"><Heart className="h-4 w-4" />Sign in to save gear</Link>;
  function run(action: (form: FormData) => Promise<void>) {
    const form = new FormData(); form.set("gearId", gearId); setError("");
    start(async () => { try { await action(form); } catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not update your library."); } });
  }
  return <div><div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
    <button type="button" aria-pressed={owned} disabled={pending} onClick={() => run(owned ? removeOwnedGear : addOwnedGear)} className={`inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold disabled:cursor-wait disabled:opacity-60 ${owned ? "border-green-200 bg-green-50 text-green-900" : "border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50"}`}>
      {owned ? <Check className="h-4 w-4" /> : <PackageCheck className="h-4 w-4" />}{owned ? "In My Gear" : "I own this"}
    </button>
    <button type="button" aria-pressed={favorite} disabled={pending} onClick={() => run(favorite ? removeFavorite : addFavorite)} className={`inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold disabled:cursor-wait disabled:opacity-60 ${favorite ? "border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-700" : "border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50"}`}>
      <Heart className={`h-4 w-4 ${favorite ? "fill-current" : ""}`} />{favorite ? "Favorited" : "Favorite"}
    </button>
  </div>{pending && <p role="status" className="mt-2 text-xs text-gray-500">Saving…</p>}{error && <p role="alert" className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-700">{error}</p>}</div>;
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Plus } from "lucide-react";
import { addGear } from "@/app/build/actions";

export default function ProductBuildButton({ buildId, gearId }: { buildId: string; gearId: string }) {
  const [pending,start]=useTransition();const [error,setError]=useState("");
  function submit(form: FormData) { setError("");start(async()=>{try {await addGear(form);}catch(e){if(e&&typeof e==="object"&&"digest" in e&&typeof e.digest==="string"&&e.digest.startsWith("NEXT_REDIRECT;"))throw e;setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:"Could not add gear.");}}); }
  return <form action={submit}><input type="hidden" name="buildId" value={buildId}/><input type="hidden" name="gearId" value={gearId}/><button disabled={pending} className="inline-flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-green-900 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-green-800 disabled:cursor-wait disabled:opacity-60"><Plus className="h-4 w-4"/>{pending?"Adding…":"Add to build"}</button>{error&&<p role="alert" className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-700">{error}</p>}</form>;
}
```

```typescript
import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowUpRight, Star, Scale } from "lucide-react";
import ProductGallery from "@/components/gear/ProductGallery";
import GearLibraryActions from "@/components/gear/GearLibraryActions";
import ReviewEditor from "@/components/gear/ReviewEditor";
import ProductBuildButton from "@/components/gear/ProductBuildButton";
import { gearMoney, gearWeight, reviewStats, safeGearUrl } from "@/lib/gear-display";
import { GearCompareButton } from "@/components/gear/GearCompareSelection";

export type Product = {
  id:string;name:string;description:string|null;weight_g:number|null;price_cad:number|null;capacity_l:number|null;frame_type:string|null;waterproof:boolean|null;temperature_rating:number|null;season:string|null;material:string|null;
  brand:{name:string};category:{id:string;name:string;slug:string};subcategory:{name:string;slug:string}|null;
  images:Array<{id:string;url:string;isPrimary:boolean}>;
  specifications:Array<{id:string;key:string;value:string;unit:string|null}>;
  prices:Array<{id:string;price:number;currency:string;url:string|null;inStock:boolean;lastUpdated:Date;retailer:{name:string}}>;
  reviews:Array<{id:string;userId:string;rating:number;title:string|null;body:string|null;createdAt:Date;user:{name:string|null;username:string|null}}>;
};
function Stars({rating}:{rating:number}){return <span aria-label={`${rating} out of 5 stars`} className="inline-flex gap-0.5">{[1,2,3,4,5].map(n=><Star key={n} aria-hidden="true" className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${n<=rating?"fill-amber-400 text-amber-400":"text-gray-200"}`}/>)}</span>;}
const date=(value:Date)=>value.toLocaleDateString("en-CA",{year:"numeric",month:"short",day:"numeric",timeZone:"UTC"});

export default function ProductDetails({gear,userId,owned,favorite,build}:{gear:Product;userId:string|null;owned:boolean;favorite:boolean;build:{id:string;name:string}|null}) {
  const stats=reviewStats(gear.reviews);
  const ownReview=gear.reviews.find(review=>review.userId===userId)??null;
  const prices=[...gear.prices].sort((a,b)=>Number(b.currency==="CAD")-Number(a.currency==="CAD")||Number(b.inStock)-Number(a.inStock)||a.price-b.price);
  const cadPrices=prices.filter(price=>price.currency==="CAD"&&price.inStock);
  const best=cadPrices[0]?.price??gear.price_cad;
  const categoryHref=`/gear/${encodeURIComponent(gear.category.slug)}`;
  const specs:Array<[string,string]>=[];
  if(gear.weight_g!==null)specs.push(["Weight",gearWeight(gear.weight_g)]);
  if(gear.capacity_l!==null)specs.push(["Capacity",`${gear.capacity_l} L`]);
  if(gear.frame_type)specs.push(["Frame",gear.frame_type]);
  if(gear.waterproof!==null)specs.push(["Waterproof",gear.waterproof?"Yes":"No"]);
  if(gear.temperature_rating!==null)specs.push(["Temperature rating",`${gear.temperature_rating} °C`]);
  if(gear.season)specs.push(["Season",gear.season]);
  if(gear.material)specs.push(["Material",gear.material]);
  for(const spec of gear.specifications){if(!specs.some(([key])=>key.toLowerCase()===spec.key.toLowerCase()))specs.push([spec.key,`${spec.value}${spec.unit?` ${spec.unit}`:""}`]);}
  return <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50"><main className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 py-6 sm:px-8 sm:py-8">
    <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb" className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-xs text-gray-500"><Link href={categoryHref} className="hover:text-green-800">{gear.category.name}</Link>{gear.subcategory&&<><span aria-hidden="true">/</span><Link href={`${categoryHref}/${encodeURIComponent(gear.subcategory.slug)}`} className="hover:text-green-800">{gear.subcategory.name}</Link></>}<span aria-hidden="true">/</span><span aria-current="page" className="text-gray-800">{gear.name}</span></nav>
    <div className="grid items-start gap-7 md:grid-cols-2 lg:gap-12">
      <ProductGallery name={gear.name} images={gear.images}/>
      <div className="min-w-0 py-2"><p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-green-800">{gear.brand.name}</p><h1 className="mt-2 break-words text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-gray-950 sm:text-4xl">{gear.name}</h1><p className="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-500">{gear.subcategory?.name??gear.category.name}</p>
        <Link href="#reviews" className="mt-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm hover:underline"><Star className="h-4 w-4 fill-amber-400 text-amber-400"/>{stats.count?<><b>{stats.average.toFixed(1)}</b><span className="text-gray-500">({stats.count} review{stats.count===1?"":"s"})</span></>:<span className="text-gray-500">No reviews yet</span>}</Link>
        <div className="mt-6 border-y border-gray-200 py-5"><p className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight">{gearMoney(best)}</p><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">{cadPrices.length?"Lowest listed in-stock CAD offer. Shipping and taxes may vary.":best!==null?"Catalog price · retailer prices may vary":"No price has been added for this product."}</p><p className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-600"><Scale className="h-4 w-4"/>{gearWeight(gear.weight_g)}</p></div>
        <div className="mt-5">{build?<><p className="mb-2 text-xs text-gray-500">Adding to <Link href={`/build/${build.id}`} className="font-medium text-green-800 hover:underline">{build.name}</Link></p><ProductBuildButton buildId={build.id} gearId={gear.id}/></>:<Link href="/build" className="inline-flex w-full justify-center rounded-lg bg-green-900 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-green-800">Create a build</Link>}</div>
        <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-start gap-3"><GearCompareButton product={{ id: gear.id, name: gear.name, categoryId: gear.category.id, categoryName: gear.category.name }} className="px-4 py-3"/><GearLibraryActions gearId={gear.id} signedIn={Boolean(userId)} owned={owned} favorite={favorite}/></div>
        <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-4 text-xs text-gray-500"><Link href="/profile/gear" className="hover:text-green-800">My Gear</Link><Link href="/profile/favorites" className="hover:text-green-800">Favorites</Link><Link href="#retailers" className="hover:text-green-800">Compare prices</Link><Link href="#specifications" className="hover:text-green-800">Specifications</Link></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div className="mt-9 grid items-start gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
      <section id="retailers" className="scroll-mt-20 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white"><div className="border-b border-gray-100 px-5 py-4"><h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">Compare prices</h2><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">Listed offers, with each retailer’s currency and availability.</p></div>{prices.length?<ul className="divide-y divide-gray-100">{prices.map(price=>{const url=safeGearUrl(price.url);return <li key={price.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 px-5 py-4"><div className="min-w-0"><p className="font-medium">{price.retailer.name}</p><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500"><span className={price.inStock?"text-green-700":"text-gray-500"}>{price.inStock?"Listed in stock":"Out of stock"}</span> · Updated {date(price.lastUpdated)}</p></div><div className="flex items-center gap-3"><b className="text-sm">{gearMoney(price.price,price.currency)}</b>{url?<a href={url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-gray-50">View <ArrowUpRight className="h-3 w-3"/></a>:<span className="text-xs text-gray-400">No link</span>}</div></li>})}</ul>:<p className="p-5 text-sm text-gray-500">No retailer offers yet.</p>}</section>
      <section id="specifications" className="scroll-mt-20 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white"><h2 className="border-b border-gray-100 px-5 py-4 text-lg font-semibold">Specifications</h2>{specs.length?<dl className="divide-y divide-gray-100">{specs.map(([key,value])=><div key={key} className="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1fr)] gap-4 px-5 py-3 text-sm"><dt className="text-gray-500">{key}</dt><dd className="break-words font-medium">{value}</dd></div>)}</dl>:<p className="p-5 text-sm text-gray-500">No specifications yet.</p>}</section>
    </div>
    {gear.description&&<section className="mt-6 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-5 sm:p-6"><h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">About this product</h2><p className="mt-3 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm leading-7 text-gray-600">{gear.description}</p></section>}
    <section id="reviews" className="mt-6 scroll-mt-20 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-5 sm:p-6"><h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">Community reviews</h2><div className="mt-5 grid items-start gap-7 lg:grid-cols-[260px_minmax(0,1fr)]">
      <div>{stats.count?<><p className="text-4xl font-bold">{stats.average.toFixed(1)}<span className="ml-2 text-sm font-normal text-gray-400">/ 5</span></p><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">Based on {stats.count} review{stats.count===1?"":"s"}</p><div className="mt-4 space-y-2">{stats.buckets.map(bucket=><div key={bucket.rating} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-500"><span>{bucket.rating} star</span><div className="h-1.5 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-gray-100"><div className="h-full bg-amber-400" style={{width:`${bucket.count/stats.count*100}%`}}/></div><span className="w-4 text-right">{bucket.count}</span></div>)}</div></>:<p className="text-sm text-gray-500">Be the first to review this gear.</p>}<p className="mt-5 text-xs leading-5 text-gray-400">Ratings are from TrailPicker members.</p></div>
      <div className="min-w-0">{userId?<ReviewEditor key={ownReview?.id??"new"} gearId={gear.id} review={ownReview}/>:<p className="rounded-lg bg-gray-50 p-4 text-sm text-gray-600"><Link href={`/api/auth/signin?callbackUrl=${encodeURIComponent(`/gear/${gear.id}#reviews`)}`} className="font-semibold text-green-800 hover:underline">Sign in</Link> to write a review.</p>}
        <div className="mt-5 divide-y divide-gray-100">{gear.reviews.map(review=><article key={review.id} className="py-5"><div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2"><span className="text-sm font-semibold">{review.user.username?`@${review.user.username}`:review.user.name??"TrailPicker member"}{review.userId===userId&&<span className="ml-2 text-xs font-normal text-green-700">You</span>}</span><span className="text-xs text-gray-400">{date(review.createdAt)}</span></div><div className="mt-2"><Stars rating={review.rating}/></div>{review.title&&<h3 className="mt-2 break-words text-sm font-semibold">{review.title}</h3>}{review.body&&<p className="mt-2 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-sm leading-6 text-gray-600">{review.body}</p>}</article>)}</div>
      </div>
    </div></section>
  </main></div>;
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { useState } from "react";
import { ImageOff } from "lucide-react";
import { safeGearUrl } from "@/lib/gear-display";

export default function ProductGallery({ name, images }: { name: string; images: Array<{ id: string; url: string; isPrimary: boolean }> }) {
  const photos = images.filter(image => safeGearUrl(image.url)).sort((a,b) => Number(b.isPrimary)-Number(a.isPrimary));
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(0);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const image = photos[selected] ?? photos[0];
  const unavailable = !image || failed.includes(image.id);
  return <div>
    <div className="relative flex aspect-square max-h-[520px] items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white">
      {unavailable ? <div className="text-center text-gray-400"><ImageOff className="mx-auto h-12 w-12" /><p className="mt-3 text-sm">Photo unavailable</p></div> : <Image src={safeGearUrl(image.url)!} alt={name} fill priority sizes="(max-width: 767px) 90vw, 45vw" className="object-contain p-6 sm:p-10" onError={() => setFailed(previous => [...previous, image.id])} />}
    </div>
    {photos.length > 1 && <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1" role="group" aria-label="Product photos">{photos.map((photo,index) => <button key={photo.id} type="button" onClick={() => setSelected(index)} aria-label={`View photo ${index+1}`} aria-pressed={photo.id===image?.id} className={`relative h-16 w-16 shrink-0 cursor-pointer overflow-hidden rounded-lg border bg-white ${photo.id===image?.id ? "border-green-700 ring-1 ring-green-700" : "border-gray-200 hover:border-gray-400"}`}>
      {failed.includes(photo.id) ? <ImageOff className="mx-auto h-5 w-5 text-gray-300" /> : <Image src={safeGearUrl(photo.url)!} alt="" fill sizes="64px" className="object-contain p-2" onError={() => setFailed(previous => [...previous,photo.id])} />}
    </button>)}</div>}
  </div>;
}
```
