### `lib/build-validation.ts`

```typescript
import { emptyLogistics, nullableNumber, parseDates, type Logistics } from "./trip-planner";
import { validatePrivateResources, type PrivateTripResources } from "./trip-resources";
import { validateFoodPlan, type FoodPlan } from "./food-plan";
import { validateArrangements, type TripArrangement } from "./trip-arrangements";

export const MAX_GEAR_QUANTITY = 999;

export function formText(form: FormData, key: string, max: number, required = false): string | null {
  const value = form.get(key);
  if (value !== null && typeof value !== "string") throw new Error(`Invalid ${key}.`);
  const text = (value ?? "").trim();
  if (text.length > max || (required && !text)) throw new Error(`${key} must be ${required ? `1–${max}` : `at most ${max}`} characters.`);
  return text || null;
}

export function formNumber(form: FormData, key: string, min: number, max: number, integer = false) {
  return nullableNumber(form.get(key), key, min, max, integer);
}

export function validCondition(value: string | null): string | null {
  if (value && !["dry", "rain", "snow"].includes(value)) throw new Error("Choose a valid weather condition.");
  return value;
}

export function parseBuildDetails(form: FormData) {
  const name = formText(form, "name", 100, true)!;
  const dates = parseDates(formText(form, "startDate", 10) ?? "", formText(form, "endDate", 10) ?? "");
  const latitude = formNumber(form, "locationLat", -90, 90);
  const longitude = formNumber(form, "locationLng", -180, 180);
  if ((latitude == null) !== (longitude == null)) throw new Error("Provide both coordinates or neither.");
  return {
    name, dates, latitude, longitude,
    people: formNumber(form, "people", 1, 100, true) ?? 1,
    minTemperature: formNumber(form, "minTemperature", -100, 60, true),
    conditions: validCondition(formText(form, "conditions", 20)),
    destinationId: formText(form, "destinationId", 200),
    location: formText(form, "location", 500),
  };
}

export function parseLogistics(value: unknown, validDayIds: string[] = [], validCampIds: string[] = [], validResupplyIds: string[] = []): (Logistics & { phase6?: PrivateTripResources; phase7?: FoodPlan; arrangements?: TripArrangement[] }) | null {
  if (value == null) return null;
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) throw new Error("Invalid trip logistics.");
  const object = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  const result = { ...emptyLogistics };
  for (const key of Object.keys(object)) {
    if (key !== "phase6" && key !== "phase7" && key !== "arrangements" && !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(result, key)) throw new Error(`Unknown trip logistics field: ${key}.`);
  }
  for (const key of Object.keys(result) as (keyof Logistics)[]) {
    const text = object[key];
    if (text !== undefined && (typeof text !== "string" || text.length > 5000)) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid trip logistics field: ${key}.`);
    }
    result[key] = (text ?? "") as string;
  }
  return { ...result,
    ...(object.phase6 === undefined ? {} : { phase6: validatePrivateResources(object.phase6, validDayIds, validCampIds) }),
    ...(object.phase7 === undefined ? {} : { phase7: validateFoodPlan(object.phase7, validDayIds, validResupplyIds.map(id=>({id,kind:"resupply" as const}))) }),
    ...(object.arrangements === undefined ? {} : { arrangements: validateArrangements(object.arrangements, validDayIds.length ? validDayIds : undefined, validCampIds.length ? validCampIds : undefined) }),
  };
}

export function combinedQuantity(current: number, incoming: number): number {
  if (!Number.isInteger(current) || current < 0 || !Number.isInteger(incoming) || incoming < 1 || current + incoming > MAX_GEAR_QUANTITY) {
    throw new Error(`A gear item cannot exceed ${MAX_GEAR_QUANTITY} units. Reduce its quantity before importing.`);
  }
  return current + incoming;
}
```

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { findAccessibleBuild } from "@/lib/build-access";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

// Public access is only for rendering. Mutations keep requireBuildAccess.
export async function getBuildViewAccess(buildId: string) {
  if (typeof buildId !== "string" || !buildId || buildId.length > 200) {
    return { status: "missing" as const };
  }
  const owned = await findAccessibleBuild(buildId);
  if (owned) return { status: "allowed" as const, canEdit: true, access: owned };

  const build = await prisma.build.findUnique({
    where: { id: buildId },
    select: { id: true, isPublic: true },
  });
  if (!build) return { status: "missing" as const };
  if (!build.isPublic) return { status: "private" as const };
  return { status: "allowed" as const, canEdit: false, access: null };
}
```

### `lib/calculations.ts`

```typescript
type CalcItem = {
  quantity: number;
  isConsumable: boolean;
  isWorn: boolean;
  weightSnapshot: number | null;
  priceSnapshot: number | null;
  gear: {
    weight_g: number | null;
    price_cad: number | null;
  } | null;
};

function itemWeight(item: CalcItem) {
  const grams = item.gear?.weight_g ?? item.weightSnapshot ?? 0;
  return grams * item.quantity;
}

function itemPrice(item: CalcItem) {
  const price = item.gear?.price_cad ?? item.priceSnapshot ?? 0;
  return price * item.quantity;
}

export function calculateWeightBreakdown(items: CalcItem[]) {
  let base = 0;
  let consumable = 0;
  let worn = 0;

  for (const item of items) {
    const weight = itemWeight(item);

    if (item.isWorn) {
      worn += weight;
    } else if (item.isConsumable) {
      consumable += weight;
    } else {
      base += weight;
    }
  }

  return {
    base,
    consumable,
    worn,
    total: base + consumable + worn,
  };
}

export function calculateTotalCost(items: CalcItem[]) {
  return items.reduce((total, item) => total + itemPrice(item), 0);
}
```

### `lib/compatibility.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * TrailPicker Compatibility — expanded trip-aware checks.
 * Pure, deterministic checks against *recorded* trip and equipment data.
 * An absent specification is unknown — never silently interpreted as zero,
 * a pass, or a failed safety certification.
 */

export type CompatibilitySeverity = "error" | "warning" | "info";
export type CompatibilityKind = "check" | "unknown" | "advisory";

export type CompatibilityIssue = {
  id: string;
  severity: CompatibilitySeverity;
  category: string;
  message: string;
  itemIds?: string[];
  kind?: CompatibilityKind;
  /** Why the finding exists. */
  basis?: string;
  /** Concrete next step without claiming a guaranteed outcome. */
  action?: string;
};

type GearSpecificationForCompat = { key: string; value: string; unit?: string | null };

type GearForCompat = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  weight_g: number | null;
  price_cad: number | null;
  capacity_l: number | null;
  frame_type: string | null;
  waterproof: boolean | null;
  temperature_rating: number | null;
  season: string | null;
  category: { name: string };
  subcategory?: { name: string; slug: string } | null;
  /** Optional for forward compatibility. Never read capacity_l as people. */
  personCapacity?: number | null;
  specifications?: GearSpecificationForCompat[];
};

export type CompatItem = {
  id: string;
  quantity: number;
  isConsumable: boolean;
  isWorn: boolean;
  customCategory: string | null;
  gearNameSnapshot: string | null;
  weightSnapshot: number | null;
  priceSnapshot: number | null;
  gear: GearForCompat | null;
};

export type TripDayForCompat = {
  minTemperature: number | null;
  conditions: string | null;
  campsite?: string | null;
  waterCarryL?: number | null;
  waterSource?: string | null;
};

export type BuildForCompat = {
  people: number;
  minTemperature: number | null;
  conditions: string | null;
  startDate: Date | null;
  endDate: Date | null;
};

const canon = (value: string | null | undefined) => (value ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
const categoryOf = (item: CompatItem) => canon(item.gear?.category.name ?? item.customCategory);
const slugOf = (item: CompatItem) => canon(item.gear?.subcategory?.slug);
const nameOf = (item: CompatItem) => item.gear?.name || item.gearNameSnapshot || "Custom item";
const active = (items: readonly CompatItem[]) => items.filter(item => Number.isSafeInteger(item.quantity) && item.quantity > 0 && !item.isConsumable);
const validNumber = (v: unknown): v is number => typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v);
const validTemperature = (v: unknown): v is number => validNumber(v) && v >= -80 && v <= 60;
const positiveVolume = (v: unknown): v is number => validNumber(v) && v > 0 && v <= 300;
const ids = (items: readonly CompatItem[]) => items.map(item => item.id);
const names = (items: readonly CompatItem[]) => items.map(nameOf).join(", ");

function nightsBetween(build: BuildForCompat): number | null {
  if (!build.startDate || !build.endDate) return null;
  const ms = new Date(build.endDate).getTime() - new Date(build.startDate).getTime();
  if (!Number.isFinite(ms) || ms < 0) return null;
  // Zero nights represents a day trip. Date-only entries can span DST changes.
  return Math.max(0, Math.round(ms / 86_400_000));
}

function tripContext(build: BuildForCompat, days: readonly TripDayForCompat[]) {
  const nights = nightsBetween(build);
  const overnight = (nights !== null && nights > 0) || days.some(day => !!day.campsite?.trim());
  const lows = [build.minTemperature, ...days.map(day => day.minTemperature)].filter(validTemperature);
  const coldest = lows.length ? Math.min(...lows) : null;
  const conditions = [build.conditions, ...days.map(day => day.conditions)].map(canon);
  const wet = conditions.some(c => /\b(rain|snow|wet|storm|showers|precipitation)\b/.test(c) && !/^no\s+(rain|snow|precipitation)\b/.test(c));
  const snow = conditions.some(c => /\b(snow|blizzard|winter)\b/.test(c) && !/^no\s+(snow)\b/.test(c));
  return { nights, overnight, coldest, wet, snow };
}

/**
 * Only explicitly labelled person-occupancy specs count. In particular,
 * capacity_l is reserved for actual liquid/pack volume and is NEVER occupancy.
 */
export function documentedShelterCapacity(item: CompatItem): number | null {
  if (!item.gear || categoryOf(item) !== "shelter") return null;
  const personCapacity = item.gear.personCapacity;
  if (Number.isSafeInteger(personCapacity) && personCapacity! >= 1 && personCapacity! <= 20) return personCapacity!;

  for (const spec of item.gear.specifications ?? []) {
    const key = canon(spec.key).replace(/[()_-]/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ");
    if (!["sleeping capacity", "person capacity", "capacity persons", "occupancy", "sleeps"].includes(key)) continue;
    if (spec.unit != null && !/^(people|person|persons|occupants?)$/.test(canon(spec.unit))) continue;
    const match = canon(spec.value).match(/^(\d{1,2})(?:\s*(?:people|persons?|occupants?))?$/);
    if (!match) continue;
    const count = Number(match[1]);
    if (count >= 1 && count <= 20) return count;
  }
  return null;
}

function essentialChecks(build: BuildForCompat, items: CompatItem[], days: readonly TripDayForCompat[]): CompatibilityIssue[] {
  const all = active(items);
  const { overnight } = tripContext(build, days);
  const issues: CompatibilityIssue[] = [];
  if (all.length === 0) return [{
    id: "empty-build", severity: "info", kind: "unknown", category: "Inventory",
    message: "No gear is recorded yet, so compatibility cannot be assessed.",
    basis: "Empty gear list", action: "Add equipment to start checking this trip.",
  }];
  const missing = (cat: string) => !all.some(item => categoryOf(item) === cat);
  const needs = overnight ? ["shelter", "sleep", "water"] : ["water"];
  for (const cat of needs) if (missing(cat)) issues.push({
    id: `missing-${cat}`, severity: "warning", kind: "advisory", category: "Trip essentials",
    message: `No ${cat} gear is recorded${overnight ? " for this overnight trip" : ""}. Confirm any shared or separately arranged equipment before departure.`,
    basis: "Recorded gear categories and trip duration", action: `Add ${cat} gear to this build, or confirm and document an alternative plan.`,
  });
  if (missing("packs")) issues.push({
    id: "missing-packs", severity: "info", kind: "advisory", category: "Trip essentials",
    message: "No backpack is recorded. This might be intentional or shared.",
    basis: "Recorded gear categories", action: "Confirm how equipment and water will be carried.",
  });
  if (overnight && missing("cooking")) issues.push({
    id: "cooking-plan", severity: "info", kind: "advisory", category: "Trip essentials",
    message: "No cooking equipment is recorded. No-cook trips and shared stoves are valid arrangements.",
    basis: "Overnight trip and recorded cooking gear", action: "Check food preparation and any planned hot-water needs.",
  });
  return issues;
}

/** A pad's R-value measures insulation, not bag temperature rating. */
function recordedPadRValue(item: CompatItem): number | null {
  if (slugOf(item) !== "sleeping-pad") return null;
  for (const spec of item.gear?.specifications ?? []) {
    if (!["r value", "rvalue"].includes(canon(spec.key).replace(/-/g, " "))) continue;
    const value = canon(spec.value);
    if (!/^(?:\d+(?:\.\d+)?|\.\d+)$/.test(value)) continue;
    const n = Number(value);
    if (n >= 0.1 && n <= 20) return n;
  }
  return null;
}

function sleepChecks(build: BuildForCompat, items: CompatItem[], days: readonly TripDayForCompat[]): CompatibilityIssue[] {
  const { coldest, overnight } = tripContext(build, days);
  if (!overnight) return [];
  const sleep = active(items).filter(item => categoryOf(item) === "sleep");
  const insulation = sleep.filter(item => ["sleeping-bag", "quilt"].includes(slugOf(item)) || (!slugOf(item) && validTemperature(item.gear?.temperature_rating)));
  const ambiguous = sleep.filter(item => !slugOf(item) && !validTemperature(item.gear?.temperature_rating));
  const issues: CompatibilityIssue[] = [];
  const groupSize = Number.isSafeInteger(build.people) && build.people > 0 ? build.people : 1;
  if (coldest === null && sleep.length === 0) issues.push({
    id: "trip-low-unknown", severity: "info", kind: "unknown", category: "Temperature",
    message: "No overnight low temperature is recorded, so the planned sleeping conditions cannot be assessed.",
    basis: "Overnight trip without a recorded minimum temperature", action: "Record an expected overnight low and check current conditions near departure.",
  });

  if (sleep.length > 0 && insulation.length === 0 && ambiguous.length === 0) issues.push({
    id: "sleep-insulation-missing", severity: "warning", kind: "advisory", category: "Sleep system",
    message: "Sleeping pads or accessories are listed, but no sleeping bag or quilt is recorded.",
    itemIds: ids(sleep), basis: "Recorded sleep subcategories", action: "Confirm sleeping insulation for each person, including any shared or alternative arrangements.",
  });
  if (ambiguous.length) issues.push({
    id: "sleep-items-unclassified", severity: "info", kind: "unknown", category: "Sleep system",
    message: `${ambiguous.length} sleep item${ambiguous.length === 1 ? " has" : "s have"} no clear sleeping-bag, quilt, or pad classification.`,
    itemIds: ids(ambiguous), basis: "Missing gear subcategory / insulation classification", action: "Identify the type of sleep equipment before relying on temperature checks.",
  });

  const pads = sleep.filter(item => slugOf(item) === "sleeping-pad");
  if (insulation.length && !pads.length) issues.push({
    id: "sleep-pad-not-listed", severity: "info", kind: "advisory", category: "Sleep system",
    message: "A sleeping bag or quilt is listed, but no sleeping pad is recorded. Hammocks and other setups may use different insulation.",
    itemIds: ids(insulation), basis: "Listed sleeping bags/quilts without a classified sleeping pad", action: "Confirm adequate ground or underside insulation for the sleeping setup.",
  });
  const padUnits = pads.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0);
  if (pads.length && padUnits < groupSize) issues.push({
    id: "sleep-pad-units", severity: "info", kind: "advisory", category: "Sleep system",
    message: `${padUnits} sleeping pad unit${padUnits === 1 ? "" : "s"} recorded for ${groupSize} people. Other ground insulation may be shared or arranged separately.`,
    itemIds: ids(pads), basis: "Listed sleeping pads and trip group size", action: "Confirm the pad/under-insulation plan for everyone.",
  });

  const recordedCount = insulation.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0);
  if (recordedCount > 0 && recordedCount < groupSize && ambiguous.length === 0) issues.push({
    id: "sleep-units", severity: "warning", kind: "advisory", category: "Sleep system",
    message: `${recordedCount} sleeping bag/quilt unit${recordedCount === 1 ? "" : "s"} recorded for ${groupSize} people. Other arrangements may exist.`,
    itemIds: ids(insulation), basis: "Recorded insulation quantities and group size", action: "Confirm each person's sleep system and any shared equipment.",
  });
  if (coldest === null && sleep.length > 0) {
    issues.push({
      id: "sleep-no-trip-low", severity: "info", kind: "unknown", category: "Temperature",
      message: "The trip has no recorded low temperature, so sleep ratings cannot be compared.",
      itemIds: ids(sleep), basis: "Missing trip temperature", action: "Enter a realistic overnight low and check up-to-date forecasts before departure.",
    });
    return issues;
  }
  if (coldest === null) return issues;
  // Pad insulation is a separate consideration. A recorded R-value never
  // converts to a sleeping-bag comfort-temperature rating.
  if (coldest <= 0 && pads.length) {
    const unknownPads = pads.filter(item => recordedPadRValue(item) === null);
    if (unknownPads.length) issues.push({
      id: "pad-insulation-unknown", severity: "info", kind: "unknown", category: "Sleep system",
      message: `Pad insulation (R-value) is missing for ${names(unknownPads)} during a trip with lows of ${coldest}°C.`,
      itemIds: ids(unknownPads), basis: "Missing sleeping-pad R-value and recorded trip low", action: "Check manufacturer R-values and the complete pad/ground-insulation setup.",
    });
    const lowPads = pads.filter(item => {
      const r = recordedPadRValue(item);
      return r !== null && r < 2;
    });
    if (lowPads.length) issues.push({
      id: "pad-insulation-review", severity: "warning", kind: "advisory", category: "Sleep system",
      message: `Listed pad R-values are below 2 for ${names(lowPads)} on a trip with lows of ${coldest}°C. Pad stacking and other insulation may change the full system's performance.`,
      itemIds: ids(lowPads), basis: "Recorded R-values below 2 and a freezing or colder trip low; planning prompt only", action: "Review complete ground insulation and manufacturer guidance for the expected conditions.",
    });
    if (coldest <= -5) {
      const moderatePads = pads.filter(item => {
        const r = recordedPadRValue(item);
        return r !== null && r >= 2 && r < 4;
      });
      if (moderatePads.length) issues.push({
        id: "pad-cold-weather-review", severity: "info", kind: "advisory", category: "Sleep system",
        message: `Recorded R-values are under 4 for ${names(moderatePads)} on a trip with lows of ${coldest}°C. This is a cold-weather planning prompt, not an absolute minimum.`,
        itemIds: ids(moderatePads), basis: "Recorded pad R-values and sub-freezing trip low", action: "Check the complete ground-insulation arrangement and manufacturer guidance for the expected conditions.",
      });
    }
  }
  const rated = insulation.filter(item => validTemperature(item.gear?.temperature_rating));
  const unrated = insulation.filter(item => !validTemperature(item.gear?.temperature_rating));
  if (unrated.length) issues.push({
    id: "sleep-rating-unknown", severity: "info", kind: "unknown", category: "Temperature",
    message: `Temperature ratings are missing for ${names(unrated)}. Their suitability at ${coldest}°C cannot be assessed.`,
    itemIds: ids(unrated), basis: "Missing temperature rating", action: "Find verified comfort ratings and check sleeping-pad insulation.",
  });
  for (const item of rated) {
    const rating = item.gear!.temperature_rating!;
    if (rating > coldest) issues.push({
      id: `sleep-rating-review-${item.id}`, severity: "warning", kind: "check", category: "Temperature",
      message: `Temperature mismatch: ${nameOf(item)} is rated ${rating}°C, but the recorded low is ${coldest}°C (${(rating - coldest).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, "")}°C colder). The rating type and full sleep system still need verification.`,
      itemIds: [item.id], basis: `Catalog rating: ${rating}°C · Recorded low: ${coldest}°C`,
      action: "Choose a sleep system suitable for the expected low, or verify the manufacturer comfort rating, pad insulation, and a suitable alternative before departure.",
    });
  }
  if (rated.length && !rated.some(item => item.gear!.temperature_rating! > coldest)) issues.push({
    id: "sleep-rating-limits", severity: "info", kind: "unknown", category: "Temperature",
    message: "Recorded sleeping-bag/quilt ratings do not exceed the trip low, but ratings may describe comfort or limit temperatures and do not account for sleeping-pad insulation.",
    itemIds: ids(rated), basis: "Unspecified rating method and complete sleep system", action: "Verify manufacturer comfort ratings and your full sleep system; this is not a warmth guarantee.",
  });
  return issues;
}

function shelterChecks(build: BuildForCompat, items: CompatItem[], days: readonly TripDayForCompat[]): CompatibilityIssue[] {
  const context = tripContext(build, days);
  const shelters = active(items).filter(item => categoryOf(item) === "shelter");
  if (!shelters.length) return [];
  const issues: CompatibilityIssue[] = [];
  if (context.overnight) {
    const known = shelters.filter(item => documentedShelterCapacity(item) !== null);
    const unknown = shelters.filter(item => documentedShelterCapacity(item) === null);
    const knownPeople = known.reduce((sum, item) => sum + documentedShelterCapacity(item)! * item.quantity, 0);
    const groupSize = Number.isSafeInteger(build.people) && build.people > 0 ? build.people : 1;

    if (unknown.length) issues.push({
      id: "shelter-occupancy-unknown", severity: "info", kind: "unknown", category: "Capacity",
      message: `Sleeping capacity is missing for ${names(unknown)}. Listed occupancy is not a verified group total.`,
      itemIds: ids(unknown), basis: "No explicitly labelled person-capacity specification", action: "Add a 'Sleeping capacity' specification with unit 'people', then verify group sleeping arrangements.",
    });
    if (knownPeople < groupSize && unknown.length === 0) issues.push({
      id: "shelter-capacity-short", severity: "error", kind: "check", category: "Capacity",
      message: `Not enough documented shelter space: ${knownPeople} sleeping places for ${groupSize} people. Separately arranged shelter may not be listed.`,
      itemIds: ids(known), basis: "Explicit sleeping capacity × quantity, compared with trip group size", action: "Add sufficient shelter capacity or record and confirm the separate sleeping arrangements for everyone.",
    });
    else if (knownPeople < groupSize && unknown.length > 0) issues.push({
      id: "shelter-capacity-unverified", severity: "info", kind: "unknown", category: "Capacity",
      message: `${knownPeople} sleeping places are documented for ${groupSize} people; other listed shelters have unknown occupancy.`,
      itemIds: ids(shelters), basis: "Partial shelter-capacity data", action: "Verify the unknown shelter capacities before judging whether the group fits.",
    });
  }
  if (context.wet) {
    const unsuitable = shelters.filter(item => item.gear?.waterproof === false);
    const unknown = shelters.filter(item => item.gear?.waterproof == null);
    if (unsuitable.length) issues.push({
      id: "shelter-wet-weather", severity: "warning", kind: "check", category: "Weather",
      message: `${names(unsuitable)} ${unsuitable.length === 1 ? "is" : "are"} recorded as not waterproof, while wet conditions are noted. A separate rain fly or tarp might provide protection.`,
      itemIds: ids(unsuitable), basis: "Planned precipitation conditions and catalog waterproof field", action: "Verify the complete shelter setup, rain protection, and manufacturer limitations.",
    });
    if (unknown.length) issues.push({
      id: "shelter-waterproof-unknown", severity: "info", kind: "unknown", category: "Weather",
      message: `Waterproofing specifications are missing for ${names(unknown)}.`,
      itemIds: ids(unknown), basis: "Missing waterproof field", action: "Check the shelter and rain-cover specifications; unknown does not mean not waterproof.",
    });
  }
  const winter = context.snow || (context.coldest !== null && context.coldest <= -10);
  const threeSeason = shelters.filter(item => /^(3\s*-?\s*season|three\s*season)$/.test(canon(item.gear?.season)));
  if (winter && threeSeason.length) issues.push({
    id: "shelter-winter-review", severity: "warning", kind: "advisory", category: "Weather",
    message: `${names(threeSeason)} ${threeSeason.length === 1 ? "is" : "are"} labelled 3-season, while snow or very low temperatures are recorded. A season label alone cannot determine wind or snow-load suitability.`,
    itemIds: ids(threeSeason), basis: "Catalog shelter season and trip conditions", action: "Check manufacturer limitations and local forecasts, including snow load and wind exposure.",
  });
  if (winter) {
    const unknownSeason = shelters.filter(item => !canon(item.gear?.season));
    if (unknownSeason.length) issues.push({
      id: "shelter-season-unknown", severity: "info", kind: "unknown", category: "Weather",
      message: `Season/snow-load suitability is not recorded for ${names(unknownSeason)} while winter conditions are planned.`,
      itemIds: ids(unknownSeason), basis: "Missing shelter season specification and planned cold/snow conditions", action: "Check shelter manufacturer's wind and snow-load limitations rather than relying on a generic season label.",
    });
  }
  return issues;
}

function waterChecks(build: BuildForCompat, items: CompatItem[], days: readonly TripDayForCompat[]): CompatibilityIssue[] {
  const water = active(items).filter(item => categoryOf(item) === "water");
  const containers = water.filter(item => ["bottle", "reservoir", "bladder", "water-bottle", "hydration-reservoir", "hydration-bladder", "canteen"].includes(slugOf(item)));
  const verifiedContainers = containers.filter(item => positiveVolume(item.gear?.capacity_l));
  const unknownContainers = containers.filter(item => !positiveVolume(item.gear?.capacity_l));
  const recordedLiters = verifiedContainers.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.gear!.capacity_l! * item.quantity, 0);
  const maxCarry = Math.max(0, ...days.map(day => day.waterCarryL).filter((n): n is number => validNumber(n) && n > 0 && n <= 100));
  const issues: CompatibilityIssue[] = [];
  const sourceDays = days.filter(day => !!day.waterSource?.trim());
  const treatment = water.filter(item => ["filter", "purifier", "treatment", "water-filter", "water-purifier"].includes(slugOf(item)));
  if (sourceDays.length && !treatment.length) issues.push({
    id: "water-treatment-unverified", severity: "info", kind: "advisory", category: "Water",
    message: "A trip-day water source is listed, but no filter or purifier is recorded. Boiling, pre-treated supplies or another arrangement may be planned.",
    itemIds: ids(water), basis: "Trip-day water sources and recorded water-treatment products", action: "Confirm whether source water needs treatment and how it will be handled.",
  });
  if (!maxCarry) {
    if (days.length && water.length) issues.push({
      id: "water-carry-unplanned", severity: "info", kind: "unknown", category: "Water",
      message: "Trip days have no recorded water-carry target, so the listed container volume cannot be compared with a planned carry.",
      itemIds: ids(water), basis: "Trip Planner days lack waterCarryL values", action: "Record planned carry volumes after checking water access and the route.",
    });
    return issues;
  }
  if (unknownContainers.length) issues.push({
    id: "water-volume-unknown", severity: "info", kind: "unknown", category: "Water",
    message: `Some containers have no recorded storage volume (${names(unknownContainers)}).`,
    itemIds: ids(unknownContainers), basis: "Trip-day planned water carry and missing container capacities", action: "Confirm the usable volume of all bottles and reservoirs.",
  });
  if (recordedLiters < maxCarry && unknownContainers.length === 0) issues.push({
    id: "water-volume-check", severity: containers.length ? "warning" : "info", kind: containers.length ? "check" : "unknown", category: "Water",
    message: `Water storage mismatch: planned carry is ${maxCarry} L, but only ${recordedLiters} L of container capacity is documented. Unlisted or shared containers may account for the difference.`,
    itemIds: ids(water), basis: "Maximum Trip Planner waterCarryL vs explicitly listed container volumes", action: "Add enough documented container capacity for the planned carry, or update the water plan after confirming water access and shared supplies.",
  });
  else if (recordedLiters < maxCarry) issues.push({
    id: "water-volume-unverified", severity: "info", kind: "unknown", category: "Water",
    message: `The plan calls for ${maxCarry} L, while ${recordedLiters} L is documented and other container volumes are unknown.`,
    itemIds: ids(containers), basis: "Incomplete water-storage specifications", action: "Verify the missing container volumes before comparing against the carry plan.",
  });
  return issues;
}

function equipmentChecks(build: BuildForCompat, items: CompatItem[], days: readonly TripDayForCompat[]): CompatibilityIssue[] {
  const { nights, overnight } = tripContext(build, days);
  const all = active(items);
  const issues: CompatibilityIssue[] = [];
  const packs = all.filter(item => categoryOf(item) === "packs");
  if (overnight) {
    const unmeasuredPacks = packs.filter(item => !positiveVolume(item.gear?.capacity_l));
    if (unmeasuredPacks.length) issues.push({
      id: "pack-volume-unknown", severity: "info", kind: "unknown", category: "Pack fit",
      message: `Pack volume is not recorded for ${names(unmeasuredPacks)}, so capacity cannot be assessed against the overnight load.`,
      itemIds: ids(unmeasuredPacks), basis: "Missing or invalid pack capacity field", action: "Add the manufacturer's pack volume or test-pack the full kit.",
    });
  }
  if (overnight && nights !== null) for (const pack of packs) {
    const cap = pack.gear?.capacity_l;
    // Deliberately advisory: these are optional packing heuristics, not minimum volume requirements.
    const heuristic = nights <= 2 ? 30 : nights <= 5 ? 45 : 55;
    if (positiveVolume(cap) && cap < heuristic) issues.push({
      id: `pack-fit-review-${pack.id}`, severity: "info", kind: "advisory", category: "Pack fit",
      message: `${nameOf(pack)} is ${cap} L for a ${nights}-night trip. ${heuristic} L is a rough planning heuristic, not a required minimum; compact setups can work well.`,
      itemIds: [pack.id], basis: "Recorded pack volume and trip duration; optional planning heuristic", action: "Test-pack the complete kit, including water and food, to verify real fit.",
    });
  }
  if (overnight && ![build.conditions, ...days.map(day => day.conditions)].some(condition => !!canon(condition))) issues.push({
    id: "trip-conditions-unknown", severity: "info", kind: "unknown", category: "Weather",
    message: "No trip conditions are recorded, so wet-weather and winter gear checks may miss relevant conditions.",
    basis: "Missing planned weather conditions", action: "Record expected conditions and check a current forecast near departure.",
  });
  if (tripContext(build, days).wet && !all.some(item => categoryOf(item) === "clothing" && item.gear?.waterproof === true)) issues.push({
    id: "rain-layer-unverified", severity: "info", kind: "unknown", category: "Weather",
    message: "Wet conditions are recorded, but the inventory has no confirmed waterproof clothing specification. A rain layer may still be packed under a custom entry.",
    itemIds: ids(all.filter(item => categoryOf(item) === "clothing")), basis: "Wet trip conditions and missing affirmative waterproof clothing data", action: "Verify personal rain protection for everyone without assuming missing catalog data means missing gear.",
  });
  if (build.people === 1) for (const cat of ["shelter", "packs"]) {
    const chosen = all.filter(item => categoryOf(item) === cat);
    const unique = new Set(chosen.map(item => item.gear?.id ?? item.id));
    if (unique.size > 1) issues.push({
      id: `multiple-${cat}`, severity: "info", kind: "advisory", category: "Inventory review",
      message: `${unique.size} distinct ${cat} products are recorded for a solo trip. They may be alternatives or deliberate backups.`,
      itemIds: ids(chosen), basis: "Solo trip and multiple catalog products", action: "Confirm what is actually carried; do not remove equipment without reviewing the trip plan.",
    });
  }
  if (build.people === 1) for (const item of packs.concat(all.filter(item => categoryOf(item) === "shelter"))) {
    if (item.quantity > 1) issues.push({
      id: `duplicate-units-${item.id}`, severity: "info", kind: "advisory", category: "Inventory review",
      message: `${item.quantity} copies of ${nameOf(item)} are recorded on a solo trip. These may be backups or a quantity entry to check.`,
      itemIds: [item.id], basis: "Solo group size and repeated item quantity", action: "Confirm the quantity is intentional; keep needed backups.",
    });
  }
  const zeroWeights = all.filter(item => (item.gear?.weight_g ?? item.weightSnapshot) === 0);
  if (zeroWeights.length) issues.push({
    id: "zero-weights", severity: "info", kind: "advisory", category: "Data quality",
    message: `Zero weight is recorded for ${names(zeroWeights)}. This may be intentional, but can cause an understated pack weight.`,
    itemIds: ids(zeroWeights), basis: "Zero gram gear weights", action: "Double-check these weights; keep zero only if accurate.",
  });
  const weightUnknown = all.filter(item => {
    const weight = item.gear?.weight_g ?? item.weightSnapshot;
    return !validNumber(weight) || weight < 0;
  });
  if (weightUnknown.length) issues.push({
    id: "unknown-weights", severity: "info", kind: "unknown", category: "Data quality",
    message: `${weightUnknown.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0)} gear unit(s) have no valid recorded weight. Weight totals are known-weight subtotals, not a full load.`,
    itemIds: ids(weightUnknown), basis: "Missing or invalid item weights", action: "Add verified weights to improve load analysis.",
  });
  return issues;
}

/** No weather API is called here. Trip conditions are only user-entered data. */
export function evaluateCompatibility(
  build: BuildForCompat,
  items: CompatItem[],
  days: TripDayForCompat[] = [],
): CompatibilityIssue[] {
  const issues = [
    ...essentialChecks(build, items, days),
    ...sleepChecks(build, items, days),
    ...shelterChecks(build, items, days),
    ...waterChecks(build, items, days),
    ...equipmentChecks(build, items, days),
  ];
  const order: Record<CompatibilitySeverity, number> = { error: 0, warning: 1, info: 2 };
  // Stable IDs + severity ordering make the UI and tests predictable.
  return issues.sort((a, b) => order[a.severity] - order[b.severity] || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
}

export function summarizeCompatibility(issues: readonly CompatibilityIssue[]) {
  const errors = issues.filter(issue => issue.severity === "error").length;
  const warnings = issues.filter(issue => issue.severity === "warning").length;
  const infos = issues.filter(issue => issue.severity === "info").length;
  const unknowns = issues.filter(issue => issue.kind === "unknown").length;
  const status: "ok" | "warning" | "error" | "incomplete" | "notes" =
    errors ? "error" : warnings ? "warning" : unknowns ? "incomplete" : infos ? "notes" : "ok";
  return { status, errors, warnings, infos, unknowns, total: issues.length };
}
```

### `lib/consumables-model.ts`

```typescript
/** Explicit, editable mass assumptions. Not nutrition, fuel, or hydration advice. */
export type ConsumableDay = {
  day: number;
  startingGrams: number;
  addedGrams: number;
  usedGrams: number;
  remainingGrams: number;
  unmetGrams: number;
};

export function projectConsumableLoad(
  startingGrams: number,
  days: number,
  dailyUseGrams: number,
  resupplyDay: number | null = null,
  resupplyGrams = 0,
): ConsumableDay[] {
  if (![startingGrams,days,dailyUseGrams,resupplyGrams].every(Number.isFinite) ||
      startingGrams<0 || startingGrams>Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER ||
      !Number.isInteger(days) || days<1 || days>31 ||
      dailyUseGrams<0 || dailyUseGrams>100_000 ||
      resupplyGrams<0 || resupplyGrams>1_000_000 ||
      (resupplyDay!==null && (!Number.isInteger(resupplyDay)||resupplyDay<2||resupplyDay>days))) {
    throw new Error('Invalid consumable timeline parameters.');
  }
  const result: ConsumableDay[]=[];
  let remaining=startingGrams;
  for(let day=1;day<=days;day++){
    const addedGrams=day===resupplyDay?resupplyGrams:0;
    const starting=remaining;
    const available=starting+addedGrams;
    const used=Math.min(dailyUseGrams,available);
    remaining=available-used;
    result.push({day,startingGrams:starting,addedGrams,usedGrams:used,remainingGrams:remaining,unmetGrams:Math.max(0,dailyUseGrams-used)});
  }
  return result;
}
```

### `lib/destination-detail.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * Discover destination-page helpers.
 * No guessed trailhead positions, facility claims or travel distances.
 * Data remains sourced from the existing BC destination catalog.
 */
import type { Destination } from "./destinations";

export type Coordinates = Readonly<{ latitude: number; longitude: number }>;
export type RelatedDestination = Readonly<{
  destination: Destination;
  /** Straight-line distance between stored coordinates. Not hiking or driving distance. */
  straightLineKm: number | null;
  relation: "same-park" | "nearby-coordinate";
}>;

export function destinationHref(id: string): string {
  return `/discover/destinations/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
}

export function validCoordinates(place: Pick<Destination, "latitude" | "longitude">): Coordinates | null {
  const { latitude, longitude } = place;
  if (typeof latitude !== "number" || typeof longitude !== "number" ||
      !Number.isFinite(latitude) || !Number.isFinite(longitude) ||
      latitude < -90 || latitude > 90 || longitude < -180 || longitude > 180) return null;
  return { latitude, longitude };
}

function radians(degrees: number) { return degrees * Math.PI / 180; }
export function straightLineKm(a: Coordinates, b: Coordinates): number {
  const differenceLat = radians(b.latitude - a.latitude);
  const differenceLon = radians(b.longitude - a.longitude);
  const value = Math.sin(differenceLat / 2) ** 2 +
    Math.cos(radians(a.latitude)) * Math.cos(radians(b.latitude)) * Math.sin(differenceLon / 2) ** 2;
  return 6371.0088 * 2 * Math.asin(Math.min(1, Math.sqrt(value)));
}

/** Handles "Mount Robson Provincial Park" vs "Mount Robson Park" without merging different parks. */
export function parkKey(park: string): string {
  return park.toLocaleLowerCase("en-CA")
    .normalize("NFKD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
    .replace(/\b(provincial|national)\s+park\b/g, "park")
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ").trim();
}

/** Related campground records come from the same park or verified stored points nearby. */
export function relatedCampgrounds(
  current: Destination, catalog: readonly Destination[], limit = 4,
): RelatedDestination[] {
  const base = validCoordinates(current);
  const matches: RelatedDestination[] = [];
  for (const destination of catalog) {
    if (destination.id === current.id || (destination.kind ?? "campground") !== "campground") continue;
    const other = validCoordinates(destination);
    const km = base && other ? straightLineKm(base, other) : null;
    const samePark = parkKey(destination.park) === parkKey(current.park);
    if (samePark) matches.push({ destination, straightLineKm: km, relation: "same-park" });
    // Stay in the same catalog region when suggesting nearby sites across park boundaries.
    else if (destination.region === current.region && km !== null && km <= 35) matches.push({ destination, straightLineKm: km, relation: "nearby-coordinate" });
  }
  return matches.sort((a,b) =>
    Number(a.relation !== "same-park") - Number(b.relation !== "same-park") ||
    (a.straightLineKm ?? Infinity) - (b.straightLineKm ?? Infinity) ||
    a.destination.name.localeCompare(b.destination.name)
  ).slice(0, Math.max(0, Math.min(limit, 12)));
}

/** More places inside exactly this park, not a guessed region-wide proximity match. */
export function relatedPlaces(
  current: Destination, catalog: readonly Destination[], limit = 4,
): Destination[] {
  return catalog.filter(destination =>
    destination.id !== current.id &&
    (destination.kind ?? "campground") !== "campground" &&
    parkKey(destination.park) === parkKey(current.park)
  ).sort((a,b) => Number(b.featured) - Number(a.featured) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
    .slice(0, Math.max(0, Math.min(limit, 12)));
}

export function officialUrl(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!value) return null;
  try {
    const url = new URL(value);
    return url.protocol === "https:" || url.protocol === "http:" ? url.href : null;
  } catch { return null; }
}

export function openStreetMapEmbedUrl(coords: Coordinates): string {
  // A visible point, not a fabricated trail line. 0.06° latitude spans ~6.7 km.
  const { latitude: lat, longitude: lon } = coords;
  const bbox = [lon - 0.052, lat - 0.03, lon + 0.052, lat + 0.03]
    .map(n => Number(n.toFixed(6))).join(",");
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ bbox, layer: "mapnik", marker: `${lat},${lon}` });
  return `https://www.openstreetmap.org/export/embed.html?${params}`;
}

export function openStreetMapLink(coords: Coordinates): string {
  return `https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=${coords.latitude}&mlon=${coords.longitude}#map=13/${coords.latitude}/${coords.longitude}`;
}

export function openStreetMapSearch(place: Pick<Destination, "name" | "park">): string {
  return `https://www.openstreetmap.org/search?query=${encodeURIComponent(`${place.name}, ${place.park}, British Columbia, Canada`)}`;
}

export function facilityLabel(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  switch(value) {
    case "yes": return "Available";
    case "no": return "Not provided";
    case "seasonal": return "Seasonal";
    case "unknown": return "Not confirmed";
    default: return "Not listed";
  }
}
export function dogsLabel(value: string): string {
  switch(value) {
    case "not-allowed": return "Not permitted";
    case "leashed": return "Leash required";
    case "under-control": return "Must be under control";
    default: return "Check current rules";
  }
}
export function permitLabel(value: string): string {
  switch(value) {
    case "required": return "Reservation required";
    case "peak-season": return "Seasonal reservations";
    case "permit": return "Permit required";
    default: return "Check current rules";
  }
}
export function distanceLabel(value: number | null, type?: string | null): string {
  if (value === null) return "Not provided";
  const suffix = type === "one-way" ? " one way" : type === "round-trip" ? " round trip" : type === "loop" ? " loop" : " listed";
  return `${Number(value.toFixed(1))} km${suffix}`;
}
```

```typescript
import rawDestinations from "@/data/destinations.json";

export type FacilityStatus = "yes" | "no" | "seasonal" | "unknown";

export type DogPolicy =
  | "not-allowed"
  | "leashed"
  | "under-control"
  | "check-current-rules";

export type ReservationPolicy =
  | "required"
  | "peak-season"
  | "permit"
  | "check-current-rules";

export type Difficulty = "easy" | "moderate" | "hard";
export type DestinationKind = "campground" | "lake" | "trail" | "summit" | "waterfall" | "viewpoint" | "coastal" | "backcountry-area" | "meadow" | "hut";
export type DestinationActivity = "hiking" | "backpacking" | "camping" | "paddling";
export type DistanceType = "one-way" | "round-trip" | "loop";

export type Destination = {
  id: string;
  kind: DestinationKind;
  activities: DestinationActivity[];
  distanceType: DistanceType | null;
  name: string;
  park: string;
  region: string;
  latitude: number | null;
  longitude: number | null;
  distanceKm: number | null;
  elevationGainM: number | null;
  difficulty: Difficulty;
  tentSites: number | null;
  toilet: FacilityStatus | null;
  foodStorage: FacilityStatus | null;
  dogs: DogPolicy;
  reservations: ReservationPolicy;
  featured: boolean;
  summary: string;
  caution: string | null;
  sourceUrl: string;
  bookingUrl: string | null;
};

export const DESTINATIONS = rawDestinations as Destination[];

export function getDestination(id?: string | null) {
  if (!id) return null;

  return (
    DESTINATIONS.find((destination) => destination.id === id) ?? null
  );
}

export function getDestinationRegions() {
  return [
    ...new Set(
      DESTINATIONS.map((destination) => destination.region),
    ),
  ].sort();
}
```

### `lib/discover-finder.ts`

```typescript
import type {Destination} from "./destinations";
/** Recommendations use only supplied catalog facts. Missing trail data never becomes a claim. */
export type TripStyle = "any" | "day" | "overnight";
export type Area = "any" | "vancouver" | "sea-to-sky" | "island" | "rockies" | "interior" | "north";
export type Scenery = "any" | "lakes" | "summits" | "forest" | "coast" | "meadows";
export type Priority = "balanced" | "facilities" | "distance" | "featured";
export type Activity = "any" | "hiking" | "backpacking" | "camping" | "paddling";
export type DistancePreference = "any" | "5" | "10" | "15" | "25";
export type GainPreference = "any" | "300" | "600" | "1000";
export type ConfirmedPreference = "any" | "yes";
export type FinderPreferences = {
  style: TripStyle; area: Area; difficulty: "any" | "easy" | "moderate" | "hard";
  scenery: Scenery; priority: Priority;
  /** Additional inputs are optional to preserve old bookmarked finder URLs. */
  activity?: Activity; distance?: DistancePreference; gain?: GainPreference;
  dogs?: ConfirmedPreference; toilets?: ConfirmedPreference; storage?: ConfirmedPreference;
};
export type QueryValues = Record<string,string | string[] | undefined>;
export const DEFAULT_PREFERENCES: FinderPreferences = {
  style:"any",area:"any",difficulty:"any",scenery:"any",priority:"balanced",
};
function enumValue<T extends string>(value:string | string[] | undefined, options: readonly T[], fallback:T):T {
  const first=Array.isArray(value)?value[0]:value;
  return options.includes(first as T)?first as T:fallback;
}
export function parseFinderPreferences(params:QueryValues):FinderPreferences {
  const preferences:FinderPreferences = {
    style:enumValue(params.style,["any","day","overnight"],"any"),
    area:enumValue(params.area,["any","vancouver","sea-to-sky","island","rockies","interior","north"],"any"),
    difficulty:enumValue(params.difficulty,["any","easy","moderate","hard"],"any"),
    scenery:enumValue(params.scenery,["any","lakes","summits","forest","coast","meadows"],"any"),
    priority:enumValue(params.priority,["balanced","facilities","distance","featured"],"balanced"),
  };
  // Ignore unknown/invalid extras. Existing links retain their old behavior.
  if(params.activity!==undefined) preferences.activity=enumValue(params.activity,["any","hiking","backpacking","camping","paddling"],"any");
  if(params.distance!==undefined) preferences.distance=enumValue(params.distance,["any","5","10","15","25"],"any");
  if(params.gain!==undefined) preferences.gain=enumValue(params.gain,["any","300","600","1000"],"any");
  if(params.dogs!==undefined) preferences.dogs=enumValue(params.dogs,["any","yes"],"any");
  if(params.toilets!==undefined) preferences.toilets=enumValue(params.toilets,["any","yes"],"any");
  if(params.storage!==undefined) preferences.storage=enumValue(params.storage,["any","yes"],"any");
  return preferences;
}
const AREA_REGIONS:Record<Exclude<Area,"any">,readonly string[]> = {
  vancouver:["Lower Mainland","Sea to Sky","Manning"],
  "sea-to-sky":["Sea to Sky"],
  island:["Vancouver Island"],
  rockies:["Canadian Rockies","Northern Rockies"],
  interior:["Okanagan-Similkameen","West Kootenay","Columbia Mountains","Purcell Mountains","Thompson","Cariboo-Chilcotin"],
  north:["Northern BC","Northern Rockies","Peace Region","Haida Gwaii"],
};
const SCENERY_TERMS:Record<Exclude<Scenery,"any">,RegExp> = {
  lakes:/\b(lake|lakes|tarn|lakeshore|lakefront)\b/i,
  summits:/\b(summit|summits|peak|peaks|ridge|ridges|mountain|mountains|panorama)\b/i,
  forest:/\b(forest|forested|forestland|waterfall|waterfalls|falls|creek|rainforest|old.growth)\b/i,
  coast:/\b(coast|coastal|beach|bay|ocean|sea|shore|shoreline|marine)\b/i,
  meadows:/\b(meadow|meadows|alpine|subalpine|wildflower|wildflowers)\b/i,
};
export const SCENERY_LABELS:Record<Scenery,string> = {
  any:"Any scenery",lakes:"Lakes",summits:"Peaks & ridges",forest:"Forests & waterfalls",coast:"Coastlines",meadows:"Alpine meadows",
};
export function sceneryMatches(destination:Destination,scene:Scenery):boolean {
  if(scene==="any")return true;
  const text=`${destination.name} ${destination.summary} ${destination.kind}`;
  return SCENERY_TERMS[scene].test(text);
}
export function finderEligible(destination:Destination,preferences:FinderPreferences):boolean {
  if(preferences.area!=="any"&&!AREA_REGIONS[preferences.area].includes(destination.region))return false;
  if(preferences.difficulty!=="any"&&preferences.difficulty!==destination.difficulty)return false;
  if(preferences.activity&&preferences.activity!=="any"&&!destination.activities.includes(preferences.activity))return false;
  if(preferences.dogs==="yes"&&destination.dogs!=="leashed"&&destination.dogs!=="under-control")return false;
  if(preferences.toilets==="yes"&&destination.toilet!=="yes")return false;
  if(preferences.storage==="yes"&&destination.foodStorage!=="yes")return false;
  // Distance/gain are soft preferences when missing. Known values outside the chosen maximum are excluded.
  if(preferences.distance&&preferences.distance!=="any"&&destination.distanceKm!==null&&destination.distanceKm>Number(preferences.distance))return false;
  if(preferences.gain&&preferences.gain!=="any"&&destination.elevationGainM!==null&&destination.elevationGainM>Number(preferences.gain))return false;
  if(preferences.style==="overnight") {
    return destination.kind==="campground" && destination.activities.includes("camping") && destination.activities.includes("backpacking");
  }
  if(preferences.style==="day") return destination.activities.includes("hiking");
  return true;
}
export type FinderMatch = {destination:Destination;reasons:string[];cautions:string[];score:number;sceneryMatch:boolean};
function matchOne(destination:Destination,preferences:FinderPreferences):FinderMatch {
  let score=0;
  const reasons:string[]=[];
  const cautions:string[]=[];
  const matchedScenery=sceneryMatches(destination,preferences.scenery);
  if(preferences.scenery!=="any"&&matchedScenery){score+=12;reasons.push(`${SCENERY_LABELS[preferences.scenery]} in catalog description`);}
  if(preferences.area!=="any"){score+=2;reasons.push(destination.region);}
  if(preferences.difficulty!=="any"){score+=2;reasons.push(`${destination.difficulty} catalog difficulty`);}
  if(preferences.style==="overnight"){score+=3;reasons.push("Cataloged camping area");}
  if(preferences.style==="day"){score+=2;reasons.push("Hiking listed as an activity");}
  if(preferences.activity&&preferences.activity!=="any"){score+=3;reasons.push(`${preferences.activity} listed as an activity`);}
  if(preferences.dogs==="yes"){score+=3;reasons.push("Dog access explicitly listed (check current rules)");}
  if(preferences.toilets==="yes"){score+=3;reasons.push("Toilets recorded as available");}
  if(preferences.storage==="yes"){score+=3;reasons.push("Food storage recorded as available");}
  if(destination.toilet==="yes"&&destination.foodStorage==="yes") {
    score+=preferences.priority==="facilities"?9:1;
    if(preferences.priority==="facilities")reasons.push("Toilet and food storage listed");
  } else if(preferences.priority==="facilities")cautions.push("Facilities not fully confirmed in the catalog");
  if(destination.distanceKm!==null) {
    score+=preferences.priority==="distance"?9:2;
    if(preferences.distance&&preferences.distance!=="any") {score+=6;reasons.push(`${destination.distanceKm} km recorded, within preferred maximum`);}
    else reasons.push("Route distance listed");
  } else {
    cautions.push(preferences.distance&&preferences.distance!=="any"?"Route distance unknown; preferred maximum unverified":"Route distance missing");
  }
  if(preferences.gain&&preferences.gain!=="any") {
    if(destination.elevationGainM!==null){score+=6;reasons.push(`${destination.elevationGainM} m recorded gain, within preferred maximum`);}
    else cautions.push("Elevation gain unknown; preferred maximum unverified");
  } else if(destination.elevationGainM===null)cautions.push("Elevation gain missing");
  if(destination.featured)score+=preferences.priority==="featured"?8:2;
  if(destination.caution)cautions.push("Review destination cautions and current park notices");
  if(preferences.scenery!=="any"&&!matchedScenery)cautions.push("Preferred scenery not confirmed");
  return {destination,reasons:reasons.slice(0,5),cautions,score,sceneryMatch:matchedScenery};
}
/** Four varied, traceable suggestions. Unknown catalog fields remain unknown. */
export function recommendDestinations(destinations:readonly Destination[],preferences:FinderPreferences,limit=4):FinderMatch[] {
  const candidates=destinations.filter(item=>finderEligible(item,preferences)).map(item=>matchOne(item,preferences));
  const supported=preferences.scenery==="any"?candidates:candidates.filter(item=>item.sceneryMatch);
  supported.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||Number(b.destination.featured)-Number(a.destination.featured)||a.destination.name.localeCompare(b.destination.name)||a.destination.id.localeCompare(b.destination.id));
  const max=Math.max(1,Math.min(limit,8));
  const results:FinderMatch[]=[],parks=new Set<string>();
  for(const candidate of supported){if(parks.has(candidate.destination.park))continue;results.push(candidate);parks.add(candidate.destination.park);if(results.length>=max)return results;}
  for(const candidate of supported){if(results.some(row=>row.destination.id===candidate.destination.id))continue;results.push(candidate);if(results.length>=max)break;}
  return results;
}
```

### `lib/discover-navigation.ts`

```typescript
/** Stable Discover routes and backwards-compatible links for the previous ?view= pages. */
export type DiscoverLegacyView = "destinations" | "trips" | "packs" | "saved";
export type UrlValues = Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>;
const allowed = new Set([
  "q", "location", "region", "sort", "difficulty", "activity", "category", "page", "feature",
  "packCategory", "packPeople", "minBaseKg", "maxBaseKg", "maxCostCad", "savedType",
]);
export function legacyDiscoverDestination(raw: UrlValues): string | null {
  const view = Array.isArray(raw.view) ? raw.view[0] : raw.view;
  let route: string;
  switch (view) {
    case "destinations": route = "/discover/search"; break;
    case "trips": route = "/discover/community"; break;
    case "packs": route = "/discover/community"; break;
    case "saved": route = "/discover/saved"; break;
    default:
      // Old site links sometimes used /discover?q=… for destination searches.
      route = raw.q || raw.region || raw.activity || raw.category ? "/discover/search" : "";
  }
  if (!route) return null;
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (view === "packs") params.set("type", "packs");
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(raw)) {
    if (!allowed.has(key)) continue;
    const first = typeof value === "string" ? value : value?.[0];
    if (first && first.length <= 120) params.set(key, first);
  }
  const query = params.toString();
  return route + (query ? `?${query}` : "");
}
```

### `lib/discover-packs-query.ts`

```typescript
/** Bounded, parameterized PostgreSQL summary query for public community packs.
 * Aggregation happens in the database so numeric filters and sorting work across
 * the ENTIRE public catalog, not only the first screen of results. No migration.
 */
import { Prisma } from "@/app/generated/prisma/client";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import { PACK_PAGE_SIZE, type PackFilters } from "@/lib/discover-packs";

const base = Prisma.sql`
  WITH pack_metrics AS (
    SELECT b."id", b."name", b."location", b."people", b."createdAt", b."updatedAt",
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT i."isWorn" AND NOT i."isConsumable"
        THEN COALESCE(g."weight_g", i."weightSnapshot")::bigint * i."quantity" ELSE 0 END), 0)::bigint AS "baseWeightG",
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT i."isWorn" AND NOT i."isConsumable"
        AND COALESCE(g."weight_g", i."weightSnapshot") IS NULL)::integer AS "missingBase",
      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(g."price_cad", i."priceSnapshot") * i."quantity"), 0)::double precision AS "knownCost",
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(g."price_cad", i."priceSnapshot") IS NULL)::integer AS "missingCost"
    FROM "Build" b
    INNER JOIN "BuildItem" i ON i."buildId" = b."id"
    LEFT JOIN "Gear" g ON g."id" = i."gearId"
    WHERE b."isPublic" = TRUE
    GROUP BY b."id"
  )`;

function whereClause(filters: PackFilters) {
  const terms: Prisma.Sql[] = [Prisma.sql`TRUE`];
  if (filters.q) terms.push(Prisma.sql`(POSITION(LOWER(${filters.q}) IN LOWER(p."name")) > 0 OR POSITION(LOWER(${filters.q}) IN LOWER(COALESCE(p."location", ''))) > 0)`);
  if (filters.location) terms.push(Prisma.sql`POSITION(LOWER(${filters.location}) IN LOWER(COALESCE(p."location", ''))) > 0`);
  if (filters.people !== null) terms.push(Prisma.sql`p."people" = ${filters.people}`);
  if (filters.category) terms.push(Prisma.sql`EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "BuildItem" ci
    LEFT JOIN "Gear" cg ON cg."id" = ci."gearId"
    LEFT JOIN "Category" cc ON cc."id" = cg."categoryId"
    WHERE ci."buildId" = p."id"
      AND LOWER(COALESCE(cc."name", ci."customCategory", 'Other')) = LOWER(${filters.category})
  )`);
  if (filters.minBaseKg !== null) terms.push(Prisma.sql`p."missingBase" = 0 AND p."baseWeightG" >= ${Math.round(filters.minBaseKg * 1000)}`);
  if (filters.maxBaseKg !== null) terms.push(Prisma.sql`p."missingBase" = 0 AND p."baseWeightG" <= ${Math.round(filters.maxBaseKg * 1000)}`);
  if (filters.maxCostCad !== null) terms.push(Prisma.sql`p."missingCost" = 0 AND p."knownCost" <= ${filters.maxCostCad}`);
  return Prisma.sql`${Prisma.join(terms, " AND ")}`;
}
function sorting(sort: PackFilters["sort"]) {
  switch(sort) {
    case "updated": return Prisma.sql`p."updatedAt" DESC, p."id" ASC`;
    case "popular": return Prisma.sql`(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "SavedBuild" s WHERE s."buildId" = p."id") DESC, p."createdAt" DESC, p."id" ASC`;
    case "name": return Prisma.sql`p."name" ASC, p."id" ASC`;
    case "lightest": return Prisma.sql`(CASE WHEN p."missingBase" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ASC, p."baseWeightG" ASC, p."id" ASC`;
    case "cheapest": return Prisma.sql`(CASE WHEN p."missingCost" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ASC, p."knownCost" ASC, p."id" ASC`;
    default: return Prisma.sql`p."createdAt" DESC, p."id" ASC`;
  }
}
/** Get exactly one page of IDs and the matching total count. */
export async function queryPublicPackIds(filters: PackFilters) {
  const where = whereClause(filters);
  const countRows = await prisma.$queryRaw<{count: bigint}[]>(Prisma.sql`${base} SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS "count" FROM pack_metrics p WHERE ${where}`);
  const total = Number(countRows[0]?.count ?? 0n);
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / PACK_PAGE_SIZE));
  const page = Math.min(filters.page, totalPages);
  if (!total) return {ids: [] as string[], total, totalPages, page};
  const rows = await prisma.$queryRaw<{id: string}[]>(Prisma.sql`${base} SELECT p."id" FROM pack_metrics p WHERE ${where} ORDER BY ${sorting(filters.sort)} LIMIT ${PACK_PAGE_SIZE} OFFSET ${(page - 1) * PACK_PAGE_SIZE}`);
  return {ids: rows.map(row=>row.id), total, totalPages, page};
}
```

### `lib/discover-packs.ts`

```typescript
/** Public gear-build discovery. All filter values are finite, bounded and URL-safe. */
export const PACK_PAGE_SIZE = 12;
export const PACK_CATEGORIES = ["Packs", "Shelter", "Sleep", "Cooking", "Water", "Clothing", "Electronics", "Misc", "Other"] as const;
export type PackSort = "recent" | "updated" | "popular" | "name" | "lightest" | "cheapest";
export type PackFilters = {
  q: string;
  location: string;
  sort: PackSort;
  people: number | null;
  category: string;
  minBaseKg: number | null;
  maxBaseKg: number | null;
  maxCostCad: number | null;
  page: number;
};
type SearchValue = string | string[] | undefined;
const first = (value: SearchValue) => typeof value === "string" ? value : Array.isArray(value) ? value[0] ?? "" : "";
function numeric(value: SearchValue, max: number, integer = false): number | null {
  const raw = first(value).trim();
  if (!raw || !/^(?:\d+)(?:\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(raw)) return null;
  const n = Number(raw);
  return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0 && n <= max && (!integer || Number.isInteger(n)) ? n : null;
}
export function parsePackFilters(raw: Record<string, SearchValue>): PackFilters {
  const requestedSort = first(raw.sort);
  const sort: PackSort = ["updated", "popular", "name", "lightest", "cheapest"].includes(requestedSort) ? requestedSort as PackSort : "recent";
  const category = first(raw.packCategory);
  const people = numeric(raw.packPeople, 20, true);
  const page = numeric(raw.page, 99999, true);
  return {
    q: first(raw.q).trim().slice(0, 100),
    location: first(raw.location).trim().slice(0, 100),
    sort,
    people: people === null || people === 0 ? null : people,
    category: PACK_CATEGORIES.includes(category as typeof PACK_CATEGORIES[number]) ? category : "",
    minBaseKg: numeric(raw.minBaseKg, 50),
    maxBaseKg: numeric(raw.maxBaseKg, 50),
    maxCostCad: numeric(raw.maxCostCad, 100000),
    page: page === null || page < 1 ? 1 : page,
  };
}
export function packBrowseHref(filters: PackFilters, updates: Partial<PackFilters> = {}): string {
  const next = {...filters, ...updates};
  const query = new URLSearchParams({type: "packs"});
  if (next.q) query.set("q",next.q);
  if (next.location) query.set("location",next.location);
  if (next.sort !== "recent") query.set("sort",next.sort);
  if (next.people !== null) query.set("packPeople",String(next.people));
  if (next.category) query.set("packCategory",next.category);
  if (next.minBaseKg !== null) query.set("minBaseKg",String(next.minBaseKg));
  if (next.maxBaseKg !== null) query.set("maxBaseKg",String(next.maxBaseKg));
  if (next.maxCostCad !== null) query.set("maxCostCad",String(next.maxCostCad));
  if (next.page > 1) query.set("page",String(next.page));
  return `/discover/community?${query.toString()}`;
}
export function packHref(id: string): string { return `/discover/packs/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`; }
export type PublicPackItem = {
  quantity: number;
  isWorn: boolean;
  isConsumable: boolean;
  weightSnapshot: number | null;
  priceSnapshot: number | null;
  customCategory: string | null;
  gear: { weight_g: number | null; price_cad: number | null; category: {name: string} } | null;
};
export function categoryOf(item: PublicPackItem): string {
  return item.gear?.category.name || item.customCategory || "Other";
}
export function summarizePack(items: readonly PublicPackItem[]) {
  let knownBaseG = 0, knownWornG = 0, knownConsumableG = 0, knownCostCad = 0;
  let unknownBaseCount = 0, unknownWornCount = 0, unknownConsumableCount = 0, unknownCostCount = 0, itemCount = 0;
  const categories = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const item of items) {
    const qty = item.quantity;
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(qty) || qty <= 0) continue;
    itemCount += qty;
    const category = categoryOf(item);
    categories.set(category, (categories.get(category) ?? 0) + qty);
    const weight = item.gear?.weight_g ?? item.weightSnapshot;
    const price = item.gear?.price_cad ?? item.priceSnapshot;
    if (price === null || !Number.isFinite(price)) unknownCostCount += qty;
    else knownCostCad += price * qty;
    if (item.isWorn) {
      if (weight === null || !Number.isFinite(weight)) unknownWornCount += qty;
      else knownWornG += weight * qty;
    } else if (item.isConsumable) {
      if (weight === null || !Number.isFinite(weight)) unknownConsumableCount += qty;
      else knownConsumableG += weight * qty;
    } else {
      if (weight === null || !Number.isFinite(weight)) unknownBaseCount += qty;
      else knownBaseG += weight * qty;
    }
  }
  return {
    itemCount, categoryCount: categories.size, categories: [...categories.entries()].sort((a,b)=>a[0].localeCompare(b[0])),
    baseWeightG: unknownBaseCount ? null : knownBaseG, knownBaseG, unknownBaseCount,
    wornWeightG: unknownWornCount ? null : knownWornG, knownWornG, unknownWornCount,
    consumableWeightG: unknownConsumableCount ? null : knownConsumableG, knownConsumableG, unknownConsumableCount,
    totalWeightG: unknownBaseCount || unknownWornCount || unknownConsumableCount ? null : knownBaseG+knownWornG+knownConsumableG,
    knownTotalG: knownBaseG+knownWornG+knownConsumableG,
    costCad: unknownCostCount ? null : knownCostCad, knownCostCad, unknownCostCount,
  };
}
export function formattedKg(grams: number) { return `${(grams / 1000).toFixed(2)} kg`; }
export function formattedCad(cad: number) { return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-CA", {style:"currency",currency:"CAD"}).format(cad); }
```

```typescript
  "garibaldi-lake-destination": "garibaldi",
  "garibaldi-lake": "garibaldi",
  "panorama-ridge-garibaldi": "garibaldi",
  "upper-joffre-lake": "joffre",

};

  "Mount Robson Park": "robson",
  "Cape Scott Park": "cape",
  "Joffre Lakes Park": "joffre",
  "Strathcona Park": "paradise",
};
export function getDiscoverPhoto(destination: { id: string; kind?: string; park: string }): DiscoverPhoto | null {
  const match = exact[destination.id];
  if (match) return representativeIds.has(destination.id) ? { ...photos[match], representative: true } : photos[match];
  // A representative image is clearly labelled and only used for campsites
  // inside the exact same named park. No guessed photo matches by category.
  const parkMatch = destination.kind === "campground" || !destination.kind ? representativeParks[destination.park] : undefined;
  if (!parkMatch) return null;
  return { ...photos[parkMatch], representative: true };
}
export function discoverPhotoUrl(photo: DiscoverPhoto): string {
  return `https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/${encodeURIComponent(photo.file)}?width=960`;
}
export function discoverPhotoSource(photo: DiscoverPhoto): string {
  return `https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:${encodeURIComponent(photo.file)}`;
}
```

```typescript
  query?: string;
  kind?: PreviewTrailKind | "all";
  region?: PreviewTrailRegion | "all";
  sort?: "featured" | "alphabetical";
};

function normalized(value: string): string {
  return value.normalize("NFKD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLocaleLowerCase().trim();
}

export function filterPreviewTrails(
  entries: readonly PreviewTrail[],
  { query = "", kind = "all", region = "all", sort = "featured" }: PreviewFilters,
): PreviewTrail[] {
  const q = normalized(query);
  const result = entries.filter((entry) => {
    if (kind !== "all" && entry.kind !== kind) return false;
    if (region !== "all" && entry.region !== region) return false;
    return !q || normalized([entry.name, entry.region, entry.park, entry.landscape, entry.description, kindNames[entry.kind]].join(" ")).includes(q);
  });
  return sort === "alphabetical" ? result.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)) : result;
}
```

```typescript
import type {Waypoint} from "./trip-planner";
/** Explicitly published route stops. Strip per-stop free-text notes and invalid day references. */
export function publicRouteWaypoints(value:unknown,dayIds:readonly string[]=[]):Waypoint[] {
  if(!Array.isArray(value))return [];
  const days=new Set(dayIds);
  const ids=new Set<string>();
  const route:Waypoint[]=[];
  for(const raw of value){
    if(!raw||typeof raw!=="object")continue;
    const p=raw as Record<string,unknown>;
    if(typeof p.id!=="string"||!p.id||p.id.length>200||ids.has(p.id))continue;
    if(typeof p.name!=="string"||!p.name.trim()||p.name.length>200)continue;
    if(typeof p.lat!=="number"||!Number.isFinite(p.lat)||Math.abs(p.lat)>90||typeof p.lng!=="number"||!Number.isFinite(p.lng)||Math.abs(p.lng)>180)continue;
    if(p.kind!=="camp"&&p.kind!=="trailhead"&&p.kind!=="water"&&p.kind!=="resupply"&&p.kind!=="waypoint")continue;
    const elevation=typeof p.elevationM==="number"&&Number.isFinite(p.elevationM)&&p.elevationM>=-500&&p.elevationM<=9000?p.elevationM:null;
    const time=typeof p.time==="string"&&/^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/.test(p.time)?p.time:null;
    const dayId=typeof p.dayId==="string"&&days.has(p.dayId)?p.dayId:null;
    ids.add(p.id);
    route.push({id:p.id,name:p.name.trim(),lat:p.lat,lng:p.lng,kind:p.kind,elevationM:elevation,...(dayId?{dayId}:{}),...(time?{time}:{})});
    if(route.length>=200)break;
  }
  return route;
}
```

### `lib/discover-related-query.ts`

```typescript
import { getDestination } from "@/lib/destinations";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import {
  EMPTY_RELATED_CONTENT,
  type RelatedPublicContent,
  type RelatedPublicItem,
} from "@/lib/discover-related";

type RelatedOptions = { excludeBuildId?: string; limit?: number };

/**
 * Only query explicitly linked, published builds. No user-entered location
 * matching, private itinerary notes, route coordinates, or trip logistics.
 * Days and items are only counted here; no individual private fields selected.
 */
export async function findRelatedPublicContent(
  destinationId: string | null | undefined,
  options: RelatedOptions = {},
): Promise<RelatedPublicContent> {
  if (!getDestination(destinationId)) return EMPTY_RELATED_CONTENT;
  const limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(6, Math.trunc(options.limit ?? 3) || 3));
  const where = {
    isPublic: true,
    destinationId: destinationId!,
    ...(options.excludeBuildId ? { id: { not: options.excludeBuildId } } : {}),
  };
  const select = {
    id: true,
    name: true,
    _count: { select: { days: true, items: true } },
  } as const;
  const [trips, packs] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.build.findMany({
      where: { ...where, days: { some: {} } },
      select,
      orderBy: [{ updatedAt: "desc" }, { id: "asc" }],
      take: limit,
    }),
    prisma.build.findMany({
      where: { ...where, items: { some: {} } },
      select,
      orderBy: [{ updatedAt: "desc" }, { id: "asc" }],
      take: limit,
    }),
  ]);
  const card = (build: {id: string; name: string; _count: {days: number; items: number}}): RelatedPublicItem => ({
    id: build.id,
    name: build.name,
    dayCount: build._count.days,
    gearCount: build._count.items,
  });
  return { trips: trips.map(card), packs: packs.map(card) };
}
```

```typescript
/** Cross-section links use catalog IDs and public Build records, never fuzzy place names. */
export type RelatedPublicItem = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  dayCount: number;
  gearCount: number;
};

export type RelatedPublicContent = {
  trips: RelatedPublicItem[];
  packs: RelatedPublicItem[];
};

export const EMPTY_RELATED_CONTENT: RelatedPublicContent = { trips: [], packs: [] };

export function relatedTripHref(id: string): string {
  return `/discover/trips/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
}

export function relatedPackHref(id: string): string {
  return `/discover/packs/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
}

export function relatedDestinationHref(id: string): string {
  return `/discover/destinations/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
}

/** Exact catalog identifiers are the sole basis of matching. */
export function relatedDestinationMatches(
  candidateId: string | null | undefined,
  requestedId: string | null | undefined,
): boolean {
  return Boolean(candidateId && requestedId && candidateId === requestedId);
}

export function relatedPublicSummary(item: RelatedPublicItem, kind: "trip" | "pack"): string {
  if (kind === "trip") {
    return `${item.dayCount} ${item.dayCount === 1 ? "day" : "days"}${item.gearCount ? ` · ${item.gearCount} gear entries` : ""}`;
  }
  return `${item.gearCount} ${item.gearCount === 1 ? "gear entry" : "gear entries"}${item.dayCount ? ` · ${item.dayCount} itinerary days` : ""}`;
}
```

### `lib/discover-saved.ts`

```typescript
/** Unified Saved library representation. A trip and a gear list may refer to the same Build. */
export type SavedKind = "destination" | "trip" | "pack";
export type SavedType = "all" | "destinations" | "trips" | "packs";
export type SavedEntry = {
  id: string;
  kind: SavedKind;
  name: string;
  subtitle: string;
  savedAt: string;
  hasDays?: boolean;
  hasItems?: boolean;
  available: boolean;
};
export type SavedSearch = { type: SavedType; q: string; page: number };
export type SearchFields = Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>;
function first(value: string | string[] | undefined) {
  return typeof value === "string" ? value : Array.isArray(value) ? value[0] ?? "" : "";
}
export function parseSavedSearch(raw: SearchFields): SavedSearch {
  const selected = first(raw.savedType);
  const type: SavedType = selected === "destinations" || selected === "trips" || selected === "packs" ? selected : "all";
  const pageText = first(raw.page);
  const page = /^\d{1,5}$/.test(pageText) && Number(pageText) >= 1 ? Number(pageText) : 1;
  return { type, q: first(raw.q).trim().slice(0, 100), page };
}
export function savedHref(item: SavedEntry, type: SavedType = "all"): string | null {
  if (!item.available) return null;
  const id = encodeURIComponent(item.id);
  if (item.kind === "destination") return `/discover/destinations/${id}`;
  // Both the trip and the gear browser can bookmark the same public Build.
  if (type === "packs" && item.hasItems) return `/discover/packs/${id}`;
  if (type === "trips" && item.hasDays) return `/discover/trips/${id}`;
  return item.hasDays ? `/discover/trips/${id}` : item.hasItems ? `/discover/packs/${id}` : null;
}
export function matchesSavedType(item: SavedEntry, type: SavedType): boolean {
  if (type === "all") return true;
  if (type === "destinations") return item.kind === "destination";
  if (type === "trips") return item.kind !== "destination" && !!item.hasDays;
  return item.kind !== "destination" && !!item.hasItems;
}
export function filterSavedEntries(entries: readonly SavedEntry[], search: SavedSearch): SavedEntry[] {
  const q = search.q.toLocaleLowerCase();
  return entries.filter(item => matchesSavedType(item, search.type) &&
    (!q || `${item.name} ${item.subtitle}`.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(q)))
    .sort((a,b) => b.savedAt.localeCompare(a.savedAt) || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
}
export function savedUrl(type: SavedType, q = "", page = 1): string {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (type !== "all") params.set("savedType", type);
  if (q) params.set("q", q);
  if (page > 1) params.set("page", String(page));
  return `/discover/saved${params.toString() ? `?${params.toString()}` : ""}`;
}
```

```typescript
import type { Destination } from "./destinations";

/** Same coordinate validation used on destination detail pages, kept pure for search tests. */
export function hasMappedCoordinates(place: Pick<Destination, "latitude" | "longitude">): boolean {
  const { latitude, longitude } = place;
  return typeof latitude === "number" && typeof longitude === "number" &&
    Number.isFinite(latitude) && Number.isFinite(longitude) &&
    latitude >= -90 && latitude <= 90 && longitude >= -180 && longitude <= 180;
}

/**
 * Never invent marker locations for un-geocoded destinations. Keep the user's
 * filtered sort order intact in both result lists.
 */
export function splitMappedDestinations<T extends Destination>(matching: readonly T[]) {
  const mapped: T[] = [];
  const unmapped: Pick<T, "id" | "name" | "park" | "region" | "difficulty">[] = [];
  for (const destination of matching) {
    if (hasMappedCoordinates(destination)) mapped.push(destination);
    else unmapped.push({
      id: destination.id,
      name: destination.name,
      park: destination.park,
      region: destination.region,
      difficulty: destination.difficulty,
    });
  }
  return { mapped, unmapped };
}
```
