### `lib/discover-trip.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * Discover -> Trip Planner starter suggestions. These are *not* trails, measured routes,
 * bookings or verified campsites. The existing Builder owns creation and editing.
 */
import type { Destination } from "./destinations";

export type DayPreview = { day: number; date: string; activities: string };
export type DiscoverPreview = {
  count: number;
  days: DayPreview[];
  error: string | null;
};

function utcDay(iso: string): Date | null {
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(iso)) return null;
  const date = new Date(`${iso}T00:00:00.000Z`);
  if (!Number.isFinite(date.getTime()) || date.toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== iso) return null;
  return date;
}

/** Align with lib/trip-planner.ts::parseDates (up to 366 inclusive days). */
export function tripDateError(start: string, end: string): string | null {
  if (!start && !end) return null;
  if (!start || !end) return "Choose both a start and an end date.";
  const first = utcDay(start), last = utcDay(end);
  if (!first || !last) return "Choose valid trip dates.";
  if (last.getTime() < first.getTime()) return "End date cannot be before start date.";
  if ((last.getTime() - first.getTime()) / 86_400_000 > 365) return "Trips may span up to 366 days.";
  return null;
}

export function starterDayActivity(destinationName: string, index: number, count: number): string {
  const name = destinationName.trim().slice(0, 140);
  if (count <= 1) return `Explore ${name}; confirm your route and timing`;
  if (index === 0) return `Travel to ${name}; confirm access and begin your visit`;
  if (index === count - 1) return `Return from ${name}; confirm exit and transport`;
  return `Explore ${name}; choose and verify today's route`;
}

/** Gives a bounded preview, never a made-up turn-by-turn itinerary. */
export function discoverTripPreview(destinationName: string, start: string, end: string): DiscoverPreview {
  const error = tripDateError(start, end);
  if (error || !start || !end) return { count: 0, days: [], error };
  const begin = utcDay(start)!;
  const finish = utcDay(end)!;
  const count = Math.round((finish.getTime() - begin.getTime()) / 86_400_000) + 1;
  const indexes = count <= 3 ? Array.from({length: count}, (_, i) => i) : [0, 1, count - 1];
  const days = indexes.map(index => {
    const date = new Date(begin.getTime() + index * 86_400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    return { day: index + 1, date, activities: starterDayActivity(destinationName, index, count) };
  });
  return {count, days, error: null};
}

/** Metadata included in the editable Trip Planner logistics section. */
export function createDiscoverLogistics(destination: Destination) {
  const official = /^https:\/\//.test(destination.sourceUrl) ? destination.sourceUrl : "";
  const caution = destination.caution?.trim() || "";
  const info = [
    `Discover destination: ${destination.name} (${destination.park}, ${destination.region}).`,
    official && `Official destination information: ${official}`,
    caution && `Catalog caution (recheck before travel): ${caution}`,
    "This listing does not provide a verified trailhead, daily route, travel duration, or campsite assignment. Confirm current park notices before departure.",
  ].filter(Boolean).join("\n");
  return {
    permits: "Check current park access, day-use, and camping permit requirements; these may be different.",
    reservations: destination.kind === "campground" || !destination.kind
      ? "Check current campground reservation or permit rules with the operator. No booking has been made."
      : "",
    transportation: "", parking: "", emergencyContact: "", emergencyPlan: "",
    notes: info.slice(0, 4900),
  };
}

/** Fields created in TripDay by the existing authenticated/guest build creation transaction. */
export function createDiscoverDaySeed(destination: Destination, index: number, total: number): {activities: string; notes?: string} {
  const activities = starterDayActivity(destination.name, index, total);
  if (index !== 0) return {activities};
  return {
    activities,
    notes: "Starter itinerary only. No route, trailhead, campsite or daily distance has been verified or assigned. Adjust this plan using the official park information.",
  };
}
```

### `lib/discover-trips.ts`

```typescript
/** Public community-trip presentation helpers. No user-private logistics are exposed. */
export type TripFeature = "all" | "route" | "campsite" | "gear";
export const TRIP_FEATURES: readonly TripFeature[] = ["all", "route", "campsite", "gear"];
export type TripDayPublic = {
  id?: string;
  date: Date | string;
  startLocation: string | null;
  endLocation: string | null;
  distanceKm: number | null;
  elevationGainM: number | null;
  elevationLossM?: number | null;
  durationMinutes?: number | null;
  campsite: string | null;
  activities: string | null;
};
export type TripStats = {
  dayCount: number;
  distanceKm: number | null;
  elevationGainM: number | null;
  measuredDistanceDays: number;
  measuredGainDays: number;
  campsites: number;
};
export function parseTripFeature(value: string | string[] | undefined): TripFeature {
  const input = Array.isArray(value) ? value[0] : value;
  return TRIP_FEATURES.includes(input as TripFeature) ? input as TripFeature : "all";
}
export function summarizeTripDays(days: readonly TripDayPublic[]): TripStats {
  const withDistance = days.filter(day => day.distanceKm !== null && Number.isFinite(day.distanceKm) && day.distanceKm >= 0);
  const withGain = days.filter(day => day.elevationGainM !== null && Number.isFinite(day.elevationGainM) && day.elevationGainM >= 0);
  return {
    dayCount: days.length,
    distanceKm: withDistance.length ? withDistance.reduce((sum, day) => sum + day.distanceKm!, 0) : null,
    elevationGainM: withGain.length ? withGain.reduce((sum, day) => sum + day.elevationGainM!, 0) : null,
    measuredDistanceDays: withDistance.length,
    measuredGainDays: withGain.length,
    campsites: days.filter(day => Boolean(day.campsite?.trim())).length,
  };
}
export function tripHref(id: string): string {
  return `/discover/trips/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
}
export function tripBrowseHref(
  filters: { q: string; location: string; region: string; sort: string },
  feature: TripFeature,
  updates: Partial<{ q: string; location: string; region: string; sort: string; feature: TripFeature; page: number }> = {},
): string {
  const next = {...filters, feature, page: 1, ...updates};
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (next.q) params.set("q", next.q);
  if (next.location) params.set("location", next.location);
  if (next.region) params.set("region", next.region);
  if (next.sort !== "recent") params.set("sort", next.sort);
  if (next.feature !== "all") params.set("feature", next.feature);
  if (next.page > 1) params.set("page", String(next.page));
  return `/discover/community${params.toString() ? `?${params.toString()}` : ""}`;
}
/** A public build may contain private notes, reservations and logistics. Never copy those to Discover pages. */
export function publicTripDay(day: TripDayPublic): TripDayPublic {
  return {
    ...(day.id?{id:day.id}:{}), date: day.date, startLocation: day.startLocation, endLocation: day.endLocation,
    distanceKm: day.distanceKm, elevationGainM: day.elevationGainM,
    elevationLossM: day.elevationLossM ?? null,
    durationMinutes: day.durationMinutes ?? null,
    campsite: day.campsite, activities: day.activities,
  };
}
export function tripDayTitle(day: Pick<TripDayPublic, "startLocation" | "endLocation" | "activities" | "campsite">, index: number): string {
  const start = day.startLocation?.trim();
  const end = day.endLocation?.trim();
  if (start && end) return start === end ? start : `${start} → ${end}`;
  return end || start || day.activities?.trim() || day.campsite?.trim() || `Day ${index + 1}`;
}
export function publicTripAuthor(user: { name: string | null; username: string | null; isProfilePublic: boolean } | null): string {
  return user?.isProfilePublic ? user.username || user.name || "Community member" : "Community member";
}
export function tripDate(value: Date | string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!value) return "Date not set";
  const date = new Date(value);
  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? "Date not set" : date.toLocaleDateString("en-CA", {month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC"});
}
```

### `lib/discover.ts`

```typescript
/** Safe, URL-driven filters and display helpers for community discovery. */
export type DiscoverView = "destinations" | "trips" | "packs" | "saved";
/** Grid/Map is a destination-search display choice, not a Discover section. */
export type DestinationDisplay = "grid" | "map";
export type DiscoverSort = "recent" | "updated" | "popular" | "name" | "distance";
export type DiscoverActivity = "all" | "hiking" | "backpacking" | "camping" | "paddling";
export type DiscoverCategory = "all" | "trail" | "lake" | "summit" | "waterfall" | "campground" | "coastal" | "viewpoint" | "other";
export type DiscoverSearch = {
  view: DiscoverView;
  display: DestinationDisplay;
  sort: DiscoverSort;
  q: string;
  location: string;
  region: string;
  difficulty: "all" | "easy" | "moderate" | "hard";
  activity: DiscoverActivity;
  category: DiscoverCategory;
  page: number;
};
export type SearchValue = string | string[] | undefined;
export type SearchInput = Record<string, SearchValue>;
function first(value: SearchValue): string {
  return typeof value === "string" ? value : Array.isArray(value) ? value[0] ?? "" : "";
}
const activities: readonly DiscoverActivity[] = ["all", "hiking", "backpacking", "camping", "paddling"];
const categories: readonly DiscoverCategory[] = ["all", "trail", "lake", "summit", "waterfall", "campground", "coastal", "viewpoint", "other"];
export function parseDiscoverSearch(raw: SearchInput): DiscoverSearch {
  const view = first(raw.view), sort = first(raw.sort), difficulty = first(raw.difficulty), pageRaw = first(raw.page);
  const pageNumber = Number(pageRaw);
  const normalizedView: DiscoverView = view === "packs" || view === "saved" || view === "trips" ? view : "destinations";
  const normalizedSort: DiscoverSort = normalizedView === "destinations"
    ? sort === "distance" || sort === "name" ? sort : "popular"
    : sort === "updated" || sort === "popular" || sort === "name" ? sort : "recent";
  const activity = first(raw.activity) as DiscoverActivity;
  const category = first(raw.category) as DiscoverCategory;
  return {
    view: normalizedView, display: normalizedView === "destinations" && first(raw.display) === "map" ? "map" : "grid", sort: normalizedSort,
    q: first(raw.q).trim().slice(0, 100), location: first(raw.location).trim().slice(0, 100),
    region: first(raw.region).trim().slice(0, 100),
    difficulty: difficulty === "easy" || difficulty === "moderate" || difficulty === "hard" ? difficulty : "all",
    activity: activities.includes(activity) ? activity : "all",
    category: categories.includes(category) ? category : "all",
    page: /^\d{1,5}$/.test(pageRaw) && Number.isSafeInteger(pageNumber) && pageNumber >= 1 ? pageNumber : 1,
  };
}
export function discoverUrl(
  current: Pick<DiscoverSearch, "view" | "sort" | "q" | "location" | "region" | "difficulty"> & Partial<Pick<DiscoverSearch,"activity" | "category" | "display">>,
  updates: Partial<DiscoverSearch> = {},
): string {
  const next = { activity: "all" as DiscoverActivity, category: "all" as DiscoverCategory, ...current, ...updates };
  const query = new URLSearchParams();
  const route = next.view === "destinations" ? "/discover/search" : next.view === "saved" ? "/discover/saved" : "/discover/community";
  if (next.view === "packs") query.set("type", "packs");
  if (next.view === "destinations" && next.display === "map") query.set("display", "map");
  if (next.sort !== "recent") query.set("sort", next.sort);
  if (next.q) query.set("q", next.q);
  if (next.location) query.set("location", next.location);
  if (next.region) query.set("region", next.region);
  if (next.difficulty && next.difficulty !== "all") query.set("difficulty", next.difficulty);
  if (next.activity && next.activity !== "all") query.set("activity", next.activity);
  if (next.category && next.category !== "all") query.set("category", next.category);
  if (next.page && next.page > 1) query.set("page", String(next.page));
  return route + (query.toString() ? `?${query.toString()}` : "");
}
export function summarizePublicBuild(
  items: readonly { quantity: number; isWorn: boolean; isConsumable: boolean; weightSnapshot: number | null; gear: { weight_g: number | null } | null }[],
  days: readonly { distanceKm: number | null; elevationGainM: number | null }[],
) {
  let baseWeightG = 0, unknownBaseWeights = 0, itemCount = 0;
  for (const item of items) {
    itemCount += item.quantity;
    if (item.isWorn || item.isConsumable) continue;
    const grams = item.gear?.weight_g ?? item.weightSnapshot;
    if (grams == null) unknownBaseWeights += item.quantity;
    else baseWeightG += grams * item.quantity;
  }
  const distanceDays = days.filter(day => day.distanceKm != null), elevationDays = days.filter(day => day.elevationGainM != null);
  return {
    itemCount, baseWeightG: unknownBaseWeights === 0 ? baseWeightG : null, unknownBaseWeights,
    dayCount: days.length,
    distanceKm: distanceDays.length ? distanceDays.reduce((n, day) => n + (day.distanceKm ?? 0), 0) : null,
    elevationGainM: elevationDays.length ? elevationDays.reduce((n, day) => n + (day.elevationGainM ?? 0), 0) : null,
    partialDistance: distanceDays.length > 0 && distanceDays.length < days.length,
  };
}
export type DiscoverDestination = {
  id: string; name: string; park: string; region: string;
  difficulty: "easy" | "moderate" | "hard";
  distanceKm: number | null; elevationGainM: number | null;
  featured: boolean; summary: string;
  kind?: string; activities?: readonly string[];
};
/** Only curated entries are searched; unknown attributes are not inferred. */
export function filterDiscoverDestinations<T extends DiscoverDestination>(
  destinations: readonly T[],
  filters: Pick<DiscoverSearch, "q" | "region" | "difficulty" | "sort"> & Partial<Pick<DiscoverSearch, "activity" | "category">>,
): T[] {
  const q = filters.q.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
  const matching = destinations.filter(destination => {
    const kind = destination.kind ?? "campground"; // Backward compatible with the original 76-site catalog.
    const category = filters.category ?? "all";
    const categoryMatch = category === "all" || (category === "other" ? !["trail","lake","summit","waterfall","campground","coastal","viewpoint"].includes(kind) : kind === category);
    const activity = filters.activity ?? "all";
    const activityMatch = activity === "all" || (destination.activities?.includes(activity) ?? (kind === "campground" && ["backpacking", "camping"].includes(activity)));
    return (!filters.region || destination.region === filters.region) &&
      (filters.difficulty === "all" || destination.difficulty === filters.difficulty) &&
      categoryMatch && activityMatch &&
      (!q || [destination.name, destination.park, destination.region, destination.summary, kind]
        .some(value => value.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(q)));
  });
  return matching.sort((a, b) => {
    if (filters.sort === "name") return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
    if (filters.sort === "distance") return (a.distanceKm ?? Infinity) - (b.distanceKm ?? Infinity) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
    return Number(b.featured) - Number(a.featured) || Number(a.kind === "campground") - Number(b.kind === "campground") || a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
  });
}

/** The spotlight is a separate section, never duplicated in the paginated cards. */
export const SPOTLIGHT_IDS = ["garibaldi-lake-destination", "upper-joffre-lake", "berg-lake-trail"] as const;
export function isUnfilteredDestinationSearch(filters: Pick<DiscoverSearch,"q" | "region" | "difficulty" | "activity" | "category" | "sort">): boolean {
  return !filters.q && !filters.region && filters.difficulty === "all" && filters.activity === "all" && filters.category === "all" && filters.sort === "popular";
}
```

### `lib/finding-dismissals.ts`

```typescript
import type { Finding } from "./pack-intelligence";

/** Persist only a user's acknowledgement, never alter the underlying finding. */
export type IgnoredFindingRecords = Record<string, string>;

/**
 * The original Analysis tab already had a handful of the same warnings as
 * Gear Compatibility. Share acknowledgements for truly equivalent checks,
 * without merging independent weather/forecast observations.
 */
export function findingAcknowledgementId(finding: Finding): string {
  const id = finding.id;
  const paired = new Map([
    ['gear-missing-packs', 'missing-packs'],
    ['gear-missing-shelter', 'missing-shelter'],
    ['gear-missing-sleep', 'missing-sleep'],
    ['gear-missing-water', 'missing-water'],
    ['gear-cooking-plan', 'missing-cooking'],
    ['gear-sleep-no-trip-low', 'sleep-no-low'],
    ['gear-sleep-rating-unknown', 'sleep-unrated'],
    ['gear-unknown-weights', 'unknown-weight'],
  ]);
  if (paired.has(id)) return paired.get(id)!;
  if (id.startsWith('gear-sleep-rating-review-')) return `sleep-temp-${id.slice('gear-sleep-rating-review-'.length)}`;
  return id;
}

/**
 * Acknowledgements re-open on changed evidence. Stable missing-category
 * checks have no additional numeric evidence: the finding disappears once
 * the gear is added, so their shared signature only needs the item IDs.
 */
export function findingFingerprint(finding: Finding): string {
  const id = findingAcknowledgementId(finding);
  const itemIds = [...finding.itemIds].sort();
  if (/^(missing-(packs|shelter|sleep|water|cooking)|sleep-no-low|sleep-unrated|unknown-weight)$/.test(id)) {
    return JSON.stringify([id, itemIds]);
  }
  if (id.startsWith('sleep-temp-')) {
    const temperatures = [...finding.basis.matchAll(/(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)°C/g)].map(m => Number(m[1]));
    if (temperatures.length >= 2) return JSON.stringify([id, itemIds, temperatures.slice(0, 2)]);
  }
  return JSON.stringify([
    id, finding.section, finding.level, finding.title, finding.detail,
    finding.action, finding.basis, itemIds,
  ]);
}

export function parseIgnoredFindings(raw: string | null): IgnoredFindingRecords {
  if (!raw) return {};
  try {
    const value: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return {};
    return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).filter(([id, fingerprint]) =>
      id.length <= 250 && typeof fingerprint === "string" && fingerprint.length <= 10000,
    ));
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

export function isFindingIgnored(finding: Finding, records: IgnoredFindingRecords): boolean {
  return records[findingAcknowledgementId(finding)] === findingFingerprint(finding);
}
```

### `lib/food-plan.ts`

```typescript
/** Meal and consumables mass planner. Pure calculations, no nutritional or safety advice.
 * Phase 7 data stays in private Build.tripLogistics.phase7 and is never added to public route JSON.
 */
type FoodStop = { id: string; kind: string; dayId?: string | null };
export const MEAL_SLOTS = ['breakfast', 'lunch', 'dinner', 'snacks'] as const;
export type MealSlot = typeof MEAL_SLOTS[number];
export type FoodItem = { id: string; name: string; gramsPerUnit: number | null; startingUnits: number; countInPack: boolean };
export type PlannedMeal = { id: string; dayId: string; slot: MealSlot; foodId: string; units: number; heated: boolean };
/** A resupply references an actual mapped resupply waypoint; its current day assignment is authoritative. */
export type FoodResupply = { id: string; waypointId: string; foodId: string; units: number; fuelGrams: number };
export type FoodSettings = {
  startingFuelGrams: number;
  countFuelInPack: boolean;
  fuelGramsPerHeating: number;
  fuelAdjustment: number;
  fuelReservePercent: number;
  otherDailyUseGrams: number;
};
export type FoodPlan = { foods: FoodItem[]; meals: PlannedMeal[]; resupplies: FoodResupply[]; settings: FoodSettings };
export const DEFAULT_FOOD_SETTINGS: FoodSettings = {
  startingFuelGrams: 0, countFuelInPack: true, fuelGramsPerHeating: 12,
  fuelAdjustment: 1, fuelReservePercent: 20, otherDailyUseGrams: 0,
};
export const emptyFoodPlan = (): FoodPlan => ({ foods: [], meals: [], resupplies: [], settings: { ...DEFAULT_FOOD_SETTINGS } });
const obj = (value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null => value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) ? value as Record<string, unknown> : null;
const finite = (x: unknown, lo: number, hi: number, integer = false): x is number => typeof x === 'number' && Number.isFinite(x) && x >= lo && x <= hi && (!integer || Number.isSafeInteger(x));
const str = (x: unknown, max: number): x is string => typeof x === 'string' && x.length <= max;
const fields = (x: Record<string, unknown>, allowed: readonly string[]) => Object.keys(x).every(key => allowed.includes(key));
const fail = (message: string): never => { throw new Error(message); };
const requireArray = (x: unknown, max: number, label: string): Record<string,unknown>[] => {
  if (!Array.isArray(x) || x.length > max || !x.every(v => obj(v))) fail(`Invalid ${label} (maximum ${max}).`);
  return x as Record<string,unknown>[];
};
const unique = (list: { id: string }[], label: string) => {
  if (new Set(list.map(x => x.id)).size !== list.length) fail(`Duplicate ${label} identifier.`);
};
/** Parse strictly on save/import. Cross references may be absent after an itinerary edit; caller supplies current IDs. */
export function validateFoodPlan(value: unknown, days: readonly string[], points: readonly Pick<FoodStop, 'id' | 'kind'>[]): FoodPlan {
  const root = obj(value);
  if (!root || !fields(root, ['foods','meals','resupplies','settings'])) throw new Error('Invalid food plan.');
  const settings = obj(root.settings);
  if (!settings || !fields(settings, Object.keys(DEFAULT_FOOD_SETTINGS))) throw new Error('Invalid fuel settings.');
  const ranges: Record<keyof Omit<FoodSettings,'countFuelInPack'>, [number,number]> = {
    startingFuelGrams: [0,50000], fuelGramsPerHeating: [0,1000], fuelAdjustment: [0.25,4],
    fuelReservePercent: [0,100], otherDailyUseGrams: [0,100000],
  };
  for (const [key,[lo,hi]] of Object.entries(ranges)) if (!finite(settings[key],lo,hi)) fail(`Invalid ${key}; allowed ${lo}–${hi}.`);
  if (typeof settings.countFuelInPack !== 'boolean') fail('Invalid fuel pack-weight flag.');
  const foods = requireArray(root.foods, 150, 'food inventory').map(row => {
    if (!fields(row,['id','name','gramsPerUnit','startingUnits','countInPack']) || !str(row.id,100) || !row.id ||
        !str(row.name,120) || !row.name.trim() || !(row.gramsPerUnit === null || finite(row.gramsPerUnit,0,100000)) ||
        !finite(row.startingUnits,0,10000) || typeof row.countInPack !== 'boolean') fail('Invalid food item.');
    return { id: row.id as string, name: (row.name as string).trim(), gramsPerUnit: row.gramsPerUnit as number | null,
      startingUnits: row.startingUnits as number, countInPack: row.countInPack as boolean };
  });
  unique(foods, 'food');
  const foodIds = new Set(foods.map(item => item.id));
  const dayIds = new Set(days);
  const meals = requireArray(root.meals, 3000, 'meal schedule').map(row => {
    if (!fields(row,['id','dayId','slot','foodId','units','heated']) || !str(row.id,100) || !row.id ||
      !str(row.dayId,200) || !dayIds.has(row.dayId) || !MEAL_SLOTS.includes(row.slot as MealSlot) ||
      !str(row.foodId,100) || !foodIds.has(row.foodId) || !finite(row.units,0.01,10000) || typeof row.heated !== 'boolean') fail('Invalid meal or removed itinerary day.');
    return row as unknown as PlannedMeal;
  });
  unique(meals, 'meal');
  const stops = new Set(points.filter(point => point.kind === 'resupply').map(point => point.id));
  const resupplies = requireArray(root.resupplies,200,'resupplies').map(row => {
    if (!fields(row,['id','waypointId','foodId','units','fuelGrams']) || !str(row.id,100) || !row.id ||
      !str(row.waypointId,200) || !stops.has(row.waypointId) ||
      !str(row.foodId,100) || (row.foodId !== '' && !foodIds.has(row.foodId)) ||
      !finite(row.units,0,10000) || !finite(row.fuelGrams,0,50000) ||
      (!row.foodId && row.units !== 0) || (row.units === 0 && row.fuelGrams === 0)) fail('Resupply must refer to an existing resupply waypoint and supply food or fuel.');
    return row as unknown as FoodResupply;
  });
  unique(resupplies,'resupply');
  return { foods, meals, resupplies, settings: settings as unknown as FoodSettings };
}
/** Non-throwing read for older saved builds. Invalid entries are ignored, never trusted. */
export function readFoodPlan(logistics: unknown): FoodPlan {
  const root = obj(logistics);
  const raw = root ? obj(root.phase7) : null;
  if (!raw) return emptyFoodPlan();
  // Read without day/route validation; model reports references that have become stale.
  // The saving server action performs strict validation against DB day/waypoint IDs.
  const foods = Array.isArray(raw.foods) ? raw.foods.slice(0,150).filter(obj).flatMap(x => {
    if (!str(x.id,100) || !x.id || !str(x.name,120) || !x.name.trim() ||
        !(x.gramsPerUnit === null || finite(x.gramsPerUnit,0,100000)) || !finite(x.startingUnits,0,10000) || typeof x.countInPack !== 'boolean') return [];
    return [{id:x.id, name:x.name, gramsPerUnit:x.gramsPerUnit, startingUnits:x.startingUnits, countInPack:x.countInPack} as FoodItem];
  }) : [];
  const validFoods = new Set(foods.map(f=>f.id));
  const meals = Array.isArray(raw.meals) ? raw.meals.slice(0,3000).filter(obj).flatMap(x =>
    str(x.id,100) && x.id && str(x.dayId,200) && str(x.foodId,100) && validFoods.has(x.foodId) && MEAL_SLOTS.includes(x.slot as MealSlot) && finite(x.units,0.01,10000) && typeof x.heated === 'boolean' ? [x as unknown as PlannedMeal] : []) : [];
  const resupplies = Array.isArray(raw.resupplies) ? raw.resupplies.slice(0,200).filter(obj).flatMap(x =>
    str(x.id,100) && x.id && str(x.waypointId,200) && str(x.foodId,100) && (!x.foodId || validFoods.has(x.foodId)) && finite(x.units,0,10000) && finite(x.fuelGrams,0,50000) ? [x as unknown as FoodResupply] : []) : [];
  const s = obj(raw.settings);
  const settings = { ...DEFAULT_FOOD_SETTINGS };
  if (s) {
    const limits: Record<string, [number,number]> = { startingFuelGrams:[0,50000],fuelGramsPerHeating:[0,1000],fuelAdjustment:[0.25,4],fuelReservePercent:[0,100],otherDailyUseGrams:[0,100000] };
    for (const [key,[lo,hi]] of Object.entries(limits)) if (finite(s[key],lo,hi)) (settings as unknown as Record<string,unknown>)[key] = s[key];
    if (typeof s.countFuelInPack === 'boolean') settings.countFuelInPack=s.countFuelInPack;
  }
  return {foods,meals,resupplies,settings};
}

export type FoodForecastDay = {
  dayId: string; day: number; foodAddedGrams: number; fuelAddedGrams: number;
  foodConsumedGrams: number; fuelConsumedGrams: number; foodStartGrams: number | null;
  foodEndGrams: number | null; fuelStartGrams: number; fuelEndGrams: number;
  packStartKnownGrams: number; packEndKnownGrams: number; unknownFoodWeights: boolean;
  shortfalls: { foodId: string; missingUnits: number }[]; fuelShortfallGrams: number;
  meals: number; heated: number;
};
export type FoodForecast = {
  days: FoodForecastDay[]; startingFoodKnownGrams: number; missingFoodWeights: boolean;
  initialCarriedKnownGrams: number; fuelNeededGrams: number; fuelTargetWithReserveGrams: number;
  totalFuelSuppliedGrams: number; orphanedResupplies: number; orphanedMeals: number;
};
/** All quantities are user-provided planning assumptions. Never imply adequate diet or fuel availability. */
export function projectFoodPlan(plan: FoodPlan, dayIds: readonly string[], route: readonly FoodStop[], baseGrams: number, builderConsumablesGrams: number): FoodForecast {
  const quantities = new Map(plan.foods.map(f=>[f.id,f.startingUnits]));
  const items = new Map(plan.foods.map(f=>[f.id,f]));
  const index = new Map(dayIds.map((id,i)=>[id,i]));
  const waypointDays = new Map(route.filter(p=>p.kind==='resupply').map(p=>[p.id,p.dayId]));
  const byDay = new Map<number,FoodResupply[]>();
  let orphanedResupplies=0;
  for (const r of plan.resupplies) {
    const day=index.get(waypointDays.get(r.waypointId) || '');
    if (day===undefined) {orphanedResupplies++;continue;}
    byDay.set(day,[...(byDay.get(day)||[]),r]);
  }
  const mealsByDay = new Map<number,PlannedMeal[]>();
  let orphanedMeals=0;
  for (const meal of plan.meals) {
    const day=index.get(meal.dayId);
    if (day===undefined) {orphanedMeals++;continue;}
    mealsByDay.set(day,[...(mealsByDay.get(day)||[]),meal]);
  }
  const included = plan.foods.filter(f=>f.countInPack);
  const missingFoodWeights = included.some(f=>f.gramsPerUnit===null && f.startingUnits>0) || plan.resupplies.some(r=>r.foodId && items.get(r.foodId)?.countInPack && items.get(r.foodId)?.gramsPerUnit===null);
  const foodMass = (): number => included.reduce((sum,f)=>sum+(quantities.get(f.id)||0)*(f.gramsPerUnit??0),0);
  const startingFoodKnownGrams = foodMass();
  let fuel=plan.settings.startingFuelGrams;
  let other=builderConsumablesGrams;
  const fuelUnit=plan.settings.fuelGramsPerHeating*plan.settings.fuelAdjustment;
  const fuelNeededGrams=plan.meals.filter(m=>m.heated && index.has(m.dayId)).length*fuelUnit;
  const totalFuelSuppliedGrams=plan.settings.startingFuelGrams+plan.resupplies.reduce((sum,r)=>sum+(index.has(waypointDays.get(r.waypointId)||'')?r.fuelGrams:0),0);
  const days:FoodForecastDay[]=[];
  for (let i=0;i<dayIds.length;i++) {
    let foodAddedGrams=0,fuelAddedGrams=0;
    for (const r of byDay.get(i)||[]) {
      if (r.foodId) {
        quantities.set(r.foodId,(quantities.get(r.foodId)||0)+r.units);
        const item=items.get(r.foodId);
        if (item?.countInPack) foodAddedGrams+=r.units*(item.gramsPerUnit??0);
      }
      fuel+=r.fuelGrams;fuelAddedGrams+=r.fuelGrams;
    }
    const foodStart=foodMass(),fuelStart=fuel;
    const packStartKnownGrams=baseGrams+other+foodStart+(plan.settings.countFuelInPack?fuel:0);
    let foodConsumedGrams=0,fuelConsumedGrams=0,fuelShortfallGrams=0;
    const shortfalls:{foodId:string;missingUnits:number}[]=[];
    const meals = mealsByDay.get(i)||[];
    for(const meal of meals) {
      const available=quantities.get(meal.foodId)||0;
      const eaten=Math.min(available,meal.units);
      quantities.set(meal.foodId,Math.max(0,available-eaten));
      if (eaten<meal.units) shortfalls.push({foodId:meal.foodId,missingUnits:Number((meal.units-eaten).toFixed(2))});
      const item=items.get(meal.foodId);
      if (item?.countInPack) foodConsumedGrams+=eaten*(item.gramsPerUnit??0);
      if (meal.heated) {
        const used=Math.min(fuel,fuelUnit);
        fuel-=used;fuelConsumedGrams+=used;
        fuelShortfallGrams+=fuelUnit-used;
      }
    }
    other=Math.max(0,other-plan.settings.otherDailyUseGrams);
    days.push({dayId:dayIds[i],day:i+1,foodAddedGrams,fuelAddedGrams,foodConsumedGrams,fuelConsumedGrams,
      foodStartGrams:missingFoodWeights?null:foodStart,foodEndGrams:missingFoodWeights?null:foodMass(),
      fuelStartGrams:fuelStart,fuelEndGrams:fuel,packStartKnownGrams,
      packEndKnownGrams:baseGrams+other+foodMass()+(plan.settings.countFuelInPack?fuel:0),
      unknownFoodWeights:missingFoodWeights,shortfalls,fuelShortfallGrams,meals:meals.length,heated:meals.filter(m=>m.heated).length});
  }
  return { days, startingFoodKnownGrams, missingFoodWeights, initialCarriedKnownGrams:baseGrams+builderConsumablesGrams+startingFoodKnownGrams+(plan.settings.countFuelInPack?plan.settings.startingFuelGrams:0),
    fuelNeededGrams,fuelTargetWithReserveGrams:fuelNeededGrams*(1+plan.settings.fuelReservePercent/100),totalFuelSuppliedGrams,orphanedResupplies,orphanedMeals };
}
```

### `lib/gear-comparison.ts`

```typescript
/** Pure comparison logic shared by the comparison page and its unit tests. */
export type CompareProduct = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  weight_g: number | null;
  price_cad: number | null;
  capacity_l: number | null;
  frame_type: string | null;
  waterproof: boolean | null;
  temperature_rating: number | null;
  season: string | null;
  material: string | null;
  brand: { name: string };
  category: { id: string; name: string; slug: string };
  subcategory: { name: string; slug: string } | null;
  specifications: Array<{ key: string; value: string; unit: string | null }>;
  prices: Array<{ price: number; currency: string; inStock: boolean }>;
  reviews: Array<{ rating: number }>;
};

export type ComparisonRow = {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  section: "Overview" | "Specifications";
  values: Array<string | null>;
  different: boolean;
  bestIndices: number[];
  bestLabel: string | null;
};

export function parseCompareIds(raw: string | string[] | undefined): string[] {
  const text = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw.join(",") : raw ?? "";
  if (text.length > 1000) return [];
  return [...new Set(text.split(",").map(v => v.trim()).filter(v => v.length > 0 && v.length <= 200))].slice(0, 4);
}

export function comparisonPrice(product: CompareProduct): number | null {
  const valid = product.prices.filter(p => p.currency === "CAD" && p.inStock && Number.isFinite(p.price) && p.price >= 0);
  return valid.length ? Math.min(...valid.map(p => p.price)) : product.price_cad;
}

const normalize = (value: string) => value.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[_-]+/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ");
const readable = (value: string) => value.replace(/[_-]+/g, " ").replace(/\b\w/g, m => m.toUpperCase());

const prioritize: Record<string, string[]> = {
  packs: ["volume", "torso length", "hip belt size", "max load", "recommended load", "dimensions", "back length"],
  shelter: ["sleeping capacity", "floor area", "packed size", "packed dimensions", "peak height", "freestanding", "hydrostatic head"],
  sleep: ["comfort rating", "limit rating", "r value", "r-value", "fill weight", "fill power", "packed size", "dimensions"],
  cooking: ["fuel type", "boil time", "burn time", "output", "pot volume"],
  water: ["filter pore size", "filter life", "flow rate", "capacity", "dimensions"],
};

export function getComparisonRows(products: CompareProduct[]): ComparisonRow[] {
  const rows: ComparisonRow[] = [];
  const text = (key: string, label: string, values: Array<string | null>, section: ComparisonRow["section"] = "Overview") => {
    const present = values.filter((v): v is string => v !== null);
    rows.push({ key, label, values, section, different: new Set(present).size > 1, bestIndices: [], bestLabel: null });
  };
  const numberRow = (key: string, label: string, raw: Array<number | null>, fmt: (n: number) => string, best: "min" | "max" | null = null) => {
    const clean = raw.map(n => n !== null && Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null);
    const values = clean.map(n => n === null ? null : fmt(n));
    const present = clean.filter((n): n is number => n !== null);
    const different = new Set(present).size > 1;
    const value = best && different ? (best === "min" ? Math.min(...present) : Math.max(...present)) : null;
    rows.push({ key, label, values, section: "Overview", different,
      bestIndices: value === null ? [] : clean.flatMap((n, index) => n === value ? [index] : []),
      bestLabel: value === null ? null : best === "min" ? "Lowest" : "Highest",
    });
  };
  text("brand", "Brand", products.map(p => p.brand.name));
  numberRow("price", "Price (CAD)", products.map(comparisonPrice), n => `$${n.toLocaleString("en-CA", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`, "min");
  numberRow("weight", "Weight", products.map(p => p.weight_g), n => n >= 1000 ? `${(n / 1000).toFixed(2)} kg` : `${n} g`, "min");
  numberRow("capacity", "Capacity", products.map(p => p.capacity_l), n => `${n} L`, "max");
  text("category", "Category", products.map(p => p.category.name));
  text("subcategory", "Type", products.map(p => p.subcategory?.name ?? null));
  text("frame", "Frame type", products.map(p => p.frame_type));
  text("waterproof", "Waterproof", products.map(p => p.waterproof === null ? null : p.waterproof ? "Yes" : "No"));
  numberRow("temperature", "Temperature rating", products.map(p => p.temperature_rating), n => `${n} °C`);
  text("season", "Season", products.map(p => p.season));
  text("material", "Material", products.map(p => p.material));
  text("rating", "User rating", products.map(p => {
    const ratings = p.reviews.filter(r => Number.isInteger(r.rating) && r.rating >= 1 && r.rating <= 5);
    return ratings.length ? `${(ratings.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.rating, 0) / ratings.length).toFixed(1)} / 5 (${ratings.length})` : null;
  }));

  const specs = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const p of products) for (const spec of p.specifications) {
    const key = normalize(spec.key);
    if (key && !specs.has(key)) specs.set(key, spec.key.trim() || readable(key));
  }
  const priority = prioritize[products[0]?.category.slug ?? ""] ?? [];
  const sorted = [...specs.keys()].sort((a, b) => {
    const ai = priority.indexOf(a), bi = priority.indexOf(b);
    return (ai < 0 ? 999 : ai) - (bi < 0 ? 999 : bi) || a.localeCompare(b);
  });
  for (const key of sorted) {
    const values = products.map(p => {
      const spec = p.specifications.find(s => normalize(s.key) === key);
      if (!spec || !spec.value.trim()) return null;
      return `${spec.value.trim()}${spec.unit?.trim() ? ` ${spec.unit.trim()}` : ""}`;
    });
    if (values.some(v => v !== null)) text(`spec:${key}`, specs.get(key)!, values, "Specifications");
  }
  return rows;
}
```

### `lib/gear-display.ts`

```typescript
export function safeGearUrl(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!value) return null;
  if (value.startsWith("/") && !value.startsWith("//")) return value;
  try { const url = new URL(value); return ["https:", "http:"].includes(url.protocol) ? url.href : null; } catch { return null; }
}

export function gearMoney(value: number | null | undefined, currency = "CAD") {
  if (value == null || !Number.isFinite(value)) return "Price unavailable";
  try { return `${new Intl.NumberFormat("en-CA", { style: "currency", currency }).format(value)} ${currency}`; }
  catch { return `${value.toFixed(2)} ${currency}`; }
}

export function gearWeight(value: number | null | undefined) {
  return value == null ? "Weight unavailable" : value >= 1000 ? `${(value / 1000).toFixed(2)} kg` : `${value} g`;
}

export function reviewStats(reviews: Array<{ rating: number }>) {
  const valid = reviews.filter(review => Number.isInteger(review.rating) && review.rating >= 1 && review.rating <= 5);
  const count = valid.length;
  return { count, average: count ? valid.reduce((sum, review) => sum + review.rating, 0) / count : 0, buckets: [5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map(rating => ({ rating, count: valid.filter(review => review.rating === rating).length })) };
}
```

```typescript
"use server";

import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import { requireBuildAccess, setCurrentBuild } from "@/lib/build-access";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

export async function openGearSelection(buildId: string, category: string) {
  const access = await requireBuildAccess(buildId);
  const type = await prisma.category.findUnique({
    where: { slug: category.toLowerCase() }, select: { slug: true },
  });
  if (!type) throw new Error("Category not found.");
  await setCurrentBuild(access.id);
  redirect(`/gear/${encodeURIComponent(type.slug)}`);
}
```

### `lib/gpx-route.ts`

```typescript
/** GPX 1.1 track interchange for TrailPicker. Browser DOMParser is used only when importing. */
import { metersBetween, simplifyTrailIndices, usableTrailSegment, validElevation, validLatLng, type LatLng, type TrailSegment } from "./trail-routing";
import type { Waypoint } from "./trip-planner";

export const GPX_MAX_BYTES = 4_000_000;
const MAX_TRACK_POINTS = 50_000;
const MAX_SEGMENTS = 199; // contiguous route links can share endpoints; route save limits 200 stops
const GPX_NS = "http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1";
const GPX_10_NS = "http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/0";
const TP_NS = "https://trailpicker.app/ns/gpx/1";

type TrackPoint = { coord: LatLng; height: number | null };
function children(node: Element): Element[] {
  return Array.from(node.childNodes).filter((child): child is Element => child.nodeType === 1);
}
export type GpxImport = { points: Waypoint[]; trackPoints: number; segments: number; distanceM: number; hasCompleteElevation: boolean; approximateSegments: number };
const esc = (s: string) => s.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&apos;");
const fix = (number: number, digits: number) => Number(number.toFixed(digits)).toString();
function newWaypoint(point: TrackPoint, name: string, dayId: string | null): Waypoint {
  return { id: crypto.randomUUID(), name: name.slice(0, 200), kind: "waypoint", lat: point.coord[0], lng: point.coord[1], elevationM: point.height, ...(dayId ? { dayId } : {}) };
}
function gainLoss(points: TrackPoint[]): { ascentM: number; descentM: number } {
  // Dead band reduces spurious climb from GPX GPS/barometric measurement noise.
  let ascentM = 0, descentM = 0, anchor = points[0].height!;
  for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
    const elevation = points[i].height!;
    const delta = elevation - anchor;
    if (Math.abs(delta) >= 3) {
      if (delta > 0) ascentM += delta;
      else descentM -= delta;
      anchor = elevation;
    }
  }
  return { ascentM: Math.round(ascentM), descentM: Math.round(descentM) };
}

/** Call in the browser. Refuses multi-track ambiguity, invalid XML, oversized tracks and unknown coordinates. */
export function importGpx(xml: string, dayId: string | null = null): GpxImport {
  if (typeof xml !== "string" || new Blob([xml]).size > GPX_MAX_BYTES) throw new Error("The GPX file must be 4 MB or smaller.");
  if (/<!\s*(?:DOCTYPE|ENTITY)/i.test(xml)) throw new Error("GPX files with document declarations or entities are not supported.");
  if (typeof DOMParser === "undefined") throw new Error("GPX import requires a browser.");
  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(xml, "application/xml");
  const errors = doc.getElementsByTagName("parsererror");
  if (errors.length || doc.documentElement.localName !== "gpx" || ![GPX_NS, GPX_10_NS, ""].includes(doc.documentElement.namespaceURI ?? "")) {
    throw new Error("This is not a valid GPX 1.0 or 1.1 document.");
  }
  const segments = Array.from(doc.getElementsByTagNameNS("*", "trkseg"));
  if (!segments.length) {
    // Route files use rte/rtept rather than trk/trkseg.
    const rte = Array.from(doc.getElementsByTagNameNS("*", "rte"));
    if (rte.length !== 1) throw new Error("Import a GPX with one track or route. Waypoint-only GPX files cannot become routes.");
    segments.push(rte[0]);
  }
  if (segments.length > MAX_SEGMENTS) throw new Error(`GPX has too many track segments (maximum ${MAX_SEGMENTS}).`);
  // Match standard GPX waypoints back to trail stops, preserving labels on round trip.
  const named = Array.from(doc.getElementsByTagNameNS("*", "wpt")).slice(0, 200).map(node => {
    const lat = Number(node.getAttribute("lat")), lng = Number(node.getAttribute("lon"));
    const name = children(node).find(el => el.localName === "name")?.textContent?.trim().slice(0, 200) ?? "";
    return validLatLng([lat, lng]) && name ? { coord: [lat, lng] as LatLng, name } : null;
  }).filter((item): item is { coord: LatLng; name: string } => item !== null);
  const namedWaypoint = (point: TrackPoint, fallback: string) => {
    const label = named.find(candidate => metersBetween(candidate.coord, point.coord) <= 1)?.name ?? fallback;
    return newWaypoint(point, label, dayId);
  };
  const result: Waypoint[] = [];
  let trackPoints = 0, distanceM = 0, approximateSegments = 0;
  let hasCompleteElevation = true;
  for (const [index, segment] of segments.entries()) {
    const elements = children(segment).filter(n => n.localName === "trkpt" || n.localName === "rtept");
    trackPoints += elements.length;
    if (trackPoints > MAX_TRACK_POINTS) throw new Error("GPX has more than 50,000 track points.");
    if (elements.length < 2) throw new Error(`GPX segment ${index + 1} has fewer than two track points.`);
    const coordinates: TrackPoint[] = elements.map(node => {
      const lat = Number(node.getAttribute("lat")), lng = Number(node.getAttribute("lon"));
      if (!node.hasAttribute("lat") || !node.hasAttribute("lon") || !validLatLng([lat, lng])) throw new Error("GPX contains invalid latitude or longitude.");
      const elevation = children(node).find(el => el.localName === "ele")?.textContent?.trim();
      const height = elevation != null && elevation !== "" ? Number(elevation) : null;
      if (height !== null && !validElevation(height)) throw new Error("GPX contains an invalid elevation sample.");
      return { coord: [Number(lat.toFixed(6)), Number(lng.toFixed(6))], height };
    });
    const approximate = Array.from(segment.getElementsByTagNameNS(TP_NS, "approximate")).some(el => el.textContent?.trim() === "true");
    const completeElevation = !approximate && coordinates.every(p => p.height !== null);
    if (!completeElevation) hasCompleteElevation = false;
    const first = coordinates[0], last = coordinates[coordinates.length - 1];
    const previous = result[result.length - 1];
    if (!previous || metersBetween([previous.lat, previous.lng], first.coord) > 1) {
      if (previous) previous.manualToNext = true; // Explicit gap; never bridge separate GPX segments as trail.
      result.push(namedWaypoint(first, index === 0 ? "GPX trailhead" : `Segment ${index + 1} start`));
    }
    let segmentDistance = 0;
    for (let i = 1; i < coordinates.length; i++) segmentDistance += metersBetween(coordinates[i - 1].coord, coordinates[i].coord);
    if (segmentDistance <= 0 || segmentDistance > 1_000_000) throw new Error("GPX has a zero-length or oversized route segment.");
    distanceM += segmentDistance;
    if (approximate) { approximateSegments++; result[result.length - 1].manualToNext = true; }
    else {
      const indexes = simplifyTrailIndices(coordinates.map(p => p.coord), 400, completeElevation ? coordinates.map(p => p.height!) : undefined);
      const segmentData: Omit<TrailSegment, "toId"> = {
        source: "gpx", geometry: indexes.map(i => coordinates[i].coord), distanceM: Math.round(segmentDistance * 10) / 10,
        ...(completeElevation ? { elevationsM: indexes.map(i => coordinates[i].height!), ...gainLoss(coordinates) } : {}),
      };
      result[result.length - 1].trailToNext = { ...segmentData, toId: "pending" };
    }
    const end = namedWaypoint(last, index === segments.length - 1 ? "GPX finish" : `Segment ${index + 1} end`);
    result.push(end);
    if (!approximate) result[result.length - 2].trailToNext!.toId = end.id;
    if (result.length > 200) throw new Error("GPX route exceeds the 200-stop limit.");
  }
  return { points: result, trackPoints, segments: segments.length, distanceM, hasCompleteElevation, approximateSegments };
}

/** Portable GPX track. Unmapped connections are marked with an extension instead of pretending they are verified trails. */
export function exportGpx(points: readonly Waypoint[], name = "TrailPicker route"): string {
  const lines = [`<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>`, `<gpx version="1.1" creator="TrailPicker" xmlns="${GPX_NS}" xmlns:tp="${TP_NS}">`, `<metadata><name>${esc(name)}</name></metadata>`];
  for (const point of points) {
    if (!validLatLng([point.lat, point.lng])) continue;
    lines.push(`<wpt lat="${fix(point.lat, 6)}" lon="${fix(point.lng, 6)}">${point.elevationM != null && validElevation(point.elevationM) ? `<ele>${fix(point.elevationM, 1)}</ele>` : ""}<name>${esc(point.name)}</name></wpt>`);
  }
  lines.push(`<trk><name>${esc(name)}</name>`);
  for (let i = 0; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
    const from = points[i], to = points[i + 1];
    const route = from.manualToNext ? null : usableTrailSegment(from, to);
    const coordinates = route?.geometry ?? [[from.lat, from.lng], [to.lat, to.lng]] as LatLng[];
    const heights = route?.elevationsM;
    lines.push("<trkseg>");
    for (const [index, coord] of coordinates.entries()) {
      lines.push(`<trkpt lat="${fix(coord[0], 6)}" lon="${fix(coord[1], 6)}">${heights && validElevation(heights[index]) ? `<ele>${fix(heights[index], 1)}</ele>` : ""}</trkpt>`);
    }
    if (!route) lines.push("<extensions><tp:approximate>true</tp:approximate></extensions>");
    lines.push("</trkseg>");
  }
  lines.push("</trk></gpx>");
  return lines.join("\n");
}

```

### `lib/guest-build-token.ts`

```typescript
import { createHmac, randomBytes, timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto";

export const GUEST_BUILD_MAX_AGE = 60 * 60 * 24 * 30;

function secret() {
  const value = process.env.AUTH_SECRET;
  if (!value) throw new Error("AUTH_SECRET is required for guest build access.");
  return value;
}

export function guestBuildCookieName(buildId: string) {
  // Hash IDs so cookie names contain only safe characters and have bounded length.
  return `guestBuild_${createHmac("sha256", secret()).update(buildId).digest("hex").slice(0, 32)}`;
}

function signature(buildId: string, payload: string) {
  return createHmac("sha256", secret())
    .update(JSON.stringify(["trailpicker-guest-build-v1", buildId, payload]))
    .digest("base64url");
}

export function createGuestBuildToken(buildId: string, now = Date.now()) {
  const payload = `${Math.floor(now / 1000) + GUEST_BUILD_MAX_AGE}:${randomBytes(32).toString("base64url")}`;
  return `${payload}.${signature(buildId, payload)}`;
}

export function verifyGuestBuildToken(buildId: string, token: string | undefined, now = Date.now()) {
  if (!token || token.length > 200) return false;
  const match = /^(\d+):([A-Za-z0-9_-]{43})\.([A-Za-z0-9_-]{43})$/.exec(token);
  if (!match) return false;
  const expiry = Number(match[1]);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(expiry) || expiry <= Math.floor(now / 1000)) return false;
  const actual = Buffer.from(match[3]);
  const expected = Buffer.from(signature(buildId, `${match[1]}:${match[2]}`));
  return actual.length === expected.length && timingSafeEqual(actual, expected);
}
```

### `lib/hiking-time.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * Trail walking time estimation. Only actual sampled elevation is used to infer
 * direction-specific slope: no slope is fabricated over sparse/unknown gaps.
 *
 * Tobler (1993): v = 6 exp(-3.5 |gradient + 0.05|) km/h.
 * We scale the speed to an independently selected level-trail pace, using
 * Tobler's level-ground speed as the normalization factor. No separate
 * ascent allowance is added to slope-based time (avoids double counting).
 *
 * With inadequate elevation resolution, fall back to the transparent
 * distance/pace + ascent/600m/h rule (modified Naismith). That is not a
 * certified walking time. Breaks and schedule reserve are *never* included.
 */
export type HeightPoint = { distanceM: number; elevationM: number };
export type WalkingMethod = "terrain" | "mixed" | "naismith";
export type WalkingTime = { minutes: number; method: WalkingMethod; slopeDistanceM: number; unprofiledDistanceM: number };
const CELL_M = 200;
const MAX_GAP_M = 400;
const MIN_CELL_M = 80;
const LEVEL_SPEED_KMH = 6 * Math.exp(-3.5 * Math.abs(0.05));
export function toblerKmh(slope: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(slope)) throw new RangeError("Slope must be finite.");
  return 6 * Math.exp(-3.5 * Math.abs(Math.max(-0.5, Math.min(0.5, slope)) + 0.05));
}
/** Flat-trail pace in km/h, with slope slowing or accelerating the segment. */
export function gradeAdjustedSpeedKmh(gradient: number, levelPaceKmh: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(levelPaceKmh) || levelPaceKmh < 1 || levelPaceKmh > 8) throw new RangeError("Level-trail pace must be 1–8 km/h.");
  return Math.max(0.45, levelPaceKmh * toblerKmh(gradient) / LEVEL_SPEED_KMH);
}
/** Naismith reference, using the historical 5 km/h + 600 m ascent per hour. */
export function classicNaismithMinutes(distanceM: number, ascentM: number): number {
  return Math.round(60 * (distanceM / 5000 + Math.max(0, ascentM) / 600));
}
/** 2025 SAC reference: 4 km/h plus 400m/h ascending and 800m/h descending. */
export function sacReferenceMinutes(distanceM: number, ascentM: number, descentM: number): number {
  return Math.round(60 * (distanceM / 4000 + Math.max(0, ascentM) / 400 + Math.max(0, descentM) / 800));
}
/** Naismith-style fallback, scaled ONLY on horizontal speed; not a terrain model. */
export function fallbackMinutes(distanceM: number, ascentM: number, paceKmh: number): number {
  return 60 * (Math.max(0, distanceM) / 1000 / paceKmh + Math.max(0, ascentM) / 600);
}
function interpolate(samples: readonly HeightPoint[], position: number) {
  let low = 0, high = samples.length - 1;
  while (low < high) {
    const mid = (low + high) >>> 1;
    if (samples[mid].distanceM < position) low = mid + 1; else high = mid;
  }
  if (low === 0) return samples[0].elevationM;
  const a = samples[low - 1], c = samples[low];
  const ratio = (position - a.distanceM) / (c.distanceM - a.distanceM);
  return a.elevationM + (c.elevationM - a.elevationM) * ratio;
}
/** Analyze a mapped leg. Missing sample areas retain fallback time, not invented slopes. */
export function estimateWalkingTime(
  distanceM: number, ascentM: number, paceKmh: number,
  samples: readonly HeightPoint[] | null | undefined,
): WalkingTime {
  if (!Number.isFinite(distanceM) || distanceM < 0 || !Number.isFinite(ascentM) || ascentM < 0)
    throw new RangeError("Distance and ascent must be nonnegative finite numbers.");
  // Also validates pace on empty legs.
  gradeAdjustedSpeedKmh(0, paceKmh);
  if (!samples || samples.length < 2 || distanceM === 0) return {
    minutes: Math.round(fallbackMinutes(distanceM, ascentM, paceKmh)),
    method: "naismith", slopeDistanceM: 0, unprofiledDistanceM: distanceM,
  };
  let slopeDistanceM = 0, slopeMinutes = 0;
  let runStart = 0;
  const addRun = (end: number) => {
    const run = samples.slice(runStart, end + 1);
    if (run.length < 2) return;
    let position = run[0].distanceM;
    const stop = run[run.length - 1].distanceM;
    while (stop - position >= MIN_CELL_M) {
      const next = Math.min(stop, position + CELL_M);
      if (next - position < MIN_CELL_M) break;
      const grade = (interpolate(run, next) - interpolate(run, position)) / (next - position);
      slopeMinutes += 60 * ((next - position) / 1000) / gradeAdjustedSpeedKmh(grade, paceKmh);
      slopeDistanceM += next - position;
      position = next;
    }
  };
  for (let i = 1; i < samples.length; i++) {
    const a = samples[i - 1], c = samples[i];
    const width = c.distanceM - a.distanceM;
    const valid = width > 0 && width <= MAX_GAP_M &&
      Number.isFinite(a.distanceM) && Number.isFinite(c.distanceM) &&
      Number.isFinite(a.elevationM) && Number.isFinite(c.elevationM) &&
      a.elevationM > -500 && a.elevationM < 9000 && c.elevationM > -500 && c.elevationM < 9000;
    if (!valid) { addRun(i - 1); runStart = i; }
  }
  addRun(samples.length - 1);
  const coverage = Math.min(distanceM, slopeDistanceM);
  // Sparse vertices are not an excuse to pretend we know every hill.
  // If less than half a leg has meaningful slopes, prefer the explicit fallback.
  if (coverage < distanceM * 0.5) return {
    minutes: Math.round(fallbackMinutes(distanceM, ascentM, paceKmh)),
    method: "naismith", slopeDistanceM: 0, unprofiledDistanceM: distanceM,
  };
  // For small sample gaps, use the level-ground fallback without adding a second
  // climbing penalty to slopes we've already modelled. Unknown gaps remain flagged.
  const unknownM = Math.max(0, distanceM - coverage);
  const unknownMinutes = 60 * unknownM / 1000 / paceKmh;
  return {
    minutes: Math.round(slopeMinutes + unknownMinutes),
    method: unknownM > distanceM * 0.02 ? "mixed" : "terrain",
    slopeDistanceM: coverage,
    unprofiledDistanceM: unknownM,
  };
}
```

### `lib/itinerary-links.ts`

```typescript
import { readWaypoints, type Waypoint } from "./trip-planner";
import { routeForSave } from "./waypoint-map";

export type DayLink = { id?: string | null; date: Date | string };

function dateKey(value: Date | string): string {
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(date.getTime())) throw new Error("An itinerary day has an invalid date.");
  return date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

// Strict validation at the import/restore boundary: never silently filter bad stops.
export function validatedRoute(value: unknown): Waypoint[] | null {
  if (value == null) return null;
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) throw new Error("The imported route must be a list of stops.");
  const points = readWaypoints(value);
  if (points.length !== value.length) throw new Error("The route contains an invalid waypoint. Nothing was imported.");
  try {
    return routeForSave(points);
  } catch (cause) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid waypoint: ${cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Check the route."}`);
  }
}

export function remapRouteDays(
  points: Waypoint[] | null,
  sourceDays: DayLink[],
  targetDays: DayLink[],
): { points: Waypoint[] | null; unassignedCount: number } {
  if (!points) return { points: null, unassignedCount: 0 };
  const sourceDateById = new Map(sourceDays.filter((day) => day.id).map((day) => [day.id!, dateKey(day.date)]));
  const targetIdByDate = new Map(targetDays.filter((day) => day.id).map((day) => [dateKey(day.date), day.id!]));
  let unassignedCount = 0;
  const updated = points.map((point) => {
    if (!point.dayId) return point;
    const date = sourceDateById.get(point.dayId);
    const mappedId = date ? targetIdByDate.get(date) : undefined;
    if (!mappedId) {
      unassignedCount++;
      return { ...point, dayId: null };
    }
    return { ...point, dayId: mappedId };
  });
  return { points: updated, unassignedCount };
}
```

### `lib/itinerary-timing.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * Itinerary timing uses the same routed-leg walking model as Route Analysis.
 * User stop times are immutable commitments, never silently replaced by ETAs.
 * A missing or unverified trail leg breaks the ETA chain instead of becoming a
 * fictitious straight-line hike. No forecast service or persistent time cache.
 */
import tzlookup from "tz-lookup";
import type { PlannerDay, Waypoint } from "./trip-planner";
import { computeRouteMetrics } from "./route-metrics";
import { consolidateOvernightStops, inheritedOvernightForDay, type OvernightDay } from "./overnight-handoffs";
import { approximateDaylight, clockLabel, estimateBreaks, parseClock, type BreakSettings, type DaylightResult } from "./route-analysis-insights";

export type StopTiming = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  scheduledMinutes: number | null;
  /** Calculated clock-time arrival, not a guarantee. Can exceed 1440 at night. */
  arrivalMinutes: number | null;
  /** Predicted arrival before any waiting, even if the user set a later time. */
  delayMinutes: number;
  /** Minutes to walk from the previous stop, when routed. */
  legMinutes: number | null;
  approximate: boolean;
  missingLeg: boolean;
};
export type DayItineraryTiming = {
  dayId: string;
  stops: StopTiming[];
  solar: DaylightResult | null;
  totalMovingMinutes: number | null;
  totalBreakMinutes: number | null;
  hasStartTime: boolean;
};
export type ItineraryTimingIssue = {
  id: string;
  dayId: string;
  stopId: string;
  category: "schedule" | "daylight";
  severity: "warning" | "info";
  title: string;
  message: string;
  /** Brief version shown beside the stop; full message stays in Compatibility. */
  inlineMessage?: string;
  action: string;
};

/** Small ETA differences are expected on trails and should not create alerts. */
export const ITINERARY_SCHEDULE_TOLERANCE_MINUTES = 15;
/** Larger delays deserve an actual warning rather than a mild advisory. */
export const ITINERARY_SCHEDULE_WARNING_MINUTES = 30;

export const ITINERARY_DEFAULT_BREAKS: BreakSettings = {
  style: "minimal", customMinutesPerHour: 10, lunchMinutes: 0, lunchThresholdMinutes: 240,
};

export function routeDaylight(day: Pick<PlannerDay,"date">, point: Pick<Waypoint,"lat"|"lng"> | undefined): DaylightResult | null {
  if (!point || !Number.isFinite(point.lat) || !Number.isFinite(point.lng)) return null;
  try {
    const zone = tzlookup(point.lat, point.lng);
    return approximateDaylight(day.date, point.lat, point.lng, zone);
  } catch { return null; }
}

/**
 * Stop times are saved as HH:mm, without a day offset. Preserve their local
 * clock value, but interpret an early-morning stop after a late-night ETA as
 * the following day (and a late-evening stop before a just-after-midnight ETA
 * as the previous day). Otherwise keep the itinerary day's clock date so a
 * genuinely too-early commitment still produces a schedule warning.
 */
function scheduledOnTimeline(clockMinutes: number | null, referenceMinutes: number | null): number | null {
  if (clockMinutes === null || referenceMinutes === null) return clockMinutes;
  const dayOffset = Math.floor(referenceMinutes / 1440);
  const localReference = referenceMinutes - dayOffset * 1440;
  const scheduled = clockMinutes + dayOffset * 1440;
  if (localReference >= 18 * 60 && clockMinutes < 6 * 60) return scheduled + 1440;
  if (dayOffset > 0 && localReference < 6 * 60 && clockMinutes >= 18 * 60) return scheduled - 1440;
  return scheduled;
}

/**
 * Each day starts at its earliest stop in saved route order. Times at subsequent
 * stops re-anchor the prediction only if an ETA was unavailable; otherwise a
 * later commitment introduces waiting time, and an earlier one becomes a warning.
 * Stop durations are applied after arrival, not added to the arrival itself.
 */
export function calculateDayItinerary(
  allPoints: readonly Waypoint[], day: Pick<PlannerDay,"id"|"date">,
  paceKmh = 4, breaks: BreakSettings = ITINERARY_DEFAULT_BREAKS,
  days: readonly OvernightDay[] = [],
): DayItineraryTiming {
  const canonical = consolidateOvernightStops(allPoints, days).points;
  const inherited = inheritedOvernightForDay(canonical, days, day.id);
  const ownStops = canonical.filter(point=>point.dayId===day.id);
  const stops = inherited ? [{...inherited.point, dayId:day.id, time:inherited.point.nextDayDepartureTime??null,
    note:inherited.point.nextDayDepartureNote??null, stayMinutes:0}, ...ownStops] : ownStops;
  const positions = new Map(canonical.map((point,index) => [point.id,index]));
  const legApproximate: boolean[] = stops.map(() => false);
  const legMinutes: (number|null)[] = stops.map((point, index) => {
    if (index === 0) return null;
    const prev = stops[index - 1];
    if (positions.get(point.id) !== (positions.get(prev.id) ?? -2) + 1) return null;
    const metrics = computeRouteMetrics([prev,point],[],paceKmh);
    // A snapped trail is required. Missing elevation gives an explicitly rough
    // distance-based approximation; completely unmapped legs never get an ETA.
    if (metrics.routedSegments !== 1) return null;
    // The route model can estimate distance-only segments, but without an
    // elevation profile that value is approximate rather than terrain-adjusted.
    legApproximate[index] = metrics.estimatedMinutes === null;
    return metrics.routedEstimateMinutes;
  });
  const fullyMapped = stops.length > 1 && legMinutes.slice(1).every(minutes => minutes !== null);
  const moving = fullyMapped ? legMinutes.slice(1).reduce<number>((sum,n)=>sum+(n??0),0) : null;
  const allBreaks = estimateBreaks(moving,breaks);
  // Distribute breaks by cumulative walking progress to avoid charging a full
  // rounded break for every short leg. Lunch appears once around mid-route.
  const legBreaks = legMinutes.map(() => 0);
  if (moving !== null && allBreaks !== null && moving > 0) {
    let cumulative = 0;
    let priorShort = 0;
    let lunchAdded = false;
    for (let i=1; i<legMinutes.length; i++) {
      cumulative += legMinutes[i] ?? 0;
      const cumulativeShort = Math.round(allBreaks.shortMinutes * cumulative / moving);
      legBreaks[i] = cumulativeShort - priorShort;
      priorShort = cumulativeShort;
      if (!lunchAdded && cumulative >= moving/2) {
        legBreaks[i] += allBreaks.lunchMinutes;
        lunchAdded = true;
      }
    }
  } else {
    // For partial routes, account for short rests on known legs without
    // claiming a full-day break estimate or adding an unsupported lunch.
    for (let i=1; i<legMinutes.length; i++) {
      if (legMinutes[i] !== null) legBreaks[i] = estimateBreaks(legMinutes[i], { ...breaks, lunchMinutes: 0 })?.shortMinutes ?? 0;
    }
  }

  let previousLeave: number|null = null;
  const calculated: StopTiming[] = stops.map((stop,index) => {
    const clock = parseClock(stop.time);
    const leg = legMinutes[index];
    let arrival: number|null = null;
    if (index === 0) arrival = clock;
    else if (leg !== null && previousLeave !== null) arrival = previousLeave + leg + legBreaks[index];
    // Infer the calendar day only for midnight rollover. A scheduled time
    // never changes the independently calculated arrival at this stop.
    const scheduled = index === 0 ? clock : scheduledOnTimeline(clock, arrival ?? previousLeave);
    const lateBy = arrival !== null && scheduled !== null ? Math.max(0,arrival-scheduled) : 0;
    const timeForContinuing = arrival === null ? scheduled : scheduled === null ? arrival : Math.max(arrival,scheduled);
    // The first stop time is a departure, so a stay duration there would
    // double-count time already spent before leaving the trailhead.
    previousLeave = timeForContinuing === null ? null : timeForContinuing + (index === 0 ? 0 : (stop.stayMinutes ?? 0));
    const approximate = leg !== null && legApproximate[index];
    return {id:stop.id,name:stop.name,scheduledMinutes:scheduled,arrivalMinutes:arrival,
      delayMinutes:lateBy, legMinutes:leg, approximate, missingLeg:index>0 && leg===null};
  });
  return {
    dayId:day.id, stops:calculated, solar:routeDaylight(day,stops[0]),
    totalMovingMinutes:moving, totalBreakMinutes:allBreaks?.totalMinutes ?? null,
    hasStartTime:stops.length>0 && parseClock(stops[0].time)!==null,
  };
}

export function itineraryTimingIssues(day: DayItineraryTiming, label: string): ItineraryTimingIssue[] {
  const issues:ItineraryTimingIssue[]=[];
  for (const stop of day.stops) {
    const delay = Math.round(stop.delayMinutes);
    if (delay <= ITINERARY_SCHEDULE_TOLERANCE_MINUTES) continue;
    const significant = delay > ITINERARY_SCHEDULE_WARNING_MINUTES;
    issues.push({
      id:`itinerary-late-${day.dayId}-${stop.id}`,dayId:day.dayId,stopId:stop.id,
      category:"schedule",severity:significant?"warning":"info",
      title:significant?"Scheduled arrival may be too early":"Tight arrival schedule",
      message:`${label}: ${stop.name} · Scheduled ${clockLabel(stop.scheduledMinutes!)} · Est. ${clockLabel(stop.arrivalMinutes!)} (${delay} min later)`,
      inlineMessage:`Scheduled ${clockLabel(stop.scheduledMinutes!)} · Est. ${clockLabel(stop.arrivalMinutes!)} (${delay} min later)`,
      action:"Allow more hiking time, change the departure time, or revise this stop's schedule.",
    });
  }
  const first=day.stops[0], solar=day.solar;
  if (first && first.scheduledMinutes!==null && solar?.sunriseMinutes!==null && solar?.sunriseMinutes!==undefined && first.scheduledMinutes < solar.sunriseMinutes) {
    issues.push({id:`itinerary-sunrise-${day.dayId}`,dayId:day.dayId,stopId:first.id,category:"daylight",severity:"info",title:"Departure before sunrise",
      message:`${label}: scheduled departure is before approximate sunrise (${clockLabel(solar.sunriseMinutes)}).`,
      action:"Plan for darkness if departing before sunrise; verify local conditions.",});
  }
  // A single meaningful daylight finding per day avoids an alert for every
  // subsequent stop after sunset. Only a calculated arrival can trigger it.
  if (solar?.sunsetMinutes!==null && solar?.sunsetMinutes!==undefined) {
    const sunset=solar.sunsetMinutes;
    const late=day.stops.find((stop,index)=>index>0 && stop.arrivalMinutes!==null && stop.arrivalMinutes>sunset);
    if (late) issues.push({id:`itinerary-sunset-${day.dayId}`,dayId:day.dayId,stopId:late.id,category:"daylight",severity:"warning",title:"Arrival after sunset",
      message:`${label}: ${late.name} · Est. ${clockLabel(late.arrivalMinutes!)} · Sunset ${clockLabel(sunset)}`,
      inlineMessage:`Est. ${clockLabel(late.arrivalMinutes!)} · Sunset ${clockLabel(sunset)}`,
      action:"Consider an earlier departure, more time, or a shorter route. Sunset varies with terrain and weather.",});
    else {
      const last=day.stops.at(-1);
      if (last && last.arrivalMinutes!==null && last.arrivalMinutes>=sunset-45) issues.push({
        id:`itinerary-daylight-tight-${day.dayId}`,dayId:day.dayId,stopId:last.id,category:"daylight",severity:"info",title:"Limited daylight margin",
        message:`${label}: estimated finish leaves about ${Math.max(0,Math.round(sunset-last.arrivalMinutes))} minutes before approximate sunset.`,
        action:"Consider an earlier departure or additional time for unexpected delays.",
      });
    }
  }
  return issues;
}

export function analyzeItineraryTimings(
  allPoints: readonly Waypoint[], days: readonly Pick<PlannerDay,"id"|"date">[],
  paceKmh=4, breaks:BreakSettings=ITINERARY_DEFAULT_BREAKS,
) {
  const ordered=[...days].sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.date).getTime()-new Date(b.date).getTime());
  const schedule=ordered.map(day=>calculateDayItinerary(allPoints,day,paceKmh,breaks,ordered));
  const issues=schedule.flatMap((day,index)=>itineraryTimingIssues(day,`Day ${index+1}`));
  return {days:schedule,issues};
}
```

### `lib/ors-request-control.ts`

```typescript
/** Small process-local safeguards for the shared ORS allowance.
 * No API credentials, build IDs or user data are persisted to disk.
 */
import type { LatLng } from "./trail-routing";

export type OrsKind = "route" | "snap";

/** ~11 cm coordinate precision; preserves direction and all shaping points. */
export function orsCoordinateKey(kind: OrsKind, points: readonly LatLng[]): string {
  return `${kind}:${points.map(([lat, lng]) => `${lat.toFixed(6)},${lng.toFixed(6)}`).join(";")}`;
}

export function retryAfterSeconds(header: string | null, now = Date.now(), fallback = 90): number {
  if (!header) return fallback;
  const seconds = /^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(header.trim())
    ? Number(header)
    : (Date.parse(header) - now) / 1000;
  return Number.isFinite(seconds) && seconds > 0 ? Math.min(3600, Math.max(1, Math.ceil(seconds))) : fallback;
}

export class OrsCooldownError extends Error {
  constructor(public retryAfterSeconds: number) {
    super("Trail routing rate limit reached. Try again later.");
  }
}
export class OrsQueueFullError extends Error {
  constructor() { super("Trail routing is busy. Retry in a moment."); }
}

/** One provider request at a time per server process, with a safe minimum interval. */
export function createOrsTrafficController({
  intervalMs = 1600,
  queueLimit = 12,
  now = () => Date.now(),
  sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise<void>(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms)),
} = {}) {
  let tail: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
  let queued = 0;
  let nextStartAt = 0;
  let blockedUntil = 0;
  return {
    cooldown(seconds: number) {
      if (Number.isFinite(seconds) && seconds > 0) blockedUntil = Math.max(blockedUntil, now() + Math.min(3600, seconds) * 1000);
    },
    remainingCooldownSeconds() { return Math.max(0, Math.ceil((blockedUntil - now()) / 1000)); },
    async schedule<T>(job: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
      if (queued >= queueLimit) throw new OrsQueueFullError();
      queued++;
      const previous = tail;
      let release!: () => void;
      tail = new Promise<void>(resolve => { release = resolve; });
      await previous;
      try {
        const remaining = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((blockedUntil - now()) / 1000));
        if (remaining) throw new OrsCooldownError(remaining);
        const delay = Math.max(0, nextStartAt - now());
        if (delay) await sleep(delay);
        const afterWait = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((blockedUntil - now()) / 1000));
        if (afterWait) throw new OrsCooldownError(afterWait);
        nextStartAt = now() + intervalMs;
        return await job();
      } finally {
        queued--;
        release();
      }
    },
  };
}

/** Cache parsed, bounded results (never raw ORS GeoJSON). In-flight requests share one task. */
export function createOrsResultCache({
  maxEntries = 160,
  successTtlMs = 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
  missingTtlMs = 5 * 60 * 1000,
  now = () => Date.now(),
} = {}) {
  const entries = new Map<string, { value: unknown; expiresAt: number }>();
  const inFlight = new Map<string, Promise<unknown>>();
  return {
    async getOrLoad<T>(key: string, load: () => Promise<T | null>): Promise<T | null> {
      const hit = entries.get(key);
      if (hit && hit.expiresAt > now()) {
        entries.delete(key);
        entries.set(key, hit); // LRU refresh
        return hit.value as T | null;
      }
      entries.delete(key);
      const pending = inFlight.get(key);
      if (pending) return pending as Promise<T | null>;
      const next = (async () => {
        const value = await load();
        entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: now() + (value === null ? missingTtlMs : successTtlMs) });
        while (entries.size > maxEntries) entries.delete(entries.keys().next().value!);
        return value;
      })();
      inFlight.set(key, next);
      try { return await next; }
      finally { inFlight.delete(key); }
    },
    size() { return entries.size; },
  };
}
```

### `lib/ors-request.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * Pure OpenRouteService request builder, shared by the server and regression tests.
 * Input point order in TrailPicker is [latitude, longitude]; ORS requires [longitude, latitude].
 * Never call this from the client or embed a real API key in browser code.
 */
export type ORSRequestKind = "snap" | "route";

type Coordinate = readonly [latitude: number, longitude: number];

export function buildORSRequest(
  kind: ORSRequestKind,
  coordinates: ReadonlyArray<Coordinate>,
  apiKey: string,
  snapRadiusM: number,
) {
  const path = kind === "snap"
    ? "snap/foot-hiking/json"
    : "directions/foot-hiking/geojson";

  const locations = coordinates.map(([lat, lng]) => [lng, lat]);
  const input = kind === "snap"
    ? { locations, radius: snapRadiusM }
    : { coordinates: locations, instructions: false, elevation: true };

  return {
    url: `https://api.heigit.org/openrouteservice/v2/${path}`,
    options: {
      method: "POST" as const,
      headers: {
        Authorization: apiKey,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        // /geojson produces application/geo+json. Sending only application/json
        // caused the provider's 406 / error 2007 response.
        Accept: kind === "route" ? "application/geo+json" : "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(input),
    },
  };
}
```

### `lib/overnight-handoffs.ts`

```typescript
/** One geographic campsite can end a hiking day and start the next.
 * The inherited next-day start is derived from the SAME waypoint ID, not a new
 * saved route stop. Legacy duplicate pins are merged only when they represent
 * a genuine consecutive overnight handoff.
 */
import type { Waypoint } from "./trip-planner";
import { isSharedOvernightStop } from "./shared-overnight-stop";

export type OvernightDay = { id: string; date: Date | string };
export type Handoff = { point: Waypoint; fromDayId: string; toDayId: string; fromDayNumber: number; toDayNumber: number };

export function orderedOvernightDays(days: readonly OvernightDay[]): OvernightDay[] {
  return [...days].sort((a,b) => +new Date(a.date) - +new Date(b.date));
}

/** Removing a legacy duplicate must preserve the outgoing trail leg and the
 * next morning's departure time/notes, rather than losing either. */
export function consolidateOvernightStops(points: readonly Waypoint[], days: readonly OvernightDay[]) {
  const ordered = orderedOvernightDays(days);
  const consecutive = new Map(ordered.slice(0,-1).map((day,i) => [day.id,ordered[i+1].id]));
  const merged: Waypoint[] = [];
  const replacedIds: Record<string,string> = {};
  for (const current of points) {
    const last = merged[merged.length - 1];
    if (last && last.kind === "camp" && current.kind === "camp" && last.dayId &&
        consecutive.get(last.dayId) === current.dayId && isSharedOvernightStop(last,current)) {
      const combined: Waypoint = {
        ...last,
        // The outgoing trail of the second pin becomes the outgoing trail of
        // the canonical pin. This preserves GPX, elevation, and shaping.
        trailToNext: current.trailToNext,
        manualToNext: current.manualToNext,
        viaToNext: current.viaToNext,
        ...(current.time ? { nextDayDepartureTime: current.time } : {}),
        ...(current.note ? { nextDayDepartureNote: current.note } : {}),
        ...(current.resource && !last.resource ? { resource: current.resource } : {}),
      };
      merged[merged.length-1] = combined;
      replacedIds[current.id] = last.id;
    } else {
      merged.push(current);
    }
  }
  return { points: merged, replacedIds };
}

export function inheritedOvernightForDay(points: readonly Waypoint[], days: readonly OvernightDay[], dayId: string): Handoff | null {
  const ordered = orderedOvernightDays(days);
  const index = ordered.findIndex(day => day.id === dayId);
  if (index <= 0) return null;
  const prevId = ordered[index - 1].id;
  const priorDayStops = points.filter(point => point.dayId === prevId);
  const final = priorDayStops[priorDayStops.length - 1];
  if (!final || final.kind !== "camp") return null;
  // An explicitly different trailhead begins another route, e.g. after a
  // shuttle transfer. Do not invent a walking leg from the former campsite.
  const first = points.find(point => point.dayId === dayId);
  if (first?.kind === "trailhead" && !isSharedOvernightStop(final, first)) return null;
  return { point: final, fromDayId: prevId, toDayId: dayId, fromDayNumber: index, toDayNumber: index + 1 };
}

/** One selectable campsite per physical overnight, with the day transition. */
export function campsiteChoices(points: readonly Waypoint[], days: readonly OvernightDay[]) {
  const { points: unique, replacedIds } = consolidateOvernightStops(points,days);
  const ordered = orderedOvernightDays(days);
  return { replacedIds, choices: unique.filter(point=>point.kind==="camp").map(point=>{
    const index=ordered.findIndex(day=>day.id===point.dayId);
    const next=index>=0 && index<ordered.length-1 && inheritedOvernightForDay(unique,ordered,ordered[index+1].id)?.point.id===point.id;
    return { id:point.id, name:point.name, dayId:point.dayId??"", dayLabel:next?`Night ${index+1} · Day ${index+1} → Day ${index+2}`:index>=0?`Day ${index+1}`:"Unassigned" };
  }) };
}
```
