### `lib/pack-analysis.ts`

```typescript
/** Pure, read-only analytics for the existing TrailPicker BuildItem data model.
 * Monetary values are CAD. All item weights are grams. Unknown is never treated as zero.
 */
export type PackInputItem = {
  id: string;
  quantity: number;
  isWorn: boolean;
  isConsumable: boolean;
  customCategory: string | null;
  gearNameSnapshot: string | null;
  weightSnapshot: number | null;
  priceSnapshot: number | null;
  gear: {
    name: string;
    weight_g: number | null;
    price_cad: number | null;
    category: { name: string };
  } | null;
};

export type WeightClass = "base" | "worn" | "consumable";

export type PackLine = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  quantity: number;
  weightClass: WeightClass;
  gramsEach: number | null;
  grams: number | null;
  priceEachCad: number | null;
  priceCad: number | null;
};

export type PackCategory = {
  name: string;
  baseGrams: number;
  wornGrams: number;
  consumableGrams: number;
  knownGrams: number;
  count: number;
  unknownWeightCount: number;
};

export type PackAnalysis = {
  lines: PackLine[];
  categories: PackCategory[];
  baseGrams: number;
  wornGrams: number;
  consumableGrams: number;
  carriedGrams: number;
  totalGrams: number;
  knownCostCad: number;
  totalUnits: number;
  knownWeightUnits: number;
  unknownWeightUnits: number;
  unknownPriceUnits: number;
  heaviest: PackLine[];
};

function knownNumber(value: number | null | undefined): number | null {
  return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 ? value : null;
}

export function analyzePack(items: readonly PackInputItem[]): PackAnalysis {
  const lines: PackLine[] = items.map(item => {
    const quantity = Number.isSafeInteger(item.quantity) && item.quantity > 0 ? item.quantity : 0;
    // Match the Builder's displayed value precedence (catalog, then saved snapshot).
    const gramsEach = knownNumber(item.gear?.weight_g ?? item.weightSnapshot);
    const priceEachCad = knownNumber(item.gear?.price_cad ?? item.priceSnapshot);
    const category = (item.gear?.category.name || item.customCategory || "Other").trim() || "Other";
    const name = (item.gear?.name || item.gearNameSnapshot || "Custom item").trim() || "Custom item";
    // Same precedence as calculateWeightBreakdown: worn takes priority if both flags are true.
    const weightClass: WeightClass = item.isWorn ? "worn" : item.isConsumable ? "consumable" : "base";
    return {
      id: item.id,
      name,
      category,
      quantity,
      weightClass,
      gramsEach,
      grams: gramsEach === null ? null : gramsEach * quantity,
      priceEachCad,
      priceCad: priceEachCad === null ? null : priceEachCad * quantity,
    };
  });

  let baseGrams = 0;
  let wornGrams = 0;
  let consumableGrams = 0;
  let knownCostCad = 0;
  let totalUnits = 0;
  let knownWeightUnits = 0;
  let unknownWeightUnits = 0;
  let unknownPriceUnits = 0;
  const categoryMap = new Map<string, PackCategory>();

  for (const line of lines) {
    totalUnits += line.quantity;
    if (line.grams === null) unknownWeightUnits += line.quantity;
    else knownWeightUnits += line.quantity;
    if (line.priceCad === null) unknownPriceUnits += line.quantity;
    else knownCostCad += line.priceCad;

    const category = categoryMap.get(line.category) ?? {
      name: line.category, baseGrams: 0, wornGrams: 0, consumableGrams: 0,
      knownGrams: 0, count: 0, unknownWeightCount: 0,
    };
    category.count += line.quantity;
    if (line.grams === null) category.unknownWeightCount += line.quantity;
    else {
      category.knownGrams += line.grams;
      if (line.weightClass === "base") { baseGrams += line.grams; category.baseGrams += line.grams; }
      else if (line.weightClass === "worn") { wornGrams += line.grams; category.wornGrams += line.grams; }
      else { consumableGrams += line.grams; category.consumableGrams += line.grams; }
    }
    categoryMap.set(line.category, category);
  }

  return {
    lines,
    categories: [...categoryMap.values()].sort((a, b) => b.knownGrams - a.knownGrams || a.name.localeCompare(b.name)),
    baseGrams,
    wornGrams,
    consumableGrams,
    carriedGrams: baseGrams + consumableGrams,
    totalGrams: baseGrams + consumableGrams + wornGrams,
    knownCostCad,
    totalUnits,
    knownWeightUnits,
    unknownWeightUnits,
    unknownPriceUnits,
    heaviest: lines.filter(line => line.grams !== null && line.grams > 0)
      .sort((a, b) => (b.grams ?? 0) - (a.grams ?? 0) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
      .slice(0, 5),
  };
}

/** A planning-only comparison: never writes or deletes gear. */
export function simulateExclusions(analysis: PackAnalysis, excludedIds: ReadonlySet<string>) {
  const excluded = analysis.lines.filter(line => excludedIds.has(line.id));
  const knownSavedBase = excluded.filter(line => line.weightClass === "base").reduce((sum, line) => sum + (line.grams ?? 0), 0);
  const knownSavedConsumable = excluded.filter(line => line.weightClass === "consumable").reduce((sum, line) => sum + (line.grams ?? 0), 0);
  const knownSavedWorn = excluded.filter(line => line.weightClass === "worn").reduce((sum, line) => sum + (line.grams ?? 0), 0);
  const knownSavedCost = excluded.reduce((sum, line) => sum + (line.priceCad ?? 0), 0);
  return {
    removedCount: excluded.reduce((count, line) => count + line.quantity, 0),
    missingWeightCount: excluded.filter(line => line.grams === null).reduce((count, line) => count + line.quantity, 0),
    knownSavedBase,
    knownSavedConsumable,
    knownSavedWorn,
    knownSavedCarried: knownSavedBase + knownSavedConsumable,
    knownSavedTotal: knownSavedBase + knownSavedConsumable + knownSavedWorn,
    knownSavedCost,
    remainingBase: analysis.baseGrams - knownSavedBase,
    remainingCarried: analysis.carriedGrams - knownSavedBase - knownSavedConsumable,
    remainingTotal: analysis.totalGrams - knownSavedBase - knownSavedConsumable - knownSavedWorn,
  };
}
```

### `lib/pack-intelligence.ts`

```typescript
/** TrailPicker 0.3 pack intelligence. Pure calculations and conservative, explainable rules.
 * No product database guesses, scraped weather, implied safety certification, or generated AI claims.
 */
import { analyzePack, type PackAnalysis, type PackInputItem } from './pack-analysis';
import { evaluateCompatibility, type CompatibilityIssue, type CompatItem, type BuildForCompat } from './compatibility';
import { readWaypoints, type PlannerDay } from './trip-planner';
import { analyzeItineraryTimings, ITINERARY_DEFAULT_BREAKS } from './itinerary-timing';
import type { BreakSettings } from './route-analysis-insights';

export type FindingLevel = 'critical' | 'review' | 'opportunity' | 'unknown';
export type FindingSection = 'compatibility' | 'weather' | 'optimization' | 'planning';
export type Finding = {
  id: string;
  section: FindingSection;
  level: FindingLevel;
  title: string;
  detail: string;
  action: string;
  basis: string;
  itemIds: string[];
};
export type IntelligenceBuild = Pick<BuildForCompat,'people'|'minTemperature'|'conditions'|'startDate'|'endDate'> & {routeWaypoints?: unknown};
export type IntelligenceDay = Pick<PlannerDay,'date'|'minTemperature'|'conditions'|'waterCarryL'|'waterSource'|'distanceKm'|'elevationGainM'|'campsite'> & {id?: string};
export type IntelligenceItem = CompatItem & PackInputItem;
export type ForecastPoint = { name:string; lat:number; lng:number; elevationM:number|null };
export type ForecastDay = {date:string; low:number|null; high:number|null; wind:number|null; gust:number|null; pop:number|null; model:string; samples:number};
export type ForecastEvidence = {point:ForecastPoint; days:ForecastDay[]; alertsStatus:'ok'|'unavailable'; alerts:{title:string}[]; loadedAt:string};
export type IntelligenceResult = { findings:Finding[]; pack:PackAnalysis; coverage:{ratedSleep:number; unratedSleep:number; unknownWeights:number; tripDays:number; modelDays:number}; plannedNights:number|null; coldest:number|null; weatherSource:'forecast'|'planned'|'none' };

const canon = (s:string|null|undefined) => (s||'').trim().toLowerCase();
const category = (i:IntelligenceItem) => canon(i.gear?.category.name ?? i.customCategory);
const name = (i:IntelligenceItem) => i.gear?.name ?? i.gearNameSnapshot ?? 'Custom item';
const positive = (n:number|null|undefined):n is number => typeof n === 'number' && Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0;
function tripNights(build:IntelligenceBuild):number|null {
  if (!build.startDate || !build.endDate) return null;
  const ms = new Date(build.endDate).valueOf() - new Date(build.startDate).valueOf();
  return Number.isFinite(ms) && ms >= 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.round(ms/86400000)) : null;
}
function validTemp(n:unknown):n is number { return typeof n === 'number' && Number.isFinite(n) && n >= -80 && n <= 60; }
const priority:Record<FindingLevel,number> = {critical:0,review:1,opportunity:2,unknown:3};

const extraTitles:Record<string,string> = {
  'missing-packs': 'No backpack recorded',
  'missing-shelter': 'No shelter recorded',
  'missing-sleep': 'No sleep gear recorded',
  'missing-water': 'No water gear recorded',
  'empty-build': 'No gear to evaluate',
  'cooking-plan': 'Cooking plan not recorded',
  'sleep-no-trip-low': 'Cannot assess sleeping temperature',
  'sleep-rating-unknown': 'Sleep system temperature ratings missing',
  'sleep-rating-limits': 'Check sleeping bag comfort ratings',
  'shelter-waterproof-unknown': 'Shelter waterproofing unknown',
  'shelter-wet-weather': 'Shelter may need more rain protection',
  'shelter-winter-review': 'Review shelter suitability for winter',
  'unknown-weights': 'Some gear weights are unknown',
  'multiple-shelter': 'Review multiple shelters',
  'multiple-packs': 'Review multiple packs',
  'trip-low-unknown': 'Cannot assess overnight temperature',
  'sleep-pad-not-listed': 'No sleeping pad recorded',
  'sleep-pad-units': 'Check sleeping pad quantity',
  'sleep-units': 'Not enough sleeping bag/quilt units listed',
  'sleep-insulation-missing': 'No sleeping bag or quilt recorded',
  'sleep-items-unclassified': 'Identify your sleep gear',
  'pad-insulation-unknown': 'Sleeping pad insulation is unknown',
  'pad-insulation-review': 'Review sleeping pad insulation',
  'pad-cold-weather-review': 'Check pad insulation for cold weather',
  'shelter-occupancy-unknown': 'Shelter sleeping capacity unknown',
  'shelter-capacity-short': 'Not enough documented shelter space',
  'shelter-capacity-unverified': 'Shelter capacity cannot be confirmed',
  'shelter-season-unknown': 'Shelter winter suitability unknown',
  'water-volume-unknown': 'Container capacities are missing',
  'water-volume-check': 'Planned water carry exceeds listed capacity',
  'water-volume-unverified': 'Water-carry capacity cannot be confirmed',
  'water-treatment-unverified': 'Water-treatment plan needs checking',
  'water-carry-unplanned': 'Water-carry target not recorded',
  'pack-volume-unknown': 'Backpack volume is unknown',
  'trip-conditions-unknown': 'Trip weather conditions not recorded',
  'rain-layer-unverified': 'Rain protection is unverified',
  'zero-weights': 'Check zero-weight entries',
};

export function compatibilityIssueToFinding(issue:CompatibilityIssue):Finding {
  return {
    id:`gear-${issue.id}`, section:'compatibility',
    // Only official ECCC alerts use the original red "Official alert" card.
    level:issue.kind==='unknown'?'unknown':issue.severity==='error'||issue.severity==='warning'?'review':'opportunity',
    title:extraTitles[issue.id] ??
      (issue.id.startsWith('sleep-rating-review-') ? 'Sleeping temperature mismatch' :
      issue.id.startsWith('pack-fit-review-') ? 'Check backpack fit' :
      issue.id.startsWith('duplicate-units-') ? 'Check duplicate gear quantity' : issue.category),
    detail:issue.message,
    action:issue.action ?? 'Review this finding against your trip arrangements.',
    basis:issue.basis ?? 'Recorded trip and gear data',
    itemIds:issue.itemIds ?? [],
  };
}

export function evaluatePackIntelligence(build:IntelligenceBuild, items:readonly IntelligenceItem[], days:readonly IntelligenceDay[], forecast:ForecastEvidence|null=null, timing?: {paceKmh:number; breaks:BreakSettings}):IntelligenceResult {
  const pack = analyzePack(items);
  const findings:Finding[] = [];
  const add = (f:Finding) => findings.push(f);
  const active = items.filter(i=>i.quantity>0);
  const matching = (cat:string) => active.filter(i=>category(i)===cat);
  const nights = tripNights(build);
  const overnight = (nights!==null && nights>0) || days.some(d=>!!d.campsite?.trim());
  const forecastTemps = forecast?.days.map(d=>d.low).filter(validTemp) ?? [];
  const plannedTemps = [build.minTemperature,...days.map(d=>d.minTemperature)].filter(validTemp);
  const temps = [...forecastTemps,...plannedTemps];
  const coldest = temps.length?Math.min(...temps):null;
  const weatherSource = forecastTemps.length ? 'forecast' : plannedTemps.length ? 'planned' : 'none';
  const windy = !!forecast?.days.some(d=>positive(d.gust) && d.gust>=60);
  const activeAlerts = forecast?.alertsStatus==='ok' ? forecast.alerts : [];

  // Daylight and stop scheduling are evaluated from recorded route evidence,
  // using the same pure itinerary logic shown beside individual stops.
  // No departure time / no mapped leg means no invented arrival warning.
  const savedPoints = readWaypoints(build.routeWaypoints);
  const datedDays = days.filter((day): day is IntelligenceDay & {id:string} => typeof day.id === 'string' && day.id.length > 0);
  if (savedPoints.length && datedDays.length) {
    const result = analyzeItineraryTimings(savedPoints, datedDays,
      timing?.paceKmh ?? 4, timing?.breaks ?? ITINERARY_DEFAULT_BREAKS);
    for (const issue of result.issues) add({
      id:issue.id, section:'planning', level:issue.severity==='warning'?'review':'opportunity',
      title:issue.title, detail:issue.message, action:issue.action,
      basis:'Mapped trail segments, scheduled stop times, estimated hiking pace and approximate solar times', itemIds:[],
    });
  }

  const sleepItems = matching('sleep').filter(i => !i.isConsumable);
  const rated = sleepItems.filter(i => validTemp(i.gear?.temperature_rating));
  const unrated = sleepItems.filter(i => !validTemp(i.gear?.temperature_rating));
  const shelters = matching('shelter');

  if (windy) add({id:'strong-gust',section:'weather',level:'review',title:'Strong gusts in model forecast',detail:'At least one selected-day ECCC model sample has gusts of 60 km/h or more. Ridge and campsite wind can differ.',action:'Review exposed camps, tent guy lines, shelter limits and route alternatives.',basis:'ECCC model-sampled gusts',itemIds:shelters.map(i=>i.id)});
  if (forecast) {
    if (forecast.alertsStatus==='unavailable') add({id:'alerts-unavailable',section:'weather',level:'unknown',title:'Official alerts could not be checked',detail:'ECCC alert data is unavailable. This is not an all-clear.',action:'Check official ECCC weather alerts before departure.',basis:'ECCC alert service unavailable',itemIds:[]});
    if (activeAlerts.length) add({id:'alerts-active',section:'weather',level:'critical',title:`${activeAlerts.length} current ECCC alert${activeAlerts.length===1?'':'s'} at this point`,detail:(activeAlerts.slice(0,3).map(a=>a.title).filter(Boolean).join(' · ')||'Review the alert details.')+' These are current alerts and might not apply to your planned trip dates.',action:'Read the official alert text, coverage and validity before making trip decisions.',basis:'ECCC alert feed at selected location',itemIds:[]});
    if (!forecast.days.length) add({id:'forecast-no-days',section:'weather',level:'unknown',title:'No matching forecast days',detail:'No sampled dates were available for the planned period at this point.',action:'Try a nearer trip date or a different waypoint.',basis:'ECCC model forecast horizon',itemIds:[]});
  } else if (overnight) add({id:'forecast-not-loaded',section:'weather',level:'unknown',title:'Live weather not checked',detail:'Trip conditions alone do not verify the weather at your actual route or campsite.',action:'Select a mapped trip waypoint and load the ECCC model forecast.',basis:'Live forecast not requested',itemIds:[]});

  const duplicates=new Map<string,IntelligenceItem[]>();
  for (const i of active.filter(i=>!i.isConsumable)) {
    if (!i.gear?.id || i.quantity<1) continue;
    duplicates.set(i.gear.id,[...(duplicates.get(i.gear.id)||[]),i]);
  }
  for (const [id, entries] of duplicates) {
    const qty=entries.reduce((sum,i)=>sum+i.quantity,0);
    if (qty>=2 && (category(entries[0])==='packs'||category(entries[0])==='shelter')) add({id:`duplicate-${id}`,section:'optimization',level:'opportunity',title:`Check ${qty} × ${name(entries[0])}`,detail:'Multiple copies of this item are listed. Group equipment and intentional backups are common.',action:'Confirm the quantity is intentional before considering a change.',basis:'Same catalog product and quantity',itemIds:entries.map(i=>i.id)});
  }
  // Similarity is only a review prompt. No automated claim that functional layers or backups are redundant.
  for (const cat of ['shelter','packs']) {
    const entries=matching(cat).filter(i=>!i.isConsumable);
    if (entries.length>=2 && (build.people||1)===1 && new Set(entries.map(i=>i.gear?.id??i.id)).size>1) add({id:`review-multiple-${cat}`,section:'optimization',level:'opportunity',title:`Review multiple ${cat} options`,detail:`${entries.length} different ${cat} entries are recorded for a solo trip; some may be alternatives rather than carried together.`,action:'Check which ones are actually packed. Do not remove shared or backup equipment without reviewing the plan.',basis:'Solo trip, inventory category count',itemIds:entries.map(i=>i.id)});
  }
  if (pack.unknownWeightUnits>0) add({id:'unknown-weight',section:'planning',level:'unknown',title:'Some weight data is missing',detail:`${pack.unknownWeightUnits} item unit(s) have no valid recorded weight. The visible total is a known-weight subtotal, not a complete pack weight.`,action:'Fill missing item weights to improve planning and comparisons.',basis:'Inventory data completeness',itemIds:pack.lines.filter(l=>l.grams===null).map(l=>l.id)});
  if (nights!==null && nights>0 && pack.consumableGrams>0) add({id:'consumables-budget',section:'planning',level:'opportunity',title:'Model how consumables change your load',detail:`${(pack.consumableGrams/1000).toFixed(2)} kg of consumables are listed. Consumption rate and resupplies are not recorded, so any daily curve is an adjustable scenario, not a prediction.`,action:'Use the Pack planning tab to test daily consumption assumptions.',basis:'Consumable flags and trip duration',itemIds:pack.lines.filter(l=>l.weightClass==='consumable').map(l=>l.id)});
  if (days.some(d=>positive(d.waterCarryL))) add({id:'water-demand',section:'planning',level:'opportunity',title:'Water-carry plan is recorded',detail:'At least one trip day specifies water carried. This is not proof that containers have enough capacity, since product volume fields are not consistently container capacity.',action:'Compare daily planned carries with your actual bottle, bladder, or reservoir volumes.',basis:'Trip Planner waterCarryL fields',itemIds:matching('water').map(i=>i.id)});
  if (forecast?.days.some(d=>d.samples<=0)) add({id:'sparse-forecast',section:'weather',level:'unknown',title:'Sparse forecast samples',detail:'At least one forecast day has no model samples; do not treat it as verified.',action:'Review source data and trip timing.',basis:'ECCC sampled days',itemIds:[]});

  // The exact same compatibility IDs, severity, evidence, and actions
  // are used in Gear, Analysis, and the Gear summary bar.
  // Forecast observations remain separate weather findings: loading a forecast
  // must not silently change user-entered trip conditions in one tab only.
  const compatibilityIssues = evaluateCompatibility(build, [...items], [...days]);
  findings.push(...compatibilityIssues.map(compatibilityIssueToFinding));

  findings.sort((a,b)=>priority[a.level]-priority[b.level]||a.section.localeCompare(b.section)||a.title.localeCompare(b.title));
  return {findings,pack,coverage:{ratedSleep:rated.length,unratedSleep:unrated.length,unknownWeights:pack.unknownWeightUnits,tripDays:days.length,modelDays:forecast?.days.length??0},plannedNights:nights,coldest,weatherSource};
}

/** Interpret model-first ECCC API output without inventing missing data or accepting an error payload. */
export function parseEcccEvidence(raw:unknown, point:ForecastPoint, relevantDates:readonly string[]):ForecastEvidence {
  if (!raw || typeof raw!=='object') throw new Error('Invalid ECCC response');
  const v=raw as Record<string,unknown>;
  if (!Array.isArray(v.daily) || !v.alerts || typeof v.alerts!=='object') throw new Error('Expected model-first ECCC data. Check the weather integration installation.');
  const alerts=v.alerts as Record<string,unknown>;
  const status: 'ok'|'unavailable' = alerts.status==='ok'?'ok':'unavailable';
  const dates=new Set(relevantDates.filter(d=>/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(d)));
  const num=(n:unknown):number|null=>typeof n==='number'&&Number.isFinite(n)?n:null;
  const daily:ForecastDay[]=v.daily.filter(d=>d&&typeof d==='object').map(d=>{
    const o=d as Record<string,unknown>;
    return {date:String(o.date??''),low:num(o.low),high:num(o.high),wind:num(o.wind),gust:num(o.gust),pop:num(o.pop),model:String(o.model||'ECCC model'),samples:typeof o.samples==='number'&&Number.isFinite(o.samples)?o.samples:0};
  }).filter(d=>/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(d.date)&&d.samples>0&&dates.has(d.date));
  const alertItems=Array.isArray(alerts.items)?alerts.items.map((a:unknown)=>({title:a&&typeof a==='object'&&typeof (a as Record<string,unknown>).title==='string'?String((a as Record<string,unknown>).title):'Official weather alert'})):[];
  return {point,days:daily,alertsStatus:status,alerts:alertItems,loadedAt:new Date().toISOString()};
}

export function projectConsumables(totalGrams:number, nights:number, dailyFraction:number) {
  const days=Math.min(31,Math.max(1,Math.trunc(nights)+1));
  const fraction=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number.isFinite(dailyFraction)?dailyFraction:0));
  return Array.from({length:days},(_,idx)=>({day:idx+1,remainingGrams:Math.round(Math.max(0,totalGrams*(1-idx*fraction))*100)/100}));
}
```

```typescript
import { PrismaClient } from "@/app/generated/prisma/client";
import { PrismaPg } from "@prisma/adapter-pg";

const adapter = new PrismaPg({
  connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL!,

export const prisma =

if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production") {
```

### `lib/profile.ts`

```typescript
import { calculateTotalCost, calculateWeightBreakdown } from "@/lib/calculations";
import { weightText, type WeightUnit } from "@/lib/user-preferences";

export type ProfileBuild = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  location: string | null;
  startDate: Date | null;
  endDate: Date | null;
  createdAt: Date;
  updatedAt: Date;
  items: Array<{
    quantity: number;
    isConsumable: boolean;
    isWorn: boolean;
    weightSnapshot: number | null;
    priceSnapshot: number | null;
    gear: { weight_g: number | null; price_cad: number | null } | null;
  }>;
};

export function summarizeBuild(build: ProfileBuild) {
  const weight = calculateWeightBreakdown(build.items);
  return { ...weight, cost: calculateTotalCost(build.items), itemCount: build.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0) };
}

export function buildStatus(build: Pick<ProfileBuild, "startDate" | "endDate">) {
  const today = new Date();
  today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  if (build.endDate && build.endDate < today) return "past" as const;
  if (build.startDate && build.startDate >= today) return "upcoming" as const;
  return "undated" as const;
}

export function dateRange(start: Date | null, end: Date | null) {
  if (!start) return "Dates not set";
  const date = (value: Date) => value.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: "short", day: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" });
  return end ? `${date(start)} – ${date(end)}` : date(start);
}

export function weightLabel(grams: number, unit: WeightUnit = "metric") {
  return weightText(grams, unit);
}
```

```typescript
/** Read-only route analysis. These estimates never overwrite a saved itinerary. */
import type { ElevationSample } from "./route-metrics";

export type BreakStyle = "minimal" | "normal" | "frequent" | "custom";
export type BreakSettings = {
  style: BreakStyle;
  customMinutesPerHour: number;
  lunchMinutes: number;
  /** Add lunch only when this individual hiking day is at least this long. */
  lunchThresholdMinutes: number;
};
export const DEFAULT_BREAK_SETTINGS: BreakSettings = {
  style: "normal", customMinutesPerHour: 10, lunchMinutes: 0, lunchThresholdMinutes: 240,
};
export function estimateBreaks(movingMinutes: number | null, settings: BreakSettings = DEFAULT_BREAK_SETTINGS) {
  if (movingMinutes === null || !Number.isFinite(movingMinutes) || movingMinutes < 0) return null;
  const rate = settings.style === "minimal" ? 5 : settings.style === "normal" ? 10 : settings.style === "frequent" ? 15 : settings.customMinutesPerHour;
  const perHour = Math.max(0, Math.min(30, Number.isFinite(rate) ? rate : 0));
  const shortMinutes = Math.round(movingMinutes / 60 * perHour / 5) * 5;
  const lunchMinutes = movingMinutes >= Math.max(0, settings.lunchThresholdMinutes)
    ? Math.max(0, Math.min(120, Number.isFinite(settings.lunchMinutes) ? settings.lunchMinutes : 0)) : 0;
  return { shortMinutes, lunchMinutes, totalMinutes: shortMinutes + lunchMinutes };
}

export type TerrainBand = "gentle" | "moderate" | "steep";
export type TerrainCell = { startM: number; endM: number; gradePct: number; band: TerrainBand; dayId: string | null };
export type SustainedSlope = { startM: number; endM: number; gainM: number; gradePct: number; dayId: string | null; direction: "climb" | "descent" };
export type TerrainInsights = {
  analyzedDistanceM: number;
  totalProfileDistanceM: number;
  gentleDistanceM: number;
  moderateDistanceM: number;
  steepDistanceM: number;
  cells: TerrainCell[];
  hardestClimb: SustainedSlope | null;
  hardestDescent: SustainedSlope | null;
};

const MAX_SAMPLE_SPACING_M = 400;
const CELL_DISTANCE_M = 200;
const MIN_SUSTAINED_M = 500;
const GENTLE_GRADE = 5;
const STEEP_GRADE = 12;
const SUSTAINED_GRADE = 8;

function interpolateAt(samples: readonly ElevationSample[], distanceM: number) {
  for (let i = 1; i < samples.length; i++) {
    if (distanceM <= samples[i].distanceM) {
      const a = samples[i-1], b = samples[i];
      if (b.distanceM <= a.distanceM) return b.elevationM;
      return a.elevationM + (b.elevationM - a.elevationM) * (distanceM - a.distanceM) / (b.distanceM - a.distanceM);
    }
  }
  return samples[samples.length - 1].elevationM;
}

/**
 * Analyze only sufficiently sampled, contiguous pieces of actual mapped geometry.
 * Sparse GPX geometry must NOT be treated as a uniformly steep slope. Interpolation
 * happens inside observed intervals only, never across an unmapped or sparse gap.
 * Classification uses 200 m windows to reduce single-vertex altimeter noise;
 * it is a planning approximation, not an exposure / technical terrain grade.
 */
export function analyzeTerrain(sections: readonly (readonly ElevationSample[])[], dayIds: readonly (string | null)[] = []): TerrainInsights {
  const cells: TerrainCell[] = [];
  let totalProfileDistanceM = 0;
  for (let sectionIndex = 0; sectionIndex < sections.length; sectionIndex++) {
    const section = sections[sectionIndex];
    if (section.length < 2) continue;
    const first = section[0], last = section[section.length - 1];
    if (Number.isFinite(first.distanceM) && Number.isFinite(last.distanceM) && last.distanceM > first.distanceM)
      totalProfileDistanceM += last.distanceM - first.distanceM;
    // Split on sparse, zero-length, nonmonotonic or corrupt spans.
    let begin = 0;
    const analyzeRun = (end: number) => {
      const run = section.slice(begin, end + 1);
      if (run.length < 2) return;
      const min = run[0].distanceM, max = run[run.length - 1].distanceM;
      if (max - min < 80) return;
      let start = min;
      while (start < max - 1) {
        const stop = Math.min(start + CELL_DISTANCE_M, max);
        if (stop - start < 80) break;
        const delta = interpolateAt(run, stop) - interpolateAt(run, start);
        const gradePct = delta / (stop - start) * 100;
        const band: TerrainBand = Math.abs(gradePct) < GENTLE_GRADE ? "gentle" : Math.abs(gradePct) < STEEP_GRADE ? "moderate" : "steep";
        cells.push({ startM: start, endM: stop, gradePct, band, dayId: dayIds[sectionIndex] ?? null });
        start = stop;
      }
    };
    for (let i = 1; i < section.length; i++) {
      const a = section[i - 1], b = section[i];
      const spacing = b.distanceM - a.distanceM;
      const valid = spacing > 0 && spacing <= MAX_SAMPLE_SPACING_M &&
        Number.isFinite(a.elevationM) && Number.isFinite(b.elevationM) &&
        Number.isFinite(a.distanceM) && Number.isFinite(b.distanceM);
      if (!valid) { analyzeRun(i - 1); begin = i; }
    }
    analyzeRun(section.length - 1);
  }
  let gentleDistanceM = 0, moderateDistanceM = 0, steepDistanceM = 0;
  for (const cell of cells) {
    const length = cell.endM - cell.startM;
    if (cell.band === "gentle") gentleDistanceM += length;
    else if (cell.band === "moderate") moderateDistanceM += length;
    else steepDistanceM += length;
  }
  const sustained = (direction: "climb" | "descent"): SustainedSlope | null => {
    const threshold = direction === "climb" ? SUSTAINED_GRADE : -SUSTAINED_GRADE;
    let best: SustainedSlope | null = null;
    let group: TerrainCell[] = [];
    const flush = () => {
      if (group.length === 0) return;
      const length = group[group.length - 1].endM - group[0].startM;
      if (length >= MIN_SUSTAINED_M) {
        const elevation = group.reduce((sum, cell) => sum + cell.gradePct * (cell.endM - cell.startM) / 100, 0);
        const gainM = Math.abs(elevation);
        if (!best || gainM > best.gainM) best = {
          startM: group[0].startM, endM: group[group.length - 1].endM, gainM,
          gradePct: elevation / length * 100, dayId: group[0].dayId, direction,
        };
      }
      group = [];
    };
    for (const cell of cells) {
      const matched = direction === "climb" ? cell.gradePct >= threshold : cell.gradePct <= threshold;
      const linked = group.length && Math.abs(group[group.length - 1].endM - cell.startM) < 0.01 && group[group.length - 1].dayId === cell.dayId;
      if (!matched) { flush(); continue; }
      if (group.length && !linked) flush();
      group.push(cell);
    }
    flush();
    return best;
  };
  return { analyzedDistanceM: gentleDistanceM + moderateDistanceM + steepDistanceM,
    totalProfileDistanceM, gentleDistanceM, moderateDistanceM, steepDistanceM, cells,
    hardestClimb: sustained("climb"), hardestDescent: sustained("descent") };
}

export function parseClock(value: string | null | undefined): number | null {
  if (!value || !/^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/.test(value)) return null;
  const [hour, minute] = value.split(":").map(Number);
  return hour * 60 + minute;
}
export function clockLabel(totalMinutes: number): string {
  const minute = Math.round(totalMinutes);
  const hour = ((Math.floor(minute / 60) % 24) + 24) % 24;
  const dayOffset = Math.floor(minute / 1440);
  return `${hour % 12 || 12}:${String(((minute % 60) + 60) % 60).padStart(2, "0")} ${hour >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM"}${dayOffset > 0 ? ` (+${dayOffset}d)` : ""}`;
}

export type DaylightResult = { sunriseMinutes: number | null; sunsetMinutes: number | null; zone: string; reason?: "polar-day" | "polar-night" | "unavailable" };
const rad = Math.PI / 180;
const normalize = (value: number, modulo: number) => ((value % modulo) + modulo) % modulo;
/** NOAA-style solar event calculation; approximate at high latitudes and in mountains. */
function eventHoursUtc(year: number, month: number, day: number, lat: number, lng: number, rising: boolean): number | null {
  const start = Date.UTC(year, 0, 1);
  const n = Math.floor((Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day) - start) / 86400000) + 1;
  const lngHour = lng / 15;
  const t = n + ((rising ? 6 : 18) - lngHour) / 24;
  const M = 0.9856 * t - 3.289;
  const L = normalize(M + 1.916 * Math.sin(M * rad) + 0.020 * Math.sin(2 * M * rad) + 282.634, 360);
  let RA = normalize(Math.atan(0.91764 * Math.tan(L * rad)) / rad, 360);
  RA = (RA + (Math.floor(L / 90) * 90 - Math.floor(RA / 90) * 90)) / 15;
  const sinDec = 0.39782 * Math.sin(L * rad);
  const cosDec = Math.cos(Math.asin(sinDec));
  const cosH = (Math.cos(90.833 * rad) - sinDec * Math.sin(lat * rad)) / (cosDec * Math.cos(lat * rad));
  if (!Number.isFinite(cosH) || cosH < -1 || cosH > 1) return null;
  const H = (rising ? 360 - Math.acos(cosH) / rad : Math.acos(cosH) / rad) / 15;
  const T = H + RA - 0.06571 * t - 6.622;
  return normalize(T - lngHour, 24);
}
function localParts(utc: Date, zone: string) {
  const tokens = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", { timeZone: zone, year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23" }).formatToParts(utc);
  const p = Object.fromEntries(tokens.filter(t => t.type !== "literal").map(t => [t.type, Number(t.value)]));
  return { year: p.year, month: p.month, day: p.day, minutes: p.hour * 60 + p.minute };
}
/** Returns local civil sunrise/sunset in a supplied IANA timezone. No API calls. */
export function approximateDaylight(date: Date | string, lat: number, lng: number, zone: string): DaylightResult {
  const value = new Date(date);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value.getTime()) || !Number.isFinite(lat) || Math.abs(lat) > 90 || !Number.isFinite(lng) || Math.abs(lng) > 180) return { zone, sunriseMinutes: null, sunsetMinutes: null, reason: "unavailable" };
  try {
    const y = value.getUTCFullYear(), m = value.getUTCMonth() + 1, d = value.getUTCDate();
    // Validate supplied IANA timezone before using it.
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", { timeZone: zone });
    const base = Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d);
    const findEvent = (rising: boolean) => {
      const hour = eventHoursUtc(y, m, d, lat, lng, rising);
      if (hour === null) return null;
      const matching: number[] = [];
      for (const offset of [-1, 0, 1]) {
        const p = localParts(new Date(base + (offset * 24 + hour) * 3600000), zone);
        if (p.year === y && p.month === m && p.day === d) matching.push(p.minutes);
      }
      if (matching.length === 0) return null;
      return matching.find(t => rising ? t < 12 * 60 : t >= 12 * 60) ?? matching[0];
    };
    const sunriseMinutes = findEvent(true), sunsetMinutes = findEvent(false);
    if (sunriseMinutes !== null && sunsetMinutes !== null) return { zone, sunriseMinutes, sunsetMinutes };
    // Polar status from the sun elevation at nominal noon; no fictitious sunrise.
    const dayN = Math.floor((base - Date.UTC(y, 0, 1)) / 86400000) + 1;
    const decl = 23.44 * Math.sin((360 / 365 * (dayN - 81)) * rad);
    const noonAltitude = 90 - Math.abs(lat - decl);
    const midnightAltitude = Math.abs(lat + decl) - 90;
    const reason = noonAltitude < -0.833 ? "polar-night" : midnightAltitude > -0.833 ? "polar-day" : "unavailable";
    return { zone, sunriseMinutes, sunsetMinutes, reason };
  } catch { return { zone, sunriseMinutes: null, sunsetMinutes: null, reason: "unavailable" }; }
}
export type ScheduleCheck = { finishMinutes: number; bufferMinutes: number | null; status: "before-sunset" | "tight-daylight" | "after-sunset" | "no-sunset"; arrivalConflict: boolean };
/** Only call for a fully mapped day. Clock inputs are local to the trail. */
export function checkDaySchedule(startHHMM: string, totalMinutes: number | null, solar: DaylightResult, arrivalHHMM?: string | null): ScheduleCheck | null {
  const start = parseClock(startHHMM);
  if (start === null || totalMinutes === null || !Number.isFinite(totalMinutes) || totalMinutes < 0) return null;
  const finishMinutes = start + totalMinutes;
  const bufferMinutes = solar.sunsetMinutes !== null ? solar.sunsetMinutes - finishMinutes : null;
  const status = bufferMinutes === null ? "no-sunset" : bufferMinutes < 0 ? "after-sunset" : bufferMinutes < 45 ? "tight-daylight" : "before-sunset";
  const arrival = parseClock(arrivalHHMM);
  const arrivalConflict = arrival !== null && arrival >= start && finishMinutes > arrival + 5;
  return { finishMinutes, bufferMinutes, status, arrivalConflict };
}
```

### `lib/route-analysis-scope.ts`

```typescript
/** Presentation-only scope for Route Analysis. Never modifies persisted day totals. */
import type { RouteMetrics } from "./route-metrics";
import { estimateBreaks, type BreakSettings } from "./route-analysis-insights";

export type RouteAnalysisScope = {
  dayId: string | null;
  segments: number;
  routedSegments: number;
  unroutedSegments: number;
  climbedSegments: number;
  sampleDerivedSegments: number;
  distanceM: number;
  routedDistanceM: number;
  knownAscentM: number;
  knownDescentM: number;
  terrainTimeDistanceM: number;
  movingMinutes: number | null;
  breakMinutes: number | null;
  complete: boolean;
  issues: string[];
};

/**
 * One source of truth for hiking time, route fundamentals, warning coverage and
 * secondary reference models. A day selection must not silently show totals
 * from the entire trip. Cross-day legs remain incomplete, not assigned to a day.
 */
export function routeAnalysisScope(
  metrics: RouteMetrics,
  requestedDayId: string | null,
  breaks: BreakSettings,
): RouteAnalysisScope {
  const day = requestedDayId ? metrics.dayMetrics.find(entry => entry.dayId === requestedDayId) : undefined;
  const isDay = !!day;
  const segments = day?.segments ?? metrics.segments;
  const routedSegments = day?.routedSegments ?? metrics.routedSegments;
  const climbedSegments = day?.climbedSegments ?? metrics.climbedSegments;
  const unroutedSegments = isDay ? segments - routedSegments : metrics.unroutedSegments;
  const unassigned = day?.unresolvedLinks ?? metrics.unassignedDaySegments;
  const fullyElevated = segments > 0 && unroutedSegments === 0 && climbedSegments === segments;
  const dayMoving = metrics.dayMetrics.map(entry =>
    entry.estimatedMinutes ?? (entry.routedSegments > 0 ? entry.routedEstimateMinutes : null));

  // Keep the whole-route estimate identical to the existing per-day break model.
  // For an individual day use only that day's walking and rest minutes.
  const movingMinutes = day
    ? day.estimatedMinutes ?? (day.routedSegments > 0 ? day.routedEstimateMinutes : null)
    : metrics.dayMetrics.length
      ? dayMoving.some(value => value !== null)
        ? dayMoving.reduce<number>((total, value) => total + (value ?? 0), 0)
        : null
      : metrics.estimatedMinutes ?? (metrics.routedSegments ? metrics.routedEstimateMinutes : null);
  const breakMinutes = day
    ? estimateBreaks(movingMinutes, breaks)?.totalMinutes ?? null
    : metrics.dayMetrics.length
      ? movingMinutes !== null
        ? metrics.dayMetrics.reduce((total, entry, index) => total + (
            entry.segments > 0 && dayMoving[index] !== null
              ? estimateBreaks(dayMoving[index], breaks)?.totalMinutes ?? 0
              : 0), 0)
        : null
      : estimateBreaks(movingMinutes, breaks)?.totalMinutes ?? null;

  const allDaysComplete = metrics.dayMetrics.length > 0 && metrics.unassignedDaySegments === 0
    && metrics.dayMetrics.some(entry => entry.segments > 0)
    && metrics.dayMetrics.filter(entry => entry.segments > 0).every(entry => entry.estimatedMinutes !== null);
  const complete = day
    ? day.segments > 0 && day.estimatedMinutes !== null && fullyElevated
    : metrics.dayMetrics.length
      ? allDaysComplete && fullyElevated
      : metrics.estimatedMinutes !== null;

  return {
    dayId: day?.dayId ?? null,
    segments, routedSegments, unroutedSegments, climbedSegments,
    sampleDerivedSegments: day?.sampleDerivedSegments ?? metrics.sampleDerivedSegments,
    distanceM: day?.distanceM ?? metrics.distanceM,
    routedDistanceM: day?.routedDistanceM ?? metrics.routedDistanceM,
    knownAscentM: day?.knownAscentM ?? metrics.knownAscentM,
    knownDescentM: day?.knownDescentM ?? metrics.knownDescentM,
    terrainTimeDistanceM: day?.terrainTimeDistanceM ?? metrics.terrainTimeDistanceM,
    movingMinutes, breakMinutes, complete,
    issues: [
      unroutedSegments > 0 ? `${unroutedSegments} straight-line route connection(s) lack mapped trail geometry` : null,
      routedSegments > climbedSegments ? `${routedSegments - climbedSegments} mapped leg(s) lack ascent/descent data` : null,
      metrics.dayMetrics.length > 0 && unassigned > 0
        ? isDay
          ? `${unassigned} cross-day or unassigned route connection(s) affect this day`
          : `${unassigned} route leg(s) cross day boundaries or lack a day assignment`
        : null,
    ].filter((entry): entry is string => Boolean(entry)),
  };
}
```

### `lib/route-explorer.ts`

```typescript
/** Shared, read-only distance/position model for the map, profile and itinerary.
 * Distances follow computeRouteMetrics, including the straight-line lower bound
 * for unresolved links. Elevation and cursor coordinates are NEVER inferred on
 * those links or across gaps in recorded samples.
 */
import type { Waypoint } from "./trip-planner";
import { metersBetween, usableTrailSegment } from "./trail-routing";
import { isSharedOvernightStop } from "./shared-overnight-stop";

export type ExplorerSample = {
  distanceM: number;
  elevationM: number;
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
};
export type ExplorerSection = {
  startM: number;
  endM: number;
  dayId: string | null;
  samples: ExplorerSample[];
};
export type ExplorerRoute = {
  distanceM: number;
  sections: ExplorerSection[];
  stopDistances: Record<string, number>;
};

export function buildRouteExplorer(points: readonly Waypoint[]): ExplorerRoute {
  const sections: ExplorerSection[] = [];
  const stopDistances: Record<string, number> = {};
  let offsetM = 0;
  for (let index = 0; index < points.length; index++) {
    const from = points[index];
    stopDistances[from.id] = offsetM;
    const to = points[index + 1];
    if (!to) break;
    if (isSharedOvernightStop(from, to)) continue;
    const segment = from.manualToNext ? null : usableTrailSegment(from, to);
    const distanceM = segment?.distanceM ?? metersBetween([from.lat, from.lng], [to.lat, to.lng]);
    const geometry = segment?.geometry;
    const heights = segment?.elevationsM;
    if (geometry && heights && heights.length === geometry.length && geometry.length >= 2) {
      const cumulative = [0];
      for (let j = 1; j < geometry.length; j++) {
        cumulative.push(cumulative[j - 1] + metersBetween(geometry[j - 1], geometry[j]));
      }
      const geometryDistance = cumulative[cumulative.length - 1];
      if (geometryDistance > 0) {
        const samples = geometry.map(([lat, lng], j) => ({
          distanceM: offsetM + cumulative[j] / geometryDistance * distanceM,
          elevationM: heights[j], lat, lng,
        }));
        // A sparse elevation window is not a continuous measured profile.
        // Split it rather than drawing a misleading line through the missing terrain.
        let run: ExplorerSample[] = [];
        const saveRun = () => {
          if (run.length >= 2) sections.push({
            startM: run[0].distanceM,
            endM: run[run.length - 1].distanceM,
            dayId: from.dayId && from.dayId === to.dayId ? from.dayId : null,
            samples: run,
          });
        };
        for (const sample of samples) {
          if (run.length && (sample.distanceM - run[run.length - 1].distanceM > 400 ||
                             sample.distanceM <= run[run.length - 1].distanceM)) {
            saveRun();
            run = [];
          }
          run.push(sample);
        }
        saveRun();
      }
    }
    offsetM += distanceM;
  }
  return { distanceM: offsetM, sections, stopDistances };
}

/** Never interpolate through a missing elevation link or a >400m sparse window. */
export function locationAtDistance(route: ExplorerRoute, distanceM: number): ExplorerSample | null {
  if (!Number.isFinite(distanceM)) return null;
  for (const section of route.sections) {
    if (distanceM < section.startM - 0.01 || distanceM > section.endM + 0.01) continue;
    const samples = section.samples;
    if (Math.abs(distanceM - samples[0].distanceM) < 0.01) return samples[0];
    for (let j = 1; j < samples.length; j++) {
      const a = samples[j - 1], b = samples[j];
      if (b.distanceM + 0.01 < distanceM) continue;
      const span = b.distanceM - a.distanceM;
      if (span <= 0 || span > 400) return null;
      const t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (distanceM - a.distanceM) / span));
      return {
        distanceM, elevationM: a.elevationM + t * (b.elevationM - a.elevationM),
        lat: a.lat + t * (b.lat - a.lat), lng: a.lng + t * (b.lng - a.lng),
      };
    }
    return samples[samples.length - 1];
  }
  return null;
}

/** Gradient across a local measured 200m window, not a noisy vertex derivative. */
export function gradeAtDistance(route: ExplorerRoute, distanceM: number): number | null {
  const section = route.sections.find(s => distanceM >= s.startM && distanceM <= s.endM);
  if (!section) return null;
  const startM = Math.max(section.startM, distanceM - 100);
  const endM = Math.min(section.endM, distanceM + 100);
  if (endM - startM < 50) return null;
  const a = locationAtDistance(route, startM);
  const b = locationAtDistance(route, endM);
  return a && b ? (b.elevationM - a.elevationM) / (endM - startM) * 100 : null;
}
```

### `lib/route-insertion.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * Find a point halfway along the displayed path, which can bend around trails.
 * Positions are [latitude, longitude]. This helper has no map/browser dependency.
 */
type LatLng = readonly [number, number];

function segmentMeters(a: LatLng, b: LatLng): number {
  const radians = Math.PI / 180;
  const dLat = (b[0] - a[0]) * radians;
  const dLng = (b[1] - a[1]) * radians;
  const h = Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 +
    Math.cos(a[0] * radians) * Math.cos(b[0] * radians) * Math.sin(dLng / 2) ** 2;
  return 6371000 * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(h), Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - h)));
}

export function routeInsertionMidpoint(path: readonly LatLng[]): [number, number] | null {
  if (path.length < 2) return null;
  const lengths: number[] = [];
  let totalMeters = 0;
  for (let index = 1; index < path.length; index++) {
    const length = segmentMeters(path[index - 1], path[index]);
    if (!Number.isFinite(length)) return null;
    lengths.push(length);
    totalMeters += length;
  }
  if (totalMeters <= 0) return null;

  let remaining = totalMeters / 2;
  for (let index = 0; index < lengths.length; index++) {
    const length = lengths[index];
    if (remaining <= length && length > 0) {
      const fraction = remaining / length;
      const from = path[index];
      const to = path[index + 1];
      return [
        from[0] + (to[0] - from[0]) * fraction,
        from[1] + (to[1] - from[1]) * fraction,
      ];
    }
    remaining -= length;
  }
  // Floating-point rounding: the end of the route is still a valid result.
  return [...path[path.length - 1]];
}
```

### `lib/route-leg-style.ts`

```typescript
/** Display rules for the Leaflet hiking route polyline.
 * Day highlighting is driven by EXPANDED itinerary panels, not the last
 * clicked stop. If all panels are collapsed, the entire route is visible.
 * Unrouted/direct connections remain dashed and amber: never imply a trail
 * was verified when the provider failed or the user chose straight lines.
 */
export type RouteLegStyleInput = {
  mapped: boolean;
  editing: boolean;
  activeDayId?: string | null;
  expandedDayIds?: readonly string[];
  startDayId?: string | null;
  endDayId?: string | null;
};

export function routeLegStyle({ mapped, editing, activeDayId, expandedDayIds, startDayId, endDayId }: RouteLegStyleInput) {
  // The explicit panel set wins over activeDayId. Retain the latter only as a
  // fallback for older embedders that have not adopted expanded-day state.
  const inactiveDay = expandedDayIds !== undefined
    ? expandedDayIds.length > 0 && !(
        !!startDayId && !!endDayId &&
        expandedDayIds.includes(startDayId) && expandedDayIds.includes(endDayId)
      )
    : Boolean(activeDayId && (startDayId !== activeDayId || endDayId !== activeDayId));
  const hasFocusedDays = expandedDayIds !== undefined ? expandedDayIds.length > 0 : Boolean(activeDayId);
  if (mapped) {
    return {
      color: "#166534",
      dashArray: undefined,
      weight: editing || (!inactiveDay && hasFocusedDays) ? 6 : 5,
      opacity: expandedDayIds === undefined && editing ? 0.98 : inactiveDay ? 0.19 : editing ? 0.98 : 0.9,
    };
  }
  return {
    color: "#d97706",
    weight: editing ? 4 : 3,
    dashArray: "6 8",
    opacity: expandedDayIds === undefined && editing ? 0.98 : inactiveDay ? 0.18 : editing ? 0.98 : 0.8,
  };
}
```

### `lib/route-marker-clustering.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * View-only map marker layout for the Trip Planner.
 * Never mutate/dedupe saved waypoints: the route and itinerary still need each stop.
 */
import type { Waypoint } from "./trip-planner";
import { isSharedOvernightStop } from "./shared-overnight-stop";

export type DisplayStop = { key: string; members: { point: Waypoint; order: number }[]; lat: number; lng: number };
export type ProjectedStop = { key: string; x: number; y: number };
export type MarkerCluster = { key: string; keys: string[]; x: number; y: number };

/** Only collapse a true consecutive overnight handoff, not a loop or two different resources. */
export function displayStops(points: readonly Waypoint[]): DisplayStop[] {
  const results: DisplayStop[] = [];
  points.forEach((point, index) => {
    const previous = index ? points[index - 1] : undefined;
    const last = results[results.length - 1];
    if (last && previous && previous.kind === point.kind && isSharedOvernightStop(previous, point)) {
      last.members.push({ point, order: index + 1 });
    } else {
      results.push({ key: point.id, members: [{ point, order: index + 1 }], lat: point.lat, lng: point.lng });
    }
  });
  return results;
}

/**
 * Zoom-dependent, pixel-distance clustering, without arbitrary grid boundaries.
 * We bound each cluster around its centroid rather than chaining neighbors:
 * a long hiking route must not disappear into one enormous pin.
 */
export function clusterProjectedStops(stops: readonly ProjectedStop[], radiusPx = 39): MarkerCluster[] {
  const radiusSq = radiusPx * radiusPx;
  const groups: { keys: string[]; members: ProjectedStop[]; x: number; y: number }[] = [];
  for (const stop of stops) {
    let closest: typeof groups[number] | undefined;
    let closestDistance = Infinity;
    for (const group of groups) {
      const dx = stop.x - group.x, dy = stop.y - group.y;
      const distanceSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
      // A bounded diameter prevents a chain of nearby trail stops from
      // becoming a single cluster stretched across the entire visible route.
      if (distanceSq > radiusSq || distanceSq >= closestDistance) continue;
      if (group.members.some(member => {
        const mx = member.x - stop.x, my = member.y - stop.y;
        return mx * mx + my * my > (2 * radiusPx) ** 2;
      })) continue;
      closest = group;
      closestDistance = distanceSq;
    }
    if (closest) {
      closest.keys.push(stop.key);
      closest.members.push(stop);
      const n = closest.members.length;
      closest.x += (stop.x - closest.x) / n;
      closest.y += (stop.y - closest.y) / n;
    } else {
      groups.push({ keys: [stop.key], members: [stop], x: stop.x, y: stop.y });
    }
  }
  return groups.map(group => ({
    key: group.keys.slice().sort().join("|"),
    keys: group.keys,
    x: group.x, y: group.y,
  }));
}

/** Temporary offsets; geographic coordinates and saved tracks are unchanged. */
export function spiderfyOffset(index: number): [number, number] {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(index) || index < 0) return [0, 0];
  let ring = 1;
  let slot = index;
  while (slot >= ring * 8) { slot -= ring * 8; ring++; }
  const angle = -Math.PI / 2 + (2 * Math.PI * slot) / (ring * 8);
  const radius = ring * 42;
  return [Math.round(Math.cos(angle) * radius), Math.round(Math.sin(angle) * radius)];
}
```

### `lib/route-metrics.ts`

```typescript
/** Route analytics shared by the map and itinerary. No invented elevation on manual links. */
import { metersBetween, usableTrailSegment, type LatLng } from "./trail-routing";
import type { Waypoint, PlannerDay } from "./trip-planner";
import { estimateWalkingTime } from "./hiking-time";
import { isSharedOvernightStop } from "./shared-overnight-stop";

export type ElevationSample = { distanceM: number; elevationM: number };
export type RouteDayMetrics = {
  dayId: string;
  distanceM: number;
  routedDistanceM: number;
  straightLineDistanceM: number;
  elevationDistanceM: number;
  gainDistanceM: number;
  unresolvedLinkDistanceM: number;
  knownAscentM: number;
  knownDescentM: number;
  segments: number;
  elevationSegments: number;
  climbedSegments: number;
  /** Leg elevations can be sampled without a provider total; those totals are estimates. */
  sampleDerivedSegments: number;
  /** Time for verified mapped legs belonging to this day, even if other legs are unresolved. */
  routedEstimateMinutes: number;
  routedSegments: number;
  terrainTimeDistanceM: number;
  fallbackTimeDistanceM: number;
  unresolvedLinks: number;
  estimatedMinutes: number | null;
  difficulty: "Easy" | "Moderate" | "Challenging" | "Strenuous" | null;
};
export type RouteMetrics = {
  segments: number;
  routedSegments: number;
  elevationSegments: number;
  climbedSegments: number;
  sampleDerivedSegments: number;
  unroutedSegments: number;
  unassignedDaySegments: number;
  distanceM: number;
  routedDistanceM: number;
  straightLineDistanceM: number;
  elevationDistanceM: number;
  gainDistanceM: number;
  unassignedDayDistanceM: number;
  /** null if any part of the route has no provider ascent/descent. */
  ascentM: number | null;
  descentM: number | null;
  knownAscentM: number;
  knownDescentM: number;
  estimatedMinutes: number | null;
  /** Estimate for routed legs only, with an ascent adjustment where supported. */
  routedEstimateMinutes: number;
  terrainTimeDistanceM: number;
  fallbackTimeDistanceM: number;
  profileSections: ElevationSample[][];
  /** Day associated with each sampled section; null for cross-day or unassigned links. */
  profileDayIds: (string | null)[];
  dayMetrics: RouteDayMetrics[];
};

export const DEFAULT_HIKING_PACE_KMH = 4;
export const CLIMB_METRES_PER_HOUR = 600;

/**
 * Fallback when a routed segment provides valid sampled altitudes but no provider
 * ascent/descent totals. A 3 m deadband limits tiny vertex-to-vertex altitude
 * fluctuations. The result is an *estimate from saved samples*, not a provider
 * measurement. Never run this on an unmapped straight-line connection.
 */
export function ascentDescentFromSamples(samples: readonly number[]): { ascentM: number; descentM: number } | null {
  if (samples.length < 2 || samples.some(value => !Number.isFinite(value) || value < -500 || value > 9000)) return null;
  const deadbandM = 3;
  let anchor = samples[0];
  let ascentM = 0, descentM = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < samples.length; i++) {
    const change = samples[i] - anchor;
    if (Math.abs(change) >= deadbandM) {
      if (change > 0) ascentM += change;
      else descentM -= change;
      anchor = samples[i];
    }
  }
  return { ascentM: Math.round(ascentM), descentM: Math.round(descentM) };
}

function walkingMinutes(distanceM: number, ascentM: number, paceKmh: number) {
  return Math.round(60 * (distanceM / 1000 / paceKmh + ascentM / CLIMB_METRES_PER_HOUR));
}

/** Scale geometric fractions along a simplifed line to the provider's measured route length. */
function sampleElevation(path: LatLng[], elevationsM: number[], distanceM: number, offsetM: number): ElevationSample[] {
  const distances = [0];
  for (let i = 1; i < path.length; i++) distances.push(distances[i - 1] + metersBetween(path[i - 1], path[i]));
  const total = distances[distances.length - 1];
  // Degenerate geometry is not a genuine distance-based elevation profile.
  if (total <= 0) return [];
  return elevationsM.map((elevationM, i) => ({
    distanceM: offsetM + distances[i] / total * distanceM,
    elevationM,
  }));
}

export function computeRouteMetrics(
  points: readonly Waypoint[],
  days: readonly Pick<PlannerDay, "id">[] = [],
  paceKmh = DEFAULT_HIKING_PACE_KMH,
): RouteMetrics {
  if (!Number.isFinite(paceKmh) || paceKmh < 1 || paceKmh > 8) {
    throw new RangeError("Hiking pace must be between 1 and 8 km/h.");
  }
  const dayMetrics: RouteDayMetrics[] = days.map(({ id }) => ({
    dayId: id, distanceM: 0, routedDistanceM: 0, straightLineDistanceM: 0,
    elevationDistanceM: 0, gainDistanceM: 0, unresolvedLinkDistanceM: 0,
    knownAscentM: 0, knownDescentM: 0, segments: 0, elevationSegments: 0, climbedSegments: 0,
    routedSegments: 0, sampleDerivedSegments: 0, routedEstimateMinutes: 0, terrainTimeDistanceM: 0, fallbackTimeDistanceM: 0, unresolvedLinks: 0, estimatedMinutes: null, difficulty: null,
  }));
  const byId = new Map(dayMetrics.map(day => [day.dayId, day]));
  const result: RouteMetrics = {
    segments: 0, routedSegments: 0, elevationSegments: 0, climbedSegments: 0, sampleDerivedSegments: 0,
    unroutedSegments: 0, unassignedDaySegments: 0,
    distanceM: 0, routedDistanceM: 0, straightLineDistanceM: 0,
    elevationDistanceM: 0, gainDistanceM: 0, unassignedDayDistanceM: 0,
    ascentM: null, descentM: null, knownAscentM: 0, knownDescentM: 0,
    estimatedMinutes: null, routedEstimateMinutes: 0, terrainTimeDistanceM: 0, fallbackTimeDistanceM: 0, profileSections: [], profileDayIds: [], dayMetrics,
  };
  // Keep route estimates and the chart in exactly the same segment order.
  let segmentHasCompleteGain = true;
  let completeRouteMinutes = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
    const from = points[i], to = points[i + 1];
    // Repeated overnight stops belong to two itinerary days but form no hike.
    if (isSharedOvernightStop(from, to)) continue;
    const routed = from.manualToNext ? null : usableTrailSegment(from, to);
    const distanceM = routed?.distanceM ?? metersBetween([from.lat, from.lng], [to.lat, to.lng]);
    const routedElevation = routed?.elevationsM;
    const hasElevation = !!(routed && routedElevation && routedElevation.length === routed.geometry.length);
    const hasProviderGain = !!(hasElevation && routed?.ascentM !== undefined && routed?.descentM !== undefined);
    const sampledGain = hasElevation && !hasProviderGain ? ascentDescentFromSamples(routedElevation!) : null;
    const hasGain = hasProviderGain || sampledGain !== null;
    const ascentM = hasProviderGain ? routed!.ascentM! : (sampledGain?.ascentM ?? 0);
    const descentM = hasProviderGain ? routed!.descentM! : (sampledGain?.descentM ?? 0);
    const sampleDerived = hasGain && !hasProviderGain;
    const offset = result.distanceM;
    const measuredSamples = hasElevation ? sampleElevation(routed!.geometry, routedElevation!, distanceM, offset) : null;
    const timeEstimate = routed ? estimateWalkingTime(distanceM, ascentM, paceKmh, hasGain ? measuredSamples : null) : null;

    result.segments++;
    result.distanceM += distanceM;
    if (routed) { result.routedSegments++; result.routedDistanceM += distanceM; }
    else { result.unroutedSegments++; result.straightLineDistanceM += distanceM; }
    if (hasElevation) {
      const samples = measuredSamples!;
      if (samples.length > 1) {
        result.elevationSegments++;
        result.elevationDistanceM += distanceM;
        result.profileSections.push(samples);
        result.profileDayIds.push(from.dayId && from.dayId === to.dayId ? from.dayId : (from.kind === "camp" && to.kind !== "trailhead" ? to.dayId ?? null : null));
      }
    }
    if (hasGain) {
      result.climbedSegments++;
      result.gainDistanceM += distanceM;
      result.knownAscentM += ascentM;
      result.knownDescentM += descentM;
      if (sampleDerived) result.sampleDerivedSegments++;
    } else segmentHasCompleteGain = false;
    if (routed) {
      result.routedEstimateMinutes += timeEstimate!.minutes;
      result.terrainTimeDistanceM += timeEstimate!.slopeDistanceM;
      result.fallbackTimeDistanceM += timeEstimate!.unprofiledDistanceM;
      completeRouteMinutes += timeEstimate!.minutes;
    }

    // A shared overnight campsite is ONE waypoint. Its outgoing leg begins the
    // following hiking day, although the campsite is owned by the night before.
    // A new trailhead is an explicit transfer, never an inferred walking leg.
    const inheritedDay = from.kind === "camp" && to.kind !== "trailhead" && from.dayId && to.dayId && from.dayId !== to.dayId
      ? to.dayId : null;
    const segmentDayId = from.dayId && from.dayId === to.dayId ? from.dayId : inheritedDay;
    const day = segmentDayId ? byId.get(segmentDayId) : null;
    if (!day) {
      result.unassignedDaySegments++;
      result.unassignedDayDistanceM += distanceM;
      // A link across different days or an unassigned stop makes both affected
      // day totals incomplete, even for short links. Do not persist partial totals as if complete.
      if (distanceM > 0) {
        const affected = new Set([from.dayId, to.dayId]);
        for (const dayId of affected) if (dayId) {
          const metric = byId.get(dayId);
          if (metric) { metric.unresolvedLinks++; metric.unresolvedLinkDistanceM += distanceM; }
        }
      }
      continue;
    }
    day.segments++;
    day.distanceM += distanceM;
    if (routed) {
      day.routedSegments++;
      day.routedDistanceM += distanceM;
      day.routedEstimateMinutes += timeEstimate!.minutes;
      day.terrainTimeDistanceM += timeEstimate!.slopeDistanceM;
      day.fallbackTimeDistanceM += timeEstimate!.unprofiledDistanceM;
    }
    else day.straightLineDistanceM += distanceM;
    if (hasElevation) { day.elevationSegments++; day.elevationDistanceM += distanceM; }
    if (hasGain) {
      day.climbedSegments++;
      day.gainDistanceM += distanceM;
      day.knownAscentM += ascentM;
      day.knownDescentM += descentM;
      if (sampleDerived) day.sampleDerivedSegments++;
    }
  }
  if (result.segments > 0 && segmentHasCompleteGain && result.routedSegments === result.segments) {
    result.ascentM = result.knownAscentM;
    result.descentM = result.knownDescentM;
    result.estimatedMinutes = Math.round(completeRouteMinutes);
  }
  for (const day of result.dayMetrics) {
    if (day.segments > 0 && day.unresolvedLinks === 0 && day.segments === day.routedSegments &&
        day.climbedSegments === day.segments) {
      day.estimatedMinutes = Math.round(day.routedEstimateMinutes);
      day.difficulty = hikingDifficulty(day.distanceM, day.knownAscentM, day.estimatedMinutes);
    }
  }
  return result;
}

/** Descriptive *planning* bands, not hiking safety grades. Require complete segment coverage. */
export function hikingDifficulty(distanceM: number, ascentM: number, movingMinutes: number): "Easy" | "Moderate" | "Challenging" | "Strenuous" {
  const distanceKm = distanceM / 1000;
  // Any single extreme dimension makes a day hard, rather than averaging hazards away.
  if (distanceKm <= 6 && ascentM <= 250 && movingMinutes <= 150) return "Easy";
  if (distanceKm <= 12 && ascentM <= 600 && movingMinutes <= 300) return "Moderate";
  if (distanceKm <= 20 && ascentM <= 1100 && movingMinutes <= 480) return "Challenging";
  return "Strenuous";
}

/** Conservative persistence boundary: do not overwrite manual day values with
 * incomplete routes OR with ascent/descent estimated from simplified samples. */
export function completeDaySummaries(metrics: RouteMetrics) {
  return metrics.dayMetrics.flatMap(day => {
    if (day.segments === 0 || day.unresolvedLinks > 0 || day.segments !== day.routedSegments ||
        day.segments !== day.climbedSegments || day.sampleDerivedSegments > 0 ||
        day.estimatedMinutes === null) return [];
    const distanceKm = Number((day.distanceM / 1000).toFixed(2));
    const elevationGainM = Math.round(day.knownAscentM);
    const elevationLossM = Math.round(day.knownDescentM);
    if (distanceKm > 1000 || elevationGainM > 20000 || elevationLossM > 20000 || day.estimatedMinutes > 1440) return [];
    return [{ dayId: day.dayId, distanceKm, elevationGainM, elevationLossM, durationMinutes: day.estimatedMinutes }];
  });
}
```

### `lib/route-profile-visual.ts`

```typescript
/** Pure elevation chart helpers. These only render supplied samples and measured terrain cells. */
import type { ElevationSample } from "./route-metrics";
import type { TerrainBand, TerrainCell } from "./route-analysis-insights";

export type TerrainStroke = { band: TerrainBand; dayId: string | null; points: ElevationSample[] };

export function terrainStrokeColor(band: TerrainBand): string {
  return band === "steep" ? "#dc2626" : band === "moderate" ? "#eab308" : "#15803d";
}

/** Retain each bucket's extrema so chart optimization never erases a summit or saddle. */
export function preserveProfileExtrema(samples: readonly ElevationSample[], maxPoints = 480): ElevationSample[] {
  if (samples.length <= maxPoints) return [...samples];
  const result: ElevationSample[] = [samples[0]];
  const bucketWidth = Math.ceil((samples.length - 2) / Math.max(1, Math.floor((maxPoints - 2) / 2)));
  for (let begin = 1; begin < samples.length - 1; begin += bucketWidth) {
    const end = Math.min(begin + bucketWidth, samples.length - 1);
    let minIndex = begin, maxIndex = begin;
    for (let index = begin + 1; index < end; index++) {
      if (samples[index].elevationM < samples[minIndex].elevationM) minIndex = index;
      if (samples[index].elevationM > samples[maxIndex].elevationM) maxIndex = index;
    }
    for (const index of [...new Set([minIndex, maxIndex])].sort((a,b) => a-b)) result.push(samples[index]);
  }
  result.push(samples[samples.length - 1]);
  return result;
}

/** Interpolate *only inside a single existing measured section*, never across two sections. */
function elevationAt(section: readonly ElevationSample[], atM: number): ElevationSample | null {
  if (section.length < 2 || atM < section[0].distanceM - 0.01 || atM > section[section.length - 1].distanceM + 0.01) return null;
  for (let index = 1; index < section.length; index++) {
    const previous = section[index - 1];
    const next = section[index];
    if (next.distanceM < atM - 0.01) continue;
    const span = next.distanceM - previous.distanceM;
    if (span <= 0 || span > 400 || !Number.isFinite(previous.elevationM) || !Number.isFinite(next.elevationM)) return null;
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (atM - previous.distanceM) / span));
    return {distanceM: atM, elevationM: previous.elevationM + (next.elevationM - previous.elevationM) * t};
  }
  return null;
}

/** Grade strokes follow the real profile, not a parallel histogram or guessed slope. */
export function buildTerrainStrokes(sections: readonly (readonly ElevationSample[])[], cells: readonly TerrainCell[]): TerrainStroke[] {
  const strokes: TerrainStroke[] = [];
  for (const cell of cells) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(cell.startM) || !Number.isFinite(cell.endM) || cell.endM <= cell.startM) continue;
    // A window is trustworthy only when it fits entirely within a measured section.
    const section = sections.find(section => section.length >= 2 &&
      cell.startM >= section[0].distanceM - 0.01 && cell.endM <= section[section.length - 1].distanceM + 0.01);
    if (!section) continue;
    const start = elevationAt(section, cell.startM);
    const end = elevationAt(section, cell.endM);
    if (!start || !end) continue;
    const middle = section.filter(point => point.distanceM > cell.startM && point.distanceM < cell.endM);
    const points = [start, ...middle, end];
    // Guard against connecting unsampled interior gaps.
    if (points.some((point, index) => index > 0 && (point.distanceM - points[index-1].distanceM > 400 || point.distanceM <= points[index-1].distanceM))) continue;
    strokes.push({band: cell.band, dayId: cell.dayId, points});
  }
  return strokes;
}
```

```typescript
/** Route changes invalidate only their adjacent legs. Valid saved ORS/GPX tracks
 * are reusable even if the provider didn't supply optional elevation samples.
 */
import type { Waypoint } from "./trip-planner";
import { usableTrailSegment } from "./trail-routing";
import { isSharedOvernightStop } from "./shared-overnight-stop";

export function missingTrailLegs(points: readonly Waypoint[]) {
  return points.slice(0, -1).map((from, index) => ({ from, to: points[index + 1] }))
    .filter(({ from, to }) => !isSharedOvernightStop(from, to) && !from.manualToNext && !usableTrailSegment(from, to));
}
```

### `lib/route-shaping.ts`

```typescript
/** Editor-only route shaping helpers. Shaping coordinates are not itinerary stops. */
import type { LatLng } from "./trail-routing";

// Keep requests and saved payloads bounded; ORS accepts intermediate coordinates.
export const MAX_ROUTE_SHAPING_WAYPOINTS = 10;

export function validShapingWaypoints(value: unknown): value is LatLng[] {
  return Array.isArray(value) && value.length <= MAX_ROUTE_SHAPING_WAYPOINTS &&
    value.every(point => Array.isArray(point) && point.length === 2 &&
      typeof point[0] === "number" && Number.isFinite(point[0]) && Math.abs(point[0]) <= 90 &&
      typeof point[1] === "number" && Number.isFinite(point[1]) && Math.abs(point[1]) <= 180);
}

function dist(a: LatLng, b: LatLng) {
  const lat = (a[0] + b[0]) * Math.PI / 360;
  const dy = (b[0] - a[0]) * 111_195;
  const dx = (b[1] - a[1]) * 111_195 * Math.cos(lat);
  return Math.hypot(dx, dy);
}

function lengths(path: readonly LatLng[]) {
  const cumulative = [0];
  for (let i = 1; i < path.length; i++) cumulative.push(cumulative[i - 1] + dist(path[i - 1], path[i]));
  return cumulative;
}

function distanceAlong(path: readonly LatLng[], cumulative: number[], target: LatLng, startAt = 0): number {
  let best = startAt;
  let minError = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  const cos = Math.cos(target[0] * Math.PI / 180);
  for (let i = 1; i < path.length; i++) {
    const length = cumulative[i] - cumulative[i - 1];
    if (length === 0 || cumulative[i] < startAt) continue;
    const a = path[i - 1];
    const b = path[i];
    const dx = (b[1] - a[1]) * cos;
    const dy = b[0] - a[0];
    const divisor = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    const t = divisor ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (
      ((target[1] - a[1]) * cos) * dx + (target[0] - a[0]) * dy
    ) / divisor)) : 0;
    const along = Math.max(startAt, cumulative[i - 1] + length * t);
    if (along > cumulative[i]) continue;
    const fraction = (along - cumulative[i - 1]) / length;
    const latitude = a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * fraction;
    const longitude = a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * fraction;
    const error = ((target[1] - longitude) * cos) ** 2 + (target[0] - latitude) ** 2;
    if (error < minError) { minError = error; best = along; }
  }
  return best;
}

function atDistance(path: readonly LatLng[], cumulative: number[], along: number): LatLng {
  for (let i = 1; i < path.length; i++) {
    if (cumulative[i] >= along && cumulative[i] > cumulative[i - 1]) {
      const ratio = (along - cumulative[i - 1]) / (cumulative[i] - cumulative[i - 1]);
      return [
        path[i - 1][0] + (path[i][0] - path[i - 1][0]) * ratio,
        path[i - 1][1] + (path[i][1] - path[i - 1][1]) * ratio,
      ];
    }
  }
  return [...path[path.length - 1]] as LatLng;
}

/** One + per stretch, using the displayed routed geometry when available. */
export function shapingInsertPositions(path: readonly LatLng[], via: readonly LatLng[]): LatLng[] {
  if (path.length < 2) return [];
  const cumulative = lengths(path);
  const end = cumulative[cumulative.length - 1];
  if (end <= 0) return [];
  let previous = 0;
  const cuts = via.map(point => {
    previous = distanceAlong(path, cumulative, point, previous);
    return previous;
  });
  const boundaries = [0, ...cuts, end];
  return boundaries.slice(0, -1).map((from, index) =>
    atDistance(path, cumulative, (from + boundaries[index + 1]) / 2));
}

/** Insert at the right ordered position, even on winding trail geometry. */
export function shapingInsertIndex(path: readonly LatLng[], via: readonly LatLng[], click: LatLng): number {
  if (path.length < 2) return 0;
  const cumulative = lengths(path);
  const at = distanceAlong(path, cumulative, click);
  let previous = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < via.length; i++) {
    previous = distanceAlong(path, cumulative, via[i], previous);
    if (at < previous) return i;
  }
  return via.length;
}

```

### `lib/route-timing-preferences.ts`

```typescript
/** Persistent, per-build hiking-time preferences. These never change route geometry. */
import { DEFAULT_HIKING_PACE_KMH } from "./route-metrics";
import { ITINERARY_DEFAULT_BREAKS } from "./itinerary-timing";
import type { BreakSettings } from "./route-analysis-insights";

export const ROUTE_TIMING_KEY = "routeTiming";
export type RouteTimingPreferences = { paceKmh: number; breaks: BreakSettings };

export const DEFAULT_ROUTE_TIMING: RouteTimingPreferences = {
  paceKmh: DEFAULT_HIKING_PACE_KMH,
  breaks: { ...ITINERARY_DEFAULT_BREAKS },
};

/** Strict on writes; never persist invalid numbers, unsupported styles, or extra fields. */
export function validateRouteTimingPreferences(value: unknown): RouteTimingPreferences {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) throw new Error("Invalid hiking settings.");
  const data = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  const paceKmh = data.paceKmh;
  const rawBreaks = data.breaks;
  if (typeof paceKmh !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(paceKmh) || paceKmh < 1 || paceKmh > 8 ||
      !rawBreaks || typeof rawBreaks !== "object" || Array.isArray(rawBreaks)) {
    throw new Error("Invalid hiking settings.");
  }
  const breaks = rawBreaks as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (!["minimal", "normal", "frequent", "custom"].includes(String(breaks.style))) throw new Error("Invalid break style.");
  const limits = [
    ["customMinutesPerHour", 0, 30],
    ["lunchMinutes", 0, 120],
    ["lunchThresholdMinutes", 0, 1440],
  ] as const;
  for (const [name, min, max] of limits) {
    const n = breaks[name];
    if (typeof n !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(n) || n < min || n > max) throw new Error(`Invalid ${name}.`);
  }
  return {
    paceKmh,
    breaks: {
      style: breaks.style as BreakSettings["style"],
      customMinutesPerHour: breaks.customMinutesPerHour as number,
      lunchMinutes: breaks.lunchMinutes as number,
      lunchThresholdMinutes: breaks.lunchThresholdMinutes as number,
    },
  };
}

/** Older builds have no saved settings, and should continue using the old defaults. */
export function readRouteTimingPreferences(tripLogistics: unknown): RouteTimingPreferences {
  if (!tripLogistics || typeof tripLogistics !== "object" || Array.isArray(tripLogistics)) return DEFAULT_ROUTE_TIMING;
  const stored = (tripLogistics as Record<string, unknown>)[ROUTE_TIMING_KEY];
  if (stored == null) return DEFAULT_ROUTE_TIMING;
  try { return validateRouteTimingPreferences(stored); }
  catch { return DEFAULT_ROUTE_TIMING; }
}
```

### `lib/route-visible-fit.ts`

```typescript
/** A map rectangle and a bottom-docked overlay rectangle in viewport pixels. */
export type RouteFitRect = Pick<DOMRectReadOnly, "top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right">;

/**
 * Height of the map actually hidden behind its bottom-docked elevation profile.
 * We measure the rendered overlay rather than relying on the preferred dock
 * height, because its CSS clamps height against the map's available space.
 */
export function coveredMapBottomPx(mapRect: RouteFitRect, dockRect: RouteFitRect | null): number {
  if (!dockRect ||
    dockRect.right <= mapRect.left || dockRect.left >= mapRect.right ||
    dockRect.bottom <= mapRect.top || dockRect.top >= mapRect.bottom) return 0;

  // Fit Route only compensates for a bottom-docked overlay, not an arbitrary
  // floating control over the map.
  if (dockRect.bottom < mapRect.bottom - 3) return 0;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(mapRect.bottom, dockRect.bottom) - Math.max(mapRect.top, dockRect.top));
}

/** Leaflet asymmetric padding fits and centers the route in the visible area. */
export function routeFitPadding(coveredBottomPx: number, marginPx = 44) {
  if (!(coveredBottomPx > 0)) return { padding: [marginPx, marginPx] as [number, number] };
  return {
    paddingTopLeft: [marginPx, marginPx] as [number, number],
    paddingBottomRight: [marginPx, marginPx + coveredBottomPx] as [number, number],
  };
}
```

### `lib/shared-overnight-stop.ts`

```typescript
/** A campsite/hut repeated as the last stop of one day and first of the next
 * is an itinerary handoff, not an additional walking leg.
 *
 * Only suppress a transition when the two geographic positions actually
 * coincide. A matching label miles away is NOT enough. Likewise, keep an
 * intentional loop with an explicit routed track or shaping via point.
 */
import { metersBetween, usableTrailSegment } from "./trail-routing";
import type { Waypoint } from "./trip-planner";

function siteKey(name: string): string {
  return name.trim().toLocaleLowerCase().replace(/&/g, " and ").replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu, " ").trim();
}

export function isSharedOvernightStop(from: Waypoint, to: Waypoint): boolean {
  if (!from.dayId || !to.dayId || from.dayId === to.dayId) return false;
  if (from.viaToNext?.length) return false;
  const distanceM = metersBetween([from.lat, from.lng], [to.lat, to.lng]);
  if (!Number.isFinite(distanceM)) return false;
  // Preserve genuine hiking loops even when they start and end at the same pin.
  const routed = usableTrailSegment(from, to);
  if (routed && routed.distanceM > 30) return false;
  // Identical map pins may have different stop labels on different days.
  if (distanceM <= 1.5) return true;
  // Place results for the same named campsite may differ by a few metres.
  return distanceM <= 25 && !!siteKey(from.name) && siteKey(from.name) === siteKey(to.name);
}
```
