### `lib/terrain-gradient-summary.ts`

```typescript
/** Presentation-friendly terrain breakdown from existing measured 200 m windows.
 * Does not interpolate across missing/sparse geometry or infer trail surface safety.
 */
import type { SustainedSlope, TerrainCell } from "./route-analysis-insights";

export type GradientDistances = {
  gentleM: number;
  moderateM: number;
  steepM: number;
  totalM: number;
};
export type DirectionalTerrain = {
  uphill: GradientDistances;
  downhill: GradientDistances;
  levelM: number;
  analyzedM: number;
  longestSteepClimb: SustainedSlope | null;
};

const MIN_SUSTAINED_M = 500;
const SUSTAINED_GRADE = 8;
const NEAR_LEVEL_GRADE = 0.5;

function accumulate(bucket: GradientDistances, cell: TerrainCell, lengthM: number) {
  if (cell.band === "gentle") bucket.gentleM += lengthM;
  else if (cell.band === "moderate") bucket.moderateM += lengthM;
  else bucket.steepM += lengthM;
  bucket.totalM += lengthM;
}
const empty = (): GradientDistances => ({ gentleM: 0, moderateM: 0, steepM: 0, totalM: 0 });

/** Uphill and downhill are classified independently; near-level terrain is shown separately. */
export function summarizeGradient(cells: readonly TerrainCell[]): DirectionalTerrain {
  const uphill = empty();
  const downhill = empty();
  let levelM = 0;
  let analyzedM = 0;
  let longestSteepClimb: SustainedSlope | null = null;
  let group: TerrainCell[] = [];

  function finish() {
    if (!group.length) return;
    const startM = group[0].startM;
    const endM = group[group.length - 1].endM;
    const length = endM - startM;
    if (length >= MIN_SUSTAINED_M && (!longestSteepClimb || length > longestSteepClimb.endM - longestSteepClimb.startM)) {
      const riseM = group.reduce((sum, cell) => sum + cell.gradePct * (cell.endM - cell.startM) / 100, 0);
      longestSteepClimb = { startM, endM, gainM: riseM, gradePct: riseM / length * 100,
        dayId: group[0].dayId, direction: "climb" };
    }
    group = [];
  }

  for (const cell of cells) {
    const lengthM = cell.endM - cell.startM;
    if (!Number.isFinite(cell.gradePct) || !Number.isFinite(lengthM) || lengthM <= 0) { finish(); continue; }
    analyzedM += lengthM;
    if (cell.gradePct >= NEAR_LEVEL_GRADE) accumulate(uphill, cell, lengthM);
    else if (cell.gradePct <= -NEAR_LEVEL_GRADE) accumulate(downhill, cell, lengthM);
    else levelM += lengthM;

    const previous = group[group.length - 1];
    const contiguous = !previous || (Math.abs(previous.endM - cell.startM) < 0.01 && previous.dayId === cell.dayId);
    if (cell.gradePct < SUSTAINED_GRADE || !contiguous) finish();
    if (cell.gradePct >= SUSTAINED_GRADE) group.push(cell);
  }
  finish();
  return { uphill, downhill, levelM, analyzedM, longestSteepClimb };
}

/** Collapse repeated terrain findings for the UI, not the underlying analysis.
 * A hardest and longest climb may legitimately be the same interval.
 */
export type TerrainFinding = { title: string; slope: SustainedSlope };

function sameInterval(a: SustainedSlope, b: SustainedSlope): boolean {
  return a.direction === b.direction && a.dayId === b.dayId &&
    Math.abs(a.startM - b.startM) < 0.01 && Math.abs(a.endM - b.endM) < 0.01;
}

export function notableTerrainFindings(
  hardestClimb: SustainedSlope | null,
  longestSteepClimb: SustainedSlope | null,
  hardestDescent: SustainedSlope | null,
): TerrainFinding[] {
  const findings: TerrainFinding[] = [];
  if (hardestClimb) findings.push({
    title: longestSteepClimb && sameInterval(hardestClimb, longestSteepClimb)
      ? "Hardest & longest steep climb" : "Hardest sustained climb",
    slope: hardestClimb,
  });
  if (longestSteepClimb && (!hardestClimb || !sameInterval(hardestClimb, longestSteepClimb))) {
    findings.push({ title: "Longest sustained steep climb", slope: longestSteepClimb });
  }
  if (hardestDescent) findings.push({ title: "Hardest sustained descent", slope: hardestDescent });
  return findings;
}

```

### `lib/trail-routing-server.ts`

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { requireBuildAccess } from "@/lib/build-access";
import { TRAIL_SNAP_RADIUS_M, validLatLng, type LatLng } from "@/lib/trail-routing";
import { buildORSRequest } from "@/lib/ors-request";
import { createOrsTrafficController, createOrsResultCache, retryAfterSeconds,
  OrsCooldownError, OrsQueueFullError } from "@/lib/ors-request-control";

export class TrailRoutingError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, public status: number, public retryAfterSeconds?: number) { super(message); }
}

export async function trailRoutingRequest(request: Request, expected: "snap" | "route") {
  if (!process.env.ORS_API_KEY) throw new TrailRoutingError("Trail routing is not configured. Set ORS_API_KEY on the server.", 503);
  if (Number(request.headers.get("content-length") ?? 0) > 2048) throw new TrailRoutingError("Route request too large.", 413);
  let body: Record<string, unknown>;
  try { body = await request.json(); }
  catch { throw new TrailRoutingError("Invalid route request.", 400); }
  if (!body || typeof body !== "object" || typeof body.buildId !== "string" || !body.buildId || body.buildId.length > 200) {
    throw new TrailRoutingError("Missing build ID.", 400);
  }
  if (expected === "snap") {
    if (!validLatLng(body.point)) throw new TrailRoutingError("Invalid waypoint coordinates.", 400);
  } else {
    if (!validLatLng(body.from) || !validLatLng(body.to)) throw new TrailRoutingError("Invalid route coordinates.", 400);
  }
  try { await requireBuildAccess(body.buildId); }
  catch { throw new TrailRoutingError("You cannot edit this build.", 403); }
  return body as { buildId: string; point?: LatLng; from?: LatLng; to?: LatLng };
}

// Cache parsed route/snap results only, not large raw GeoJSON payloads.
// Shared between both endpoints in one Node process; resets on server restart.
export const orsResultCache = createOrsResultCache();
const orsTraffic = createOrsTrafficController();

/** Call the matching ORS endpoint with the media type it actually produces. */
export async function queryORS(kind: "snap" | "route", coordinates: LatLng[]) {
  const { url, options } = buildORSRequest(
    kind,
    coordinates,
    process.env.ORS_API_KEY!,
    TRAIL_SNAP_RADIUS_M,
  );

  return orsTraffic.schedule(async () => {
    let response: Response;
    try {
      response = await fetch(url, {
        ...options,
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(12000),
        cache: "no-store",
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("openrouteservice connection failed:", error);
      throw new TrailRoutingError("Trail routing is temporarily unavailable.", 503);
    }

    if (!response.ok) {
      const details = await response.text().catch(() => "");
      console.error("openrouteservice routing error:", {
        kind, status: response.status, details: details.slice(0, 1000),
      });
      if (response.status === 401 || response.status === 403) {
        throw new TrailRoutingError("Routing API key was rejected or access is denied. Check ORS_API_KEY.", 503);
      }
      if (response.status === 429) {
        const seconds = retryAfterSeconds(response.headers.get("Retry-After"));
        orsTraffic.cooldown(seconds);
        throw new TrailRoutingError("Trail routing rate limit reached. Try again later.", 429, seconds);
      }
      if (response.status === 406) {
        throw new TrailRoutingError("The routing provider rejected the response format. Check ORS request headers.", 502);
      }
      // ORS uses HTTP 404 / code 2010 when a waypoint is outside its routable
      // hiking graph. This is a missing trail, not a missing API endpoint.
      if (response.status === 404 && kind === "route") {
        let code: unknown;
        try { code = (JSON.parse(details) as { error?: { code?: unknown } }).error?.code; }
        catch { /* Keep genuine endpoint errors distinguishable. */ }
        if (code === 2010) {
          throw new TrailRoutingError("No routable hiking trail found near one or more waypoints. Move the waypoint closer to a mapped trail or use a manual segment.", 422);
        }
      }
      if (response.status === 400 || response.status === 404) {
        throw new TrailRoutingError("The routing provider rejected the request or endpoint. Check server logs.", 502);
      }
      if (response.status === 422) {
        throw new TrailRoutingError(
          kind === "snap" ? "No hiking trail found within the snapping radius." : "No connected hiking route found for those stops.",
          422,
        );
      }
      throw new TrailRoutingError("Trail routing provider is temporarily unavailable.", 503);
    }

    try {
      return await response.json() as unknown;
    } catch {
      throw new TrailRoutingError("Routing provider returned an invalid JSON response.", 502);
    }
  }).catch(error => {
    if (error instanceof OrsCooldownError) throw new TrailRoutingError(error.message, 429, error.retryAfterSeconds);
    if (error instanceof OrsQueueFullError) throw new TrailRoutingError(error.message, 503);
    throw error;
  });

}

```

### `lib/trail-routing.ts`

```typescript
/** Pure helpers for trail-following route geometry. No routing-provider dependency. */
export type LatLng = [number, number];
export type TrailSegment = {
  toId: string;
  geometry: LatLng[];
  distanceM: number;
  source: "openrouteservice" | "gpx";
  /** Elevations returned by ORS, one height per simplified geometry vertex. */
  elevationsM?: number[];
  /** Provider-computed cumulative ascent / descent before geometry simplification. */
  ascentM?: number;
  descentM?: number;
};

export const TRAIL_SNAP_RADIUS_M = 75;
export const MAX_TRAIL_VERTICES = 400;

export function validLatLng(value: unknown): value is LatLng {
  return Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 2 &&
    typeof value[0] === "number" && Number.isFinite(value[0]) && Math.abs(value[0]) <= 90 &&
    typeof value[1] === "number" && Number.isFinite(value[1]) && Math.abs(value[1]) <= 180;
}


/** Reject invalid provider elevations; null never masquerades as sea level. */
export function validElevation(value: unknown): value is number {
  return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= -500 && value <= 9000;
}

function validAscent(value: unknown): value is number {
  return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 200000;
}

export function metersBetween(a: LatLng, b: LatLng): number {
  const radians = Math.PI / 180;
  const dLat = (b[0] - a[0]) * radians;
  const dLon = (b[1] - a[1]) * radians;
  const h = Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 + Math.cos(a[0] * radians) * Math.cos(b[0] * radians) * Math.sin(dLon / 2) ** 2;
  return 6371000 * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(h), Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - h)));
}

export function validTrailSegment(value: unknown): value is TrailSegment {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return false;
  const s = value as Partial<TrailSegment>;
  return typeof s.toId === "string" && !!s.toId && s.toId.length <= 200 &&
    (s.source === "openrouteservice" || s.source === "gpx") && typeof s.distanceM === "number" &&
    Number.isFinite(s.distanceM) && s.distanceM >= 0 && s.distanceM <= 1_000_000 &&
    Array.isArray(s.geometry) && s.geometry.length >= 2 && s.geometry.length <= MAX_TRAIL_VERTICES &&
    s.geometry.every(validLatLng) &&
    (s.elevationsM === undefined ||
      (Array.isArray(s.elevationsM) && s.elevationsM.length === s.geometry.length &&
        s.elevationsM.every(validElevation))) &&
    ((s.ascentM === undefined && s.descentM === undefined) ||
      (s.elevationsM !== undefined && validAscent(s.ascentM) && validAscent(s.descentM)));
}

/** A saved segment is never reused after a stop is moved or reordered. */
export function usableTrailSegment(
  start: { id: string; lat: number; lng: number; trailToNext?: TrailSegment },
  end: { id: string; lat: number; lng: number },
): TrailSegment | null {
  const segment = start.trailToNext;
  if (!validTrailSegment(segment) || segment.toId !== end.id) return null;
  const first = segment.geometry[0];
  const last = segment.geometry[segment.geometry.length - 1];
  if (metersBetween(first, [start.lat, start.lng]) > TRAIL_SNAP_RADIUS_M + 5 ||
      metersBetween(last, [end.lat, end.lng]) > TRAIL_SNAP_RADIUS_M + 5) return null;
  return segment;
}

/** Simplify noisy provider tracks without inventing straight-line trail sections. */
/** Return original indices so elevation and coordinates use identical sampled vertices. */
export function simplifyTrailIndices(
  points: LatLng[], maxVertices = MAX_TRAIL_VERTICES, elevationsM?: readonly number[],
): number[] {
  if (points.length <= maxVertices) return points.map((_, index) => index);
  if (maxVertices < 2) throw new Error("At least two route vertices are required.");
  const project = (p: LatLng) => [p[1] * Math.cos(p[0] * Math.PI / 180), p[0]];
  function shrink(tolerance: number): number[] {
    const keep = new Set([0, points.length - 1]);
    const visit = (a: number, b: number) => {
      if (b <= a + 1) return;
      const [ax, ay] = project(points[a]), [bx, by] = project(points[b]);
      let best = -1, distance = tolerance * tolerance;
      for (let i = a + 1; i < b; i++) {
        const [px, py] = project(points[i]);
        const dx = bx - ax, dy = by - ay;
        const t = dx * dx + dy * dy ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((px - ax) * dx + (py - ay) * dy) / (dx * dx + dy * dy))) : 0;
        const planarError = (px - ax - t * dx) ** 2 + (py - ay - t * dy) ** 2;
        // Retain meaningful vertical peaks even on geometrically straight paths.
        // Elevation is in metres; ~111 km/degree keeps it comparable to XY error.
        const verticalError = elevationsM
          ? ((elevationsM[i] - elevationsM[a] - t * (elevationsM[b] - elevationsM[a])) / 111195) ** 2
          : 0;
        const d = planarError + verticalError;
        if (d > distance) { distance = d; best = i; }
      }
      if (best > 0) { keep.add(best); visit(a, best); visit(best, b); }
    };
    visit(0, points.length - 1);
    return [...keep].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  }
  let tolerance = 0.000005;
  let indices = points.map((_, i) => i);
  for (let i = 0; i < 24 && indices.length > maxVertices; i++) {
    indices = shrink(tolerance);
    tolerance *= 1.8;
  }
  if (indices.length > maxVertices) throw new Error("Trail geometry is too detailed to display accurately.");
  return indices;
}

/** Simplify noisy provider tracks without inventing straight-line trail sections. */
export function simplifyTrail(points: LatLng[], maxVertices = MAX_TRAIL_VERTICES): LatLng[] {
  return simplifyTrailIndices(points, maxVertices).map(index => points[index]);
}

export function parseSnapResponse(data: unknown): { point: LatLng; distanceM: number } | null {
  const root = data as { locations?: Array<null | { location?: unknown; snapped_distance?: unknown }> } | null;
  const result = root?.locations?.[0];
  if (!result || !validLatLng(Array.isArray(result.location) ? [result.location[1], result.location[0]] : null)) return null;
  const point: LatLng = [Number((result.location as number[])[1]), Number((result.location as number[])[0])];
  const distanceM = result.snapped_distance;
  if (typeof distanceM !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(distanceM) || distanceM < 0 || distanceM > TRAIL_SNAP_RADIUS_M + 1) return null;
  return { point, distanceM };
}

/** Parse two- or three-dimensional ORS GeoJSON without trusting malformed elevation values. */
export function parseRouteResponse(
  data: unknown, from: LatLng, to: LatLng,
): { geometry: LatLng[]; distanceM: number; elevationsM?: number[]; ascentM?: number; descentM?: number } | null {
  const root = data as {
    features?: Array<{
      geometry?: { type?: string; coordinates?: unknown };
      properties?: { summary?: { distance?: unknown; ascent?: unknown; descent?: unknown } };
    }>;
  } | null;
  const feature = root?.features?.[0];
  if (feature?.geometry?.type !== "LineString" || !Array.isArray(feature.geometry.coordinates)) return null;
  const coordinates = feature.geometry.coordinates;
  if (coordinates.length < 2 || coordinates.length > 50000) return null;
  const geometry: LatLng[] = [];
  const rawElevations: number[] = [];
  let allElevationsValid = true;
  for (const pair of coordinates) {
    if (!Array.isArray(pair)) return null;
    const point: LatLng = [pair[1], pair[0]];
    if (!validLatLng(point)) return null;
    geometry.push([Number(point[0].toFixed(6)), Number(point[1].toFixed(6))]);
    if (pair.length < 3 || !validElevation(pair[2])) allElevationsValid = false;
    else rawElevations.push(Number(pair[2].toFixed(1)));
  }
  if (metersBetween(geometry[0], from) > TRAIL_SNAP_RADIUS_M + 5 ||
      metersBetween(geometry[geometry.length - 1], to) > TRAIL_SNAP_RADIUS_M + 5) return null;
  const distanceM = feature.properties?.summary?.distance;
  if (typeof distanceM !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(distanceM) || distanceM <= 0 || distanceM > 1_000_000) return null;
  const indices = simplifyTrailIndices(geometry, MAX_TRAIL_VERTICES, allElevationsValid ? rawElevations : undefined);
  const result: { geometry: LatLng[]; distanceM: number; elevationsM?: number[]; ascentM?: number; descentM?: number } = {
    geometry: indices.map(index => geometry[index]), distanceM,
  };
  if (allElevationsValid) {
    result.elevationsM = indices.map(index => rawElevations[index]);
    const { ascent, descent } = feature.properties?.summary ?? {};
    if (validAscent(ascent) && validAscent(descent)) {
      result.ascentM = ascent;
      result.descentM = descent;
    }
  }
  return result;
}
```

### `lib/trip-arrangements.ts`

```typescript
/** Private, structured permits and non-campsite bookings. Campsite bookings
 * continue using phase6.bookings so there is only one authoritative record. */
export const ARRANGEMENT_KINDS = ["permit", "reservation", "other"] as const;
export const ARRANGEMENT_CATEGORIES = ["other", "hut", "shuttle", "ferry", "parking", "rental"] as const;
// "cancelled" remains readable for older saved entries, but is not a choice
// in the new four-stage booking progress control.
export const ARRANGEMENT_STATUSES = ["not_required", "planned", "pending", "confirmed", "cancelled"] as const;
export type ArrangementKind = (typeof ARRANGEMENT_KINDS)[number];
export type ArrangementCategory = (typeof ARRANGEMENT_CATEGORIES)[number];
export type ArrangementStatus = (typeof ARRANGEMENT_STATUSES)[number];
export type TripArrangement = {
  id: string;
  kind: ArrangementKind;
  category: ArrangementCategory;
  name: string;
  status: ArrangementStatus;
  startDate: string;
  endDate: string;
  provider: string;
  confirmation: string;
  bookingUrl: string;
  notes: string;
  dayId: string;
  /** Optional link to a real overnight waypoint for hut/shelter reservations. */
  waypointId?: string;
};
const caps: Record<keyof TripArrangement, number> = {
  id: 100, kind: 20, category: 20, name: 200, status: 20,
  startDate: 10, endDate: 10, provider: 150, confirmation: 120,
  bookingUrl: 500, notes: 750, dayId: 200, waypointId: 200,
};
const isDate = (s: string) => !s || /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s) && (() => {
  const date = new Date(`${s}T12:00:00Z`);
  return Number.isFinite(date.getTime()) && date.toISOString().slice(0, 10) === s;
})();
export function validateArrangements(input: unknown, validDayIds?: readonly string[], validCampIds?: readonly string[]): TripArrangement[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(input) || input.length > 80) throw new Error("Up to 80 permits and reservations are supported.");
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  return input.map(value => {
    if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) throw new Error("Invalid permit or reservation.");
    const raw = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (Object.keys(raw).some(key => !(key in caps))) throw new Error("Unknown permit or reservation field.");
    const values = {} as Record<keyof TripArrangement, string>;
    for (const [key, max] of Object.entries(caps) as [keyof TripArrangement, number][]) {
      const v = raw[key];
      if (key === "waypointId" && v === undefined) continue;
      if (typeof v !== "string" || v.length > max) throw new Error(`Invalid reservation ${key}.`);
      values[key] = v.trim();
    }
    const entry = values as unknown as TripArrangement;
    if (!entry.id || seen.has(entry.id)) throw new Error("Duplicate or missing reservation ID.");
    seen.add(entry.id);
    if (!entry.name || !ARRANGEMENT_KINDS.includes(entry.kind) || !ARRANGEMENT_CATEGORIES.includes(entry.category) || !ARRANGEMENT_STATUSES.includes(entry.status)) throw new Error("Invalid reservation type, name, or status.");
    if (entry.kind === "permit" && entry.category !== "other") throw new Error("Permits do not require a reservation category.");
    if (!isDate(entry.startDate) || !isDate(entry.endDate) || (entry.startDate && entry.endDate && entry.endDate < entry.startDate)) throw new Error("Invalid reservation dates.");
    if (entry.bookingUrl) {
      try { if (new URL(entry.bookingUrl).protocol !== "https:") throw new Error(); }
      catch { throw new Error("Use an HTTPS booking URL."); }
    }
    if (validDayIds && entry.dayId && !validDayIds.includes(entry.dayId)) throw new Error("Reservation refers to a removed trip day.");
    if (entry.waypointId && entry.category !== "hut") throw new Error("Only hut reservations may link to overnight stops.");
    if (validCampIds && entry.waypointId && !validCampIds.includes(entry.waypointId)) throw new Error("Reservation refers to a removed overnight stop.");
    return entry;
  });
}
export function readArrangements(logistics: unknown): TripArrangement[] {
  if (!logistics || typeof logistics !== "object" || Array.isArray(logistics)) return [];
  const value = (logistics as Record<string,unknown>).arrangements;
  if (value === undefined) return [];
  try { return validateArrangements(value); } catch { return []; }
}
```

```typescript
"use server";

import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import { requireBuildAccess } from "@/lib/build-access";
import { analyzePack } from "@/lib/pack-analysis";
import { readLogistics, readWaypoints } from "@/lib/trip-planner";
import { readPrivateResources } from "@/lib/trip-resources";
import { readFoodPlan } from "@/lib/food-plan";
import type { TripExport } from "@/lib/trip-resources-export";

/** Read-only export projection, including live catalog item weights and categories.
 * The caller must have access to this build; private information is filtered
 * by each individual export format, not by this owner-only server action.
 */
export async function getTripExportData(buildId: string): Promise<TripExport> {
  const access = await requireBuildAccess(buildId);
  const build = await prisma.build.findUnique({
    where: { id: access.id, userId: access.userId },
    include: {
      days: { orderBy: { date: "asc" } },
      items: { include: { gear: { select: {
        name: true, weight_g: true, price_cad: true,
        category: { select: { name: true } },
      } } } },
    },
  });
  if (!build) throw new Error("Build not found.");
  return {
    name: build.name,
    people: build.people,
    days: build.days,
    points: readWaypoints(build.routeWaypoints),
    logistics: readLogistics(build.tripLogistics),
    bookings: readPrivateResources(build.tripLogistics).bookings,
    packLines: analyzePack(build.items).lines,
    foodPlan: readFoodPlan(build.tripLogistics),
  };
}
```

```typescript
"use server";
import { requireBuildAccess, requireTripDayAccess } from "@/lib/build-access";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { getDestination } from "@/lib/destinations";
import { getDateRange } from "@/lib/trip";

import { mutateBuildWithRevision } from "@/lib/build-history";

const text = (f: FormData, key: string, max = 5000) => { const v = f.get(key); if (v != null && typeof v !== "string") throw new Error(`Invalid ${key}.`); const s = (v ?? "").trim(); if (s.length > max) throw new Error(`${key} is too long (maximum ${max} characters).`); return s || null; };
const number = (f: FormData, key: string, min: number, max: number, integer = false) => nullableNumber(f.get(key),key,min,max,integer);
const condition = (f: FormData) => { const v = text(f,"conditions",20); if (v && !["dry","rain","snow"].includes(v)) throw new Error("Choose a valid weather condition."); return v; };
export async function saveTripDetails(f: FormData) {
  const buildId = text(f,"buildId",200)!;
  const access = await requireBuildAccess(buildId);
  const dates = parseDates(text(f,"startDate",10) ?? "", text(f,"endDate",10) ?? "");
  const selected = getDestination(text(f,"destinationId",200));
  const lat = selected?.latitude ?? number(f,"locationLat",-90,90), lng = selected?.longitude ?? number(f,"locationLng",-180,180);
  if ((lat == null) !== (lng == null)) throw new Error("Provide both location coordinates.");
  const data = { ...dates, destinationId: selected?.id ?? null, location: selected ? `${selected.name}, ${selected.park}` : text(f,"location",500), locationLat: lat, locationLng: lng, people: number(f,"people",1,100,true) ?? 1, minTemperature: number(f,"minTemperature",-100,60,true), conditions: condition(f) };
  await mutateBuildWithRevision(buildId, access.userId, "trip", "Updated trip details", async tx => {
    const old = await tx.tripDay.findMany({ where: { buildId }, select: { id: true, date: true } });
    const range = dates.startDate && dates.endDate ? getDateRange(dates.startDate,dates.endDate) : [];
    const keys = new Set(range.map(d => d.getTime()));
    if (old.some(d => !keys.has(d.date.getTime())) && f.get("confirmDateChange") !== "yes") throw new Error("The new dates remove itinerary days. Tick the confirmation box to discard those days. Days still within the range will be kept.");
    const removedIds = new Set(old.filter((day) => !keys.has(day.date.getTime())).map((day) => day.id));
    if (removedIds.size) {
      const build = await tx.build.findUnique({ where: { id: buildId, userId: access.userId }, select: { routeWaypoints: true, tripLogistics: true } });
      const route = validatedRoute(build?.routeWaypoints);
      // Avoid leaving saved meals pointed at deleted TripDay IDs. Resupply entries
      // remain attached to mapped stops and can be re-assigned to another day.
      const root = build?.tripLogistics;
      if (root && typeof root === "object" && !Array.isArray(root)) {
        const data = root as Record<string, unknown>;
        const food = data.phase7;
        if (food && typeof food === "object" && !Array.isArray(food)) {
          const phase7 = food as Record<string, unknown>;
          if (Array.isArray(phase7.meals)) {
            await tx.build.update({where:{id:buildId,userId:access.userId},data:{tripLogistics:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({
              ...data, phase7: {...phase7, meals:phase7.meals.filter(meal =>
                !!meal && typeof meal === "object" && !removedIds.has((meal as {dayId?:string}).dayId || "")),
              },
            }))}});
          }
        }
      }
      if (route) {
        const points = route.map((point) => point.dayId && removedIds.has(point.dayId) ? { ...point, dayId: null } : point);
        await tx.build.update({ where: { id: buildId, userId: access.userId }, data: { routeWaypoints: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(points)) } });
      }
    }
    await tx.build.update({ where: { id: buildId, userId: access.userId }, data });
    if (range.length) await tx.tripDay.createMany({ data: range.map(date => ({ buildId,date })), skipDuplicates: true });
    await tx.tripDay.deleteMany({ where: { buildId, date: { notIn: range } } });
  });
  revalidatePath(`/build/${buildId}`);
}
export async function saveTripDay(f: FormData) {
  const buildId = text(f,"buildId",200)!, dayId = text(f,"dayId",200)!;
  const day = await requireTripDayAccess(buildId,dayId);
  // Compact day editor omits notes; do not overwrite independently edited day notes.
  const strings = Object.fromEntries(dayTextFields.filter(key => f.has(key)).map(key => [key,text(f,key)]));
  const data = { ...strings, conditions: condition(f), minTemperature: number(f,"minTemperature",-100,60,true), distanceKm: number(f,"distanceKm",0,1000), elevationGainM: number(f,"elevationGainM",0,20000,true), elevationLossM: number(f,"elevationLossM",0,20000,true), durationMinutes: number(f,"durationMinutes",0,1440,true), waterCarryL: number(f,"waterCarryL",0,100) };
  await mutateBuildWithRevision(buildId, day.accessUserId, "itinerary", "Updated itinerary day", async tx => {
    await tx.tripDay.update({ where: { id: dayId, buildId, build: { userId: day.accessUserId } }, data });
  });
  revalidatePath(`/build/${buildId}`);
}
export async function saveTripDaySummary(f: FormData) {
  const buildId = text(f, "buildId", 200)!, dayId = text(f, "dayId", 200)!;
  const day = await requireTripDayAccess(buildId, dayId);
  const summary = text(f, "summary", 100);
  await mutateBuildWithRevision(buildId, day.accessUserId, "itinerary", "Updated day summary", async tx => {
    await tx.tripDay.update({ where: { id: dayId, buildId, build: { userId: day.accessUserId } }, data: { activities: summary } });
  });

}
export async function saveTripDayNote(f: FormData) {
  const buildId = text(f,"buildId",200)!, dayId = text(f,"dayId",200)!;
  const day = await requireTripDayAccess(buildId, dayId);
  const note = text(f, "note", 5000);
  await mutateBuildWithRevision(buildId, day.accessUserId, "itinerary", "Updated day note", async tx => {
    await tx.tripDay.update({ where: { id: dayId, buildId, build: { userId: day.accessUserId } }, data: { notes: note } });
  });
  revalidatePath(`/build/${buildId}`);
}
export async function saveTripRoute(f: FormData) {
  const buildId = text(f,"buildId",200)!, access = await requireBuildAccess(buildId);
  const raw: unknown = JSON.parse(text(f,"waypoints",1500000) ?? "[]");
  const validatedPoints = validatedRoute(raw);
  if (!validatedPoints) throw new Error("Route must be a list of stops.");
  await mutateBuildWithRevision(buildId, access.userId, "route", "Updated trip route", async tx => {
    const tripDays = await tx.tripDay.findMany({ where:{ buildId }, select:{ id:true,date:true } });
    const merged = consolidateOvernightStops(validatedPoints, tripDays);
    const points = validatedRoute(merged.points);
    if (!points) throw new Error("Cannot save the merged overnight route.");
    const { replacedIds } = merged;
    const assignedIds = [...new Set(points.map(p => p.dayId).filter((v): v is string => typeof v === "string"))];
    if (assignedIds.length) {
      const matchingDays = await tx.tripDay.findMany({
        where: { buildId, id: { in: assignedIds } }, select: { id: true },
      });
      if (matchingDays.length !== assignedIds.length) {
        throw new Error("One or more route stops refer to a removed trip day. Reassign those stops and try again.");
      }
    }
    const existingBuild = await tx.build.findUnique({ where: { id: buildId, userId: access.userId }, select:{ tripLogistics:true, routeWaypoints:true } });
    const previous = validatedRoute(existingBuild?.routeWaypoints) ?? [];
    const formerIds = consolidateOvernightStops(previous, tripDays).replacedIds;
    const currentIds = new Set(points.map(point=>point.id));
    // The client submits a canonical one-pin route. Recover old foreign-key
    // mappings from the SAVED route so linked reservations are not orphaned.
    const bookingRedirects = { ...formerIds, ...replacedIds };
    const root = existingBuild?.tripLogistics && typeof existingBuild.tripLogistics === "object" && !Array.isArray(existingBuild.tripLogistics)
      ? existingBuild.tripLogistics as Record<string,unknown> : {};
    const previousCamps = readPrivateResources(root);
    const phase6 = Object.keys(bookingRedirects).length ? { ...previousCamps,
      bookings: previousCamps.bookings.map(booking=>{
        const target = bookingRedirects[booking.waypointId];
        return {...booking, waypointId: target && currentIds.has(target) && !currentIds.has(booking.waypointId) ? target : booking.waypointId};
      }) } : undefined;
    const arrangements = Object.keys(bookingRedirects).length && Array.isArray(root.arrangements)
      ? validateArrangements(root.arrangements).map(entry => {
          const target = bookingRedirects[entry.waypointId ?? ""];
          return target && currentIds.has(target) && !currentIds.has(entry.waypointId ?? "")
            ? {...entry, waypointId: target} : entry;
        }) : undefined;
    await tx.build.update({
      where: { id: buildId, userId: access.userId },
      data: {
        routeWaypoints: points.map(p => ({ ...p, name: p.name.trim(), ...(p.dayId ? { dayId: p.dayId } : {}) })),
        ...(phase6 || arrangements ? { tripLogistics: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({ ...root, ...(phase6 ? { phase6 } : {}), ...(arrangements ? {arrangements} : {}) })) } : {}),
      },
    });
    // Route geometry is authoritative for COMPLETE, same-day mapped sections.
    // Keep user-entered day summaries untouched for unknown, partial, or unassigned sections.
    // TripDay summaries keep a stable base pace; user-selected hiking preferences
    // are stored separately in tripLogistics.routeTiming and shown by Route Analysis.
    if (assignedIds.length) {
      const dayMetrics = computeRouteMetrics(points, assignedIds.map(id => ({ id })), DEFAULT_HIKING_PACE_KMH);
      for (const data of completeDaySummaries(dayMetrics)) {
        const { dayId, ...values } = data;
        await tx.tripDay.update({ where: { id: dayId, buildId }, data: values });
      }
    }
  });
  revalidatePath(`/build/${buildId}`);
}
export async function saveTripLogistics(f: FormData) {
  const buildId = text(f,"buildId",200)!, access = await requireBuildAccess(buildId);
  const value = parseLogistics(Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(emptyLogistics).map(key=>[key,text(f,key) ?? ""])))!;
  await mutateBuildWithRevision(buildId, access.userId, "logistics", "Updated trip logistics", async tx => {
    // Preserve private campsite reservations and water-planning preferences when
    // the legacy seven-field logistics form autosaves.
    const existing = await tx.build.findUnique({ where: { id: buildId, userId: access.userId }, select: { tripLogistics: true } });
    const root = existing?.tripLogistics && typeof existing.tripLogistics === "object" && !Array.isArray(existing.tripLogistics) ? existing.tripLogistics as Record<string, unknown> : {};
    await tx.build.update({ where: { id: buildId, userId: access.userId }, data: { tripLogistics: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({ ...root, ...value })) } });
  });
  revalidatePath(`/build/${buildId}`);
}



/** Private campsite booking tracker, stored inside the existing JSON field without a migration. */
export async function saveTripResources(f: FormData) {
  const buildId = text(f, "buildId", 200)!;
  const access = await requireBuildAccess(buildId);
  const raw = JSON.parse(text(f, "resources", 40000) ?? "null") as unknown;
  await mutateBuildWithRevision(buildId, access.userId, "logistics", "Updated campsites and water plan", async tx => {
    const [build, days] = await Promise.all([
      tx.build.findUnique({ where: { id: buildId, userId: access.userId }, select: { tripLogistics: true, routeWaypoints: true } }),
      tx.tripDay.findMany({ where: { buildId }, select: { id: true } }),
    ]);
    if (!build) throw new Error("Trip not found.");
    const route = validatedRoute(build.routeWaypoints) ?? [];
    const phase6 = validatePrivateResources(raw, days.map(d => d.id), route.filter(p => p.kind === "camp").map(p => p.id));
    const root = build.tripLogistics && typeof build.tripLogistics === "object" && !Array.isArray(build.tripLogistics) ? build.tripLogistics as Record<string, unknown> : {};
    await tx.build.update({ where: { id: buildId, userId: access.userId }, data: { tripLogistics: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({ ...root, phase6 })) } });
  });
  revalidatePath(`/build/${buildId}`);
}

    const build = await tx.build.findUnique({ where: { id: buildId, userId: access.userId }, select: { tripLogistics: true } });
    if (!build) throw new Error("Trip not found.");
    const root = build.tripLogistics && typeof build.tripLogistics === "object" && !Array.isArray(build.tripLogistics) ? build.tripLogistics as Record<string, unknown> : {};
    // Validate only the incoming settings; preserve the *exact* existing
    // booking records, including older records that another UI may be editing.
    const incoming = validatePrivateResources({ settings: raw, bookings: [] }, [], []);
    const previous = root.phase6 && typeof root.phase6 === "object" && !Array.isArray(root.phase6)
      ? root.phase6 as Record<string, unknown> : {};
    await tx.build.update({ where: { id: buildId, userId: access.userId }, data: {
      tripLogistics: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({ ...root, phase6: { ...previous, settings: incoming.settings } })),

    if (!build) throw new Error("Trip not found.");
    const points = validatedRoute(build.routeWaypoints) ?? [];
    const phase7 = validateFoodPlan(raw, days.map(d=>d.id), points);
    const root = build.tripLogistics && typeof build.tripLogistics === "object" && !Array.isArray(build.tripLogistics) ? build.tripLogistics as Record<string, unknown> : {};
    await tx.build.update({ where: { id: buildId, userId: access.userId }, data: { tripLogistics: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({ ...root, phase7 })) } });

/** Save only hiking-time preferences; never save an in-progress route draft here. */
export async function saveRouteTimingPreferences(f: FormData) {
  const buildId = text(f, "buildId", 200)!;
  const access = await requireBuildAccess(buildId);
  const settings = validateRouteTimingPreferences(JSON.parse(text(f, "settings", 2500) ?? "null") as unknown);
  await mutateBuildWithRevision(buildId, access.userId, "route-timing", "Updated hiking settings", async tx => {
    const current = await tx.build.findUnique({ where: { id: buildId, userId: access.userId }, select: { tripLogistics: true } });
    if (!current) throw new Error("Trip not found.");
    const root = current.tripLogistics && typeof current.tripLogistics === "object" && !Array.isArray(current.tripLogistics)
      ? current.tripLogistics as Record<string, unknown> : {};
    await tx.build.update({
      where: { id: buildId, userId: access.userId },
      data: { tripLogistics: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({ ...root, [ROUTE_TIMING_KEY]: settings })) },
    });
  });
  revalidatePath(`/build/${buildId}`);
}


/** Save one permit, non-camp reservation, or the EXISTING phase6 campsite record.
 * Other logistics fields, water assumptions, and food data are untouched. */
export async function saveTripBooking(f: FormData) {
  const buildId = text(f, "buildId", 200)!;
  const access = await requireBuildAccess(buildId);
  const operation = text(f, "operation", 12);
  const source = text(f, "source", 20);
  if (!(["upsert", "delete"].includes(operation || "") && ["camp", "arrangement"].includes(source || ""))) throw new Error("Invalid booking operation.");
  const raw = text(f, "booking", 6000);
  if (!raw) throw new Error("Missing booking details.");
  let payload: unknown;
  try { payload = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { throw new Error("Invalid booking details."); }
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== "object" || Array.isArray(payload)) throw new Error("Invalid booking details.");
  const incoming = payload as Record<string, unknown>;
  const id = incoming.id;
  if (typeof id !== "string" || !id || id.length > 100) throw new Error("Invalid booking ID.");
  const saved = await mutateBuildWithRevision(buildId, access.userId, "logistics", "Updated permits and reservations", async tx => {
    const [build, days] = await Promise.all([
      tx.build.findUnique({ where: { id: buildId, userId: access.userId }, select: { tripLogistics: true, routeWaypoints: true } }),
      tx.tripDay.findMany({ where: { buildId }, select: { id: true } }),
    ]);
    if (!build) throw new Error("Trip not found.");
    const root = build.tripLogistics && typeof build.tripLogistics === "object" && !Array.isArray(build.tripLogistics) ? build.tripLogistics as Record<string, unknown> : {};
    const dayIds = days.map(day => day.id);
    const campIds = (validatedRoute(build.routeWaypoints) ?? []).filter(point => point.kind === "camp").map(point => point.id);
    const currentCamps = readPrivateResources(root);
    // Retain old bookings if a route stop or itinerary day was subsequently removed.
    // Clear only dangling links; do not discard the booking or confirmation details.
    currentCamps.bookings = currentCamps.bookings.map(booking => ({
      ...booking,
      dayId: booking.dayId && !dayIds.includes(booking.dayId) ? "" : booking.dayId,
      waypointId: booking.waypointId && !campIds.includes(booking.waypointId) ? "" : booking.waypointId,
    }));
    const currentArrangements = validateArrangements(root.arrangements ?? []).map(entry => ({
      ...entry, dayId: entry.dayId && !dayIds.includes(entry.dayId) ? "" : entry.dayId,
      ...(entry.waypointId && !campIds.includes(entry.waypointId) ? {waypointId: ""} : {}),
    }));
    if (source === "camp") {
      if (operation === "upsert") {
        if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(incoming, "status")) throw new Error("Missing campsite booking status.");
        const next = currentCamps.bookings.filter(row => row.id !== id).concat(incoming as import("@/lib/trip-resources").CampBooking);
        const updated = validatePrivateResources({ ...currentCamps, bookings: next }, dayIds, campIds);
        if (updated.bookings.some(row => row.id !== id && row.waypointId && row.waypointId === incoming.waypointId && row.arrival === incoming.arrival && row.departure === incoming.departure)) throw new Error("That campsite already has a booking for these dates. Edit the existing entry.");
        currentCamps.bookings = updated.bookings;
      } else {
        if (!currentCamps.bookings.some(row => row.id === id)) throw new Error("Campsite booking not found.");
        currentCamps.bookings = currentCamps.bookings.filter(row => row.id !== id);
      }
    } else if (source === "arrangement") {
      const next = currentArrangements.filter(row => row.id !== id);
      if (operation === "upsert") next.push(incoming as import("@/lib/trip-arrangements").TripArrangement);
      else if (next.length === currentArrangements.length) throw new Error("Reservation not found.");
      const validated = validateArrangements(next, dayIds, campIds);
      root.arrangements = validated;
    }
    // A separate field is used for these records. Keep water and food data;
    // obsolete freeform permit/reservation notes are intentionally cleared.
    const phase6 = { ...currentCamps, bookings: currentCamps.bookings };
    const arrangements = source === "arrangement" ? root.arrangements as import("@/lib/trip-arrangements").TripArrangement[] : currentArrangements;
    await tx.build.update({ where: { id: buildId, userId: access.userId }, data: {
      tripLogistics: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({ ...root, permits:"", reservations:"", phase6, arrangements })),
    } });
    return { arrangements, bookings: phase6.bookings };
  });
  revalidatePath(`/build/${buildId}`);
  return saved;
}


/** Add a real overnight stop from the booking editor without requiring a
 * trailhead or existing hiking route. Conflict-check the source snapshot so
 * a stale Logistics panel cannot overwrite newer map edits. */
export async function addBookingCampsiteStop(f: FormData) {
  const buildId = text(f, "buildId", 200)!;
  const access = await requireBuildAccess(buildId);
  const dayId = text(f, "dayId", 200);
  const name = text(f, "name", 200);
  const latitude = number(f, "lat", -90, 90);
  const longitude = number(f, "lng", -180, 180);
  const expectedRoute = text(f, "expectedRoute", 1500000) ?? "[]";
  if (!name || !dayId || latitude === null || longitude === null) throw new Error("Choose a campground and an itinerary day.");
  const id = crypto.randomUUID();
  const point = {id, name, kind: "camp" as const, lat: latitude, lng: longitude, elevationM: null, dayId};
  await mutateBuildWithRevision(buildId, access.userId, "route", "Added overnight campsite", async tx => {
    const [build, days] = await Promise.all([
      tx.build.findUnique({where:{id:buildId,userId:access.userId},select:{routeWaypoints:true}}),
      tx.tripDay.findMany({where:{buildId},select:{id:true,date:true}}),
    ]);
    if (!build) throw new Error("Trip not found.");
    const old = validatedRoute(build.routeWaypoints) ?? [];
    let expected: unknown;
    try { expected = JSON.parse(expectedRoute); } catch { throw new Error("Invalid itinerary snapshot."); }
    const normalizedExpected = validatedRoute(expected);
    if (!normalizedExpected || JSON.stringify(old) !== JSON.stringify(normalizedExpected)) throw new Error("The itinerary changed. Reload before adding a campground so your route edits are preserved.");
    if (old.length >= 200) throw new Error("The route already has 200 stops.");
    if (!days.some(day => day.id === dayId)) throw new Error("That trip day no longer exists.");
    const ordered = [...days].sort((a,b)=>+new Date(a.date)-+new Date(b.date));
    const targetIndex = ordered.findIndex(day => day.id === dayId);
    let insertAt = old.length;
    for (let i=0;i<old.length;i++) {
      const dayIndex=ordered.findIndex(day => day.id === old[i].dayId);
      if (dayIndex > targetIndex) {insertAt=i;break;}
    }
    // Within the selected day, append after existing stops rather than
    // placing a campsite before the day's trailhead.
    const result = [...old.slice(0,insertAt),point,...old.slice(insertAt)];
    if (insertAt > 0) {
      result[insertAt-1] = {...result[insertAt-1], trailToNext:undefined, viaToNext:undefined};
    }
    const validated = validatedRoute(result);
    if (!validated) throw new Error("Could not add the campsite to this itinerary.");
    await tx.build.update({where:{id:buildId,userId:access.userId},data:{routeWaypoints:validated}});
  });
  revalidatePath(`/build/${buildId}`);
  return point;
}
```

```typescript
import type { TrailSegment, LatLng } from "./trail-routing";
import { validShapingWaypoints } from "./route-shaping";
import type { ResourceAnnotation } from "./trip-resources";

export type Waypoint = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  elevationM: number | null;
  dayId?: string | null;
  time?: string | null;
  /** Morning departure for the next day; the overnight campsite itself keeps one ID. */
  nextDayDepartureTime?: string | null;
  nextDayDepartureNote?: string | null;
  /** Optional minutes spent at this stop before continuing. */
  stayMinutes?: number | null;
  note?: string | null;
  kind: "trailhead" | "camp" | "water" | "resupply" | "waypoint";
  /** Non-sensitive campsite, water, or resupply observations; private booking data is stored separately. */
  resource?: ResourceAnnotation;
  /** Route geometry from this stop to the next stop. Optional for legacy/manual routes. */
  trailToNext?: TrailSegment;
  /** Explicit straight-line fallback when a trail cannot be found. */
  manualToNext?: boolean;
  /** Ordered via coordinates between this saved stop and the next. Not itinerary stops. */
  viaToNext?: LatLng[];
};
export type Logistics = { permits: string; reservations: string; transportation: string; parking: string; emergencyContact: string; emergencyPlan: string; notes: string };
export const emptyLogistics: Logistics = { permits: "", reservations: "", transportation: "", parking: "", emergencyContact: "", emergencyPlan: "", notes: "" };
export type PlannerDay = { id: string; date: Date; minTemperature: number | null; conditions: string | null; notes: string | null; startLocation: string | null; endLocation: string | null; distanceKm: number | null; elevationGainM: number | null; elevationLossM: number | null; durationMinutes: number | null; campsite: string | null; reservation: string | null; waterSource: string | null; waterCarryL: number | null; trailConditions: string | null; activities: string | null };
export type PlannerBuild = { id: string; name?: string; location: string | null; locationLat: number | null; locationLng: number | null; startDate: Date | null; endDate: Date | null; people: number; minTemperature: number | null; conditions: string | null; days: PlannerDay[]; routeWaypoints?: unknown; tripLogistics?: unknown };
export const dayTextFields = ["startLocation", "endLocation", "campsite", "reservation", "waterSource", "trailConditions", "activities", "notes"] as const;
export function plannedDay(day: PlannerDay) { return !!(day.startLocation?.trim() && day.endLocation?.trim() && day.distanceKm != null); }
export function tripTotals(days: PlannerDay[]) {
  const sum = (key: "distanceKm" | "elevationGainM" | "elevationLossM" | "durationMinutes") => days.reduce((n,d) => n + (d[key] ?? 0), 0);
  return { distanceKm: sum("distanceKm"), gainM: sum("elevationGainM"), lossM: sum("elevationLossM"), minutes: sum("durationMinutes"), measuredDays: days.filter(d => d.distanceKm != null).length, plannedDays: days.filter(plannedDay).length };
}
export function readWaypoints(value: unknown): Waypoint[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  return value.filter((p): p is Waypoint => !!p && typeof p === "object" && typeof p.id === "string" && typeof p.name === "string" && Number.isFinite(p.lat) && Number.isFinite(p.lng) && Math.abs(p.lat) <= 90 && Math.abs(p.lng) <= 180 && ["trailhead","camp","water","resupply","waypoint"].includes(p.kind) && (p.elevationM === null || Number.isFinite(p.elevationM)) && (p.dayId === undefined || p.dayId === null || (typeof p.dayId === "string" && p.dayId.length > 0 && p.dayId.length <= 200)) && (p.time === undefined || p.time === null || (typeof p.time === "string" && (!p.time || /^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/.test(p.time)))) && (p.nextDayDepartureTime === undefined || p.nextDayDepartureTime === null || (typeof p.nextDayDepartureTime === "string" && (!p.nextDayDepartureTime || /^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/.test(p.nextDayDepartureTime)))) && (p.nextDayDepartureNote === undefined || p.nextDayDepartureNote === null || (typeof p.nextDayDepartureNote === "string" && p.nextDayDepartureNote.length <= 500)) && (p.note === undefined || p.note === null || (typeof p.note === "string" && p.note.length <= 500)) && (p.stayMinutes === undefined || p.stayMinutes === null || (Number.isSafeInteger(p.stayMinutes) && p.stayMinutes >= 0 && p.stayMinutes <= 240)) && (p.manualToNext === undefined || typeof p.manualToNext === "boolean") && (p.viaToNext === undefined || validShapingWaypoints(p.viaToNext)));
}
export function readLogistics(value: unknown): Logistics {
  const result = { ...emptyLogistics };
  if (value && typeof value === "object") for (const key of Object.keys(result) as (keyof Logistics)[]) { const v = (value as Record<string, unknown>)[key]; if (typeof v === "string") result[key] = v; }
  return result;
}
export function nullableNumber(raw: unknown, label: string, min: number, max: number, integer = false): number | null {
  if (raw == null || raw === "") return null;
  if (typeof raw !== "string" && typeof raw !== "number") throw new Error(`${label} must be a number.`);
  const n = Number(raw);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < min || n > max || (integer && !Number.isInteger(n))) throw new Error(`${label} must be ${integer ? "a whole number " : ""}between ${min} and ${max}.`);
  return n;
}
export function parseDates(startRaw: string, endRaw: string) {
  if (!startRaw && !endRaw) return { startDate: null, endDate: null };
  const valid = (raw: string) => /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(raw) && Number.isFinite(new Date(raw).getTime()) && new Date(raw).toISOString().slice(0,10) === raw;
  if (!valid(startRaw) || !valid(endRaw)) throw new Error("Choose both a valid start and end date.");
  const startDate = new Date(startRaw), endDate = new Date(endRaw);
  if (endDate < startDate) throw new Error("End date must be on or after start date.");
  if ((endDate.getTime()-startDate.getTime())/86400000 > 365) throw new Error("Trips can span up to 366 days.");
  return { startDate, endDate };
}
```

```typescript
/** Escape user-controlled data in export documents; neutralize spreadsheet formulas. */
import type { Waypoint, PlannerDay, Logistics } from "./trip-planner";
import type { PackLine } from "./pack-analysis";
import type { CampBooking } from "./trip-resources";
import type { FoodPlan } from "./food-plan";
import type { TripArrangement } from "./trip-arrangements";

export type TripExport = { name: string; days: PlannerDay[]; points: Waypoint[]; logistics: Logistics; bookings: CampBooking[]; arrangements?: TripArrangement[]; packLines: PackLine[]; foodPlan?: FoodPlan; people?: number };
export const TRIP_DOCUMENT_SECTIONS = ["itinerary", "resources", "logistics", "packing"] as const;
export type TripDocumentSection = (typeof TRIP_DOCUMENT_SECTIONS)[number];
export type TripDocumentOptions = Partial<Record<TripDocumentSection, boolean>>;

export function csvCell(value: unknown): string {
  let text = String(value ?? "");
  if (/^[\s\r\n]*[=+@\-\t\r]/.test(text)) text = `'${text}`;
  return `"${text.replaceAll('"', '""')}"`;
}
export function csvTable(rows: (string | number | null | undefined)[][]): string {
  return "\ufeff" + rows.map(row => row.map(csvCell).join(",")).join("\r\n") + "\r\n";
}
export function exportLogisticsCsv({ logistics, bookings, arrangements = [], name }: TripExport, includePrivate: boolean): string {
  const rows: (string | number)[][] = [["Trip", name],["Category", "Field", "Value"]];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(logistics)) {
    if (!includePrivate && ["emergencyContact", "emergencyPlan", "reservations", "permits"].includes(key)) continue;
    rows.push(["Logistics",key,value]);
  }
  rows.push(["Bookings", "Campground", "Status", "Arrival", "Departure", "Provider", "Confirmation", "Notes"]);
  for (const item of bookings) rows.push(["Booking", item.campground,item.status,item.arrival,item.departure,item.provider,includePrivate ? item.confirmation : "[private]",includePrivate ? item.notes : "[private]"]);
  if (includePrivate) {
    rows.push(["Permits and reservations", "Type", "Name", "Status", "Start", "End", "Provider", "Confirmation", "URL", "Notes"]);
    for (const entry of arrangements) rows.push(["Arrangement", `${entry.kind}: ${entry.category}`, entry.name, entry.status, entry.startDate, entry.endDate, entry.provider, entry.confirmation, entry.bookingUrl, entry.notes]);
  }
  return csvTable(rows);
}
export function exportCampsitesCsv({ points, bookings, days }: TripExport, includePrivate: boolean): string {
  const lookup = new Map(bookings.filter(b => b.waypointId).map(b => [b.waypointId,b]));
  const byDay = new Map(days.map((day,index) => [day.id, `Day ${index+1}`]));
  const rows: (string | number)[][] = [["Campsite", "Day", "Latitude", "Longitude", "Access", "Notes", "Source", "Booking status", "Confirmation"]];
  for (const point of points.filter(p => p.kind === "camp")) {
    const booking = lookup.get(point.id);
    rows.push([point.name,byDay.get(point.dayId || "") || "Unassigned",point.lat,point.lng,point.resource?.access || "",point.resource?.detail || "",point.resource?.sourceUrl || "",booking?.status || "untracked",includePrivate ? booking?.confirmation || "" : "[private]"]);
  }
  return csvTable(rows);
}
export function exportPackCsv({ packLines, foodPlan }: TripExport): string {
  return csvTable([["Item", "Category", "Quantity", "Weight per item (g)", "Total weight (g)", "Worn/consumable/base", "Packed?"],
    ...packLines.map(line => [line.name,line.category,line.quantity,line.gramsEach,line.grams,line.weightClass,""]),
    ...(foodPlan?.foods.filter(f=>f.countInPack).map(f=>[f.name,"Planned food",f.startingUnits,f.gramsPerUnit,f.gramsPerUnit===null?null:f.startingUnits*f.gramsPerUnit,"consumable (Phase 7)",""] as (string|number|null)[]) || []),
    ...(foodPlan?.settings.countFuelInPack && foodPlan.settings.startingFuelGrams ? [["Planned fuel","Cooking",1,foodPlan.settings.startingFuelGrams,foodPlan.settings.startingFuelGrams,"consumable (Phase 7)",""]] : [])]);
}
export function escapeHtml(value: unknown): string {
  return String(value ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, character => ({ "&":"&amp;", "<":"&lt;", ">":"&gt;", '"':"&quot;", "'":"&#39;" }[character]!));
}
const dateText = (value: Date | string) => new Date(value).toLocaleDateString("en-CA", { year:"numeric",month:"short",day:"numeric",timeZone:"UTC" });

/** A self-contained, print-ready document. Works with selected sections, and
 * retains the old two-argument form for callers expecting the full itinerary.
 * All user-authored content is escaped before insertion into the document.
 */
export function printableTripHtml(data: TripExport, includePrivate = false, sections: TripDocumentOptions = {}): string {
  const h = escapeHtml;
  const show: Record<TripDocumentSection, boolean> = {
    itinerary: sections.itinerary !== false,
    resources: sections.resources !== false,
    logistics: sections.logistics !== false,
    packing: sections.packing !== false,
  };
  const byDay = !show.itinerary ? "" : (data.days.length ? data.days.map((day,index) => {
    const waypoints = data.points.filter(p => p.dayId === day.id);
    const info = [
      day.startLocation && `Start: ${day.startLocation}`,
      day.endLocation && `Finish: ${day.endLocation}`,
      day.distanceKm != null && `Distance: ${day.distanceKm} km`,
      day.elevationGainM != null && `Gain: ${day.elevationGainM} m`,
      day.elevationLossM != null && `Descent: ${day.elevationLossM} m`,
      day.durationMinutes != null && `Moving time: ${Math.round(day.durationMinutes / 60 * 10)/10} h`,
      day.campsite && `Camp: ${day.campsite}`,
      day.waterSource && `Water: ${day.waterSource}`,
    ].filter(Boolean).map(v => `<li>${h(v)}</li>`).join("");
    const stops = waypoints.length ? `<h3>Route stops</h3><ol>${waypoints.map(point => `<li>${h(point.name)} (${h(point.kind)})${point.note ? `: ${h(point.note)}` : ""}</li>`).join("")}</ol>` : "";
    return `<section><h2>Day ${index+1} · ${h(dateText(day.date))}</h2><ul>${info}</ul>${stops}${day.notes ? `<p class="notes">${h(day.notes)}</p>` : ""}</section>`;
  }).join("") : `<section><h2>Day-by-day itinerary</h2><p>No itinerary days planned yet.</p></section>`);

  const resourceStops = data.points.filter(point => ["camp", "water", "resupply"].includes(point.kind));
  const byDayLabel = new Map(data.days.map((day,index) => [day.id, `Day ${index+1}`]));
  const resourcesHtml = !show.resources ? "" : `<section><h2>Campsites &amp; water sources</h2>${resourceStops.length ? `<ul>${resourceStops.map(point => {
    const meta = [
      byDayLabel.get(point.dayId || "") || "Unassigned day",
      point.kind,
      point.resource?.access,
      point.resource?.waterReliability && `Water reliability: ${point.resource.waterReliability}`,
      point.resource?.detail,
      point.resource?.sourceName && `Source: ${point.resource.sourceName}`,
      point.resource?.checkedOn && `Checked: ${point.resource.checkedOn}`,
    ].filter(Boolean).map(h).join(" · ");
    return `<li><strong>${h(point.name)}</strong><small> ${meta}</small></li>`;
  }).join("")}</ul>` : `<p>No campsite or water stops recorded.</p>`}</section>`;

  const bookingHtml = show.resources && data.bookings.length ? `<section><h2>Campsite reservations</h2><ul>${data.bookings.map(b =>
    `<li>${h(b.campground)} · ${h(b.status)}${b.arrival ? ` · ${h(b.arrival)}` : ""}${includePrivate ? ` · ${h(b.confirmation)} ${h(b.notes)}` : ""}</li>`
  ).join("")}</ul></section>` : "";
  const arrangementsHtml = show.logistics && includePrivate && data.arrangements?.length
    ? `<section><h2>Permits and reservations</h2><ul>${data.arrangements.map(a => `<li><strong>${h(a.name)}</strong> · ${h(a.kind)} · ${h(a.status)}${a.startDate ? ` · ${h(a.startDate)}` : ""}${a.endDate ? ` to ${h(a.endDate)}` : ""}${a.provider ? ` · ${h(a.provider)}` : ""}${a.confirmation ? ` · Confirmation: ${h(a.confirmation)}` : ""}${a.notes ? ` · ${h(a.notes)}` : ""}</li>`).join("")}</ul></section>` : "";
  const logisticsHtml = !show.logistics ? "" : `<section><h2>Logistics</h2><ul>${Object.entries(data.logistics)
    .filter(([key,value]) => value && (includePrivate || !["emergencyContact","emergencyPlan","permits","reservations"].includes(key)))
    .map(([key,value]) => `<li><strong>${h(key)}:</strong> ${h(value)}</li>`).join("") || "<li>No logistics added yet.</li>"}</ul></section>`;

  const packHtml = data.packLines.map(line => `<li><span class="check">☐</span> ${h(line.quantity)} × ${h(line.name)} ${line.grams != null ? `(${h(line.grams)} g)` : "(weight unknown)"}</li>`).join("");
  const foodHtml = data.foodPlan?.foods.filter(food=>food.countInPack).map(food =>
    `<li><span class="check">☐</span> ${h(food.startingUnits)} × ${h(food.name)} ${food.gramsPerUnit == null ? "(unknown mass)" : `(${h(food.startingUnits*food.gramsPerUnit)} g)`}</li>`
  ).join("") || "";
  const mealHtml = data.foodPlan?.meals.map(meal => {
    const day = data.days.findIndex(d=>d.id===meal.dayId);
    const food = data.foodPlan?.foods.find(f=>f.id===meal.foodId);
    return `<li>Day ${h(day+1)} · ${h(meal.slot)}: ${h(meal.units)} × ${h(food?.name||"Unknown")}</li>`;
  }).join("") || "";
  const packingHtml = !show.packing ? "" : `<section><h2>Packing checklist</h2><ul>${packHtml}${foodHtml}${data.foodPlan?.settings.countFuelInPack && data.foodPlan.settings.startingFuelGrams ? `<li><span class="check">☐</span> Planned fuel (${h(data.foodPlan.settings.startingFuelGrams)} g)</li>` : ""}</ul></section>${mealHtml ? `<section><h2>Food &amp; meals</h2><ul>${mealHtml}</ul></section>` : ""}`;

  return `<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>${h(data.name)} · TrailPicker trip plan</title><style>body{font:14px/1.6 system-ui,sans-serif;max-width:800px;margin:36px auto;color:#172018;padding:0 18px}h1{font-size:26px;margin-bottom:4px}h2{font-size:18px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;margin-top:24px}h3{font-size:14px}section{break-inside:avoid;padding:3px 0}ul,ol{padding-left:24px}.check{font-size:19px}small{color:#555}.notes{white-space:pre-wrap}@page{margin:17mm}@media print{body{margin:0;max-width:none}a{color:inherit}}</style></head><body><h1>${h(data.name)}</h1>${data.people ? `<p>${h(data.people)} participant${data.people===1?"":"s"}</p>` : ""}<small>TrailPicker trip document · Verify routes, water availability and campsite rules before departure.</small>${byDay}${resourcesHtml}${bookingHtml}${logisticsHtml}${arrangementsHtml}${packingHtml}</body></html>`;
}
```

```typescript
/** Private trip logistics and public-safe route resource annotations.
 * Water estimates are planning prompts, not proof of an available or potable water supply.
 */
import { metersBetween, usableTrailSegment } from "./trail-routing";
import type { Waypoint } from "./trip-planner";

export type ResourceKind = "camp" | "water" | "resupply";
export type WaterReliability = "unknown" | "reported" | "seasonal" | "unavailable";
export type ResourceAnnotation = {
  detail?: string;
  access?: string;
  waterReliability?: WaterReliability;
  refillConfirmed?: boolean;
  checkedOn?: string;
  sourceName?: string;
  sourceUrl?: string;
};
export type BookingStatus = "to_book" | "requested" | "confirmed" | "cancelled" | "not_required";
export type CampBooking = {
  id: string;
  waypointId: string;
  dayId: string;
  campground: string;
  status: BookingStatus;
  arrival: string;
  departure: string;
  provider: string;
  confirmation: string;
  notes: string;
  bookingUrl?: string;
};
export type ResourceSettings = { rateLph: number; reserveL: number; capacityL: number };
export type PrivateTripResources = { settings: ResourceSettings; bookings: CampBooking[] };
export const defaultResourceSettings: ResourceSettings = { rateLph: 0.6, reserveL: 0.75, capacityL: 3 };
export const BOOKING_STATUSES: BookingStatus[] = ["to_book", "requested", "confirmed", "cancelled", "not_required"];
const short = (value: unknown, limit: number): string => typeof value === "string" ? value.trim().slice(0, limit) : "";
const validIso = (value: string) => {
  if (!value) return true;
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) return false;
  const date = new Date(`${value}T12:00:00Z`);
  return Number.isFinite(date.getTime()) && date.toISOString().slice(0,10) === value;
};
const validHttps = (value: string) => !value || (() => { try { return new URL(value).protocol === "https:"; } catch { return false; } })();

export function parseResourceAnnotation(value: unknown): ResourceAnnotation | null {
  if (value == null) return null;
  if (typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) throw new Error("Invalid stop resource information.");
  const obj = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  const allowed = new Set(["detail","access","waterReliability","refillConfirmed","checkedOn","sourceName","sourceUrl"]);
  if (Object.keys(obj).some(key => !allowed.has(key))) throw new Error("Unsupported stop resource field.");
  for (const key of ["detail", "access", "checkedOn", "sourceName", "sourceUrl"] as const) {
    if (obj[key] !== undefined && (typeof obj[key] !== "string" || obj[key].length > (key === "detail" ? 750 : key === "access" ? 350 : 300))) throw new Error(`Invalid resource ${key}.`);
  }
  if (obj.waterReliability !== undefined && !["unknown", "reported", "seasonal", "unavailable"].includes(String(obj.waterReliability))) throw new Error("Invalid water-source reliability.");
  if (obj.refillConfirmed !== undefined && typeof obj.refillConfirmed !== "boolean") throw new Error("Invalid refill confirmation.");
  const checkedOn = short(obj.checkedOn, 20), sourceUrl = short(obj.sourceUrl, 300);
  if (!validIso(checkedOn) || !validHttps(sourceUrl)) throw new Error("Check the source date and HTTPS URL.");
  const result: ResourceAnnotation = {
    ...(short(obj.detail, 750) ? { detail: short(obj.detail, 750) } : {}),
    ...(short(obj.access, 350) ? { access: short(obj.access, 350) } : {}),
    ...(obj.waterReliability !== undefined ? { waterReliability: obj.waterReliability as WaterReliability } : {}),
    ...(obj.refillConfirmed === true ? { refillConfirmed: true } : {}),
    ...(checkedOn ? { checkedOn } : {}),
    ...(short(obj.sourceName, 120) ? { sourceName: short(obj.sourceName, 120) } : {}),
    ...(sourceUrl ? { sourceUrl } : {}),
  };
  return Object.keys(result).length ? result : null;
}

export function readPrivateResources(value: unknown): PrivateTripResources {
  const root = value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value) ? value as Record<string, unknown> : {};
  const raw = root.phase6 && typeof root.phase6 === "object" && !Array.isArray(root.phase6) ? root.phase6 as Record<string, unknown> : {};
  const settings = raw.settings && typeof raw.settings === "object" && !Array.isArray(raw.settings) ? raw.settings as Record<string, unknown> : {};
  const n = (value: unknown, fallback: number, min: number, max: number) => typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= min && value <= max ? value : fallback;
  return {
    settings: {
      rateLph: n(settings.rateLph, defaultResourceSettings.rateLph, 0.1, 2),
      reserveL: n(settings.reserveL, defaultResourceSettings.reserveL, 0, 5),
      capacityL: n(settings.capacityL, defaultResourceSettings.capacityL, 0.25, 20),
    },
    bookings: Array.isArray(raw.bookings) ? raw.bookings.slice(0, 40).flatMap(entry => {
      if (!entry || typeof entry !== "object") return [];
      const row = entry as Record<string, unknown>;
      const status = BOOKING_STATUSES.includes(row.status as BookingStatus) ? row.status as BookingStatus : "to_book";
      const arrival = short(row.arrival, 10), departure = short(row.departure, 10);
      if (!validIso(arrival) || !validIso(departure)) return [];
      return [{
        id: short(row.id, 100), waypointId: short(row.waypointId, 200), dayId: short(row.dayId, 200),
        campground: short(row.campground, 200), status, arrival, departure,
        provider: short(row.provider, 150), confirmation: short(row.confirmation, 120), notes: short(row.notes, 750),
        ...(validHttps(short(row.bookingUrl, 500)) && short(row.bookingUrl, 500) ? { bookingUrl: short(row.bookingUrl, 500) } : {}),
      }];
    }) : [],
  };
}

export function validatePrivateResources(value: unknown, validDays: readonly string[], validStops: readonly string[]): PrivateTripResources {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) throw new Error("Invalid campsite planning data.");
  const raw = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  const settings = raw.settings;
  if (!settings || typeof settings !== "object" || Array.isArray(settings)) throw new Error("Missing water settings.");
  const config = settings as Record<string, unknown>;
  const bounds: [keyof ResourceSettings, number, number][] = [["rateLph",0.1,2],["reserveL",0,5],["capacityL",0.25,20]];
  for (const [key,min,max] of bounds) if (typeof config[key] !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(config[key]) || (config[key] as number) < min || (config[key] as number) > max) throw new Error(`Water ${key} must be between ${min} and ${max}.`);
  if (!Array.isArray(raw.bookings) || raw.bookings.length > 40) throw new Error("A trip can store up to 40 campsite reservations.");
  const bookings: CampBooking[] = [];
  const ids = new Set<string>();
  for (const record of raw.bookings) {
    if (!record || typeof record !== "object" || Array.isArray(record)) throw new Error("Invalid booking record.");
    const row = record as Record<string, unknown>;
    const required = ["id","waypointId","dayId","campground","status","arrival","departure","provider","confirmation","notes"];
    if (Object.keys(row).some(key => !required.includes(key) && key !== "bookingUrl")) throw new Error("Unknown booking field.");
    if (row.bookingUrl !== undefined && (typeof row.bookingUrl !== "string" || row.bookingUrl.length > 500 || !validHttps(row.bookingUrl))) throw new Error("Invalid booking HTTPS URL.");
    const caps: Record<string,number> = { id:100, waypointId:200, dayId:200, campground:200, status:20, arrival:10, departure:10, provider:150, confirmation:120, notes:750 };
    for (const key of required) if (typeof row[key] !== "string" || row[key].length > caps[key]) throw new Error(`Invalid booking ${key}.`);
    const b = row as CampBooking;
    if (!b.id || ids.has(b.id)) throw new Error("Duplicate booking ID.");
    ids.add(b.id);
    if (!BOOKING_STATUSES.includes(b.status)) throw new Error("Invalid booking status.");
    if (b.waypointId && !validStops.includes(b.waypointId)) throw new Error("Reservation refers to a removed campsite stop.");
    if (b.dayId && !validDays.includes(b.dayId)) throw new Error("Reservation refers to a removed trip day.");
    if (!validIso(b.arrival) || !validIso(b.departure) || (b.arrival && b.departure && b.departure < b.arrival)) throw new Error("Invalid booking dates.");
    bookings.push({ ...(Object.fromEntries(required.map(key => [key, (b as unknown as Record<string,string>)[key].trim()])) as CampBooking),
      ...(typeof row.bookingUrl === "string" && row.bookingUrl.trim() ? { bookingUrl: row.bookingUrl.trim() } : {}) });
  }
  return { settings: { rateLph: config.rateLph as number, reserveL: config.reserveL as number, capacityL: config.capacityL as number }, bookings };
}

export type WaterLeg = { from: string; to: string; distanceKm: number | null; movingHours: number | null; requiredL: number | null; exceedsCapacity: boolean; incomplete: boolean; note: string };
export function calculateWaterLegs(points: readonly Waypoint[], settings: ResourceSettings, paceKmh = 3.5): WaterLeg[] {
  if (!points.length || !Number.isFinite(paceKmh) || paceKmh <= 0) return [];
  const segments: WaterLeg[] = [];
  let origin = points[0].name, km = 0, hours = 0, incomplete = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
    const from = points[i], to = points[i + 1];
    const trail = from.manualToNext ? null : usableTrailSegment(from, to);
    if (!trail) incomplete = true;
    else {
      km += trail.distanceM / 1000;
      if (trail.ascentM !== undefined && trail.elevationsM && trail.elevationsM.length === trail.geometry.length) {
        hours += trail.distanceM / 1000 / paceKmh + trail.ascentM / 600;
      } else incomplete = true;
    }
    const refill = to.kind === "water" && to.resource?.refillConfirmed && to.resource.waterReliability !== "unavailable";
    const final = i === points.length - 2;
    if (refill || final) {
      const required = incomplete ? null : Number((hours * settings.rateLph + settings.reserveL).toFixed(2));
      segments.push({ from: origin, to: to.name, distanceKm: incomplete ? null : Number(km.toFixed(2)), movingHours: incomplete ? null : Number(hours.toFixed(2)), requiredL: required, exceedsCapacity: required !== null && required > settings.capacityL, incomplete, note: refill ? "Planned refill, availability must be rechecked" : "End of route or no later confirmed refill" });
      origin = to.name; km = 0; hours = 0; incomplete = false;
    }
  }
  return segments;
}
```

### `lib/trip.ts`

```typescript
export function getDateRange(start: Date, end: Date): Date[] {
  const days: Date[] = [];
  const cursor = new Date(
    Date.UTC(start.getUTCFullYear(), start.getUTCMonth(), start.getUTCDate())
  );
  const last = new Date(
    Date.UTC(end.getUTCFullYear(), end.getUTCMonth(), end.getUTCDate())
  );

  while (cursor.getTime() <= last.getTime()) {
    days.push(new Date(cursor));
    cursor.setUTCDate(cursor.getUTCDate() + 1);
  }

  return days;
}

export function formatDateRange(start: Date | null, end: Date | null): string {
  if (!start || !end) return "No dates set";

  const opts: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = { month: "short", day: "numeric" };
  const sameYear = start.getUTCFullYear() === end.getUTCFullYear();

  const startLabel = start.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { ...opts, timeZone: "UTC" });
  const endLabel = end.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
    ...opts,
    year: "numeric",
    timeZone: "UTC",
  });

  if (sameYear) {
    return `${startLabel} – ${endLabel}`;
  }

  const startLabelWithYear = start.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
    ...opts,
    year: "numeric",
    timeZone: "UTC",
  });

  return `${startLabelWithYear} – ${endLabel}`;
}

export function getNights(start: Date | null, end: Date | null): number {
  if (!start || !end) return 0;

  const startUTC = Date.UTC(start.getUTCFullYear(), start.getUTCMonth(), start.getUTCDate());
  const endUTC = Date.UTC(end.getUTCFullYear(), end.getUTCMonth(), end.getUTCDate());

  return Math.max(0, Math.round((endUTC - startUTC) / 86400000));
}

export function getDaysUntil(start: Date | null): number | null {
  if (!start) return null;

  const now = new Date();
  const todayUTC = Date.UTC(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
  const startUTC = Date.UTC(
    start.getUTCFullYear(),
    start.getUTCMonth(),
    start.getUTCDate()
  );

  return Math.round((startUTC - todayUTC) / 86400000);
}
```
