```typescript
const test = require("node:test");
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
const itinerary = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, "components/builder/TripPlanner/DayStopsItinerary.tsx"), "utf8");
const weather = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, "components/builder/TripPlanner/WeatherPanel.tsx"), "utf8");

test("Day Forecast passes solar data into its existing weather panel", () => {
  assert.match(itinerary, /<WeatherPanel[\s\S]*?daylight=\{forecastSolar\}/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(itinerary, /Approximate solar times at the selected forecast location/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(itinerary, /Terrain and weather can reduce usable daylight/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(itinerary, /<Sunset\b/);
});

test("Sunrise and sunset render within the weather card, after its location selector", () => {
  const start = weather.indexOf('aria-label={`Day forecast for');
  const end = weather.indexOf('id={!date ? "weather"', start);
  const dayBranch = weather.slice(start, end);
  const selector = dayBranch.indexOf('label="Day forecast location"');
  const sunrise = dayBranch.indexOf('<Sunrise');
  const sunset = dayBranch.indexOf('<Sunset');
  const closingCard = dayBranch.indexOf('</section>');
  assert.ok(start >= 0 && selector >= 0 && sunrise > selector && sunset > sunrise && closingCard > sunset);
  assert.match(dayBranch, /<p className="mt-1\.5 text-\[11px\] text-gray-500">Times from \{daylight\.zone\}<\/p>/);
  assert.match(dayBranch, /\{daylight && \(/);
});

test("Solar times still render when weather data is out of forecast range", () => {
  const dayBranch = weather.slice(weather.indexOf('aria-label={`Day forecast for'),weather.indexOf('id={!date ? "weather"'));
  assert.ok(dayBranch.indexOf('{daylight && (') > dayBranch.indexOf('!forecastAvailable || !hasNumbers'));
  assert.match(dayBranch, /daylight\.sunriseMinutes/);
  assert.match(dayBranch, /daylight\.sunsetMinutes/);
});

test("Trip-wide WeatherPanel remains unchanged unless an itinerary passes daylight", () => {
  assert.match(weather, /daylight\?: DaylightResult \| null;/);
  assert.equal((itinerary.match(/<WeatherPanel/g)||[]).length,1);
  assert.equal((weather.match(/Times from \{daylight\.zone\}/g)||[]).length,1);
});
```

### `tests/discover-catalog-expansion.test.mjs`

```typescript
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const read = file => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,"data",file), "utf8"));
const places = read("destinations.json");
const origins = read("destination-coordinate-sources.json");
const facts = read("destination-verified-metrics.json");
const byId = new Map(places.map(x => [x.id,x]));
const populated = field => places.filter(x => x[field] !== null && x[field] !== undefined).length;

test("catalog retains 184 unique destination IDs", () => {
  assert.equal(places.length,184);
  assert.equal(byId.size,184);
});
test("mapped destinations have complete, distinct coordinates", () => {
  assert.equal(populated("latitude"),origins.totalCount);
  assert.equal(populated("longitude"),origins.totalCount);
  assert.equal(new Set(places.filter(x=>x.latitude!==null).map(x=>`${x.latitude.toFixed(6)}:${x.longitude.toFixed(6)}`)).size,origins.totalCount);
  for (const d of places) {
    assert.equal(d.latitude===null,d.longitude===null,d.id);
    if(d.latitude!==null) {
      assert.ok(d.latitude>=48 && d.latitude<=60,d.id);
      assert.ok(d.longitude>=-139 && d.longitude<=-114,d.id);
    }
  }
});
test("each new coordinate is sourced and mapped to the intended destination", () => {
  assert.equal(origins.originalCount,14);
  assert.equal(origins.addedCount,111);
  assert.equal(origins.totalCount,125);
  assert.equal(Object.keys(origins.sources).length,origins.addedCount);
  for(const [id,source] of Object.entries(origins.sources)) {
    const place = byId.get(id);
    assert.ok(place, id);
    assert.equal(source.latitude,place.latitude,id);
    assert.equal(source.longitude,place.longitude,id);
    assert.ok(source.referenceUrl || source.coordinateSource,id);
    assert.ok(source.coordinateType,id);
    assert.ok(["campground","feature-centre"].includes(source.coordinateType),id);
    if (source.coordinateType === "campground") assert.equal(place.kind,"campground",id);
  }
});
test("lakes and their campgrounds have distinct mapped locations", () => {
  for (const [feature,site] of [["greendrop-lake-destination","greendrop-lake-chilliwack"],["bedwell-lake-destination","bedwell-lake-strathcona"],["quiniscoe-lake-destination","quiniscoe-lake"]]) {
    const x=byId.get(feature),y=byId.get(site);
    assert.ok(x?.latitude!==null && y?.latitude!==null);
    assert.notDeepEqual([x.latitude,x.longitude],[y.latitude,y.longitude]);
  }
});
test("campground feature locations require no safety or trust warning", () => {
  assert.ok(!places.some(x=>"unsafe" in x || "unverified" in x || "warningBadge" in x));
});
test("route and campsite facts have provenance", () => {
  assert.ok(populated("distanceKm")>=103);
  assert.ok(populated("elevationGainM")>=33);
  assert.ok(populated("tentSites")>=50);
  assert.ok(Object.keys(facts.sources).length>=10);
  for(const [id,details] of Object.entries(facts.sources)) {
    assert.ok(byId.has(id),id);
    assert.ok(details.source,id);
  }
});


test("new Rockwall and Robson campsite points are distinct and source-backed", () => {
  const ids = ["emperor-falls-robson","marmot-robson","floe-lake-rockwall","numa-creek-rockwall","tumbling-creek-rockwall","helmet-falls-rockwall","helmet-ochre-junction-rockwall"];
  for (const id of ids) {
    assert.equal(byId.get(id)?.kind, "campground", id);
    assert.ok(Number.isFinite(byId.get(id)?.latitude), id);
    assert.equal(origins.sources[id]?.coordinateType, "campground", id);
    assert.match(origins.sources[id]?.referenceUrl || "", /^https:\/\/mapcarta\.com\//, id);
  }
  assert.equal(new Set(ids.map(id => `${byId.get(id).latitude},${byId.get(id).longitude}`)).size, ids.length);
});
test("Parks Canada trail metrics distinguish round-trip distance and access rules", () => {
  for(const [id,km,ascent] of [["balu-pass",12.8,780],["avalanche-crest",10.2,795],["asulkan-trail",15.8,870],["hermit-meadows-glacier",6.4,820]]) {
    const record=byId.get(id),source=facts.sources[id];
    assert.equal(record.distanceKm,km,id);
    assert.equal(record.elevationGainM,ascent,id);
    assert.equal(record.distanceType,"round-trip",id);
    assert.ok(source?.source.includes("parks.canada.ca"),id);
  }
  assert.equal(byId.get("balu-pass").dogs,"not-allowed");
  assert.match(byId.get("cape-scott-lighthouse").caution,/private property/i);
  assert.equal(byId.get("cape-scott-lighthouse").latitude,null);
});

```

### `tests/discover-fixes.test.mjs`

```typescript
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
import test from 'node:test';

const root=path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)),'..');
const read=rel=>readFileSync(path.join(root,rel),'utf8');

test('destination cards lead to the trip setup form rather than silently creating builds',()=>{
  const landing=read('components/discover/DiscoverLanding.tsx');
  const details=read('components/discover/DestinationDetail.tsx');
  const form=read('components/discover/DestinationTripForm.tsx');
  assert.doesNotMatch(landing,/startDestinationPlan/);
  assert.match(landing,/destinationHref\(destination\.id\)\}#plan-trip-heading/);
  assert.match(details,/<DestinationTripForm destination=\{destination\}/);
  assert.match(form,/id="plan-trip-heading"/);
  assert.match(form,/name="startDate"/);
  assert.match(form,/name="endDate"/);
  assert.match(form,/name="people"/);
});

test('server handoff forwards chosen name, dates, people and seed option',async()=>{
  const source=read('app/discover/actions.ts');
  const start=source.indexOf('export async function startDestinationPlan(');
  const finish=source.indexOf('\n}',start)+2;
  assert.ok(start>0 && finish>start);
  const code=source.slice(start,finish)
    .replace('export async function startDestinationPlan(formData: FormData): Promise<void>', 'async function startDestinationPlan(formData)')
    .replace(' as const','');
  const received=[];
  const action=new Function('services',`const {getDestination,createBuild}=services;\n${code}\nreturn startDestinationPlan;`)(
    {getDestination:id=>id==='lake' ? {id,name:'Lake',region:'Coast',park:'Park'} : null,
      createBuild:async form=>received.push(form)});
  const data=new FormData();
  for(const [k,v] of Object.entries({destinationId:'lake',name:'My trip',startDate:'2028-06-01',endDate:'2028-06-05',people:'3',seedItinerary:'1',isPublic:'true',discoverPlan:'0'}))data.set(k,v);
  await action(data);
  assert.equal(received.length,1);
  assert.deepEqual(Object.fromEntries(received[0]),{
    name:'My trip',destinationId:'lake',startDate:'2028-06-01',endDate:'2028-06-05',people:'3',discoverPlan:'1',seedItinerary:'1',
  });
  await assert.rejects(action(new FormData()),/destination/i);
  const bad=new FormData();bad.set('destinationId','nope');
  await assert.rejects(action(bad),/Destination not found/);
});

test('build destination type supports the full catalog and nullable coordinates',()=>{
  const types=read('lib/destinations.ts');
  const data=JSON.parse(read('data/destinations.json'));
  assert.equal(data.length,184);
  assert.equal(new Set(data.map(item=>item.id)).size,data.length);
  assert.match(types,/latitude: number \| null/);
  assert.match(types,/longitude: number \| null/);
  assert.match(types,/kind: DestinationKind/);
  assert.match(types,/activities: DestinationActivity\[\]/);
  assert.match(types,/distanceType: DistanceType \| null/);
  const kinds=new Set(['campground','lake','trail','summit','waterfall','viewpoint','coastal','backcountry-area','meadow','hut']);
  const activities=new Set(['hiking','backpacking','camping','paddling']);
  for(const item of data){
    assert.ok(kinds.has(item.kind),`unexpected kind ${item.id}`);
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(item.activities) && item.activities.every(a=>activities.has(a)),`bad activities ${item.id}`);
    assert.ok(item.distanceType===null||['one-way','round-trip','loop'].includes(item.distanceType));
    assert.ok((item.latitude===null&&item.longitude===null)||(typeof item.latitude==='number'&&typeof item.longitude==='number'));
  }
});

test('facility audit updates do not convert unverified storage into confident NO',()=>{
  const data=JSON.parse(read('data/destinations.json'));
  const byId=Object.fromEntries(data.map(d=>[d.id,d]));
  assert.equal(byId['alder-flats'].foodStorage,'unknown');
  assert.equal(byId['magnesia-meadows-cypress'].foodStorage,'unknown');
  assert.equal(byId['circlet-lake-strathcona'].foodStorage,'yes');
  assert.equal(byId['kwai-lake-strathcona'].foodStorage,'yes');
  assert.equal(byId['dark-creek-campground-pinecone-burke']?.foodStorage ?? 'not found','no');
  assert.match(byId['alder-flats'].caution,/does not confirm/);
});

test('planner recognises tab=trip and shows TripPlanner',()=>{
  const page=read('app/build/[id]/page.tsx');
  const build=read('app/build/actions.ts');
  assert.match(page,/const activeTab = tab === "trip" \? "trip" : "gear"/);
  assert.match(page,/activeTab === "trip"\s*\?/);
  assert.match(page,/<TripPlanner/);
  assert.match(build,/discoverPlan \? "\?tab=trip" : ""/);
});
```

```typescript
test('recorded distances/gains outside preferences are excluded, missing stays unknown',()=>{

 assert.equal(finderEligible(known,{...DEFAULT_PREFERENCES,distance:'10'}),false);
 assert.equal(finderEligible(missing,{...DEFAULT_PREFERENCES,distance:'10'}),true);

});
```

```typescript
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import test from 'node:test';
import {parseDiscoverSearch,discoverUrl,filterDiscoverDestinations,isUnfilteredDestinationSearch,SPOTLIGHT_IDS,summarizePublicBuild} from '../lib/discover.ts';
import {getDiscoverPhoto,discoverPhotoUrl,discoverPhotoSource} from '../lib/discover-photos.ts';

const rows = [
  {id:'lake',name:'Alpine Lake',kind:'lake',park:'Park 1',region:'Sea to Sky',difficulty:'moderate',distanceKm:8,elevationGainM:400,featured:true,summary:'Alpine lake',activities:['hiking','backpacking']},
  {id:'camp',name:'Backcountry Camp',kind:'campground',park:'Park 1',region:'Sea to Sky',difficulty:'hard',distanceKm:6,elevationGainM:null,featured:true,summary:'Camping site',activities:['backpacking','camping']},
  {id:'falls',name:'Waterfall',kind:'waterfall',park:'Park 2',region:'Lower Mainland',difficulty:'easy',distanceKm:2,elevationGainM:50,featured:false,summary:'Forest waterfall',activities:['hiking']},
  {id:'old',name:'Old Camp',park:'Park 2',region:'Lower Mainland',difficulty:'easy',distanceKm:null,elevationGainM:null,featured:false,summary:'Older entry'},
];
const defaults = {q:'',region:'',difficulty:'all',activity:'all',category:'all',sort:'popular'};
test('the new URL params are sanitized and remain sharable',()=>{
  const parsed = parseDiscoverSearch({view:'destinations',category:'lake',activity:'hiking',region:'Sea to Sky',page:'3'});
  assert.equal(parsed.category,'lake');assert.equal(parsed.activity,'hiking');assert.equal(parsed.page,3);
  assert.equal(parseDiscoverSearch({category:'sneaky',activity:'bogus'}).category,'all');
  assert.equal(parseDiscoverSearch({activity:'paddling'}).activity,'paddling');
  const url = discoverUrl(parsed,{q:'Garibaldi Lake',page:2});
  const params = new URL(url,'https://trailpicker.app').searchParams;
  assert.equal(params.get('q'),'Garibaldi Lake');assert.equal(params.get('activity'),'hiking');
  assert.equal(params.get('category'),'lake');assert.equal(params.get('page'),'2');
});
test('filter by activity and place type without guessing for old rows',()=>{
  assert.deepEqual(filterDiscoverDestinations(rows,{...defaults,activity:'camping'}).map(x=>x.id),['camp','old']);
  assert.deepEqual(filterDiscoverDestinations(rows,{...defaults,activity:'hiking',category:'lake'}).map(x=>x.id),['lake']);
  assert.deepEqual(filterDiscoverDestinations(rows,{...defaults,activity:'hiking',category:'waterfall'}).map(x=>x.id),['falls']);
  assert.deepEqual(filterDiscoverDestinations(rows,{...defaults,category:'campground'}).map(x=>x.id),['camp','old']);
  assert.deepEqual(filterDiscoverDestinations(rows,{...defaults,region:'Lower Mainland',difficulty:'easy'}).map(x=>x.id),['old','falls']);
});
test('spotlight eligibility is limited to default view, and ids do not repeat',()=>{
  assert.equal(isUnfilteredDestinationSearch(defaults),true);
  assert.equal(isUnfilteredDestinationSearch({...defaults,category:'lake'}),false);
  assert.equal(new Set(SPOTLIGHT_IDS).size,SPOTLIGHT_IDS.length);
});
test('photo metadata cites the actual file and uses park-level label where needed',()=>{
  const photo = getDiscoverPhoto({id:'garibaldi-lake-destination',kind:'lake',park:'Garibaldi Park'});
  assert.ok(photo);assert.equal(photo.representative,undefined);
  assert.ok(discoverPhotoUrl(photo).startsWith('https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/'));
  assert.ok(discoverPhotoSource(photo).includes('Garibaldi'));
  assert.ok(getDiscoverPhoto({id:'random',kind:'campground',park:'Mount Robson Park'})?.representative);
  assert.equal(getDiscoverPhoto({id:'munro-lake-pinecone-burke',kind:'lake',park:'Pinecone Burke Park'}),null);
});

 const total=summarizePublicBuild([{quantity:2,isWorn:false,isConsumable:false,weightSnapshot:250,gear:null},{quantity:1,isWorn:true,isConsumable:false,weightSnapshot:200,gear:null}],[]);
 assert.equal(total.baseWeightG,500);assert.equal(total.itemCount,3);
```

```typescript
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import test from 'node:test';

import {
  destinationHref, validCoordinates, straightLineKm, parkKey,
  relatedCampgrounds, relatedPlaces, officialUrl,
  openStreetMapEmbedUrl, openStreetMapLink, openStreetMapSearch,
  dogsLabel, facilityLabel, permitLabel, distanceLabel,
} from '../lib/destination-detail.ts';

const make = (id, name, park, kind, latitude=null, longitude=null, extra={}) => ({
  id, name, park, region:'Sea to Sky', kind, latitude, longitude,
  difficulty:'moderate',distanceKm:null,elevationGainM:null,featured:false,
  summary:'Sample record', toilet:null,foodStorage:null, dogs:'check-current-rules',
  reservations:'check-current-rules',tentSites:null,sourceUrl:'https://bcparks.ca/',bookingUrl:null,
  ...extra,
});
const target = make('lake', 'Sample lake', 'Garibaldi Provincial Park', 'lake', null, null);
const sameCamp = make('camp','Camp', 'Garibaldi Park', 'campground', 49.94,-123.04);
const sameOther = make('other', 'Different view','Garibaldi Provincial Park','viewpoint');
const elsewhere = make('else','Faraway camp','Manning Park','campground',49.2,-120.8);
const unsafe = make('fake','No coordinates','Other Park','campground',0,0);

test('detail paths preserve identifier and do not interpolate unsafe HTML', () => {
  assert.equal(destinationHref('garibaldi-lake'), '/discover/destinations/garibaldi-lake');
  assert.equal(destinationHref('name with slash/a'), '/discover/destinations/name%20with%20slash%2Fa');
});
test('only valid explicit lat/lon can power a pin', () => {
  assert.equal(validCoordinates(target), null);
  assert.equal(validCoordinates({latitude:null,longitude:-123}), null);
  assert.equal(validCoordinates({latitude:91,longitude:-123}), null);
  assert.equal(validCoordinates({latitude:49,longitude:Infinity}), null);
  assert.deepEqual(validCoordinates({latitude:49.94,longitude:-123.04}),{latitude:49.94,longitude:-123.04});
});
test('map links use proper OSM embed and search rather than fabricated coordinates',()=>{
  const coords=validCoordinates(sameCamp);
  const embed=new URL(openStreetMapEmbedUrl(coords));
  assert.equal(embed.hostname,'www.openstreetmap.org');
  assert.equal(embed.pathname,'/export/embed.html');
  assert.equal(embed.searchParams.get('marker'),'49.94,-123.04');
  assert.equal(embed.searchParams.get('layer'),'mapnik');
  assert.equal(embed.searchParams.get('bbox').split(',').length,4);
  assert.ok(openStreetMapLink(coords).includes('mlat=49.94'));
  const lookup=new URL(openStreetMapSearch(target));
  assert.equal(lookup.pathname,'/search');
  assert.match(lookup.searchParams.get('query'),/Garibaldi Provincial Park/);
});
test('related campgrounds respect park aliases and skip unsupported distances',()=>{
  assert.equal(parkKey('Mount Robson Provincial Park'),parkKey('Mount Robson Park'));
  const items=relatedCampgrounds(target,[target,sameCamp,sameOther,elsewhere,unsafe]);
  assert.deepEqual(items.map(x=>x.destination.id),['camp']);
  assert.equal(items[0].straightLineKm,null);
  assert.equal(items[0].relation,'same-park');
  assert.deepEqual(relatedPlaces(target,[target,sameCamp,sameOther,elsewhere]).map(x=>x.id),['other']);
});
test('distance only calculated between two stored coordinates and is straight-line',()=>{
  const p1={latitude:49.94,longitude:-123.04};
  assert.equal(straightLineKm(p1,p1),0);
  assert.ok(straightLineKm(p1,{latitude:49.95,longitude:-123.04}) > 1);
  const a=make('a','A','First Park','lake',49.94,-123.04);
  const b=make('b','B','Other Park','campground',49.95,-123.04);
  const linked=relatedCampgrounds(a,[a,b]);
  assert.equal(linked.length,1);
  assert.equal(linked[0].relation,'nearby-coordinate');
  assert.ok(linked[0].straightLineKm > 1);
});
test('facility, permit and trip distance labels never infer missing details',()=>{
  assert.equal(facilityLabel('unknown'),'Not confirmed');
  assert.equal(facilityLabel(null),'Not listed');
  assert.equal(facilityLabel('seasonal'),'Seasonal');
  assert.equal(dogsLabel('check-current-rules'),'Check current rules');
  assert.equal(permitLabel('required'),'Reservation required');
  assert.equal(distanceLabel(null),'Not provided');
  assert.equal(distanceLabel(9,null),'9 km listed');
  assert.equal(distanceLabel(9,'round-trip'),'9 km round trip');
});
test('only valid HTTP(S) official URLs are displayed',()=>{
  assert.equal(officialUrl('javascript:alert(1)'),null);
  assert.equal(officialUrl('//website'),null);
  assert.equal(officialUrl('not a url'),null);
  assert.equal(officialUrl('https://bcparks.ca/golden-ears-park/'),'https://bcparks.ca/golden-ears-park/');
});
test('detail route, metadata, plan action and related links are wired',()=>{
  const dir=path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

});
```

```typescript
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import test from 'node:test';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
import {
  tripDateError, discoverTripPreview, starterDayActivity,
  createDiscoverDaySeed, createDiscoverLogistics,
} from '../lib/discover-trip.ts';

const dir = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const root = path.resolve(dir, '..');
const file = rel => fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,rel),'utf8');
const destination = {
  id:'garibaldi-lake',name:'Garibaldi Lake',kind:'campground',
  park:'Garibaldi Park',region:'Sea to Sky',
  sourceUrl:'https://bcparks.ca/garibaldi-park/black-tusk-garibaldi-lake-area/',
  caution:'Bookings and park access rules may change.',
};

test('date inputs are optional as a pair and reject malformed, backwards, and >366-day ranges',()=>{
  assert.equal(tripDateError('',''),null);
  assert.match(tripDateError('2027-05-01',''),/both/);
  assert.match(tripDateError('','2027-05-01'),/both/);
  assert.match(tripDateError('2027-02-30','2027-03-02'),/valid/);
  assert.match(tripDateError('2027-03-02','2027-03-01'),/before/);
  assert.equal(tripDateError('2028-02-28','2028-03-01'),null);
  assert.equal(tripDateError('2027-01-01','2028-01-01'),null); // 366 inclusive days
  assert.match(tripDateError('2027-01-01','2028-01-02'),/366/);
});

test('preview handles single day, multi-day, leap day and displays bounded date list',()=>{
  let result=discoverTripPreview('Garibaldi Lake','2028-02-29','2028-02-29');
  assert.equal(result.count,1);assert.equal(result.days[0].date,'2028-02-29');
  assert.match(result.days[0].activities,/Explore Garibaldi Lake/);
  result=discoverTripPreview('Garibaldi Lake','2028-02-28','2028-03-02');
  assert.equal(result.count,4);assert.deepEqual(result.days.map(day=>day.day),[1,2,4]);
  assert.deepEqual(result.days.map(day=>day.date),['2028-02-28','2028-02-29','2028-03-02']);
  assert.match(result.days.at(-1).activities,/Return/);
  assert.equal(discoverTripPreview('Garibaldi Lake','','').count,0);
});

test('seeded days are high-level editable activities without fake route or campsite data',()=>{
  const first=createDiscoverDaySeed(destination,0,3);
  const middle=createDiscoverDaySeed(destination,1,3);
  const last=createDiscoverDaySeed(destination,2,3);
  assert.match(first.activities,/Travel/);assert.match(first.notes,/not.*verified|No route/i);
  assert.match(middle.activities,/choose and verify/);assert.equal(middle.notes,undefined);
  assert.match(last.activities,/Return/);
  for (const day of [first,middle,last]) {
    for (const key of ['distanceKm','campsite','startLocation','endLocation','durationMinutes','waterSource']) {
      assert.equal(Object.hasOwn(day,key),false,`${key} must not be fabricated`);
    }
  }
  assert.match(starterDayActivity('Lake',0,1),/Explore Lake/);
});

test('Trip Logistics includes official source, caution and placeholders, never reservations as booked',()=>{
  const result=createDiscoverLogistics(destination);

  assert.doesNotMatch(createDiscoverLogistics({...destination,sourceUrl:'javascript:alert(1)'}).notes,/javascript:/);
});

test('sidebar offers date and traveller choice, day preview, and private planner handoff',()=>{
  const c=file('components/discover/DestinationTripForm.tsx');

test('server forwards whitelisted fields and existing build action seeds inside transaction',()=>{
  const discover=file('app/discover/actions.ts');
  const build=file('app/build/actions.ts');
  assert.match(discover,/const raw = formData.get\("destinationId"\)/);
  assert.match(discover,/for \(const key of \["startDate", "endDate", "people"\]/);
  assert.match(discover,/values.set\("discoverPlan", "1"\)/);
  assert.match(discover,/await createBuild\(values\)/);
  assert.match(build,/parseBuildDetails\(formData\)/);
  assert.match(build,/createDiscoverLogistics\(selected\)/);

test('createBuild transaction keeps ordinary builds unchanged and seeds only Discover plans', async () => {
  // Exercise the actual patched createBuild function with repository-shaped mocks,
  // not a rewritten version of the production implementation.
  const source=file('app/build/actions.ts');
  const begin=source.indexOf('export async function createBuild(formData: FormData) {');
  const end=source.indexOf('export async function addGear(',begin);
  assert.ok(begin > 0 && end > begin);
  const executable=source.slice(begin,end).replace('export async function createBuild(formData: FormData) {','async function createBuild(formData) {');
  const makeAction=new Function('services',`const {currentBuildUserId,prisma,parseBuildDetails,getDestination,getDateRange,createDiscoverLogistics,createDiscoverDaySeed,recordBuildRevision,setCurrentBuild,redirect}=services;\n${executable}\nreturn createBuild;`);
  const run = async (discover, seed) => {
    const writes={build:null,days:[],revisions:[],current:null,url:null};
    const services={
      currentBuildUserId: async()=> 'user-1',
      prisma:{
        userSettings:{findUnique:async()=>({defaultBuildPublic:true})},
        $transaction: async fn=>fn({
          build:{create:async ({data})=>{writes.build=data;return {id:'new-trip',startDate:data.startDate,endDate:data.endDate};}},
          tripDay:{createMany:async({data})=>{writes.days=data;}},
        }),
      },
      parseBuildDetails: form=>({
        name:String(form.get('name')), destinationId:'garibaldi-lake',
        location:null, latitude:null, longitude:null,
        people:2,conditions:null,minTemperature:null,
        dates:{startDate:new Date('2028-07-01'),endDate:new Date('2028-07-02')},
      }),
      getDestination:()=>destination,
      getDateRange:(start,end)=>[new Date(start),new Date(end)],
      createDiscoverLogistics,createDiscoverDaySeed,
      recordBuildRevision:async (...args)=>{writes.revisions.push(args);},
      setCurrentBuild:async(...args)=>{writes.current=args;},
      redirect:url=>{writes.url=url;},
    };
    const form=new FormData();form.set('name','Lake trip');
    if(discover)form.set('discoverPlan','1');
    if(seed)form.set('seedItinerary','1');
    await makeAction(services)(form);
    return writes;
  };
  const discover=await run(true,true);
  assert.equal(discover.build.isPublic,false);
  assert.equal(discover.build.location,'Garibaldi Lake, Garibaldi Park');
  assert.match(discover.build.tripLogistics.notes,/bcparks.ca/);
  assert.equal(discover.days.length,2);
  assert.match(discover.days[0].activities,/Travel to/);
  assert.match(discover.days[1].activities,/Return from/);
  assert.ok(discover.days.every(day=>!Object.hasOwn(day,'campsite') && !Object.hasOwn(day,'distanceKm')));
  assert.equal(discover.revisions.length,1);
  assert.deepEqual(discover.current,['new-trip',false]);
  assert.equal(discover.url,'/build/new-trip?tab=trip');
  const noSeed=await run(true,false);
  assert.equal(noSeed.days[0].activities,undefined);
  assert.equal(noSeed.days[0].notes,undefined);
  const regular=await run(false,true);
  assert.equal(regular.build.isPublic,true);
  assert.equal(regular.build.tripLogistics,undefined);
  assert.equal(regular.days[0].activities,undefined);
  assert.equal(regular.url,'/build/new-trip');
});
```

```typescript
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { previewTrails, filterPreviewTrails } from "../lib/discover-preview.ts";

test("preview data has unique ids", () => {
  assert.equal(new Set(previewTrails.map((t) => t.id)).size, previewTrails.length);
});

test("search matches trail and region names case insensitively", () => {
  const results = filterPreviewTrails(previewTrails, { query: "gaRIbaldi" });
  assert.ok(results.some((t) => t.name === "Garibaldi Lake"));
  assert.ok(results.some((t) => t.name === "Elfin Lakes"));
});

test("trip type and region filters combine", () => {
  const results = filterPreviewTrails(previewTrails, { kind: "multi", region: "Vancouver Island" });
  assert.equal(results.length, 2);
  assert.ok(results.every((t) => t.region === "Vancouver Island" && t.kind === "multi"));
});

test("search is normalized for accents", () => {
  assert.equal(filterPreviewTrails(previewTrails, { query: "o’hara" })[0]?.name, "Lake O’Hara");
});

test("unknown queries return an empty list", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(filterPreviewTrails(previewTrails, { query: "unlisted trail 12345" }), []);
});

test("alphabetical sort does not mutate source array", () => {
  const original = previewTrails.map((t) => t.id);
  const sorted = filterPreviewTrails(previewTrails, { sort: "alphabetical" });
  assert.deepEqual(sorted.map((t) => t.name), [...sorted.map((t) => t.name)].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)));
  assert.deepEqual(previewTrails.map((t) => t.id), original);
});
```

```typescript
import test from 'node:test';

const read=(rel)=>readFileSync(new URL('../'+rel,import.meta.url),'utf8');
const DESTINATIONS=JSON.parse(read('data/destinations.json'));

test('finder safely normalizes unsupported URL preferences and array inputs',()=>{
  assert.deepEqual(parseFinderPreferences({}),DEFAULT_PREFERENCES);
  assert.deepEqual(parseFinderPreferences({style:'overnight',area:'sea-to-sky',difficulty:['hard','easy'],scenery:'lakes',priority:'facilities'}),
    {style:'overnight',area:'sea-to-sky',difficulty:'hard',scenery:'lakes',priority:'facilities'});
  assert.deepEqual(parseFinderPreferences({style:'inject',area:'not-a-region',difficulty:'impossible',scenery:'unknown',priority:'random'}),DEFAULT_PREFERENCES);
});

test('overnight suggestions require both camping and backpacking on an explicit campground',()=>{
  const prefs={...DEFAULT_PREFERENCES,style:'overnight'};
  for(const row of DESTINATIONS.filter(d=>finderEligible(d,prefs))) {
    assert.equal(row.kind,'campground');assert.ok(row.activities.includes('camping'));assert.ok(row.activities.includes('backpacking'));
  }
  const results=recommendDestinations(DESTINATIONS,prefs);
  assert.ok(results.length>=1);
  for(const result of results) assert.equal(result.destination.kind,'campground');
  assert.equal(finderEligible(DESTINATIONS.find(d=>d.id==='garibaldi-lake-destination'),prefs),false);
});

test('day-hike suggestions exclude campgrounds with no listed hiking activity',()=>{
  const prefs={...DEFAULT_PREFERENCES,style:'day'};
  assert.ok(recommendDestinations(DESTINATIONS,prefs).every(x=>x.destination.activities.includes('hiking')));
});

test('region and difficulty are enforced, never softened to create recommendations',()=>{
  const prefs={...DEFAULT_PREFERENCES,area:'island',difficulty:'hard'};
  assert.ok(recommendDestinations(DESTINATIONS,prefs).every(x=>x.destination.region==='Vancouver Island'&&x.destination.difficulty==='hard'));
  const rows=DESTINATIONS.filter(d=>d.region==='Haida Gwaii');
  assert.deepEqual(recommendDestinations(rows,{...DEFAULT_PREFERENCES,area:'sea-to-sky'}),[]);
});

test('scenery preference is supported by catalog text, not guessed from region',()=>{
  for(const scenery of ['lakes','summits','forest','coast','meadows']) {
    const prefs={...DEFAULT_PREFERENCES,scenery};
    for(const entry of recommendDestinations(DESTINATIONS,prefs)) {
      assert.equal(entry.sceneryMatch,true);assert.ok(sceneryMatches(entry.destination,scenery));
      assert.ok(entry.reasons.some(reason=>reason.includes('catalog description')));
    }
  }
  assert.deepEqual(recommendDestinations(DESTINATIONS.filter(d=>d.kind==='summit'),{...DEFAULT_PREFERENCES,scenery:'coast'}).filter(x=>!sceneryMatches(x.destination,'coast')),[]);
});

test('recommendations are deterministic, capped and diverse by park where possible',()=>{
  const prefs={...DEFAULT_PREFERENCES,area:'sea-to-sky',scenery:'lakes'};
  const actual=recommendDestinations(DESTINATIONS,prefs);
  assert.ok(actual.length>0&&actual.length<=4);
  assert.deepEqual(actual.map(m=>m.destination.id),recommendDestinations([...DESTINATIONS].reverse(),prefs).map(m=>m.destination.id));
  assert.equal(new Set(actual.map(m=>m.destination.id)).size,actual.length);
  const one=recommendDestinations(DESTINATIONS,prefs,1);assert.equal(one.length,1);

test('finder reasons and cautions never misreport missing data as zero',()=>{

  assert.ok(result.cautions.some(t=>t.includes('Elevation gain missing')));
  assert.ok(!result.reasons.includes('Route distance listed'));

  assert.equal(legacyDiscoverDestination({q:'Munro Lake'}),'/discover/search?q=Munro+Lake');
  assert.equal(legacyDiscoverDestination({}),null);
});
```

### `tests/discover-search-map.test.mjs`

```typescript
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { parseDiscoverSearch, discoverUrl, filterDiscoverDestinations } from "../lib/discover.ts";
import { hasMappedCoordinates, splitMappedDestinations } from "../lib/discover-search-map.ts";

const read = path => readFileSync(new URL("../" + path, import.meta.url), "utf8");
const catalog = JSON.parse(read("data/destinations.json"));
const first = catalog.find(d => hasMappedCoordinates(d));

// The exact count is intentional: don't silently infer coordinates for missing rows.
test("map includes only real stored coordinates, preserving all results", () => {
  const split = splitMappedDestinations(catalog);
  assert.equal(split.mapped.length, 125);
  assert.equal(split.unmapped.length, catalog.length - 125);
  assert.equal(split.mapped.length + split.unmapped.length, catalog.length);
  assert.ok(split.mapped.every(hasMappedCoordinates));
  assert.ok(split.unmapped.every(d => !("latitude" in d) && !("longitude" in d)));
  assert.deepEqual(split.mapped.map(d => d.id), catalog.filter(hasMappedCoordinates).map(d => d.id));
});

test("invalid, null, out-of-range and infinite coordinates cannot become map markers", () => {
  for (const coords of [
    {latitude:null,longitude:1},{latitude:2,longitude:null},{latitude:NaN,longitude:2},
    {latitude:3,longitude:Infinity},{latitude:91,longitude:40},{latitude:2,longitude:-181},
    {latitude:"49.0",longitude:-123},
  ]) assert.equal(hasMappedCoordinates(coords),false);
  assert.equal(hasMappedCoordinates(first),true);
});

test("map and grid reflect the identical server-side filtered catalog", () => {
  const filters = parseDiscoverSearch({q:"Garibaldi",region:"Sea to Sky",activity:"camping",display:"map"});
  const result = filterDiscoverDestinations(catalog,filters);
  const {mapped,unmapped} = splitMappedDestinations(result);
  assert.equal(result.length, mapped.length + unmapped.length);
  assert.ok(mapped.every(d => result.includes(d)));
  assert.ok(unmapped.every(d => result.some(x => x.id === d.id)));
});

test("display=map is whitelisted, shareable and preserves filters", () => {
  const parsed = parseDiscoverSearch({view:"destinations",display:"map",q:"Lake & River",activity:"hiking",region:"Sea to Sky",page:"3"});
  assert.equal(parsed.display,"map");
  const href = discoverUrl(parsed,{region:"Lower Mainland",page:1});
  const u = new URL(href,"https://trailpicker.local");
  assert.equal(u.pathname,"/discover/search");
  assert.equal(u.searchParams.get("display"),"map");
  assert.equal(u.searchParams.get("region"),"Lower Mainland");
  assert.equal(u.searchParams.get("activity"),"hiking");
  assert.equal(u.searchParams.get("q"),"Lake & River");
  assert.equal(u.searchParams.has("view"),false);
  assert.equal(u.searchParams.has("page"),false);
  const grid = new URL(discoverUrl(parsed,{display:"grid"}),"https://trailpicker.local");
  assert.equal(grid.searchParams.has("display"),false);
  assert.equal(grid.searchParams.get("activity"),"hiking");
});

test("map display only belongs to destination search; invalid display is grid", () => {
  assert.equal(parseDiscoverSearch({view:"destinations",display:"attack"}).display,"grid");
  assert.equal(parseDiscoverSearch({view:"packs",display:"map"}).display,"grid");
  assert.equal(parseDiscoverSearch({view:"trips",display:"map"}).display,"grid");
  assert.equal(new URL(discoverUrl(parseDiscoverSearch({view:"destinations",display:"map"}),{view:"saved"}),"http://localhost").searchParams.has("display"),false);
});

test("map view uses safe client-only Leaflet and shows unmapped results", () => {
  const page = read("components/discover/DiscoverLanding.tsx");
  const server = read("components/discover/DiscoverResultsServer.tsx");
  const view = read("components/discover/DiscoverDestinationMapView.tsx");
  const map = read("components/discover/DiscoverSearchMapInner.tsx");
  const wrapper = read("components/discover/DiscoverSearchMap.tsx");
  const routes = read("lib/discover.ts");
  assert.match(page,/href=\{discoverUrl\(filters, \{display: "map", page: 1\}\)\}/);
  assert.match(page,/name="display" value="map"/);
  assert.match(page,/!isMapView && totalPages > 1/);
  assert.match(server,/splitMappedDestinations\(matching\)/);
  assert.match(view,/unmapped\.map/);
  assert.match(view,/onSelect=\{setSelectedId\}/);
  assert.match(map,/tile.openstreetmap.org/);
  assert.match(map,/referrerPolicy="origin"/);
  assert.match(map,/CtrlWheelZoom/);
  assert.match(map,/tileerror/);
  assert.match(wrapper,/ssr: false/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(routes,/\/discover\?view=destinations/);
});
```

### `tests/discover-trips.test.mjs`

```typescript
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import {parseTripFeature, publicTripAuthor, publicTripDay, summarizeTripDays, tripBrowseHref, tripHref, tripDayTitle} from '../lib/discover-trips.ts';
const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url);
const file=rel=>fs.readFileSync(new URL(rel,root),'utf8');

test('trip query params reject unexpected values and encode urls',()=>{
  assert.equal(parseTripFeature('route'),'route');
  assert.equal(parseTripFeature(['gear','campsite']),'gear');
  assert.equal(parseTripFeature('hijack'),'all');
  const href=tripBrowseHref({q:'Forest & Ocean',location:'Vancouver Island',region:'Sea to Sky',sort:'popular'},'campsite',{page:2});
  const p=new URL(href,'http://localhost').searchParams;
  assert.equal(new URL(href,'http://localhost').pathname,'/discover/community');assert.equal(p.get('feature'),'campsite');assert.equal(p.get('q'),'Forest & Ocean');assert.equal(p.get('page'),'2');
  assert.equal(tripHref('abc/123'),'/discover/trips/abc%2F123');
});

test('distance and ascent metrics are transparent about partial data',()=>{
  const days=[{date:'2026-08-01',startLocation:'Trailhead',endLocation:'Camp',distanceKm:10,elevationGainM:400,campsite:'Camp',activities:'Hike'},
    {date:'2026-08-02',startLocation:'Camp',endLocation:'Trailhead',distanceKm:null,elevationGainM:0,campsite:null,activities:null}];
  const s=summarizeTripDays(days);
  assert.deepEqual(s,{dayCount:2,distanceKm:10,elevationGainM:400,measuredDistanceDays:1,measuredGainDays:2,campsites:1});
  assert.equal(summarizeTripDays([]).distanceKm,null);
  assert.equal(tripDayTitle(days[0],0),'Trailhead → Camp');
});

test('public day whitelist excludes notes, reservations and private logistics',()=>{
  const day={date:'2026-01-01',startLocation:null,endLocation:null,distanceKm:0,elevationGainM:null,campsite:null,activities:'Walk',notes:'Secret',reservation:'123456',tripLogistics:'Private'};
  assert.equal(publicTripDay(day).distanceKm,0);
  for(const key of ['notes','reservation','tripLogistics']) assert.equal(Object.hasOwn(publicTripDay(day),key),false);
  assert.equal(publicTripAuthor({name:'Private Name',username:'secret',isProfilePublic:false}),'Community member');
  assert.equal(publicTripAuthor({name:'Public Name',username:'hiker',isProfilePublic:true}),'hiker');
});

test('Trip discovery is public-only and indexed by real stored itinerary data',()=>{
  const landing=file('components/discover/DiscoverResultsServer.tsx');
  assert.match(landing,/if \(filters\.view === "trips"\)/);
  assert.match(landing,/isPublic: true, days: \{some: \{\}\}/);
  assert.match(landing,/feature === "campsite"/);
  assert.match(landing,/feature === "route"/);
  assert.match(landing,/feature === "gear"/);
  assert.match(landing,/const count = await prisma\.build\.count/);
  assert.match(landing,/return <TripExplore/);
  const page=file('app/discover/trips/[id]/page.tsx');
  assert.match(page,/where:\{id,isPublic:true,days:\{some:\{\}\}\}/);
  assert.match(page,/routeWaypoints:true/);
  assert.match(page,/id:true,date:true/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(page,/tripLogistics:true|reservation:true|notes:true/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(page,/locationLat:true|locationLng:true/);
  const detail=file('components/discover/PublicTripDetail.tsx');
  assert.match(detail,/const coords=destination\?validCoordinates\(destination\):null/);
  assert.match(detail,/TripActions/);
  const actions=file('app/discover/actions.ts');
  assert.match(actions,/source\.days\.length \? "\?tab=trip" : ""/);
});
```

### `tests/discover.test.mjs`

```typescript
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import { discoverUrl, parseDiscoverSearch, summarizePublicBuild, filterDiscoverDestinations } from "../lib/discover.ts";

test("search params are validated and capped", () => {
  const filters = parseDiscoverSearch({ view: "unknown", sort: "unknown", q: "  mountain   ", location: " BC ", page: "-20" });
  assert.deepEqual(filters, { view: "destinations", display: "grid", sort: "popular", q: "mountain", location: "BC", region: "", difficulty: "all", activity: "all", category: "all", page: 1 });
  assert.equal(parseDiscoverSearch({ page: "3", view: "saved", sort: "popular" }).page, 3);
  assert.equal(parseDiscoverSearch({ view: "trips", sort: "distance" }).sort, "recent");
  assert.equal(parseDiscoverSearch({ view: "destinations", sort: "distance", difficulty: "hard" }).difficulty, "hard");
  assert.equal(parseDiscoverSearch({ page: "3.2" }).page, 1);
  assert.equal(parseDiscoverSearch({ page: "9999999" }).page, 1);
  assert.equal(parseDiscoverSearch({ page: "NaN" }).page, 1);
  assert.equal(parseDiscoverSearch({ q: "x".repeat(300) }).q.length, 100);
});

test("discover urls preserve filters and URL encode values", () => {
  const path = discoverUrl({ view: "destinations", sort: "popular", q: "Lake & River", location: "BC, Canada" }, { view: "saved", page: 2 });
  const url = new URL(path, "https://example.com");
  assert.equal(url.pathname, "/discover/saved");
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get("view"), null);
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get("q"), "Lake & River");
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get("page"), "2");
});

test("summaries exclude worn and consumables and multiply quantities", () => {
  const summary = summarizePublicBuild([
    { quantity: 2, isWorn: false, isConsumable: false, weightSnapshot: null, gear: { weight_g: 1200 } },
    { quantity: 1, isWorn: true, isConsumable: false, weightSnapshot: 400, gear: null },
    { quantity: 3, isWorn: false, isConsumable: true, weightSnapshot: 100, gear: null },
  ], [
    { distanceKm: 3.4, elevationGainM: 120 },
    { distanceKm: null, elevationGainM: 90 },
  ]);
  assert.equal(summary.itemCount, 6);
  assert.equal(summary.baseWeightG, 2400);
  assert.equal(summary.distanceKm, 3.4);
  assert.equal(summary.partialDistance, true);
  assert.equal(summary.elevationGainM, 210);
  assert.equal(summary.dayCount, 2);
});

test("unknown base weights are not misreported as complete", () => {
  const summary = summarizePublicBuild([
    { quantity: 1, isWorn: false, isConsumable: false, weightSnapshot: null, gear: null },
  ], []);
  assert.equal(summary.baseWeightG, null);
  assert.equal(summary.unknownBaseWeights, 1);
  assert.equal(summary.distanceKm, null);
  assert.equal(summary.elevationGainM, null);
});


test("curated destination filtering respects region, difficulty, search and sorting", () => {
  const destinations = [
    { id: "a", name: "Alpine Lake", park: "Park A", region: "Rockies", difficulty: "hard", distanceKm: 15, elevationGainM: 1400, featured: true, summary: "Large lake" },
    { id: "b", name: "Coastal Loop", park: "Park B", region: "Sea to Sky", difficulty: "easy", distanceKm: 5, elevationGainM: 80, featured: false, summary: "Coastal forests" },
    { id: "c", name: "Lake Circuit", park: "Park A", region: "Rockies", difficulty: "easy", distanceKm: 3, elevationGainM: 100, featured: false, summary: "Lake walk" },
  ];
  assert.deepEqual(filterDiscoverDestinations(destinations, { q: "lake", region: "Rockies", difficulty: "all", sort: "distance" }).map(d => d.id), ["c", "a"]);
  assert.deepEqual(filterDiscoverDestinations(destinations, { q: "", region: "", difficulty: "easy", sort: "name" }).map(d => d.id), ["b", "c"]);
  assert.equal(filterDiscoverDestinations(destinations, { q: "missing", region: "", difficulty: "all", sort: "popular" }).length, 0);
});
```

### `tests/export-import-toolbar-v088.test.cjs`

```typescript
const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const { readFileSync } = require('node:fs');
const { resolve } = require('node:path');
const read = file => readFileSync(resolve(__dirname, '..', file), 'utf8');
const toolbar = read('components/builder/BuildDataTools.tsx');
const route = read('components/builder/TripPlanner/TripRoute.tsx');
const bridge = read('lib/trip-export-events.ts');
const server = read('lib/trip-export-actions.ts');

test('toolbar is the only home for the four export formats', () => {
  for (const name of ['TrailPicker backup', 'Trip document', 'GPX route', 'Spreadsheet (CSV)']) {
    assert.ok(toolbar.includes(name), `${name} option missing`);
  }
  assert.match(toolbar, /role="menu"/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /tool === "trip-document"/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /tool === "csv-export"/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /tool === "gpx-export"/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(route, /Print & export|Open printable itinerary|Logistics CSV|Campsites CSV|Packing checklist CSV|aria-label="Print and export"/);
});

test('JSON backup and both import paths remain available', () => {
  assert.match(toolbar, /getBuildExport\(buildId\)/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /inspectImport\(text\)/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /importBuildItems\(formData\)/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /startGpxAction\(action\)/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /importGpx\(await file\.text\(\), gpxDayId \|\| null\)/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /GPX_TOOLBAR_IMPORT/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /GPX_TOOLBAR_EXPORT/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /No(thing)? to export yet/);
});

test('export bridge uses live Trip Planner data, otherwise an authenticated saved projection', () => {
  assert.match(bridge, /TRIP_EXPORT_REQUEST/);
  assert.match(route, /window\.addEventListener\(TRIP_EXPORT_REQUEST/);
  assert.match(route, /liveExportRef\.current = liveExport/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /liveTripExport\(\) \?\? getTripExportData\(buildId\)/);
  assert.match(server, /requireBuildAccess\(buildId\)/);
  assert.match(server, /readPrivateResources\(build\.tripLogistics\)/);
  assert.match(server, /analyzePack\(build\.items\)/);
});

test('document sections and private details are explicitly selectable', () => {
  for (const name of ['itinerary','resources','logistics','packing']) assert.match(toolbar, new RegExp(`"${name}"`));
  assert.match(toolbar, /checked=\{includePrivate\}/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /printableTripHtml\(data, includePrivate, documentSections/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /window\.open\("", "_blank"\)/);
});
```

```typescript
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { emptyFoodPlan } from '../lib/food-plan.ts';
import { parseLogistics } from '../lib/build-validation.ts';
import { exportPackCsv, printableTripHtml } from '../lib/trip-resources-export.ts';
import { emptyLogistics } from '../lib/trip-planner.ts';

const plan = { ...emptyFoodPlan(), foods: [{id:'f',name:'=Sensitive name',gramsPerUnit:180,startingUnits:2,countInPack:true}],
  meals:[{id:'m',dayId:'d',slot:'dinner',foodId:'f',units:1,heated:false}],
  resupplies:[{id:'r',waypointId:'rs',foodId:'f',units:2,fuelGrams:0}],
};
test('phase7 survives logistics import validation with mapped route/day references',()=>{
  const parsed=parseLogistics({...emptyLogistics,phase7:plan},['d'],[],['rs']);
  assert.deepEqual(parsed?.phase7,plan);
  assert.equal(parsed?.phase6,undefined);
  assert.throws(()=>parseLogistics({...emptyLogistics,phase7:plan},['d'],[],[]),/Resupply/);
});
test('packing CSV and print view show planned food without raw formula execution',()=>{
  const payload={name:'Test',packLines:[],days:[{id:'d',date:new Date('2026-06-01T12:00:00Z'),startLocation:null,endLocation:null,notes:null}],
    points:[],logistics:emptyLogistics,bookings:[],foodPlan:plan};
  const csv=exportPackCsv(payload);
  assert.match(csv, /'=(Sensitive name|Sensitive name)/);
  assert.match(csv, /Planned food/);
  const html=printableTripHtml(payload);
  assert.match(html,/Food &amp; meals/);
  assert.match(html,/Day 1 · dinner/);
  assert.match(html,/=Sensitive name/);
});
test('private plans are optional to Phase 6 exports',()=>{
  const csv=exportPackCsv({packLines:[]});
  assert.match(csv,/Item/);
});
```

### `tests/food-plan.test.mjs`

```typescript
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFoodPlan, validateFoodPlan, projectFoodPlan, emptyFoodPlan } from '../lib/food-plan.ts';

const make = () => ({
  foods: [
    { id:'rice',name:'Rice packet',gramsPerUnit:100,startingUnits:3,countInPack:true },
    { id:'bars',name:'Snack bar',gramsPerUnit:50,startingUnits:2,countInPack:true },
  ],
  meals:[{id:'m1',dayId:'d1',slot:'dinner',foodId:'rice',units:1,heated:true},
    {id:'m2',dayId:'d2',slot:'lunch',foodId:'bars',units:1,heated:false}],
  resupplies:[{id:'r1',waypointId:'s1',foodId:'rice',units:2,fuelGrams:60}],
  settings:{...emptyFoodPlan().settings,startingFuelGrams:30,otherDailyUseGrams:10},
});
const route=[{id:'s1',kind:'resupply',dayId:'d2'}];
test('valid phase7 plan and private serialization',()=>{
  const p=make();assert.deepEqual(validateFoodPlan(p,['d1','d2'],route),p);
  assert.deepEqual(readFoodPlan({phase7:p}),p);
  assert.deepEqual(readFoodPlan(null),emptyFoodPlan());
});
test('daily timeline uses actual meal units and mapped resupply day',()=>{
  const summary=projectFoodPlan(make(),['d1','d2'],route,1200,200);
  assert.equal(summary.startingFoodKnownGrams,400);
  assert.equal(summary.initialCarriedKnownGrams,1830);
  assert.equal(summary.days[0].packStartKnownGrams,1830);
  assert.equal(summary.days[0].packEndKnownGrams,1708); // 100 g meal + 12 g fuel + 10 other
  assert.equal(summary.days[1].foodAddedGrams,200);
  assert.equal(summary.days[1].fuelAddedGrams,60);
  assert.equal(summary.days[1].packStartKnownGrams,1968);
  assert.equal(summary.days[1].packEndKnownGrams,1908); // 50 g snack + 10 other
  assert.equal(summary.fuelNeededGrams,12);
});
test('resupply follows reassigned route day without changing saved resupply',()=>{
  const p=make(), summary=projectFoodPlan(p,['d1','d2'],[{...route[0],dayId:'d1'}],0,0);
  assert.equal(summary.days[0].foodAddedGrams,200);
  assert.equal(summary.days[1].foodAddedGrams,0);
});
test('unassigned resupply does not invent arrival or mass',()=>{
  const summary=projectFoodPlan(make(),['d1','d2'],[{...route[0],dayId:null}],0,0);
  assert.equal(summary.orphanedResupplies,1);
  assert.equal(summary.totalFuelSuppliedGrams,30);
  assert.equal(summary.days[1].foodAddedGrams,0);
});
test('insufficient food and fuel produce explicit shortfall',()=>{
  const p=make();p.foods[0].startingUnits=0;p.resupplies=[];p.settings.startingFuelGrams=3;
  const result=projectFoodPlan(p,['d1','d2'],route,0,0);
  assert.equal(result.days[0].shortfalls[0].missingUnits,1);
  assert.equal(result.days[0].fuelShortfallGrams,9);
  assert.equal(result.days[0].foodConsumedGrams,0);
});
test('unknown food mass is not silently represented as complete',()=>{
  const p=make();p.foods[0].gramsPerUnit=null;
  const result=projectFoodPlan(p,['d1','d2'],route,0,0);
  assert.equal(result.missingFoodWeights,true);
  assert.equal(result.days[0].foodStartGrams,null);
});
test('food already in Builder can be excluded from double counted mass',()=>{
  const p=make();p.foods[0].countInPack=false;p.settings.countFuelInPack=false;
  const result=projectFoodPlan(p,['d1','d2'],route,500,400);
  assert.equal(result.initialCarriedKnownGrams,1000); // base + existing builder + only snack bars
});
test('invalid day, stop, duplicate food and unreasonable mass rejected',()=>{
  const p=make();p.meals[0].dayId='deleted';
  assert.throws(()=>validateFoodPlan(p,['d1','d2'],route),/Invalid meal/);
  p.meals[0].dayId='d1';p.resupplies[0].waypointId='deleted';
  assert.throws(()=>validateFoodPlan(p,['d1','d2'],route),/Resupply/);
  p.resupplies[0].waypointId='s1';p.foods.push({...p.foods[0]});
  assert.throws(()=>validateFoodPlan(p,['d1','d2'],route),/Duplicate food/);
  p.foods.pop();p.foods[0].gramsPerUnit=-1;
  assert.throws(()=>validateFoodPlan(p,['d1','d2'],route),/Invalid food/);
});
test('cannot forge arbitrary object fields or invalid fuel settings',()=>{
  const p=make();p.settings.extra='ignore';
  assert.throws(()=>validateFoodPlan(p,['d1','d2'],route),/Invalid fuel/);
  delete p.settings.extra;p.settings.fuelAdjustment=100;
  assert.throws(()=>validateFoodPlan(p,['d1','d2'],route),/Invalid fuelAdjustment/);
});
test('read tolerates invalid legacy contents',()=>{
  const plan=readFoodPlan({phase7:{foods:[{id:3,name:'bad'}],meals:[{bad:true}],resupplies:[null]}});
  assert.equal(plan.foods.length,0);
  assert.equal(plan.meals.length,0);
  assert.equal(plan.settings.startingFuelGrams,0);
});

```

### `tests/gear-comparison.test.mjs`

```typescript
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { parseCompareIds, comparisonPrice, getComparisonRows } from "../lib/gear-comparison.ts";

const fixture = (id, overrides = {}) => ({
  id, name: id, price_cad: 200, weight_g: 900, capacity_l: 55,
  frame_type: "internal", waterproof: false, temperature_rating: null,
  material: "Nylon", season: null,
  brand: { name: "Brand" }, category: { id: "packs", name: "Packs", slug: "packs" },
  subcategory: { name: "Backpacks", slug: "backpacks" },
  specifications: [], prices: [], reviews: [], ...overrides,
});

test("comparison IDs are deduplicated, constrained and capped", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(parseCompareIds(" a ,b,a,c,d,e "), ["a", "b", "c", "d"]);
  assert.deepEqual(parseCompareIds(undefined), []);
  assert.deepEqual(parseCompareIds("x".repeat(1001)), []);
  assert.deepEqual(parseCompareIds(["a", "b"]), ["a", "b"]);
});

test("lowest in-stock CAD price is used without treating foreign currencies as CAD", () => {
  const one = fixture("one", { prices: [{ price: 120, currency: "USD", inStock: true }, { price: 180, currency: "CAD", inStock: true }, { price: 50, currency: "CAD", inStock: false }] });
  assert.equal(comparisonPrice(one), 180);
  assert.equal(comparisonPrice(fixture("two", { price_cad: 30, prices: [{ price: 20, currency: "USD", inStock: true }] })), 30);
});

test("numeric comparisons highlight lightest, least expensive and highest capacity", () => {
  const rows = getComparisonRows([
    fixture("heavy", { weight_g: 1500, price_cad: 300, capacity_l: 40 }),
    fixture("light", { weight_g: 800, price_cad: 150, capacity_l: 65 }),
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(rows.find(r => r.key === "weight")?.bestIndices, [1]);
  assert.deepEqual(rows.find(r => r.key === "price")?.bestIndices, [1]);
  assert.deepEqual(rows.find(r => r.key === "capacity")?.bestIndices, [1]);
  assert.equal(rows.find(r => r.key === "price")?.different, true);
});

test("unknown specs remain null and do not win best-value comparisons", () => {
  const rows = getComparisonRows([fixture("known", { weight_g: 500 }), fixture("unknown", { weight_g: null })]);
  const weight = rows.find(r => r.key === "weight");
  assert.deepEqual(weight?.values, ["500 g", null]);
  assert.deepEqual(weight?.bestIndices, []);
  assert.equal(weight?.different, false);
});

test("category-specific specs align by normalized key rather than row order", () => {
  const rows = getComparisonRows([
    fixture("one", { specifications: [{ key: "Packed_Size", value: "40 x 12", unit: "cm" }, { key: "Torso length", value: "Medium", unit: null }] }),
    fixture("two", { specifications: [{ key: "torso-length", value: "Large", unit: null }] }),
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(rows.find(r => r.key === "spec:torso length")?.values, ["Medium", "Large"]);
  assert.deepEqual(rows.find(r => r.key === "spec:packed size")?.values, ["40 x 12 cm", null]);
  assert.equal(rows.find(r => r.key === "spec:torso length")?.different, true);
});

test("a tied value is not falsely highlighted as better", () => {
  const row = getComparisonRows([fixture("a"), fixture("b")]).find(r => r.key === "weight");
  assert.deepEqual(row?.bestIndices, []);
  assert.equal(row?.different, false);
});

```

### `tests/gpx-route.test.mjs`

```typescript
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { exportGpx, importGpx } from "../lib/gpx-route.ts";
import { computeRouteMetrics } from "../lib/route-metrics.ts";
const a={id:"a",name:"A&B <trailhead>",lat:49.2,lng:-123.2,kind:"trailhead",elevationM:100};
const b={id:"b",name:"End",lat:49.201,lng:-123.201,kind:"waypoint",elevationM:180};
const track={toId:"b",source:"gpx",distanceM:2000,geometry:[[a.lat,a.lng],[49.2005,-123.2005],[b.lat,b.lng]],elevationsM:[100,140,180],ascentM:80,descentM:0};
const example={...a,trailToNext:track};

test("GPX export uses valid waypoint and track tags, escapes names and keeps elevation samples",()=>{
  const xml=exportGpx([example,b],"Crest & Lake");
  assert.match(xml,/<gpx version="1\.1"/);
  assert.match(xml,/<name>Crest &amp; Lake<\/name>/);
  assert.match(xml,/<name>A&amp;B &lt;trailhead&gt;<\/name>/);
  assert.match(xml,/<ele>140<\/ele>/);
  assert.equal((xml.match(/<trkpt /g)||[]).length,3);
});
test("unmapped lines are exported explicitly as unverified, not made-up trail measurements",()=>{
  const xml=exportGpx([{...a,manualToNext:true},b]);
  assert.match(xml,/<tp:approximate>true<\/tp:approximate>/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(xml,/<ele>180<\/ele><\/trkpt>/);
});
test("GPX import validates size and unsafe document declarations before parsing",()=>{
  assert.throws(()=>importGpx('a'.repeat(4_000_001)), /4 MB/);
  assert.throws(()=>importGpx('<!DOCTYPE gpx><gpx/>'), /document declarations/);
});
// A browser's native DOMParser provides XML validation without a runtime dependency.
// Optional DOM implementation exercises import in Node when present (e.g., test harness).
test("GPX export/import retains route shape, altitude and waypoint names when DOMParser exists",{skip:typeof DOMParser==="undefined"},()=>{
  const xml=exportGpx([example,b]);
  const imported=importGpx(xml,"day1");
  assert.equal(imported.points.length,2);
  assert.equal(imported.points[0].name,a.name);
  assert.equal(imported.points[1].name,b.name);
  assert.equal(imported.points[0].trailToNext.source,"gpx");
  assert.equal(computeRouteMetrics(imported.points,[{id:"day1"}]).ascentM,80);
});

```

### `tests/gpx-toolbar-v053.test.cjs`

```typescript
const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const { readFileSync } = require('node:fs');
const { resolve } = require('node:path');
const read = path => readFileSync(resolve(__dirname, '..', path), 'utf8');
const toolbar = read('components/builder/BuildDataTools.tsx');
const route = read('components/builder/TripPlanner/TripRoute.tsx');
const analysis = read('components/builder/TripPlanner/RouteAnalysisSection.tsx');
const page = read('app/build/[id]/page.tsx');
const bar = read('components/builder/ShareBar.tsx');
const bridge = read('lib/gpx-toolbar-events.ts');

test('global Import/Export buttons expose separate JSON and GPX menu actions', () => {
  assert.match(toolbar, /aria-haspopup="menu"/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /role="menu"/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /Build data \(JSON\)/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /GPX route/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /onClick=\{\(\) => startGpxAction\(action\)\}/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /open\("import"\)/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /open\("export"\)/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /outside/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /event\.key === "Escape"/);
  assert.match(bar, /<BuildDataTools/);
  assert.match(page, /activeTab=\{activeTab\}/);
  assert.match(page, /gpxDays=\{build\.days\.map/);
  assert.match(page, /overflow-visible rounded-2xl/);
});

test('GPX import retains size validation, preview, day assignment, replacement confirmation and Save route', () => {
  assert.match(toolbar, /importGpx\(await file\.text\(\), gpxDayId \|\| null\)/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /GPX_MAX_BYTES/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /Assign imported track to a day/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /gpxPreview\.trackPoints/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /gpxPreview\.hasCompleteElevation/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /window\.confirm/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /will not be stored until you click Save route/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /window\.dispatchEvent\(new CustomEvent\(GPX_TOOLBAR_IMPORT/);
  assert.match(route, /const accepted = replaceFromGpx\(detail\.points\)/);
  assert.match(route, /setEditing\(true\)/);
  assert.match(route, /function save\(\)/);
});

test('Export GPX downloads the current working route, including draft changes', () => {
  assert.match(toolbar, /window\.dispatchEvent\(new CustomEvent\(GPX_TOOLBAR_EXPORT/);
  assert.match(route, /exportGpx\(points, buildName\)/);
  assert.match(route, /link\.download = "trailpicker-route\.gpx"/);
  assert.match(route, /points\.length < 2/);
  assert.match(bridge, /GPX_TOOLBAR_EXPORT/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(toolbar, /getBuildExport\(buildId\)[\s\S]*\.gpx"/);
});

test('GPX options from gear tab transition to Trip Planner via ready/ping handshake', () => {
  assert.match(toolbar, /sessionStorage\.setItem\(pendingGpxKey, action\)/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /router\.push\(`\/build\/\$\{encodeURIComponent\(buildId\)\}\?tab=trip`\)/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /sessionStorage\.removeItem\(pendingGpxKey\)/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /GPX_TOOLBAR_READY/);
  assert.match(toolbar, /GPX_TOOLBAR_PING/);
  assert.match(route, /window\.addEventListener\(GPX_TOOLBAR_PING, ready\)/);
  assert.match(route, /window\.addEventListener\(GPX_TOOLBAR_IMPORT, importRequested\)/);
  assert.match(route, /window\.addEventListener\(GPX_TOOLBAR_EXPORT, exportRequested\)/);
});

test('Route Analysis no longer hosts duplicate GPX controls or accordion', () => {
  assert.match(analysis, /<RouteElevationPanel/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(analysis, /GPX files & route tools|Import GPX|Export GPX|Download GPX|toolsOpen/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(analysis, /importGpx|exportGpx|<input[^>]*type="file"/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(route, /onImport=\{replaceFromGpx\}/);
  assert.match(route, /onSave=\{save\}/);
});
```

```typescript
const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const { readFileSync } = require('node:fs');
const { resolve } = require('node:path');
const source = readFileSync(resolve(__dirname, '../components/builder/TripPlanner/RouteElevationPanel.tsx'), 'utf8');
const scope = readFileSync(resolve(__dirname, '../lib/route-analysis-scope.ts'), 'utf8');

test('hiking summary is primary, partial coverage is explicit, and underlying time arithmetic is unchanged', () => {
  for(const item of ['Hiking time', 'Moving time unavailable',
    'moving', 'breaks', 'Partial estimate', 'Only estimable route sections', 'totalBreakText', 'totalMinutes']) {
     assert.ok(source.toLowerCase().includes(item.toLowerCase()),`missing ${item}`);
  }
  assert.match(source, /const totalMinutes = movingMinutes !== null && breakEstimate !== null \? movingMinutes \+ breakEstimate : null/);
  assert.match(scope, /metrics.dayMetrics.length/);
  assert.match(scope, /const movingMinutes = day/);
  assert.match(scope, /const breakMinutes = day/);
  assert.match(source, /routeTimeComplete/);
});

test('pace, breaks, Tobler model are shared with itinerary, not a second timing dashboard',()=>{
 for(const item of ['Hiking pace','level-trail speed','Break duration','Advanced pace',
    'customMinutesPerHour','Classic Naismith','Swiss Alpine Club']) assert.ok(source.includes(item),`missing ${item}`);
 assert.match(scope, /estimateBreaks\(dayMoving\[index\], breaks\)/);
 assert.doesNotMatch(source, /Plan your hiking days|Daylight planning reserve|Compare with a completed hike/);
});
```

### `tests/hiking-time-v4.test.mjs`

```typescript
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { classicNaismithMinutes, sacReferenceMinutes, toblerKmh,
  gradeAdjustedSpeedKmh, estimateWalkingTime } from '../lib/hiking-time.ts';
import { computeRouteMetrics, DEFAULT_HIKING_PACE_KMH } from '../lib/route-metrics.ts';

const pointsFor = (distance, gain, spacing=100) => {
  const samples=[];
  const count=Math.round(distance/spacing);
  for(let i=0;i<=count;i++) {
    const x=distance*i/count;
    samples.push({distanceM:x,elevationM:650+gain*i/count});
  }
  return samples;
};
test('Tobler baseline and directional walking speeds', () => {
  assert.ok(Math.abs(toblerKmh(0)-5.036) < .02);
  assert.ok(toblerKmh(-.05)>toblerKmh(0));
  assert.ok(toblerKmh(-.25)<toblerKmh(0));
  assert.ok(gradeAdjustedSpeedKmh(.10,4)<4);
  assert.ok(gradeAdjustedSpeedKmh(-.05,4)>4);
  assert.throws(()=>gradeAdjustedSpeedKmh(0,0),RangeError);
});
test('real recorded geometry uses slope rather than adding ascent twice', () => {
  const distance=14770, ascent=1309, samples=pointsFor(distance,ascent);
  const estimated=estimateWalkingTime(distance,ascent,4,samples);
  assert.equal(estimated.method,'terrain');
  assert.ok(estimated.slopeDistanceM/distance > .98);
  assert.ok(estimated.minutes >= 295 && estimated.minutes <= 330, JSON.stringify(estimated));
  assert.ok(estimated.minutes < Math.round((distance/1000/4+ascent/600)*60));
  // 14.77km, +1309m, 5h moving, 1h rest is an *observed example*;
  // it is not used as a fitted constant in the implementation.
});
test('flat versus steep or downhill with identical trail length', () => {
  const flat=estimateWalkingTime(2000,0,4,pointsFor(2000,0));
  const climb=estimateWalkingTime(2000,400,4,pointsFor(2000,400));
  const easyDown=estimateWalkingTime(2000,0,4,pointsFor(2000,-100));
  const sharpDown=estimateWalkingTime(2000,0,4,pointsFor(2000,-600));
  assert.ok(climb.minutes>flat.minutes);
  assert.ok(easyDown.minutes<flat.minutes);
  assert.ok(sharpDown.minutes>flat.minutes);
});
test('sparse sample gaps do not imply invented slope; fallback is explicit', () => {
  const sparse=estimateWalkingTime(2500,200,4,[{distanceM:0,elevationM:100},{distanceM:2500,elevationM:300}]);
  assert.equal(sparse.method,'naismith');
  assert.equal(sparse.slopeDistanceM,0);
  assert.equal(sparse.minutes,Math.round((2.5/4+200/600)*60));
  const broken=estimateWalkingTime(1000,400,4,[{distanceM:0,elevationM:100},{distanceM:100,elevationM:120},{distanceM:900,elevationM:480},{distanceM:1000,elevationM:500}]);
  assert.equal(broken.method,'naismith');
  assert.throws(()=>estimateWalkingTime(-1,0,4,null),RangeError);
});
test('established reference rules are distinguishable, not blended',()=>{
  assert.equal(classicNaismithMinutes(14770,1309),308);
  assert.equal(sacReferenceMinutes(14770,1309,0),418);
});
test('route/day times share slope model and preserve incomplete day boundaries',()=>{
  assert.equal(DEFAULT_HIKING_PACE_KMH,4);
  const a={id:'a',name:'a',lat:49.1,lng:-123.1,dayId:'one',kind:'waypoint',elevationM:null};
  const b={id:'b',name:'b',lat:49.2,lng:-123.2,dayId:'one',kind:'waypoint',elevationM:null};
  const c={id:'c',name:'c',lat:49.20001,lng:-123.2,dayId:'two',kind:'waypoint',elevationM:null};
  const samples=pointsFor(14000,1200,100);
  a.trailToNext={toId:'b',geometry:samples.map(s=>[a.lat+(b.lat-a.lat)*s.distanceM/14000,a.lng+(b.lng-a.lng)*s.distanceM/14000]),distanceM:14000,elevationsM:samples.map(s=>s.elevationM),ascentM:1200,descentM:0,source:'gpx'};
  b.trailToNext={toId:'c',geometry:[[b.lat,b.lng],[c.lat,c.lng]],distanceM:2,elevationsM:[1850,1851],ascentM:1,descentM:0,source:'gpx'};
  const r=computeRouteMetrics([a,b,c],[{id:'one'},{id:'two'}]);
  assert.ok(r.estimatedMinutes>0);
  assert.ok(r.terrainTimeDistanceM>13000);
  assert.equal(r.dayMetrics[0].estimatedMinutes,null);
  assert.ok(r.dayMetrics[0].routedEstimateMinutes>0);
  assert.equal(r.dayMetrics[0].unresolvedLinks,1);
});
```

### `tests/itinerary-schedule-anchors-v066.test.cjs`

```typescript
const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const ts = require('typescript');

// Exercise the actual schedule engine, isolating only its imported route,
// daylight and break services. This permits the small patch to be tested
// without a full Next.js installation.
const source = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, '../lib/itinerary-timing.ts'), 'utf8');
const compiled = ts.transpileModule(source, {
  compilerOptions: {
    target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022,
    module: ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS,
    esModuleInterop: true,
  },
  reportDiagnostics: true,
});
assert.deepEqual(compiled.diagnostics.filter(d => d.category === ts.DiagnosticCategory.Error), []);
const parseClock = value => /^(?:[01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/.test(value || '') ? Number(value.slice(0, 2))*60+Number(value.slice(3)) : null;
const clockLabel = total => {
  const m = ((total%1440)+1440)%1440;
  return `${Math.floor(m/60)%12||12}:${String(m%60).padStart(2,'0')} ${m>=720?'PM':'AM'}${total>=1440?' (+1d)':''}`;
};
const mocks = {
  'tz-lookup': () => 'America/Vancouver',
  './overnight-handoffs': {consolidateOvernightStops:points=>({points,replacedIds:{}}),inheritedOvernightForDay:()=>null},
  './route-metrics': {
    computeRouteMetrics: ([prev, next]) => ({
      routedSegments: prev.trailToNext?.toId === next.id ? 1 : 0,
      estimatedMinutes: 60, routedEstimateMinutes: 60,
    }),
  },
  './route-analysis-insights': {
    parseClock, clockLabel,
    approximateDaylight: () => null,
    estimateBreaks: moving => moving === null ? null : ({shortMinutes:0,lunchMinutes:0,totalMinutes:0}),
  },
};
const exportsHolder = {exports:{}};
new Function('module','exports','require',compiled.outputText)(
  exportsHolder, exportsHolder.exports,
  name => { if (!(name in mocks)) throw new Error(`Unexpected import: ${name}`); return mocks[name]; },
);
const {calculateDayItinerary,itineraryTimingIssues,ITINERARY_DEFAULT_BREAKS} = exportsHolder.exports;
const day={id:'d1', date:new Date('2026-11-21T00:00:00Z')};
function route(times=['08:00',null,null,null]) {
  const points=times.map((time,i)=>({id:`s${i}`,dayId:'d1',name:`Stop ${i}`,lat:49+i*.01,lng:-123,kind:'waypoint',time}));
  for(let i=0;i<points.length-1;i++) points[i].trailToNext={toId:points[i+1].id};
  return points;
}
const run=points=>calculateDayItinerary(points,day,4,{...ITINERARY_DEFAULT_BREAKS,lunchMinutes:0});

test('no intermediate schedule: predictions propagate from first departure',()=>{
  assert.deepEqual(run(route()).stops.map(s=>s.arrivalMinutes),[480,540,600,660]);
});
test('later scheduled arrival delays downstream ETAs by the waiting period',()=>{
  const pts=route(['08:00','10:30',null,null]);
  const got=run(pts);
  assert.deepEqual(got.stops.map(s=>s.arrivalMinutes),[480,540,690,750]);
  assert.equal(got.stops[1].scheduledMinutes,630);
  assert.equal(pts[1].time,'10:30');
});
test('earlier schedule never makes a predicted route leg faster',()=>{
  const pts=route(['08:00','08:15',null,null]);
  const got=run(pts);
  assert.deepEqual(got.stops.map(s=>s.arrivalMinutes),[480,540,600,660]);
  assert.equal(got.stops[1].delayMinutes,45);
  assert.ok(itineraryTimingIssues(got,'Day 1').some(i=>i.category==='schedule'));
});
test('stop duration applies after the later of schedule and ETA, not to the arrival itself',()=>{
  const pts=route(['08:00','10:30',null,null]);
  pts[1].stayMinutes=20;
  const got=run(pts);
  assert.deepEqual(got.stops.map(s=>s.arrivalMinutes),[480,540,710,770]);
});
test('an unmapped leg breaks the ETA chain; a later scheduled stop can re-anchor it',()=>{
  const pts=route(['08:00',null,'13:00',null]);
  delete pts[1].trailToNext;
  const got=run(pts);
  assert.deepEqual(got.stops.map(s=>s.arrivalMinutes),[480,540,null,840]);
  assert.equal(got.stops[2].scheduledMinutes,780);
});
test('overnight scheduled arrival uses the following day when the route reaches it near midnight',()=>{
  const pts=route(['22:00','00:20',null,null]);
  const got=run(pts);
  assert.deepEqual(got.stops.map(s=>s.arrivalMinutes),[1320,1380,1520,1580]);
  assert.equal(got.stops[1].scheduledMinutes,1460);
  assert.equal(got.stops[1].delayMinutes,0);
  assert.equal(pts[1].time,'00:20');
});
test('a late-evening commitment before a post-midnight ETA stays on the previous day',()=>{
  const pts=route(['23:30','23:50',null,null]);
  const got=run(pts);
  assert.equal(got.stops[1].arrivalMinutes,1470);
  assert.equal(got.stops[1].scheduledMinutes,1430);
  assert.equal(got.stops[1].delayMinutes,40);
  assert.equal(got.stops[2].arrivalMinutes,1530);
});
test('a too-early same-day schedule is not accidentally advanced to the next morning',()=>{
  const pts=route(['20:00','09:00',null,null]);
  const got=run(pts);
  assert.equal(got.stops[1].scheduledMinutes,540);
  assert.equal(got.stops[1].delayMinutes,720);
  assert.equal(got.stops[2].arrivalMinutes,1320);
});
test('first stop departure stays a departure and ignores stop duration',()=>{
  const pts=route();pts[0].stayMinutes=50;
  assert.equal(run(pts).stops[1].arrivalMinutes,540);
});
```

```typescript
});

 const out=calculateDayItinerary(delayed,day,4,breaks);

test('unmapped or cross-day legs break the ETA chain; later fixed anchors can resume it',()=>{
```

```typescript
const {test}=require('node:test');

const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
function load(rel, mocks={}){
  let js=stripTypeScriptTypes(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,rel),'utf8'));
  const names=[...js.matchAll(/export (?:async )?function (\w+)|export const (\w+)/g)].map(m=>m[1]||m[2]);
  js=js.replace(/import\s+\{([^}]+)\}\s+from\s+["']([^"']+)["'];/g,(_,imports,spec)=>`const {${imports}}=require(${JSON.stringify(spec)});`).replace(/export /g,'');
  return new Function('require',js+`\nreturn {${names.join(',')}};`)(key=>key in mocks?mocks[key]:require(key));
}
const validate=load('lib/trip-arrangements.ts');
const form=values=>{const f=new FormData();for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(values))f.set(k,String(v));return f;};
function stubRoute(initial=[]){
  let route=structuredClone(initial),writes=0;
  const days=[{id:'day-one',date:new Date('2027-07-15')},{id:'day-two',date:new Date('2027-07-16')}];
  const tx={
    build:{findUnique:async()=>({routeWaypoints:route}),update:async ({data})=>{route=data.routeWaypoints;writes++;return {}}},
    tripDay:{findMany:async()=>days},
  };
  const action=load('lib/trip-planner-actions.ts',{
    '@/lib/build-access':{requireBuildAccess:async id=>{if(id!=='owned')throw Error('Access denied');return{userId:'owner'};},requireTripDayAccess:async()=>({accessUserId:'owner'})},
    'next/cache':{revalidatePath:()=>{}},
    '@/lib/destinations':{getDestination:()=>null},
    '@/lib/trip':{getDateRange:()=>[]},
    '@/lib/trip-planner':{emptyLogistics:{},nullableNumber:(v,k,min,max)=>{const n=Number(v);if(v===null || v==='' || !Number.isFinite(n)||n<min||n>max)throw Error('Invalid '+k);return n;},parseDates:()=>({})},
    '@/lib/build-history':{mutateBuildWithRevision:async(_buildId,_userId,_kind,_message,work)=>work(tx)},
    '@/lib/build-validation':{parseLogistics:()=>({})},
    '@/lib/itinerary-links':{validatedRoute:val=>Array.isArray(val)?val:null},
    '@/lib/overnight-handoffs':{consolidateOvernightStops:points=>({points,replacedIds:{}})},
    '@/lib/route-metrics':{computeRouteMetrics:()=>[],completeDaySummaries:()=>[],DEFAULT_HIKING_PACE_KMH:3},
    '@/lib/trip-resources':{readPrivateResources:()=>({bookings:[]})},
    '@/lib/trip-arrangements':validate,
    '@/lib/food-plan':{validateFoodPlan:()=>({})},
    '@/lib/route-timing-preferences':{ROUTE_TIMING_KEY:'routeTiming',validateRouteTimingPreferences:x=>x},
  });
  return {action,route:()=>route,writes:()=>writes};
}
function locationRoute(initial, extra={}){
  return form({buildId:'owned',dayId:'day-one',name:'Kees and Claire Hut',lat:50.03,lng:-122.95,expectedRoute:JSON.stringify(initial),...extra});
}
test('can add a campground with zero trailheads or existing stops',async()=>{
  const s=stubRoute([]);
  const result=await s.action.addBookingCampsiteStop(locationRoute([]));
  assert.equal(result.name,'Kees and Claire Hut');
  assert.equal(result.kind,'camp');
  assert.equal(result.dayId,'day-one');
  assert.equal(typeof result.id,'string');
  assert.equal(s.route().length,1);
  assert.equal(s.route()[0].id,result.id);
  assert.equal(s.writes(),1);
});
test('adding an overnight after existing stops retains later day stops and invalidates only affected leg',async()=>{
  const a={id:'trail',name:'Trailhead',kind:'trailhead',lat:50.0,lng:-122.9,dayId:'day-one',elevationM:null,trailToNext:{distanceM:123}};
  const b={id:'day2',name:'Summit',kind:'waypoint',lat:50.1,lng:-123.0,dayId:'day-two',elevationM:null};
  const initial=[a,b],s=stubRoute(initial);
  const added=await s.action.addBookingCampsiteStop(locationRoute(initial));
  assert.deepEqual(s.route().map(p=>p.id),['trail',added.id,'day2']);
  assert.equal(s.route()[0].trailToNext,undefined);
  assert.equal(s.route()[2].id,'day2');
});
test('stale route snapshot and invalid day are rejected with no write',async()=>{
  const p={id:'newer',name:'Other',kind:'camp',lat:50,lng:-122,dayId:'day-one',elevationM:null};
  const s=stubRoute([p]);
  await assert.rejects(()=>s.action.addBookingCampsiteStop(locationRoute([])),/itinerary changed/);
  await assert.rejects(()=>s.action.addBookingCampsiteStop(locationRoute([p],{dayId:'removed'})),/no longer exists/);
  assert.equal(s.writes(),0);
});
test('hut bookings can reference the shared campsite but other categories cannot',()=>{
  const base={id:'h1',kind:'reservation',category:'hut',name:'Kees and Claire Hut',status:'confirmed',startDate:'2027-07-15',endDate:'2027-07-16',provider:'',confirmation:'',bookingUrl:'',notes:'',dayId:'day-one',waypointId:'camp-one'};
  assert.deepEqual(validate.validateArrangements([base],['day-one'],['camp-one']),[base]);
  assert.throws(()=>validate.validateArrangements([{...base,category:'rental'}],['day-one'],['camp-one']),/Only hut/);
  assert.throws(()=>validate.validateArrangements([base],['day-one'],['missing']),/removed overnight/);
  const withoutLink={...base};delete withoutLink.waypointId;
  assert.deepEqual(validate.validateArrangements([withoutLink],['day-one'],['camp-one']),[withoutLink]);
});
```

```typescript
test('affected TSX syntax parses and transpiles',()=>{

    const transpile=ts.transpileModule(source,{fileName:file,compilerOptions:{jsx:ts.JsxEmit.ReactJSX,target:ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022,module:ts.ModuleKind.ESNext},reportDiagnostics:true});
    assert.equal(transpile.diagnostics?.filter(d=>d.category===ts.DiagnosticCategory.Error).length??0,0);

});
```
