### `tests/logistics-permits-v091.test.cjs`

```typescript
const { test } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { stripTypeScriptTypes } = require('node:module');
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
function load(rel, mocks = {}) {
  let js = stripTypeScriptTypes(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, rel), 'utf8'));
  const names = [...js.matchAll(/export (?:async )?function (\w+)|export const (\w+)/g)].map(m=>m[1]||m[2]);
  js = js.replace(/import\s+\{([^}]+)\}\s+from\s+["']([^"']+)["'];/g, (_,imports,spec)=>`const {${imports}} = require(${JSON.stringify(spec)});`).replace(/export /g, '');
  return new Function('require', js+`\nreturn {${names.join(',')}};`)(key => key in mocks ? mocks[key] : require(key));
}
const arrangements = load('lib/trip-arrangements.ts');
const resources = load('lib/trip-resources.ts', {'./trail-routing': {metersBetween:()=>0, usableTrailSegment:()=>null}});
const notes = {permits:'old permit text',reservations:'old reservation text',transportation:'drive',parking:'lot',emergencyContact:'private',emergencyPlan:'exit',notes:'other'};
const makeArrangement = (patch={}) => ({id:'entry-one',kind:'permit',category:'other',name:'Park permit',status:'planned',startDate:'2027-07-15',endDate:'2027-07-17',provider:'BC Parks',confirmation:'SECRET-123',bookingUrl:'https://example.com/permit',notes:'Remember pickup',dayId:'',...patch});
const makeCamp = (patch={}) => ({id:'camp-one',waypointId:'camp-stop',dayId:'day-one',campground:'Camp A',status:'confirmed',arrival:'2027-07-15',departure:'2027-07-16',provider:'BC Parks',confirmation:'PRIVATE-456',notes:'Tent pad',bookingUrl:'https://example.com/camp',...patch});
const form = x => {const f = new FormData();for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(x))f.set(k,typeof v==='string'?v:JSON.stringify(v));return f;};

test('structured arrangements validate date, type, URL, limits, linked days, duplicates', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(arrangements.validateArrangements([makeArrangement()],['day-one']),[makeArrangement()]);
  assert.throws(()=>arrangements.validateArrangements([makeArrangement({bookingUrl:'http://bad.example'})]), /HTTPS/);
  assert.throws(()=>arrangements.validateArrangements([makeArrangement({startDate:'2027-02-30'})]), /dates/);
  assert.throws(()=>arrangements.validateArrangements([makeArrangement({endDate:'2027-07-01'})]), /dates/);
  assert.throws(()=>arrangements.validateArrangements([makeArrangement({kind:'reservation',category:'campsite'})]), /type, name, or status/);
  assert.throws(()=>arrangements.validateArrangements([makeArrangement({dayId:'removed'})],['day-one']), /removed/);
  assert.throws(()=>arrangements.validateArrangements([makeArrangement(),makeArrangement()]), /Duplicate/);
  assert.throws(()=>arrangements.validateArrangements(Array.from({length:81},(_,i)=>makeArrangement({id:'id'+i}))), /80/);
  assert.equal(arrangements.readArrangements({arrangements:[makeArrangement()]}).length,1);
});

test('existing campsite booking URL is optional, HTTPS-only and survives normalization', () => {
  const sample={settings:resources.defaultResourceSettings,bookings:[makeCamp()]};
  assert.deepEqual(resources.validatePrivateResources(sample,['day-one'],['camp-stop']).bookings[0],makeCamp());
  assert.deepEqual(resources.readPrivateResources({phase6:sample}).bookings[0],makeCamp());
  assert.throws(()=>resources.validatePrivateResources({...sample,bookings:[makeCamp({bookingUrl:'javascript:bad'})]},['day-one'],['camp-stop']),/HTTPS/);
  assert.equal(resources.validatePrivateResources({...sample,bookings:[{...makeCamp(),bookingUrl:undefined}]},['day-one'],['camp-stop']).bookings[0].id,'camp-one');
});

function setup() {
  let rootData = {...notes,phase6:{settings:resources.defaultResourceSettings,bookings:[makeCamp()]},phase7:{existing:'food survives'},routeTiming:{speed:3}};
  const writes=[];
  const tx={
    build:{findUnique:async()=>({tripLogistics:rootData,routeWaypoints:[{id:'camp-stop',kind:'camp'}]}),update:async arg=>{writes.push(arg);rootData=arg.data.tripLogistics;return {}}},
    tripDay:{findMany:async()=>[{id:'day-one'}]},
  };
  const actions=load('lib/trip-planner-actions.ts', {
    '@/lib/build-access':{requireBuildAccess:async id=>{if(id!=='owned')throw Error('no access');return {userId:'owner'};}, requireTripDayAccess:async()=>({accessUserId:'owner'})},
    'next/cache':{revalidatePath:()=>{}},
    '@/lib/destinations':{getDestination:()=>null},
    '@/lib/trip':{getDateRange:()=>[]},
    '@/lib/trip-planner':{emptyLogistics:notes,nullableNumber:()=>null,parseDates:()=>({})},
    '@/lib/build-history':{mutateBuildWithRevision:async(_buildId,_uid,_kind,_msg,callback)=>callback(tx)},
    '@/lib/build-validation':{parseLogistics:()=>notes},
    '@/lib/itinerary-links':{validatedRoute:()=>[{id:'camp-stop',kind:'camp'}]},
    '@/lib/overnight-handoffs':{consolidateOvernightStops:points=>({points,replacedIds:{}})},
    '@/lib/route-metrics':{computeRouteMetrics:()=>[],completeDaySummaries:()=>[],DEFAULT_HIKING_PACE_KMH:3},
    '@/lib/trip-resources':resources,
    '@/lib/trip-arrangements':arrangements,
    '@/lib/food-plan':{validateFoodPlan:()=>({})},
    '@/lib/route-timing-preferences':{ROUTE_TIMING_KEY:'routeTiming',validateRouteTimingPreferences:x=>x},
  });
  return {actions, writes, get:()=>rootData};
}

test('saving permits deletes legacy notes but preserves campsite reservations, water settings and food', async () => {
  const h=setup();
  const result=await h.actions.saveTripBooking(form({buildId:'owned',operation:'upsert',source:'arrangement',booking:makeArrangement()}));
  assert.equal(result.arrangements[0].name,'Park permit');
  assert.equal(h.get().permits,'');
  assert.equal(h.get().reservations,'');
  assert.equal(h.get().emergencyContact,notes.emergencyContact);
  assert.deepEqual(h.get().phase7,{existing:'food survives'});
  assert.equal(h.get().phase6.bookings[0].bookingUrl,'https://example.com/camp');
  assert.deepEqual(h.get().phase6.settings,resources.defaultResourceSettings);
  assert.equal(h.get().arrangements.length,1);
  assert.equal(h.writes[0].where.userId,'owner');
  await h.actions.saveTripBooking(form({buildId:'owned',operation:'upsert',source:'arrangement',booking:makeArrangement({status:'confirmed'})}));
  assert.equal(h.get().arrangements.length,1);
  assert.equal(h.get().arrangements[0].status,'confirmed');
  await h.actions.saveTripBooking(form({buildId:'owned',operation:'delete',source:'arrangement',booking:{id:'entry-one'}}));
  assert.deepEqual(h.get().arrangements,[]);
});

test('editing a campsite changes its original phase6 record, without creating a duplicate', async () => {
  const h=setup();
  await h.actions.saveTripBooking(form({buildId:'owned',operation:'upsert',source:'camp',booking:makeCamp({confirmation:'NEW-111'})}));
  assert.equal(h.get().phase6.bookings.length,1);
  assert.equal(h.get().phase6.bookings[0].confirmation,'NEW-111');
  assert.deepEqual(h.get().arrangements,[]);
  await h.actions.saveTripBooking(form({buildId:'owned',operation:'upsert',source:'camp',booking:makeCamp({id:'camp-two',arrival:'2027-07-16',departure:'2027-07-17'})}));
  assert.equal(h.get().phase6.bookings.length,2);
  await assert.rejects(()=>h.actions.saveTripBooking(form({buildId:'owned',operation:'upsert',source:'camp',booking:makeCamp({id:'duplicate'})})),/already has a booking/);
  await h.actions.saveTripBooking(form({buildId:'owned',operation:'delete',source:'camp',booking:{id:'camp-one'}}));
  assert.equal(h.get().phase6.bookings.length,1);
});

test('bad booking data is rejected before the database write', async () => {
  const h=setup();
  await assert.rejects(()=>h.actions.saveTripBooking(form({buildId:'owned',operation:'upsert',source:'arrangement',booking:makeArrangement({bookingUrl:'http://bad.example'})})),/HTTPS/);
  await assert.rejects(()=>h.actions.saveTripBooking(form({buildId:'owned',operation:'upsert',source:'camp',booking:makeCamp({waypointId:'removed'})})),/removed campsite/);
  assert.equal(h.writes.length,0);
});

test('private CSV and printable exports include reservations only when explicitly requested', () => {
  const e=load('lib/trip-resources-export.ts');
  const data={name:'Trip',days:[],points:[],logistics:notes,bookings:[makeCamp()],arrangements:[makeArrangement()],packLines:[]};
  const publicCsv=e.exportLogisticsCsv(data,false);
  const privateCsv=e.exportLogisticsCsv(data,true);
  assert.ok(!publicCsv.includes('SECRET-123'));
  assert.ok(!publicCsv.includes('PRIVATE-456'));
  assert.ok(privateCsv.includes('SECRET-123'));
  const publicHtml=e.printableTripHtml(data,false);
  const privateHtml=e.printableTripHtml(data,true);
  assert.ok(!publicHtml.includes('SECRET-123'));
  assert.ok(privateHtml.includes('SECRET-123'));
});
```

```typescript
  assert.equal(parsed.parseDiagnostics.length,0,parsed.parseDiagnostics.map(d=>ts.flattenDiagnosticMessageText(d.messageText,' ')).join(';'));
  const compiled=ts.transpileModule(source,{fileName:file,compilerOptions:{jsx:ts.JsxEmit.ReactJSX,target:ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022,module:ts.ModuleKind.ESNext},reportDiagnostics:true});
  assert.equal((compiled.diagnostics??[]).filter(d=>d.category===ts.DiagnosticCategory.Error).length,0);
});
```

### `tests/ors-optimization-v081.test.cjs`

```typescript
const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const ts = require('typescript');
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const { orsCoordinateKey, retryAfterSeconds, createOrsResultCache, createOrsTrafficController,
  OrsCooldownError, OrsQueueFullError } = require('../lib/ors-request-control.ts');
const { missingTrailLegs } = require('../lib/route-request-planner.ts');

const point = (id, lat, lng) => ({ id, name:id, lat, lng, elevationM:null, kind:'waypoint' });
const line = (from, to) => ({ toId:to.id, source:'openrouteservice', geometry:[[from.lat,from.lng],[to.lat,to.lng]],distanceM:200 });

test('routing cache keys keep directions, kinds and shaping waypoints separate', () => {
  const a=[49.1,-122.1], b=[49.2,-122.2], via=[49.15,-122.15];
  assert.notEqual(orsCoordinateKey('route',[a,b]),orsCoordinateKey('route',[b,a]));
  assert.notEqual(orsCoordinateKey('route',[a,b]),orsCoordinateKey('route',[a,via,b]));
  assert.notEqual(orsCoordinateKey('route',[a,b]),orsCoordinateKey('snap',[a,b]));
  assert.equal(orsCoordinateKey('route',[a,b]),orsCoordinateKey('route',[a,b]));
});

test('positive, negative and concurrent ORS requests share bounded cache results', async () => {
  let now=0, calls=0;
  const cache=createOrsResultCache({maxEntries:2,successTtlMs:100,missingTtlMs:10,now:()=>now});
  let release;
  const work=()=>{calls++;return new Promise(resolve=>{release=resolve;});};
  const p1=cache.getOrLoad('A',work),p2=cache.getOrLoad('A',work);
  assert.equal(calls,1);
  release({ok:true});
  assert.deepEqual(await Promise.all([p1,p2]),[{ok:true},{ok:true}]);
  assert.deepEqual(await cache.getOrLoad('A',()=>{throw new Error('should not load')}),{ok:true});
  await cache.getOrLoad('B',async()=>null);
  assert.equal(await cache.getOrLoad('B',async()=>{throw new Error('negative hit')}),null);
  now=11;
  await cache.getOrLoad('B',async()=>{calls++;return {ok:false}});
  assert.equal(calls,2);
  await cache.getOrLoad('C',async()=>1);
  assert.equal(cache.size(),2);
  now=150;
  await cache.getOrLoad('B',async()=>2);
  assert.equal(await cache.getOrLoad('B',async()=>{throw new Error('after refresh')}),2);
});

test('failed provider calls are not cached',async()=>{
  const cache=createOrsResultCache();
  let calls=0;
  await assert.rejects(cache.getOrLoad('a',async()=>{calls++;throw new Error('429')}));
  await cache.getOrLoad('a',async()=>{calls++;return 2});
  assert.equal(calls,2);
});

test('serial ORS controller spaces calls and stops its queue after rate limiting',async()=>{
  let now=0;
  const traffic=createOrsTrafficController({intervalMs:1600, now:()=>now, sleep:async(ms)=>{now+=ms;}});
  const starts=[];
  const one=traffic.schedule(async()=>{starts.push(now);return 'one'});
  const two=traffic.schedule(async()=>{starts.push(now);traffic.cooldown(90);return 'two'});
  const three=traffic.schedule(async()=>{starts.push(now);return 'three'});
  assert.equal(await one,'one');
  assert.equal(await two,'two');
  assert.deepEqual(starts,[0,1600]);
  await assert.rejects(three,e=>e instanceof OrsCooldownError && e.retryAfterSeconds===90);
  assert.equal(traffic.remainingCooldownSeconds(),90);
  now+=90000;
  assert.equal(await traffic.schedule(async()=>{starts.push(now);return 'resumed'}),'resumed');
  assert.equal(starts.length,3);
});

test('queue capacity rejects excess work without executing it',async()=>{
  let release;
  const gate=new Promise(resolve=>release=resolve);
  const traffic=createOrsTrafficController({queueLimit:1,intervalMs:0});
  const first=traffic.schedule(()=>gate);
  await assert.rejects(traffic.schedule(async()=>2), OrsQueueFullError);
  release(1);
  assert.equal(await first,1);
});

test('moving one stop in a long route only invalidates its two adjacent legs', () => {
  const points=Array.from({length:12},(_,index)=>point(`p${index}`,49+index*0.001,-122-index*0.001));
  for(let i=0;i<points.length-1;i++) points[i].trailToNext=line(points[i],points[i+1]);
  assert.equal(missingTrailLegs(points).length,0);
  points[5]={...points[5],lat:points[5].lat+0.002,trailToNext:undefined};
  assert.deepEqual(missingTrailLegs(points).map(({from})=>from.id),['p4','p5']);
});

test('Retry-After accepts seconds and dates but rejects dangerous values',()=>{
  assert.equal(retryAfterSeconds('42',0),42);
  assert.equal(retryAfterSeconds('Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:30 GMT',0),30);
  assert.equal(retryAfterSeconds('99999',0),3600);
  assert.equal(retryAfterSeconds('invalid',0),90);
});

test('valid saved routes do not re-request ORS merely because elevation metadata is missing',()=>{
  const a=point('a',49.1,-122.1),b=point('b',49.101,-122.101),c=point('c',49.102,-122.102);
  a.trailToNext=line(a,b);
  assert.deepEqual(missingTrailLegs([a,b,c]).map(({from})=>from.id),['b']);
  b.trailToNext=line(b,c);
  assert.equal(missingTrailLegs([a,b,c]).length,0);
  b.lat=49.103;
  assert.deepEqual(missingTrailLegs([a,b,c]).map(({from})=>from.id),['a','b']);
  a.manualToNext=true;
  assert.deepEqual(missingTrailLegs([a,b,c]).map(({from})=>from.id),['b']);
});

test('route endpoints enforce access before using shared cache and propagate Retry-After',()=>{
  for (const f of ['app/api/trails/route/route.ts','app/api/trails/snap/route.ts']) {
    const code=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f),'utf8');
    assert.ok(code.indexOf('trailRoutingRequest(request,') < code.indexOf('orsResultCache.getOrLoad('));
    assert.match(code,/Retry-After/);
    assert.match(code,/error\.status === 422/);
  }
  const server=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'lib/trail-routing-server.ts'),'utf8');
  assert.match(server,/orsTraffic\.schedule\(async/);
  assert.match(server,/orsTraffic\.cooldown\(seconds\)/);
  const client=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'components/builder/TripPlanner/TripRoute.tsx'),'utf8');
  assert.match(client,/const missing = missingTrailLegs\(points\)/);
  assert.match(client,/if \(response\.status === 429\)/);
  assert.match(client,/break; \/\/ Do NOT send the other pending segments/);
});

test('all modified TS/TSX files transpile',()=>{
  for (const f of ['lib/ors-request-control.ts','lib/route-request-planner.ts','lib/trail-routing-server.ts','app/api/trails/route/route.ts','app/api/trails/snap/route.ts','components/builder/TripPlanner/TripRoute.tsx']) {
    const parsed=ts.transpileModule(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f),'utf8'),{fileName:f,compilerOptions:{module:ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS,target:ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022,jsx:ts.JsxEmit.ReactJSX},reportDiagnostics:true});
    assert.deepEqual((parsed.diagnostics||[]).map(d=>ts.flattenDiagnosticMessageText(d.messageText,' ')),[],f);
  }
});
```

```typescript
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { buildORSRequest } from "../lib/ors-request.ts";

const coordinates = [[50.022245, -122.872238], [50.023, -122.871]];

test("directions uses the HeiGIT URL and accepts GeoJSON (regression for HTTP 406/2007)", () => {
  const request = buildORSRequest("route", coordinates, "test-key", 75);
  assert.equal(request.url, "https://api.heigit.org/openrouteservice/v2/directions/foot-hiking/geojson");
  assert.equal(request.options.method, "POST");
  assert.equal(request.options.headers.Accept, "application/geo+json");
  assert.equal(request.options.headers["Content-Type"], "application/json");
  assert.equal(request.options.headers.Authorization, "test-key");
  assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(request.options.body), {
    coordinates: [[-122.872238, 50.022245], [-122.871, 50.023]],
    instructions: false,
    elevation: true,
  });
});

test("snap retains /json and accepts JSON, with a 75m radius", () => {
  const request = buildORSRequest("snap", [coordinates[0]], "test-key", 75);
  assert.equal(request.url, "https://api.heigit.org/openrouteservice/v2/snap/foot-hiking/json");
  assert.equal(request.options.headers.Accept, "application/json");
  assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(request.options.body), {
    locations: [[-122.872238, 50.022245]],
    radius: 75,
  });
});

test("ORS uses the radius provided by the app, not a hidden constant", () => {
  const request = buildORSRequest("snap", [coordinates[0]], "test-key", 25);
  assert.equal(JSON.parse(request.options.body).radius, 25);
});
```

```typescript
const camp=(id,day,name='Kees and Claire Hut',lat=49.25,lng=-123.15)=>({id,dayId:day,name,kind:'camp',lat,lng,elevationM:null});
const waypoint=(id,day,lat=49.26,lng=-123.14)=>({...camp(id,day,id,lat,lng),kind:'waypoint'});
const route=(from,to)=>({toId:to.id,geometry:[[from.lat,from.lng],[to.lat,to.lng]],distanceM:1500,elevationsM:[100,120],ascentM:20,descentM:0,source:'openrouteservice'});

test('duplicate overnight stops become one waypoint and preserve the following morning departure and outgoing mapped leg',()=>{
 const a=waypoint('a','d1',49.248,-123.152), first=camp('camp-a','d1');
 const duplicate={...camp('camp-b','d2'),time:'08:30',note:'Early morning start'};
 const b=waypoint('b','d2');a.trailToNext=route(a,first);duplicate.trailToNext=route(duplicate,b);
 const {points,replacedIds}=handoffs.consolidateOvernightStops([a,first,duplicate,b],days);
 assert.equal(points.length,3);
 assert.equal(points[1].id,'camp-a');
 assert.equal(replacedIds['camp-b'],'camp-a');
 assert.equal(points[1].nextDayDepartureTime,'08:30');
 assert.equal(points[1].nextDayDepartureNote,'Early morning start');
 assert.equal(points[1].trailToNext.toId,'b');
 const inherited=handoffs.inheritedOvernightForDay(points,days,'d2');
 assert.equal(inherited.point,points[1]);
 assert.equal(inherited.fromDayNumber,1);
 assert.equal(inherited.toDayNumber,2);
 const day2=computeRouteMetrics(points,days).dayMetrics[1];
 assert.equal(day2.segments,1);
 assert.equal(day2.distanceM,1500);
 assert.equal(day2.unresolvedLinks,0);
});

 assert.equal(handoffs.inheritedOvernightForDay(points,days,'d2').point.id,'hut');
 assert.equal(points.length,2);

 assert.equal(choices.length,1);
 assert.equal(choices[0].dayLabel,'Night 1 · Day 1 → Day 2');
});

test('different explicitly placed next-day trailheads override inherited overnight',()=>{

 assert.equal(handoffs.inheritedOvernightForDay([first,trail],days,'d2'),null);
});

test('do not merge different campsites, nonconsecutive days, shaped loops, or multiple nights at same site',()=>{

 const twoNights=[first,camp('dup','d2'),camp('third','d3')];
 const result=handoffs.consolidateOvernightStops(twoNights,days);
 assert.equal(result.points.length,2); // Night 1 handoff only; the second night is a real overnight.
});
```

```typescript
  assert.match(route, /function select\(point: Waypoint, dayOverride\?: string\)/);
  assert.match(route, /setFocus\(\(previous\) => \(\{/);
});

test('inherited editor uses original ID but is scoped to the next day and is not draggable', () => {
  assert.match(itinerary, /route\.activeDayId === \(inherited\?\.toDayId \?\? point\.dayId \?\? null\)/);
  assert.match(itinerary, /onClick=\{\(\) => inherited \? route\.editOvernightStart\(point, inherited\.toDayId\) : route\.editStop\(point\.id\)\}/);
  assert.match(route, /function editOvernightStart\(point: Waypoint, nextDayId: string\)/);
  assert.match(route, /editStop, editOvernightStart, updateStop: patch/);
  assert.match(itinerary, /draggable=\{!route\.pending\}/);
  assert.match(itinerary, /inherited \? \(/);
  assert.match(itinerary, /data-trailpicker-stop-id=\{inherited \? undefined : point\.id\}/);
});

test('next morning departure fields live in edit mode and stay separate from original arrival time', () => {
  assert.match(itinerary, /formattedTime\(inherited \? point\.nextDayDepartureTime : point\.time\)/);
  assert.match(itinerary, /\{editing && \(inherited \? \(/);
  assert.match(itinerary, /onChange=\{value => route\.updateStop\(point\.id, \{ nextDayDepartureTime: value \}\)\}/);
  assert.match(itinerary, /nextDayDepartureNote/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(itinerary, /Next morning departure \(optional\)[\s\S]*Edit shared campsite\s*<\/button>/);
});

test('campsite dropdown reuses the actual map campground icon and calls unlinked option by a clear name', () => {
  assert.match(manager, /import WaypointIcon from "\.\/WaypointIcon"/);
  assert.match(manager, /backgroundColor:waypointType\("camp"\)\.color/);
  assert.match(manager, /<WaypointIcon kind="camp"/);
  assert.match(manager, /Clear link/);
  assert.match(manager, /detail:stop\.dayLabel/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(manager, /Manual \/ not mapped|text-amber-700/);
});

test('the changed TSX files parse without syntax errors', () => {
  for (const file of ['DayStopsItinerary.tsx','TripRoute.tsx','PermitReservationManager.tsx']) {
    const content = source('components/builder/TripPlanner/' + file);
    const parsed = ts.createSourceFile(file, content, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true, ts.ScriptKind.TSX);
    assert.equal(parsed.parseDiagnostics.length, 0, file + ': ' + parsed.parseDiagnostics.map(d => ts.flattenDiagnosticMessageText(d.messageText,' ')).join('; '));
    const compiled = ts.transpileModule(content, {fileName:file, compilerOptions:{jsx:ts.JsxEmit.ReactJSX,module:ts.ModuleKind.ESNext,target:ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022}, reportDiagnostics:true});
    assert.equal((compiled.diagnostics??[]).filter(d=>d.category===ts.DiagnosticCategory.Error).length, 0, file);
  }
});
```

### `tests/pack-analysis.test.mjs`

```typescript
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { test } from 'node:test';
import { analyzePack, simulateExclusions } from '../lib/pack-analysis.ts';

const gear = (name, category, weight_g, price_cad = 100) => ({ name, category: { name: category }, weight_g, price_cad });
const item = (id, overrides = {}) => ({
  id, quantity: 1, isWorn: false, isConsumable: false, customCategory: null,
  gearNameSnapshot: null, weightSnapshot: null, priceSnapshot: null, gear: null,
  ...overrides,
});

test('empty build has no divide-by-zero or phantom weights', () => {
  const result = analyzePack([]);
  assert.equal(result.totalGrams, 0);
  assert.equal(result.totalUnits, 0);
  assert.equal(result.categories.length, 0);
  assert.deepEqual(result.heaviest, []);
});

test('quantity, catalog precedence, worn priority and known totals match Builder', () => {
  const result = analyzePack([
    item('pack', { gear: gear('Pack', 'Packs', 900, 350) }),
    item('food', { quantity: 3, isConsumable: true, weightSnapshot: 400, priceSnapshot: 4, customCategory: 'Food' }),
    item('shoes', { isWorn: true, isConsumable: true, gear: gear('Shoes', 'Clothing', 620, 110) }),
    item('sleep', { quantity: 2, gear: gear('Quilt', 'Sleep', 300, 75), weightSnapshot: 900, priceSnapshot: 100 }),
  ]);
  assert.equal(result.baseGrams, 1500);
  assert.equal(result.consumableGrams, 1200);
  assert.equal(result.wornGrams, 620);
  assert.equal(result.carriedGrams, 2700);
  assert.equal(result.totalGrams, 3320);
  assert.equal(result.knownCostCad, 350 + 12 + 110 + 150);
  assert.equal(result.totalUnits, 7);
  assert.equal(result.unknownWeightUnits, 0);
  assert.equal(result.categories[0].name, 'Food');
  assert.equal(result.heaviest[0].name, 'Custom item');
});

test('unknown weight or price never counted as known zero', () => {
  const result = analyzePack([
    item('unknown', { quantity: 2, customCategory: 'Misc' }),
    item('zero', { weightSnapshot: 0, priceSnapshot: 0 }),
    item('invalid', { weightSnapshot: -5, priceSnapshot: Number.NaN }),
  ]);
  assert.equal(result.knownWeightUnits, 1);
  assert.equal(result.unknownWeightUnits, 3);
  assert.equal(result.unknownPriceUnits, 3);
  assert.equal(result.totalGrams, 0);
  assert.equal(result.knownCostCad, 0);
  assert.equal(result.categories.find(c => c.name === 'Misc').unknownWeightCount, 2);
});

test('categories account for quantities and weight classes', () => {
  const result = analyzePack([
    item('a', { quantity: 2, gear: gear('A', 'Clothing', 100) }),
    item('b', { isWorn: true, gear: gear('B', 'Clothing', 500) }),
    item('c', { isConsumable: true, gear: gear('C', 'Water', 200) }),
  ]);
  const clothing = result.categories.find(c => c.name === 'Clothing');
  assert.equal(clothing.baseGrams, 200);
  assert.equal(clothing.wornGrams, 500);
  assert.equal(clothing.count, 3);
  assert.equal(result.categories[0].name, 'Clothing');
});

test('simulation does not mutate the input or subtract missing weights', () => {
  const result = analyzePack([
    item('a', { gear: gear('A', 'Packs', 1000, 300) }),
    item('b', { quantity: 2, isConsumable: true, weightSnapshot: 250, priceSnapshot: 10 }),
    item('c', { isWorn: true, weightSnapshot: 400 }),
    item('d', {}),
  ]);
  const excluded = new Set(['a', 'b', 'c', 'd']);
  const scenario = simulateExclusions(result, excluded);
  assert.equal(scenario.knownSavedCarried, 1500);
  assert.equal(scenario.knownSavedTotal, 1900);
  assert.equal(scenario.knownSavedCost, 320);
  assert.equal(scenario.missingWeightCount, 1);
  assert.equal(scenario.remainingCarried, 0);
  assert.equal(result.carriedGrams, 1500);
  assert.equal(result.lines.length, 4);
});

test('long item lists and mixed custom gear remain deterministic', () => {
  const items = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => item(`id-${i}`, { customCategory: i % 2 ? 'Custom' : null, weightSnapshot: i * 100, gearNameSnapshot: `Gear ${i}` }));
  const result = analyzePack(items);
  assert.equal(result.heaviest.length, 5);
  assert.equal(result.heaviest[0].name, 'Gear 19');
  assert.equal(result.totalGrams, 19000);
});


test('removing worn gear changes total weight but not carried weight', () => {
  const result = analyzePack([
    item('base', { gear: gear('Pack', 'Packs', 800) }),
    item('worn', { isWorn: true, gear: gear('Boots', 'Clothing', 1200) }),
  ]);
  const simulation = simulateExclusions(result, new Set(['worn']));
  assert.equal(simulation.knownSavedCarried, 0);
  assert.equal(simulation.knownSavedTotal, 1200);
  assert.equal(simulation.remainingCarried, 800);
  assert.equal(simulation.remainingTotal, 800);
});

test('catalog zero is known zero, snapshot fallback works when catalog null', () => {
  const result = analyzePack([
    item('zero', { gear: gear('Zero', 'Misc', 0, 0), weightSnapshot: 900, priceSnapshot: 500 }),
    item('fallback', { gear: gear('Fallback', 'Misc', null, null), weightSnapshot: 300, priceSnapshot: 45 }),
  ]);
  assert.equal(result.totalGrams, 300);
  assert.equal(result.knownCostCad, 45);
  assert.equal(result.unknownWeightUnits, 0);
});

```

### `tests/pack-intelligence.test.mjs`

```typescript
import {test} from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { evaluatePackIntelligence, parseEcccEvidence, projectConsumables } from '../lib/pack-intelligence.ts';
const build=(o={})=>({people:1,minTemperature:null,conditions:null,startDate:null,endDate:null,...o});
const item=(id,cat,weight=400,extras={})=>({id,quantity:1,isConsumable:false,isWorn:false,customCategory:cat,gearNameSnapshot:id,weightSnapshot:weight,priceSnapshot:null,gear:null,...extras});
const dates=[{date:new Date('2026-11-02'),minTemperature:null,conditions:null,waterCarryL:null,waterSource:null,distanceKm:null,elevationGainM:null,campsite:null}];
const byId=(result,id)=>result.findings.find(f=>f.id===id);
const overnightDays=[{...dates[0],campsite:'Planned campsite'}];

test('sleep temperature comparison reports review, not certain danger, when rating is warmer',()=>{
 const sleep=item('quilt','Sleep',500,{gear:{id:'q',name:'Quilt',weight_g:500,price_cad:null,capacity_l:null,frame_type:null,waterproof:null,temperature_rating:5,season:null,category:{name:'Sleep'},subcategory:{name:'Quilt',slug:'quilt'}}});
 const r=evaluatePackIntelligence(build({minTemperature:-4}),[sleep],overnightDays);
 assert.equal(byId(r,'gear-sleep-rating-review-quilt').level,'review');
 assert.match(byId(r,'gear-sleep-rating-review-quilt').detail,/rating type and full sleep system/i);
 assert.equal(r.coldest,-4);
});
test('an unknown sleep rating is unknown and never treated as unsafe or warm enough',()=>{
 const unrated=item('s','Sleep',400,{gear:{id:'s',name:'Unrated quilt',weight_g:400,price_cad:null,capacity_l:null,frame_type:null,waterproof:null,temperature_rating:null,season:null,category:{name:'Sleep'},subcategory:{name:'Quilt',slug:'quilt'}}});
 const r=evaluatePackIntelligence(build({minTemperature:-4}),[unrated],overnightDays);
 assert.equal(byId(r,'gear-sleep-rating-unknown').level,'unknown');
 assert.equal(r.findings.some(f=>f.id==='gear-sleep-rating-review-s'),false);
});
test('weather evidence is date-scoped; alerts and strong gusts are reported',()=>{
 const data={daily:[{date:'2026-11-02',low:-9,high:2,gust:75,pop:85,model:'HRDPS',samples:6},{date:'2026-11-03',low:-15,high:0,gust:5,pop:30,model:'RDPS',samples:4}],alerts:{status:'ok',items:[{title:'Wind warning'}]}};
 const point={name:'Camp',lat:50,lng:-122,elevationM:1800};
 const evidence=parseEcccEvidence(data,point,['2026-11-02']);
 assert.equal(evidence.days.length,1);assert.equal(evidence.days[0].low,-9);
 assert.equal(evidence.point.lat,50);assert.equal(evidence.days[0].pop,85);
 const shelter=item('tent','Shelter',900,{gear:{id:'tent',name:'Tent',weight_g:900,price_cad:null,capacity_l:null,frame_type:null,waterproof:false,temperature_rating:null,season:'3-season',category:{name:'Shelter'},subcategory:{name:'Tent',slug:'tent'}}});
 const r=evaluatePackIntelligence(build(),[shelter],dates,evidence);
 assert.equal(byId(r,'alerts-active').level,'critical');
 assert.ok(byId(r,'strong-gust'));
 // A forecast alone must not silently become a user-entered wet-weather condition.
 assert.equal(byId(r,'gear-shelter-wet-weather'),undefined);
 const wet=evaluatePackIntelligence(build({conditions:'rain'}),[shelter],dates,evidence);
 assert.equal(byId(wet,'gear-shelter-wet-weather').level,'review');
});
test('alerts unavailable is not an all-clear',()=>{
 const point={name:'Camp',lat:50,lng:-122,elevationM:null};
 const evidence=parseEcccEvidence({daily:[],alerts:{status:'unavailable',items:[]}},point,[]);
 const r=evaluatePackIntelligence(build(),[],dates,evidence);
 assert.equal(byId(r,'alerts-unavailable').level,'unknown');
});
test('missing categories require overnight context except packs',()=>{
 const day={...dates[0],campsite:null};
 const dayCamping={...day,campsite:'Alice'};
 const daytrip=evaluatePackIntelligence(build(),[],[day]);
 assert.equal(!!byId(daytrip,'gear-missing-shelter'),false);
 const camping=evaluatePackIntelligence(build(),[item('water','Water')],[dayCamping]);
 assert.equal(byId(camping,'gear-missing-shelter').level,'review');
});
test('unknown weight never counts as known zero',()=>{
 const r=evaluatePackIntelligence(build(),[item('unknown','Misc',null)],dates);
 assert.equal(r.pack.unknownWeightUnits,1);
 assert.equal(byId(r,'unknown-weight').level,'unknown');
});
test('solo duplicates trigger review prompts without recommending dangerous removals',()=>{
 const duplicateGear={id:'one',name:'Pack',category:{name:'Packs'},weight_g:1500,price_cad:100,capacity_l:50,frame_type:null,waterproof:null,temperature_rating:null,season:null};
 const r=evaluatePackIntelligence(build(),[item('a','Packs',1500,{quantity:2,gear:duplicateGear})],dates);
 assert.equal(byId(r,'duplicate-one').level,'opportunity');
 assert.match(byId(r,'duplicate-one').action,/Confirm/);
});
test('consumables scenario is bounded, never generates negative mass',()=>{
 const r=projectConsumables(1200,4,0.4);
 assert.deepEqual(r.map(d=>d.remainingGrams),[1200,720,240,0,0]);
 assert.equal(projectConsumables(100,300,1).length,31);
});
test('missing live forecast is visible on overnight trips',()=>{
 const r=evaluatePackIntelligence(build({startDate:new Date('2026-10-01'),endDate:new Date('2026-10-03')}),[],dates);
 assert.equal(byId(r,'forecast-not-loaded').level,'unknown');
});
test('does not hallucinate waterproofing or unsafe equipment from missing specifications',()=>{
 const r=evaluatePackIntelligence(build({conditions:'rain'}),[item('tent','Shelter')],dates);
 assert.equal(byId(r,'gear-shelter-waterproof-unknown').level,'unknown');
 assert.equal(!!byId(r,'gear-shelter-wet-weather'),false);
});
```

```typescript
const test = require("node:test");
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const ts = require("typescript");

const root = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
const read = (name) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, "components/builder/TripPlanner", name), "utf8");
const panel = read("RouteElevationPanel.tsx");
const itinerary = read("DayStopsItinerary.tsx");
const picker = read("StopSelectPicker.tsx");

test("hiking time fallback uses a declared, derived break value", () => {
  assert.match(panel, /const totalBreakText = movingMinutes !== null && breakEstimate !== null \? duration\(breakEstimate\) : "Unavailable"/);
  assert.match(panel, /totalBreakText !== "Unavailable" \? ` · \$\{totalBreakText\} breaks` : ""/);
  assert.match(panel, /const totalMinutes = movingMinutes !== null && breakEstimate !== null \? movingMinutes \+ breakEstimate : null/);
  assert.match(panel, /timeBarTotal > 0 && <div/);
  assert.match(panel, />Hiking settings<\/span>/);
});

test("unassigned stops use the shared custom dropdown, never native select", () => {
  const unassigned = itinerary.split('aria-label="Unassigned route stops"')[1]?.split("</ol>")[0];
  assert.ok(unassigned, "unassigned stop list exists");
  assert.doesNotMatch(unassigned, /<select\b|<option\b/);
  assert.match(unassigned, /<StopSelectPicker/);
  assert.match(unassigned, /placeholder="Assign day"/);
  assert.match(unassigned, /variant="action"/);
  assert.match(unassigned, /disabled=\{route\.pending\}/);
  assert.match(unassigned, /onChange=\{\(dayId\) => \{ if \(dayId\) route\.assignStop\(stop\.id, dayId\); \}\}/);
  assert.match(unassigned, /timeZone: "UTC"/);
  assert.match(unassigned, /!route\.readOnly && orderedDays\.length > 0/);
});

test("action variant remains enabled except when actually disabled", () => {
  assert.match(picker, /variant\?: "default" \| "action"/);
  assert.match(picker, /placeholder\?: string/);
  assert.match(picker, /selected\?\.label \?\? placeholder/);
  assert.match(picker, /variant === "action"/);
  assert.match(picker, /border-green-200 bg-green-50/);
  assert.match(picker, /hover:border-green-400 hover:bg-green-100/);
  assert.match(picker, /disabled=\{disabled\}/);
  assert.match(picker, /createPortal\(/);
  assert.match(picker, /role="listbox"/);
  assert.match(picker, /role="option"/);
  for (const key of ["ArrowDown", "ArrowUp", "Home", "End", "Escape", "Tab"])
    assert.ok(picker.includes(`"${key}"`), `keyboard navigation must support ${key}`);
});

test("all three TSX files parse successfully", () => {
  for (const name of ["RouteElevationPanel.tsx", "DayStopsItinerary.tsx", "StopSelectPicker.tsx"]) {
    const result = ts.transpileModule(read(name), {
      fileName: name,
      compilerOptions: { target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022, jsx: ts.JsxEmit.ReactJSX, module: ts.ModuleKind.ESNext },
      reportDiagnostics: true,
    });
    assert.deepEqual((result.diagnostics || []).map(d => ts.flattenDiagnosticMessageText(d.messageText, " ")), [], name);
  }
});
```

```typescript
const test = require('node:test');
```

```typescript
  assert.match(source, /const movingShare = timeBarTotal > 0 \? Math\.max\(0, movingMinutes \?\? 0\) \/ timeBarTotal \* 100 : 0/);
  assert.match(source, /const breakShare = timeBarTotal > 0 \? Math\.max\(0, breakEstimate \?\? 0\) \/ timeBarTotal \* 100 : 0/);
  assert.match(source, /timeBarTotal > 0 && <div/);
  assert.ok(source.includes('aria-label={`${duration(movingMinutes!)} moving, ${duration(breakEstimate!)} breaks`}'));
  assert.match(source, /style=\{\{ width: `\$\{movingShare\}%` \}\}/);

});

});
```

### `tests/route-analysis-v2.test.mjs`

```typescript
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { computeRouteMetrics, completeDaySummaries } from "../lib/route-metrics.ts";

const point = (id, dayId, lat, lng) => ({ id, name: id, kind: "waypoint", lat, lng, elevationM: null, dayId });
const routed = (from, to, { elevation = true } = {}) => ({
  toId: to.id, source: "gpx", geometry: [[from.lat, from.lng], [to.lat, to.lng]], distanceM: 1500,
  ...(elevation ? { elevationsM: [200, 290], ascentM: 90, descentM: 0 } : {}),
});

test("elevation profile samples stay aligned with day ids", () => {
  const a = point("a", "one", 49.2, -123.2);
  const b = point("b", "one", 49.201, -123.201);
  const c = point("c", "two", 49.202, -123.202);
  const d = point("d", "two", 49.203, -123.203);
  a.trailToNext = routed(a, b);
  b.trailToNext = routed(b, c);
  c.trailToNext = routed(c, d, { elevation: false });
  const result = computeRouteMetrics([a, b, c, d], [{ id: "one" }, { id: "two" }]);
  assert.deepEqual(result.profileDayIds, ["one", null]);
  assert.equal(result.profileSections.length, result.profileDayIds.length);
  assert.equal(result.unassignedDaySegments, 1);
  assert.equal(result.ascentM, null, "missing elevation cannot become a total");
  assert.deepEqual(completeDaySummaries(result), [], "cross-day links cannot overwrite day records");
});

test("unrouted and no-elevation links do not invent samples", () => {
  const a = point("a", "one", 49.2, -123.2);
  const b = point("b", "one", 49.201, -123.201);
  const c = point("c", "one", 49.202, -123.202);
  a.trailToNext = routed(a, b, { elevation: false });
  b.manualToNext = true;
  const result = computeRouteMetrics([a, b, c], [{ id: "one" }]);
  assert.deepEqual(result.profileSections, []);
  assert.deepEqual(result.profileDayIds, []);
  assert.equal(result.estimatedMinutes, null);
  assert.equal(result.unroutedSegments, 1);
});


test("nine mapped 3D sections without provider totals get real sample-based climb estimates", () => {
  const points = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => point(`point-${i}`, "one", 49.2 + i * .001, -123.2 - i * .001));
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) points[i].trailToNext = {
    toId: points[i+1].id, source: "openrouteservice",
    geometry: [[points[i].lat, points[i].lng],[points[i+1].lat, points[i+1].lng]],
    distanceM: 1632, elevationsM: [300 + i * 40, 340 + i * 40],
    // No ascentM/descentM, exactly the situation in the reported UI.
  };
  const m = computeRouteMetrics(points, [{id: "one"}], 3.5);
  assert.equal(m.profileSections.length, 9);
  assert.equal(m.climbedSegments, 9);
  assert.equal(m.sampleDerivedSegments, 9);
  assert.equal(m.unroutedSegments, 0);
  assert.equal(m.ascentM, 360);
  assert.equal(m.descentM, 0);
  assert.ok(m.estimatedMinutes > 0);
  assert.ok(m.dayMetrics[0].estimatedMinutes > 0);
  assert.equal(m.dayMetrics[0].routedEstimateMinutes > 0, true);
  assert.deepEqual(completeDaySummaries(m), [], "estimated elevations do not overwrite manual day stats");
});

test("time for mapped same-day sections remains visible when another leg crosses days", () => {
  const a = point("a", "one", 49.2, -123.2);
  const b = point("b", "one", 49.201, -123.201);
  const c = point("c", "two", 49.2015, -123.2015);
  a.trailToNext = {toId: "b", source: "gpx", geometry: [[a.lat,a.lng],[b.lat,b.lng]], distanceM: 14690, elevationsM: [100,250]};
  b.trailToNext = {toId: "c", source: "gpx", geometry: [[b.lat,b.lng],[c.lat,c.lng]], distanceM: 80, elevationsM: [250,260]};
  const m = computeRouteMetrics([a,b,c],[{id:"one"},{id:"two"}]);
  assert.equal(m.distanceM, 14770);
  assert.equal(m.dayMetrics[0].distanceM,14690);
  assert.equal(m.dayMetrics[0].unresolvedLinks,1);
  assert.equal(m.dayMetrics[0].estimatedMinutes,null, "complete day time still blocked");
  assert.ok(m.dayMetrics[0].routedEstimateMinutes > 0, "assigned mapped leg has an honest partial time");
  assert.equal(m.estimatedMinutes !== null,true,"whole-route time independent of day assignment");
});

test("missing all sampled elevations still cannot produce complete ascent or day time", () => {
  const a = point("a","one",49.2,-123.2), b = point("b","one",49.201,-123.201);
  a.trailToNext = routed(a,b,{elevation:false});
  const m = computeRouteMetrics([a,b],[{id:"one"}]);
  assert.equal(m.profileSections.length,0);
  assert.equal(m.ascentM,null);
  assert.equal(m.sampleDerivedSegments,0);
  assert.equal(m.dayMetrics[0].estimatedMinutes,null);
  assert.ok(m.dayMetrics[0].routedEstimateMinutes > 0);
});
```

### `tests/route-analysis-v3.test.mjs`

```typescript
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import {
  analyzeTerrain, approximateDaylight, checkDaySchedule, clockLabel,
  DEFAULT_BREAK_SETTINGS, estimateBreaks, parseClock,
} from "../lib/route-analysis-insights.ts";
import { computeRouteMetrics } from "../lib/route-metrics.ts";

const sample = (distanceM, elevationM) => ({ distanceM, elevationM });

test("break frequency is separate from pace; lunch is planned in the itinerary", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(estimateBreaks(300), { shortMinutes: 50, lunchMinutes: 0, totalMinutes: 50 });
  assert.deepEqual(estimateBreaks(300, {...DEFAULT_BREAK_SETTINGS, style: "minimal"}), {shortMinutes: 25, lunchMinutes: 0, totalMinutes: 25});
  assert.deepEqual(estimateBreaks(300, {...DEFAULT_BREAK_SETTINGS, style: "frequent"}), {shortMinutes: 75, lunchMinutes: 0, totalMinutes: 75});
  assert.deepEqual(estimateBreaks(300, {...DEFAULT_BREAK_SETTINGS, style: "custom", customMinutesPerHour: 25, lunchMinutes: 0}), {shortMinutes: 125, lunchMinutes: 0, totalMinutes: 125});
  assert.deepEqual(estimateBreaks(239), {shortMinutes: 40, lunchMinutes: 0, totalMinutes: 40});
  assert.equal(estimateBreaks(null), null);
  assert.equal(estimateBreaks(-5), null);
  const twoDays = estimateBreaks(300).totalMinutes + estimateBreaks(120).totalMinutes;
  assert.equal(twoDays, 70, "the default only adds short breaks, not a hidden lunch stop");
  assert.deepEqual(estimateBreaks(300, {...DEFAULT_BREAK_SETTINGS, lunchMinutes: 30}),
    {shortMinutes: 50, lunchMinutes: 30, totalMinutes: 80}, "explicit lunch options remain compatible with callers");
});

test("break settings clamp invalid values to avoid bogus times", () => {
  const r = estimateBreaks(60, {style:"custom", customMinutesPerHour:900, lunchMinutes:1000, lunchThresholdMinutes:0});
  assert.deepEqual(r,{shortMinutes:30,lunchMinutes:120,totalMinutes:150});
});

test("terrain windows identify sustained climbs, descents, and bands from contiguous samples", () => {
  // Each 100 m sample rises 20m over 600m, then falls 20m over 600m.
  const sections = [[...Array.from({length:7}, (_,i)=>sample(i*100, 100+i*20)),
    ...Array.from({length:6},(_,i)=>sample((i+7)*100, 220-(i+1)*20))]];
  const a = analyzeTerrain(sections,["one"]);
  assert.equal(a.analyzedDistanceM, 1200);
  assert.equal(a.steepDistanceM, 1200);
  assert.equal(a.gentleDistanceM, 0);
  assert.ok(a.hardestClimb);
  assert.ok(a.hardestDescent);
  assert.equal(a.hardestClimb.direction,"climb");
  assert.equal(a.hardestClimb.startM,0);
  assert.equal(a.hardestClimb.endM,600);
  assert.equal(a.hardestClimb.gainM,120);
  assert.equal(a.hardestClimb.dayId,"one");
  assert.equal(a.hardestDescent.startM,600);
  assert.equal(a.hardestDescent.endM,1200);
});

test("sparse, gapped and disconnected profile samples do not fabricate slopes", () => {
  const a=analyzeTerrain([
    [sample(0,100),sample(1000,700)], // 1km jump must not imply uniform grade
    [sample(2000,150),sample(2100,155),sample(2200,160)],
    [sample(5000,100),sample(5100,105),sample(5200,110)],
  ],["one","one","two"]);
  assert.equal(a.analyzedDistanceM,400);
  assert.equal(a.hardestClimb,null);
  assert.equal(a.hardestDescent,null);
  assert.equal(a.totalProfileDistanceM,1400);
  assert.ok(a.cells.every(c=>c.endM-c.startM <= 200));
});

test("no grades merge across day assignment boundaries", () => {
  const one=[0,100,200,300].map(d => sample(d,100+d*.2));
  const two=[300,400,500,600].map(d => sample(d,160+(d-300)*.2));
  const r=analyzeTerrain([one,two],["day-a","day-b"]);
  assert.equal(r.hardestClimb,null,"each day has only 300 m, not 600 m sustained");
});

test("approximate daylight returns plausible local civil times in Vancouver in winter and summer", () => {
  const winter=approximateDaylight("2026-11-14",49.25,-123.1,"America/Vancouver");
  assert.ok(winter.sunriseMinutes > 420 && winter.sunriseMinutes < 480, JSON.stringify(winter));
  assert.ok(winter.sunsetMinutes > 960 && winter.sunsetMinutes < 1030, JSON.stringify(winter));
  const summer=approximateDaylight("2026-07-14",49.25,-123.1,"America/Vancouver");
  assert.ok(summer.sunriseMinutes < winter.sunriseMinutes);
  assert.ok(summer.sunsetMinutes > winter.sunsetMinutes);
  assert.equal(approximateDaylight("bad",49,-123,"America/Vancouver").sunsetMinutes,null);
  assert.equal(approximateDaylight("2026-11-14",49,-123,"Not/AZone").sunsetMinutes,null);
});

test("daylight checks flag tight finishing and schedule conflicts", () => {
  const solar={sunriseMinutes:440,sunsetMinutes:990,zone:"America/Vancouver"};
  const okay=checkDaySchedule("09:00",300,solar,"17:30");
  assert.equal(okay.finishMinutes,840);
  assert.equal(okay.status,"before-sunset");
  assert.equal(okay.arrivalConflict,false);
  const tight=checkDaySchedule("12:00",240,solar,"15:00");
  assert.equal(tight.status,"tight-daylight");
  assert.equal(tight.arrivalConflict,true);
  const late=checkDaySchedule("14:00",240,solar);
  assert.equal(late.status,"after-sunset");
  assert.equal(checkDaySchedule("???",200,solar),null);
  assert.equal(checkDaySchedule("08:00",null,solar),null);
  assert.equal(parseClock("24:00"),null);
  assert.equal(parseClock("09:30"),570);
  assert.equal(clockLabel(990),"4:30 PM");
  assert.equal(clockLabel(1510),"1:10 AM (+1d)");
});

const p = (id, dayId, lat, lng) => ({id, name:id, lat, lng, kind:"waypoint", elevationM:null, dayId});
test("an unassigned cross-day leg even shorter than 10m blocks a fully verified day schedule", () => {
  const a=p("a","day1",49.2,-123.2), b=p("b","day1",49.2005,-123.2), c=p("c","day2",49.20051,-123.2);
  a.trailToNext={toId:b.id,geometry:[[a.lat,a.lng],[b.lat,b.lng]],distanceM:500,elevationsM:[100,150],source:"gpx"};
  b.trailToNext={toId:c.id,geometry:[[b.lat,b.lng],[c.lat,c.lng]],distanceM:2,elevationsM:[150,151],source:"gpx"};
  const metrics=computeRouteMetrics([a,b,c],[{id:"day1"},{id:"day2"}]);
  assert.equal(metrics.dayMetrics[0].estimatedMinutes,null);
  assert.equal(metrics.dayMetrics[0].unresolvedLinks,1);
  assert.equal(metrics.unassignedDayDistanceM,2);
  assert.ok(metrics.dayMetrics[0].routedEstimateMinutes > 0);
});
```

```typescript
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { computeRouteMetrics, completeDaySummaries, hikingDifficulty } from "../lib/route-metrics.ts";
import { validTrailSegment } from "../lib/trail-routing.ts";
const xy = [[49.2,-123.2],[49.201,-123.201],[49.202,-123.202],[49.203,-123.203]];
const day = (i, id) => ({id, name:`Stop ${i}`, kind:"waypoint", lat:xy[i][0], lng:xy[i][1], elevationM:null, dayId:id});
const routed = (a, b, distanceM=2000) => ({toId:b.id, geometry:[[a.lat,a.lng],[b.lat,b.lng]], elevationsM:[300,400], ascentM:100, descentM:0, distanceM, source:"gpx"});
test("GPX track geometry is valid and daily difficulty varies by effort",()=>{
  const [a,b]=[day(0,"day1"), day(1,"day1")]; a.trailToNext=routed(a,b);
  assert.equal(validTrailSegment(a.trailToNext),true);
  const result=computeRouteMetrics([a,b],[{id:"day1"}],3.5);
  assert.equal(result.dayMetrics[0].difficulty,"Easy");
  assert.deepEqual(completeDaySummaries(result),[{dayId:"day1",distanceKm:2,elevationGainM:100,elevationLossM:0,durationMinutes:44}]);
  assert.equal(hikingDifficulty(8000,350,200),"Moderate");
  assert.equal(hikingDifficulty(15000,800,350),"Challenging");
  assert.equal(hikingDifficulty(25000,1500,480),"Strenuous");
});
test("an inter-day link blocks partial day totals from overwriting saved values",()=>{
  const a=day(0,"day1"), b=day(1,"day1"), c=day(2,"day2"), d=day(3,"day2");
  a.trailToNext=routed(a,b); b.manualToNext=true; c.trailToNext=routed(c,d);
  const data=computeRouteMetrics([a,b,c,d],[{id:"day1"},{id:"day2"}]);
  assert.equal(data.unassignedDaySegments,1);
  assert.equal(data.dayMetrics[0].unresolvedLinks,1);
  assert.equal(data.dayMetrics[1].unresolvedLinks,1);
  assert.equal(data.dayMetrics[0].estimatedMinutes,null);
  assert.deepEqual(completeDaySummaries(data),[]);
});
test("gaps and incomplete altitude never persist manufactured climb or time",()=>{
  const a=day(0,"day1"), b=day(1,"day1"); a.manualToNext=true;
  assert.deepEqual(completeDaySummaries(computeRouteMetrics([a,b],[{id:"day1"}])),[]);
  delete a.manualToNext;
  a.trailToNext={...routed(a,b),elevationsM:undefined,ascentM:undefined,descentM:undefined};
  assert.deepEqual(completeDaySummaries(computeRouteMetrics([a,b],[{id:"day1"}])),[]);
});
```

### `tests/route-day-visibility-overnight-v082.test.cjs`

```typescript
const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const ts = require('typescript');
const root = path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
const original = require.extensions['.ts'];
// Load project-local pure TypeScript models with no Next.js runtime dependency.
require.extensions['.ts'] = function(module, filename) {
  const source=fs.readFileSync(filename,'utf8');
  const compiled=ts.transpileModule(source,{fileName:filename,compilerOptions:{module:ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS,target:ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022,esModuleInterop:true}}).outputText;
  module._compile(compiled,filename);
};
const { isSharedOvernightStop } = require('../lib/shared-overnight-stop.ts');
const { missingTrailLegs } = require('../lib/route-request-planner.ts');
const { computeRouteMetrics } = require('../lib/route-metrics.ts');
const { buildRouteExplorer } = require('../lib/route-explorer.ts');
const { routeLegStyle } = require('../lib/route-leg-style.ts');
require.extensions['.ts'] = original;
const point=(id,name,dayId,lat=49.2,lng=-123.2)=>({ id,name,dayId,lat,lng,kind:'camp',elevationM:null });
function route(a,b,distanceM=1000){ return {toId:b.id,geometry:Array.from({length:5},(_,i)=>[a.lat+(b.lat-a.lat)*i/4,a.lng+(b.lng-a.lng)*i/4]),distanceM,elevationsM:[100,105,110,115,120],ascentM:20,descentM:0,source:'openrouteservice'}; }
const d1=point('d1','Kees and Claire Hut','day-1');
const d2=point('d2','Kees and Claire Hut','day-2');
const earlier=point('earlier','Previous stop','day-1',49.198,-123.202);
const later=point('later','Next stop','day-2',49.202,-123.198);
earlier.trailToNext=route(earlier,d1);
d2.trailToNext=route(d2,later);

test('same overnight campsite across consecutive days generates no fictitious route leg or warning',()=>{
  const points=[earlier,d1,d2,later];
  assert.ok(isSharedOvernightStop(d1,d2));
  assert.deepEqual(missingTrailLegs(points),[]);
  const metrics=computeRouteMetrics(points,[{id:'day-1'},{id:'day-2'}]);
  assert.equal(metrics.segments,2);
  assert.equal(metrics.unroutedSegments,0);
  assert.equal(metrics.unassignedDaySegments,0);
  assert.equal(metrics.dayMetrics[0].segments,1);
  assert.equal(metrics.dayMetrics[1].segments,1);
  assert.equal(metrics.distanceM,2000);
  assert.ok(metrics.estimatedMinutes !== null);
  const explorer=buildRouteExplorer(points);
  assert.equal(explorer.distanceM,metrics.distanceM);
  assert.equal(explorer.stopDistances[d1.id],explorer.stopDistances[d2.id]);
  assert.equal(explorer.sections.length,2);
});

test('small coordinate differences are allowed for same named overnight sites, not distant sites',()=>{
  const nearby=point('d2','  kees & claire hut  ','day-2',49.20007,-123.20007);
  assert.ok(isSharedOvernightStop(d1,nearby));
  assert.equal(isSharedOvernightStop(d1,point('different','Unrelated name','day-2',49.20007,-123.20007)),false);
  assert.equal(isSharedOvernightStop(d1,point('far','Kees and Claire Hut','day-2',49.21,-123.2)),false);
  assert.equal(isSharedOvernightStop(d1,point('same day','Kees and Claire Hut','day-1')),false);
  assert.equal(isSharedOvernightStop(d1,point('no day','Kees and Claire Hut',null)),false);
  assert.ok(isSharedOvernightStop(d1,point('identical pin','Other label','day-2')));
});

test('intentional loop tracks or route shaping are not silently removed',()=>{
  assert.equal(isSharedOvernightStop({...d1,viaToNext:[[49.21,-123.21]]},d2),false);
  const loop={...d1,trailToNext:{toId:d2.id,geometry:[[d1.lat,d1.lng],[49.204,-123.2],[d2.lat,d2.lng]],distanceM:2200,source:'gpx'}};
  assert.equal(isSharedOvernightStop(loop,d2),false);
  assert.equal(computeRouteMetrics([loop,d2],[{id:'day-1'},{id:'day-2'}]).segments,1);
});

test('genuinely different leg after a shared overnight belongs to the next day, with ORS still required',()=>{
  const far=point('far','Other campsite','day-2',49.21,-123.19);
  assert.equal(isSharedOvernightStop(d1,far),false);
  assert.equal(computeRouteMetrics([d1,far],[{id:'day-1'},{id:'day-2'}]).unassignedDaySegments,0);
  assert.equal(computeRouteMetrics([d1,far],[{id:'day-1'},{id:'day-2'}]).dayMetrics[1].segments,1);
  assert.equal(computeRouteMetrics([d1,far],[{id:'day-1'},{id:'day-2'}]).unroutedSegments,1);
  assert.equal(missingTrailLegs([d1,far]).length,1);
});

test('route dimming follows expanded panels, not the last clicked stop',()=>{
  const base={mapped:true,editing:true,startDayId:'day-2',endDayId:'day-2',activeDayId:'day-1'};
  assert.ok(routeLegStyle({...base,expandedDayIds:['day-2']}).opacity>.9);
  assert.ok(routeLegStyle({...base,expandedDayIds:['day-1']}).opacity<.3);
  assert.ok(routeLegStyle({...base,expandedDayIds:[]}).opacity>.9);
  assert.equal(routeLegStyle({...base,expandedDayIds:[]}).weight,6); // editing mode uses full weight
  assert.equal(routeLegStyle({...base,editing:false,expandedDayIds:[]}).weight,5);
  assert.ok(routeLegStyle({...base,editing:false,expandedDayIds:['day-1','day-2']}).opacity>.8);
  assert.ok(routeLegStyle({...base,mapped:false,expandedDayIds:['day-1']}).opacity<.3);
  assert.equal(routeLegStyle({...base,mapped:false,expandedDayIds:[]}).dashArray,'6 8');
});

test('mixed-day segment shows when both owning panels are expanded',()=>{
  const b={mapped:true,editing:false,startDayId:'day-1',endDayId:'day-2'};
  assert.ok(routeLegStyle({...b,expandedDayIds:['day-1','day-2']}).opacity>.8);
  assert.ok(routeLegStyle({...b,expandedDayIds:['day-1']}).opacity<.3);
});

test('itinerary expansion state reaches the map, and stop drag ghost cannot keep cards gray',()=>{
  const route=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'components/builder/TripPlanner/TripRoute.tsx'),'utf8');
  const map=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'components/builder/TripPlanner/RouteMapInner.tsx'),'utf8');
  const itinerary=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'components/builder/TripPlanner/DayStopsItinerary.tsx'),'utf8');
  assert.match(route,/expandedDayIds=\{expandedDayIds\}/);
  assert.match(map,/expandedDayIds,\s*startDayId/);
  assert.match(itinerary,/open=\{route\.expandedDayIds\.includes\(day\.id\)\}/);
  assert.match(itinerary,/setOpen=\{\(next\) => route\.setDayExpanded\(day\.id, next\)\}/);
  assert.ok(!itinerary.includes('opacity-45'));
  assert.match(itinerary,/window\.addEventListener\("drop", endDrag\)/);
  assert.match(itinerary,/drag\.end\(\)/);
});

test('modified TypeScript parses (TS/TSX)',()=>{
  for(const rel of ['lib/shared-overnight-stop.ts','lib/route-metrics.ts','lib/route-explorer.ts','lib/route-request-planner.ts','lib/route-leg-style.ts','components/builder/TripPlanner/TripRoute.tsx','components/builder/TripPlanner/DayStopsItinerary.tsx','components/builder/TripPlanner/RouteMapInner.tsx']){
    const source=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,rel),'utf8');
    const result=ts.transpileModule(source,{fileName:rel,compilerOptions:{target:ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022,module:ts.ModuleKind.ESNext,jsx:ts.JsxEmit.ReactJSX},reportDiagnostics:true});
    assert.deepEqual((result.diagnostics||[]).map(d=>ts.flattenDiagnosticMessageText(d.messageText,' ')),[],rel);
  }
});
```

```typescript
const test = require("node:test");
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const { readFileSync } = require("node:fs");
const { join } = require("node:path");
const { buildRouteExplorer, locationAtDistance, gradeAtDistance } = require("../lib/route-explorer.ts");
const { computeRouteMetrics } = require("../lib/route-metrics.ts");

const fixture = (id, dayId, lat, lng, kind = "waypoint") => ({ id, name:id, dayId, lat, lng, kind, elevationM:null });
function segment(start, end, distanceM, elevationsM) {
  return { toId:end.id, source:"gpx", distanceM,
    geometry:Array.from({length:elevationsM.length}, (_, i) => {
      const t=i/(elevationsM.length-1);
      return [start.lat+(end.lat-start.lat)*t, start.lng+(end.lng-start.lng)*t];
    }), elevationsM };
}

test("map cursor follows precisely the elevation profile measured location", () => {
  const a=fixture("a","one",49.2,-123.2);
  const b=fixture("b","one",49.203,-123.203,"camp");
  a.trailToNext=segment(a,b,900,[600,625,675,700]);
  const route=buildRouteExplorer([a,b]);
  const metrics=computeRouteMetrics([a,b],[{id:"one"}]);
  assert.equal(route.distanceM,metrics.distanceM);
  assert.equal(route.sections.length,1);
  assert.equal(route.sections[0].dayId,metrics.profileDayIds[0]);
  const cursor=locationAtDistance(route,450);
  assert.ok(cursor);
  assert.ok(cursor.lat > a.lat && cursor.lat < b.lat);
  assert.ok(cursor.lng < a.lng && cursor.lng > b.lng);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(cursor.elevationM-650)<0.01);
  assert.ok(gradeAtDistance(route,450)>0);
  assert.equal(route.stopDistances[b.id],900);
});

test("a day crossover and a manual link never become a continuous elevation profile", () => {
  const a=fixture("a","one",49.2,-123.2);
  const b=fixture("b","one",49.203,-123.203);
  const c=fixture("c","two",49.204,-123.204);
  const d=fixture("d","two",49.207,-123.207);
  a.trailToNext=segment(a,b,900,[600,625,675,700]);
  b.manualToNext=true;
  c.trailToNext=segment(c,d,900,[700,725,750,800]);
  const route=buildRouteExplorer([a,b,c,d]);
  assert.equal(route.sections.length,2);
  assert.deepEqual(route.sections.map(s=>s.dayId),["one","two"]);
  const gap=(route.stopDistances[b.id]+route.stopDistances[c.id])/2;
  assert.equal(locationAtDistance(route,gap),null);
  assert.equal(gradeAtDistance(route,gap),null);
  assert.ok(locationAtDistance(route,route.stopDistances[c.id]+450));
});

test("sparse >400m windows cannot create fake chart lines or map locations", () => {
  const a=fixture("a","one",49.2,-123.2);

});
```

```typescript
const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const ts = require('typescript');
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const read = (file) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, file), 'utf8');
const fit = require('../lib/route-visible-fit.ts');

const map = { left: 0, top: 50, right: 900, bottom: 750 };
const drawer = height => ({ left: 0, right: 900, bottom: 750, top: 750 - height });

test('closed drawer leaves Fit Route padding unchanged', () => {
  assert.equal(fit.coveredMapBottomPx(map, null), 0);
  assert.deepEqual(fit.routeFitPadding(0), { padding: [44, 44] });
});

test('open profile is excluded from the fitted route viewport', () => {
  assert.equal(fit.coveredMapBottomPx(map, drawer(247)), 247);
  assert.deepEqual(fit.routeFitPadding(247), {
    paddingTopLeft: [44, 44],
    paddingBottomRight: [44, 291],
  });
});

test('uses the actual on-screen dock height rather than assumed 30% height', () => {
  for (const actualHeight of [185, 247, 410, 530]) {
    const measured = fit.coveredMapBottomPx(map, drawer(actualHeight));
    assert.equal(measured, actualHeight);
    assert.equal(fit.routeFitPadding(measured).paddingBottomRight[1], 44 + actualHeight);
  }
});

test('only overlapping bottom dock space is reserved', () => {
  assert.equal(fit.coveredMapBottomPx(map, { left: 901, right: 1200, top: 500, bottom: 750 }), 0);
  assert.equal(fit.coveredMapBottomPx(map, { left: 0, right: 900, top: 200, bottom: 400 }), 0);
  assert.equal(fit.coveredMapBottomPx(map, { left: 0, right: 900, top: 520, bottom: 900 }), 230);
  assert.equal(fit.coveredMapBottomPx(map, { left: 0, right: 900, top: 20, bottom: 900 }), 700);
});

test('Fit Route gets the dock bounds at click time, and compensates for single markers', () => {
  const mapSource = read('components/builder/TripPlanner/RouteMapInner.tsx');
  const dockSource = read('components/builder/TripPlanner/ResizableElevationDock.tsx');
  const fitStart = mapSource.indexOf('function FitRoute(');

  assert.match(handler, /querySelector<HTMLElement>\("\[data-route-elevation-dock\]"\)/);
  assert.match(handler, /getBoundingClientRect\(\)/);
  assert.match(handler, /coveredMapBottomPx\(/);
  assert.match(handler, /\.\.\.routeFitPadding\(coveredBottom\)/);
  assert.match(handler, /map\.panBy\(\[0, coveredBottom \/ 2\], \{ animate: false \}\)/);
  assert.match(handler, /if \(coveredBottom > 0\)/);
  assert.match(handler, /map\.setView\(center, zoom\);/);
  assert.match(mapSource, /<FitRoute points=\{points\} fallback=\{fallback\} \/>/);
  assert.match(dockSource, /calc\(100% - 170px\)/);
});

test('new source files transpile as TS/TSX', () => {

    'lib/route-visible-fit.ts',
    'components/builder/TripPlanner/RouteMapInner.tsx',

});
```

### `tests/route-hiking-autosave-v078.test.cjs`

```typescript
const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const Module = require('node:module');
const ts = require('typescript');
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const source = (name) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, name), 'utf8');

function compileRouteTiming() {
  const filename = path.join(root, 'lib/route-timing-preferences.ts');
  const result = ts.transpileModule(fs.readFileSync(filename, 'utf8'), {
    fileName: filename, reportDiagnostics: true,
    compilerOptions: { target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022, module: ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS },
  });
  assert.deepEqual((result.diagnostics || []).map(d => ts.flattenDiagnosticMessageText(d.messageText, ' ')), []);
  const mod = new Module(filename, module);
  mod.filename = filename;
  mod.paths = Module._nodeModulePaths(path.dirname(filename));
  mod.require = (name) => {
    if (name === './route-metrics') return { DEFAULT_HIKING_PACE_KMH: 4 };
    if (name === './itinerary-timing') return { ITINERARY_DEFAULT_BREAKS: {
      style: 'minimal', customMinutesPerHour: 10, lunchMinutes: 0, lunchThresholdMinutes: 240,
    } };
    return require(name);
  };
  mod._compile(result.outputText, filename);
  return mod.exports;
}
const timing = compileRouteTiming();
const sample = { paceKmh: 4.5, breaks: { style: 'custom', customMinutesPerHour: 20, lunchMinutes: 45, lunchThresholdMinutes: 300 } };

test('legacy builds load defaults and saved preferences round-trip', () => {
  assert.equal(timing.readRouteTimingPreferences(null).paceKmh, 4);
  assert.equal(timing.readRouteTimingPreferences({}).breaks.style, 'minimal');
  assert.deepEqual(timing.readRouteTimingPreferences({ phase6: { water: 1 }, routeTiming: sample }), sample);
});

test('malformed old data falls back safely, while invalid writes are rejected', () => {
  const invalid = [
    { ...sample, paceKmh: 0 },
    { ...sample, paceKmh: 9 },
    { ...sample, paceKmh: '4' },
    { ...sample, paceKmh: NaN },
    { ...sample, breaks: { ...sample.breaks, style: 'extreme' } },
    { ...sample, breaks: { ...sample.breaks, customMinutesPerHour: 900 } },
    { ...sample, breaks: { ...sample.breaks, lunchMinutes: -1 } },
  ];
  for (const data of invalid) {
    assert.throws(() => timing.validateRouteTimingPreferences(data));
    assert.equal(timing.readRouteTimingPreferences({ routeTiming: data }).paceKmh, 4);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(timing.validateRouteTimingPreferences({ ...sample, unknown: 3, breaks: { ...sample.breaks, unknown: true } }), sample);
});

test('server action validates, authenticates, merges logistics and tracks a revision', () => {
  const action = source('lib/trip-planner-actions.ts');
  assert.match(action, /export async function saveRouteTimingPreferences\(f: FormData\)/);
  assert.match(action, /await requireBuildAccess\(buildId\)/);
  assert.match(action, /validateRouteTimingPreferences\(/);
  assert.match(action, /mutateBuildWithRevision\(buildId, access\.userId, "route-timing"/);
  assert.match(action, /\.\.\.root, \[ROUTE_TIMING_KEY\]: settings/);
  assert.match(action, /revalidatePath\(`\/build\/\$\{buildId\}`\)/);
  assert.match(source('lib/tracked-build-actions.ts'), /export const saveRouteTimingPreferences = \(form: FormData\) => trackBuildSave/);
});

test('client restores saved settings and debounces changes, with no autosave on read-only builds', () => {
  const client = source('components/builder/TripPlanner/TripRoute.tsx');
  assert.match(client, /useState\(\(\) => readRouteTimingPreferences\(tripLogistics\)\.paceKmh\)/);
  assert.match(client, /useState<BreakSettings>\(\(\) => readRouteTimingPreferences\(tripLogistics\)\.breaks\)/);
  assert.match(client, /if \(readOnly\) return;/);
  assert.match(client, /window\.setTimeout\(\(\) => \{ void saveLatest\(\); \}, 450\)/);
  assert.match(client, /while \(JSON\.stringify\(latestTimingRef\.current\) !== persistedTimingKey\.current\)/);
  assert.match(client, /markBuildDirty\(buildId, "route-timing"/);
  assert.match(client, /clearBuildDirty\(buildId, "route-timing"\)/);
  assert.match(client, /await saveRouteTimingPreferences\(form\)/);
  assert.match(client, /void flushTimingRef\.current\(\)/);
  assert.match(client, /detail:\{buildId,points,paceKmh,breakSettings\}/);
});

test('changed TS and TSX files parse cleanly', () => {
  for (const name of [
    'components/builder/TripPlanner/TripRoute.tsx',
    'lib/trip-planner-actions.ts',
    'lib/tracked-build-actions.ts',
    'lib/route-timing-preferences.ts',
  ]) {
    const transpiled = ts.transpileModule(source(name), {
      fileName: name, reportDiagnostics: true,
      compilerOptions: { target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022, module: ts.ModuleKind.ESNext, jsx: ts.JsxEmit.ReactJSX },
    });
    assert.deepEqual((transpiled.diagnostics || []).map(d => ts.flattenDiagnosticMessageText(d.messageText, ' ')), [], name);
  }
});

```

```typescript
  module._compile(compiled, filename);
};
const { displayStops, clusterProjectedStops, spiderfyOffset } = require('../lib/route-marker-clustering.ts');
require.extensions['.ts'] = old;
const point = (id, day, kind='camp', name='Shared Camp', lat=49.2, lng=-123.2) => ({id,dayId:day,kind,name,lat,lng,elevationM:null});

test('shared overnight campsite is one visual marker but both day records remain selectable', () => {
  const points = [point('day1','d1'),point('day2','d2')];
  const groups = displayStops(points);
  assert.equal(groups.length, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(groups[0].members.map(member=>member.point.id), ['day1','day2']);
  assert.deepEqual(groups[0].members.map(member=>member.order), [1,2]);
  assert.equal(points.length,2);
});

test('do not collapse unlike resources, distant campsites, or genuine hiking loops',()=>{
  const camp=point('a','d1');
  const water=point('b','d2','water');
  assert.equal(displayStops([camp,water]).length,2);
  assert.equal(displayStops([camp,point('far','d2','camp','Shared Camp',49.3,-123.2)]).length,2);
  const hikingLoop={...camp,viaToNext:[[49.22,-123.22]]};
  assert.equal(displayStops([hikingLoop,point('d2','d2')]).length,2);
});

test('two different day markers too close at a given zoom cluster together',()=>{
  const result = clusterProjectedStops([{key:'a',x:100,y:100},{key:'b',x:119,y:117},{key:'c',x:400,y:400}],39);
  assert.equal(result.length,2);
  assert.deepEqual(result[0].keys,['a','b']);
  assert.equal(result[0].x,109.5);
  assert.equal(result[0].y,108.5);
  assert.deepEqual(result[1].keys,['c']);
});

test('pixel radius changes clustering naturally as the map zoom level changes',()=>{
  const large=[{key:'a',x:0,y:0},{key:'b',x:30,y:0}];
  const small=[{key:'a',x:0,y:0},{key:'b',x:60,y:0}];
  assert.equal(clusterProjectedStops(large).length,1);
  assert.equal(clusterProjectedStops(small).length,2);
});

test('neighboring points cluster across arbitrary grid boundaries but not into one long chain',()=>{
  const grouped=clusterProjectedStops([{key:'left',x:0,y:0},{key:'center',x:35,y:0},{key:'right',x:70,y:0}],39);
  assert.equal(grouped.length,2);
  assert.deepEqual(grouped[0].keys,['left','center']);
  assert.deepEqual(grouped[1].keys,['right']);
  const acrossBoundary=clusterProjectedStops([{key:'a',x:38,y:38},{key:'b',x:41,y:41}],39);
  assert.equal(acrossBoundary.length,1);
});

test('spiderfied offsets are distinct and keep temporary pins away from the cluster center',()=>{
  const offsets = Array.from({length:32},(_,i)=>spiderfyOffset(i));
  assert.equal(new Set(offsets.map(pos=>pos.join(','))).size,offsets.length);
  assert.ok(offsets.every(([x,y])=>Math.hypot(x,y)>=40));
});

test('map layer clusters only saved stop visuals, never route geometry or itinerary',()=>{
  const map=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'components/builder/TripPlanner/RouteMapInner.tsx'),'utf8');
  const itinerary=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'components/builder/TripPlanner/DayStopsItinerary.tsx'),'utf8');
  assert.match(map,/<StopMarkerLayer points=\{points\}/);
  assert.match(map,/clusterProjectedStops\(/);
  assert.match(map,/map\.project\(/);
  assert.match(map,/spiderfyOffset\(/);
  assert.match(map,/zIndexOffset=\{selected \? 1500/);
  assert.match(map,/isSharedOvernightStop\(point, next\)/);
  assert.match(map,/<Polyline key=\{trail \? "mapped" : "direct"\}/);
  assert.match(itinerary,/DayStopsItinerary/);
});

test('changed TS and TSX have no syntax errors',()=>{
  for (const rel of ['lib/route-marker-clustering.ts','lib/waypoint-map.ts','components/builder/TripPlanner/RouteMapInner.tsx']) {
    const compiled=ts.transpileModule(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,rel),'utf8'),{fileName:rel,reportDiagnostics:true,compilerOptions:{target:ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022,module:ts.ModuleKind.ESNext,jsx:ts.JsxEmit.ReactJSX}});
```

```typescript
const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');

function renderedMarker(kind, selected, size) {

}
```

### `tests/route-metrics.test.mjs`

```typescript
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { computeRouteMetrics } from "../lib/route-metrics.ts";
import { parseRouteResponse, validTrailSegment, usableTrailSegment } from "../lib/trail-routing.ts";

const a = [49.2, -123.2], b = [49.21, -123.19], c = [49.22, -123.18], d = [49.23, -123.17];
const waypoint = (id, coords, dayId = "day1") => ({id, name:id, lat:coords[0], lng:coords[1], elevationM:null, kind:"waypoint", dayId});
function leg(toId, start, end, distanceM, elevationsM, ascentM = 100, descentM = 25) {
  return {toId,geometry:[start,end],distanceM,elevationsM,ascentM,descentM,source:"openrouteservice"};
}

test("full trail metrics combine real ORS distances and ascent, with adjustable pace", () => {
  const points = [waypoint("a",a),waypoint("b",b),waypoint("c",c)];
  points[0].trailToNext = leg("b",a,b,2000,[100,190],120,30);
  points[1].trailToNext = leg("c",b,c,3000,[190,290],180,50);
  const data = computeRouteMetrics(points,[{id:"day1"}], 4);
  assert.equal(data.distanceM,5000);
  assert.equal(data.routedDistanceM,5000);
  assert.equal(data.straightLineDistanceM,0);
  assert.equal(data.ascentM,300);
  assert.equal(data.descentM,80);
  assert.equal(data.estimatedMinutes,105); // 5km /4km/h + 300m/600m/h
  assert.equal(data.dayMetrics[0].estimatedMinutes,105);
  assert.equal(data.profileSections.length,2);
  assert.equal(data.profileSections[0].at(-1).distanceM,2000);
  assert.equal(data.profileSections[1].at(-1).distanceM,5000);
  assert.equal(computeRouteMetrics(points,[],2).estimatedMinutes,180);
});

test("manual lines are explicitly lower bounds and cannot create fake ascent or full route estimates", () => {
  const points = [waypoint("a",a),waypoint("b",b),waypoint("c",c, "day2")];
  points[0].trailToNext = leg("b",a,b,2200,[80,110],55,15);
  points[1].manualToNext = true;
  const data = computeRouteMetrics(points,[{id:"day1"},{id:"day2"}]);
  assert.equal(data.routedDistanceM,2200);
  assert.equal(data.unroutedSegments,1);
  assert.ok(data.straightLineDistanceM > 0);
  assert.equal(data.ascentM,null);
  assert.equal(data.estimatedMinutes,null);
  assert.equal(data.knownAscentM,55);
  assert.equal(data.profileSections.length,1);
  assert.equal(data.dayMetrics[0].segments,1);
  assert.equal(data.dayMetrics[1].segments,0);
  assert.equal(data.unassignedDaySegments,1);
});

test("missing provider totals are estimated from complete saved elevation samples", () => {
  const points = [waypoint("a",a),waypoint("b",b)];
  points[0].trailToNext = {toId:"b",geometry:[a,b],elevationsM:[0,250],distanceM:2500,source:"openrouteservice"};
  const data = computeRouteMetrics(points,[{id:"day1"}]);
  assert.equal(data.profileSections.length,1);
  assert.equal(data.elevationSegments,1);
  assert.equal(data.climbedSegments,1);
  assert.equal(data.sampleDerivedSegments,1);
  assert.equal(data.ascentM,250);
  assert.equal(data.descentM,0);
  assert.ok(data.dayMetrics[0].estimatedMinutes > 0);
  assert.equal(data.dayMetrics[0].sampleDerivedSegments,1);
});

test("legacy trail segments remain usable, but do not claim an elevation profile", () => {
  const points = [waypoint("a",a),waypoint("b",b)];
  points[0].trailToNext = {toId:"b",geometry:[a,b],distanceM:2500,source:"openrouteservice"};
  const data = computeRouteMetrics(points);
  assert.equal(data.routedDistanceM,2500);
  assert.equal(data.elevationSegments,0);
  assert.equal(data.ascentM,null);
  assert.equal(data.routedEstimateMinutes,38); // 2.5km at new default 4 km/h (no ascent data)
});

test("bad route elevations are rejected, and a moved stop invalidates cached altitude", () => {
  const old = leg("b",a,b,2300,[150,200]);
  assert.equal(validTrailSegment(old),true);
  assert.equal(validTrailSegment({...old,elevationsM:[150]}),false);
  assert.equal(validTrailSegment({...old,elevationsM:[150,Number.NaN]}),false);
  assert.equal(validTrailSegment({...old,elevationsM:[150,12000]}),false);
  assert.equal(validTrailSegment({...old,ascentM:-1}),false);
  assert.equal(validTrailSegment({...old,descentM:undefined}),false);
  assert.equal(usableTrailSegment({...waypoint("a",a),trailToNext:old},{...waypoint("b",b),lat:50}),null);
});

test("3D ORS coordinates and summary are parsed, while 2D ORS routes still work", () => {
  const response = {features:[{geometry:{type:"LineString",coordinates:[
    [a[1],a[0],0],[b[1],b[0],150]
  ]},properties:{summary:{distance:3300,ascent:170,descent:20}}}]};
  const parsed = parseRouteResponse(response,a,b);
  assert.deepEqual(parsed,{geometry:[a,b],distanceM:3300,elevationsM:[0,150],ascentM:170,descentM:20});
  assert.equal(validTrailSegment({toId:"b",...parsed,source:"openrouteservice"}),true);
  const invalidElevation = structuredClone(response);
  invalidElevation.features[0].geometry.coordinates[1][2] = null;
  assert.deepEqual(parseRouteResponse(invalidElevation,a,b),{geometry:[a,b],distanceM:3300});
  const missingSummary = structuredClone(response);
  delete missingSummary.features[0].properties.summary.ascent;
  const partial = parseRouteResponse(missingSummary,a,b);
  assert.deepEqual(partial.elevationsM,[0,150]);
  assert.equal(partial.ascentM,undefined);
});

test("simplification keeps matching sampled elevations and both route endpoints", () => {
  const coords = Array.from({length:900},(_,i)=>[a[1] + i / 200000,a[0] + i / 200000,
    100 + Math.sin(i / 30)*200]);
  const response = {features:[{geometry:{type:"LineString",coordinates:coords},properties:{summary:{distance:18000,ascent:1900,descent:1800}}}]};
  const start = [coords[0][1],coords[0][0]], end = [coords.at(-1)[1],coords.at(-1)[0]];
  const result = parseRouteResponse(response,start,end);
  assert.ok(result && result.geometry.length <= 400);
  assert.equal(result.geometry.length,result.elevationsM.length);
  assert.equal(result.elevationsM[0],Number(coords[0][2].toFixed(1)));
  assert.equal(result.elevationsM.at(-1),Number(coords.at(-1)[2].toFixed(1)));
  assert.equal(result.ascentM,1900);
  assert.equal(validTrailSegment({toId:"b",...result,source:"openrouteservice"}),true);
});

test("invalid hiking speeds are rejected",()=>{
  assert.throws(()=>computeRouteMetrics([],[],0),RangeError);
  assert.throws(()=>computeRouteMetrics([],[],Number.NaN),RangeError);
  assert.throws(()=>computeRouteMetrics([],[],9),RangeError);
});

test("vertical elevation peaks survive simplification of a nearly straight mapped route", () => {
  const coordinates = Array.from({length:900},(_,i)=>[
    -123 + i / 100000,
    49 + i / 100000,
    100 + 700 * Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(i-449)/449),
  ]);
  const response = {features:[{geometry:{type:"LineString",coordinates},properties:{summary:{distance:2500,ascent:700,descent:700}}}]};
  const start = [coordinates[0][1],coordinates[0][0]], end = [coordinates.at(-1)[1],coordinates.at(-1)[0]];
  const parsed = parseRouteResponse(response,start,end);
  assert.ok(parsed.elevationsM.length <= 400);
  assert.ok(Math.max(...parsed.elevationsM) > 795, "The summit must not be erased by XY-only decimation");
});
```
