### `tests/route-refresh-autosave-v083.test.cjs`

```typescript
const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const Module = require('node:module');
const path = require('node:path');
const ts = require('typescript');
const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');

function harness(saveBehavior = async () => {}) {
  const saved = [];
  const hooks = [];
  const timers = new Map();
  const formHandlers = new Map();
  const windowHandlers = new Map();
  const form = {
    fields: new Map([['buildId','trip-1'], ['notes','initial']]),
    checkValidity: () => true,
    addEventListener: (name, fn) => formHandlers.set(name, fn),
    removeEventListener: (name) => formHandlers.delete(name),
    emit: (name) => formHandlers.get(name)?.(),
  };
  class FakeFormData {
    constructor(source) { this.fields = new Map(source?.fields ?? []); }
    entries() { return this.fields.entries(); }
    forEach(fn) { this.fields.forEach((value,key) => fn(value,key)); }
    append(key,value) { this.fields.set(key,value); }
    set(key,value) { this.fields.set(key,value); }
    get(key) { return this.fields.get(key) ?? null; }
  }
  class FakeObserver {
    constructor(cb) { this.cb = cb; observer = this; }
    observe() {}
    disconnect() {}
    fire() { this.cb([{type:'attributes'}]); }
  }
  let observer;
  const original = {
    FormData: global.FormData, MutationObserver: global.MutationObserver,
    window: global.window, setTimeout: global.setTimeout, clearTimeout: global.clearTimeout,
  };
  global.FormData = FakeFormData;
  global.MutationObserver = FakeObserver;
  global.window = {
    addEventListener: (name, fn) => windowHandlers.set(name,fn),
    removeEventListener: (name) => windowHandlers.delete(name),
  };
  global.setTimeout = fn => { const id = Symbol(); timers.set(id,fn); return id; };
  global.clearTimeout = id => { timers.delete(id); };
  const react = {
    useRef: (() => {let n=0; return (initial) => ({current:n++===0?form:initial});})(),
    useEffect: fn => hooks.push(fn),
  };
  const saveStatus = { clearBuildDirty:()=>{},failBuildSave:()=>{},markBuildDirty:()=>{} };
  const originalLoad = Module._load;
  Module._load = function(request, parent, main) {
    if (request === 'react') return react;
    if (request === '@/lib/build-save-status') return saveStatus;
    return originalLoad.call(this,request,parent,main);
  };
  let hook;
  try {
    const source = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT,'lib/use-build-autosave.ts'),'utf8');
    const output = ts.transpileModule(source,{compilerOptions:{module:ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS,target:ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022},reportDiagnostics:true});
    assert.equal(output.diagnostics?.filter(d=>d.category===ts.DiagnosticCategory.Error).length??0,0);
    const loadedModule = new Module(path.join(ROOT,'lib/use-build-autosave.ts'),module);
    loadedModule.filename = path.join(ROOT,'lib/use-build-autosave.ts');
    loadedModule.paths = Module._nodeModulePaths(ROOT);
    loadedModule._compile(output.outputText,loadedModule.filename);
    hook = loadedModule.exports.useBuildAutosave({buildId:'trip-1',resource:'logistics',save:async data=>{ saved.push(new Map(data.entries())); await saveBehavior(); }});
  } finally { Module._load = originalLoad; }
  const cleanups = hooks.map(fn => fn()).filter(Boolean);
  return {
    hook,form,saved,timers,
    observe:()=>observer.fire(),
    flush:async()=>{const pending=[...timers.values()];timers.clear();for(const fn of pending) fn();for(let i=0;i<8;i++)await Promise.resolve();},
    cleanup:()=>{for(const fn of cleanups.reverse())fn();for(const [key,val] of Object.entries(original)) global[key]=val;},
  };
}

test('hydration/server input-attribute updates do not launch a save or flush on unmount',async()=>{
  const h=harness();
  try {
    h.form.fields.set('notes','server-rendered');h.observe();
    assert.equal(h.timers.size,0);
    assert.equal(h.saved.length,0);
  } finally {h.cleanup();}
  assert.equal(h.saved.length,0);
});

test('real user typing still autosaves, without subsequent server refresh echo saves',async()=>{
  const h=harness();
  try {
    h.form.fields.set('notes','typed');h.form.emit('input');
    assert.equal(h.timers.size,1);
    await h.flush();
    assert.equal(h.saved.length,1);
    assert.equal(h.saved[0].get('notes'),'typed');
    h.form.fields.set('notes','new server props');h.observe();
    assert.equal(h.timers.size,0);
    assert.equal(h.saved.length,1);
  } finally {h.cleanup();}
});

test('server-prop changes during an in-flight save do not trigger another save',async()=>{
  let release;
  const h=harness(() => new Promise(resolve=>{ release=resolve; }));
  try {
    h.form.fields.set('notes','typed'); h.form.emit('input');
    await h.flush();
    assert.equal(h.saved.length,1);
    // Simulates a server revalidation writing canonical values into the form.
    h.form.fields.set('notes','server-canonical'); h.observe();
    assert.equal(h.timers.size,1);
    release();
    for(let i=0;i<12;i++) await Promise.resolve();
    assert.equal(h.timers.size,0);
    assert.equal(h.saved.length,1);
  } finally {h.cleanup();}
});

test('explicit destination-picker confirmation can still autosave hidden field updates',async()=>{
  const h=harness();
  try {
    h.hook.markUserEdit();
    h.form.fields.set('destinationId','new-destination');h.observe();
    assert.equal(h.timers.size,1);
    await h.flush();
    assert.equal(h.saved.length,1);
    assert.equal(h.saved[0].get('destinationId'),'new-destination');
  } finally {h.cleanup();}
});

test('manual Save action works without a prior input event',async()=>{
  const h=harness();
  try {
    const data=new FormData();data.set('buildId','trip-1');data.set('notes','manual');
    await h.hook.saveNow(data);
    assert.equal(h.saved.length,1);
    assert.equal(h.saved[0].get('notes'),'manual');
  } finally {h.cleanup();}
});

test('TripEditForm marks destination selection as intentional before changing hidden fields',()=>{
  const source=fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT,'components/builder/TripPlanner/TripEditForm.tsx'),'utf8');
  const pos=source.indexOf('autosave.markUserEdit();');
  assert.ok(pos>0);
  assert.ok(pos<source.indexOf('setDestination(next);'));
});

### `tests/route-shaping.test.mjs`

```typescript
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import {
  validShapingWaypoints, shapingInsertIndex, shapingInsertPositions,
  MAX_ROUTE_SHAPING_WAYPOINTS,
} from '../lib/route-shaping.ts';

const contents = (file) => readFileSync(new URL(`../${file}`, import.meta.url), 'utf8');
const from = [49, -123];
const to = [49.02, -123];
const middle = [49.01, -123];

test('validates bounded shaping coordinates separately from saved stops', () => {
  assert.equal(validShapingWaypoints([middle]), true);
  assert.equal(validShapingWaypoints([]), true);
  assert.equal(validShapingWaypoints(Array(MAX_ROUTE_SHAPING_WAYPOINTS + 1).fill(middle)), false);
  assert.equal(validShapingWaypoints([[92, -123]]), false);
  assert.equal(validShapingWaypoints([[49, NaN]]), false);
  assert.equal(validShapingWaypoints([[49, -123, 17]]), false);
  assert.equal(validShapingWaypoints('fake'), false);
});

test('places a new insertion control in EACH stretch and correctly orders insertions', () => {
  const path = [from, middle, to];
  const controls = shapingInsertPositions(path, [middle]);
  assert.equal(controls.length, 2);
  assert.ok(controls[0][0] > 49.004 && controls[0][0] < 49.006);
  assert.ok(controls[1][0] > 49.014 && controls[1][0] < 49.016);
  assert.equal(shapingInsertIndex(path, [middle], [49.004, -123]), 0);
  assert.equal(shapingInsertIndex(path, [middle], [49.016, -123]), 1);
});

test('follows rendered trail geometry, not a straight-line midpoint', () => {
  const routed = [[0, 0], [0.02, 0], [0.02, 0.01]];
  const [insert] = shapingInsertPositions(routed, []);
  assert.ok(insert[0] > 0.014 && insert[0] < 0.016);
  assert.equal(insert[1], 0);
  assert.deepEqual(shapingInsertPositions([], []), []);
  assert.deepEqual(shapingInsertPositions([[0, 0], [0, 0]], []), []);
});

test('shaping waypoint controls only render when editing, unlike saved stop markers', () => {
  const map = contents('components/builder/TripPlanner/RouteMapInner.tsx');
  const route = contents('components/builder/TripPlanner/TripRoute.tsx');
  assert.match(route, /onMoveVia=\{canEdit && !pending \? moveShapingWaypoint : undefined\}/);
  assert.match(route, /onInsert=\{canEdit && !pending && !placing && snappingCount === 0 \? insertShapingWaypoint : undefined\}/);
  assert.match(map, /\{onMoveVia && via\.map\(/);
  assert.match(map, /shapingWaypointIcon/);
  assert.match(map, /<StopMarkerLayer points=\{points\}/);
  assert.match(route, /return \{ \.\.\.point, viaToNext, trailToNext: undefined \}/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(route, /function insertStop\(/);
});

test('persists shaping coordinates as segment metadata; routing request uses intermediates', () => {
  const model = contents('lib/trip-planner.ts');
  const serializer = contents('lib/waypoint-map.ts');
  const server = contents('app/api/trails/route/route.ts');
  const client = contents('components/builder/TripPlanner/TripRoute.tsx');
  assert.match(model, /viaToNext\?: LatLng\[\]/);
  assert.match(model, /validShapingWaypoints\(p\.viaToNext\)/);
  assert.match(serializer, /viaToNext: point\.viaToNext\.map\(/);
  assert.match(server, /validShapingWaypoints\(rawVia\)/);
  assert.match(server, /\[body\.from!, \.\.\.via, body\.to!\]/);
  assert.match(client, /via: from\.viaToNext \?\? \[\]/);
  assert.match(client, /form\.set\("waypoints", JSON\.stringify\(route\)\)/);
});

### `tests/stop-time-picker-v058.test.cjs`

```typescript
const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const vm = require('node:vm');
const ts = require('typescript');

const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const file = path.join(root, 'components/builder/TripPlanner/StopTimePicker.tsx');
const parent = path.join(root, 'components/builder/TripPlanner/DayStopsItinerary.tsx');
const source = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
const parentSource = fs.readFileSync(parent, 'utf8');

// Exercise the component's real conversion helpers without requiring a DOM.
const start = source.indexOf('function parseTime(');
const end = source.indexOf('export default function StopTimePicker(');
assert.ok(start > 0 && end > start, 'Could not locate time conversion helpers');
const helpers = source.slice(start, end) + '\nmodule.exports = {parseTime, timeLabel, timeValue};';
const {outputText, diagnostics} = ts.transpileModule(helpers, {
  fileName: 'time-functions.ts',
  compilerOptions: { target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2020, module: ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS },
  reportDiagnostics: true,
});
assert.equal(diagnostics.length, 0, 'Time conversion helpers should parse');
const sandbox = {module: {exports: {}}};
vm.runInNewContext(outputText, sandbox);
const {parseTime, timeLabel, timeValue} = sandbox.module.exports;

test('custom picker converts all valid 24-hour values losslessly', () => {
  for (let hours=0; hours<24; hours++) for(let minutes=0; minutes<60; minutes++) {
    const raw = `${String(hours).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(minutes).padStart(2,'0')}`;
    assert.equal(timeValue(parseTime(raw)), raw);
  }
  assert.equal(timeLabel(parseTime('00:00')), '12:00 AM');
  assert.equal(timeLabel(parseTime('12:00')), '12:00 PM');
  assert.equal(timeLabel(parseTime('22:26')), '10:26 PM');
  assert.equal(timeLabel(parseTime('23:59')), '11:59 PM');
});

test('empty and malformed stop times stay unset', () => {
  for (const val of [null, undefined, '', '24:00', '01:60', '9:30', '25:61', 'text']) {
    assert.equal(parseTime(val), null);
  }
});

test('only custom time picker is used by the itinerary editor', () => {
  assert.match(parentSource, /import StopTimePicker from "\.\/StopTimePicker"/);
  assert.match(parentSource, /<StopTimePicker[\s\S]*?value=\{point\.time\}[\s\S]*?onChange=\{\(time\) => route\.updateStop\(point\.id, \{ time \}\)\}/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(parentSource, /type="time"/);
  assert.match(source, /createPortal\(/);
  assert.match(source, /aria-haspopup="dialog"/);
  assert.match(source, /Clear time/);
  assert.match(source, /onChange\(null\)/);
  assert.match(source, /onClick=\{commit\}/);
  assert.match(source, /event\.key === "Escape"/);
});

test('both edited TSX files compile without syntax diagnostics', () => {
  for (const name of [file, parent]) {
    const result = ts.transpileModule(fs.readFileSync(name, 'utf8'), {
      fileName: name,
      compilerOptions: { target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2020, jsx: ts.JsxEmit.ReactJSX, module: ts.ModuleKind.ESNext },
      reportDiagnostics: true,
    });
    assert.deepEqual(result.diagnostics.map(item=>ts.flattenDiagnosticMessageText(item.messageText, ' ')), [], path.basename(name));
  }
});

### `tests/terrain-compact-v051.test.cjs`

```typescript
const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { notableTerrainFindings } = require('../lib/terrain-gradient-summary.ts');
const panel = fs.readFileSync(path.resolve(__dirname, '../components/builder/TripPlanner/RouteElevationPanel.tsx'), 'utf8');
const slope = (direction, dayId, startM, endM, gradePct = 12) => ({
  direction, dayId, startM, endM, gradePct, gainM: Math.abs(endM - startM) * Math.abs(gradePct) / 100,
});

test('repeated hardest and longest climb is one finding with a combined label', () => {
  const hardest = slope('climb','day-1', 740, 2720, 13.3);
  const longest = { ...hardest };
  const result = notableTerrainFindings(hardest, longest, null);
  assert.equal(result.length, 1);
  assert.equal(result[0].title, 'Hardest & longest steep climb');
  assert.equal(result[0].slope, hardest);
});

test('distinct notable climb intervals remain separate, including descent', () => {
  const hardest = slope('climb','one',100,700);
  const longest = slope('climb','one',1100,2200);
  const descent = slope('descent','two',2800,3600, -12);
  const result = notableTerrainFindings(hardest,longest,descent);
  assert.equal(result.length,3);
  assert.deepEqual(result.map(x=>x.title), ['Hardest sustained climb','Longest sustained steep climb','Hardest sustained descent']);
});

test('equal start/end but different day or direction are not incorrectly deduplicated', () => {
  const first=slope('climb','one',0,600);
  const otherDay=slope('climb','two',0,600);
  assert.equal(notableTerrainFindings(first,otherDay,null).length,2);
});

test('absent slopes do not produce misleading empty placeholder cards', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(notableTerrainFindings(null,null,null), []);
});

test('notable climbs stay in Route Analysis and the gradient bars move to the map', () => {

  assert.match(dock, /aria-label="Gradient legend"/);

 for(const item of ['aria-label="Hiking time and breaks"','estimateBreaks(dayMoving[i], breaks)','classicNaismithMinutes'])assert.ok(panel.includes(item),`missing ${item}`);
 assert.doesNotMatch(panel,/Daily hiking analysis|Plan your hiking days|How reliable is this analysis/);

### `tests/terrain-gradient-v047.test.cjs`

```typescript
const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { analyzeTerrain } = require('../lib/route-analysis-insights.ts');
const { summarizeGradient } = require('../lib/terrain-gradient-summary.ts');
const source = (name) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, '../components/builder/TripPlanner/', name), 'utf8');
const p = (distanceM, elevationM) => ({distanceM, elevationM});

test('gradient split distinguishes ascent, descent, and near-level terrain', () => {
  const result = summarizeGradient([
    {startM:0,endM:200,gradePct:3,band:'gentle',dayId:'a'},
    {startM:200,endM:400,gradePct:9,band:'moderate',dayId:'a'},
    {startM:400,endM:600,gradePct:15,band:'steep',dayId:'a'},
    {startM:600,endM:800,gradePct:-2,band:'gentle',dayId:'a'},
    {startM:800,endM:1000,gradePct:-9,band:'moderate',dayId:'a'},
    {startM:1000,endM:1200,gradePct:-13,band:'steep',dayId:'a'},
    {startM:1200,endM:1400,gradePct:0.3,band:'gentle',dayId:'a'},
  ]);
  assert.equal(result.analyzedM,1400);
  assert.equal(result.uphill.totalM,600);
  assert.equal(result.downhill.totalM,600);
  assert.equal(result.levelM,200);
  assert.deepEqual([result.uphill.gentleM,result.uphill.moderateM,result.uphill.steepM],[200,200,200]);
  assert.deepEqual([result.downhill.gentleM,result.downhill.moderateM,result.downhill.steepM],[200,200,200]);
});

test('longest sustained climb requires >= 500 m at >= 8% without crossing gaps or days', () => {
  const c=(a,b,g,d='one')=>({startM:a,endM:b,gradePct:g,band:g>=12?'steep':'moderate',dayId:d});
  const result=summarizeGradient([c(0,200,9),c(200,400,9),c(400,600,9),
     c(600,800,2),c(800,1000,10),c(1000,1200,10),
     c(1500,1700,10),c(1700,1900,10),c(1900,2100,10),c(2100,2300,10,'two')]);
  assert.equal(result.longestSteepClimb.startM,0);
  assert.equal(result.longestSteepClimb.endM,600);
  assert.equal(result.longestSteepClimb.gainM,54);
  assert.equal(result.longestSteepClimb.dayId,'one');
  assert.equal(summarizeGradient([c(0,200,9),c(200,400,9)]).longestSteepClimb,null);
});

test('existing terrain window gap handling is retained', () => {
  const sections=[[p(0,600),p(100,615),p(200,630),p(300,645),p(400,660),p(500,675),p(600,690)],
    [p(1800,700),p(2600,900)]];
  const existing=analyzeTerrain(sections,['a','b']);
  assert.equal(existing.analyzedDistanceM,600);
  assert.equal(summarizeGradient(existing.cells).analyzedM,600);
  assert.equal(summarizeGradient(existing.cells).longestSteepClimb.endM,600);
});

test('route analysis uses one gradient report, no duplicated elevation chart', () => {
  const panel=source('RouteElevationPanel.tsx');
  const route=source('TripRoute.tsx');
  const section=source('RouteAnalysisSection.tsx');
  const dock=source('RouteProfileDock.tsx');
  assert.match(panel, /id="route-notable-terrain"/);
  assert.match(panel, /Notable climbs & descents/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(panel, /Gradient distribution|Uphill distance|Downhill distance/);
  assert.match(dock, /aria-label="Gradient legend"/);
  assert.match(dock, /terrainStrokes.map/);
  assert.match(panel, /Locate on map/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(panel, /<ProfileChart|Detailed elevation & gradient analysis|route-elevation-detail/);
  assert.match(section, /onInspectTerrain=\{onInspectTerrain\}/);
  assert.match(route, /function inspectTerrainSection\(section: SustainedSlope\)/);
  assert.match(route, /locationAtDistance\(explorer, midpoint\)/);
  assert.match(route, /setElevationOpen\(true\)/);
  assert.match(dock, /focusedRange &&/);

test('time and breaks remain while daily schedules move to itinerary', () => {

### `tests/trail-routing.test.mjs`

```typescript
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import {
  validLatLng, metersBetween, parseSnapResponse, parseRouteResponse,
  usableTrailSegment, validTrailSegment, simplifyTrail,
} from "../lib/trail-routing.ts";

const a = [49.2801, -123.1207];
const b = [49.2821, -123.1187];

test("validates trail coordinates and distance", () => {
  assert.equal(validLatLng(a), true);
  assert.equal(validLatLng([91, 0]), false);
  assert.equal(validLatLng([49, Number.NaN]), false);
  assert.ok(metersBetween(a, b) > 0);
  assert.equal(metersBetween(a, a), 0);
});

test("snapping never accepts results outside the configured 75m radius", () => {
  const response = { locations: [{ location: [a[1], a[0]], snapped_distance: 12 }] };
  assert.deepEqual(parseSnapResponse(response), { point: a, distanceM: 12 });
  assert.equal(parseSnapResponse({ locations: [null] }), null);
  assert.equal(parseSnapResponse({ locations: [{ location: [a[1], a[0]], snapped_distance: 150 }] }), null);
});

test("valid routing preserves geometry and rejects mismatched endpoints", () => {
  const middle = [49.2813, -123.121];
  const response = { features: [{ geometry: { type: "LineString", coordinates: [a, middle, b].map(([lat, lng]) => [lng, lat]) }, properties: { summary: { distance: 575 } } }] };
  const result = parseRouteResponse(response, a, b);
  assert.deepEqual(result?.geometry, [a, middle, b]);
  assert.equal(result?.distanceM, 575);
  const segment = { toId: "b", geometry: result.geometry, distanceM: 575, source: "openrouteservice" };
  assert.equal(validTrailSegment(segment), true);
  assert.deepEqual(usableTrailSegment({ id: "a", lat: a[0], lng: a[1], trailToNext: segment }, { id: "b", lat: b[0], lng: b[1] }), segment);
  assert.equal(usableTrailSegment({ id: "a", lat: a[0], lng: a[1], trailToNext: segment }, { id: "c", lat: b[0], lng: b[1] }), null);
  assert.equal(usableTrailSegment({ id: "a", lat: 50, lng: a[1], trailToNext: segment }, { id: "b", lat: b[0], lng: b[1] }), null);
  assert.equal(parseRouteResponse(response, [40, 10], b), null);
});

test("keeps both route endpoints when simplifying a long track", () => {
  const many = Array.from({ length: 900 }, (_, index) => [49 + index / 10000, -123 + Math.sin(index / 15) / 500]);
  const simplified = simplifyTrail(many, 150);
  assert.ok(simplified.length <= 150);
  assert.deepEqual(simplified[0], many[0]);
  assert.deepEqual(simplified[simplified.length - 1], many[many.length - 1]);
});

```

import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { parseResourceAnnotation, readPrivateResources, validatePrivateResources, calculateWaterLegs } from "../lib/trip-resources.ts";
import { csvCell, exportCampsitesCsv, exportLogisticsCsv, exportPackCsv, escapeHtml, printableTripHtml } from "../lib/trip-resources-export.ts";
const stop = (id,name,kind,lat) => ({ id,name,kind,lat,lng:-123.1,elevationM:null });
const routed = (from,to,distance=3500) => ({ toId:to.id,geometry:[[from.lat,from.lng],[to.lat,to.lng]],elevationsM:[50,250],ascentM:200,descentM:0,distanceM:distance,source:"gpx" });

test("resource metadata rejects embedded booking fields, invalid links, bad reliability and lengths",()=>{
  assert.deepEqual(parseResourceAnnotation({ detail:"  bear locker  ",waterReliability:"unknown" }),{ detail:"bear locker",waterReliability:"unknown" });
  assert.throws(()=>parseResourceAnnotation({ confirmation:"SECRET" }),/Unsupported/);
  assert.throws(()=>parseResourceAnnotation({ sourceUrl:"javascript:alert(1)" }),/HTTPS/);
  assert.throws(()=>parseResourceAnnotation({ waterReliability:"certain" }),/reliability/);
  assert.throws(()=>parseResourceAnnotation({ detail:"x".repeat(751) }),/Invalid/);
});

test("bookings are private and strict validation rejects missing and unrelated day/stop IDs",()=>{
  const row = { id:"book1",waypointId:"camp1",dayId:"d1",campground:"Ridge Camp",status:"confirmed",arrival:"2026-11-11",departure:"2026-11-12",provider:"Parks",confirmation:"A0001",notes:"Bring permit" };
  const p = { settings:{rateLph:0.5,reserveL:1,capacityL:3},bookings:[row] };
  assert.equal(validatePrivateResources(p,["d1"],["camp1"]).bookings[0].confirmation,"A0001");
  assert.equal(readPrivateResources({phase6:p}).bookings[0].confirmation,"A0001");
  assert.deepEqual(readPrivateResources(null).bookings,[]);
  assert.throws(()=>validatePrivateResources(p,[],["camp1"]),/removed trip day/);
  assert.throws(()=>validatePrivateResources(p,["d1"],[]),/removed campsite/);
  assert.throws(()=>validatePrivateResources({...p,bookings:[row,row]},["d1"],["camp1"]),/Duplicate/);
  assert.throws(()=>validatePrivateResources({...p,settings:{...p.settings,rateLph:100}},["d1"],["camp1"]),/rateLph/);
});

test("water legs use routed distance, ascent and only user-marked refills",()=>{
  const a=stop("a","Trailhead","trailhead",49.1), b=stop("b","Stream","water",49.11), c=stop("c","Camp","camp",49.12);
  a.trailToNext=routed(a,b); b.trailToNext=routed(b,c);
  b.resource={waterReliability:"seasonal",refillConfirmed:false};
  const setting={rateLph:0.6,reserveL:1,capacityL:2};
  assert.equal(calculateWaterLegs([a,b,c],setting).length,1);
  b.resource.refillConfirmed=true;
  const legs=calculateWaterLegs([a,b,c],setting);
  assert.equal(legs.length,2);
  assert.ok(legs[0].requiredL > 1);
  assert.equal(legs[0].distanceKm,3.5);
  assert.equal(legs[1].from,"Stream");
  assert.equal(calculateWaterLegs([a,b,c],{...setting,capacityL:1})[0].exceedsCapacity,true);
  a.manualToNext=true;
  assert.equal(calculateWaterLegs([a,b,c],setting)[0].requiredL,null);
  b.resource.waterReliability="unavailable";
  assert.equal(calculateWaterLegs([a,b,c],setting).length,1);
});

const sample=()=>({ name:"<Forest & Lake>", days:[{ id:"d1",date:new Date("2026-11-11"),startLocation:"Trailhead",endLocation:"Camp",distanceKm:7,elevationGainM:250,durationMinutes:180,notes:"<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>" }],points:[{...stop("c","=Danger", "camp",49.1),dayId:"d1",resource:{detail:"See <note>"}}], logistics:{ permits:"code",reservations:"ABC",transportation:"Car",parking:"At start",emergencyContact:"PRIVATE",emergencyPlan:"SECRET",notes:"Enjoy" }, bookings:[{id:"b1",waypointId:"c",dayId:"d1",campground:"=Harmful",status:"confirmed",arrival:"",departure:"",provider:"BC Parks",confirmation:"SECRET123",notes:"private"}],packLines:[{name:"Tent",category:"Shelter",quantity:1,gramsEach:800,grams:800,weightClass:"base"}] });
test("CSV injection is neutralized, private references excluded by default",()=>{

  assert.match(exportPackCsv(sample()),/Tent/);

import assert from "node:assert/strict";

import { forecastHints, tripDayForecast, comparePlan } from "../lib/weather/presentation";
import type { WeatherResult } from "../lib/weather/service";
const now=Date.parse("2026-10-25T12:00:00Z");
const dates=[0,1,2,3,4,5].map(h=>new Date(now+h*3600000).toISOString());
const schedule=(model:(typeof MODELS)[number],times:string[]):Schedule=>({model,run:new Date(now).toISOString(),times});
test("HRDPS is chosen ahead of RDPS, GDPS at same valid time",()=>{
  const schedules=MODELS.map(m=>schedule(m,dates));
  assert.deepEqual(modelPriority(dates[2],schedules,now).map(s=>s.model.id),["HRDPS","RDPS","GDPS"]);
});

  const times=chooseTimes([schedule(MODELS[0],[dates[0],dates[2],dates[5]])],"UTC","",now);
  assert.deepEqual(times,[dates[0],dates[2],dates[5]]);
});
test("waypoint model summary only computes sampled extrema",()=>{
  const hour=(time:string,temp:number):ModelHour=>({time,temperature:temp,wind:36,gust:null,pop:null,condition:"Model sample",model:"HRDPS",resolutionKm:2.5,run:new Date(now).toISOString(),sampled:true});
  const hs=[hour(dates[0],-2),hour(dates[2],8)];

  const data={query:{zone:"UTC"},hourly:hs,daily:[day],forecastStale:false} as WeatherResult;
  const fc=tripDayForecast(data,"2026-10-25");
  assert.equal(fc?.low,-2);
  assert.ok(forecastHints(fc!).some(h=>h.includes("insulation")));
  assert.equal(comparePlan(fc!,{minTemperature:2,conditions:"dry"}).length,1);
  assert.equal(tripDayForecast({...data,forecastStale:true},"2026-10-25"),null);
  assert.equal(tripDayForecast(data,"2027-01-01"),null);
});

### `tools/generate-docs.ts`

````typescript
import {
  existsSync,
  lstatSync,
  readFileSync,
  readdirSync,
  statSync,
  writeFileSync,
} from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import process from 'node:process';

interface Config {
  output: string;
  includeExtensions: string[];
  ignoreDirs: string[];
  ignoreFiles: string[];
  maxFileBytes: number;
  includeLockfiles: boolean;
  includeHiddenFiles: boolean;
}

interface FileEntry {
  absPath: string;
  relPath: string;
  ext: string;
  bytes: number;
  lines: number;
  text?: string;
  skippedReason?: string;
}

interface ImportLink {
  from: string;
  raw: string;
  resolved: string | null;
}

const DEFAULT_CONFIG: Config = {
  output: 'PROJECT_CONTEXT.md',
  includeExtensions: [
    '.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx', '.mjs', '.cjs',
    '.json', '.jsonc', '.md', '.mdx', '.css', '.scss', '.html',
    '.yaml', '.yml', '.toml', '.ini', '.txt', '.env.example', '.gitignore', '.npmrc',
  ],
  ignoreDirs: [
    '.git', 'node_modules', 'dist', 'build', 'coverage',
    '.cache', '.next', '.turbo', '.vite', 'out', 'target',
  ],
  ignoreFiles: ['PROJECT_CONTEXT.md', 'PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md'],
  maxFileBytes: 300_000,
  includeLockfiles: true,
  includeHiddenFiles: true,
};

const LOCKFILES = new Set([
  'package-lock.json',
  'pnpm-lock.yaml',
  'yarn.lock',
  'bun.lock',
  'bun.lockb',
]);

const TEXT_FILE_OVERRIDES = new Set(['.env.example', '.gitignore', '.npmrc']);

function parseArgs(argv: string[]): { root: string; output?: string; configPath?: string; includeTests: boolean; noSource: boolean } {
  const args = [...argv];
  let root = process.cwd();
  let output: string | undefined;
  let configPath: string | undefined;
  let includeTests = false;
  let noSource = false;

  while (args.length) {
    const arg = args.shift()!;
    if (arg === '--root') root = path.resolve(args.shift() ?? '.');
    else if (arg === '--output') output = args.shift();
    else if (arg === '--config') configPath = path.resolve(args.shift() ?? 'docs.config.json');
    else if (arg === '--include-tests') includeTests = true;
    else if (arg === '--no-source') noSource = true;
    else if (arg === '--help' || arg === '-h') {
      printHelp();
      process.exit(0);
    } else {
      throw new Error(`Unknown argument: ${arg}`);
    }
  }

  return { root, output, configPath, includeTests, noSource };
}

function printHelp(): void {
  console.log(`
Project Context Generator

Usage:
  npm run docs -- [options]

Options:
  --root <dir>          Project root to scan. Default: current directory.
  --output <file>       Output Markdown file. Default: configured output.
  --config <file>       Config JSON file. Default: docs.config.json when present.
  --include-tests       Include common test/spec files even when ignored by a custom rule.
  --no-source            Generate structure/metadata without source code contents.
  --help, -h            Show this help.
`);
}

function loadConfig(root: string, configPath?: string): Config {
  const candidate = configPath ?? path.join(root, 'docs.config.json');
  if (!existsSync(candidate)) return { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG };

  const raw = JSON.parse(readFileSync(candidate, 'utf8')) as Partial<Config>;
  return {
    output: raw.output ?? DEFAULT_CONFIG.output,
    includeExtensions: raw.includeExtensions ?? DEFAULT_CONFIG.includeExtensions,
    ignoreDirs: raw.ignoreDirs ?? DEFAULT_CONFIG.ignoreDirs,
    ignoreFiles: raw.ignoreFiles ?? DEFAULT_CONFIG.ignoreFiles,
    maxFileBytes: raw.maxFileBytes ?? DEFAULT_CONFIG.maxFileBytes,
    includeLockfiles: raw.includeLockfiles ?? DEFAULT_CONFIG.includeLockfiles,
    includeHiddenFiles: raw.includeHiddenFiles ?? DEFAULT_CONFIG.includeHiddenFiles,
  };
}

function isLikelyBinary(buffer: Buffer): boolean {
  const sample = buffer.subarray(0, Math.min(buffer.length, 8192));
  return sample.includes(0);
}

function shouldIncludeFile(fileName: string, config: Config, includeTests: boolean): boolean {
  if (config.ignoreFiles.includes(fileName)) return false;
  if (!config.includeHiddenFiles && fileName.startsWith('.')) return false;
  if (LOCKFILES.has(fileName)) return config.includeLockfiles;
  if (includeTests && /\.(test|spec)\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/.test(fileName)) return true;
  if (TEXT_FILE_OVERRIDES.has(fileName)) return true;
  return config.includeExtensions.includes(path.extname(fileName).toLowerCase());
}

function scanFiles(root: string, config: Config, includeTests: boolean): FileEntry[] {
  const results: FileEntry[] = [];

  function walk(dir: string): void {
    const entries = readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
    entries.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

    for (const entry of entries) {
      const abs = path.join(dir, entry.name);
      const rel = path.relative(root, abs).split(path.sep).join('/');

      if (entry.isDirectory()) {
        if (config.ignoreDirs.includes(entry.name)) continue;
        walk(abs);
        continue;
      }

      if (!entry.isFile()) continue;
      if (!shouldIncludeFile(entry.name, config, includeTests)) continue;

      let stat;
      try {
        stat = statSync(abs);
      } catch {
        continue;
      }

      const entryInfo: FileEntry = {
        absPath: abs,
        relPath: rel,
        ext: path.extname(entry.name).toLowerCase(),
        bytes: stat.size,
        lines: 0,
      };

      if (stat.size > config.maxFileBytes) {
        entryInfo.skippedReason = `File exceeds maxFileBytes (${formatBytes(config.maxFileBytes)}).`;
        results.push(entryInfo);
        continue;
      }

      try {
        const buffer = readFileSync(abs);
        if (isLikelyBinary(buffer)) {
          entryInfo.skippedReason = 'Likely binary file.';
        } else {
          entryInfo.text = buffer.toString('utf8').replaceAll('\r\n', '\n');
          entryInfo.lines = entryInfo.text === '' ? 0 : entryInfo.text.split('\n').length;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        entryInfo.skippedReason = `Could not read file: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`;
      }

      results.push(entryInfo);
    }
  }

  walk(root);
  return results;
}

function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  if (bytes < 1024 ** 2) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  return `${(bytes / 1024 ** 2).toFixed(1)} MB`;
}

function buildTree(files: FileEntry[]): string {
  interface TreeNode { children: Map<string, TreeNode>; file?: boolean }
  const root: TreeNode = { children: new Map() };

  for (const file of files) {
    const parts = file.relPath.split('/');
    let node = root;
    for (const part of parts) {
      if (!node.children.has(part)) node.children.set(part, { children: new Map() });
      node = node.children.get(part)!;
    }
    node.file = true;
  }

  const lines: string[] = [];
  function render(node: TreeNode, prefix: string): void {
    const names = [...node.children.keys()].sort((a, b) => {
      const aNode = node.children.get(a)!;
      const bNode = node.children.get(b)!;
      if (aNode.file !== bNode.file) return aNode.file ? 1 : -1;
      return a.localeCompare(b);
    });

    names.forEach((name, index) => {
      const child = node.children.get(name)!;
      const last = index === names.length - 1;
      lines.push(`${prefix}${last ? '└── ' : '├── '}${name}${child.file ? '' : '/'}`);
      if (child.children.size) render(child, `${prefix}${last ? '    ' : '│   '}`);
    });
  }

  render(root, '');
  return lines.join('\n');
}

function extractImportLinks(files: FileEntry[], root: string): ImportLink[] {
  const sourceExtensions = new Set(['.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx', '.mjs', '.cjs']);
  const fileSet = new Set(files.map(f => f.relPath));
  const links: ImportLink[] = [];

  const importRegex = /(?:import\s+(?:[^'";]+?\s+from\s+)?|export\s+(?:[^'";]+?\s+from\s+)?|require\s*\(|import\s*\()(['"])(.+?)\1/g;

  for (const file of files) {
    if (!sourceExtensions.has(file.ext) || !file.text) continue;

    for (const match of file.text.matchAll(importRegex)) {
      const raw = match[2];
      if (!raw.startsWith('.')) continue;

      const baseAbs = path.resolve(path.dirname(file.absPath), raw);
      const rawExt = path.extname(baseAbs).toLowerCase();
      const extensionlessAbs = ['.js', '.jsx', '.mjs', '.cjs', '.ts', '.tsx'].includes(rawExt)
        ? baseAbs.slice(0, -rawExt.length)
        : baseAbs;
      const candidates = [
        baseAbs,
        `${extensionlessAbs}.ts`, `${extensionlessAbs}.tsx`, `${extensionlessAbs}.js`, `${extensionlessAbs}.jsx`, `${extensionlessAbs}.mjs`, `${extensionlessAbs}.cjs`,
        path.join(extensionlessAbs, 'index.ts'), path.join(extensionlessAbs, 'index.tsx'),
        path.join(extensionlessAbs, 'index.js'), path.join(extensionlessAbs, 'index.jsx'),
      ];
      const resolved = candidates.map(candidate => path.relative(root, candidate).split(path.sep).join('/'))
        .find(candidate => fileSet.has(candidate)) ?? null;

      links.push({ from: file.relPath, raw, resolved });
    }
  }

  return links;
}

function findTodos(files: FileEntry[]): string[] {
  const items: string[] = [];
  for (const file of files) {
    if (!file.text) continue;
    const lines = file.text.split('\n');
    lines.forEach((line, index) => {
      const match = line.match(/\b(TODO|FIXME|HACK|XXX)\b[:\-]?\s*(.*)$/i);
      if (match) {
        items.push(`${file.relPath}:${index + 1} **${match[1].toUpperCase()}** ${match[2].trim()}`);
      }
    });
  }
  return items;
}

function chooseFence(text: string): string {
  const longest = Math.max(0, ...(text.match(/`+/g) ?? []).map(s => s.length));
  return '`'.repeat(Math.max(3, longest + 1));
}

function languageForFile(file: FileEntry): string {
  const byName: Record<string, string> = {
    '.md': 'markdown', '.mdx': 'mdx', '.json': 'json', '.jsonc': 'jsonc',
    '.css': 'css', '.scss': 'scss', '.html': 'html', '.yaml': 'yaml', '.yml': 'yaml',
    '.toml': 'toml', '.ini': 'ini', '.txt': 'text',
  };
  const name = path.basename(file.relPath);
  if (name === 'Dockerfile') return 'dockerfile';
  if (name === '.gitignore' || name === '.npmrc' || name === '.env.example') return 'text';
  if (byName[file.ext]) return byName[file.ext];
  if (['.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx', '.mjs', '.cjs'].includes(file.ext)) return 'typescript';
  return 'text';
}

function safeRelativeOutput(root: string, output: string): string {
  return path.isAbsolute(output) ? output : path.resolve(root, output);
}

function createMarkdown(root: string, files: FileEntry[], config: Config, options: { noSource: boolean }): string {
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const links = extractImportLinks(files, root);
  const todos = findTodos(files);
  const included = files.filter(f => f.text !== undefined);
  const skipped = files.filter(f => f.skippedReason);
  const totalBytes = files.reduce((sum, f) => sum + f.bytes, 0);
  const totalLines = included.reduce((sum, f) => sum + f.lines, 0);

  const internalLinks = links.filter(link => link.resolved);
  const unresolvedRelative = links.filter(link => !link.resolved);

  const packageJson = files.find(f => f.relPath === 'package.json' && f.text);
  let packageSummary = '';
  if (packageJson?.text) {
    try {
      const pkg = JSON.parse(packageJson.text) as Record<string, unknown>;
      const scripts = pkg.scripts && typeof pkg.scripts === 'object' ? Object.keys(pkg.scripts as object) : [];
      packageSummary = [
        `- Name: ${typeof pkg.name === 'string' ? pkg.name : 'unknown'}`,
        `- Version: ${typeof pkg.version === 'string' ? pkg.version : 'unknown'}`,
        `- Scripts: ${scripts.length ? scripts.join(', ') : 'none detected'}`,
        `- Package type: ${typeof pkg.type === 'string' ? pkg.type : 'not specified'}`,
      ].join('\n');
    } catch {
      packageSummary = '- package.json could not be parsed as standard JSON.';
    }
  }

  const sections: string[] = [];
  sections.push(`# PROJECT CONTEXT\n\n> Generated automatically. Treat source files as authoritative; summaries are derived metadata.\n\n- Generated: ${now}\n- Root: \`${path.basename(root)}\`\n- Files scanned: ${files.length}\n- Files included with readable text: ${included.length}\n- Total included source lines: ${totalLines.toLocaleString()}\n- Total scanned size: ${formatBytes(totalBytes)}\n- Max file size: ${formatBytes(config.maxFileBytes)}\n`);

  sections.push(`## PROJECT STRUCTURE\n\n\`\`\`text\n${buildTree(files)}\n\`\`\``);

  if (packageSummary) sections.push(`## PACKAGE SUMMARY\n\n${packageSummary}`);

  sections.push(`## INTERNAL IMPORTS / DEPENDENCIES\n\n${internalLinks.length
    ? internalLinks.map(link => `- \`${link.from}\` → \`${link.resolved}\` (import: \`${link.raw}\`)`).join('\n')
    : '_No relative internal imports were detected._'}`);

  if (unresolvedRelative.length) {
    sections.push(`## UNRESOLVED RELATIVE IMPORTS\n\n${unresolvedRelative.map(link => `- \`${link.from}\` → \`${link.raw}\``).join('\n')}`);
  }

  sections.push(`## TODO / FIXME / HACK\n\n${todos.length ? todos.map(item => `- ${item}`).join('\n') : '_None detected._'}`);

  if (skipped.length) {
    sections.push(`## SKIPPED FILES\n\n${skipped.map(file => `- \`${file.relPath}\` — ${file.skippedReason}`).join('\n')}`);
  }

  sections.push(`## FILE INDEX\n\n| File | Size | Lines | Status |\n|---|---:|---:|---|\n${files.map(file => `| \`${file.relPath}\` | ${formatBytes(file.bytes)} | ${file.lines || '—'} | ${file.skippedReason ? `Skipped: ${escapeTable(file.skippedReason)}` : 'Included'} |`).join('\n')}`);

  if (!options.noSource) {
    sections.push('## SOURCE FILES');
    for (const file of included) {
      const fence = chooseFence(file.text!);
      sections.push(`### \`${file.relPath}\`\n\n${fence}${languageForFile(file)}\n${file.text}\n${fence}`);
    }
  }

  sections.push(`## AI USAGE NOTES\n\n- Use the **source file sections** as the ground truth for implementation details.\n- The dependency section is heuristic and only resolves relative imports when the target file exists in the snapshot.\n- Generated/build/cache directories are excluded by default.\n- Files larger than the configured limit are listed but their contents are omitted.\n- Re-run the generator after changing the project to refresh this snapshot.`);

  return `${sections.join('\n\n')}\n`;
}

function escapeTable(value: string): string {
  return value.replaceAll('|', '\\|').replaceAll('\n', ' ');
}

function writeStructureFile(root: string, files: FileEntry[]): void {
  const output = path.join(root, 'PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md');
  const lines = [
    '# PROJECT STRUCTURE',
    '',
    '> Generated automatically by Project Context Generator.',
    '',
    '```text',
    buildTree(files),
    '```',
    '',
    '## Files',
    '',
    ...files.map(f => `- \`${f.relPath}\` (${formatBytes(f.bytes)}, ${f.lines || 'unknown'} lines)`),
    '',
  ];
  writeFileSync(output, lines.join('\n'), 'utf8');
}

function main(): void {
  const options = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
  if (!existsSync(options.root) || !lstatSync(options.root).isDirectory()) {
    throw new Error(`Project root does not exist or is not a directory: ${options.root}`);
  }

  const config = loadConfig(options.root, options.configPath);
  const files = scanFiles(options.root, config, options.includeTests);
  const outputPath = safeRelativeOutput(options.root, options.output ?? config.output);
  const markdown = createMarkdown(options.root, files, config, { noSource: options.noSource });
  writeFileSync(outputPath, markdown, 'utf8');

  if (path.basename(outputPath) !== 'PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md') {
    writeStructureFile(options.root, files);
  }

  console.log(`Generated ${path.relative(process.cwd(), outputPath) || outputPath}`);
  console.log(`Scanned ${files.length} files; ${files.filter(f => f.text !== undefined).length} included with readable text.`);
}

try {
  main();
} catch (error) {
  console.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
  process.exit(1);
}


````

### `tools/weather-smoke.ts`

```typescript
/** Live ECCC weather smoke test. */
import { getWeather, validateQuery } from "../lib/weather/service";

async function main() {
  const locations = [
    ["Whistler", 50.12, -122.95],
    ["Singing Pass area", 50.07, -122.86],
    ["Toronto", 43.65, -79.38],
  ] as const;

  for (const [name, lat, lng] of locations) {
    const started = Date.now();

    const data = await getWeather(
      validateQuery(
        new URLSearchParams({
          lat: String(lat),
          lng: String(lng),
        })
      )
    );

    if (data.alerts.status !== "ok") {
      throw new Error(`${name}: ECCC alerts unavailable`);
    }

    if (data.hourly.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(`${name}: model temperature samples unavailable`);
    }

    if (data.daily.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(`${name}: no daily model summary`);
    }

    console.log(
      `${name}: ${data.hourly.length} samples, ` +
      `${data.daily.length} days, ` +
      `models=${data.modelsAvailable.join(",")}, ` +
      `first=${data.hourly[0].model} ` +
      `${data.hourly[0].temperature}°C, ` +
      `${Date.now() - started}ms`
    );
  }
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error("Weather smoke test failed:", error);
  throw error;
});
